r+shariskezu sku ske spe speri skugo 4ci ri hrī5rtsi 4rnge—ri snyiṣe 4༵corī t+t+waṃri ge 4 ༄ chi chosto bi oṃd+kutrī trī ṇa torirdo ya cho jisgro sgyuspyarterme snye di — —/ji retsā jo trer+sha snye ri ri rje ṣe glo cho smoṭ+wāṃXrme ri ju ྾sgo4 ༄༄ ngatsho ༄ — bo ༷sgrusgro3 4sa mo sta —r+ṣa 〉 wa4 / ri dze ciyapre ri 4 trī ri sde sdumingadroskresked+ku/cho sngu gle chi riri —sne —rdzi sku dzal4 spre ṣ+ka rī ru spya ri d+nghape 4snye nemosku rīskurtse phyo rdzo ri sneṅkasku sauri thorījir 9trī3snyedzeṇ+ḍaṃ ( re ri sgorngo tre rtsostor+shane smiX.a+yomeṣ+ṭha ༷'i skra'i 4 ci jiske khe ‘snyephro ju me+eyiḍazirtso sgyutshosgo4 phyo zhesne petshorto — ra gyi9 4ri kho snar+ṣa dze sgror+ṣa d+ku phre — sle — snye cisto trī rmeji rdzi dzhatrengahwariste dīrisnari zhespre ge lha ri ṭāglo(/9 〉 ci ) tho mi ni zi+oX tho rerngisnasmori— cabyeṣ+peX phroṃ mu5sne ram̐ji 7ri tsho — ri dzeji~Xza yoskye ri — —44 — rdosko d+kurti tiri 0 ji pa 7 ṅkad+ngha——— wargu rtso waṃ lhusgoXdzār+sha la sh+lautre sru ci rī thospyo mo tsho lto jiskre rdeshakyi ༈༈ ༄ sgro dzodza 7lo ru 7 narilja stor+sā — rtodzedze jin sna tsho 0gene 4d+ku dza ༷rī trī lo rdortswaX —d+kun wī3ོdzo0 / d+kur+sha trīri

sgrig pa po'i gtam/ slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog ni/deng dus bod mi rigs spyi'i gtsug tu mchod pa'i mkhas dbang chen po zhig red/ khong gis sku tshe gang bor rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la thugs zhen zab bzhes ngos nyams pa sor chud/ ma nyams gong 'phel/ shes rig yar rgyas kyi don du brtse gzigs zol med/ brtson pa lhod med/ gsung dbyangs 'gag med kyis rang nus gang yod phul ba'i bka' drin ni bsam brjod yul las 'das pa zhig red/ lhag par du khong gis nga tshor bzhag pa'i rig gzhung gi shul bzhag rin po che la bltas kyin bltas kyin mos gus mchi ma rab tu 'khrigs/ bsam bzhin bsam bzhin rin thang gzhal du med pa shes/ nga rang tsho mi rigs dpe skrun gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pa'i ngos nas bshad na/ slob dpon chen mo 'di ba'i phyag rtsom mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig bsgrigs nas par du bskrun na 1

ni rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod la rin chen nor bu zhig bsnan pa lta bu'i dge mtshan chen po ldan zhing / lar blo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs la rig pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa zhig mngon par bstabs pa'i phan yon shin tu mi dman pa zhig yod par mthong nas de lugs kyi brtson pa lhur len pa'i 'dun pa drag po snying la bcags khar/ nye lam rje nyid kyi sku sring bde mchog skyid dang khong gi yang tsha grwa btsun bslab gsum rgya mtsho zung gis sa thag ring bo'i dka' sdug la ma 'dzems par rje nyid kyi gsung rtsom mtha' dag dre'u khal du longs pa zhig dngos su khur nas rang re'i dpe skrun khang du slebs shing / khyed dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig spus tshad legs pas gzhan su dang gang la'ang ma sprad par khyed cag la gtad pa yin zhes gsung 'bum dpar skrun gyi dngos shugs dbang cha yod tshad nga tshor phul ba dang /khyad par du nged dpe skrun khang la ma dngul gyi 'khos ka zhan pa mthong nas/ gcen po'i gsung 'bum par du btab nas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon na de las che ba med ces gsungs te gcen rin po che'i brtsams yon skar gcig kyang med pa'i thog da dung gzhan las zhal 'debs dngul sgor khri gnyis tsam bsdus nas gun gsab kyi ཿ ri

rogs skyor byas pa la nga tsho sems 'gul chin po dang skul ma chin po thebs te/ gzhi nas khong gi gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig sgrig pa'i 'char gzhi dngos bstar byas pa yin/ da cha nga tshos par du bskrun pa'i gsung 'bum 'di la khyon —bsdoms pod drug tu bkar/ pod dang po ni gtso cher rnam thar skor yin/ 'di'i nang du nga tshos de snga sus kyang mjal ma myong ba'i mdo smad bstan pa'i bdag po rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lo rgyus mjal thub par ma zad/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi byung ba lo rgyus las mkhas chen dam pa zhig thos sbyang gi stobs ga 'dra zhig la brten nas 'tsha ra longs byung ba'i tshul la rgyus mnga' lon cing rang nyid la sbyang stobs che ru bskyed pa'i skul ma thebs nges yin/ pod gnyis pa ni gtso cher gzhung 'grel skor te/ 'di'i nang nas rtsom pa po rang nyid nang don rig pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin pa'i ngos nas deng gi 'chad grwa'i gzhung khrid kyi dka' gnad la dmigs nas tshig don gnyis gsal gyi 'grel bshad gnang yod/ pod gsum pa ri gtso cher lo rgyus skor te/ 'di'i nang du bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas dar tshul gyi lo rgyus sogs bkod yod pas/nga tshos lo rgyus 'di dag las rtsopopa po'i lo rgyus zhib/ 'jug gi 3

phul rgyung grub 'bras mthong thub par ma brid/ mkhas pa gzhan/gyi gsung na med pa'i legs bshad btso ma'i gser lta bu'ang mi nyung ba zhig zin rgyu yod do/ /pod bzhi ba ni gtso cher sgra snyan ngag skar rtsis kyi skor yin/ 'di'i nang du slob dpon 'di bas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bslab bya so so rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing go bde ba'i lam nas bkral yod pas las dang po ba rnams la nye bar mkho zhing 'jug bde ba'i gnas dam pa zhig tu 'khums so/ /pod lnga ba ni gtso cher sum rtags dag gsum skor yin/ 'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa po'i deng rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs dang lta ba gsar ba/ lag len gyi rin thang ldan zhing nye bar mkho ba'i bshad pa gsar ba shes rtogs byed thub pa yin/ pod drug pa ni gsung thor bu'i skor te/'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa pos gdul bya'i blo gang la gang 'tsham du sbyar ba'i shes bya sna tshogs/ dri ba dris lan/ chab shog sogs mjal thub la/ gsung tsag tsig la snang chung mi byed par zhib tu bklags na ni bye ma'i gseb nas gser rdo rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' snang skye'ang srid do/ /mdor na/ khong gi gsung 'bum la brjod don zab kyang tshig 'grel gsal ba/ rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i las dang 4

po ba rnams kyi blor 'tsham zhing go sla ba/ gnas lnga rig pa'i snying bcud 'dus shing 'jug bde ba/ shes ldan rgan pas bklags na blo skyed gsar ba thob pa/ a gsar gzhon nus bklags na mos gus dbang med 'chor ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod chen po zhig yin pas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes dang brtse ba'i grogs su gyur cig gu/ /zhes 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig khang nas/ spyi lo 1996 zla 8 tshes3 la phul/
chiri thu —tsā ri ri mi — tsho ci ma rī

dkar chag zhadanakidasko dbyudaske dardoska nazhud buzhi rdo lhazhi dan py-in nabazha napyod / snyan dag gi sdug jibucadab/naska / sdug zhaskresko sge lhagha zhasded nades zheska gu na spruzhugaska sro/ / dze skuburga dad skozhi tshigs dacad nanarga thazhad ska/ ‘ — ( 3ci )skuzhaspe gahaṃg puzhi tshogaspe thacad rnanarga zhazhad blo/ ( 75 )skudaska gsumā puzhi tshogs dacad rnanarga thazhad pu/ ( 87 )skuzharga bzhi brazhi tshogs zhacad rnanargo zhazhad pu/ ( 95 )skuzhaṅge lnga dazhi tshogaska zhacad rnanargawāṭ+wād pu/ tsho sna ( 1 17)skadaspe drug puzhi dzigs zhacad rnanam bulhad pu/ ( 123 )skuzhaspe budun puzhi dzigargasnyezhacad rnanas 'ashadapu/ ( 1 28 )skubus burgyad puzhi dzigarga bucadarnagasadz+nyozhazhad pu/ ༷༷ ( 132 )5na byin skubusu brargyad puzhi naldazha dakhyod zhaskan zhazhelka gid ci1

brazhin nor guzha 'aspred nanaspe skuzhobuzud smug zhabyed kyi tshigaspe bucad rnanasu brazhad pu/ ñtsa (156)mdug byid / (170)sprustuska don skyoska n+derdon rgyu zhitshon zhidug buzhi glu gnaidasro / ཿga zhaspreska snyag don naspru gaskaska zheska byi t+pā buzhugaske sro/ /nachod pur darnod puzhi tshig don buzhad pu/ (179)gzhud don dardog zhasprelka tha/ (182)gnas dang bo'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (200)gnas gnyis pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (267)gnas gsum pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (367)gnas bzhi ba'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (437)gnas lnga ba'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (499)gnas drug pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (5tso 2)gnas bdun pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (615)gnas brgyad pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/ (673)nadug byad / (715)3

sgeg da chen rdo rgyud bla nazhi 2snyan buskyoska / :ga zhaspren dubu sprusnyan gin rgyuska zheska py-i bu buzhugaska zho//zhezhu dad bro/ de dazhin gshegs puzhi snyid thozhi skubus buzhad pu (723〉rluzhu gahaṃs pu/ dag pu gahaṃs dad ldan puzhi byud thubra nu skubus brazhad pu/ ༷ (826)zhezhu gsumā pu/ dag pu gahaṃska ldan gyi byad chubu ska burten puzhi ā+on tan rgyu skabuspe buzhad pu/ (868)zhe'u buzhi bra/ skangs rgyarga sum̐ k+kon tan ska tharten puzhi de buzhin gzhegs puzhi zhaphroṃn lus kyi skabuska buzhad pu/ (893)mudug byad / (930)

/ rdzo / margyu // slobatho dze /ma lju—ghoṣāhāsabadz+rasu 'irami t+natsusnye 8ñdzasnye/nya//snye+odi+osnye+o/ snyo// 5zhe lde7/haṃ༈45kyir+sā sgrormya r+sāmabe+ermar+shamy-ir+yān snosgro+o 0 0 rkatsar ṇan+ta suka ba rī kānābakya gras+dzabhāsnyesdo ——snyenar+sha 5sne0rko sne sposnyemiwi kheyasnye/ rti/ / trī trerme tso⑫ sbyo mkhrimasmo mā lāpu ṣ+pe nām tarata sma//cekho/ (zhe sdolasmrosnedekau (snyo snyo 5snye+o5ོ

— rko sprosnye— ldasnyelasdoyasnyespyo — snye 2snyeglukausnyedzo chi citsho ṭ+wāṃ — /— 4snyesgrusnyekyigotsosnyegi0snye tsho —/la 5 sgo8snyetremeyu/snyekaudi ci~X ci:ca saci nyu dze 0 1 1 ci / / 3 3 rtse rtso hūṃ hūṃ / /— 3— / rmā/ ci ṅgemakhriṭīrmāl+līskusgyukhrilgor+yā rkuzhe — chi3smo be+emamabe+esgror+ṣasakhyu ma྾ 0sgolge/ /bālaspa rberidzoya3t+t+waṃkhaṃ d+nghator dhi yī r+bha/ / lhe/khyelakush+ka khi kyi mak+ṣe/'a spyosanes/lgo phesprusnyes gar+ṣanyo sau chosaci ma 0 gem m+mu r+yātshu / ༈ 3 snye 3 3 dzilha 3 '-i / 3 /d+ku ma zu zarmā ci haṃ d+kuspulho/rī rtso 5ma chi ri kyā sposgromaslosloḥ khrilkepy-ime du rnyenasnasnebu ṣ+ṭha ji hā samedha saḥ/ /bdag 'e sa bar+yā dang snya/khro slohrī a+yo'idab brgyabatshwa//

tsho — bhe rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpa~X dbyangs/ /mi yi zol gyis bshad sgrub la brtson mdzad bzang si/sa/ /shes bya'i gnas la rtag 'grus 'od stong rab 'bar bas/ /thub bstan pad tshal rgyas mdzad kun mkhyen mchog der 'dud/ /dpag par dka' ba'i mkhyen dpyod pad ma gzhon nu des/ /mdo rgyud rig gnas nyi zer bag med 'thung che bas/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho ge sar rdul mang rab skyugs te/ /yangs pa'i sa chen 'di la sngon med shis pa bsgrubs/ /dam pa du ma'i gsung gi bskul tshig rlung g.yos te/ /bdag yid ljon pa g.yos shing 'grel tshig me tog phring / /'thor ba dam pa'i spyan sngar bstar 'os 'ga' mchis na/ /bdag dang skal mnyam dag gi mgrin pa'i rgyan du 'bul/ /'dir kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan pos sa chen khyab pa gang de'i thugs 'jam dpal rdo rje brtan pa'i 'khor lo dang gsung sgra dbyangs lha mo'i rgyud mang gi sgra las drangs pa'i zab gsung yongs su grags pa dag las srid zhi'i gdung sel phar snye
phyin skabs brgyad kyi mtha' dpyodabar gsum gyi tshigs bcad dag thitshod tsam zhig 'god par bya 'o / /ri

skubus dad sdozhi sdugaska bucad rnanaska sprugid da/ thog mar skabs dang bo'i mtha' dpyod kyi don 'chad pa la bzhi/ mchod par brjod pa/ bstan bcos 'di'i don thugs su chu/da par bstan pa/ ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul bstan pa/ snod ldan nyan par bskul ba'o/ /dang bo la/ bla ma la mchod par brjod pa/ 1 bstan pa'i bdag po la mchod par brjod pa/ 1 byams pa la mchod par brjod pa/ kā 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa/ 4lha mo dbyangs ca na ma la mchod par brjod pa/ 5 thogs med sku mched la mchod par brjod pa/ a+yo 'phags seng la mchod par brjod pa/ gyi chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams la mchod par brjod pa/ 8rje bdag nyid chen po la mchod par brjod pa/ 9 sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen la mchod par brjod pa/ 10 mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang lamachod par brjod pa/ 11 rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la mchodagepar brjod pa'o/ /13dang bo bla ma la mchod par brjod pa ni/ 'od ldan 3

bcu gasnyes bdag bzhin thub pa'i bstan/ /ji dang sras bzhi mchog skyed yum don kun/ /gsal madz+rad yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs mchog kun zhabs/ /dad pa'i sbyi gtsug rgyan byas snying nas 'dud/ /ces pa ste 'od ldan bcu gnyis kyi bdag po ni nyi ma yin la/ nyi maso 'jig rten khams kyi mun pa bsal nas 'od kyi snang bas 'jig rten gyi gling dang gling phran kun gsal bar byed pa de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang /nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems sangs rgyas 'phags pa ste sras bzhi mchog tu skyed par byed pa'i brjod bya don gyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ston byed rjod byed tshig gi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i don kun te ma lus par gsal bar mdzad pa'i yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen khri chen rnam bzhi sogs 'jam dbyangs mi'i rnam par rol ba thun mong snang tshod la'ang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas 'gran zla dang bral ba'i stabs kyis bstan 'dzin gyi khrod na mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyi sku'i dma' shos zhabs de nyid bdag gi dad pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan du byas te snying nas 'dud pa ste snying nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di ni dpe rgyan so gnyis kyi dang bo chos dpe'o//nyi ma la bcu gnyis bdag po zhes brjod pa ni/ skar khyim gyi 4

go la'i khyim bcu gnyis la nyi mas reng 'grosajigayon skor gyis lo — gcig la rdzogs par longs spyod pas na khyim bcu gnyis kyi bdagapo zhes brjod pa dang / yang dus 'khor lugs kyi tha snyad sadum bu bcu gnyis la dbang bsgyur ba'am/ mdzod lugs kyici gling bzhi gling phran brgyad de gling bcu gnyis la dbang bsgyur bsan bcu gnyis bdag po zhes kyang brjod do/ /khyim bcu gnyis ni/ lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa/ /seng ge bu mo srang sdig gzhu/ /chu srin bum pa nya rnams so/ /zhes gosungs pa ltar/lug khyim/ glang khyim/ 'khrig khyim/ karka ṭa'i khyim/ seng ge'i khyim/ bu mo'i khyim/ srang khyim/ sdig khyim/ gzhu khyim/ chu srin gyi khyim/ bum pa'i khyim/ nya'i khyim rnams so/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i yongs 'dzin khri chen rnam bzhi ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma khri rin po che ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho dang / 1 de'i sras kyi thu bo theg chen sbyor lam bar gsungs pa'i rgyal sras chen po mdo sngags gnyis dang lung gi gter mdzod drin can bla ma don 'grub rgya mtsho dang / 3 thor rgod/ mdo sngags kun dang lung rtogs gnyis ka'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dgon lung sprul sku ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan/ kā lcang skya/ dka' lnga sogs rigs pa smra ba la deng dus kyi sa'i steng na 'gran zla 5

bralajib rigs pa'i dbang phyug shes rab sbyinabyupa /ste/ 4 nyi ma thang ba ste gsang phu'i grwa tshang bcu gcig gi nang tshan/ bzhi'o/ / gnyis pha bstan pa'i bdag po la mchod par brjod pa ni/lhag bsamalhang stobs mchog gis rgyal sras thog ma'i dus nasaglu 5 kyang / /zla bral khrod ne pad dkar 'dra zhes rgyal rnams rmad byuji ba'i/ /bsngags brjod gragaso snyan mkha' bzhin phyogs kun khrab mngod nyi ma'i gnyen/ /mnyam med shākya beng ge' zhabs sen snying dbus pad mtshor bzhugs/ /zhes pa ste/ snying rje pad ma dkar bo'i mdo las bshad pa ltar bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i tshe na/ rgyal sras gzhan gyis bdag gir ma bzhes pa'i ma dag pa'i mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i 'gro ba dmu rgod rnams rjes su 'dzin par thugs bskyed cing smon lam btab pas/ rgyal ba'i sras su gyur pa ste byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i thog ma'i dus nas kyang / byang chub sems dpa' gzhan las kyang / 'gran zla dang bral ba khyod ni pad ma dkar bo dang 'dra'o/ /zhes rgyal ba rnams mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i grags pa snyan pos phyogs kun khyab par mdzad pa bo/ nyi ma'i gdung rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i nyi ma'i 6

gnyin mnyam mid shākya seng ge'i zhabs son rje nyid kyi snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi pad ma'i gdan gyi mtsho chen po 'dir bzhugs shig ces pa'o/ /'di ni bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin no/ / gsum pa byams pa la mchod par brjod pa ni/ mgon de'i rgyal tsha ba bye ba phrag brgya'i gling / /ma lus gcig car chos kyis skyo nga mardzod pa'i/ /thub pa'i gsang gsum marngon byur bdud bzhi las/ /rgyal ba'i mi pham mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces pa ste/ mgon de'i zhes pa'i de sgra ni nges bzung gi phrad de/ gang ngos bzung na gong du brjod ma thag pa'i shākya seng ge de'i rgyal tshab tu gyur pa/ yul 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya'i gling ma lus pa/ dus cig car du thabs dam pa chos kyis skyong bar mdzad cing / thub pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum mngon du gyur pa ste lkog tu ma gyur pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / phung bo'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud/lha'i bu'i bdud de bdud bzhi phra rags las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud/ ces pa'o/ /'di ni bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang yonasnye tan rang bzhin brjod pa bsres pa'i rgyan no/ /shākya thub pa'i rgyal tshab tu gyur tshul ni/7

ston pa shākyajithub pajisku tshe 'di'i sngonajidu dga' ldan rdu lha 'i bu dam pa tog dkar zhes pa'i lha'i dpal mgon du skye ba bzhes te/ 'dzam bu'i gling du mi rnams kyi dpal mgon du phebs ran pa na/dbu'i prog zhu rje btsun byams mgon gyi dbu la gnang ste/ dga' ldan gyi chos kyi rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur bas/ rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po zhes grags pa dang / dga' ldan gyi lha rna mas kyis byams mgon rgyal tshab tu thob pa na/ rang cag nams mi pham mo zhes bsgrags pas/ mi pham mgon zhes grags so/ /bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa ni/ dpag med gdod nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang / /smon dbang rgyal sras tshul gyis rnam 'dren kun/ /bskyed mngod rgyal ba' lab gabyug la btud kye/ /cam don ma lus gsal ba'i blo gros spyol/ /ces pa ste/ bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i gdod nas te sngon rol nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin kyeng / sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis rnam 'dren kun te rgyal ba dpag tu med par thog mar thugs bskyed par mdzad pa dang / bar du tshogs gnyis rlabs po che la slob par mdzad pa dang / mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa la grogs dan dang bshes gnyen mdzad pa'i stabs kyis/ rgyal 8

ba rnams skyed par mdzad pa'i yab lta bur gyur pa'i rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs la lus ngag yid gsum gyis btud de/ kye zhes thugs rgyud bskyul ba'i 'bod tshig bsgrags nas/ zhe yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi brjod bya'i don gcig kyang ma lus par sems la gsal lhang lhang 'char ba'i blo gros stsol cig ces dngos grub zhus pa'o/ /'di yang bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no/ /lnga ba lha mo dbyangs can ma la mchod par brjod pa ni/ dung dung lan re mos spyang rmongs pa'i snying / /mang mang shes bya'i gzugs kun gsal 'char ba'i/ /mokhas mkhas gtsug nor mchog ster dbyangs can kye/ /lhag skug dka' gnad mdud grol ngag spyol cig /ces pa ste/ sems dung dung ba'i dad pa lan re tsam gyis mos sgom byas pa tsam gyis kyang sngar shes bya la rmongs pa'i snying la/ mang ba bas kyang ches mang ba'i shes bya'i rang dang spyi'i gzugs kun te ngo bo dang khyad par ma lus pa ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar 'char ba'i stabs kyis/ mkhas pa las kyang ches mkhas pa dag gi gtsug gi nor bu ste/ gtsug tu bkur ba'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang mchog ster bar mdzad pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma kye/ zhes bugs rgyud bskul te/ 'bad brtson 9

chir bskyed mi dgos par lhug lhug tu dka' ba'i gnad kyi mdu da pa grol nus pa'i rtsom pa ngag gi dngos grub stsol ci ga ces dngos grub zhus palko /'di ni zung ldan gyi rgyan gyi bye brag bar ma chodad+kupa'i zung ldan bco lngab rkang ba bzhi ga'i thogasamar yod pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ /drug pa thogs med sku mched la mchod par brjod pa ni/yum don dka' snyam bcu gnyis lor skub pa'i/ /mi pham gsung than gaṅgā'i chu klung che/ /lha yi yul nas mi yul ma lus par/ /khrab mdzad thogs med sku mched 'gro ba'i mig /ces gsungs te/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don shin tu zab pas rtogs dka' snyam nas/ rje btsun byams mgon lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du sgrub pa'i mthar/ rje btsun gyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ste/ dga' ldan du khrid nas mi lo lnga bcu'i bar du byams pa las chos gsan/ byams chos sde lnga sogs mi pham byams mgon gyi gsung rgyun dag byed gaṅgā'i chu klung chen po ste k+ṣiṃbo 'gro ldan ma'i gzugs su bkod pa de/ lha yul dga' ldan nas spyan drangs te mi yul 'dzam bu gling gi yul gru ma lus par khyab par mdzad pa'i gcene 'phags pa thogs med dang gcung slob dpon dbyig gnyen te sku ma ched gnyis ni 'gro ba rnams kyi dam pa'i trī0

chos kyi dgongs don mthong ba'i mig yin no/ /zhes che ba brjod pa ste/ mi yul 'dir chos mngon pa la dgra lan gsum byung ba'i rjes su/ thogs med kyis byams chos spyan drangs te sku mched gnyis kas theg pa chen po sa khyab rdo khyab tu spel bas bka' drin shin tu che ba yin no/ /'di'i rkang ba gnyis pa bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan dang / gzhan rnams bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin no/ /bdunagipa 'phags seng gnyis la mchod par brjod pa ni/'phags yul sher sbyin 'grel mdzad sa 'dzin dbus/ /'chadadzu mkhas tsan dan dri bsung ngad 'thul ba'i/ /legs bshad nags klung skug pos lha mi'i yid/ /'phrog mdzad 'phags beng grags snyan srid rtser brgal/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi sher phyin gyi 'grel ba mdzad pa bo sa 'dzin te ri bo phreng bsgrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su/ 'chad pa la mkhas pa'i tsan dan gyi dri bsung gi ngad de dri bzang bo 'thul ba'i rtsom pa legs bshad kyi nags klung stug po ste 'thug pos/ lha dang mi'i mkhas pa dag gi yid 'phro ga par mdzad3pa'i ri bo ma la ya lta bu'i 'phags pa grol sde dang slob dpon seng ge bzang bo gnyis kyi grags pa snyan po des 'jig rten khyab ste srid pa'i rtse mo las kyang 11

brgal lo/ /zhes pa yin la/ sher phyin gyi 'grel ba mdzad pa bo rnams sa 'dzin te ri bo la sbyar ba'i shushas kyis 'phags seng gnyis kyang ri bo khyad 'phags shig la sbyar ba go nus la/ 'chad mkhas tsan dan gyi dri bsung la sbyar ba dang / tsholegs bshad nags klung stug po la sbyar bas/ 'phags seng gnyis ri bo ma la ya la sbyar ba don gyis go ste/ ri bo ma la ya ni tsan dan gyi nags stug pos gang zhing / de phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rlung la tsan dan gyi— dri'i dpal dang ldan pa ni snyan ngag pa la yongs su grags pa'i dpe'o/ /'di yang bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan no/ / brgyad pa chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams la mchod par brjod pa ni/ gangs ris bskor yang rmongs pa'i mun 'thib pa'i/ /sngongs 'dir chos snang spro mdzad lo paṇa dang / /rgyal blon kun dang khyad par sher phyin galung / /spel mdzad mkhas dbang ma lus phyag gi yul/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'khor yug gangs ri dkar bos bskor na yang chos la rmongs pa'i mun nag 'thib pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'od kyi snang ba dkar bo spro bar mdzad mkhan yi ge 'bri ba'i thog ma'i srol gtod pa bo thon mi sabho ṭa dang phyi dar gyi lo chen rin bzang lhalha

sogs lo tsā ba rnamasabyudangacopaṇa ṭi ta kujis ra sogs dang / phyi dar skabs kyi jo bo a ti sha sogs snga phyir byung ba'i paṇa ṭi ta rnams dang / phyag rjes rmad du byung ba'i chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum sogs dang chos la dkar ba'i blon po kun dang / khyad par du sher phyin gyi gzhung spel bar mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo ma lus pa phyag gi yul yin/ zhes pa ste/ 'di'i tshig rkang dang bo mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / lhag ma bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no/ / dgu ba rje bdag nyid chen po la mchod par brjod pa ni/thub pa'i lung ltar 'jam dbyangs mi yi blos gar gyis/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa lung rtogs bslab gsum lag len sogs/ /mtha' dag rdzogs ldan la bkod blo bzang rgyal ba zhes/ /grags pa'i ba dan grid na mtho bar gus pyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa ste/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng 'di stongs gyu ra na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa ltar/ 'jam dpal dbyangs mi yi zlos gar bsgyur ba 13

rnya/ mi'i tshul bzung nas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lung rtogs kyi bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dang lam bslab pa gsum gyi lag len sogs/ sangs rgyas rang nyid slar 'jig rten 'dir byon pa bzhin du mdzad de/ mdo sngags mtha' dag gang gi cha nas kyang snyigs dus 'di rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la bkod pa'i byed pa bo blo bzang rgyal ba zhes snyan pa'i grags pa'i ba dan srid pa 'di na mngon par mtho ba/ de la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di ni bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang /yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bsres pa'i sgo nas bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo gsum gyi nang nas phyag bya ba'i dngos po'o/ /bcu ba sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen la mchod par brjod pa ni/ mgon de'i sras rnams kun dang gang gi lugs/ /gsung bzhin mkhyen rab dar bas ma lus chos/ /ji bzhin gzigs pas 'gro la legs ston pa'i/ /rgyal tshab rin chen bdun ldan chos kyi rje/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'gro ba'i mgon po blo bzang grags pa de'i gsung las skyes pa'i sras rnams kun kyang 'gro ba'i gnyen yin pa dang / khyad par du rje bdag nyid chen po gang gi/ rang lugs dri ma dang bral ba de nyid rje rang gi 14

gsung jijilta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa'i mkhyen rab dar zhing rgyas pa'i stabs kyis/ shes bya ma lus pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs pas/ 'gro ba rnams la legs par ston pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa 'phags nor rin chen ba dun dang ldan pa 'i chos kyi rje yin no/ /zhes dar ma rin chen zhes pa'i mtshan gtor te/ bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi sgo nas gtso bo mkhyen pa dang 'chad —pa'i yon tan brjod pa'o/ /'phags nor rin chen bdun ni/dad pa'i nor/ tshul khrims kyi nor/ thos pa'i nor/ gtong ba'i nor/ ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ khrelayod pa'i nor/ shes rab kyi nor rnams te/ dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba dang / /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / dzobacu gcig pa sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang la mchod par brjod pa ni/ mkhas grub bye ba'i ral ba' thor cog rtser/ /rigs brgya'i khrab bdag dge legs dpal 'a nga zhabs/ /mkhas btsun bzang bos legs bkod skal ldan kun / /'dren mdzad 'gro ba'o gnyen gcig la phyag 'tshalda/ /zhes gsungs te/ rje rin po ches bstan pa spyimidang / khyad par sngags 15

kyi bstan pa nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa la gtad pas/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bore gyur pa'i dge zhing legs pa'i zhibs zung de nyid mkhas btsun bzang bo'i yon tan gyi stobs kyis/ rī mkhas grub bye ba ste mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa ches ṅgen tu mngaX bo'i ral ba'i thor cog gi rtse ste/ sbyi bor legs par bkod nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi ri gnas las 'dren cing thar ba dang thams tshocad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god par mdzad pa'i 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi sgo nas/ phul du byung ba'i yon tan brjod de phyag byas pa'o/ / bcu gnyis pa rgyal ba— yab sras gnyis la mchod par brjod pa ni/ sprul ba'i rabs kyis zhwa ser ring lugs bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can ma lus khrab byas pas/ /grags pa'i ba dan brad na lhang rje ba/ /rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la gus zag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ sprul ba'i rabs kyis te sku phreng rabayodang rim pas zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs kyi zla bral 16

bstan pa rin po chi rgya mtsho'i gos can te sa'i steng ma lus pa khyab par byas pas/ snyan pa'i grags pa'i ba dan de nyid srid pa 'di na lhang nger gsal ba/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal bo yab sras gnyis la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang ba dang bo gnyis bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang / rkang ba gsum pa ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi sgo nas phyag byas pa/ 'o/ / rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bstan bcos 'di'i don thugs —su chud par bstan pa ni/ /lung rigs rin chen bye ba' dra ba 'chang / /jod byed khyad 'phags dri bzang phyogs bcur khyab/ /don gyi sher phyin 'dod pa kun cer ba'i/ /rnam sad dbag bsam smon pa skal bas dhed/ /ces gsungs te/ lung dang rigs pa rin po che bye ba'i gzugs su bkod de/ de lta bu'i rin po che'i dra ba 'chang zhing / rjod byed khyad par —du 'phags pa dri bzang gi gzugs su bkod nas/ de lta bu'i dri bzang bos phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhi ste brgyad dang / steng dang 'og gi phyogs gnyis te phyogs bcur khyab pa dang / don gyi sher phyin dngos po brgyad dang don bdun cu'i 'dod pa kun ster ba'i/ rnam sad de lha'i ljon pa rang nyid skal ba bzang bo yin pas rnyed do / 17

zhes pa ste/ 'di ne cha shas gzugs can dang / rkang ba bzhi bar bsdus brjod 'dres pas/ cha shas gzugs can dang bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bsres te/ sher phyin gyi don thugs su chud cing /bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang bar bstan pa'o/ / rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ la la tshig tsam mthong bas blom sems byed/ /'ga' zhig zer sgros bris shing phal cher gyis/ / ga don skun mda' 'phangs la chags sdang gis/ /rtsod yig dgag yul min phyir 'dir mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs te/ mkhas rlom la la tshig tsam mthong bas bdag mkhas so snyam pa'i rlom sems byed/ 'ga' zhig gis mkhas pa snga mas gsungs zin pa zer sgros kyis rang gi rtsom yin khul gyis bris shing / mkhas rlom phal cher gyis tshig gi don ma go bar mun nag nang du mda' 'phangs pa lta bu'i gzhung brtsams pa yin la/ da dung rang phyogs la chags pa dang gzhan phyogs la sdang ba'i dbang gis brtsams pa'i rtsod yig dag ni/dgag pa'i yul min pas gzhung 'dir mi 'chad do/ /zhes mkhas rlom dag gi rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi sgo nas/de lta bu'i rang bzhin can dag ni/ rtsod yul las bkar te/rtsod pa'i yul ni chags sdang dang bral zhing / kun slong khyad par 18

can dang ldan pa'i gzur gnas kyi blo gros can/ mkhas pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa dag yin par shugs la bstan to/ / rtsatsho ba'i sa bcad bzhi ba snod ldan nyan par bskul ba ni/ skum don ston pa'i gsungs dang rgyal tshab kyis/ /bkral bzhin ging rta chen po'i lugs bzhin du/ /dam pa'i drin gyis zhed de lung rigs gyis/ /blom bralarirtse bas 'dir 'chad blo ldan nyon//zhes gsungs te/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don/ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa dakhu / rgyal tshab byams mgon gyis byams chos kyi skabs su yum don bkral ba ji lta ba bzhin dang / shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis kyi lugs ji lta ba bzhin du bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas/bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' drin gyispu rnyed de/ lung dang rigs pa la byang ba'i stobs kyis bdag mkhas so snyam pa'i rlom sems dang bral nas/ brtse ba snying rje chen po'i dbang gis sher phyin gyi don 'dir 'chad pas blo gros dang ldan pa dag nyon cig ces snod ldan nyan par bskul ba'o/ /rnyed de yan chod kyis bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yum don ma lus pa phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud par bstan pa dang / lung rigs kyis rlom bral zhes pas kun slong ma dag pa dang bral bar bstan pa dang 19

brtsi bas zhes pas kun slong gi gtso bo brtsi ba snyong rje chen posatshu zin par bstan pa'o/ /'di'ang bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bsres pa yin la/mchod brjod 'di sogs tshigs bcad gzhan dag tu'ang rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gtso bo byas pa ni/ snyan ngag gi gzhung gi dgongaso pa yin te/ snyan ngag me long las/ rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas/ /rang bzhin brjod pa 'di 'dra ni/ /bstan bcos kun la rgyal srid nyid/ /ces dang / kun mkhyen rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag rtsa ba las/ bstan bcos kun la rgyal srid ji bzhin dpal gyis mtho/ /mkhas mang snying du bcings pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa gang / /zhes bstan bcos kun la rgyal bo'i rgyal srid kyi mnga' thang ji bzhin du gtso che zhing / phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho bar gsungs so/ /de ltar mchod brjod kyi don rang gi go tshod tsam zhig 'grel zin to/ / zhar byung skyes bu gsum gyi rnam bzhag gi martswag gi bar skabs tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad kyang ma bsgoms na nyon mongs spang 20

mi nus par bstan pa/ thos bsam tsam la yang phan yon che bar bsnyan pa/ sher phyin la bshad sgrub byed rgyu byung ba 'di ngo mtshar che bar bstan pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ rmad byung bstan pa'i bdud rdzithos bsam gyis/ /skabs gsum ro 'dzin tshim kyang ma sbyangs pa'i/ /sgra tsam 'dzin pa'i yid kyi zug ju kun/ /'byin la sman dpyad barmags pas nad bzhin no/ /zhe sa gsungs te/ smras pa/ zhes pa 'di ltar brjod/ ces pa'i do na/rme ci rmad du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che lha'i bdudacirtsi'i gzugs su bkod/de lta bu'i bdud rtsi la thos bsam gyis longs spyad pas skabs gsum ste lha'i ro 'dzin tshim kyang / sgom la ma sbyangs pa'i sgra tsam 'dzin pa'i thabs la brten nas yid kyistathug rngu ste nyon mongs —pa'i nad kun drungs nas 'byin par 'dod pa dag la/ sman mi 'thung bar sman dpyad kyi dpe bklags pas nad zhi bar 'dod pa bzhin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /'di'i skabs gsum zhes pa ni thos bsam byed mkhan la go dgo sa te/ bstan pa bdud rtsi'i gzugs su bkod nas/ dzode la thos bsam byed mkhan la/ skabs gsum zhes dpe can la bsams nas dpe brjod pa 'di ni/ dpe can dpe'i nang du bsdus nas brjod pas bsdus brjod kyi rgyan 21

yin la/ bsdus brjod kyi nang nas kyang spyi'i bsdus brjod yin te/ kun mkhyen rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag rtsa ba la sa/dpe can la bsam dpe la smras pa yis/ /don bsdus 'di 'dra'i bsdus brjod spyir bltan mdzag /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ ro 'dzin ni ljags yin la/ skabasagasum ni lha'i mngon bsgrod yin te/ lha rnams skye ba'i skabs su lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa lta bu dang / gnas pa'i skabs su'ang lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa lta bu dang / 'chi ba'i skabs su yang lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa ltabu yin pas/ skabs gsum pa'am/ skabs gsum zer te/ mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel ba las/ 'di la skye ba dang gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i bdag nyid yod pa sa skabs gsum mo/ /mi rnams kyi bzhin du na ba dang rga bas yongs su 'gyur zhing zad pa ni mi ldan te/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa lta bus skye zhing gnas pa dang 'chi bar yang byed pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa thos bsam tsam la phan yon che bar bstan pa ni/'on kyang sgra bcas sngags 'gas rims 'arngoms bzhin/ /thub gsung sher phyin rig sngags thos pas kyang / — /nyon mongasand dang gdon sel lha'i dbang bos/ /skad cig bsam dang brjod pas bdud sogs zhi/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma bsgoms par nyon 22

mongs spang mi nus pa yin mod/ 'on kyang sgra dang bcas pa'i rig sngags 'arga' zhig brjod pas/ rims nad 'joms pa de bzhin du/ sher phyin gyi rig sngags zapa mo 'di thos pas kyang /nyon mongs dang nad dang gdon sel ba ni/ sngon lha'i dbang bos sher phyin gyi don dus skad cig tsam la bsam pa dang brjod pas kyang bdud sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba yin pas/ thos pa dang bsam pa tsam la'ang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon dpag tu med pa yod do/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di ni dpe rgyan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dang bo chos dpe yin no/ /gsum pa sher phyin la bshad sgrub byed rgyu byung ba ngo mtshar che bar bstan pa ni/ bsam gyis mispyab kun nas ches che ba /ston pas bkur dang sangs rgyasatsām 5cad kyis/ /skyes bskur bsngags pa'i sher phyin 'di lhar du/ /nyin mtshan spyod pa ngo mtshar e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs te/ brjod bya'i cha nas/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab phartsorol phyin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar so so skye bo'i smra bsam gyi yul las 'das pa dang / rjod byed kyi cha nas bskal ba bye bar thos dka' ging / thos na don che bas phan yon gyi sgo nas kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / brjod bya rjod byed kun nas ches che ba'amuji lkezemado sde kun nas ches che ba yin 23

te/ rab dang phul dang gtso bo dang gya nom pa yin pa dang /ston pas kyang sher mdo gsungs tshe khri la phyag gsum 'tshal te khri thog tu bzhugs nas gsungs pa sogs bkur ste dang rnyi/ 'jig rten khams gzhan gyi byang chub soms dpa' rnams bdag cag gi ston pa'i drung du sher mdo nyan par phebs pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dang de'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis me tog la sogs pa'i skyes bskur te bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i sher phyin rin po che la rang re rnams kyis 'di ltar du nyin mtshan kun tu thos bsam sgom gsum gyis longs spyod rgyu byung be ngo mtshar zhing e ma ho ste ches shin tu ngo mtshar che'o/ /'di ni dga' ba'i rgyan yin te/ kun mkhyen nyid kyis/ khyad 'phags nyams ldan dga' ba brjod pa'i ngag /ces gsungs so/ / tshig don rtsod spong gi mjug gi tshigs bced kyi 'gre' / 'di la dga' dad kyi 'bras bu dge mtshan rgyas par bstan pa/ byis pa dag gis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mi mthong bar bstan pa/ theg gsum dge 'dun dang 'grogs pa la bsngags pa dang gsum mo/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ 'jig rten mdzes pa kun bskus thub 24

dbang zhal gyi bedud rtsi de/ /blo yis rtsang yang nyon mongs gdung ba kun gcod bdud rtsi'i gter/ /snying gi ku skud skyong blad dad pa' mig gi 'dabapyim rgyas/ /dga' ba'i 'od snang mkha' mthar phyin pas legs byas rgyu skar bkram/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'jig rten khams kyi mdzes pa ci yod pa kun gcig tu bsdus pa'i thub pa'i dbang bo'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi de/ zhes zhal bdud rtsi'i gzugs su bkod/ de lta bu'i bdud rtsi de blo yis myang ba ste yid la shar yang / sems kyi nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung kun gcod pa'i thub pa'i zhal bdud rtsi'i gter te/ zla ba de nyid/ snying gi ku mud skyong ba'i slad du mngon sum du mthong 'dod kyi dad pa'i mig gi 'dab ma rgyas pa ste/ mig gis cer gyis lta bzhin du dad pa dang dga' ba'i 'od kyi snang ba de/ mkha' mthar phyin pa ste nam mkha'i mthar khyab pas/ legs byas kyi 'bras bu'i dge mtshan rgyu skar nam mkha' la bkram mo/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang ba dang bos zhal bdud rtsi'i gzugs su bkod la rnam dbye drug pa ma bsdus pas/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang / rkang ba gnyis pas zhal bdud rtsi'i gter te/ zla ba'i gzugs su bkod la rnam dbye drug pa bsdus pas bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang / rkang ba gsum pas thugs kyi rtogs pa snying gi ku mud ces dpe ku mud 25

kyis bsdus pas/ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang / dad pa'i mig me tog gi 'dab ma'i gzugs su bkod la/ drug pa ma bsdus pas/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang / dga' ba 'od kyi snangardziba'i gzugs su bkod pa snga ma bzhin ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan dang / legs byas rgyu skar gyi gzugs su bkod pa bsdus pa'i gzugs can no/ /des na thub pa'i zhal thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi ngor gsal bar shar bar bstan pa dang / blo yis myang yang / zhes pa'i yang sgras thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi ngor snang ba tsam du ma zad dbang bos mngon sum du mthong 'dod par bstan pa dang / dad pa'i mig gi 'dab ma rgyas zhes pa'i shugs la/mngon sum du mthong bar bltan nas/ dga' ba'i 'od snang mkha' mthar phyin/ zhes pas sa dang bo rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa sa lam rtogs pa mtha' dag rab tu rgyas pa'i don dang /legs byas rgyu skar bkram/ zhes pas nam mkha' mthas gar khyab 'phrin las kyis khyab par bstan to/ /rīganyis pa ni/ grid pa'i dpal 'byor mi lam rol ba tsam 'jig rten dgra gnyen gar mkhan cha lugs badzir/ /'gyur ba'i rtsag bsngal g.yang khalismrang rtsi'i ro/ /r+sā zhes mi ra long ba'i 'gros mthong mtshar/ /zhes gsungs te/ srid pa ste 'jig rten 26

gyi dpal dang 'byor ba la longs spyad pa ni/ rmi lam thun gcig la dpal 'byor la rol bar rmis pa tsam yin la/ 'jig rten gyi dgra dang gnyen ni zlos gar 'cham mkhan gyis dgra'i cha lugs bzung ba dang yang gnyen gyi cha lugs su bsgyur ba dang 'dra la/'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal te zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba ni g.yang kha'i sgrang rtsi'i ro la chags te de la spyod 'dod kyis g.yang sar lhung ste sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba dang mtshungs pa'i 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mngon sum du snang ba 'di dag kyang / byis pa so so skye bo ma rig pa'i dbang du gyur pa rnams kyis mi mthong bar blang dor gyi gom 'gros 'khyor ba mthong bas mtshar zhing snying rje skye/ zhes pa'i don no/ /'di ni bsdus ma bsdus kyi gzugs can gyi rgyan ci rigs par yod pa shes sla'o/ /gsum pa ni/ legs byas lam bzang mngon mtho'i tshon lang bkra/ /legs baṭad snyan pa'i glu dbyangs ting 'dzin gyi/ /sgo brgya'i ro mngar thes rab yongs 'du'i dri/ /theg gsum rnam sad tshogs dang 'grogs 'ji bsngags/ /zhes gsungs te/ legs par byas pa'i lam bzang bo ste lha dang mi'i rten gyi tshon yang ste kha dog kyang rnam par bkra zhing mdzes la/ legs par bshad pa rab tu snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mo ske27

brgya phrag 'byed pa'i ro mchog mngar zhing / shes rab kyi dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dri ngad 'thul ba/ de lta bu'i yon tan gyi khyad par phun sulo tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i theg pa gsum gyi gang zag rnam sad de lha rnams dang lhan cig 'grogs rgyu byung ba 'di ni/ ches shin tu skal ba dang ldan zhing bsngags par 'os so/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /tshigs bcad 'di gzugs can gyi rgyan dang / tshon yang zhes pa'i yang sgra gong mas 'og ma sdud nga 'i mthun pa'i tshig rgyan yin la/ rnam sad ces pa lha'i ming yin te/ mkhas pa'i rna rgyan las/ gnyid med pas rnam sad ces so/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dis ni rje rang nyid theg gsum 'apags pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su chos ston zhing bzhugs yod pa'i rnam par thar ba ngo mtshar ba bstan to/ / tshig don gyi sgo nas bshad pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad gnyis kyi 'grel/ gang la rol bya'i yon tan dang /rol ba bo'i yon tan brjod pa gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ smras pa/ sgrib gnyis sgrib gsum glib bzhi'i rtsa ngan gyi/ /dug tsher ma lus be shes me yis bsregs/ /grid zhi'i rgud pa'i skun bral phun tshogs bzhi'i/ /dri ngad phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i dpag bsam zhing / /zhes gsungs te/ nyon sgrib 28

shes sgrib gnyis dang / nyon shes snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gsum dang / nyon shes chags thogs kyi sgrib pa bzhi'i mya ngan gyi dug tsher ma lus pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me yis bsregs pa dang / srid pa'i rgud pa dang zhi ba'i rgud pa'i mun pa ma lus pa dang bral ba ste spangs shing / rang don spangs rtogs dang gzhan don gzugs sku dang 'phrin las phun tshogs te phun sum tshogs pa bzhi'i dri ngad phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i thub dbang dpag bsam gyi shing de nyid/ ces pa ste/ khyad chos rnams gzugs can gyi rgyan gyis spras te/ dpe can gyi khyad gzhi dngos su ma brjod par dpes bsdus pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rmad byung bsam ba' ro bda' bais legs kyi/ /rin chen rgyan dang bdud rtsi gos bzhon pa/ /ma lus 'byung gnas theg gsum thar 'dod kyi/ /rnam sad bye ba phra ga brgyas rol ba rmad/ /ces gsungs dhete/ rmad du byung ba'i bsam pa nges 'byung dang byang sems kyi ro bda' ba ste ro mngar zhing /nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ thos pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi dang / tshul khrims kyi gos dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba'i bzhon pa sogs yon tan ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ theg pa gsum gyi thar 'dod kyi skyes bu 29

rnam sad de lha bye ba phrag brgyas zub dbang dpag bsam gyi ljon pa de la rol ba ni rmad du byung ba ste phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ rmad byung bsam pa dpag bsam shing gi ro'i gzugs su bkod/ nges legs rin chen rgyan gyi gzugs su bekod/ dpe can thos pa'i chospodang / tshul khrims/ yang dag lta ba rnams/dpe bdud rtsi dang / gos dang / bzhon pa rnams kyis bsdus te/ yon tan de thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dpe rnam sad kyis mtshon pa'i theg gsum thar 'dod rnams kyis dpe dpag bsam gyi ljon pas mtshon pa'i thub dbang la rol ba ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la longs su spyod pa dang / khyad par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rol zhing longs su spyad de/ sa lam gyi rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba de rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ / chos 'khor mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'dir sher mdo gsung tshul/ skyo ba'i rgyu/ thugs skyo tshul/ skyabs yul gyi thugs rgyud bskul ba ste bzhi las/dang bo ni/ smras pa/ bye ba phrag brgya'i gling na rtsababobang gis/ /geb phrag brgya 'i 'khor la 'dzum pa'i 'od/ /bye ba phrag brgya bkye nas sher gyin don/ /bye ba phrag brgya sogs kyi bdud 30

rtsi rdzos/ /zhes gsungs te/ chags 'jig gcig pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya'i lho 'dzam bu gling na thub dbang gis/'khor bye ba phrag brgya ste 'khor shin tu mang bo la/ zhal 'dzum pa'i 'od bye ba phrag brgya ste ches shin tu mang bo bkye nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bye ba phrag brgya sogs kyis te ches shin tu mang bos bdud rtsi ngab tu sgros so/ /zhes pa ste/ chags—'jig gcig pa'i 'jig rten gyi khamaspobye ba phrag brgya ni/ mchog gi sprul sku gcig gi gdul zhing yin pas / de'i 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya na/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa bye ba phrag brgyas bya rgod phung bo ri bye ba phrag brgya na sher mdo gsungs pa'i don yin la/bye ba phrag brgya phyi ma gsum ni mang tshig yin te/ dper na/ rje rin po ches/ nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs lasagasal ba'i thugs/ /zhes dang / phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ /zhes pa ltar mang tshig gi tshig rgyan lar+sā/ grangs nges par bzung ba min la/ 'di ni bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o gnyis pa ni/ phal cher zas dang phal cher gyi na dang / /phal cher 'du 'dzi phal cher chags rnang rjo/ /phal cher dbang rtul phal cher don chung bems/ /phal tsher rjo yang phal cher ltos 31

grogs dbang / /zhes gsungs te/ skye bo phal cher zas gos tsam don du gnyer ba dang / phal cher snyom las kyi ngang du gyi nar sdod pa dang / phal cher phyi nang gi 'du 'dzis g.yeng ba'i dbang du gyur cing / phal cher rang phyogs la chags pa dang / gzhan phyogs la sdang ba'i nyon mongs shin tu rno ba'i dbang gis mi dge ba'i las kho nar zhugs pa dang / phal cher dbang bo rtul bas dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs la 'jug mi nus shing / zhugs kyang blang dor gyi gnas shes mi nus pa dang / phal cher tshe 'di'i don chung phran tshe gas la sems shor te/ dal 'byor stong zad du gtong ba dang / phal cher dbang bo rno yang de'i nang nas phal cher ltos grogs te grogs po ngan pa'i dbang du song nas tshe 'di'i bya ba dang sdig pa'i las la 'jug pa dang / tha na spobs pa myur ba bdud kyi las su gyur te/ log par rtog pa'i dbang du gyur pa'ang yod do/ /zhes pa'i don de/ mdor na/ skye tho phal che ba nyon mongs pa dang bya ba ngan pa'i dbang du song gho mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi don dang mi mthun pas bslus te sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba la/ mi bzod pa'i snying rje skyes te/thugs shin tu skyo ba'i ngang tshul gsungs so/ /'di ni rkang ba re re'i thog ma dang bar du bskor bya ya bkod pa'i thog bar gnyis 32

no yod pa'i bar du chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ 'di 'dra bsams nas rang gi yul bor te/ /'gi 'dra zhed dka' dal 'byor nor bu snyam/ /'azhi 'dra bsam spyang snying med mang thos ba/ /'azhi 'dra mi shes pa bzhin rnam gabeng skyo/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa'i skye bo 'di 'dra ba dag gi ngang tshul la bsam sgro btang nas/ rang gi pha yul rgyang ring du bor te/ grwa sa 'dir thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum byed pa 'di 'dra ba'i rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor zhig thob pa 'di ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu red do snyam/'on kyang 'di 'dra ba'i bsam pa zhig skyes kyang / snying med pa dang 'dra ba'i mang du thos pa bdag ni/ 'di 'dra ba'i dal 'byor thob pa mi shes pa'i skye bo bzhin du rnam par g.yeng bu'i dbang du gyur pa 'di la sems skyo'o/ /zhes khengs skyung ba'i gsung dang bcas te thugs skyo tshul gsungs so/ /'di ni bar chod pa'i zung ldan rkang ba bzhi ga'i thog ma la yod pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / dhebazhi ba ni/ thogs med kun tu gzigs pa'i pad ma'i tshon ldan rgyal rnams kye/ /kye ma 'gro la rjes chags thugs rje'i chu gter rlabs mang bos/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ldan mtshan dale'i 33

sku dang drug cu'i dbyangs/ /mngonad+kum sprune bzhin dga' bzhin mdzod cig 'dren mchotsha da rma /zhes pa'ang rnam g.yeng sna tshogs kyis skyo ba'i dus bsam don snya na tshigagis gsal bor tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ shes snathams cad chags thogs med cing ris 'jog med par dus kun tu garigs pa'i pad ma rgyas 'dra'i spyan dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba rnacha/sa kye/ zhes 'bod tshig gis thugs rgyud bskul te/ kye ma zhes gong du bshad pa ltar rnam g.yeng gis thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa bstan te/ dngos grub zhu ba ni/ 'gro ba rnams la ma bu gcig pa ltar rjes su chags pa'i thugs rje chu gter chen po de'i dbang gis/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od can gyi mtshan dpes spraspo pa'i sku dang / gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs de/ mig gis mngon sum du myong bzhin du sems dga' zhing spro bzhin du sku mthong ba dang gsung thos par mdzod cig 'dren ma chog 'gran zla med pa'i sangs rgyas kye/ zhes slar yang nan tan gyi tshul du gsol ba btab pa'o/ /'di'i rkang ba dang bor pad ma'i spyan ldan zhes 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud kyi dpe rgyan dang / thugs rje'i chu gter zhes ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang / mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ /lhag ma go sla'o/ / 34

mngon du byas pa'i tshad bshad pa'i masdug gi tshigs shaṃcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung gis yid tshim par bstan pa/ dka' gnad ma thags par blos byas kyi bshad pas re ba skong mi thub par bstan pa/ thos bsam la zhugs nas dgongs don mthar thug rnyed par bstan pa dang gsum mo/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ zhes bya pha maba' med pa'i khengs ldan lha'i mchod yon/ /ma pham sku bzhi'i zhal nas 'dren mkhas thogs med zhabs/ /'phags beng lha chen blo gros ral glung gatha' chus/ /deng dus bems kyi brkel mngashralpan baspus pas tshim/ /zhes gsungs te/ shes bya pha mtha' med pa'i brjod bya'i khengs pa ste/ nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i lha'i mchod yon te chu bo gaṅgā byams pa'i chos mi pham lha tshangs pa po'i sku bzhi'i zhal bzhi las mi yul du 'dren mkhas te/ 'dren par mdzad pa bo slob dpon thogs med zhabs dang / 'phags seng lha chen dbang phyug gi blo gros ral ba stug po'i nang gi chu klung gaṅgā'i chus/ deng gi dus su sems kyi bskal mang ste/ ngo bo gra ba'i dbang gis bskal don du song ba'i sems kyi nang gi sher phyin gyi don mishes pa ste ma rig pa'i dri ma kun baspus nas blo gros rgyas pas dzim mo/ /zhes 35

pa ste/ rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du/ lha'i mchod yon chu bo gaṅgā'am bod skad du 'gro ldan ma zer ba de/ lha yul nas mi yul du slebs pa'i tshe sta rgyal gyis sgra dang bcas te sa gzhi'i steng du bzhur bar bshad pas/ dpe can gyi khyad gzhi byamār+sā chosu dngos su ma brjod par/ dpe lha'i mchod yon gyis bsdus te/byams chos kyi khyad chos brjod bya mtha' med pa de 'gro ldan ma'i khengs pa ste nga rgyal gyi gzugs su bkod nas/ rig byed kyi gtam rgyud la 'jig rten thams cad tshangs pas sprul bar bshad pa'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas rgyal ba mi pham pa'i sku bzhi bo lha catshangs— pa pa'i zhal bzhi'i gzugs su bkod de/ de las byams chos lha'i mchod yon mi yul du 'dren pa'i slob dpon thogs med dang /gzhan yang / rig byed kyi gtam rgyud las/ gaṅgā de lha dbang phyug chen po'i ral ba'i klong du sim pa las/ skal ldan shing rtas mes po namasasgakyi sdig pa 'dag pa'i ched du dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs nas gsol ba btab pas/ dbang phyug gis ral ba spar mos btsir te thig pa gcig lhung ba chu bo gaṅgā 'di yin la/des bkrus pa'i sdig pa 'dag par bshad pa dang sbyar te/'phags seng gnyis lha chen po'i gzugs su bkod/ 'phags senge gnyisar+shakyi blo gros de lha chen gyi ral ba'i gzugs su bkod/36

'phags seng gi gzhung lugs de dpe chu klung gaṅgās bsdus te bsdus brjod kyis brgyan nas/ sher phyin gyi non phra mo mang bo mi bes pa dri ma'i gzugs su bkod/ de lta bu'i ngo bo phra ba'i dbang gis bskal don du song ba'i dri ma mang bo/ 'phags seng gi mdo rgyan 'grel ba chu klung gaṅgā'i chus bkrus pas rang gi blo tshim mo/ /zhes pa ste thogs med dang 'phags seng gi gzhung la brten nas sher phyin gyi don lhag ma med par khong du chud par bstan to/ /gaṅgā'i gtam rgyud sogs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi zla med ston pa ma'i 'grel bar zhal gsal zhing khungs dag pa zhig yod pas der blta bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho'i gling gi rin mchog 'dra'i chos/ /dka' gnad dri mas ma brags rang rang gi /blo byas nyes bshad mching bu bkra ba der/ /'bad btsal bsgrims kyang re ba ji ltar skong / /zhes gsungs te/ rgya mtsho'i gling gi nor bu rin po che mchog dang 'dra ba'i chos kyi dka' ba'i gnad/ rang blo skyon gyi dri ma can des ma thags pa ste rtogs ma thub par/ rang gi blo bzo byas pa'i nyes bshad kyi gzhung gi mching bu bkra ba ste bkram zin pa de dag la 'bad pas sbyangs te chos kyi dgongs don btsal phyir bsgrims kyang / chos kyi dgongs don rtogs 37

'dod kyi re ba ji ltar skong ste skong minus so/ /zhes pa ste/rin chen ma chog 'dra'i/ zhes pa'i 'dra mtshungasab gsal byed kyi sgra yinastabs/ rkang ba dang bo dpe rgyan gyisasrus/ dri masardzim phigs zhes cha can skyon can gyi blom brjod pa ra/ dri mas zhes khyad par gyis cha can bsdus pas bsdus brjod du rtogs la /'ching bu ni nor bu 'dra ba'i rdo phalab zhig yin pas/ nyes bshad byas pa'i gzhung de'i gzugs sabakod de gzugs can gyi rgyan gyis spras/ bkra ba ni mang ba dang bkram yod pa'i don la'ang 'jug pas/ skabs 'dir bkram pa'i don dang 'di ni rab spel gyi rgyan yang yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ tshul de ma bathod lhag bsam dar chen btsugs/ /thos bsam grur zhug sa galung mang rgya mtsho brgal/ /mtshungs bral 'jig ten rin chen kun nyed des/ /megs bshad nor byas grags pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa'i nyes bshad bkram pa'i gnas tshul de dag rang dgar bskyur ma bzod pa ra/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dar chen btsugs te/ thos bsam gyi gru chen por zhugs nas/ gzhung mang bo'i rgyasamatsho brgal bas/ mtshungs blo dang bral ba'i dgongs don 'jig rten gyi rin po che ci yod kun rnyed pa des rgyu byas 38

nas/ mtha' dpyod 'di sogs gzhung brtsams pa'i legs bshad kyi nor bu de'i stabs kyis snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs su grags pa ni 'jig rten na rab tu mtho ba rā dza ste rgyal bo bzhin rdzino/ /zhes pa ste/ lhag bsam dar chen dadz+wa/ thos bsam grur zhugs pa dang / gzhung mang rgya mtsho'i gzugs su bkod pas/ de dag gzugs can gyi rgyan dang / gzhung gi dgongs don rmad du byung ba ma lus par rnyed pa'i dbe can de ni/ dpe mtshungs bral 'jig rten rin chen kun rnyed pas bsdus pas bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang / legs bshad nor bu'i gzugs su bkod pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan yin la/ — rin chen kun rnyed des/ zhes gsum pa byed pa byas pas/ des rgyu byas nas gzhung brtsams pa dang / legs bshad nor bus/ zhes yang rnam dbye gsum pa byas stabs/ gzhung brtsams pa'i legs bshad de'i dbang gis snyan grags rgyas par 'grel dgos so/ /bka' bstan bcos kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'dir shing rta chen go'i lugs bor ba snying rje'i yul du bstan pa/ mkhyen ga4ma gyi lam la 'jug par bskul ba/tshig tsam thar ba'i rgyur mi 'gyul ma bstan pa/ yang dag 'jog 39

la gzhol tshul dang bzhi'o/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ bka' dang dgongs 'grel brjod don ma rtogs par/ /ston dang shang rta chen po'i lugs bor te/ /yid byed 'gog dang chang 'thung glu men sogs/ /bar ba'i lam ston mkhas pa'i snying rje'i yul/ /zhes gsungs te/sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bka' dang / de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos dag gi brjod bya'i don ma rtogs par/ston pa sangs rgyas dang de'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grel ba'i shing rta chen po dag gi ring lugs bor te/ hā shang gi lugs bzhin du yid byed gang yin 'gog pa dang / dam rdzas su bsnyad btags nas chang 'thung ba dang gsang sngags kyi spyod par bsnyad btags nas glu len gar rtse sogs thar ba'i lam yin par ston pa'i glun po smyo ham can dag ni/ mkhas pa gnas lugs mkhyen pa dag gis snying rje ba'i yul yin no/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni rigs brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed kyi rgyan no/ /gnyis pa rno/ mtho dman rang blo'i 'gros kyis bstan pa'i mkhar/ /thos pa'i 'gros dang bsam pa'i ches mtho'i 'gros/ /sgom ba'i mkha' lding rgan gzhon bgrod pa bzhin/ /mkhyen gsum lha yi dga' tshal 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ 40

blokha mtho dman gyi gdul bya rang rang gi blo'i 'gros te blo dang 'tsham par bstan pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos kyi mkhar rdzong chen por brgal ba'i thabs/ mang du thos pa'i gom 'gros kyis bgrod pa dang / thos pa'i don la bsam pas sgro 'dogs bcad de snga ma las kyang che mtho ba'i gom 'gros kyis bgrod pa dang /thos bsam gyi don la sgom pa'i nyams len gyi 'gros snga ma gnyis las kyang che ba mkha' lding rgan gzhon dag gi bgrod pa bzhin du shugs chen pos mkhyen pa gsum lha yi dga' tshal kun mkhyen ye shes kyi sa la 'jug par rigs so/ /zhes bskul ba ste/gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par bstan pa'i bstan bcos mkhar gyi gzugs su bkod pas gzugs can gyi rgyan dang / sgom pa'i 'gros kyi dper mkha' lding trīrgan gzhon gyi bgrod pa bzhag pas dpe rgyan dang / mkhyen gsum lha'i dga' tshal gyi gzugs su bkod pa'o / /gsum pa ni/ ma rtogs tshig bzung byis pas gter kha byang / /go lang mi bsam nye dga' mar khu bzhin/ /phyogs res mchog 'dzin bar ba'i rgyur gsungaspoba'i/ /thub gsung gartan bde'i lam nyed dga' thu bsam/ /zhes kasungs te/ don ma rtogs par tshig tsam bzung zhing klog 'don byed pa ni/ byis pa 41

dag gis gter gyi kha byang klog pa dang mtshungs la/ gzhung gi bstan dogago yang bsam pa dang sgom pas nyams su mi len par thos pa tsam bsags pa ni/ nye dgas rlung nad sel ba'i mar khu'i do na du mar bsags nas mar khu ma 'thungs pas nad ma drag pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang la la phyogs res kyi dbang gis rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi dbang du song ba yin la/ bdag gis ni thar ba'i rgyu dam par gsungs pa'i thub pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung gtan du bde ba'i lam bzang bo de rnyed pa ni shin tu dga' ba'i rgyu red bsam mo/ /zhes pa ste 'di la dka' rgyu bsam zhes pa 'grel tshul legs po zhig yod kyang bla brang dang sku 'bum dpar ma gnyis kar dga' rgyu bsam zhes yod pa sor bzhag byas so/ /'di ni dpe rgyan dang rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bsres ma yin la/nye dga'i byung ba ni drug sde'i nang tshan gyi nye dga' la rlung nad byung ste 'tsho byed gzhon nu la sman dpyad zhus pas/ sman pa 'tsho byed gzhon nus nyin re bzhin mar khu srang gang re 'thungs na nad sos par 'gyur zhes bshad/ khos slob ma rnams la khyed rnams kyis thos sam/ nga la mar dgos pas mar slongs shig ces bsgos nas/ slob ma rnams kyis mar mang bo bslangs te phul kyang /mar khu 'thung yobra bar mar btsongs nas gser la brjes/ de 42spi

mkha' khyab tu rgyas nas 'gro don dpag tu med pa bsgrubanu/ pa shugs la bstan to/ /'di'i rkang ba gsum pa dpe rgyan byas te/ rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gi las kyi rgyu gnyis pa 'thob bya'i rgyu'i rgyanakhugyis brgyan pa'o/ /rus sbal kha nas shing shor ba yang 'dul ba lung gi gtam rgyud yin zhing / kun la grags che bas shesasla'o/ / lke sher phyiske phar phyin gyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la legs bshad kyi khyad chos bstan pa/ rtsom pa bo'i khyad chos bstan pa/ dam chos 'dzin par spro bar bstan pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ ngan rtog mtshan mtha' zad dang megs smon gyi/ /'od sngon bus drangs thub gsung nyi zer dang / /'phrad pas ma tshongs nyung 'dod spubs kyi rgya/ /grol ba'i legs bshad tshon brgya bla na mebar/ /zhes gsungs te/ ngan rtog ma rig pa'i mtshan mo'i mtha' zad pa ste spangs pa dang sngon gyi thugs bskyed legs smon gyi 'od sngon bu ste skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i thub pa'i gsung rab nyi ma'i 'od zer dang phrad pas/ ma sbyangs pa dang nyung tsam sbyang 'dod kyi blo pad ma'i 'dab ma kha zum pa'i spubs kyi rgya grol te/ rgya/sa pa'i legs bshad kyi 'dab ma'i tshon mdog sna tshogs brgya phrag bla na med par 'bar ba ste rgyas so/ /44

zhes pa ste/ ngan rtog ste ma rtogs log rtog gi sgrib pa ni mtshan mo'i gzugs su bkod de/ mtshan mo zad mthar skya rengs shar dgos pas sngon gyi thugs bskyed kyi legs 'bras 'grub par mngon du phyogs pa ni skya rengs kyi gzugs su bkod/ thugs bskyed des drangs pa'i thub pa'i gsung rab dang phrad pa/ skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer dang phrad pa'i gzugs su bkod/ ma sbyangs pa dang 0nga tsam sbyang 'dod kyi blo ni pad ma'i kha zum ste rgya ma grol ba'am kha ma phye ba'i gzugs su bkod/ thub pa'i gsung rab dang phrad pas ma sbyangs pa dang nyung tsam sbyang 'dod kyi stoblo bag 'khum pa'i bsam blo bsal nas/ legs par sbyangs pas —blo gros rnam par rgyas te/ legs bshad brtsams pa ni nyi ma'i 'od zer dang phrad stabs pad ma'i sbubs rgya grol te 'dab ma kha dog sna tshogs pa'i tshon mdog rab tu rgyas pa'i gzugs su bkod pas 'di ni/ me long ma'i dngos bstan gyi gzugs can gyi rgyan nyi shu'i nang gi bzhi ba mtha' dag gzugs can dang rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gi rigs pa'i rgyus bskyed pa'i mtshar skermeba'i rgyu'i rgyan gyi gzhi mthun du bdag 'dod do/ / gnyis pa ni/ snyigs ma'i 'dam du skyes kyang tshe sngon gyi/ /bag chags tshad med dri bsung phyogaspobargyar 'gengs/ /kun 45 /

dkris chu 'dzin ldan lang mang thos kyi/ /blo gros 'od stong spro ba'i bcu gnyis bdag /ces gsungs te/ dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i 'dam du skyes kyang / tshe sngon gyi chos la goms pa'i bag chagasardzitshad med pa sad pa'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar 'gengs so/ /zhis khong rang nyid pad mar sbyar ba dang / yang khengs bskyungs pa' tshul gyis ston mongs kun dkris kyi chu 'dzin te sprin dang ldan dzhayang / mang du thos pa'i blo grosacikyi 'od stong spro ba'i bcu gnyisardzibadag po ste nyi ma yin no/ /zhes khong rang nyid nyi ma la sbyar ba ste/ dpe don gnyis ka'i khyad gzhi dngos su ma brjod par/khyad chos snyigs ma'i dus su skyes pa 'dam du skyes pa'i gzugs rdzisu bkod/ skyes kyang zhes pa'i kyang ni mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan yang yin la/ khyad chos bag chags tshad med sad pa ni pad ma'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar 'gengs pa'i gzugs su bkod pa 'di ni/ cha shas gzugs can yin yang kun dkris chu 'dzin gyi gzugs su bkod de/ chu 'dzin ldan yang zhes pa'i yang de yang mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan yin la/ blo gros 'od stong kro ba'i gzugartswa su bkod de/ dpe can gyi khyad chos dag dpe'i khyad chos kyi gzugs su bkod nas/ dpe can gyi khyad gzhi khong rang nyid dpe'i khyad gzhi bcu gnyis bdag pos bsdus pas bsdus brjod 46

7kyi rgyan ba95 so/ / gsum pa ni/ khrad 'phags phul sbyin pha rol phyin pa'i don/ /skye 'am 'chi lang rmi lam tshun chad du/ /thub gsung ji bzhin 'dzin pa'i ched du 'dir/ /rgan bus lus de rgas kyang rnam brgyas spro/ /zhes gsungs te/ brjod bya dang rjod byed gang gi cha nas khyad par du 'phags shing / sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa drungs nas 'byin byed yin pas phul du byung ba gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gyi don zab rgyas kyi chos tshul mtha' dag skye 'am 'chi yang ste skye 'chi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad dang tha na rmi lam gyi gnas skabs tshun chad du/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin du 'dzin pa ste/ mdor na dam chos 'dzin pa'i ched du tshe 'dir rgan bu bdag gis lus rgas kyang sems kyi brtson pa rnam pa brgyu zag gi sgo nas spro'o/ /zhes pa ste/ mdo las/ rab dang phul dang gtso bo dang gya nom pa nyid du gyur pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyad 'phags phul phyin pha rol phyin pa zhes yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang / rkang ba phyi ma gsum ni/ bsam pa rgya che ba'i rgyan yin la/ rgyal sras rnams kyi smon lam klung yangs ni/ /47

dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus par/ //gsungs phyir/zhes gsungs pa ltar dam chos 'dzin pa'i thugs smon nan tan mdzad pa'o/ / sems bskyed kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'di la gsum/ byang chub kyi sems kyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba/ byang chub kyi sems de dpe gang gis kyang ji bzhin mtshon mi nus par bstan pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon bstan pa'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ gang zhig thob na 'bad mi dgos par rgyalasnyeb kun gyi gdung 'tshob sras 'byur zhing / /lha dang lhacemin mi dang klur bcas phyag 'os dgra brtsom nyan rang sogs zil sgro gnon/ /rgyal kun dgyes bzhin sras mchog rnams dang dkar phyogs ma lus dgo' ba'i stobs bskyed pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyi rin chen sngon rmed zid zhi'i gtsug gi rgyan mchog der phyag sta'atshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang zhig ces spyi'i tshul du smras nas/de thob na 'bad brtson byed mi dgos par rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'tshob ste rgyal tshab tu dbang bsgyur nus pa'i rgyal sras dam par 'gyur zhing / lha dang lha min dang mi dang klu la sogs pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis phyag bya ba'i 48

'os su 'gyur la/ sems ma bskyed pa'i dgra bcom pa gser gyi ri bo lta bu rnams dang rang rang gi lam gyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan —khyad 'phags thob pa'i nyan thos dang rang rgyal rnams dang sogs sgras bsdus pa zhi lhag gi yon tan khyad par ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa thams cad zil gyis gnon cing / rgyal ba kun dgyes bzhon du dang sras mchog byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang dkar bo'i phyogs la dga' ba'i lha mi dag gis spyang dga' ba'i stobs bskyed pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che sngon med pa'i srid pa dang zhi ba'i gtsug gi rgyan mchog tu gyur pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ gang zhig ces pa'i gang ni/ spyi sgra yin te/ spyi sgra la/thog mar don de dmigs su ma bzung bar spyir smos nas/ phyis yon tan sogs kyis khyad par du byas nas/ dmigs su 'dzin pa dang / rigs can kun la khyab pa'i spyi tsam brjod pa dang /spyir 'dri ba dang / the tshom nas 'dri ba dang / gdams ngag la 'jug pa rnams yode pa las/ 'di dang bo yin te / rkang ba dang bo'i dbur gang zhig ces spyi'i tshul du smos nas/ rkang ba gsum pa yan chad kyis —yon tan gyis khyad par du byas te rkang ba bzhi ba'i dbur byang chub sems kyi rin chen zhes dmigs su 49

bzung ba'i phyir/ des na rkang ba bzhi bas byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i gzugs su bkrod pas gzugs can gyi rgyan dang /tshig rkang gong ma rnams yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ brgya byin gatshog gi nor bu dang / /'khor los bskur ba'i 'khor lo mchog mtsho 'dzin pa'i rin chen yang / /byang chub sems kyi phyogs lde'i dpe/ /zhes gsungs te/lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyi spyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bos dab nga sgyur byed kyi 'khor lo rin po che mchog tu gyur pa de dang / rgya mtsho 'dzin pa ste rgya mtsho chen por gnas pa'i nor bu rin po che rnams kyang byang chub kyi sems kyi dper bzhag pa ni/ phyogs re ba ste cha shas tsam re'i dpe mtshon tsam las ji bzhin mtshon nus pa'i gnas med do/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dpe rgyan nyer gsum pa thun mong min pa'i dpe'i khongs su gtogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ spog bzhin theg chen lam gyi 'anug snog / /sangs rgyas sa bon yonartsetan rdzom bzhin byed/ /dus mtha'i me bzhin jig chen bams cad bsreg /nor bu mchog des re ba ma lus skong / /zhes gsungs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di ni lusadzha50

sem rten brten pa'i 'brel ba gnas pa'i srog bzhin dang de skyes na theg pa po'i lam du 'jug pa dang de dor na theg pa chen po'i lam las ldog pas 'jug sdog gi rgyu dam pa yin la/sangs rgyas kyi sa bon du gyur pa'i yon tan thams cad 'khor dang longs spyod rnyed bkur sogs kyi rgyur gyur nas 'thor du mi 'jug par sdom byed kyi thag pa bzhin byed pa dang / dus mtha'i me bzhin du sdig pa ches chen po dag kyang bsreg par bya ba sogs/de lta bu'i yon tan tshad med pa'i byang chub kyi sems nor bu rin po che mchog des 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i re ba ma lus pa skong bar byed do/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang ba gong ma rnams dpe rgyan dang / nor bu mchog des zhes byang chub kyi sems bsdus pa'o/ /bden gnyis kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'di la bzhi/ thub pa'i gsung gilomakhas mang gi blo gros 'phel ba/ deng dus 'jam bzhad khong giyolegs bshad kyi sgo brgya phye ba/ mkhas rlom dag gis log bshad kyi yig 'jog bkram tshul/khong gis thub bstan spel ba'i thugs khyar mi 'dor tshul bstan pa'o dang bo ni/ smras ba/ ba' bla ba ston ba mchog de yis/ /beg gsum dge 'dugababoracags mdzes nang / /thespodon 51

bdud khyu'i thos ba mang ma da pas/ /rgya bod mkhas mang blo yi rgya mtsho 'phel/ /zhes gsungs te/ zab don smra— ba'i zla ba ston pa bla na med pa mchog tu gyur pa de yis/ nyan rang byang sems kyi theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun rgyu skar gyi 'khor tshogs rab tu ma dzes shing lta na sdug pa'i nang du/ sher mdo sogs gsungs te nges don zab mo stong ba nyid kyi bdud rtsi spros pa sogs kyi mdzad pa lan mang mdzad pas/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang bod gangs can gyi mkhas pa ha cang mang bo'i zab don rtogs pa'i blo gros kyi rgya mtsho rab tu 'phel to/ /zhes pa ste/ spyir zab mo'i lta ba ston pa'i cha nas/ smra ba zla med ces bstod pa dang / rgyo chen spyod pa'i cha nas/ 'dren pa mnyam med ces bstod pa yin la/ 'dir yang gtso bor zab don bstan pa'i cha nas bstod pa yin te/ smra ba'i zla ba zhes pa/ zab don smra bar byed pa'i zla ba zhes zla ba'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / 'khor dge 'dun rnams ni zla ba'i 'khor skar tshogs kyi gzugs su bkod pa dang /nges don don dam bden pa gsungs pa bdud rtsi spros pa'i gzugs su bkod pa ni/ tsha yul rtswa tsha bas gdung ba'i tshe na zla ba shar te zla 'od lus la phog pas bsil ba'i snang ba skyes te zla bas bdud rtsi spros zer zhing / zla 'odal bdud rtsi'i zegs ma 52

yang zer ro/ /dpe de bzhin du ston pas chos nyid bden pa bstan pas gdul bya'i nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba sel ba'o/ /mkhas mang gi blo gros kyang rgya mtsho'i gzugs n+da/'ibakod pas/gzugs can gyi rgyan dang skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu'i rgyan yang yin—no/ /gnyis pa ni/ skal ldan gdung ba'i nad sel deng dus lang / /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i kuro'i re ba skong / /shes sam sher sbyin bdud rtsi'i sgo r+ṣabargya r+bha/ /tshod par rigs sam nad gdungs 'gro rnams kye/ /zheso gsungs te/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya'i las nyon dang sgrib gnyis kyi gdung ba sel byed sher phyin gyi bdud rtsi 'dis deng sang gi dus skabs 'dir yang bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i thugs kyi ku mu da'i re ba skong bar byas so/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis shise sam da ni bdagañtsagis phar phyin gyi gzhung 'di lta khyi rtsom pa 'dis mtshon 'chad rtsod rtsom pas —sher phyin gyi brdudz+wacu'i sgo mo brgya phrig phye bar bya ste/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sa longs su spyod par rigs sam/las nyon gyi nad kyis gdungs paṅge 'gro ba rnams kye/ zhes 'bod par mdzad pa ste/ re ba skongaji.oṃn chad kyis sher phyin gyi don khong rang gis khong du chud parad+kustan/ shes sam man chad kyis/53

rang gis nges bzhin gzhan dag la/ /nges pa skyed par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya gzhan la rgya cher ston rgyu yin par bstan/ spyado par rigs sam man gyis snying rje'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i 'gro ba rnams dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi khong gi legs bshad 'di lta bu la longs sbyod par bskul ba'o/ /'di yang gzugs can gyi rgyan yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ la la'i 'khrul 'byams kha cig ma to'i r+bha/ /phal cher the tshom 'ga'i dzig don bral rtsan/ /'ga' zhig thes blom thub chod smyon paligar/ /mang bo'i skun mda' gtad bral ci yang byas/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhung rtsom pa bo la la'i rtsom gyi nang du nor 'khrul 'byams klas pa ste/ shin tu mang bos gang ba dang / kha cig gis mu to ste sprang bo'i phye bzhin du gzhan rtsom sna tshogs btus pa dang / phal cher gyis the tshom tsam las sgro 'dogs ma chod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis tshig dang don ya bral du song ba'i rdzun gtam bsgrigs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis shes par rlom pa'i nga rgyal gyi dbang gis thub chod de ham pa byas te thag bcad pa smyon pa'i zlos gar 'khrab pa lta bu dang / gzhung mang bo'i nang don mun nag nang du mda' 'phangs pa ltar blo rtse 54

gtad so dang bral ba ci yang byas so/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni rang bzhin brjod pa dang gzugs can gyi rgyaspyo bsres pa'o/ / bzhi ba ni/ da dung lnga phrag drug skad phazhen lham nas/ /thub dbang 'khor gyi rgyal sras dpal mang gis/ /thub bstan spel ba'i thugs khur mi 'dor bas/ /'azhi byas skal mnyamastel bsam galar khrala'ang yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ da dung bstan pa'i gnas tshad lnga brgya phrag bcu yod pa'i nang gi lnga brgya phrag drug pa tshul khrims kyi le'u yin skad de/ yin par gsungs pa bden snyam nas/ thub dbang gi 'khor gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' mang bo dag gis/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i thugs bskyed kyi khur de mi 'dor stabs/ bdag gis kyang 'di 'dra'i rtsom pa zhig byas na rang dang skal ba mnyam pa dag la phan par 'gyur bsams nas g.yar khral tsam du bris —pa'ang yin/ zhes khengs skyungs dang bcas te thub bstan rin po che spel ba'i thugs bskyed mi 'dor bar bstan pa yin la/ bya ba brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed do/ / bden bzhi'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'di la lam bzang bsnam rigs par bltan pa dang / lugs bzang rgyul mtshan btsugs par brten pa dang gnyis so/ /5bya

dang bo ni/ smras pa/ 'khor ba' 'bras rnam byang rgyu 'bras lam/ /so sor bstan 'di shes nas shes rab can/ / /gcig tu bde la drangs ging dge ba'i lam/ /drang spong chen po'i bgrod yul bsnam bar rigs/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras ni rgyu kun 'byung bden pa dang 'bras bu sdug bden gnyis dang / rnam byang phyogs kyi rgyu 'bras ni/ rgyu lam bden dang 'bras bu 'gog bden te/ 'khor 'das kyi rgyu 'bras kyi lam bden bzhi khyad chos bcu drug dang bcas pa rtogs pa'i lam so sor bstan pa 'di shes nas/ shes rab can rnams sngar mtha' gcig tu bde ba'i thar ba'i lam la drangs shing / da dung yang 'dren par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i lam drang srong chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi thar bar bgrod pa'i yul te lam 'di bsnam par ri gas pa ste nyams su len par rigs so/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang ba dang bo gnyis skor ba'i rgyan dang / phyi ma gnyis bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa yin la/ 'gog bden rtag pa yin pas 'bras bu dngos min yang / lam bden nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'gog bden thob dgos stabs/ 'gog lam gnyis la rnam byang phyogs kyi rgyu 'bras kyi tha snyad mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhas rmongs sna tshogs gtam gyis 'phags 56

rnams spyang / /som nyi'idzārgya la thum pa snyam byed pa'i/ /logawā'i dra ba kun bcad 'phags seng dang / /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang rgyal mtshan btsugos/ /zhes gsungs te/ mkhas par rlom yang don la rmongs pa'i log bshad sna tshogs pa'i gtam gyis/ 'phags pa rnams kyang som nyi ste the tshom gyi dra ba'i rgyar thum par 'gyur snyam du dogs pa skyed par byed pa'i log bshad kyi dra ba rnams dgag gzhag gi ral gris bcad de/ 'phags sepa dang rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang bo dri ma med pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs so/ /zhes pa ste/ —tshig rkang dang bo gnyis rab btags snyam sgra can dang / phyi ma gnyis gzugs can gyi rgyan gyis spras la/ dpa' ba'i nyams ldan gyi rgyan yang yin no/ / skyabs gsum gyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'di la sku gsum rin rnyed par bstan pa/ mkhyen gsum nor bu rnyed par bstan pa gnyis so/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ sna tshogs las nyon chu brin 'dzin khris gang / /skye rga na 'chi'i za klong cher 'khrag pa'i/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rgal byed skyabs gsum grur/tsho /rab lugs sku gsum rin chen dhed pa rmad/ /ces gsungs te/ ngo bo phra rags dang 57

rigs sna tshogs pa'i las dang ston mongs pa chu srin 'dzin te chu srin khri phrag gis gang zhing skye go na 'chi'i ze klodzoches cher 'khrug pa'i 'khor‘ba'i rgya mtsho rgal byed skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi grur rab tu zhugs nas/ chos longs sprul gsum gyi hūṃ gsumasarin chen rnyed pa rmad du byung ba'o / /zhes pa ste/ las la khams gsum du 'phen byed kyi las dang / 'dod khams su 'phen byed la'ang bdi 'gro dang ngan 'gror 'phen byed sna tshogs pa zhig yod pa dang / myong 'gyur gyi dbang gis dbye ba gsum dang / ngo bo'i sgo nas/ byas la ma bsags pa/ bsags dze+em byas pa/ byas bsags tshang ba sogs sna tshogs pa zhig yod pa dang / nyon mongs la'ang khams gsum gyi nyon mongs dang / rtsa ba dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa sogs sna tshogs pa zhig yod pas/ sna tshogs las nyon zhes gsungs shing / de dgakhrishā mtsho chen po'i nang du chu srin gdug pa can rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig yod pa'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / thar ba ma thob kyi bar du skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal brgyud mar myong dgos pa de/ rgya mtsho chen po'i rba klong 'jigs su rung ba cher 'khrug pa'i gzugs su bkod/ las nyon sna tshogartswab dang skye rga na 'chi'i khyad chos can gyi zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo lngas bsdus pa'i 'khor ba 58

de nyid chu srin 'dzin ches mang bos gang zhing / rba klong 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i gzugs su bkod/thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa la/ skyabs gsum la nges par brten dgos pas skyabs gsum rgya mtsho rgal byed kyi gru'i gzugs su bkod/ skyabs gsum la brten nas sku gsum gyi go 'phang thob pa ni/ grur zhugs nas rgya mtsho'i gling du phyin te rin po che rnyed pa'i gzugs su bkod pas/ sho lo ka 'di ni mtha' dag gzugs can dang rmad byung gi nyams ldan yang yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ rgya pod dran dbang bye bas bgrod dka'i gnas/ /glub mtha' so so'i lugs mang chu gter chogs/ /mthong yang dzoms min darngos brgyad r+pā gari'i/ /gling bgrod mkhyen gsum nor bu thob pa 'alda/ /zi lam min nam bskal ba du ma ru/ /rkang gnyispomachogawār ded dpobe+e bsten nam mtshar/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgya gar 2phags pa'i yul dang bod gangs can gyi dran dbang ste mkhas dbang bye ba ste ches shin tu mang bos bgrod par dka' ba ste shes dka' ba'i gnas/ grub mtha' bzhi sogs phyi nang gi grub mtha'—so so'i rang rang gi lugs mi 'dra ba mang bo chu gter sna tshogs ba de mthong zhing shes na yang / 59

des ngoms pa min pa ste ma tshims par/ dngos po brgyad dang don bdun cu ston pa'i rgyan mdo dang bcas pa'i bā da ri'i gling— ste/ ri bo 'od zer can gyi gling du bgrod nas/ gzhi lam mkhyen gsum gyi nor bu thob pa 'di ni/ a re dga' ba la rmi lam du rmis pa min nam/ yang na/ bskal pa du ma ru rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ded dpon du bsten pa min nam ches ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes pa ste/ rgya bod kyi mkhas dbang mang bos shes dka' ba'i grub mtha' so so'i lugs mang ni chu gter te mtsho sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su bkod/ dngos po brgyad don bdun cu brjod bya rjod byed dang bcas pa bā da ri'i gling gi gzugs su bkod/mkhyen gsum nor bu'i gzugs su bkod/ de thob pa'i da ga' ston rnyed dka' ba rnyed pa 'di rmi lam min nam zhes the tshom pa'i tshul dang ’/ sangs rgyas ded dpon gyi gzugs su bkod de/ de bsten pa'i 'bras bu yin nam zhes the tshom phul byung gi rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ /gong gi tshigs bcad gcig dang / 'og gi rkang ba drug po 'dis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal thabs la dbang 'byor zin pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba bstan to/ /spyan lnga skangon shes kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 60

'grel/ 'dir sho lo ka gcig gis sher phyin la rol bar bsngags pa ni/ thub bstan chu bo'i 'byung gnas phar sbyin gyi/ /ma dros mtsho chen 'chad pa'i gangs ri la/ /'phags seng bde 'byung rnam 'apyal rmad byung gis/ /mkhas dbang bye bas dus kun rol ba rmad/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dir rol ba'i gnas/ ji ltar rol ba'i tshul/ rol ba bo'i gang zag gsum gyi sgo nas gsungs te/ rnam 'dren thub pa'i bstan pa chu bo thams cad kyi 'byung gnas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i klu ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po de gang las 'chad pa'i 'byung khungs gangs can ri la/ zhes gang la —rol ba'i gnas phar phyin ri bo gangs can gyi gzugs su bkod pa dang / 'phags seng bde 'byung ste lha chen dbang phyug gi ngang tshul rmad du byung ba'i tshul dag gis/ zhes ji ltar rol ba'i tshul 'phags pa grol byusde dang slob dpon seng ge bzang bo gnyis phar phyin la rol ba'i mdzad pa lha chen dbang phyug gangs can rir dka' thub la gnas pa'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / de lta bu'i tshul kyis mkhas dbang bye ba ste ches shin tu mang bos pha rol tu phyin pa la rol zhing longs spyod pa 'di rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes rol ba bo'i gang zag ngos bzung ba'o/ /spyir 'dzam bu'i gling gi chu klung thams cad mtsho ma dros pa'i bdag po'i mabu las byung 61

ba dang / chu 'go gangs la thug zer ba bzhin/ chu bo thams cad kyi rtsa ba ri lhagangs can la thug par bshadapa yadz+wayonasapas/ 'dir phyi ma'i dpang du byasate/ mtsho ma dros pa yang gangs can ri las chad pa'am byung ba gzhir bzhag nas/ thub pa'i bstan pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs rme rolatu phyin pa yin pa dang / chu bo thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/ mtsho ma dros pa gang las chad pa'i gangs can ri yin pa dpe don sbyar ro/ /—rig byegakyi gtam rgyud ltar lha chen dbang phyug ri bo gangs can du dka' thub la rol ba dang / 'phags seng sher phyin la rol tshul dpermo do na sbyar te/ cha shas can gyi gzugs can gyis sgras pa'o/ /gzung rtog 'dzin rtog gi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig po 'dis thabs shes yongs rdzogs bsten pa la bsngags pa ni/ smras pa/ gang girtswazin na nyon mongs dag gis kyang / /byang chub skub pa'i snathabs mkhas zher pyin 'di/ /rmad byung thabs shes yongaspordzogs bzhen byedamipa/ /byis pa'i dus nas khams gsusabla mar byur/ /ces gsungs te/ gang gis zhes spyi'i tshul du smras te gis zhes gsum pa byed pa yin pas/ spyi'i tshul du smos pa des zin na/ nyon mongs dag gis kyangartsebla med byang chub smub pa'i thabs mkhas byed thub 62

gyinibyugo nga du spyi'i tshul du smos pa dmigs kyis bzung ste sher phyin 'di yin no/ /zhes ngos bzung ba dang / de ltar rmad du byung ba'i thabs snying rje chen po dang shes rab stor nyid rtogs ba'i blo yongs rdzogs bsten par byed pa'i skyes bu de ni/ gyis pa ste so so skye bo dus nas kyang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi bla mar gyur to/ /zhes pa ste/ thabs gzhan don khur 'khyer gyi snying rje chen po dang / shes rab stong nyid rtogs pa'i blos zin na/ byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang gis/ nyon mongs pa dag kyang byang chub sgrub pa'i rgyur bsgyur te/ dper na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis khyim thabs la gnas nas/ sras byang chub sems dpa' stong la sogs pa bskrun te/ soms can gyi don dpag tu med pa zhig mdzad pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i thabs shes khya da par can rgyud la skyes na rang nyid so so skye bo 'chigab kun ldan yin kyang /ka la ping kas sgo nga'i sbubs nasaskarīdar+sā'abyin pa ltar/ sems can gyi don la rab tu brtson pas/ theg dman dgra bcom pa gsir gyi ri bo lta bu dag gisakyang phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur te/spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyamasaṃ thag rnams/ /bde 63
