gshegs rnams kyi sras zhis brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di ni skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu'i rgyan no/ /theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ gzhung 'di ngo mtshar bar bstan pa/ bden gnyis ya ma bral bar bstan pa/ sher phyin la longs spyod par bskul ba'o/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ 'phags seng gcig tu gyar ram lang na rje lab sras/ /lhan stsag lang yang dpyad pas ma lus mkhas nems yid/ /bkugs bzhin chags bzhin dad bzhin 'dun bzhin skal ldan tshogs/ /bstod bzhin dgyes bzhin ngo mtshar phul byung lta bur gleng / /zhes gsungs te/ 'phags seng gnyis gcig tu gyur ram/ yang na rje yab sras rnams lhan cig tu 'dus te/ yang yang brtag dpyad byas pa'i stobs kyis yin nam gang ltar gcig kyang ma lus pa'i mkhas pa rnams gzhung 'dis yid rang dbang med par bkugs pa bzhin du yid 'phrog cing 'di la chags shing zhen bzhin dang dad cing gus bzhin dang / yid 'dun bzhin du ngo mtshar bar 'dzin la/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya'i tshogs rnams kyis kyang bstod bzhin 64

dang dga' zhing dgyes bzhin du ngo mtshar zhing phul du byung ba 'di lta bur snang ngo / /zhes gleng bar byed do/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang ba dang bo gnyis kyis sems ldan rab rtog gi rgyan gyi sgo nas blo gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog cing rto mtshar bar bstan pa dang / rkang ba gsum pa'i mjug dang rkang ba tha mas skal ldan rnams kyis yid shin tu mgu nas bstod cing ches shin tu ngo mtshar bar gleng ba'i tshul bstan la/ 'di ni sems ldan rab rtog gi rgyan yin te/ sems ldan 'phags seng gnyis gcig tu gyur pa ma yin na'ang de ltar btags pa dang / rje yab sras rnams gcig tu tshogs nas brtag dpyad dang gros bsdur gyis gzhung 'di brtsams pa min yang de ltar sgro btags nas smras pas rab rtog gi rgyan du 'gyur te/ kun mkhyen snyan ngag rtsa ba las/ sems ldan de yi chos gang gzhan gnas par/ /rnam pa gzhan du sgro btags rab rtog gi /sgra ldan de ni sems ldan rab rtog 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ rab rtog gi sgra dang yang ldan te/ rkang ba dang bo'i gcig tu gyur ram/ zhes pa'i ras sgra dang / 'og gi bzhin sgra rnams kyang rab rtog gi sgra yin te/ de nyid las/ snyam dang dogs dang nges dang 'dra min nam/ ru /bzhin dang yang sogs khyo5

ra7ba rtog sgra ru 'dod/ /cesagasungartepa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'ji ga rten gimo gya chu mang la mtshar+sā rte ji/mkhas rnams don dam da mig wārkun bral yang / /kun rjob ma'i rol ba mi 'char pa'o/ ci /bzhen misko suspun min ya mtshan rtag rtu smogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ las lar+sā 'jig rten sna tshogs skyes/ /zhes gsungs —pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi mtho dman ltung bab dar rgud sogs ri mo gya rgyu shin tu mang la mtshar che ba zhig yin mo da/ gnas lugs—rtogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams don dam la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi ngor/ kun rdzob kyi dmigs ba ste snangatreb kun dang bral yang /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu de med pa min la/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes la kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rol pa mi 'char ba'i stabs kyis/ kun rdzob de nyid bden pa min yang blo kun rdzob pa'i ngor rdzun pa min stabs/ kun rdzob bdene pha zhes brjod pa sogs mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba ston pa'i legs bshad ya.atshan pa dus rtag tu sgrogs par byed do/ /zhes pa ste/ ) don dam dmigs pa kun bral yang / /zhis pa'i yang sgras/ kun rdzob kyi ri mo sna tshospus pa de dag 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes la mi snang yang med pa min zhes ston to/ /'di ni khong gi snyan 66

tsho ga rtsa ba las/ shar ba'i nges tshigardziyod phyir grags jina'ang sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shar phyogs gau ḍa ba 'udod pa'i rab dwangs yinano/ / gsum pa.oṃ/ kun 'byung — masathi' pa'i rtsag bden gas/ /grid pa'i 'byor skud mtshes cig chu'i gnyer ma/ — /ma zin don chung kun spangs sher sbyin kyi/ /rnam sad longs rdzod jogs pa rtag rol kye/ /zhes gsungs te/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung bden pa sgyu ma'i gzugs su bkod nas/ kun 'byung sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags kyis sprul ba'i phyi nang gi sdug bden sna tshogs pas bsdus pa'i srid pa ste 'khor ba'i 'byor rgud dang mdzes sdug mtha' dag chu'i gnyer ma'i gzugs su bkod de/ de lta bu'i chu'i gnyer ma chom zin zin 'dod kyi don chung kun te tshang ma spangs nas/ sher phyin gyi rnam sad longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa la rtag tu rol bar mdzod cig kye/ zhes bskul ba'o/ /rnam sad ni lha'i ming ste/ lha la gnyid med pas rnam sad ces brjod do/ /des na sher phyin gyi/ rnam sad longs spyod rdzogs pa rtag rol kye/ /zhes pa ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan no/ / gzungs kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi rmegrel/ 'di la 67

gzungs thob par bstan pa dang / — 'khru la ba bsal bar 4bstan pa gnyis so/ / d+ku tsho / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ tshe rabs rtsangs pa'i bad masporab khrab pa'i/ /sngon bsagaspotshogaspoganyis 'o ma'i mtsho chen las/ /shes bya kun mkhyen gzungs kyidze dbyangs can ma/ /brngod thob tshangs pa'i bu mo ma yin nam/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshe rabs mang bor sbyangs pa'i sbyangs stobasatshukyi she sa rab pad mas rab tu khyab —pa'i sngon bsags bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rno ma'i mtsho chen po las/ shes bya kun mkhyen pa'i gzungs kyi lha mo dbyangs can ma 'khrungs so/ /zhes rkang ba dang bo gsum bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs ca na gyi rgyan dang / bzod pa'i gzungs thob pa 'di ni tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can lha mo ma yin nam/ zhes rab rtog ma yin nam gyi sgra can gyis spras so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'azhir mongs blo chen rgan yang the tshom gdong / /'khral ba'i gnam du 'gyar de megs bshad kyi/ /thal 'gyur sen mos bcad kyang yang dag pa'i/ /gzungs bzhi'i zhal ras 'gro la mchog tu bzhad/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dir gzungs bzhi sogs la rmongs pa'i blo chen te tshangs pa rgan yang 'khrul ba'i gdong gnam du 'phyar ba de legs bshad kyi thal 'gyur sen mos 68

rnasapar bcad kyang / yang dag pa'i gezungs bzhi'i zhal ras bzhi 'gro ba rnams la mchog tu bzhad do/ /zhes pa ste/ gzungs kyi don la rmongs pa'i dri ma dang ldan pa'i yig cha rtsom pa bo snga ma dag tshangs pa'i gzugs su bkod/ tshangs pa la blo chen zer ga rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du 'jig rten thams cad tshangs paliblo'i g.yo ba las byung bar 'dod pas blo chen zhes smos/'khrul ldan yig 'jog mkhan de dag sngar byung rgan pa yin pa/rgan yang zhes tshangs pa rgan par byed pa'i gzugs su bkod de/'chi med mdzod las/ tshangs pa bdag skyes lha las rgan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang gtam rgyud las/ sdon tshangs pas thig le mchog ma zhes bya ba'i bu mo zhig sprul nas de la rang nyid chags te/ bu mo de phyogs bzhir bskor ba la bltas pas gdong bzhi byung / steng du song ba la bltas pas gdong gcig ste lnga byung ba dbang phyug gis nam mkha' nas mthong nas der ngo tsha bas chad las la steng gi gdong de bcad/ de nas gdong bzhi ba zhes grags pa/ gtam rgyud de lhadang sbyar nas/ yig 'jog de dag gis sgro 'dogs ma rtod par tshe tshoblu pa ni/ gdong lnga ba'i gzugs su bkod/ the tshom gyis 'khrul gtam bshad pa de/gdong ba lnga bas gnam du bltas pa'i gzugasdo su bkod/ legs 69

par bsh-id pa'i thal 'gyur de sen mo'i gzugs su bkod/ thal 'gyur gyis 'khrul ba rtsad nas phyung ba de sen mos steng gdong bcad pa'i gzugs su bkod/ 'khyal ba bsal shul du gathungs bzhi'i rnam pazhag yang dag par bshad pa de/ tshangatse pa'i steng gdornga bcad shul gyi gdong bzhi —lhas 'gro ba la bltas nas bzhagapa'i gzugs su bkod pas mtha' dag gzugs can gyis sdi byun pa'o/ /gzungs bzhi ni/ bzod pa/ chos/ don/ sngags kye gzungs r+pāzhi ste/ 'di'i gong du yig char shin tu gsal lo/ /skabs dang bo'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ legs bshad kyi mchod sprin ston pa la phul ba/blo ldan rnams dga' ba'i yule yin par bstan ba/ 'gro ba'i blo dang 'tsham par spros par bstan pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ mngar ba'i ro mchog kun mkhyen za ku la yi 'bras bu'i khur sadud/ /chos bca'i 'dab ma rab rgyas khrad 'phags 3 mo 'bum 'char mdo rgyan 'phros/ /phan tshun zel ba'i yal 'ad0 pong phung rin chen rgyan gyi tshogs 'phyang 'asprul/ /lung rigs bye ba'i dri bzang ngad 'thul sngon med mchod sprin ston mchog la'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ brjod bya sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan ches shin tu mngar ba'i ro mchog dang ldan pa'i kun 70

mkhyen ye shes kyi phung bo bā ku la yi 'bras bu rab tu rgyas pas khur shin tu dud pa/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i 'dab ma rab tu rgyas thing / khyad par du 'phags pa'i rimo 'a'i.oṃphrag 'char ba dang / rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i mdo dang / mngonasprertogs rgyan gyi 'phros dag phan tshun spel ba ste phan tshun gcigalhagis gcig la go ba ster ba'i yalaga'i 'dab ma phang phung du g.yo ba lasarin po che'i rgyanadhesna tshogs r+pā'i 'phyang 'asrul dang ldan pa lung dang rigs pa bye ba 'bum phrag du ma'i dri bzang gi ngad phyogs bachur 'a thul ba'i sngon med pa'i mchod pa'i sprin skabs dang bo'i mtha' dpyod 'di/ thub pa'i dbang bo ston pa mchog la 'bul lo/ /zhes pa ste/ brjod bya bla na med pa'i kun mkhyen ye shes kyi mung bo de/ bā ku la'i 'bras bu'i gzugs su bkod/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu bo legs par bshad pa mi tog gi 'dab ma rgyu sa shing khyad par du 'phags pa'i༄ re mo 'bum 'char ba'i gzugs subakod/ mdo rgyag/ 'asbos dang 'phros gzhi pan tshun spel zhing gung bsgri gas pa de/ dpag bsam shing gi yal 'dab phang phung du g.yo ba la rin po che'ice'aphyang 'phrul gyis brgyan pa'i gzugs su bkod/ tshig la thon 26) cha dang cha can gnyis kyi nang gi cha rnams tshang ma gzugs su bkod la/ cha can gzhung 71

'di sngon med mchod sprin zhes sgedhetsam las/ dpag bsam rīgyi gzugs su ma bkod pas/ tshigs bcad 'ani cha shas gzugs can yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ zab don sher phyin brang 'gro'i snying bo ni/ ji /sngon sbyangs ma la ma yi ngogs skyes pa/ /ma sbyangs stong ba'i dgag sgrub brang 'gro'i 'jigs/ /blo gros lag ldan tshogs kyi dga' skyes yul/ /zhes gsungs te/ zab don lta ba ston pa'i sher phyin brang 'gro'i snying bo ste/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo de ni/ bdag gi sngon sbyangs skyes stobs kyi shes rab ri bo ma la ya'i ngogs su skyes pa yin la/ gzhung lugs la ma sbyangs shing don thog tu r+shakhel bar tshig stong ba'i dgag sgrub lhur len pa dag ni brang 'gro ste sbrul la 'jigs mod/ blo gros dang ldan pa'i mkhas dbang lag ldan te glang bo che rnams rab tu dga' ba skyes pa'i yul yin no/ /zhes pa ste/ zab don ston pa'i sher phyin tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo'i gzugs su bkod/ khong gi skyes stobs kyi shes rab ni ri bo ma la ya'i gzugs su bkod/ khong gis sher phyin— gyi don khong du chud pa tsan dan sbrul snying ma la yar skyes pa'i gzugs su bkod/ ma sbyangs par tshig tsam stong ba'i dgag sgrub kyi yig cha rtsom mkhan ni/ sbrul snying gi sbrul la 'jigs par 72 —

gsungs—te/ don ni khong gi legs bshad kyi dgag sgrur+pā kyi zil mi bzod par 'jigs pa'i don yin/ blo ldan mkhas pa rnams glang bo che'i gzu gas su bkod/ glang bo che rnams sbrul la mi 'jigs par ma zad tsan dan sbrul snying gi dri la shin tu dga' zhing tsan dan gyi bsil ba'i reg bya la ha cang dga' ba yin/ de bzhin du mkhas pa rnams legs bshad 'di'i dgag sgrub la mi 'jigs par ma zad/ 'di'i legs par bshad pa'i khyad chos kyis thugs yid tshim zhing dga' bar 'gyur bas so/ /'di ni ldan pa'i gzugs can yin/gsum pa ni/ phra zhib bshad na mkhas pa'ang 'khral bskyed la/ /rgya cher spros na nam mkha' dog byed mkhan/ /rgya bod lugs kun blo gros grwa gnas pa'i/ /legs bshad 'gro blor 'tshams spros rje btsun bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhung phra zhing zhib par bshad na mkhas pa yin na'ang blor mi shong bar 'khrul ba bskyed par 'gyur la/ rgya cher spros na nam mkha' yang dog por byed thub mkhan/ rgya bod kyi grub mtha' so so'i 'dod lugs kun rang gi blo gros kyi grwar gnas pa ste khong du chud pa'i 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa bdag gis/ legs bshad 'dir gdul bya'i 'gro ba dag gi blo dang 'tshams par spros pa ni/ rje btsun byams 73 —

mgosagyis brtsams pa baṣ+kan yin— no/ /zhes pa ste/ blo gros grwar gnas pa'i yan gyis rtsophapa bo'i yon tan khyad par ba — brjod pa dang / de man gyis gdul bya'i blo—dadz+wa'atshams par spros par gsungs la/ 'di shar phyogs go ḍa ba rnamayokyisa'adod pa'i mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ /skabaspodeng bo'i mchod brjod dang bar skabs tshigs bcad/ mjug—rtsom dang bcas pa'i 'grel rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig bris zin to/ / / /

rmo tre smo skabuska gnyas 2zhi snyagaska 2cad rnanaska gezhad 8/ skabs gnyis pa'i mtha' dpyod mcho da brjod kyi 'grel/ 'di la bzhi yod de/ 'gyur phyag gi tshul du phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' baju rtsom par sgobar bstan pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam ba' dbyangs piphyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ 'gyur phyag gi tshul zhes pa ni /sngon lo tsā ba rnams kyis rgya gzhung bod skad du bsgyurir ba'i tshe na/'gyur mthar phyin pa'i ched du 'dod pa'i lha la phyag 'tsha2 gyi — slotshig gzhung gi dbur 'god par mdzad la/ 'di 'gyur dngos oṃyin yang 'gyur gzhung de dag gi tshul dang mazunapar mdzad pas/ 'gyur phyag gi tshul zhes brjod dgos la/ bla lodadz+wa'ajam dpyangs sogs kyi sgra bshad dang go don sogs gzhan du bshad zin pas 'dir ṣ+pespro'o/ / snaci gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ciba'o dume na'ang brtse ba' snying stobs dz+dzags pa'i sems bskyed cing / /lam gyi rnam pa'i gas kun 75

sdab bzhes tshogs gnyis pha rol sbyin/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang mthor 'tshegs mtshan gyi sgras kyang 'gro 'dren pa'i/ /pad dkar ltar bsngags mgon po nyi mdzi gnyedzha la phyag byas te/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'gro ba'i dus na ste so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan gyi las dang bo ba'i dus dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad sogs su skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe na'ang snying rje dang snying stobs rab tu rdzogs pa'i sems bskyed cing / sa lam gyi rnam pa'i tshogs ma lus pa kun thugs nyams su rab tu bzhes te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste mthar phyin nas/ bla na med pa'i sku bzhi'i go 'phang mthon por 'dzegs pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa gzhan lta ci smos/ mtshan gyi sgra tsam gyis kyang 'gro ba rnams ngan song dang 'khor ba las 'dren pa'i rgyal ba kun gyi pad ma dkar bo ltar bsngags pa'i mgon po nyi ma'i gnyen la yid dang bas phyag byas te/ zhes pa ste/ dus na'ang zhes pa'i 'ang sgra'i don ni/ rtogs pa mthon por slebs pa'i dus su ma zad ces pa'i don yin/ phyag byas te zhes pa'i te sgra lhag ma 'dren pa'i lhag bcas kyi sgra ste/ 'og gi rtsom par dam bca' ba'i tshig dag 'dren pa'o/ /'di ni don rgyan bcu gsucha/ pa rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gi 'thob bya'i rgyu'i rgyan dang / nyer d+ngha76

gnyisapa rgya che ba'i—rgyan dang bo bsam pa rgya che ba'i rgyan yin te/kun mkhyen snyan ngag rtsa ba las/ thob bya gang zhig thob byed bya ba des/ /thob par ston pa thob bya'i rgyu yi phon/ /zhes dang / snying stobs blo dang brtse sogs ci rigs pa'i/ /bsam pa bla med bsam pa rgya che'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ brad pa'i dug 'byin zhi ba'i zul sel ba'i/ /lam gsum shes pa'i khrid la myang 'das bzhin/ /jol mjod rgyal sras rnams kyi 'artsag ngogs mchog /rab dang phul de rgyal tshab gsung bzhin 'god/ /ces gsungs te/srid pa ste 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi dug ma lus pa rtsa ba nas 'byin par byed cing / zhi ba myang 'das kyi mthar ltung ba'i rdul ma lus pa sel bar byed pa'i gzhi lam rnam gsum gyi lam shes pa'i gang zag sems can gyi don du srid pa ste 'khor ba'i gnas su theg dman 'phags pa dag myang 'das la dgyes pa bzhin du rol bar mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jug ngogs mchog tu gyur pa/ rab dang phul dang gya nom pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i gsung bzhin du 'god par bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/ srid mtha' dug dang zhi mtha' —rdul gyi 77

gzugs su bkod de rnam dbye drug pa ma bsdusdo pas ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang / latha' de gnyis sol ba'i lam gsum po shes pa'i byang chub soms dba' rnams sems can gyi don du 'khor ba'i gnas la rol ba ni/ theg dman 'phags pa dag myang 'das la rol ba bzhin yin do/ /zhes dpe rgyan gyis smras pa yin no/ / bzhi ba ni/ 'jig rten 'du 'dzi glun po'i zil spyong dang / /dman pa'i bder gas snyom las tsam min pa'i/ /ngal med ngal brgyas dub kyangajirgas ra rkyang / /bems kyi spro ba 'bum gyisaltajurtswal rjo/ /zhis gsungs te/ 'jig rten phalaci ba'i tshe 'di'i snang shas kyi dbang rdu song nas 'a tsholacib dang /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs la g.yeng ba'i 'du 'a dzi /dang / blun po'i zol sbyor te mi shes shes khul gyi brel zing dang / dman pa'i bde ba la gnyis yod pa'i 2khor bdi gzugs sgra dri ro reg byangadzi chags pa dang zhi ba'i badzib myang 'das la zhen pa'i chags pa —gang gis kyang—ngal ba min la/ snyom las com du bsdad ba yang dzoyin pa'i ngal ba med pa'i chos kyi don la dka' ba brgya phrag spyad pa'i ngal ba brgya phrag gis lus po dub kyang na tshod rgas par gyur kyang / sems kyi spro ba ste brtson 'grus 'bum gyis bstan 18

bcos rtsom pa la 'jug par spro'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di gi/don rgyan nyer lnga ba khyad par brjod pa la lnga yod pa'imilnga ba rgyu'i —khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan yin te/ kun mkhyen snyan ngag rtsa ba 4las/ khyad par 'ga' zhig ma tshang khyad par rgyus/ /'bras bu bskyed pa rgyu yi khyad par brdzod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ rgyu'i khyad par 'ga' zhig ma dublo pa dang ma rgas pa ma tshang yang / khyad par gyi rgyu sems kyi spro ba 'bum gyis/'bras bu bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa bskyed par brjod pa'i phyir ro/ / chos bcu gcig gis lam shes mtshon te bstan pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad gcig gi 'grel/ smras pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa mthong ba'i spyan ras stong / /brtse ba'i 'gro la gzigs pa mi dman pas/ /'khor ba dga'asnyel bzhen gzigs 'gro ba rnams/ /skyong madz+rad byams 'a ma cing 'i gter sogs da/ /ces gsungs te/ 'khor ba'i gnas na 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal brgya phrag gis mnar ba'i nyes pa mthong ba'i spyan ras stong gis/ snying brtse ba'i yul du gyur —pa'i 'gro ba rnams la gzigs pa mi dman pa ste mchog tu gyur pas/ sems can gyi don du 'khor ba'i gnas su 'jug ba ni/ rme lha'i dga' tshal du 79

'jug pa bzhin yin par gzigs nas 'khor bar gnas te 'gro ba rnams skyong bar mdzad pa'i rje btsun byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs snying rje'i gter spyan rasarnagazigs sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis ston pa'i 'khor du byon pa rnams shin tu rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / lam shes kyi yan lag gi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ smras pa/ gnad bor byis pa'i rdol gtam sna tshogs dang // mtshungs min rnam dasbod bye ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /lugs ngan blo gros ngan pa mog mog bor/ /lam shes 'khor gyi 'od bzhin rab bcom ste/ /yab sras gnyis dang rje btsun 'phags seng lugs/ lham me lhan ne sa gsum gsal 'azhi ltos/ /zhes gsungs te /gzhung gi gnad don bor te/ byis pa gtam mi chos pa dag gis rdal rdol gyi gtam sna tshogs smra ba dang mtshungs pa min par/ rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros bye ba brgya phrag gi 'od zer gyis/ lugs ngan pa'i grub mtha' dang blo gros ngan pa ste shes rab zhan pa mtha' dag zil gyis mnan te/ sngon ston pa'i 'od kyis lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog bor byas pa ste/ lam shes gsung skabs kyi 'khor lha rnams kyi 'od zil gyis mnan pa bzhin du rab tu 80

bcom ste/ yab rje tsong kha ba dang sras kyi thujo gnyis dang sde btsun byams mgon dang 'phags seng gnyis kyi lugs rnams /lham me lhan nir sa 'og sa steng sa bla ste sa gsum mam yang na 'dod khams dang gzugs gzugs med khams kyi sa gsum du gsal bar byas pa 'di la ltos shig ces pa ste/ gzugs can dpe rgyan bsres pa'o/ / — nyan rang dgra bcom pa theg chen lam du gang nas 'jug dpyad pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'di la gnyis/ 'phags seng rang lugs 'di na gsal bar bstan pa dang / bshad dka' ba gsal bar bstan pa'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ smongs 'der 'gal 'du mang bris khur che yang / /megs bshad skad du brag cha ltar sgrog byed/ /'phags seng rang lugs pad ma bye ba'i chogs/ /cig char bzhad pa'i 'od stong 'di na 'char/ /zhes gsungs te/ gangs ljongos 'dir 'gal 'du can gyi gzhung mang bo bris te nang 'gal gyi khur bo che na yang / legs bshad yin skad du brag cha ltar gyi stong skad sgrog par byed kyang / sher phyin gyi don 'phags seng rang lugs pad ma bye ba'i tshogs kyi 'dab ma cig char du 'byed thub pa'i legs bshad 'od stong can gyi nyi ma 'di na 'char ro /81

zhis pa ste/ sngon gyi yig cha phal cher nang 'gal gyi phung bo can yin na yang phyogs ris kyis legs bshad yin zhes bsgrogs pa ni stong skad brag cha'i dbyangs dang mtshungs la/ 'phags seng neng lugs kyi don mtha' dag cig char gsamu ba'i legs bskod nyi ma sngo lta bu ni yig cha 'di yin no zhes pha yin la/ dpe rgyan dang rkagazugs can 'dres ma'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ phal rang bzhed galhang 'o ma bu ram gyi/ /mngar khyad ji bzhin shes kyang bshad dka' ba/ /kho bos ku sha'i rtse ltad ma 'dres shing / /gsal ba stong 'khun za 'og ri mo bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang rang rgyud pa gnyis kyi rang rang gi bzhed pa'i gzhung gi don ni/ so sor shes kyang bshad dka' ba/ dper na/ 'o ma dang bu ram gnyis kyi mngar khyad mi 'dra ba ji lta ba bzhin shes kyang bshad dka' ba bzhin bshad dka' ba yin mod/ kho bos ni ku sha'i rtse mo ltar so sor ma 'dres shing ha cang gsal ba/ rgya nag stong 'khun gyi yul nas thon pa'i gos chen za 'og gi ri mo bzhin tu gsal bar byas so/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang ba dang bo gnyis bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang / phyi ma gnyis chos dpe'o/ /tshwathong lam gyi mjug gi tshigs bcad gcig gi 'grel/82

smrasapa/ 'phags yul paja zen so so' mthong lasal/ /bzhed tshul stong 'khusagos kyi ri mo lhar/ /ma dre0khabasal sge'i gzigs mo lta 'dod na/ /gnyis ba'i skabs spyi gegs bshad me long bsten/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgya gar 'phagayopa'i yul gyi paṇa ṭi ta chen po so so'i mthong lam la bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa de dag rgya nag stong 'khun yul gyi gos chen gyi ri mo ltar ma 'dres par gsal bar dod pa'i gzigs mo yid du 'ong ba la blta 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyan skabs gnyis pa'i skabs kyi mtha' dpyod kyi legs bshad me long 'di bsten cigaces pa ste/ stong 'khun gos kyi ri mo ltar zhes pa dpe rgyan dang / legs bshad me long 'di zhes pa gzugs can gyi rgyan no/ / —skabs gnyis pa'i mtha' dpyod kyidzomajug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ rislar yang phyag 'tshal ba/ nyi tshe ba'i yon tan gyi chogasgoshes bsten mi rung ba/ mjug tu dge ba bsngo ba'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ bgrang yas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i jin gyis gzigs/ /rang rgyud byams dang snyidza rje chen pos gang —/ /skal ldan gdul byas skar tshogs bzhin bskor ba'i/ /sar gnas 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal 'dud1 /ces 83

gsungs te/ bgrang yas te grangs las 'das pa'i bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis byogs rje'i spyan gyisro gzigs nas rjes su ba zung zhing / — rang gi shes rgyudañtsams pa dang snying rje chen pos gang la/ skol ldan gyiṣ+ṭigadul byas zla ba skar tshogs kyis bskor ba bzhin du bskor ba'i sa chen po la — gnas pa'i 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal zhing lus ngeg yid gsum gyis 'dud do/ /zhes pa ste/ thugs rje spyan gyi gzugs su bkod pa dang / skar tshogs bzhin bskor zhes pa dpe rgyan te go sla'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ sa brgyad mi ldog sa la gnas der lang / —/rgyal bas mnyam bzhago baspangs nas da dung tshogs/ /rgya cher sog cug gdul bya'i don gyis zhes/ /bskul na nyi tshe'i dge bas chog 'dod mtshar/ /zhes gsungs te/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba thob pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' der yang / rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyis mnyam bzhag las bslangs nas/ da dung tshogs rgya chen por sog cig gdul bya'i don gyis shig ces bskul dgos na/ nyi tshe ba'i dge ba tsam zhig gis chog par 'dod pa ste chog shes bsten pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyal bas mnyam bzhag bslangs 84

na.oṃd dung tshogs/ /zhes pa'i skabs mnyam bzhag las bslangs nas/ zhes pa'i rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs kyi las bsdus pa yin la/ tshigs bcad kyi skabs rnam dbye bsdus pa cung mang bas/'grel tshe bsdus pa bskangs nas 'grel dgos te/ sum cu ba las/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sbyor ba rnams/ /cung zad bsdus pa yod na yang / /de ni de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mnyam bzhag las slong tshul/ rgyal ba rnams kyis 'gog las slong bar mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi skabs su gsungs pa ltar la/ 'di ni 'gog rgyan bcu gsum pa grogs kyis 'gog pa'i char gtogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal kun skyed yum zla med pa/ /'phags seng dgongs bzhin rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs/ /bshad pas mkha' mnyam ma lus 'gro ba 'azhis/ /sa bcu'i bgrod pa byur du mthar phyin shog /dus gsum du byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi rgyal ba sangs rgyas rnams skyed par byed pa'i yum 'gran zla med pa sher phyin gyi don/ 'phags seng gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin pa'i rje rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa yab sras kyi lugs de gsal bar bshad pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma lus pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis/ sa bcu'i 8 5—

bgrod pa mthar phyin te sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog cigaces bsngo ba smon lame gyis mtshams sbyar ba ste/ 'di byu ba rang batshi/na brjod pa'i rgyan gyis sbrus pa'o/ /skabs gnyis pa'i mtha' dpyod kyi mgo mjug dang bar skabs tshigs bcad kyi 'grel rang pyiblodi watshowawa tshod tsam zhig 'grel khul byas zin to// //

skunaske gaspun dazhi :ghaska sprucad rnanaska sprugad pu/ skabs gsum pa'i mchod brjod kyi 'grel/ thog mar legs sbyar skadanakyis dbyangs can ma la gaug 'tshal ba ni/ na masra/ phyag 'tshal ba/ sa rnam bcad/ na maḥswa ra/dbyangs/ rnam par bcad bya'i spo'os/ gong gi rnam bcad sar gyur te su thog tu drangs pas/ na masnya raḥ detrel ldan rkyen ba ti byin/ de'i gong du suṭa byin/ ṭa dang utshosong / sa ba thog tu drangs pas/ ma ti/ rnam par bcad bya'i sa'os/gong gi rnam bcad sa yig tu gyur te drangs pas/ na masga rasnya ti/ de la bzhi ba'i nge byin/ nga song / e lhag de la aṭa byin/ṭu song / a dang e 'dus pa i/ /ti'i srog gi i phral/ ta/i lngar gyur/ yu dang ca i thog tu drardos pas/ ju/ na mabla rasru tram̐/ dbyangs can ma laphyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes skad la bag chags 'jog phyir saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyi sgo nas/ ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag byas pa'o/ /bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo la mchod shi7

par brjod pa ni/ stobs bcu'i lhan pos mi mthun glung mnan zhing / /sku bzhi'i bang rim mchog tu 'phags pa'i rtser/ /mkhyen pa'i spyano stong 'gro la rtag gzi/gos pa/ /stogapa lha mi'i dbang bos 'gro 'di skyongs/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i stobs sogs stobs bcu'i ri rgya la lhun pos/ mi mthun phyogs sgrib gnyis sogs kyi rlung mnan zhing /ngo bo nyid sku/ ye shes chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku ste/ sku bzhi'i bang rim ches mchog tu 'phags pa'i rtser/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyan stong gis 'gro ba sems can thams cad la dus rtag tu gzigs pa ston pa lha dang mi'i dbang bos 'gro ba 'di dag skyongs shig ces pa ste/ 'di ni gzugs can gyi rgyan brgyad pa ldan pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan yin te/ ldan pa ste phan tshun 'grogs shing lhan cig tu gnas par 'os pa ri rgyal lhun po'i khyad chos dag dper bkod pa'o/ /gzhi shes kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ thabs shes zung 'brel la bsngags pa/ zhi mthar ltung ba smad pa/ byang sems las dang bo ba la'ang bsngags pa gsum mo/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ mgo la me shor lta bur rab brtson 'ibyi

spang / /thabs mkhas bral na brad zhi'i mthar rtsang na / /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i lam bzang bo/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba'i lam tshol rigs/ /zhes gsungs te/ mgo'i skra la me shor na glo bur brel tshub kyis mgo'i me gsod pa'i thabs la 'bad pa lta bur lam bslab pa gsum la brtson par mdzad kyang / thabs shes zung 'brel la mkhas pa dang bral na ste mi mkhas na/ yang na srid pa'i mthar ltung ba dang yang na zhi ba'i mthar ltung bar 'gyur bas na/ thabs gzhan don khur 'khyer gyi snying rje chen po dang / shes rab stong ba nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis zung du 'brel ba 'i lam bzang bo/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba'i dbang bo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi lamartsotshol bar rigs so/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni don rgyan so lnga'i drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan la/ dbye na nyer gsum yod pa'i gsum pa ma 'ongs pa 'gog pa'i rgyan yin te/ sngar byung zin pa thabs shes ya bral gyis srid zhi'i mthar ltung ba 'gog byed/ phyis su 'byung chog pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel mi byed pa dgag byar byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhas kyang pha ma'i grangs mtha' med pa'i 'gror/ /shes bzhin rang nyid gabyug pya'i zhi bde'i dbyings/ /la lugs ma rnams 'bor ba'i ngang tshul 'azha/ /'phags pa yin 89

rkyang mad pa 'o tshulalanye/ zhes gsungasacha te/ dman pa'i dgra bcom pa dag sde snad gsugasogs dzosbyar0pa dang bslasapha —gsum sogs la bslab pa'i mkhas pa yin kyang / pha dang marasagyur pa'i grangs mtha' med pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag sdug bsngaldogyis gzir ba shes bzhin du/ rang nyid gcig pu'i bde ba'i don du zhi bde'i dbyings la zhugasanas/ ma rgan 'gro ba rnams 'bor ba'i ngang tshul 'di/ khong rnams 'apags pa yin kyang smad pa'i tshul la nye'o/ /zhes pa ste/ theg dman dgra bcom pa gser gyi ri bo lta bu dag kyang / las nyon gyi 'ching ba bcad stabs yang srid las grol ba'i cha nas phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa yin —mod/ byang chub kyi sems dang bral ba'i ca nas smad pa'i tshulal thag nye bar gsungs te thabs khyad parocan la bsngags pa shugs bstan yin no/ /'di'i mkhas kyang zhes pa'i kyang sgra ni/ r+sha mthun pa'i tshig rgyan yin la 'di ni 'gal rgyan gyi khongs su 'du rtastizu// gsum pa ni/ rang nyid 'acung brtsas bcings kyang ma lu —'gro/ /sgrol 'dod dbugs 'byin rgyal sras dang bo dang / /sgo nga'i sbyabs rgya ma grol skad 'byin pa'i/ /ka la thang kas skye dasarngo mtshar byed/ /ces pa ste/ rang nyid hon mongs kha ma bri bas 90

lasaston gyi 'ching ba brgyas bcings kyang / pha mar gyur pa'i ma lus pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje chen po skyes te/ srid zhi'i ud pa mtha' dag las sgrol 'dod pa'i dbugs 'byin pa ste/byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i rgyal sras las dang bo ba dang / sgo nga'i sbyabasargya ma grol ba ste sgo nga'i kha ma gad par sgo nga'i nang nas skad 'byin pa'i bya ka la ming kas kyang skye dgu ngo mtshar bar byed do/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni don rgyan nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan la gnyis yod pa'i dang bo bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor yin te/ kun mkhyen snyan ngag rtsa ba las/ bstod yul khyad 'phagayoyul du ming gis sam/ /rnam grangs mtshungs pas bstod pa mtshungs sbyor bstod/ /ces gsungs so/ /skabs gsum pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'di la shis brjod dang bsngags pa gnyis/dang bo ni/ smras pa/ 'aspom gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan rtser/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'o zhabs sen ngal gso zhing / —/phun tshogs grags pa'i dri bsung phyogs su 'gengs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pas dus kun dge legs tsul/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug tor gyi nor bu'i rgyan gyi rtser/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi zhabs 91

kyi sen mo byin rlabs kyi ngad 'thul ba ngal gso zhing / phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan pa'i grags pa'i dri bsung gis phyogs thams cad 'gengs par mdzad pa rgyal (ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pas dus dang gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis shing dge zhing legs pa'i dngos po mtha' dag stsol cig ces pa ste/ 'dzam gling gi mkhas pa mang che bas rje'i zhabs la gtugs te slob mar gyur cing / dngos su slob mar ma gyur pa rnams kyang / mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyis zil gyis mnan te/ kun gyi rtse mor son pas/ zhabs sen mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du ngal gso ba yin la/ snyan grags kyis phyogs kun tu khyab pa yang / stobs dang longs spyod dang drag po'i dpung sogs kyis grags pa rgya sa pa min par/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhar+sā btsun bzang gsum/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas snyan grags rgyas pas/ phun tshogs grags pa'i dri bsnyong / zhes gsungs pa4 —yinatsho/ 'di ni cha shas gzugs can gyi sgo nas don rgyan so gsum pa shis pa brjod pa'i rgyan yin te/ kun mkhyen snyan ngag rtsa ba las/ mngon 'dod dngos po bsrung ngam bsgrub pa la/ /gegs med legs par smon pa shis brjod rgyan/ /rgyu yis don gang grub zin smon sogs mang / /mthar sogs rgyal sogs shis pa'i sgra ldan mang / /zhes gsungs 92

pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg pa gsum gyi gzhi zhes don ma lus/ /phra zhib 'phags seng dgongs don glur blangs pas/ /rnam sad bra wang bskur ba'i sgeg mo de/ /phyogs 'dir 'ongs sam skye dgu'i yid dbang 'phrog /ces gsungs te/ theg chen/ rang rgyal/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ste theg pa gsum gyi gzhi shes kyi don ma lus pa ste tshang ma phra zhing zhib pa'i sgo nas/ 'phags seng gi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin glur blangs dzis/ rnam sad de lha'i bu mo lang tsho'i nga rgyal gyi rnam 'gyur ngom bzhin pa'i sgeg mo de sa phyogs 'dir 'ongs sam/ skye dgu rnams kyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog go /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni rab btags kyi rgyan yin te/ 'di'i rkang ba bzhi ba'i phyogs 'dir 'ongs sam/zhes pa'i sam de rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra yin te/ kun mkhyen snyan ngag rtsa ba las/ snyam dang dogs dang nges dang 'dra min nam/ /bzhin dang yang sogs rab rtob/ sgra ru 'dod/ /ces gsungs pas/ yang sogs zhes pa'i sogs sgras bsdus pa'i rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra yin la/ 'di 'dra ba la rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra med na le'u dang bo'i nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun du 'gyur la/ 'di la rab rtog dang rab btags zhes yi ge 93
mi 'dra ba gnyis 'byung yang don gcig yin pas/ gnyis ka dag pa yin no/ /skabs gsum pa'i tshigs bcad kyi 'grel rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig 'grel zin to// // dzo4 —

snyaspruska buzhi spruzhi :gas t+pācadarnanas sprurga/dpu/ skabs bzhi ba'i mchod brjod kyi 'grel/ 'di labazhi/ legs sbyar gyi skad kyi sgo nas bla ma 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa/ rje tsong kha ba tshan po la mchod par brjod pa/gzhung 'di brtsams par bsngags pa brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba dang bzhi'o/ / dang bo ni/ na masra/ phyag 'tshal ba/ sa ru dag gi rnam bcad do zhes pas/ sa rnam bcad byas pas/ na maḥgu ru bla ma/ mazhu 'jam/ sgo ṣadabyangs / ha ba la u'o zhes pas/ maḥ rnam bcad mu yig tu rgyur/ na ma u/ma'i srog gi a phral/ na za a u/ a u la o'o zhes pas/a dang u 'dus pa or gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro 'es pas/ za srog med o thog tu drangs pas/ na mo gu ru maspya sto kha/ de la rnam dbye bzhi ba'i gcig tshig gi nge byin/ ngu ni 5 'gro ba'i don can yin pas phyis/e/ nge la akra'o zhes pas/ akra ā ga ma byin/ ka ni ka 95

'gro ba'i don can yin pas phyis/ e a zhes gnas pa la/ e ayu'o zhes pas e ayur gyur/ aya/ a/ dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro zhes pas/ yu a thog tu drangs pas/ na mo mazhugho dzi a yu/ ka lnga pa las rim pa las ma 'das par phral bar bya'o/ /zhes pas/ dzi'i srog gi a phral/ dzi srog med gyur pa'i ha lan+ta'i mtshan/ dzi a a yu/'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring bo'o zhes pas a dang a 'dus pa ā ring bor gyur/ ā ya/ dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro zhes pas/ dzi srog med ā thog tu drangs pas/ khri ya/ sdom pas/ na mo gu ru maspya sto ṣa la bla ma 'jam dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ brad zhi'i mig gcig thub pas nga nyid 'das rjes su/ /khrod ni byis pa'i tshul bzung sangs rgyas gnyis pa ru/ /lha klu mi sogs 'khor dbus dgon gnas lung bstan pa'i/ /lab gcig 'jam mgon rtsong kha ba khyod byi bor ba'ugs/ /zhes gsungs te/ srid pa 'jig rten dang zhi ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mig/ gcig pu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng 'di stongs gyur na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis 96

de/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes nga nyid 'das rjes su 'jam dpal la khyod ni byis pa ste skye bo rang 'ga' ba'i tshul bzung nas bstan pa mtha' dag rmang nas gsos te sangs rgyas 'jig rten du slar byon pa lta bu'i mdzad pa mdzad pas sangs rgyas gnyis par grags par lung bstan pha dang / lha dang klu dang mi la sogs pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin/ /zhes dgon gnas dang bcas pa lung bstan pa'i rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'jam mgon tsong kha ba chen po khyod bdag gi spyi bor bzhugs shig ces shis brjod kyi rgyan gyi sgo nas 'dod don zhus pa dang / lho shar thun mong min pa'i rgyan la bcu yod pa'i dgu ba mdzes pa'i yon tan la lho sha ra gnyis las/ lho ba'i 'dod pa la'ang sngon byung gi gtam rgyud brjod gzhir byas pa dang / yo na tan la bsngags pa brjod gzhir byas pa gnyis yod pa'i 'di ni dang bo yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ byams mgon bzhed yangs mkha' ngos legs bshad kyi/ /'od stong rab spro 'phags seng rang lugs ja/ /lung gi rin chen dbyug gu legs bkug pas/ /rjo 'jam bskun pa'i chu 'dzin thal bzhin snyan/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyal tshab 97

byams pa mgon po'i dgongs bzhed shin tu rgya che zhing yangs pa nam mkha'i ngos salegs bshadartsokyi 'odabyustong rab tu smo bar bye da pa 'a gas seng ṣ+karang lugs rnga bo che de/ bdag 'jam dbyangasaubazhad bas lung gi rin poce'i dbyug gu legs spur bkug pa des/ lung rigs kyi zur rno zhipa sdepa sbyor gyi 'tham lhod dang lhan pa'i sgo nas bsnun pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra de yang chu 'dzin glal ba ste 'brug sgra bzhin du ldir zhing snyan no/ /zhes pa ste/ byams mgon gyi dgongs bzhed yangs shing rgya che ba nam mkha'i gzugs su bkod/ 'phags seng gi 'grel ba'i legs bshad 'od stong gi gzugs su bkod/ de lta bu'i legs bshad kyi 'od stong spro ba'i 'phags seng gi rang lugs de rnga bo che'i gzugs su bkod/khong gis rgya bod kyi gzhung gi lung mang bo gung bsgrigs nas drangs te mtha' dpyid brtsams pa ni/ rin po che'i dbyug gu bkug pa'i gzugs su bkod/ de lta bu'i dbyug gus rno 'jam bsnun pa'i dpe des/ lung rigs kyi zurorno zhing bab 'os kyi dgag gzhag dang bcas mtha' dbyod brtsams pa bsdus/ mtha' dpyod de rjod byid snyan —zhing brjod bya zabartsocing baglings pa 'brug sgra ldir ba dang 'dra zhes dpe rgyan gyi sgo nas bstod la/ tshigs bcad 'di yang sto phyogs bai dar+bha'i lugs kyi mdzes pa'i rgyan 9byi

gyi bsngawas pa la sbyaraba'i rgyan yin no/ / byu bzhi ba ni/ gangs can mkhas dbang ñtsasos rab 'bad spyang / /ma thagaspo'aphags yul paṇa chen the tshom yul/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas stod stod legs bshad pa'i/ /gser 'azeng rnams bshad ji bzhin 'chad 'di nyon/ /zhes gsungs te/bod gangs can gyi sngon gyi mkhas pa'i dbang bo so sos rab tu 'bad nas gzhung don btsal yang / dka' ba'i gnad 'gag ma phigs pa dang / 'phags yul gyi paṇa chen dag gis kyang the tshom gyi yul du lus pa'e sher phyin gyi don rtogs dka' ba dga'ajam dbyangs bla ma ste rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgyu 'phrul tsong kha ba chen pos/ tshig 'jam zhing go bde bas lhod la dka' gnad kyi mdud pa grol tshul yang go ba bde blag tu ster nus pas lhod cing lhod par legs par bshad pa'i legs bshad gser 'phreng dang / rje'i gsung rgyal tshab rin po ches zin bris mdzad pa'i rnam bshad snying bo rgyan gyi dgongs donagyiji lta ba bzhin du 'chad par bya ba yin pas/ snod ldan rnams nyon cig ces pa ste/ 'di ni/ don rgyan bcu dgu ba gzi brjid can gyi rgyan gyi khongs su gtogs so/ / — gzhi shes kyi rnam pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 99

'grel/ 'di la bzhi/ rbub gsung thugs la bcings nas bshad pa/ brtson 'atsas bskyed par bskul ba/ sher phyin gus mchod kyi bsod nams la bsngogs pa/ ston pa'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ thub pas sto dang bar‘ta rna dang byang nas byang / /sher phyin 'bri mtshod thos bsam yid byed dge blong sogs/ /ngas dgongs gzigs bzhin rgyal kun gzigs zhing dgongs gsungs pa/ /snying la bsams nas dus 'dir phan par dka' lang bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ thub pa bcom ldan 'das kyis lho dang brar ta ni dang byang nas byang du bstan pa dar te/ sher phyin 'bri mchod dang thos bsam dang yid la byed pa'i dge slong sogs 'byeng zhing / de dag la ngas dgongs shing gzigs pa bzhin du rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs shing gzigs par gsungs te/ brgyad stong ba'i le'u bcu ba las/ shā ri'i bu yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i mdo sde 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos 'jig pa'i dus kyi tshe chos 'dul ba snying bo gsar pa thob pa na lho phyogs su 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogs nas kyang bar ta nir 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bar ta ni nas yang byang phyogs su 'byung skye/ shā klo00

ri'i bu de'i dus na gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang 'chang ba dang klog pa dang kun chub par—byed pa dang rab tu 'don pa dang ston pa dang nye bar ston pa dang lung 'bogs pa dang kha ton byed par 'gyur zhing tha na glegs bam du chud par byas nas 'chang bar 'gyur ba'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas dgongs so/ /de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen to/ /shā ri'i bu de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs so/ /shā ri'i bu de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas gzigs so/ /shā ri'i bu de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rnam par gzigs so/ /shā ri'i bus gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di lta bur zab mo 'di yang 'di ltar phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na byang gi yul dang byang gi phyogs kyi char rgyas par 'gyur lags sam/ bsdom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/shā ri'i bu de la byang gi yul rang byang gi phyogs kyi cha der gang dgashes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di mnyan nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la rnal 'byor du byed pa de dag rgyas par 'gyur ro/ dz+wa /zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bha byang gi yul dang byang gi phyogs kyi glu01

char byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' po mang zhing shin tu mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gsungs pa snying la bsams nas/ snyigs dus— 'dir phan par dka' yang bshad pa yin/ zhe sa pagyik+ṇi/ 'dir ba ltan bco.oṃrtsom pa'i rgyu gzharnga/ la phan par 'dod pa'i sum̐gs dgongs ma tshang ba lta bur gsungs nas/ rgyu tshogs tshang ba lta bu'i 'bras bu bstan bcos brtsam par gsungs pas/ khyad phar brjod pa'i rgyan du gtogs so/ / tshoganyis pa ni/ 'phags beng gnyis kas sher don dugo ring zhig /rtogs par gsungal bzhin re zhig ma rtogs rkyang / khid chad mi bgyi rtogs na tshe rabs kyi/ /raju gzhan doskokun 'grub bas brtson pha skyed/ / ces gsungs te/ 'phags seng gnyis kas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don dus yun ring zhig la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa las gzod rtogs par 'gyur gsungs pa bzhin dus thung zhig la rtogs mi thub pas/ re zhig ma rtogs kyang / yid chad de phyir bshol mi bgyi bar rgyun bsring dgos te/ rtogs na tshe rabs kyi 'phreng bar rang gzhan gnyis kas don rlabs chen po 'grub pas brtson pa skyed cig ces ba ste/ bya rbo rang bzhin brjod pa dang yon tan rang bzhin brjod 102

pa'i rgyan gyi sgo nas snod ldan rnams la bskul ma gnango ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ don 'di rtogs dang sems la gus smos/ /glegs bam bgyid༄ dang mchod bstod gos 'bul sogs/ — /nyan rang bsod nams las lhag thub dbang gis/ /'dzum bzhin 'od stong 'gyegabazhinacebaka' stsal to/ /zhes gsungs te/ sher phyin gyi don zab mo stong ba nyid 'di rtogs pa dang ma rtogs kyang sems la dad gus skyes pa la phan yon ma tha' yas pa yod pa lta ci smos/ sher phyin gyi glegs bam bgyid pa ste bzhengs pa dang /mchod 'bul dang / bstod pa dang gos 'bul ba sogs kyi phan yon ni/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal skye 'a phags thams cad kyi bsod nams las lhag par ston pa thub pa'i dbang bos zhal 'dzum zhing zhal nas 'od zer stong phrag 'gyed bzhin du bka' stsal to/ /zhes pa ste/ yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa dang bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no/ / bzhi badzini/ mthong ka ngoms pa'ad pa'i thub dbang sku/ /bsam zhing bsamabhe zhing spu ldang mami ma bral/ /dad cing dad kyang ma tshim mgon khrod gyis/ /zab mo'i dbyangs kyis dbugs dbyung dus la babs/ /zhesagasung sa te/ mthong na ngoms pa med pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo'i sku de/ yid la bsam zhing 103

bsgoms te yang dang yang du bsam zhing bsgoms pas sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang bka' drin dran nas dad pa skyes te lus kyi ba spu ldang zhing mig nas mchi ma brul te dad cing rab tu dad kyang gatshim par yid gdung bas/ mgon po khyod kyis/ gsung zab mo'i dbyangs kyis dbugs dbyung ba'i dus la babs so/ /zhes pa ste/ rkang ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i thog mar yod pa'i bar ma chod zung rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / lam shes sbyor ba'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'di la gsum/ thob pa'i yon tan la bsngags pa/ 'phags seng gi dgongs pa 'dzin par bstan pa/ lam shes rnam pa'i mtha' dpyod la bsngags pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ lang lang rgya chen lam dang bsam pa sbyangs/ /myi lci sems can khur khyer rgyal sras rnams/ /mtho mtho'i sa lam rim bgrod sangs rgyas pa/ /bsam bsam kun 'byung thob pa'i dga' ston rmad/ /ces gsungs te/lan gcig tsam ma yin par yang nas yang du rgya chen po'i lam phyin drug bsdu bzhi sogs dang bsam pa byang chub kyi sems la sbyangs nas/ khur lci ba las kyang ches lci ba'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa'i khur chen po khyer 104

pa'i4rgyal sras rnams kyis mtho ba ma dag sa bdun dang ches mtho ba dag pa sa gsum gyi sa dang lam rim par bgrod de sangs /rgyas pa'i rnam par thar ba bsam zhing / de ltar bsam pa las yon tan kun 'byung bar yid ches thob pa'i dga' ston 'di rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni/ sna rtsa bar dngos su bstan pa'i ma chod pa'i zung ldan la bco lnga yod pa'i bco lnga ba rkang ba bzhi ga'i thog mar yod pa can gyi zung ldan no/ / gnyis pa ni/ mkhas kyang brags dka' pha rol jin ba'i gnad/ /'chad mkhan mang yang ga rdon 'dab stong gi/ don gyi gnad bor mig gi lo ma'i khur/ — /mthong nas 'phags seng gnad don nor bu 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa yin kyang gzhung gi gnad don ni phigs dka' stabs/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dka' ba'i gnad 'chad mkhan mang yang / tshig dang don gnyis char legs pa'i me tog pad pa'i 'dab ma stong gi don gyi 'and de bor nas/ tshig tsam gyi lo ma'i khur bo rab t+yā rgyas pa mthong nas/ bdag ni 'phags seng gi gzhung gi gnad don gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'i gzhung rtsom pa'i bya ba la zhugs so/ /zhes pa ste/ sngar gyi gzhung mang bor dka' gnad bshad ma bub par bor ba de/ me tog pad+ma'i 105

'dab ma dang ze'u 'brulged pa'i gzugs su bkod/ tshig mang zhing rdzob pa de—pad ma'i sdong bor lo gtsam rgyas pa'i gathugs sa bkod/ 'phags seng gzhung gi gnad don nor bu'ingagazugayosu bkod de gzugs can gyi rgyan byas so/ / gsulapa ni/ so drug lam shes spyor ba'i rgyan ldan ba'i/ /lam shespolha dbangatsād kyis ma pakhri jin/ /'khral ba'i mi 'dzum rgyal sras yongs 'du la/ /theg chen lagangaldan steng nas gzigs sam snyam/ /zhes gsungs te/ sum cu so brug gi grangs tshang ba'i lam shes sbyor ba'i rgyan cha dang ldan pa'i/ lam shes lha'i dbang bo brgya byin khyod kyi lam shes kyi rnam pa'i spyan stong po/'khrulaba'i mi 'dzum pa ste 'dzum pa med par rgyal sras byang sems kyi yongs 'du sa brtol ljon pa la/ theg pa po'i sa layolag ldan te glang chen sa la rab brtan gyi steng nas gzigs sam snyam ste gapigs pa yin nam snyam mo/ /zhes pa ste/ layoshes lha'i dbang bo'i gzugs su bkod/ lam shes sbyor blo thodrug brgya byin gyi rgyan cha'i gzugs su bkaud/ lam shes kyi rnam partsoni brgya byin gyi spyan gyi gzugs su bkod/ lam shes kyi rnam pa 'chad tshul 'di la 'khrul ba med pa ni lha'i dbang bo'i mig mi 'dzum pa'i gzugs su bkod/ lam shes nyams su len pa'i rgyal 106

sras rnams yongs 'du ljon pa'i gzugs su bkod/ theg pa chen po ni glang bo che'i gzugs su bkod de/ mtha' dag gzugs can gyis spras pa dang / glang chen gyi steng nasagazigs sam snyam zhes rab btags snyam sgra can gyis brgyan pa ste/ don ni lam shes kyi rnam pa'i mtha' dpyod 'di la bsngags pa'o/ / byang phyogs so bdun bshad pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ smras pa/ theg gsum byangacab phyogs mthun 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /thos bsam 'od stong shar bas rab bzhad ba'i/ / legs bshad dri bsung sa gsum yongs khrab ba'i/ /mngon bar rtogs pa ma 'dres ri mo bkra/ /zhes gsungs te/ theg pa gsum ga'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi byang chub kyi phyogs mthun 'dablo brgya'i dga' tshal te pad ma'i tshal de nyid/ bdag gi thos bsayogyi nyi ma'i 'od zer stong phrag shar bas/ 'dab ma rab blubazhad pa'i legs bshad kyi dri bsung mngar bos sa gsum yongs sakhyab pa'i/ theg gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa ste sa lam ma 'dros par so sor gsal ba'i ri mo rnam pa bkra'o/ /zhes ba ste /byang phyogs so bdun pad ma'i tshal gyi gzugs supabakod pa dang /khong gi thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi gzugs snyobakod pa dang / mkhyen cing gzigs pas legs bshad ཿ07

brtsams te de'i mthu nus dang snyan grags kyis sa steng khyab pa ni nyi 'od shar bas 'dab ma rab tu bzhad de dri bsung gis sa gsum khyab pa'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / legs bshad 'gir theg gsum mngon rtogs ma 'dres par gsal ba ni/ pad tshal gyi ri mo rnam par bkra ba'i gzugs su bkod de ldan gzugs kyis spras pa'o rnam thar brgyad kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/'dir tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan bcos 'di'i che ba brjod pa ste/ smras pa/ ma dul tsher dang nyon mongs dri ngan bral/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i rin chen sa brtol nas/ /rmad byung grid zhi'i 'dod dgu kun ster ba'i/ /lam shes rnam sad yongs 'du'i smon shing mtshar/ /legs bshad rang rang blo mthun rin chen gyi/ /sna tshogs rgyan 'phyang khengs bral 'dud pa'i shing / /rin chen kun las grub kyang mnyen lhag can/ /'jig ten don skub thab byed bla na 'bar/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems rgyud ma dul ba'i tshig ngan gyi tsher ma dang bral ba dang / kun slong ma dag pa'i nyon mongs pa'i dri ngan dang yang bral zhing / lhag bsam dag pa'i rin chen sa brtol nas byon pa/ rmad du byung ba'i srid zhi'i 'dod dgu kun ce dgos 'dod yod do cog ster ba'i lam 108

d+ngha— shes bhernam sad de lha'i yongs 'du sa brtol gyi ljon shing 'de shin tu ngo mtshar te/ legs par bshad pa gdul bya rang rang gi blo dang mthun pa ste blo dang 'tsham pa'i rin chen gyi rgyan sna tshogs pa'i rgyan 'phyangs pa ste dpyangs nas khengs dregs dang bral ba'i dhe 'dud pa ste dud pa'i ljon shing de/ rin po che kun las grub kyang / sra mkhregs min par mnyen zhing smyug can/ 'jig rten gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don sgrub par byed pa'i sgrub byed kyi gzhung 'di bla na ste gong du 'bar ba ste mchog tu gyur to/ /zhes pa ste/ 3 yongs 'du sa brtol ljon pa ni ri rgyal gyi rtsar skyes kyang lha ma yin gyi yul brtol de lha yul du slebs pas sa brtol ljon pa zhes grags la/ 'dir dpe can bstan bcos 'di'i khyad gzhi dang khyad chos yongs rdzogs dpe yongs 'du sa brtol ljon pa'i khyad gzhi dang khyad chos kyi gzugs su bkod pas/ mtha' dag gzugs can gyi rgyan yin la/ rin chen kun las grub kyang mnyen smyug can/ /zhes pa'i don brjod bya yum gyi don mtha' dag 'dus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin kyang rjod byed kyi tshig rna bar snyan zhing mnyen la go sla bzhi don yin zhing / gzhan rnams go sla'o/ / rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 109

〉 khrospol/ 'gi la gnyis/ dga' bde rgyas par bstan pa dang /snying brtse bar bstan pa'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ 'a ga ten skye dgu'i bde skyid me tog tshal/ /rab rtu snang bar byed dang skye mched skya/ /nyi ma theg gsum mngon rtogs 'od sprospopas/ /sgrib gnyis byun bsal skye 'phags dga' bde rgyas/ /zhes gsungs te/'jig rten khams kyi skye dgu ma lus pa'i bde skyid me tog dga' tshal de nyid rab tu snang bar byed pa dang / khams dang skye mched kyi gnas lugs gsalo balnge byed pa'i nyi ma legs bshad dri ma med pa 'dis/ci theg pa gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa ma 'dres par bshad pa'i 'od spros nas/ sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa bsal ba'i dga' pa'i dga' ston chen po 'di la brten nas blo ldan skye 'phags thams cad kyi dga' bde rab tu rgyas so/ /zhes pa ste/gzhung 'di dag brtsams pa la brten nas blo ldan gyi skye 'phags kun la dga' ba rgyas pa'i don yin la/ dga' ba'i sgeg pa'i nyams ldan gyi rgyan kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems kyi phug pa chos min phyogs su bstan/ /'khor ba'i bag chags sprul gdug ma mthong bar/ //gti chug brab por gnyid pa'i drun po dag /bsam na snying rje mi skye de su 110

zhigo /ces gsungs te/ 'khor ba'i sems can 'ga' zhig gi sems kyi phug pa ste/ phug gi gtad so ni/ chos ma yin pa sdig pa'i phyogs su bstan cing / 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i bag chagasa'ide dug sbrul gdug pa can lta bu yin pa ma mthong bar/ gti mug munatshupa thib por gnyid log pa'i blun po dgangagi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la bsam blo btang na snying rje mi skye ba'i thabs med pas/ de la snying rje mi skyerdzoba'i blo ldan de su zhig yin/ zhegapa ste/ nyams brgyad kyi nang gi snying rje ba'i nyams kyis brgyan pa'o shes mtshan khyad mtshan gyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gnyis/ dus gsusaugyi rigs can gsum 'khobadud rtsi 'gyed pa'ang sher phyin 'di ṅgen par gsungs pa dang / sher phyin gyi glegs bam tsam gnas pa'ang skal ba bzang bar gsungs pa gnyis las/dang bo ni/ smras pa/ phub debang 'dzum ba'i 'od zer phyogs kun tu/ /song bas nyer bkug rgyal sras mi mjed khams / /khyab dbus 'das dang ma 'ongs gartar gyi/ /rigs can gsum la bdud rtsi 'thed pa'ang 'ane/ /zhes gsungs te/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang bos sher byin gyi mdo gsung ba'i tshe 111

na/ thog mar zhal 'dzum pa las 'od zer 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad khyab pas/ zhing /khams de dang de'i sangs rgyas kyes rang rang gi 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas shākya thub pas sher phyin gyi mdo gsung bzhin yod pas song la nyon cig ces bskul nas phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' mtha' dag sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'khor du 'dus/ de ltar 'od zer phyogs kun tu song bas/ nye bar bkug pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyis mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir khyab pa'i dbus su 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa da ltar te dus gsum gyi gdul bya rigs can gsum la nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad ma lus pa zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i bgo skal 'gyed pa'ang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'di yin no/ /zhes pa ste/ 'ang sgras zhing 'di'i gdul bya dang da ltar gyi dus kyi gdul bya ma zad ces bstan pa ste/ 'di ni lho bas 'dod pa'i don gsal lo/ / gnyis pa ni/ gsung rab lan lag bcu gnyis las gartsesru par/ /lan gnyis lan gsum gtad pas sa gsum gyi/ /rims kun zhi mthad zab mo'i a smra ta'i/ /smregs bam gzugs 'khril 1/2

'gi lha skal ba bzang / /zhes rga/sungs te/ thub pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis las kyang gces par bzung ste/ kun dga' bo sogs nyan thos rnams dang / 'jam dbyangs phyag rdor sogs byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/—lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du gtad pas/ sa cigasum gyi sdug bsngal gyi nad rims ma lus pa zhi bar mdzad pa'i gdams8 pa zam mo sher phyin gyi glegs bam gyi gzugs 'khyil ba ste gnas pa 'di ni shin tu skal ba bzang ngo / /zhes pa ste/ 'di shar bas 'dod pa'i don gsal lo/ / skabs bzhi ba'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la bzhi/ skabs bzhi ba'i mtha' dpyod 'di brgya byin dang sbyar ba/ mngon rtogs rgyan chu bo gaṅgā dang sbyar ba/ 'khor sgyu ra spyi bo skyes dang sbyar ba/ skabs bzhi ba rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang sbyar nas khong de la rol tshulacibastan pa'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ thabs shes lus rgyas theg chen sa srung steng / /rnam rdzogs spyor ba'i spyan stong rab bgrad de/ /gnyen po rtse brgya gdengs pa'i lha dbang 'di/ /glib bzhi'i lha min 'joms tshul sngon med rmad/ /ces gsungs te/ gzhung 'di'i skabs su thabs dang shes rab rgyas par bshad pas/ thabs shes kyi lus 113

rgyas shing theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs kyi glang chen sa srung gi steng du bzhon te/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa'i spyan stong rab tu bgrad de/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i mthar ltung ba'i gnyen po gzhi lam gyisgornam par bzhag pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya rab tu —gdengs pa'i lha'i dbang bo brgya byin 'dis/ ston shes dang chags thogs kyi sgrib pa bzhi'i lha min rnams 'joms pa'i tshul 'di ni sngon med pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni mtha' dag gzugs can gyi rgyan yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sku bzhi'i zhal nas mngags ba'i mngon skyogs kyis/ /rigs can sa gsum dag byed lha'i martsod yon/ /shes khyad byed mtshan sgra sgrogs mkhyen gsu4gyi/ /spyor ba' blabs phreng can 'des dra kun 'khrad/ /ces gsungs te/ sku bzhi ni tshangs pa'i zhal bzhi'i gzugs su bkod de/ mi pham mgon tshangs pa chen po'i sku bzhi'i zhal bzhi nas mngags pa'am 'ongs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan dag byed kyi chu bo 'dis rigs can gsum dang sa gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag par byed cing / de lta bu'i bstan bcos mchod yon chu bo 'gro ldan ma 'dis shes mtshan khyad mtshan gyi sgra chil chil sgrogs shing /mkhyen pa gsum gyi sbyor ba'i rlabs phreng can 'dis sdig pa dang 114

sgringapa'i dri mad+kutha'abyudag 'khrud par byed do/ /zhiyopa ste/ gzugs can no/ / gsum pa ni/ mngon mtho'i them skas la zhu gsarī thos bas khagyi/ /gos bzang mdzes klon legs bsgom snya'i nordobu'/ /sems kyi gtsug skyes mdzes pa'i rgyal sras 'des/ /chosakyi dbang phyug go sa gnon la brel/ /zhes gsungs te/ mngon mtho mi'i go 'phang thob pa'i thome skas la zhugs te/ thos bsam gyi gos bzang mdzes par gyone zhing / thos bsam gyi don legs par bsgom par bya ba lha'i nor bu lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems kyi spyi bo'i gtsug nas skyes pa'i rgyal sras spyi bo skyes 'dis dam pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal bo'i go sa gnon pa la brel ba ste/ de'i bya ba la zhugs so/ /zhes pa ste/ mngon meṅge'i rten thob pa them skas brgal ba'i gzugs su bkod/ thos bsayobyas pa gos bzang gyon pa'i gzugs su bkod/ thos bsam gyi don bsgom bya nor bu lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems gtsug rgyan gyi gzugs su bkod/ byang chub kyi sems las skyes pa'i rgyal sras de 'khor sgyur gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan las skyes pa'i 'khor 4sgyur spyi bo skyes te 'khor sgyur nga las nu'i gzugs su bkod/ de lta bu'i rgyal sras des rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba ma yin par/115

dam pa'i chos la dbang zhing phyug pa'i go sa gnon pa'i bya ba la zhugs so/ /zhes ldog pa can gyi rgyan du gtogs pa'i don rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / kha bzhi ba ni/ rgyal ba kun kyi skyam gyur rnam pa'i tshogs/ /brgya dang don gsum ri mo rab bkra ba'i/ /bzhi ba'i skabs kyi lha dbang po brang du/ /blo gros ci dgar rol ba bla na 'bar/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyal ba kun gyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa skyed pa'i yum du gyur pa brjod bya don gyi sher phyin mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa'i tshogs brgya dang don gsum gyi ri mo rab tu bkra ba'i mngon rtogs rgyan skabs bzhi ba'i skabs kyi mtha' dpyod lha'i dbang bo'i rnam rgyal pho brang du/ rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis ci dgar rol ba ste rang 'dod du longs spyod cing rol ba bla na 'bar ba ste bla na med pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/skabs bzhi ba'i tshig don mtha' dag la khong gi rnam dpyod thogs med du 'jug pa'i don yin la/ 'di ni cha shas gzugs can no/ /skabs bzhi ba'i mtha' dpyod kyi tshigs bcad rnams rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig 'grel zin to// // ri 116

skubuska lda nazhi :gaska sprucad rnanaska spruzhad pu/skabs lnga ba'i mchod brjod kyi 'grel/ 'di la gnyis/mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis so dang bo ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i me shes phung bo'i cha/ /gcig gyur li khri'i mdangs ldan gzhon nu'i sku/ /gsungs dbyangs srid zhi'i khams na khyab mdzod pa'i/ /'azam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ /zhes gsungs te/ rab 'byams te grangs las 'das pa'i rgyal ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi —thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi phung bo'i cha thams cad gcig tu gyur cing / lha sku bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba'i li khri'i mdangs ldan te/ dmar ser gyi mdangs dang ldan zhing mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gzhon nu brgyad gnyis bcu drug lon pa'i na kyi+od kyi sku can/ gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyis srid pa dang zhi ba'i khams ma lus pa na khyab par mdzad pa'i 'jam mgon te/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bla 117

ma'i sku'i dma' shos zhabs la lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag byas te/ zhes pa ste/ mchod brjod phyag bya dngos po dang / /nges par bstan pa de 4sgo/ /zheyogasungs pa ltar/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo gsum gyi nang gi phyag bya ba'i sgo yin la te zhes pa lhag ma 'dren pa'isnetshig go / gnyis pa ni/ rtse spyor skabs de legs bshad rtse mo ru/ /nor bu'i tog bzhin khrad 'phags ches gsal glu/ /gre bar bskyil kyang ma 4ba mi na kās/ /khengs 'phrog rgyal ba'i gsung gi rjes 'gro len/ /zhes gsungs te/ skabs brgyad kyi rtse sbyor gyi skabs de/ legs khushad kun gyi rtse mo ru gyur pa nor bu'i tog bzhin yin no/ /zhes pa'i glu de ṅga bar bskyil kyang ste/ mgrin 5ra bzung yang 'dzin ma thub par lha mo me na kās glu dbyangs pa kun gyi khengs pa 'phrog pa'i glu/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi rjes su 'gro ba ste de dang 'dra ba len par bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/mai na kā'i zhes 'brel sgra byas na 'brel chags pa 'asamod/ bla brang dang sku 'bum dpar ma gnyis kar byed sgra byas yod pas/ma bcosardzopar khong me na kā ste lha'i bu mo'i gzugs su bkod pa'i dbang du byas te/ gzhan gyi khengs pa 'phrog par sbyar ba dang /rjes 'gro zhes pa mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgru yin pas rgyal ba 'i /1ni

gsung dang 'dra ba'i don yin no/ /mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mjug gi tshigasabacad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gnyis/ legs bshad 'di nyi ma lta bu yin par bstan pa dang dam pa'i bka' drin dran nas slar yang phyag byas pa'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ 'phags yul 'dzam gling gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ /mkhas mchog zla ba'i ngo na ra ri can/ /thub bstan bcu gnyis bdag po'i 'od stong gis/ /brtsom pa'i mkhas grub bye ba'i 'dab ma bzhad/ /ces gsungs te/ 'phags yul gyi 'dzam gling gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan lta bu'i mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa 'ga' zhig zla ba'i gzugs su bkod de/ de 'dra'i zla ba'i ngo na'ang 'khrul ba'i ra ri'i dri ma yod pa/ zhes pa'i 'ang sgras gzhan lta ci smos/ de 'dra'i mkhas mchog la'ang 'khrul ba yod ces sdud/ de lta bu'i ra ri ste ri mo nag nog ri bong gi gzugs lta bu yod pa'i zla ba de/ thub bstan khyim bcu gnyis kyi bdag po nyi mas 'od zer stong gis bcom pa'i tshul de la mkhas pa dang grub pa thob pa'i gango zag bye treb mang bo'i dga' zhing spro ba'i pad ma'i 'dab me rab tu bzhad do/ /zhes pa ste/ bsdus pa'i gzugs can no/ / smo — shāglu9

gnyis pa ni/ khengs pa'i me khyer ngang tshul mi 'dzin spyang / /'char nub thed par shes phakyan gsal ba'i/ /nor bya'i sgron me spyan tshostong ldan pas kyang / /rnyed min dam pa'i bka' drin dran phyag byes/ /zhes gsungs te/ khengs pa'i me khyer te nga rgyal srin bu mi khyer gyi gzugs su bkod pa dang / ngang tshul mite de'i tshul mi 'dzin kyang / 'char ba dang nub pa med par shes bya thams cad shin tu gsal ba'i nor bu'i sgron me ste/ shin tu gsal ba'i nor bu'i 'od 'askebar ba'i sgron me'i gzugasu su bkod/ spyan stong ldan pa ste lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis kyang rnyed pa min pa ste sher phyin gyi don spyan stong dang ldan pas kyang ma mthong bas dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag byas pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can no/ /skabs lnga ba'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gnyis/ theg chen gyi lam spyi la bsngags pa/ bye brag skabs lnga ba'i mtha' daphyod 'di la bsngags pa'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ the sgor rnam bzhi'i rtse mo cus mtho ba'i / /rgyagoyum ji dbang rdzor bzhi'i bang rim steng / /rtsabazhi'i rnam par rgyalaba'i pho zang na/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan stong ldan pa'i sangs rgyas stong / /zhes gsungs te/ stor lam rtse sbyor/ mthong lam rtse sbyor/13khya —

sgom lam rtse sbyor/ bar chad med pa 'i rtse sbyor te/ rtse sbyor rnam pa bzhi'i rtse mo ches ma tho ba'i brjod bya don gyi rgyal ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rolatu phyin pa'i ri dbang / zhes rgyal yus ri dbadzoste ri rab lhun po'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ rtse sbyor/ mthar gyis sbyor ba/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba stertso sbyor ba rnam bzhi ri rgyal gyi bang rim gyi gzugs su bkod de/sbyor bzhi'i bang rim steng du/ sku bzhi ni lha'i dbang bo 'i rnalo rgyadze+epho brang gi gzugs su brokodi de/ skya bzhi'i rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang gi nang na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shesadetshodabardo bo brgya byin spyan stong gi gzugs su bkoganas / mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyan stong dang ldan pa'i brgya byin sangayorgyaspostong bzhugs yod do/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni gzugs can gyi rgyan yin te/ khyad gzhi la brgya byin zhes dngos su ma smosakyang / khyadaltos mtshungs pa tshang ma gzuganu/ su balko/da pas/ cha shas gzugs can yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ yum don rtse spyor so so'i rnam sad kyi/ /ngo mtshar dga' ston yon tan lo 'dab dang / /'bras bu'i ro dang madz+rad pa'o kha dog stong / /lta 'dod legs bshad me long tshal 'gir stos/ /zhes gsungs te/ yum sher phyin gyi don/121

//////// //bye/ /ji / 1/de/ /rdo/rdo //re/ ra rnam ba so so khyad par rna ma sad lha'i mtshar ba dga' ston yon tan gyi skyed mos tshal gyi lo 'dab dang / 'bras bu'i ro dang mdzad pa'i kha dog mdzes pa stong phrag yod pa la blta 'dod na/ skabs lnga ba'i mtha' daphyod kyi legs par bshad pa'i me long gi tshal 'di la ltos shig ces pa ste/ rtse sbyor so so'i khyad par dga' tshal gyi gzugs su bkod/ rtse sbyor gyi yon tan rnams skyed tshal gyi lo 'dab rgyas pa dang / 'bras bu'i ro zhim pa'i gzugs su bkod/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i byang sems kyi mdzad pa rnams skyed tshal gyi me tog la sogs pa'i kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i gzugs su bkod/ legs bshad 'di me long gi gzugs su bkod/ me long tshal gyi gzugs su bkod de gzugs can 'phar mas brgyan pa yin no/ /skabs lnga ba'i mtha' dpyod kyi tshigs bcad rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig / 'grel zin to// // ga ṇi tsho 122

snya2ska skyegha puzhi :ghaska bucad rnanaska bugid pu/skabs drug pa'i mtha' dpyod kyi dbu'i tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis so/ / dang bo dbyangs can ma la legs sbyar gyi skad kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba 'di'i byings sgrub ni/ zhwa sgra dang gdung ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la/ i man tra asuku 'os/ rkyen asuku byin/ u dang kra dbyi/ as/ yon tan no zhes pas skṛ'i srog gi ṛ aru du gyur/ drangs/ sa rnam bcad byas pas/ swaraḥgrub/de la ma dang a mtha' u ba dhā las ba tu inu dag gos/ rkyen ba tu byin/ ba tu/ na las tsha ta la saku'os/ tu'i gong du saku byin/ sa'i a dang kra phyis/ tu'i u brjod don gyis phyis pas/bsata/ bā tsa'i pa ti la sogs pa rnams la'os/ gong gi rnam bcad sa yig tu gyur te ba thog tu drangs pas/ swa ra swas t+ya/dzi ṭa u ṛtra las sos/ ābra byin/ sga rjes 'brel gyis phyis/swa raswa satre yī/ tre yī thog tu drangs/ sra ta thog tu drangs — 123

pas/ su ra su snre/ grub/ de la rnam dbye bzhi ba'i gcig tshig gi nge byin/ de la itre utro dag las sos/ aṭa byin/ṭa phyis/ nge'i dra 'gro ba'i don gyis phyis/ ame / a dang e 'dus pa ir gyur/ snri'i srog gi ā phral/ yī yur gyur/ sta dang yu rim par i thog tu drangs pas/ :wā ra zhwa ’/ grub pa/ bod skad du/ dbyangs can rma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i yum la mchod par brjod pa ni/ mkhye na pa'i mkha' la zhes bya'i rgyu skar bkra/ /leges bshad bdud rtsis skal ldan tsu dzid tshogs/ kha lus bzhade pa'o sras brna' chu gter che/ /thel mdzad rgyal ba'i yum la gus pas 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ 'bras bu sher phyin thamasacad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi nam mkha' la/ ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya'i rgyu skar ma lus dzi phra lam mer bkra ba ste chos thams cad glegs thogs med par mkhyen pa'i don dang / legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsis skal ba dang ldan pa'ikadul bya me tog ku mu da'i tshogs rma lus par bozhad dzi'i dpal yon gyis nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems sangs rgyas kyi spos bzhi'i chu gter chen po spel bar mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i yug spuzhung lam 'bras bu'i the/sa rab kyi pha rol rtu phyin ba la gus pasaji 'dud do/ /nes pa ste/ 'bras bu sher phyin rnam mkhyen gyi 124

rtsor chos thams cad cig car du 'char ba/ nam mkha' la rgyu skar bkra ba'i gzugs su bkod/ gzhung sher phyin legs pa bshad pas skal ldan rnams kyi blo gros rgyas pa ni/ nam mtshosar nas zla ba'i 'od zer spros/ te me tog ku mu da'i 'dab ma bzhad par byas pa'i gzugs su bkod/ gzhung lam 'brasadzābu'i yum gsu ma gyis sras t+pāzhi bskrun pa ni/ zla k+ka 'i 'od kyis chu gter te rgya mtsho 2phel ba'i gzugs su bkaud de/ de lta bu'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba'i yum la sgo gsum gus pas phyag byas pa ste/ 'di yung sto shas gzugs can gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ brgya dang don gsum zab skon ma lus kun/ /mabar gyis sgom byed bcu gsum rtsis zin sman/ /ma lus yams nad bel ba'i bdud rtsi dang / /'dod pa kun rtser dpag bapham ljon 'dir sprel/ /zhes gsungs te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya dang don gsum gyi zab mo yum gyi don ma lus pa kun/ sgro mthar gyis te go rim nges can du sgom par byed pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba bcu gsum gyi bdud rtsis/ jin pa'i sman 'di ni/ ma lus pa'i yams nad de dug gsum rgyu 'bras sa bon dang bcas pa'i nad ma lus pa sel bar byed pā'i bdud rtsi dang / gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod pa'i dngos ā+o kusna ster bar byed pa'i125

lha'i dpag bsam gyi ljon pa 'dir spel bar bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni gzutro/sa can bcu gsum pa rgyu'i gzugs can gyi phyogs su gtogs so/ / skabs drug pa'i mtha' dpyod kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gnyis/ 'phags seng gi dgongs pa ji bzhin rnyed mkhan ni/ rje bdag nyid chen po yin par bstan pa/ mthar gyis sbyor ba ji bzhin shes 'dod na mtha' dpyod kyi gzhung 'dir zhugs dgos par bstan pa'o/ / dang bo ni/ smras pa/ sra zhing 'gugs dka'i chum don gnam ru de/ /'phags beng dgongs pas bkugs kyang bod ma snyed/ /lab rjes 'doms su bkang ba'i rgyud kyi sgras/ /log smra'i lha min rmad 'gems sa gsum grags/ /zhes gsungs te/ zab cing phra ba'i dgongs pa rtogs dka' ba'i sra zhing 'gugs dka' ba'i yum sher phyin gyi dgongs don gnam ru ste gzhu de nyid/ 'phags seng gnyis kyis rtogs nas dgongs pa bla na med pas bkugs kyang /bod snga ma rnams kyis dgongs don ma rnyed la/ yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pas dgongs don rtogs dka' ba'i gnam ru de 'doms su bkang ba ste gzhu rgyud rab tu 'then pa'i gzhu rgyud kyi sgras gzhung don log par smra ba'i lha ma yin gyi klad pa 'gems par sne26

byed cing / de'i snyan pa'i sgra sa gsum na yongs su grags so/ /zhes pa ste/ don rgyan bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan la/ dngos ngo 'i rgyu dang dngos med kyi rgyu mtshar ba'i rgyu gsum/ dang bo dngos po'i rgyu la/ byed po'i rgyu dang / shes byed kyi rgyu gnyis/ de'i dang bo byed po'i rgyu la/ 'grub byed kyi rgyu gnyis dang / las kyi rgyu gnyis yod pa las/ 'di ni 'grub byed kyi rgyu gnyis pa/nyams byed 'grub pa'i rgyu'i rgyan du gtogs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ mthar gyis spyor ba'i mi na tā yi glu/ /snyan cing bkra bar 'dod na megs bshad kyi/ /mkho dgu'i tshig spyor 'dab ma sna tshogs can/ /rnam sad me long dga' ba'i tshal 'dir zhugs/ /zhes gsungs te/ mthar gyis sbyor ba 'chad pa'i lha mo me na kā'i glu snyan cing 'gyur khug dang ldan pa'i bkra bar 'dod na/ legs bshad kyi mkho dgu'i tshig sbyor gyi lo 'dab sna tshogs can gyi mtha' dpyod gsal la dwangs pa rnam sad de lha'i me long gi dga' ba'i tshal 'dir zhugs shig ces bskul ba yin te/ mthar gyis sbyor ba bshad cing nyams su len 'dod na/ legs bshad 'dir thos bsam gyis zhugs shig ces pa ste/ legs bshad 'di lha'i me long dang me long dga' tshal gyi gzugs su bkod pas/ gzugs can 'phar ma'i rgyan yin no ////127

skuspru ska budun skozhi snyaghas bucad rnanaska spruzhad ga skabs bdun pa'i mtha' dpyod kyi mchod brjod kyi 'grel/ 'di la legs sbyar skad kyis bla ma 'jam dbyangs la phyag byas pa/ 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa/ bla ma'i gsang gsum la—bsngags pa/ bye brag sher phyin ston pa la bsngags pa ste bzhi/ ridang bo ni/ na masra/ phyag 'tshal ba sgrub tshul gong bzhin/gu ru bla rīm/ mamyu 'jam/ r+ghaṃ ṣa dbyangs/ de la rnam dbye bzhi ba'i nge byin/ nge la akra'o/ /zhes pas/ akro byin/kra phyis/ nge'i sdo phyis/ e ayur gyur/ dzi'i a phral/ 'dra ring byas/ ṣā ā thog tu drangs/ yu a thog tu drangs pas/na mo gu ru mañtsa sto ṣa ya/ bla ma 'jam po'i dbyangs la phyaske 'tshalko lo/ /zhes spu'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ li khri'i ma zhog 'chang ud pa17zur mig g.yo/ /dbang sngon thor cog rgyu skar sbeng bas sprud/ /gdod 128

rubyul rjos skusna kun rtog lusa'ad thim/ /kun gzigs zi dbang 'asnam dbyangs bla mar 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ dmar ser li khri'i mdog 'chang ba ste mdog 'dzin zhing / me tog ud pa la'i 'dab ma lta bu'i dzur mig g.yo zhing / dbang sngon te nam mkha'i mdog ldan gyi thor cog la rgyu skar phreng ba lta bu'i rin chen rgyan gyis spud pa ste brgyan pa/ gdod ma nas rang bzhin kun nyon dang bral ba ste rang bzhin la nyon mongs ma zhugs pa'i chos sku thugs rang bzhin med pha'ilke dasnyings la/ kun rtog gi lus med de bdud thim nas med par gyur pa/ shes bya mtha' dag cig char du gzigs pa'i smra ba'i dbang bo 'jam dbyangs bla ma la gus pas 'dud do/ /zhes pa ste/ dpe rgyan tshig sdud can gyis brgyan cing / kun rtog ni lus med dga' rab dbang phyug gi gzugs su bkod/ lus med ces pa dga' rab dbang phyug gi mngon brjod yin te/ dbang phyug po dka' thub la gnas pa'i skabs su/ khos mda' lnga 'phangs nas dka' thub las nyams par byas skabs/ dbang phyug chen0po khros te/ mig gsum gyi dbus ma las me 'bar te/ kho'i lus bsregs pas/ de phyin nal lus med ces grags par rig byed kyi gtacha/ rgyud las bshad do/ / 129

gsum pa ni/ gsang gsum cher 'phags gzi byin 'bum chags pa'i/ /'byams klas 'phul gyis kun bzang mdzad 'azin gyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la ris med khyab gyur tshe/ /khyod nyid bsngags la rgyal kun gcig tu gzhol/ /zhes gsungs te/ sku'i tsagasang ba dang gsung gi gsang ba dang thugs kyi gsang ba ste gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan ches cher 'phags pa ste rab tu rgyas pa'i gzi byin 'bum phrag chags pa'i 'byams klas pa'i 'phrul gyis kun tu bzang bo'i mdzad pa mdzad la/ de 'dra'i mdzad 'phrin gyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba la phyogs ris su ma chad par khyab pa de'i tshe/ khyod nyid bsngags shing bstod pa la rgyal ba kun mgrin gcig tu gzhol bar gyur to/ /zhes pa ste/'bum chags pa'i yan gyis sku gsum gyi yon tan bstan/ 'byams klas man gyis 'phrin las kyici yon tan bstan pa ste/ yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin no/ / bzhi ba ni/ mkhyen gsum yul gyi ngo bo tshon ris bkra/ /rdzor bzhi'i bzi bos brtsas sgom ring sbyangs pas/ /sku bzhi'i 'ablun las 'bar ba'i dga' ston 'char/ /tshul de ston la mgon khyod e ma rmad/ /ces gsungs te/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi yul gyi ste mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa'i tshon gyi ri mo rnam par bkra zhing /130

sbyor ba bzhi'i bzo bos mkhyen pa gsum bsdus sgom gyis yun ring bar sbyangs pas/ sku bzhi'i 'phrin las rab tu rgyas te 'bar zhing mched pa'i dga' ba'i ston mo 'char ro/ /tshul de nyid 'chad /rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas gdul bya la ston par byed pa'i mgon po khyod nyid las lhag pa med pas e ma ho ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi ngo bo gtan la phab pa ni tshon ris bkra ba'i gzugs su bkod/ sbyor bzhi bzo ba'i gzugs su bkod/ sbyor bzhi'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom yun ring sbyangs pa ni/ bzo bo mkhas pas gser sbyangs pa'i gzugs su bkod/ de ltar sbyangs pas mthar sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob ste/ de'i 'phrin las kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad pa ni/ gser sbyangs pas 'od 'bar ba'i ngas/'a ston 'char ba'i gzugs su bkod/ tshul de ston pa'i mgon po ni/ 'di rtsom pa bo thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yig cha rtsoyopa bo kun mkhyen chenahopo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la go dgos so/ / / /(skabs bdun pa'i mtha' dpyod 'di kun mkhyen gyi gsung dngos mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs skabs 'khyar nas ma rnyed pa'i kha skong du thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis kyis mdzad par 'di'i mjug byang du gsal lo/ / )131

skubuska burgyud puzhi :gaska nacad rnanaska spruzhad pu/skabs brgyad pa'i mtha' dpyod 'khrul sel gaṅgā'i chu rgyun mi pham zhal lung gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ thog mar skad la bag chags 'jog cing legs sbyar la mkhas phywa'i ched du saṃ skṛ ta'i skad gyis bla ma dang 'jam dbyangs la phyag 'tshal nas dngos klub zhus thā ni/ na mo/ phyag 'tshal ba/ gur we/ bla ma la/ nā tha/ mgon po/ mamyu/ 'jam// sgo ṣa ya/ dbyangs la/ tsa /dang don/ bhā/ blo gros/ tit+ta/ gnas pa/ su/ rang ngam rgyud/ ma ma/ bdag sarba/ thams cad/ satāñtsa/ sems can/ tsa/ dang don / sdoms te/ na mo gu ra we ā thā mchu sto tsho ya tsa sgyu tiṣ+ṭha su ma ma saza satārgya/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phywa5ga'atshal lo bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la blo gro.oṃganasapar mdzod/ ces pa'o/ /de nas bstan pa'i bdag po sra sa dang bcas pa la mchod par brjod pa/ 1 byams 'jam dbyangs sogs lhag pa'i lha la 13lha

mchod par brjod pa/ 1 dbyangs can ma la mchod phar brjod pa/ tī rje tsong kha ba/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po gsum sras dang bcas pa la mchod phar brjod pa/ 4bshes gnyen spyi la mchod par brjod pa/ 5 —rtsospa pa'i kun slong bstan pa'i sgo nas rtsom par dam bca' ba/ ca rtsom pa'i dgos pa bstan pa'i sgo nas 'jam dpal dbyangs la dngos grub zhus pa ste bdun las/dang bo ni/ chos dbyings mkha' la sku bzhi'i tshad med zin/ /chosawāphrin blabs rigro po' rgyu 'tshamos par /chos sgo 'brams zas radzo skadazhan skal por/ /chos 'khor rimabaskor rgyal dang sko sdos mchod4/ /ches gsungs ti/ ma nyam rjes ngo bo gcig tu song nas myosakyi dbyings la rtag tu mnyam ji bar bzhagalkopa'i nam mkha' la/ cirang don gyi sku ngo bo nyid sku dang ye shes chos sku/ gzhan don gyi sku longs sku dang sprul sku ste sku bzhi'i yon tan tshad med pa'i sprirna'akhrigs shing / mdzad pa'i gtso bo līchosaston pha'i 'phrin 'kho rlabs po che'i char nagro ba 'i shes rgyud dang 'tshams dzir phargak+toni/ chos kyi sgo mocabargyad gyibozhi stong rab 'byams mitha' glas pa/ gdul bya rang rang gi skad la zhen pa dag gis rang rar gi skal dzo'i skaska kyi ngor go ba'i 133

chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum sogs bskor te snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i gdul bya 'dul ba'i rgyal ba thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang de'i sras nye sras brgyad sogs byang chubu sems dpa' rnams dang / mchog zung gnyis sogs nyan thos chen po rnams la mchod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ nam mkha' dang sprin sogs kyi gzugs su bkod pas/ gzugs can gyi rgyan yin la/ bye brag gong du lan du mar smras pa dag gis shes par 'gyur ro gnyis pa ni/ mchod par 'os mchog rgyal tshab byams 'jam dbyangs/ /dbyangs bdag 'jam dkar la sogs lhag pa'i lha/ /lha sogs skye dgu'i re skong rin po che/ /che ba'i mchog brnyes brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/thub pa'i gsung gi gsang ba zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa sogs bka' drin zla med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis phyag 'tshal zhing mchod par 'os pa'i mchog rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / dbyangs bdag ste rgyal ba kun gyi gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi bdag po 'phags mchog 'jam dbyangs dkar bo sogs lhag pa'i lha mchog lha sogs te sogs sgras bsdus pa'i mi sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus dze 134

pa'i skye dgu'i re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i rin po che/ ches che ba'i mchog sku bzhi'i go 'phang brnyes pa brgyud par bcas pa rnams la 'dud do/ /zhes pa ste/ gtso bo yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no/ / gsum pa ni/ thugs rje'i phyag zung la gnas 'phang 'gro'i rgyud/ /dkrol dran snying la 'khor lo bkod tsam gyis/ /mongs thabs kun grol dbyangs can la 'dud kye/ /bla bral 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgo brgya gyes/ /zhes gsungs te/ thugs snying rje chenaci po'i dbang gis 'gro ba rnams sgrol ba'i slad du thugs bde ba chen po'i ye shes lha sku bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba ni sku yin pas/ thugs rje'iskyi phyag zung zhes gsungs/ sgra dbyangs lha mo'i phyag zung la gnas pa ste/ phyag gis bsnams pa'i 'phang 'gro ste pi wang gi rgyud dkrol ba dran zhing snying la sngags 'khor bkod de sgom bzlas byas pa tsam gyis/ snying rmongs pa'i sbubs su chud pa kun grol nas shes rab kyi 'dab ma bzhad par mdzad pa'i lha mchog dbyangs can ma la 'dud do kye/ zhes 'bod tshig gis thugs rgyud bskul te/ 'gran zla dang bral ba'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab kyi sgo mo brgya phrag phyes shig ces pa ste/ gzi brjid kyi rgyan du gutogs la/ shis brjod kyi rgyan yang yin no/ /135

bzhi ba ni/ khams gsum yongasakyi rnam 'dren tsho nga kha ba/ /snang mtha'i rnam 'phrul blo bzang chos rgyaspo dang / /dus gsum rgyal ba'o dbang bo bad dkara'adzin/ /rnam gsum mab bras brgyud par bcas phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dod khams gzugs khams gzugaru'i mad khams yongs kyi 'gro ba rnams thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang du 'dren par mdzad pa'i rnam 'dren rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen po dang / bde lngan zhing gi mgon po sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas mi'i rnam par 'phrul ba paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag na pad dkar 'dzin pa rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dang rnam pa gsum yab sra sa brgyud par bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i sgo nas phyag byas pa'o/ /lnga ba ni/ blo gros lang tsho dar ba'i sa sru nga steng / /'cha da rtsod rtsodzapa'i rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis/ /'khyul ldan ri bo 'khrams pa' zags brtsom ste/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can mgon madz+rad rnams la 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros ni lang tsho rab tu dar ba'i glang chen sa la rab brtan gyi gzugs subakod de/ de'i steng du bzhon nas/ 'chad rtsod 136

rtsom pa'i mdzad bzang ni/ brgya byin gyis zho 'azung rus pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya ba gdengs pa'i gzugs su bkod de/ 'khrul ba dang ldan pa'i log bshad rnams ri bo bag med du rgyu zhing 'khyams pa'i gzugs su bkod nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsojim pa'i rdo rje gdengs tsam gyis de dag bcom ste/ rgya mtsho'i gos can te sa gzhi chen po yongasaṅkakyi mgon skyabs mdzad pa'i mkhas dbang rnams la 'dud/ ces pa ste/ rig byed kyi gtam rgyud༄ sngon ri bo rnams sa gzhi'i steng du rgyu zhing 'khyams pa las srog chags mang bo gcir ba sogs gnod tshabs che bas/ brgya gyin gyis rdo rje 'phangs nas ri bo rnams kyi rkang ba bcag pha nas bzung 'gro ma thub par gyur to zer ba'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar — ro/ /'di ni gzugs can dang 'brel ba'i dpa' ba'i nyams ldan gyi rgyan yin no/ /drug pa ni/ gsang las che gsang sku bzhi'i gsang ba'i gnad/ /ma rtogs rab rib mukharī chol mthong 'azor/ /phan ched grags 'dod dbyug gus batshon min zhing / /lhag bsam rnam sad ja bo che 'gi grags/ //zhes rīgasungs te/ so sneskye bos spyod yul las 'das pa'i gsang ba las kyang theg dman 'phags pa dag gis kyang rtogs mi nus pu'i ches gsang ba'i rgyal ba'i sku snyebyi7
