bzhi'i rnam bzhag gi dka' ba'i gnad rnams ma rtogs par/ mig rab rib kyis bsgribs pa'i long ba dag gis mkhar ba ste dbyug pas lam 'tshol ba ltar gzhung don 'tshol bar mthong nas 'gro ba dag la pan pa'i ched du 'di rtsom pa yin gyi/ rang nyid grags 'dod kyi dbyug gus rnga bo che la bsnun pa min zhing / lhag bsam dag pa'i dbang gis rnam sad de lha'i rnga bo che 'di grags so/ /zhes pa ste/ rang nyid grags 'dod kyis gzhung 'di rtsom pa ma yin pa de/ dbyug gus rnga bo che la bsnun pa ma yin pa'i gzugs su bkod/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis gzhung 'di dag brtsams dang rtsom par 'gyur ba ni/ lha'i bsod nams kyi dbang gis lha'i rnga bo che rang grags byung ba'i gzugs su bkod pa ste rtsom par dam bcas pa'o/ /bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ rang laspodaman la phan dang mnyam blo 'phel//mtho la'ang dogs slong ched skabs brgyad pa yi/ /dka' sar nyes bshad thing 'khyogs gcod pa'i slad/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab ral gri gdengs bzhin bathags/ /zhes gsungs te/bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i dgos pa bzhi gsungs pa ste/ rang las blo dman pa dag la phan pa'i ched dang / rang dang blo gros 138

mnyam pa dag gi blo gros 'phel ched dang / rang las blo kha mtho ba dag la'ang dogs slong gi ched dang / skabs brgyad pa'i dka' sar nyes bshad byas pa'i shing 'khyogs gcod pa'i slad du mtha' dpyod 'di rtsom pa yin pas/ lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs khyed kyis mkhyen rab kyi ral gri gdengs bzhin du cibadag gi snying gar bzhugs shig ces pa ste/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa khong rang nyid kyi gsung las/ spyi bor bla ma snying gar 'jam dbyangs dang / ljags la dbyangs can bkod de/zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di dag rtsom pa'i skabs su'ang / de ltar mdzad par bstan pa'o/ /'di bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang 'grel ba'i shis brjod kyi rgyan yin no/ / chos sku'i rnam bzhag gi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ rgyu mtshan gzigs nas legs bshad brtsams pa/ ma rtogs byis pa'i spyod pa bzhad gad kyi rgyur bstan pa/ legs bshad 'di'i yon tan la bsngags pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ 'dir smras pa/ sku bzhi'i ri mo ches bkra'i stong gsum dar/ /nyes bshad zukha gyi nang du mi mngon pa/ /rnam daphyod me zhal mig gis legs rtogs nas/ /legs bshed rgyal mtshan chen po lhab lhab g.yo/ /zhes gsungs te/ sku bzhi'i139

ji mo ches bkra ba ste/ sku bzhi'i rnam— —bzhag ches shin tu gsal ba'i bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan— 'grel ba dang bcas pa /stong gsum gyi stong ri+o po'i 'jig rten gyi —khams su dar na yang /blun po'i nyes bshad khri rdul gyi nang du cucib ste mi mngon par —gyas pa/ khong gi rnam par nedasnyod gyipa'i blo grosalge zhal te dbangu phyug men po'i mig gis legs par rtogs nas/ bstan mi rin po che mi nuthā pa'i legs bshad kyi rgyal mtshan chen po btsugs te lhag dang don gyi sham bu lhab lhub tu g.yo bar byed do/ /zhes pa ste—/'di ni ma bsdus shing bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang shar ba'i don gsal kyang yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ bka'o dang dgongs 'aspel las 'odzās sku —bzhi'i mtsho/ /ma mthong blos byas khron pa'i chu tsam gyis/ /lab sras rnam dbyod rgya mtsho gzhal 'dod pa/ /kye ma byis pa'i kurma bzhad gad rgyu/ /zhes gsungs te/ bka' yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang dgongs 'grel mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'athrel las 'ongs pa'i sku bzhi'i rnam bzhag ston pa'i gzhung gi brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rgya mtsho chen po ma mthong bar rang gis blo bzo byas pa'i khron pa'i chu tsam gyis/ rje yab sras kyi rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi rgyu mtsho chen po gzhal bar 'dod 140

po ste 'et+pan pa ra 'dod pa dag ni/ kye ma ho byis pa'i rol rtsid yin pas bzhad gad de gad mo shor ba'i rgyu kho na'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni khron pa'i rus sbal gyis rgya mtsho chen po ma mthong bar rang nyisko dz+wages pa'i khron pa'i chu tsam la rgya mtshor zhen pa'i gtam rgyud de/nga sbyar te/ gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi sgo nas rje yab srosacikyi legs bshad la 'gran par 'dod pa dag la zur za gnong ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bsam bzhin dpyad na 'phags yul rgyan drug kyang / /bang gis rgol ba'i za rlabs brngod dka' ba'i/ / gangs ljongs nor 'dzin sto ngal yon tan lcid/ /kyan mkhyen— tshad ma'i srang gis 'degs sam snyam/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzu bor gnas pa'i blo gros kyis legs par bsam bzhin du dpyad rtso na/ lung rigs kyi rgyab 'thug la dgag sgrub kyi zil rno bas 'a phags yul gyi paṇa chen rgyan druspu gis kyang / gang gis te legasacibashad 'di'i skabs smra ngan la rgolo ba'i rba rlabs bzod dziro dka' tha'i gaspus can bod kyi lkongs kyi nor 'dzin te sa gzhi'i lto bas mi theg par ngal par9 byed pa'i yon tan 'akau'i lcid tshad ni/ gzherna gyisagazhal b.re mi nus pas kun mkhyen ye shes kyi tshad ma'i srang gis 'degs sal snyam/ zhes pa ste/ rgyan 141

drug dag kyang ha las shing zil bzod par dka' ba'i yon tan 'di ljid che bas gangs ljongs sa gzhis kyang mi theg par ngal bar byed pa 'di'i ljid tshad rnam mkhyen gyi srang gis gzhal snyam/ zhes rab rtog snyam sgra can gyis brgyan te/ nyams brgyad kyi nang gi dga' ba sgeg pa'i nyams kyang yin no/ /lus rnam bzhag la rtsod tshul gyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ blun pos legs bshad kyi gzi mi bzod par bstan pa/ log smra bcom pas thub bstan rgyas par bstan pa/ rgyan drug slar byon pa lta bu dag la blo ldan mi gus pa med par bstan pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ smras pa/ legs bshad rin chen gser gyi 'phreng ba bzhin/ /rnam bkra mdzad pas mkhas rnams ya mtshan kyang / /mongs pas ma lcibs bcu gnyis bdag po'i gzi/ /mthong ba'i bya rog dgra bzhin mi brngod byed/ /ces gsungs te/mtha' dpyod 'di'i skabs su rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i rgyan gyi rgyas 'grel legs bshad rin po che gser gyi 'phreng ba ji lta ba bzhin te/ de'i dgongs don gzhir bzhag nas brtsams te/tshig don gang cha nas gsal zhing go bde la ma 'dres par zhib cha dang ldan pa'i rnam par bkra bar mdzad pas/ mkhas pa rnams —142

kyi legs bshad ya mtshan pa 'di lta bu mdzad do/ /zhes ya mtshan par gyur kyang / tshig don la rmongs pa tshos blo mig ma lcibs pa ste mig lcibs kyis sgrib ma thub par/ bcu gnyis bdag po ste nyi ma'i gzi 'od mthong ba'i bya rog dgra ste 'ug pa bzhin du rab tu mi bzod par byed do/ /zhes pa ste/ bya rog dgra bzhin mi bzod byed ces dpe rgyan gyi chos dpe'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dzam gling rgyan galung ma mthong thal brtsas tsam/ /zis pas phar phyinashes chom me 'khyer 'od/ /sku bzhir dpyad pa'i nyin byed kyis brtsom dang / /lhan cig thub bstan pad tshal mgo spyog rgyas/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'phags yul paṇa chen 'dzam gling mdzes byed kyi rgyan drug sogs kyi gzhung ma mthong bar/ thal 'gyur 'ga' zhig bkod pa'i gzhung bsdus pa re bris pas phar phyin gyi don shes so snyam pa'i mkhas rlom srin bu me 'khyer gyi 'od de/ sku bzhir dpyad pa'i mtha' dpyod nyin mor byed pa 'di'i 'od kyis bcom pa dang lhan cig tu thub pa'i bstan pa'i pad mo'i dga' tshal rabangatu rgyas te 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i pad ma dkar bo'i mgo lcog rab tu rgyas shing ldem mo/ /zhes pa ste/ don rgyan so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / —143

gsum pa ni/ b.la'asku na lha baghosathuchasathākud glegs ral dag /bsnams pa minad+kung zhe stod 'byams zlas galud / ci /'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyan drug smar byon lter/ /gsal marngod mkhas pa rnams lko mi gus su/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi pha ma byams mgon ltar dga' ldan gyi lha brgya ste lha ches mang bos btud pa ma yin la/ rje btsun 'jamu dbyangs ltar glegs bam dang ral gri bsnams pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang sde snod 'byams glas pa ste mtha' yas pa'i gzhung la 'chad pa dang rtsod pa rtsom pa'i bya ba la zhugs nas 'dzam gling —mdzesnya pa'i rgyan drug slar byon pa ltar rgyal bstan gsal bar mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo rnams la blo gros dang ldan pa su zhig mi gus/ zhes pā ste/'di ni don rgyan nyer lnga ba khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gnyis pa yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ /sde tshan drug pa zil gnon gyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ smras pa/ mkhas gyub bye ba'i bzhed galung 'o ma'i mtsho/ /mab sras rnachasabashad nor lhas bsrubs phaltas/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi gye btsā ba'i zla/ /thub bstan dbang phyonas sa 'dzin rtse nas shar/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang bo dag dang grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba bye ba ste 144

shin4 tso mdz+wa bos bzhed pa'i gzhung 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po de/ rdziyapa sus kyi legs bshad nor gyiholhas bsrupas pa 'dzib/ legs bshad kyi bdud rtsi bye ba sgro ba'i zla ba 'di/ thub pa'i bstan r+ha dbang phyogs te shar gyi sa 'dzin te shar phyogs ri bo'i rtse nas shar ro/ /zhes pa ste/ gtam rgyud las/ sngon lha dalda lha ma yin dag gis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ ba dud rtsi dang nyi zla la sogs pa byung bar bshad pa'i gtadza rgyud dang sbyar te/ mkha.oṃgrub bye ba'i bzhed gzhung rgya mtsho'i gzugs subakod/ rje yab sras kyi yig cha nor lha'i gzugs su bkod/ khongo gis yab srasangakyi yig cha'i steng nas mkhas grub mang bo'i gzhung la dbyad—pa mtha' chod pa byayokhu rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i gozugasartsosu bkod/—mtha' dpyod 'dis legar+sā par bshad pa ni zla bas bdud rtsi spro ba'i gzugs su bkod/ thub pa'i ba stan pa ni shar ri'i gzugs su bkod/ mtha 'a dpyod 'di brtsams pa ni shar ri'i rtse nas zla ba shar ba'i gzugs sutshubakod de mtha' dag gzugs can gyis brgyan pa'o/ / longs sku'i rnam bzhag mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ dang bo longs sku'i ngo mtshar la bsngags pa ni/ 'dir dz+ras pa/ ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i bkod par lngas pa lnga/ /rtag minatag 145

par rol pa'i longs spyod rdzogs/ /mthong ba min rkyang gsang gsum mdzad pa'i gar/ /sems ngor bris pa ngo mtshar ci lang skyes/ /zhe sa gsungs te/ sangs rgyas mi mdzad pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i bkod par nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de/ mtshan dpe'i longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzugs sku yin pas rtag pa min yang / dus 'khor ba ma stong bar du mya ngan las 'da' tshul mi ston par rtag par rol pa ste rtag tu bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum gyi bla na med pa'i mdzad pa'i zlos gar de nyid/ sems ngor ri mor gsal bar bris pa la ngo mtshar zhing dad pa'i yon tan ci yang skyes so/ /zhes pa ste/ rtag min rtag par rol pa'i zhes pa'i bar du kyang sgra bsdus yod pa de ni mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang /mthong ba min kyang zhes pa'i kyang sgra ni gong mas 'og ma sdud pa'i sdud pa yin la/ 'di ni don rgyan bcu bdun pa dga' ba brjod pa'i rgyan gyi gzugs brnyan gyi dga' ba'i rgyan gyi khongs su gtogs so/ / rme gnyis pa sku bzhi thob phyir sa lam bgrod pa la bsngags pa ni/phun tshogs 'byung gnas sku bzhi'i gzhal mas sgor/ /tshogs gnyis them skas bcu gcig sa'i rim par/ /rgyal sras 'khor bcas 146

phar phroṃn bcus bgrod par/ /yab mes rgyal rnams dgyes bsu'i zlos gar rmad/ /ces gsungs te/ rang dang gzhan gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas sku bzhi'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i sgor zhugs pa'i phyir/ bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kyi rin po che'i them skas la sa dang bo nas sa bcu tha ma'i bar gyi sa bcu gcig gi skas kyi rim pa bcu gcig la sa chen po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgyal sras 'khor dang bcas pa phar phyin bcu'i gom 'gros kyis bgrod par yab mes rgyal ba ste sngar sangs rgyas zin pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyis thugs rab tu dgyes pa'i sgo nas bsu bar byed pa'i zlos gar 'di ltad mo rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ ldan pa'i gzugs can no/ / gsum pa yon tan kun 'dus kyi ngo bo la slar yang phyag 'tshal ba ni/ zhing gis ring yang thugs rjes shin tu nye/ /mthong bar dka' lang nam lang 'char ba'i sku/ /dbyangs gcig yin kyang drug cu'i yan lag can/ /brtsas min dpal cig kun 'dus der phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ longs sku'i zhing gzugs khams gnas rigs bco brgyad pa gnasagyi'og min stug po'i bkod pa ni thag shin tu ring stabs zhing gis thag ring yang /147

thugs rje la nye ring med pas thugs rjes shin tu thag nyi la/ chu bur mig gis shin tu mthong bar dka' na yang sgom rgyung ting ji —'dzin gyiwar dus nam yin yang 'char ba'i sku dang ldan pa/gsung gcig nyid du gsung na yang / /rdu ma nyid du so sor go /zhes gsungs9po ltar/ gosu nga ngo bo gcig yin kyang /khyad par gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu can te/ de lta bu'i sku gsung thug sa kyi yon tan 'di ni/ srid pa dang zhi pa'i khames kyi mdzes pa mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu ched du gnyer conas bsdus pa min yang / srid zhi'i khams kyi dpal phun sum tshogs partsathams cad dang mdzesasdug kun 'dus pa'i rgyal ba de la slar yang spyag 'tshal/ zhes pa' ma yang na dus nam kun tu phyag 'tshal lo /zhes pa'i don yin la/ rkang ba dang bo gnyis kyi yang gnyis dang /gsum pa'i kyang rnams ni mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan yin la/ rkang ba bzhi ba ni rgyu'i khya da par brjod pa'i rgyan yin/ des na/mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / bzhi ba ma rgan sems can dang bcas pa sangs rgyagasutsho'agyur bar smon pa ni/ la lar ma yin gsang gsum kun rtu khrab/ /dus 'ga' tsam min rtag par rgyun mi 'cham /nyi tshe ba min 148

spangs rtogs pha mthar phyin/ /khrod bzhin byur cig bdag cag ma rnams bcas/ /zhes gsungs te/ ye shes ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /sku yirtswakyang ni de snyed khyab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ yul la lar khyab la la lar ma khyab pa ma yin par/gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan gyi shes bya thams cad la khyab pa dang / thub pa'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces gsungar+sā pa ltar/ dus 'ga' zhig la yod pa tsam min par 'phrin lartswa dus rtag par rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / spangs rtogs kyi yon tan nyi tshe ba ste phyogs re ba ma yin par/ spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan pha rol gyi mthar phyin pa'i bcom ldan 'das khyed bzhin du bdag cag sems can rnams dang bcas pa gyur cig ces pa ste/ 'di ni/ shar phyogs kau ḍa ba'i sbyar ba/ ma yig bskor ba'i rjes khrid do/ / mjug tu shis pa brjod pa ni/ thub bstan rin chen them skas thos bsam dang / /sgom pa'i gom stabs rnam dablod shel mig tu/ /zhal 'dzum gshegs shul mthong ba lkobakod par/ /ma 'dres mtsho' bshes khyed kyi phyag des skyongs/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsod nams min pa dang bor bzlog ces sogs ltar/bub pa'i bstan pa rin po che skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i 149

(them skas la/ thos bsam— sgom gsum gyi gom stabs kyis bgrod de/ gnas lugs bden pa'i don la rnam par dpyod pa'i bden mthong shel gyi mig gi lam du thub pa rang nyid kyi zhal 'dzum bzhin du gshegs pa'i shul 'phags lam bden pa mthong ba'i lam du gdul bya grangs las 'darme pa bkod pa'i ma 'dres pa'i mdza' bshes chen po/ khyed kyi 'phrin las kyi phyag des skyongs shig ces pa ste cha shas gzugs can no/ /mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'a/grel/ dang bo ston pa la phyag 'tshal ba ske/ 'dir smras pa/ mthong na mi mthun med cing nam lang blta bas chog mi shes pa thub dbang mtshan dbe'i sku/ /gang de'i mgur las drug cu'i dbyajes kyi yan lag kun khrab dus gsum dge ba'i lam ston gsung / /chos kun bkra bar gzigs kyang spangs rtogs ro gcig dbyings las mi bzhorngos ting 'dzin 'bum 'argyad thugs/ /lung rtogs rgya mtsho'o mnga' bdag 'khor dang chabs gcig rgyal yum ston madz+rad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ gedul bya su dang sus bltas na mi mdzes pa dang mi 'grig pa sogs medacipar mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar snang bas mthong na mi mthun pa med pa dang blta bas chog mi shes par yang dang yang du blta 'dod pa'i thub pa'i dbang bo'i 1bya0

mtshon dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i sku gang de'i mgur te gong du smos zin pa'i thub pa'i dbang bo'i mgur las byung ba'i grangs drug cu tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag shes bya kun la khyab cing 'das ma 'ongs da lta ste dus gsum du dged+ku'i lam ston par byed pa'i gsung / 'khor 'das kyi chos kun kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma 'dres par cig car du so sor bkra bar gzigs kyang / spang bya sgrib gnyis dang gnyen po rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams bden med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i chos kyi dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes las dus gtan du mi bzhengs pa'i mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig tu song ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'bum phrag 'gyed pa'i thugs te de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa/ sde snod gsum gyi lung dang bslab pa gsum gyi rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs nyan thos chen po dag dang chabs gcig tu/ rgyal ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston par mdzad pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no/ —/gnyis pa rgyan rtsa 'grel la spyod rgyu byung ba bsod nams che bar bstan pa ni/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab de sras thogs med sogs/ /15‘

'phags mtshog bye treba'i galung lam phar rgyun gzhung / /pha rol phyin ltar blophuyis deng spyod pa/ /sngon bsags mi dmarke' lam min nam ci/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po dang de'i sras 'phags pa thogs med sogs 'phags pa mchog bye ba ste mang bo'i gsung gi gzhung spyi dang bye brag phar phyin gyi gzhung la thos bsam sgom gsum byed tshul pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo las ji ltar gsungs pa ltar du rang gi blo gros kyis deng — 'dir longs spyod rgyu byung ba 'di ni/ sngon bsagasardzikyi bsod nams mi dman pa'i 'bras bu mi dman pa ste a re rmi lam min nam ci/ zhes pa ste/ 'di ni nyams brgyad kyi bdun pa rmad byung gi nyams kyis spras pa'o/ /gsum pa legs bshad la dad 'dun rgyas par bstan pa ni/rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyal ba gnyis pa bzhin/ /lde snod sku 'bras theg kun nyi ma ltar/ /gsal madz+rad legs bshad za phab me long la/ /'phags bod lugs brgya gsal ba'i dad 'dun rgyas/ /zhes gsung/sa te/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa spel ba la/ rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa bzhin du/ 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa ste/ sde snod gsum dang / rgyu pharaphyin theg pa dang 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa ste theg pa kun nyi mas 'jis/ rten gsal 152

bachiltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i ligs bshad kyi pra phab mi long la 'a phags bod kyi mkhas pa so so'i rang rang gi lugs brgya ste ches mang bo gsal ba mthong ba'i dbang gis dad pa dang 'dun pa rab tu rgyas so/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu'i rgyan no/ / bzhi ba 'di brtsams pa'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba ni/ lhag bsam dag pas rab bathan 'der bsags kyi/ /dge ba dpag las gang bsags lus can gyis/ /dus gsum pha rol phyin pa la rdzod cing / /thub dbang go 'phang 'thob pa'i ched du bsngo/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhan don khur du 'khyer ba'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas/ bstan bcos 'di rab tu bskrun pa'i skabs 'dir gang bsags kyi dge ba 'dis mtshon/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba dpag yas te dpag par dka' zhing mtha' yas pa'i dge ba gang bsags kyi mthu las lus can te 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la longs su spyod cing / thub pa'i dbang bo sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i ched du bsngo bar bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di rgyu'i rgyan gyi nang gi 'thob bya'i rgyu'i rgyan no/ / 153

lnga ba khong nyid kyang 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dponadu 'gyur bar smon pa ni/ bdag kyang rigs gsum margon dang kun ba nga bzhirke/ 1dpag mas rgyal sras spyod 'i rdzing stobs grus/ /mkha' khrab ma rnams 'khor mtsho las bsgral te/ /sku bzhi'i gling bgrod ded dpon gyur cig gu /zhes gsungs te/ bdag kyang ste mtha' dpyod 'di rtsom pa bo khong nyid rgyal ba rigs gsum mgon po dang kun tu bzang bo sogs kyis spyod pa rlabs po che la ji ltar bslabs pa de bzhin du dpag par dka' zhing mtha' yas pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i snying stobs kyi grus/ nam mkha' khyab pa'i ma rgan 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ sku bzhi'i gling du bgrod pa'i ded dpon du gyur cig gu/ zhes pa ste/ gu zhes pa smon pa'i tshig phrad yin la/ snying stobs gru dang / 'khor ba rgya mtsho dang / sku bzhi gling gi gzugs su bkod pas gzugs can gyi rgyan no/ /drug pa legs bshad 'di yun ring gnas par smon pa ni/ mchog gsum mthu dang chos dbyings 'gyur med gzhis/ /rten 'byung bslu med lhag bsam lhan byug mthus/ /gaṅgās sa ceng ca rtso sgrog de grid/ /legs bshad 'dis kyang gsar bshad sgrogs byur cig /ces gsungs te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin 154

mthu dang / chos rnams kyi chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i gshis lugs kyi rten 'byung 'gyur ba med cing bslu ba med pa dang / lhag bsam rnam par dag pa lhan cig pa'i mthu la brten nas/ chu bo gaṅgās sa steng 'dir ca co'i sgra sgrog bzhin du bzhur ba'i rgyun ma chad pa de srid du/ mtha' dpyod kyi legs bshad 'dis kyang gsar bshad kyi legs bshad kyi sgra sgrogs par gyur cig ces pa ste/ 'di yang skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu'i rgyan yin no/ /zhes skabs brgyad pa'i mtha' dpyod 'khrul sel gaṅgā'i chu rgyun mi pham zhal lung gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig bris zin to/ / rī / / 155

2na py-in sku2ska busnyed puzhi nagizha dpy-id 2san zhasgelu gid —buzhin rnan duzhi zhasded nane+eska skalu 2zwad ne+eg zhasnyed nyu ne+egaska bucad rnanaska sprugid pu/ phar phyin skabs brgyad pa'i mtha' dpyod bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng mdzes skal bzang mig 'byed kyi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis so/ /dang bo ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ /mkhas dbang bye ba 'bum gyi gtsug tor rgyan/ /nyon mongs dug gis mi 'chi'i rtsi ma lha/ /shes rab phar phyin ma la gus brtud de/ /zhes gsungs te/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba byon dang 'byon gyur gyi sangs rgyas ma lus bskyed pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lha sku bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba'i yum/ mkhas dbang bye ba 'bum phrag gi gtsug tor gyi rgyan du gyur cing / nyon mongs 156

pa'i dug 'joms par byed pas de'i dbang gis mi 'chi ba'i rtsi ma ghi ste bdud rtsi sman mchog shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ste lhamo sher phyin ma la gus pas btud de/ zhes pa ste/ de zhes pa lhag bcas dang / rtsi ma ghi ni gla rtsi'i ming du byas pa yod mod/gla rtsi kho na la sbyar na skabs 'dir 'brel de tsam mi che bas bdud rtsi sman mchog la sbyar ba yin la/ yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa dang / gzugs can 'dres pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhon nu'i dus na brgyad pa'i skabs kyi sku'i/ /rngo bo dbye ba rnam grangs 'phags seng gnyis/ /gcig byur lta bu'i rgyas bshad mang drag ces/ /bskul ngor sku bzhi 'phrin las rmad byung ston/ /zhes gsungs te/ bdag gzhon nu'i dus na/ mngon rtogs rgyan skabs brgyad pa'i skabs kyi sku bzhi bo re re'i ngo bo/ dbye ba/ rnam grangs sogs gsal zhing ma 'khrul ba 'phags seng gnyis gcig tu gyur nas bshad pa lta bu'i rgyas bshad kyi mtha' dpyod 'khrul sel gaṅgā'i chu rgyun mi pham zhal lung brtsams pa de rgyas drags pas 'chums dka' stabs/ de las bsdus pa zhig brtsam dgos zhes/ bskul ba'i ngor sku bzhi 'phrin las dang bcas pa rmad du byung ba zhig slar yang ston par bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/ bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang gzugs 157

can 'dres ma'i rgyan no/ / ye shes chos sku'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/dang bo legs par bshad pa'i mchod sprin 'dis rgyal ba rnams mchod pa ni/ smras pa/ ji lta ji snyed ma ngon gzugs me shes sku'i/ /yon tan mkha' ltar rgya che grangs med kun/ /shes par dka' lang sde tshan nyer gabyug tu/ /rgyan las gsungs pa'i dka' gnad zhing rta che/ /so so'i lugs bzhin ma 'dres ma nor bar/ /me long tshal bzhin bshad 'azhis rgyal rnams mchod/ /ces gsungs te/ji lta ba dang ji snyed pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i ye shes chos sku'i yon tan ni/ nam mkha' ltar rgya che la sa'i rdul bzhin grangs med pas/ de dag kun re re nas shes par dka' na yang / zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig tu bsdus pa'i don/ rgyan las gsungs pa'i dka' ba'i gnad/ shing rta chen po so so'i lugs ji lta ba bzhin du ma 'dres shing / ma nor bar me long chung ngu'i nang du skyed mo'i tshal dang nags tshal rgya che ba dag ma 'dres par gsal bar 'char ba bzhin du gsal bar bshad pa'i mchod sprin bla na med pa 'dis rgyal ba rnams mchod do/ /zhes pa ste/ yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa dang bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang dpe rgyan 'dres 158

ma'i sgo nas mchod par brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa blo gsal don gnyer can rnams gzhung 'dir 'jug par bskul ba ni/ bdag nyid chen po lab sras legs bshad kyis/ /'phags seng dgongs 'grel ma lus legs bshad skabs/ legs bshad rkang drug mang rnams legs bshad dbyangs/ /dar der da sgrogs grags snyan ja gsang ldir/ /zhes gsungs te/rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras rnams kyi legs bshad dri ma med pas/ 'phags seng gi dgongs 'grel ma lus pa legs par bshad pa'i skabs 'dir/ blo gsal don gnyer can rkang drug ste sgrang ma rnams mtha' dpyod 'di lta bur zhugs te/ —legs bshad kyi glu dbyangs dar dir gyi sgra da lta nyid du sgrogs shitha/ dang / grags snyan te/ snyan pa'i grags pa'i rnga gsang ste 'brug sgra ldir bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ste/ bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyis brgyan pa'o/ /longs sku'i mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/ 'di la gsum/ longs sku'i zhing sogs ngo mtshar bar bstan pa/ zhing de'i sangs rgyas dang 'khor byang sems kyi mtha' med par bstan pa/ mdo la brten nas zhing de'i yon tan khong du chud parabastan pa'o/ /

dang bo ni/ smras pa/ rgyan dang rin chen yod do cog gi 'od/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin rgyu skar bkram bzhin mang / /dpal dang 'byor bas skug po'i po brang mchog /nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs tshul 'de ngo mtshar/ /zhes gsungs te/ longs sku'i pho brang dang / longs sku'i rgyan dang / gzhan yang tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu'i rin po che yod do cog gi 'od ni/ nyi ma'i 'od 'bar ba bzhin du 'od gsal ba dang / nam mkha' la rgyu skar bkram pa bzhin du ches mang ba dang / ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang bsam las 'das pa'i 'byor bas brgyan pa'i gnas 'og min stug po bkod pa'i pho brang mchog ni/ nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs tshul sogs 'di dag ches ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni rgya che ba'i rgyan gnyis pa 'byod+ku ba rgya che ba'i rgyan yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngo mtshar che mang 'di na sangs rgyas kun/ /dus bzhir 'dus pa'i pha mtha' nam mkha'i mthar/ /song ba gzigs pa'i yul min sa bcu yi/ /rgyal sras 'khor gyi pha mtha' ci la yod/ /ces gsungs te/ rgyu bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags stobs las grub pa'i/ gnas 'og min stug po'i bkod pa'i zhing / ngo mtshar ches che zhing rab tu mang 160

ba 'di na/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun dus bzhir 'dus ba'i pha mtha' ni/ mtha' med nam mkha'i mthar song ba/ gzigs shing shes pa'i yul ma yin pa dang 'khor sa bcu'i rgyal sras kyis bskor ba'i 'khor gyi pha mtha' ci la yod de med do/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di mtshar ba'i rgyu'i rgyan du gtogs so/ / gsum pa ni/ de lta'i phun tshogs 'khor la bka' stsal mod/ /sa bcu sdong bkod mdo sogs rgyal sras kyi/ /yul 'di sgra tsam thos tshe 'og min gyi/ /pho brang gzhal yas khang du phyin nam snyam/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa de lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa tshang ma bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho lu bka' stsal pa yin mod/ bdag cag gis ni sa bcu ba'i mdo dang / sdong bo bkod pa'i mdo sogs las gsungasga pa'i rgyal sras sa mthon po ba rnams kyi spyod yul 'di'i/ sgra tsam thos tshe gnas 'og min gyi longs sku'i gzhal yas khang du phyin pa yin nam snyam pa'i blo skye'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni the tshom phul byung gi rgyan du gtogs so/ / pi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi 'grel/dang bo mdzad pa bcu gnyis gsal bar bshad pa ni/smras pa/tsā6/

sangs rgyas rnams kyi ma da ba bcu gnyis tshul/ /bye ba brag brgyar ston pa'i lung rigs chogs/ /bcu gnyis bdag po'itsād las ches gsal ba/ /lung bzhin rigs pa bzhin du ma 'khral gsal //zhesadzāgasungs te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston tshul ni/ 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i lung dang / rigs pa'i tshogs bcu gnyis bdag po ste nyi ma'i 'od las kyang— ches gsal ba/ mdo rgyud kyi lung dang dngos po'i stobs shugs kyi rigs pa bzhin du ma 'khrul bar gsal bar bshad do/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni bskor rgyan gsum pa/ tshig don gnyis ka bskor ba'i rgyan yin no/ /gnyis pa metha' dpyod 'dis legs par bshad pa la bsngags pa ni/ bcu gnyis 'dren tshul mang thos sngon gyi lhas/ /ma tsung mdo rgyud bstan brtsos bshad tshul dang / /nges pa lnga ldan gsung rab gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /'dir drangs dz+ra byu nu des yin par blom/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'dren tshul sogs kyi legs bshad/ mang du thos pa'i mkhas pa snga ma sdon gyi lha de dag gis ma myong ba'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi bshad tshul dang / ngeyopa lnga ldan gyi longs sku'i gsung rab gaṅgā'i chu rgyun sa steng 'dir 'dren pa'i bya ba ni drang srong dza hu nu des byas pa 162

yin par rlom mo/ /zhes pa ste/ mkhas pa snga ma dag sngon gyi lha'i gzugs su bkod de/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi bshad tshul dang nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs sku ston pa'i gsung rab dag chu bo gaṅgā'i gzugs su bkod nas/ mkhas pa snga mas mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi bshad tshul dang longs sku ston pa'i gsung rab sogs ji bzhin ma bshad pa ni/ sngon gyi lhas gaṅgā la longs spyod ma myong ba'i gzugartswasabakod nas/ mtha' dpyod 'dir de dag tshul bzhin bshad pa ni/ de dag gis ma myong ba'i gaṅgā sa steng 'dir drangs pa'i gzugs su bkod de/ 'dir drangs pa'i bya ba ni dza hu nu des byas pa yin par rlom zhes pa'i de sgra snyegs gzhi khong rang nyid yin pas/ 'di 'dra'i legs bshad rtsom ma/khan ni khong rang nyid yin snyam du rlom mo zhes pa'i don de/ 'di ni nyams ldan gyi rgyun brgyud kyi dang bo/ dga' ba'i sgeg pa'i nyams ldan gyi rgyun yin la/ chu bo gaṅgā ni drang srong dza hus 'thungs te slar bskyugs pa las byung bas/ dza hu nu'i bu mo yang zer ro /mjug gi tshigs bcad kyi don 'grel ba/ 'di la gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin la bsngags pa/ 1 lam rim las mdo sngags kyi lam gyi sgo rnyed pa/ 3 mdo sngags kyi gsang ba'i k+ṣe6ñtsa

gnad thugs su chud pas dga' bde rgyas pa/ 3 sku bzhi 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i sngar med legs bshad bsgrongs pa/ 4legs bsha da kyi snang bas 'jig rten kun khyab par smon pa/ 5sher phyin gyi chos 'di phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par smon pa dang drug las/ — dang bo ni/ smras pa/ ma ma phyogs bcu'i rgyal’ba srasatshobacas dang / /nyan rang theg pa gsum gyi tshogs rnams kun/ /skyed mdzad dus gsum thar bar bgrod pa'i lam/ /gakhyang lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin yum rnams mid/ /ces gsungs te/ e ma ho ngo mtshar che/ ngo mtshar gang che na/ phyoges bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang / nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems kyi theg pa gsum gyi skye 'phags kyi yon tan gyi tshogs rnams ma lus pa kun skyed par mdzad cing / dus gsum du thar bar bgrod pa'i lam po che/ gzhung sher phyin yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'grel ba dang bcas pa dang / lam sher phyin byang sems kyi lam dang sne 'bras bu sher phyin thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gyi yum 'di rnams ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di ni don rgyan bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan gyi nang gi brgyad pa rmad byung gi nyams kyis spras pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kye ma mdo sngags gzhung mang ghab maba' rngo64

kun/ /yun ring ngal brgyas dub ba'i ngal bso'i gnas/ /pharasnyephyin gzhung don legs ston lam rim las/ /mdo sngags lam gyi sgo dhed ngal bso thob/ /ces gsungs te/ kye ma ho/zhes thugs skyo ba'i gsung byon te/ gang la skyo na/ mdo sngagayokyi gzhung ches mang bo la sbyangs pa dang / phyi nang gi grub mtha' kun la yun ring bor ngal ba brgya phrag gis sbyangs pas lus sems dub bo/ /zhes thugs skyo ba'i rgyu gsungs pa dang / 'on kyang / lus sems dub pa'i ngal bso ba'i gnas/ phar phyin gyi gzhung don lam gyi rim par bsgrigs te legs par ston pa'i man ngag byang chub lam rim las mdo dang sngags kyi lam gyi smo ske gnad sgo rnyed nas dka' ba brgya phrag gis btsal bas ngal zhing ca dub pa ngal bso thob bo/ /zhes pa ste/ lam rim las mdo sngags kyi dgongs don thugs su chud par gsungs te/ 'di yang dga' ba'i sgeg pa'i nyams ldan gyi rgyan du gtogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ rigs brgya'i khrab bdag sre ba rdo rje 'chang / /mgon de'i zhabs bsten mdo sngags gsang ba'i gnad/ /ma lus kun brtsas khrid chen ma smra ta/ /klu dbang grags thob legs smon dga' bdes khyab/ /ces gsungs te/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag srad rgyud rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog yar 'phel zhes yongs 165

su grags pa rje bla ma'i snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa 'dzin pa'i mgon po de'i zhabs la brten nas/ mdo sngags kyi gsang ba'i man ngag gi gnad ma lus pa kun bsdus pa'i khrid chen drug dang brgya—da sogs a skṛ ta ste bdud rtsi thob nas nyams su blangs pas/mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur te/ klu rnams la dam pa'i chos kyis dbang bsgyur bas klu dbang ste/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi snyan pa'i grags pa khong gis thob nas/ sgyusngon gyi legs smon gyi mthu grub ste/ lus sems dga' ba dang bde ba'i ye shes kyis khyab pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ bla na med pa'i rnam par thar ba ste/ 'di yang / don rgyan bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan la gnyis yod pa'i/ dang bo dngos thob kyi dga' ba'i rgyan yin te/ /kun mkhyen snyanane ngag rtsa ba las/ dga' ba'i yul thob pa las dngos su ni/ /khyad 'phags dga' ba brjod pa dngos thob dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/bzhi ba ni/ longs sprul mes pos mngags ba'i legs bshad kyi/ /dag byed mchod yon sngon byon zhing rta che'i/ /blo gros ral bar nyis stong lnga brgyar bzung / /bdag blo'i skal ldan thing rtas rgyun 'azhi bsgrengs/ /zhes gsungs te/ longs sku dang sprul sku mes po lha chen tshangs pas mngags pa'i legs bshad kyi 166

dag byed mchod yon chu bo gaṅgā ni/ sngon byon shing rta chespo po dag gi thugs blo gros kyi ral ba'i nang du lo nyis stong lnga brgyar bzung ba de/ bdag gi blo gros skal ldan shing rtas drangs te/legs bshad kyi gaṅgā'i rgyun 'di bsgrengs so/ /zhes pa ste/ longs sku dang sprul sku ni tshangs pa'i gzugs su bkod/ de'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i sku bzhi'i rnam bzhag sogs kyi legs bshad chu bo 'gro ldan ma'i gzugs su bkod/ sngon byon shing rta chen po dag gi blo gros ni/ dbang phyug chen po'i ral ba'i gzugs su bkod/ shing rta chen po dag gi thugs la bzhugs pa ni/ gaṅgā dbang phyug gi ral ba'i nang du sim pa'i gzugs su bkod/ ston pa zil gnon me rta la 'khrungs pa'i dbang du byas te/ ston pa sangs rgyas shing chos 'khor bskor nas 'di rtsom rag gi par du lo nyis stong lnga brgya dang go brgyad lon pas/ de'i bar du yum don shing rta chen po dag gi thugs la bzhugs shing mtha' dpyod 'di lta bu'i gsal bshad mtha' chod pa phyod pa'i legs bshad ma byung ba ni/ gaṅgā dbang phyug gi ral ba'i nang du lo stong gnyis dang lnga brgyar bzhugs pa'i gzugs su bkod/ khong gi blo gros ni/ skal ldan shing rta'i gzugs su bkod/ khong gis legs bshad bla na med pa 'di brtsams pa ni/ skal ldan shing rtas 16spya

dbang phyug chen po dka' thub kyis mnyes par byas te/ chu bo gaṅgā mi yul du drangs pa'i gzugs sa bkod/ des na chu dang cha can tshang ma gzugs su bkod pas mtha' da ga gzugs can yin la don rgyan bcu dgu ba gzi brjid can gyi rgyan du'ang gtogs so/ /chu bo gaṅgā'i gtam rgyud mi 'dra ba 'ga' re 'a dugasprekyang /gsal zhing khungs ldan gyi stolo rgyus shig kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi gsol 'debs ke ta ka'i 'phreng mdzes kyi slo 'grel bar yod pas shes 'dod pa dag gis der gzigs 'tshal/lnga ba ni/ 'azhir 'bad dge ba ches dkar mkha' khrab 'gro'i/ /legs byas 'dab brgya bye ba'i tshogs bzhad cing / /skal bzang bung bas dar nir mgrin glu dang / /legs bshad snang bas cig char kun khrab shog /ces gsungs te/ kun slong rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i bya ba la 'bad pa las byung ba'i dge ba dkar ba las kyang ches dkar ba 'di'i mthu las/ nam mkha' sgob pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi legs pa'i bsod nams las byas pa'i dge mtshan pad ma dkar bo 'dab ma brgya ba bye ba 'bum phrag du ma'i tshogs rab tu bzhad cing / gdul bya las dang skal ba bzang bo can gyi rkang drug bung bas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa 'i dar dir gyi mgrin pa'itshoglu dbyangs sgrogs pa dang /glu68

legs bshad kyi 'od kyi snang bas cig car du yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun khyab par shog ces pa ste/ gzugs can dang 'brel ba'i lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o/ / drug pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byin blabs dang / /rten cing 'brel 'byung bslu med bden pa'i mthus/ /phyogs 'azhi phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur byug /ces gsungs te/ spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag mthar phyin pa'i phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams dang / sa lam gyi rtogs pa mthon por slebs shing gzhan don gyi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mkha' khyab tu spro bzhin pa'i rgyal sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyings rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'gyur ba med cing bslu ba med pa'i bden pa po'i mthus/ sher phyin gyi bstan pa 'di'i mtshon dkar bo dge ba'i phyogs 'di mtha' dag phyogs thams cad dang dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces pa ste/ bden stobs brjod nas bsngo smon rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar ba ste/ shar rtso thun mong gi lam don rgyan so lnga'i nang gi so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan gyis sprus te/ bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i mjug bsdus pa'ormo/ / / / 169

nadug py-id / kyi de ltar mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhye na chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i phar phyin skabs brgyad kyi mtha' dpyod kyi tshigs bcad rnams kyi tshig 'grel rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig 'grel khul byas zin la/ dgongs pa ji bzhin lon pa rngo mi thogs te /dngos po'i snang tshod la'ang kun mkhyen chen po mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba yin gshis/ gsung zab citha barmingab dang / rang nyid skyes sbyangs kyi shes rab zhan stabs/ mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa'i legs bshad cig 'byung dka' mod dpang lo tsā ba blo gros bstan pa'i zhal nas/ deng sang bstan pa nya mas dmas pas/ /'di 'dra'i tshulta la mthun sgrub dang / /'jug pa shin tu nyung mod kyang / /shes na mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/ ci /'di la mkhas par byed 'dod cing / /gang zhig shes na mkhas 'gyur ba/ / 70

'di dang 'di 'dra'i gzhung mi slob/ /de rnams blo ni be+em po'am ci/ /zhes—gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang phyi nang gi rkyen gang thad nasasnyegazhung lugs la sbyong mkhan dkon zhing / mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa phal cher na'ang po ti 'ga' zhig la thal phyir gyis yam tsas sbyangs nas yid tshims te/ gnas brtan zhal mar gzigs kyi tshul du bzhugs shing / gzhan la 'chad spel re byed na'ang / phag sna rdo thug gi dpe bzhin tshigs bcad dang / sgra sgrub sogs rgyus med dag dum bskyur dum bskyur gyis 'gro ba las/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan nyin skar tsam snang la/ 'ga' zhig gis ni sum rtags dang snyan ngag phyogs mthong tsam la brten nas 'chad rtsom gyi khul byed mod/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i srog dang bral ba dang tha snyad rig gnas la'ang mtha' ma chod pas muspyo nag gi mda' gang la phog mi shes pa'ang snang zhing / 'ga' zhig gis ni/ rang rigs kyi rig pa'i gnas la sbyang ba mtharophyin ma nus par/ rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas kha zin sna zin tsam re khyer nas/ khyi brgyags kyis bdag por rmur zer ba ltar gyi rnam par skyong mkhan yang —yod/ de lta bu'i rnyog gra chebyuba'i skabs su/ mi smra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu 'gro ba ni mchog 17lha

yin mod/ 'on kyang rnam g.yeng la goms pa'i dbang gis kha lag gnyis ka 'dzin ma thub par g.yang ba'i bya ba 'di 'dra la zhugs par gyur/ 'on kyang 'di 'dra brtsams pa la'ang skyon med yang dag cig yin zhes khas len ma nus mod/ don gtan nas med pa min snyam ste/ kun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' chen mo las/ gang zhig gzhan gyis mi smras 'dir med cing / /ljongs 'di la ltos sngon med legs bshad mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dus 'di dang ljongs 'di la ltos na legs bshad du bgrang chog snyam la/ rang rigs kyi rig gnas la zhen yod pa 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad na dga' ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'ang srid snyam ste/ skyes rabs las/ ya rabs rnams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar byed/ /ces dang / dris lan rin chen 'phreng ba las/ dri med dris lan rin chen 'phreng ba 'di/ /gang gi mgul na legs par yod gyur pa/ /de ni skyes bu mkhas pa 'dus nang du/ /mgul gyi mu tig rgyan bzhin mdzes pa yin/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ mthong ba'i dbang gis mi rnams rab tu dga' ba mchog skyed pa/ /zhes dang / chos kyang don rnams phye bas mkhas rnams 'di na dga' mchog skyed/ /ces gsungs so snyam mo/ /17lha

'di rtsom pa'i skabs su'ang byed 'brel la dogs pa yod pa lta bu yi ge'i dag cha la'ang dogs gnas 'ga' zhig byung mod/ pho tshod kyis bcos ma phod par/ dpar ma gzhir bzhag nas de mthun gyis 'grel rgyag khul byas shing / khong gi rtsom 'di yang shar phyogs gi ḍa dza'i rtsom lugs yin gshis/ skabs 'gar tshig bsdu zhing rmings pas go dka' ba dag la'ang rang blos dpyad de bkral ba la 'grig mi 'grig ci rigs yod nges la/ rgyan ngo sprod kyang ji bzhin ngo 'phrod pa dka' ste/ spyir rgyan la yang me long ma sogs kyis dngos su ma zin pa'ang dpag tu med pa yod par kun mkhyen rang nyid kyis gsungs pa dang / dngos su zin pa dag la'ang thad kar ngo ma 'phrod pa yod nges pas/ mkhas pa rnams kyis sreg bcad brdar ba'i dpe bzhin du dpyad nas/ngang bas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin du blang dor mdzadapar zhu/'dir smras pa/ mdo rgyud rig gnas gser 'khor rtsibs stong gis/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i khyo na la dbang bsgyur cing / /'phrin las zer brgya 'bar ba'i 'od rnon gyis/ /'jig rten dkar khyab gtong ba'i byed po mchog /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi skre shes 'dab brgya ba/ /rab tu bzhad pa'i zhabs skyes ge sar rdul/ /spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i mthu dpal las/ / 173

'di phyi dge ba'i dpal yon 'bar gyur cig /'dir 'bad las byung dung ltar dkar ba'i dngos/ /rang gzhan 'o ma'i mtsho dang yongs 'dres te/ /'gro ba'i rims nad 'joms pa'i rtsir gyur nas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rnam thar skyong gyur cig /ces 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i phar phyin mtha' dpyod kyi snyan ngag gi tshigs bcad rnams kyi tshig 'grel me tog 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sngar dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge gling gi lung rigs smra ba dge slong mkhas grub rgya mtshos bkra shis pa'i lha reg dri med dang dngos skyes du ma bcas nan tan du bskul ba dang / lo snga mar dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi bshes gnyen lung rigs/ smra ba'i khyu mchog 'jam dbyangs pha rgya mtshos lha dar dngos skyes bcas bskul ba dang / nye sngon dpal ldan bkra shisaci'akhor lo'i dgon gyi lung rigs smra ba 'jam dbyangs nyi mas kyang 'phrin yig gi lam nas bskul ba dang / nye char yang dpal ldan smra seng gling gi ar yag sprul ba'i sku bstan pa rgya mtshos kyang nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ tha snyad pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas rab rgyal shing byi lo'i (1984) hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin dbu btsugs/ rnga stod sgo mang dge ldan 174

bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa sogs bka' chos 'chad spel gyi zhor la bris shing / slar rnga rdzong du slob sbyong 'dzin grwa btsugs te dpe khrid kyi zhar zhor la brel tshab kyi ngang du bris nas/ lo de ga'i hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer sto cibazhi'i nyin mjug rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod yangs pa sprul ba'i sku dge slong 'jam dbyangs blo gros rgya mtshos bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bde zhing skyid par gyur cig/ //ces pa 'di yang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gsung rab dpar khang nas dpar du basbyan pa'i lcags dpar la gzhi byas nas btab pa'o/ / sab maṅga lo // 1lha5

rdzo0 r+pāmabe+emamaḥmamasbriḥmabhelge/ /drasha ka shām ཿ samatheḥ atsusnye spre55snye+o༈ོle'iye.oṃ༈ོnya ya snyezhe kai// /1 / khyurmāsgabe+e 1 ri sacaṣāmabha dha rma bā rahṝ pū sha tarasulde'u(gamildaspyosnyesnyapyi swolageri nokisnye// spra /pre / / /blusmikhyur+shar+yāṣ+ṭhabe+en( smogar+bha t+ta wagan+dabahar ta sma//gasgo7 ldesgospyo//zhu zhe gi 531da// —1 / —

d+ngha wī sde ༄ —tshwa.ā+otho ṭiX skeglulhaglusnyespyo dzo 5 7snyeṅgesnyephodū5 ༷stse+o sh+lau r+ṣa snyezlo.ālhusnye snye75)gosnyelachaci ༵snyel5ruskyusposnyelo r+ṣasdusnye hwa ske h+pho sde trī be+e rka/snye snye godzosnye dzisnyeXdzo5sprospethosnyespyo snye 5snye5 r+sā ri r+ṣa— sne ra ma bla kyi be+e ma sma 7/ ( / hūṃ sne nyu hūṃ ngh+ru / skre / ṇ+ḍaṃ/ nyu hūṃ hūṃ snye — the1 khyu'i sna l+līrdzosmo zaslosimamasaush+laurme spa7 ཿ khri ༄/ /trishemu'imahā riḥsaṃsarāgadhirterarnye rgyaḥ/ /dze/dastse྾ bla spru raspru phro nas//gahing zatha'a'or lo au las/ dhe rtswa sa sma sne dze+e ma ma/ lha / lha / rtse hūṃ lha — hūṃ kyi rje / hūṃ nyu hūṃ ri 'i ri —skum sabe+e smonamom/ tā rka ra su : yakosmodeshaṃka ཿte skya/ / rimagyura'astso 'drene ma3 paṃ/ /r+sā mog de la phyag '-itshala.ā+o / /

ming dang don gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me yi/ /legs bshad mdzod kyi bsdus don gyi/ /tshig don rang blos dpag tshod 'bri/ /de la 'dir chos mngon mdzod kyi bsdus don chos mngon rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings zhes bya ba'i tshig don rang gi blos dpag tshod tsam zhig 'grel ba la/ mchod par brjod pa'i tshig don bshad pa dang gzhung don dngos 'grel ba'o / / naskyod dan bu8da puzhi sdugha don nagid spru/dang bo mchod par brjod pa ni/ tshogs gnyis rin chen zhes sogs te/ sku gsung thugs gsum gyi sgo nas bstod la sku'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ tshogs gnyis rin chen las grub sku/ /zhes gsungs te bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis po rin po che'i gzu gas su bkod de gzugs can gyi rgyan gyis spras pa yin la/ de'i nang nas bsdus pa'i gzugs can 179

gyi rgyan lgus spras pa'o/ /rdon rne bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi lag rjes la gzugs sku grub pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs kyi lag rjes la chos sku 'grub pas/ de lta bu'i chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis dang ldan par bstod pa ste rgyu'i sgo nas sku la bstod pa'o/ /gsung gi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ dbyangs kyisazhe dgu tshim mngad gsung— / /zhes gsung la/ byed las kyi sgordzo nas bstod pa ste/ dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i chos nyid bden pa bstan pa'i gsung gi mdzad pa'i sgo nas/ skye dgu ste 'gro ba yod do cog gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag bsal nas/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsung gi sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /thugs kyi sgo nas bstod /pa ni/ sgrib bral ting 'dzin 'bum bkra'i thugs/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin sogs kyi sgo nas slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyi snyoms par zhugs pa'i mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig tu song ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'bum phrag bkra ba ste rab tu mang zhing sna tshogs ting nge 'dzin sogs kyi thugs kyi yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod yul ni/ 'gro 'dren shākya seng ger 'dud/ / 180

3) /ste :rdo /bye/ /tha /// /rdo/ dresas gsungs / lta ba na tan nas 'a ba rnams ༄ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las 'dren par mdzad pa ston pa shākya seṅge'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos 'dud pa ste phyag 'tshal ba'o/ / — / / ci— ri — — rtsa— spya wa — chi tsho 7— wa 181

— rī gzhud —don dardoska zhaskresko spru/ — gnyis pa gzhung don dngos 'grel ba la/ mtshan don gyi skabs su/ ya snyi mngon phyogs la sogs la/ /zhes gsungs te/ don ni a gyi zhes pa don du mar 'jug ste/ a khyi mu dzi mngon phyogs dang / a 9 kyā yang yang dang / a khyi skyi zil gnon dang / a bhi sa ma ya mngon rtogs la 'jug pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes mtha' dpyod las gsung ba de bsdus pa'o/ /chos spyang rnam bshad rig pa las/ /chos ne shes bya lam dang ni/ /rtsa ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ /bsod nams tshe dang mtho ris dang / /'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos kyi skad dod dharma zhes pa snyar 'dzin pa'i byings kyis sgrub pa yin stabs 'dzin pa la go dgos/ dang bo ni shes bya la chos zhes bya ste/ blo'i yul ma yin pa las yongs su bzung ste blo'i yul du bya rung ba'am blos 'dzin rgyu yod pa go dgos/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags lam la chos zhes bya ste/ so skye yi sa las yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ myang 'das 'gog 182

bden la chos zhes bya ste/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ yid kyi yul chos kyi skye mched la chos zhes bya ste/ med pa las rang gi ngo bo yod par 'dzin pa'o/ /lnga ba ni/ bsod nams bsags pa'am dge ba bsgrub pa la chos zhes bya ste/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal las yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ tshe la chos zhes bya ste srog 'dor ba las yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang la chos zhes bya ste/ ngan song gi rten las yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ 'byung 'gyur lus rgas par 'gyur ba lta bu'i chos la chos zhes bya ste mi 'gyur ba las yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /dgu ba ni/ skyes pa 'jig pa'i chos can no lta bu dang / dge sbyong gi chos bzhi lta bu la chos zhes bya ste/ nges can ma yin pa las yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /bcu ba ni/ chos lugs la chos zhes bya ste/ chos min gyi lugs las sngongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /mchod brjod/ gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing / /'khor ba'i 'dam las 'gro ba drangs mdzad pa/ /don bzhin ston pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes pa'i mchod brjod rkang ba gsum gyi skabs su/ phun tshogs gsum gyi sgo nas ston pa sangs rgyas trībyi3

bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa yin te/ rkang ba dang bos rang don phun tshogs/ gnyis phas gzhan don phun tshogs/ gsum pas 'phrin las phun tshogs kyi sgo nas bstod pa'i phyir/ de'i don 'di las/ spangs stogs phun tshogasporang gi don/ /'gro ba drangs pa gzhan gyiron/ /chos ston 'asbrin las lun tshogs te/ /'de dang gnyis pa'i khyad par dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing zhes pas/ sangs rgyas te/ shes bya kun la sgrib pa'i nyon mongs dang / nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa sa bon dang bcas pa gtan nas bcom zhing spangs pa'i spangs pa phun tshogs dang ldan pa dngos su bstan nas/ shes bya thams cad rtogs pa'i rtogs pa phun tshogs shugs la bstan/ de lta bu'i spangs rtogs phun tshogs brnyes pa rang gi don dang / 'khor ba 'di bgol dka' ba'i 'dam rdzab kyi gzugs su bkod nas 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab chen po las 'gro ba rnams thar ba'i skam sar drangs pa dang 'dren par mdzad pa de nyid gzhan don phun sum tshogs ba dang / 'gro ba 'dren tshul de yang / khyab 'jug ltar lus sna tshogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu dang / dbang phyug ltar khyod der gyur cig lta bu'i dam pa sbyin pa'i mthus ma yin par/gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rang gis rtogs pa'i don bzhin ston ②byi4

bar mdzod pa ni/ 'phrin las phun tshogs te/ de ltar phun tshogs gsum gyi sgo nas bstod cing / tshes ston pa'i 'phrin lasanephun tshogs 'di dang / 'gro ba drangs pa'i gzhan don phun tshogs gnyis kyi khyad par dpyad gsung ba yin la/ dpyad tshul ni/ tshoms las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la 'pho min te/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsudz+wa ba ltar/ 'gro pa 'dren pa yang 'phrin las kyi mchog chos ston pa la rag las pa yin/ de yang 'phrin las phun tshogs yin mod/ skabs 'dir/ rkang ba gnyis pa'i skabs su dngos su 'gro pa 'dren pa'i ngo bo tsam bstan nas/ king ba gsum pa'i skobs su de'i thabs tshul chos ston pa'i 'phrin las phun tshogs dmigs kyis bsal nas dngos su bstan pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas brtsom ldan 'das zhes pa/ /blos min nye tshig gus phyir dang / /zhes gsungs te/ kha cig na re/ rang 'grel las/ gang zhig ces bya ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbang du byas nas smras so zhes gsungs pa la zlos skyon yod par thal/ sasdas rgyas dang bcom ldan 'das gang ru nga zhig smras pas chog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gnyis don 185

gcig la 'jug pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa/ zlos pa min te/ ma gus pa bzlog pa'i phyir nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar te gus pa byed pa'i phyir yin no/ /che ba brjod pa'i tshig nye tshig ma sbyar r+pār ming nas smos pa ni ma gus pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyir/ dper na lhas sbyin zhes pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir gsung ngo / /'dul ba bshad rnam bse ru dang / /skye mtha'i sems dpar rim gdags phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/'phags yul gyi 'dul ba rnam par bshad pa dag gam 'dul ba'i rjes 'brang gi mngon pa dag na re/ sangs rgyas dang bcom ldan 'das gang rung re smos mi rigs par thal/ gsung rab nas sangs rgyas dang bcom ldan 'das zhes bshad pa gang rung re yin na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gsung rab nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas dang bcom ldan 'das yin min la mu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gsung rab nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas yin la bcom ldan 'das ma yin pa bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dang / gsung rab nas bshad pa'i bcom ldan 'das yin la sangs rgyas ma yin pa srid pa tha ma'i byang sems lta bu dang / zhes sangs rgyas kyi sgra bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal la btags pa da nga / bcom ldan 'das kyi sgra srid pa tha 186

ma'i byang sems la gdags par bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi don yang legs pa drug la byed de/ rang dbang dang / rab sbyangs dang / gzugs bzang dang / grags pa dang / dpal ldan dang / che ba ste/ de rnams tshogs pa la byed de/ sgra nges par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i mngon brjod las/ ji skad du/ dbang byug dang ni rab sbyangs dang / /gzugs bzang ba dang grags pa dang / /dpal dang che ba nyid du brjod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /myan pa brtsom tshul ba'i mtha' can/ /'ji'i zhes drug pa'i 'bya mang dang / /'dis zhes gsum pa byed tshig la/ /jir ba gnyis ka 'gal ba med/ /ces gsungs te/ gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing / /zhes pa'i mun pa bcom tshul ba'i mtha' can te rnam dbye drug pa 'i sbyar ba'i mtha' can/ 'di'i mun pa bcom zhes rnam dbye drug pa 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud can dang / 'dis zhes sa mtha' can de rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa'i tshig la sbyar ba gnyis kar 'gal ba med cesacagasung ba yin la/ 'gal ba med tshul ni/ drug pa'i 'bru mang zhes pa ni drug sgra bsdus pa'i bdag sgra khong nas 'don dgos pa'i tshig sdud kyi ming ste/ mun pa bcom pa lam gyi chos yin par ston pas/ mun pa bcom pa can zhes pa'i don yin la/ gsum pa'i 'bru mang 187

ni rnam dbye gsum pa byed mig bsdus pa'i byid mig khong nas 'don dgos pa'i tshig sdud gcig gi ming ste/ 'dis mun pha 'joms par byed ces 'don dgos pas/ rnam grololam lto bu 'di'i bcom pa zhes druspu sgra byas na ba/com pa'i don bral ba la byed cing / bar chad med lam lta bu 'dis bcom zhes rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa'i sgra byas na bcom pa gnod pa'i don la 'jug —pas/ drug pa 'brel sgra dang / gsum pa byed pa gang byas spyang 'gal ba med do/ /'on kyang rnam dbye rtsa ba rang gi tshig zin la thon med kyang / 'grel ba‘'grel bshad dag las khong na gnas pa dag legs par bkral ba'o/ /sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sbyor ba rnams/ /cung zad bsdus pa yod na yang / /de ni de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar khong na gnas pa'i rnam dbye'i don legs par bkral ba'i don bzhin du/ mtha' dpyod sdom bcas kyis kyang legs par gtan la phabs pa'o/ /gang spel blob mas ston mongs mi na/ /ma spangs bzhed par mdzod ṭīka bshad/ /mi 'thad spangs pa'i bye brag gos/ /rnam pa lnga'o zhes gang spel gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang spel gyi lugs la slob ma nyan thos dgra bcom pas nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa ma spangs par shā8snye

bzhid par mdzod ṭīka thar lam gsal byed du bshad —kyang / mi 'thad de/ gang spel bas chags bral gyis spangs pa yang 'dod pa'i phyir te/ gang spel las/ spangs pa'i bye brag gis rnam pa lnga'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ yang 'ga' zhig na re/ gang spel lugs la/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa dgra bcom dag gis ma spangs par thal/ des sangs rgyas kyis de spangs la dgra bcom gzhan gyis ma spangs par 'dod pa'i phyir te/ gang spel las/ 'di ni zhes bya bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de yin gyi gzhan ni 'ga' yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa so sor brtags 'gog gis spangs pa sangs rgyas kho nar bshad pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ 'di ni kun la mun pa gtan bcom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'grel bshad yin phyir/ rang lugs la'ang nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis kyis nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa gnyis spangs kyang gtan nas spangs pa ma yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams kyang nyon mongs can gyi rmongs pa bral ba'i phyir kun la bcom par ni 'dod mod kyi/ gnyan nas ni ma yin te/ ram̐byi9

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang gis thob pa chad tshul te/ /de yang skye mi rung mi dgos/ /zhes gsungs te/ nyan rang dgra bcom gnyis kyis nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa gnyis rang gis thob pa chad pa'i tshul gyis spangs pa yin yang / de yang skye mi rung ba mi dgos te/ nyams pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi dang ni shes sgrib 'dun pa la/ /'ardod chags bral ba'i tshul gyis spang phyir mdor/ /nga ne chos gcig yongs su ma shes zhing / /ma spangs rtsag bsngal mthar byed mi smra'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis kyis/ gzhan gyi ste nyon sgrib dang ni shes sgrib ste nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa'i mun pa rnams 'dun pa la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i tshul gyis spangs pa'i phyir te/ mdo las/ nga ni chos gcig yongs su ma shes shing ma spangs par sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed par mi smra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ni mchims mdzod las/ de dag gis nyon sgrib kyi ngo bo'ang spangs la/ shes sgrib ni 'dun pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba'i tshul gyis spangs te/ zhes sogs ltar ro/ /mdzod ṭīka rgyu bzhi mi shes myan par bshad/ /sangs rgyas tshos zab shes bya ring ba dang / /yul dang dus dang rnam pa'i rab 1ski0 tre

dbye ring / /rgyu mtshan bzhi bo spang bya tsam min la/ /des mthus blo 'das cha bzhi rgyu bzhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdzod ṭīka thar lam gsal byed las/ mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi bo de mi shes pa'i mun pa yin par bshad/ mi shes pa'i rgyu ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos zab cing phra ba dang / shes bya ring ba khams dang 'a4 ba dang skye gnas dang skye ba sogs rnam grangs shin tu mang ba rtogs dka' ba dang / yul shin tu thag ring ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum gyi bar chod pa lta bu'i yul dang dus thag ring ba/ bskal ba chags 'jig brgya stong gis bar chod pa'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / rnam pa'i ring ba ni/ shes bya'i dbye ba mtha' yas pa rtogs dka' ba'o/ /gang spel las/ rgyu rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ shes pa ring ba nyid dang / yul ring ba nyid dang / dus ring ba nyid dang / rab tu dbye ba ring ba nyid do/ /zhes rgyu bzhi'i grangs su sangs rgyas kyi chos zab cing phra ba ma bgrangs la/ rang 'grel las/ de dag la sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / yul dang dus shin tu bskal ba dang / zhes sangs rgyas kyi chos zab cing phra ba bgrangs pa'i stabs kyis 'dir yang bgrangs mod/ grangs dngos ni shes bya yul dus rab dbye'i bskal ba bzhi 'dren tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi chos zab cing phra ba ni/ri — 191

shes bya ring ba'i khongs su bsdu'o/ /mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi ste/mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan bzhi bo ni/ mi shes pa'i mun pha min te /de bzhi spang bya tsam yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhi'i mthu la brten nas yul bzhi blo las 'das pa ste mi shes pa bzho ni/ k+ṣiṃbazhi'i rkyen gyis mi shes pa bzhi'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /des na mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi ni/ mi shes pa'i mun pa ma yin pas mdzod ṭīka sogs kyis rgyu bzhi mi shes pa'i mun par bshad pa mi 'thad la/ 'dis rgyu bzhi nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i sgrib par 'dod pa yang mi 'thad par shes so/ /ngas ni 'azhi yi thar ba yi/ /sa bon gin tu phra ba dag /tshon nam do yi gseb na gser/ /bag la zha ba'i tshul gyis gzigs/ /dewār mardor gsungs / /zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos/ zab cing phra ba mi shes pa/dper na shā ri'i bus de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung bo la sogs pa mi shes pa lta bu dang / yul shin tu bskal bsu mi shes pa ni/ dper na mo'u 'gal gyi bus rang gi ma byang phyogar+sā 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten du skyes pa ma shes pa lta bu dang / dus shin tu bskal bas mi shes pa dper na shā ri'i bus khyim bdag dpal skyes la thar ba cha mthun gyi dge rtsa yod pa ma shes pa lta bu yin pas/ mdo las/ ngas ni sogs te ngas skyes bu 'di'i 192

thar ba'i dge rtsa'i sa bon shin tu phra ba 'di dag dapher na tshon rtsi'am rdo'i gseb na gser bag la zha ba ste/ mngon par mi gsal ba'i tshul du yod pa dag gzigs shing mkhyen pa yin no/ /zhes de skad du mdo las gsungs so/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /sgra gcan gyis/ rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig bu yi/ /rgyu yi dbye ba sna tshogs pa/ /kun mkhyen min pas shes bya min / /de mkhyen pas ni kun mkhyen stobs/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan bzhi'i nang nas/ rnam pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas pas mi shes pa ni/ gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin gyis/rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig pu yi/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gsungs/ don ni rma bya'i mdongs te de'i sgro gshog gi ri mo tshon mdangs sna tshogs pa de gcig pu'i rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa'i dbye ba rnams/ kun mkhyen te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma yin pas shes par bya ba ma yin la/ de lta bu mkhyen pas na kun mkhyen ye shes kyi stobs/ zhes bya'o/ /gtan du zhes pas khyad sge zhing / /rtogs pa phun tshogs shugs la bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing / /zhes pa'i gtan du zhes pas nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang bcom ldan 'das gnyis kyis nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs can ma 193

yin pa'i d+nghasgrib gnyis spangs pa 'dra yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gtan du spangs pa yin te/ slar rang rgyud la skye mi rung gi chos can du byas nas spangs pa yin la/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis kyis gtan du spangs pa ma yin te/nyams pa'i chos rtsen gyi dgra bcom pa yod pa'i phyir/ gong du bshad pa ltar mchod brjod kyi tshig 'dis spangs pa phun tshogs dngos su bstan nas / rtogs pa phun tshogs shugs la bstan te/ shes bya thams cad rtogs pa la sgrib pa'i sgrib pa gnyis ka spangs par bshad na/ shes bya thams cad rtogs pa shugs la go nus pa'i phyir/ dngos bstan drang bya lam zhugs te/ /thar cha'i dge rtsa smin gsungs phyir/ /rgyud bla dar ṭīka lam ma khyags/ /la yang thar cha'i dge rtsa bzhag /ces gsungs te/ skabs 'di'i+o dngos bstan gyi drang 'os kyi 'gro ba la lam zhugs dgos te/ de la thar ba cha mthun gyi dge rtsa smin pa zhig dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla dar ṭīka las lam ma zhugs la'ang thar ba cha mthun gyi dge rtsa bzhag mod/ de ni thar ba myang 'das thob pa'i dge rtsa tsam la dgongs sam dpyad/ rang lugs la tshogs lam nas 'jog par gsungs so/ /zag med shes rab gcor gyur pa'i/ /zag med phung po don 194

dmasmosngan/ / mas las 'byed la shes rab gartso/ /rjes 'brang bcas pa'i yin pa med/ /gzugs med phung 'o bzhi bar mchims/lke /gsungs kyang de na'ang zag med sdom/ /ldan langazus des brtsas min la/ /zag med gang du skyes pa'i yin/ /gsungs pa'i steng nas 'di la dbyad/ /ces gsungs te/ zag med kyi shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'i zag med kyi phung bo don dam pa'i chos mngon pa yin te/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa chos can/ phung bo lnga ba can yin te/ zag med kyi shes rab rjes 'brang ste 'khor du byas pa'i gzugs tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes lnga ba can yin pa'i phyir/ spyiri sems gtso dang sems byung 'khor yin mod/ chos rnam par 'byed pa la gtso sems las shes rab gtso ba'i phyir/ shes rab de spyir 'khor yin kyang / 'dir zag med kyi shes rab de byed las kyi sgo nas gtso bor bzhag pa'i phyir/ shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa don dam pa'i mngonazupa yin yang / shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i yin pa med de/ gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes lnga'i yin pa med pa'i phyir/ mchims mdzod las gzugs med kyi sgom byung ni phung bo bzhi ba yin te/ rjes su 'brang ba'i gzugs med 195

pa'i phyir ro/ /zhis gzugs sku'i phung bo bzhi bar mchims ṭīka las gsungs spyang / — de na zag med kyi sdom ba yod pas gzugs yod do/ /'on kyang zag med kyi sdom pa dang ldan yang /de'i sas bsdus min la/ zag med gang du skyes pa'i yin/ /gsungs pa'i steng nas 'di la dpyad na/ /gzugs med sas bsdus kyi zag med kyi sdom pa yod par rīthal/ gzugs med 'phags rgyud kyi de lod pa'i phyir ltam khyab/ khyab par thal/ zag med kyi sdom pa rten gang gis bsdus pa de'i yin pa'i phyir —te/ zag med gang du skyes pa'i yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyab ste/ zag med kyi lus ngag gi las kyis bsdu sa tshul tsam yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na b.ri chad med lam du gyur pa'i 'phags lam yan lag gi ngag sogs de ltar yin min dpyad ——dgos so/ /'di lawong sdom yod mod kyi/ /so b.ratsām pa dang 'gal te/ /de ni semaso rjes 'brang min phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la ste mi spyogs med kyi bar chad med lagagyi tshogaspopa na spogasdom yod mod kyi/ de ni so thar sdom ba dang 'gal te/ bsam gtan sdom pa dang zag med kyi sdom pa de la sesas kyi rjesa'abrang gis khyab la/ so thar gyi de la sems kyi rjes 'brang ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnas bzhi bar/ tha tsā96

oṃganyis ni sems rjes 'brang / /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis 'grub pa'i phyir/ thob byed tshogs spyor lam mngon pa/ /mthong lam byur pa'i thos bsam sgom/ /gsungs pa zhing rta'i yi ge nor/ /zhesagasungs te/ brdar btags pa'i chos mngoskopa de la/ lam mngon ba dang gzhung mngon pa gnyiyoyod pas/ dang bo ni/ don dam pa'i mngon pa thob byed kyi tshogs lam dang sbyor lam gnyis po brdar btags pa'i lam mngogapa yin no/ /chos mngon rin 'dren pa'i shing rta las/ kha cig rang 'bras don dam pa'i mngon pa thob byed kyi thabs yin na/ brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa yin pas khyab zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab chos can/der thal/ de'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa mtha' dpyod du'ang tshig zin ltar bkod mod/ de ni yi ge nor ba yin te/ bye smra'i lugs la/ mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga bo sgom byung yin pas/ma thong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum med pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sgom byung zhes pa yin no/ /sde bdun don kun ma brtsasakrang / /gces gartses bskus dzir de yi mdzod/ /yang na lde bdun 'azhi'i 'byung gnas/ /min phyir de la mdzod ces bya/ /zher+sāgasungs te/ mngon pa mdzod shā97

cesapa'i don ni bstan bcos mdzod rtsa 'dis/ mngon pa sde bdun gyi don kun te don thams cad bsdus pa min yang / mngon pa sde bdun po re re'i mngon pa gsum po'i gces gces rnamayo bstan bcos 'dir brjod bya'i don yang dag par bsdus pas na mngon pa mdzod ces bya'o/ /yang na mngon pa sde bdun la mdzod ces bya ste/ bstan bcos 'di'i tshig don gyi— mngon pa rnams 'byung ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ de la mdzod ces bya'o/ /'gro ba drangs phyir lde bdun ni/ /ston pa'i gsung bzhin bdag kyang bshad/ /bya yi rtsom pa kho na la/ /srur na ltag 'og 'brel med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ don ni/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba las drangs pa'i phyir du/ mngon pa sde bdun gyi don ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin du/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen bdag gis kyang bshad pa yin/ zhes 'grel bar bya yi rtsom pa kho na la sbyar na ltag 'og 'brel med du 'gyur te/ chos mngon mdzod kyi bstan bcos rab bshad bya zhes mngon pa sde bdun gyi don ni ston pa'i gsung bzhin bdag gis bshad par bya/ zhes pa dang ma 'brel bar 'gyur ro/ /ye shes la 'anug gartso bo ste/ /de dag nam mkha' snang skun sogs/ /bshad kyang bye smras mdor 'dod la/ /ma rangs pas ni lo zhes pa/ /bdun la ma rangs 198

mig jin gsungs/ /'on kyang don bkag de bkag 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ mngon pa sde bdun ni/ lha rje go cha'i sdom las/ ye shes la 'jug kā t+ya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig bshes kyis/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /chos kyi phung bo shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mo'u 'gal bus/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang bos byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ ye— shes la 'jug sde bdun gyi gtso bo'am dang bo yin la/ de dag las nam mkha' snang mun sogs bshad kyang / bye smras de dgasangs rgyas kyis thor bu thor bur gsungs pa dgra bcom bdun gyis bsdus pa yin pas mdor 'dod la/ slob dpon gyis dgra bcom pa'i ming can bdun gyis brtsams pa las mdo ma yin par 'dod stabs/ 'di ston pas gsungs zhes pa la ma rangs pa ste mi dga' ba'i tshig lo zhes smras so/ /kha cig lo zhes pa sde bdun la ma rangs pa'i tshig yin zer mod/ sde bdun gyi don bkag na de bkag par 'gyur bas sde bdun bkag pa mine te/ sde bdun bka' yin par 'dod pa la ma rangs pa'i tshig lo zhes smras pa dang / snang dang mun pa dag yin lo/ /zhes nam mkha' snang mun du 'dod pa la ma rangs pa'i zur za'i lo smras pa 6199

lta bu 'ga' zhig las/ sde bdun gyisnyebarjod don spyi la ma rangs pa'i tshig brjod pa ma yin pa'i khyad par 'byed dgos/ pa'i phyir/khas len mi mthun mang mod kyang / /skabs 'azhir blob dbon r+hasmra min/ /rje bdun byed po dgra brtsom lang / /min bar dpe ston kha cig 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di dag la khas len mi mthun pa mang bo yod mod spyang / — skabs 'dir slob dpon bye smra yin par 'dod dgos te/ mtha' dpyod las/skabs 'dir slob dpon sogs bye smrar byed dgos pa'i phyir/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sde bdun byed pa bo ste rtsom pa bo dgrabacom pa yang ma yin par dpe ston pa ste mdo sde ba kha cig gis kyang 'dod de/ mtha' dpyod las/ 'di'i grag ces pa mdo sde bas kyang dgra bcom pas byas par grags pa tsam du 'dod pa'i don yin te/ zhes dang / thub bstan byi dor las/ de'i phyir mdo sde bas kyang mngon pa sde bdun la sogs pa rtsom pa bo rnams 'phags pa ma yin par smra ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnas dang bo'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/gnyis pa brtswams pa'i gzhung gi brjod don gyi skabs kyi 200

sdom ni/ phung bo ma brtsas khams sogs kyis/ /bsnusat+pang kuzhe byang rim med phyir/ /ma bshad zag bcas zag med sbos1 /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir phung khams skye mched sogs kyi sgo nas mi 'chad par zag bcas zag med kyi sgo nas 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ chos thams cad phung bo sogs su mi 'du la/khams dang skye mched sogs su chos thams cad 'dus kyang / kun nyon dang rnam byang gi go rim med pa'i phyir de'i sgo nas ma bshad la/ 'dir kun byang gi go rim ston pa'i ched du/ zag bcas sngon dang zag med rjes su smras so/ /chos zhes bdag gnyis 'gog phyir ro/ /dmigs pa mtshungs ldan gnyis ka'i sgos/ /rgyas par ma nges dgra bcom mig /mtshungs ldan med spyang zag bcas te/ /gzugs can bcu dang rnam shes lnga/ / gcig spu sgom spangs nyid phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ zagabacas zag med de gnyis la chos zhes smos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/bdag dang bdag gi ba gnyis 'gog pa'i ched yin te/ gang spel las/ chos smos pas ni 'di ni chos tsam kho na ste/ 'di ni bdag gam bdag gi ba yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i snyir/ zag bcas la dmigs pa dang / mtshungs ldan 30/

gnyis ka'i sgo nas zag pa rgyas pa'i khyab pa ma nges te/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i mig de la mtshungs ldan med kyang zag bcaso yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs can bcu dang rnam shes lnga bo mtha' gcig tu sgom spang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skye rung tsam min 'gog lam lang / /mkha' la chags sdang mi skye yang / log par lta bra'i rnam pa mang / /sred pas bzung la gzhan 'byung rtse/ /gsher ba'i ras la rtsal bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te/mdo sde ba snga rabs pa kha cig zag pa gang la skye rung de zag bcas kyi don yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ 'gog lam gnyis kyang skye rung yin pas dmigs mtshungs gang rung gi sgo nas zag pa rgyas rung du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te skye rung tsam yin yang rgyas par mi 'gyur bas zag bcas ma yin pa'i phyir te/rang 'grel las/ de gnyis la rgyas par mi 'gyur bas de gnyis zag pa dang bcas pa nyid du thal ba med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' la chags pa dang sdang pa mi skye yang log par lta ba'i rnam pa yod de/ nam mkha' snang mun du 'dod pa lta bu yod do/ /sred pa ste 'dod chags kyis bzung ba la zag pa'am phra rgyas nyon mongs gzhan 'byung ste/ dper na gsher ba'i ras te ras rlon pa la rdul chags pa bzhin no/ /nyon mongs 203

mgo ba'i bdag snyed mtshungs ldan rnams/ /bdag rkyen dmegs sogs sgo nas zag dang 'dz+wal/ /'phen byed las ni sred pazhi zag pas bcings/ /gong mar zag pa'i sa bon rjes su 'brangs/ /de skyeng dmigs pa zag dang rje su rdzuthun/ /zag zad phung bo zag pa'i rgyu lus byudu / /zhes gsungs te/ zag pa'i sgo drug po ci rigs dang 'brel bas zag bcas su bshad pa'i drug ni nyon mongs rnams zag pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dang1/ nyon mongs dang mtshungs ldan rnamūs bdag rkyen dang dmigs pa sogs kyi sgo nas zag dang 'brel ba yin3/ 'phen byed las ni sred pa'i zag pas bcings pa yin3/ khams gong mar zag pa'i sa bon dang zag pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa4/ de skyed byed kyi dmig/sa pa zag pa dang rjes su mthun pa5/ zag pa zad pa'i rgyud kyi phung bo de zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba'o.a+yo/ /yang zag pa'i sgo drug ni/ zag pa'i bdag nyid/ zag pa dang 'brel ba/zag pas bcings pa/ zag pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ zag pa dang rjes su mthun pa/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba ste drugago /dang bo ni nyon mongs pa rnamasaso/ /gnyis pa ni nyon mongs dang mtshungs ldan rnams so/ /gsum pa ni 'phen byed kyi las so/ /bzhi ba ni khams gong ma dag go /lnga ba ni nyon mongs 203

skyed byed kyi dmishas pa dag zho /drug pa ni zag pa zad pa'i phung bo'o/ /rtog dang gnyen po min sog5 bshad pa mang / /zag med sku4can drutshapo dmigs pa'i sgos/ /zag bcas yin kyang jang dmigs sgos zag med/ /ces gsungs te/ de dalhartog gdang gnyen po ma yin pa sogs bshad tshul dang rtsod tshul mang ste/ 'dus ma byas gsum dang lam bden la dmigs pa'i cartog pa med na de la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs med dgos la/ de med na lam bden la dmigs pa'i the tshom yod pa mtha' dpyod las gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yod na log par lta ba'i rnam pa mang / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ log par lta ba yod na/ bdag tu lta ba yod dam med/ yod na lha ba dang sred pas bdag gir byas na zag bcas su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod mi nus te/zag pa rgyas par mi 'gyur phyir zag med yin te gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ zag med gong ma'i spyod yul min/ /bdag gir ma byas gnyen po'i phyir/ /zhes gnyen po yin par gsungs la/ sa gong ma la dmigs pa'i 'og ma'i nyon mongs kyis kyang gong ma rgyas par mi 'argyur te/ bdag gir ma byas shing gnyen po yin pa'i phyir zer/ yang 'ga' zhig gis/ 'dus ma byus gsum khams gong gi nyon mongs kyi gnyen po ma yin pa'i 204

phyir sogs bshad pa mang zhes pa'o/ /zag med kyi yul tsan drug ste/ 'gog pa mthong spang nyon mongs —gsum dang lam mthong spang nyon mongs gsugaste so sor lta ba dang the tshom dang ma rig pa ste drug po ni/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas zag bcas yin kyang /rang gi dmigs pa'i sgo nas zag med yin no/ /zag bca thob pa zag bcas kho na'i phyir/ khangs rgyas thohopa zagamed gsungs pa dgyad/ /so skyes 'gog gnyis thob pa zag bcaspote/ /spang bya min pa'i rnam gnyis 'dod gsungs phyir/ /zheyo gsungs te/ mtha' dpyod las/ zag bcas kyi thob pa la zagabyubacas kyis khyab kyang / zhes gsungs pas/ zag bcas kyi thob pa la zagartsobacas kho na sa khyab kyang / yang mtha' dpyod las/ lhag med myang 'das kyi thob pa dang sang 4rgyas kyi thob pa dang las bden gyi thob pa gsum zag bcas zag med gang rung ma yin pa'i phyi ra zer na mi 'thad de/ / de gsum zag med yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sangs rgyas kyi thob pa yang zag med yin par gsungs pa dpyad dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku sangs rgyas dkon mchog min yangasnyesangs rgyas yin par gsungs la/ de byang semasasbyor lam pa'i lus rten dang tshe gcig gis bsdus pa'i phyir sdug bden yin pas zag bcas yin 205

la/ des na de'i thob pa yang zag bcas yin dgos so/ /sangs rgya sa kyi thob pa zag med yin gsungs pa zad mi skye'i ye shes la dgongs sam snyam ste/ mtha' dpyod las/ der thal/ 'phags lam la brten nas 'thob dgos pa'i zag med kyi thob pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zag med kyi thob pa zag med kho na yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ zag med so sor brtags min gyi thob pa dang / so skyes so sor brtags 'gog gi thob pa gnyis zag bcas yin te/ rtsa ba las/ spang bya min pa'i rnam gnyis 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gnas mas rtsang 'das gcig pya bye brag pas/ /rtsal sogs 'gog byed lang sgra nges bzung don/ /drung rten skyes dang ma skyes 'gog pa'i phyir/ /khyad par bya ba'i dbang byas snas grub gsum/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dus ma byas rnam gsum yang ste/ /zhes pa'i yang sgra'i don yod de/ gnas ma bu bas 'dus ma byas myang 'das gcig pur smra ba dang / bye brag pas rdul phra rab sogs mang bor smra ba 'gag pa'i ched du rnam gsum dang yang sgra nges bzung gi tshig smras pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas gsum dngos po yin te/ don byed nus pa yin phyir te/ nam mkhas rlung rten pa'i don byed/ so sor brtags 'gog gis rang gi spang bya skye sa 206

zin 'das pa sogs 'gog pa'i don byed/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pas rang gi dgag bya ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can sogs 'gog pa'i don byed pa'i phyir/ de ltar rang rang gi don byed pa'i khyad par gyi bya ba'i dbang du byas nas dngos po rdzas su grub pa'i 'dus ma byas gsum bzhag go /nam mkhas 'gog med sems mthus gzhan 'gog grid/ /mchod sbyin ma'i mdor 'gog pa 'dra min gsungs/ /dzis tha dad kyang 'dra rgyu med la dgongs/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs can la yang mi sgrib par ma zad gzugs can gzhan gyis tshur mi sgrib pa'i rtag rdzas de nam mkha'i ngo bo yin/ zhes pa la/ kha cig gis/ sems dang sems byung la sogs pas phar sgrib pa dang tshur sgrib par mi byed pas rme nam mkhar thal lo zhe na/ nam mkhas gzhan 'gog pa med la/sems kyi mthus gzhan 'gog srid de/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i sems dang sems byung gi mthu las gzhan gyi 'gro sogs la gegs byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ mthong spang spangs pa'i 'gog pa la 'dra ba du ma yod par gsungs pa la/ kha cig gis/ 'dra ba medaskede/ mchod sbyin ma'i mdo las/ 'gog pa ni 'dra ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'gog pa dag rdzas tha dad mying rtag pa yin pas rang gi 'dra ba'i rgyurtsomed cing 'asgog pas 307

kyang chos gzhan gyi 'dra ba'i rgyu mi gyed pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ rkyen ma tshang ba brtags min kho na min/ /mi rtagalhams 'jug skye b.libaspo gtan gsum/ /'gog phyir skye la gtan smo sa gzhan sbyir gzhan/ /de dang brtags mimu rang ste 'gog pa lnga/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang gi dgag bya'i chos ma 'ongs pa skye ba la gtan tu gegs su gyur cing / bratshwab las gzhan pa'i 'gog pa de/ so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa'i mtshan nyid du bshad pa la/ 'o na rkyen ma tshang ba'i 'gog pa la so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pas khyab bam zhe na ma khyab ste/ mi rtag pa'i 'gog pa sogs lnga smod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mi rtag pa'i dang /snyoms 'jug gi dang / skye ba'i bsam gtan gyi dang —/so sor brtags pa'i dang / so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa dang lngar bshad pa'i phyir/ de'i nang nas mi rtag pa'i 'gog pa dang / snyoms 'jug gi 'gog pa dang / skye ba'i bsam gtan gyi 'gog pa gsum brtags min gyi 'gog pa yin pa ra 'gog pa'am gcod pa'i phyir du mtshan nyid kyi zur du skye la gtan du gegs byed pa zhes smras la/ 'gog pa gzhan so sor brtags 'gog gcod pa'i phyir matsan nyid kyi zur du gzhan zhes smras so/ /gong gi mi rtag snyoms 'jug skye ba'i bsam gtan gsum lha0byi

dang / so sor brtags 'gog ste bzhi bo de dadze+e/ brtagaso min gyi 'gog pa rang ste 'gog pa lnga'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /da lta'i zag bcas brtags 'gog gzhi/ /ma 'ongs ṣ+peskye'i zag med gzhan/ /gnyis ka yin pa rdom gsum rtse/ /gzhan rdugayeng ba'i dgra brtsom gyis/ /ma mthong 'gag 'gyur gartsags 'dzin mig /ngan 'gro'i skye ba rim bzhin te/ /skye la gtan du gegs bcas pa'i/ /skye ba su la ldan pa dpyad/ /rgyag car thob gzhi dgra bcom 'bras/ /thob ma thag pa'i mig dang ni/ /rdor ting tshe na skye rung la/ /gnyis par mi skye'i chos can du/ /'gyur nges rnams so rgyal sras mar/ /mthong thob spuyi nyon mongs pa/ /chen po'i gnyen po skyes pa na/ /nyon mongasazi chen po ma 'ongs pa'o/ /'gog gnyis cige car thob gsungs dbyad/ /ces gsungs te/ da lta'i zag pacas dang zag bcas 'das pa dang 'byung 'gyur rnams so sor brtags 'gog kho na thob pa'i gzhi yin la/ ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i zag med kyi chos te gzhan pa brtags min gyi 'gog pa kho na thob pa'i gzhi yin no/ /gnyis ko yin pa la rnam pa gsumartsoyogade/ sems gzhan du g.yeng ba'i dgra bcom gyis/ gzugs gzhan ma mthong zhing 'gag 'ahūṃr gyi gzugs 'dzin mig lta bu brtags 'gog sdon du thob nas/ rjes su chos de'i brtags min thob pa lta bu dang /209

den 'gro'i skye ba brtags min sngon dang brtags 'gog rjes su thob pa lta bu/ rim pa bzhin du brtags 'gog sngon du thob pa dang / brtags min sngon du thob pa'i mtshan gzhir 'jog go /skye la gtan du gegs bcas pa'i skye ba de gang zag su'i rgyud la ldan pa dpyad dgos gsungs te/ de ni skye ba yin pas rgyud kyis bsdus pa yin dgos/ des na mi skye ba'o chos can gyi gang zag gi rgyud la ldan zer dgos sam dpyad par bya ste/ ma ti sa ras sbyor lam bzod pa thob kha ma'i rgyud la 'jog pa 'dra ba zhig gsungs/ 'gog gnyis cig car thob pa'i gzhi la dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob ma thag pa'i mig dang / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshe na skye rung la skad cig gnyis par mi skye ba'i chos can du 'gyur nges rnams bzhag chog ste/ de rnams kyi 'gog pa gnyis cig car thob pa'i phyir/ rgyal sras ma las/ kha cig ni cig car te mthong bas thob pa'i nyon mongs pa chen po'i yang chen po'i gnyen po skyes pa na/— nyon mongs pa chen po ma 'ongs pa de dag gi so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa dang so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa cig car thob bo/ /zhes gsungs par dpyad dgos gsungs te/ nyon mongs chen po'i chin po ni nyon mongs skor dgu'i dang bo yin pas/ de spangs na'ang da dung 210

chen po'i 'bring dang / chen po'i chung ngu yang yod pas chen po spangs par mi 'gro la/ gzhan yang chen po'i yang chen po'i gnyen po skyes pa na/ bar chad med lam thob kyang / rnam grol lam ma thob na brtags 'gog thob par mi 'jog pa'i phyir/des na nyon mongs pa chen po'i gnyen po skyes nas rnam grol lam thob pa na/ nyon mongs pa chen po ma 'ongs pa de dag gi so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa dang / so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa cig car thob bo/ /zhes pa'i don yin par bshad na dgongs par e 'gro snyam/ yang du ma tshogs dgos phyir/ /byas pa'i steng du 'dus pa bsnan/ /'dus byas mdor rgyas rim pa'ang yin/ /mi skye rnams spyang der rung ste/ /lus gnas la yang 'o ma bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dus byas zhes byas pa'i sngon du 'dus pa bsnan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byas pa zhes pas rkyen gcig gis byas sam snyam pa mi khegs pas/ rgyu yang du ma zhig tshogs dgos pa go ba'i ched du byas pa'i steng du 'dus pa sngon du bsnan te/ 'dus zhes pa mdor bstan dang /byas zhes pa rgyas bshad yin pas/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad kyi rim pa'ang yin no/ /byas zin dang byed 'gyur dang dus la ltos pa'i mi skye ba'i chos can gyi byas pa gsum ga la 'dus byas 211
