zhis pa'i sgra 'jug pas/ mi skye ba'i chos can gyi byas pa rnams spyang 'dus byas su rung ste/ dper na/ bzhos na dabhā 'jo bzhin pa dang 'arjothu'agyur lus la gnas pa'i 'o ma la yang rdzo ma'i sgra 'jug pa bzhin no/ / gotam gzhi gtamo gyi rgya mi don/ /gzhi bcas gesmras rgyu tsami la/ /pashad ba 'der rung sbyir min te/ /gzhi lngas ga dzhad cing gosung rab las/ /ngo bo nyid dmigs kun spyor dang / /thu dang yongs bzung gzhi lnga'ang bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dus byas spyi'i ming gi rnam grangs skabs su/ rtsa ba las/ de dag nyid dus gtam gzhi dang / /nges par 'byung bcas gzhi dang bcas/ /zhes 'dus byas rnams la dus zhes bya ste/ song ba dang 'gro ba dang 'gro ba'i phyir dang mi rtag pa nyid kyis zad pa'i phyir/ 'dusabyas de rnams la gtam gyi gzhi rizhes bya ste/ gtam ni ngagadheste tshig du ma 'dus pa yin la/ 'di'i gzhi ni rgyu la go dgos pas/ 'dus byas kun gtam gyi rgyu yin pa'i don yin te gtam rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ 'di yi gzhi bcas bye smras rgyu tsam la 'dod pa skabs 'dir rung mod spyir rung ba min te/bhespyir gzugs kyi gzhi sogs gzhi lnga bshad pas gnod cing /spusung rab las gzhi lnga bshad pa'i phyir te/ ngo bo nyid da nga / 212

dmigs pa dang / kun tu sbyor ba'am ldan pa dang / rgyu dang /yongs su bzung ba dang lnga bshad pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi ni chos gang thob pa de dang ldan pa lta bu dang / dmigs pa'i gzhi ni chos thams cad shes pa lta bu dang / kun sbyor ram ldan pa'i gzhi ni chags sdang dang ldan pa lta bu dang / rgyu'i gzhi ni 'dus byas thams cad lta bu dang / yongs su 'dzin pa'i gzhi ni zhing gi gzhi dang khyim gyi gzhi dang zong gi gzhi lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas rnams gtam gyi gzhi min te/ gtam gyi rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas rnams la nges par 'byung bcas zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lhag med myang 'das la ltos nas lam bden sogs 'dus byas thams cad skabs 'di'i mya ngan yin pas nges par 'byung ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na lam bden chos can/ spang bya yin par thal /skabs 'di'i mya ngan yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags gyub ste/lhag med la ltos nas rgyun ldog dgos pa'i 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ lta gnas don ni gang spel— las/ /dus kun pa dang thams cad la/ /rnam grangs med dang mi g.yo ba/ /lta yin de phying chags sogs dang / /ma rig pa dang the tshom min/ /zhes so / /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa ming gi rnam grangs kyis 3/3

dbye ba'i skabs/ rtsa bar/ gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /phung bo'ang de dag 'thab bcas kyang / sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rten dang / /lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhes pa ltar zag bcas kyi rnam grangs yod de/ nyer len gyi phung bo dang / 'thab bcas dang / sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'jig rten dang / lta gnas dang / srid pa ste bdun no/ /zag bcas rnams la/ nyer len zhes byatshuste—/ rang rgyu nyon mongs pa de dag gi nyer len las byung ba'i phyir/ dper na/ rtswa las byung ba'i me la rtswa me zer ba dang /rang 'bras nyer len nyon mongs pa rnams 'byung bas kyang nyer len zhes brjod de/ dper na/ rgyal bo la rag lus pa'i mi la rgyal bo'i mi dang / me tog skyed pa'i shing la me tog gi shing zhes brjod pa ltar ro/ /zag bcas kyi phung bo de dag la 'thab bcas zhes kyang bya ste/ khyod la brten nas rang gzhan la dmigs pa'i lus ngag gi 'theb mo 'byung ba'i phyir/ de dag la sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal gsum po gang rung dang 'brel zhing / 'phags pa rnams dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ de la kun 'byung zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal phyi ma skyed pa'i phyir/ de la 'jig rten zhes bya ste/ skad cig gis 'jig cing gnyen pos 314

dzong 'jig pa'i phyir/ de la srid pa zhes bya ste/ sdugacibasngal dang kun 'byung gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i phyir/ de la lta gnas zhes bya ste/ khyod la lta ba rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir /gang spel gyi tshig gi don ni/ lta ba ni zag bcas kyi dngos po thams cad la/ dus thams cad kyi tshe na/ rnam grangs te dbye ba med par/ mi g.yo ba ste brtan par 'dzin pa yin la /'dod chags dang khong khro dang nga rgyal ni nyon mongs pa rang gi mtshan nyid pa yin pas thams cad la ma yin te/ 'dod chags ni yid du 'ong ba dang / khong khro ni yid du mi 'ong ba darnga /nga rgyal ni yon tan du dmigs pa la brten pa yin pas thams cad la min la/ dus thams cad pa yang min te/ gang la de skyes ma spangs pa'i/ /zhes pa ltar/ skyes pa ste mngon du gyur pa dang ma gyur pa'i skabs du ma yod pa yin la/ ma rig pa ni dus thams cad kyi tshe yin yang / rnam grangs med pa ra phyogs gcig tu ni ma yin te/ 'dod chags la sogs dang mtshungs par ldan pa rnams 'dod chags la sogs pa bzhin du so sor rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /the tshom la ni khyad chos gzhan yod kyang brtan par 'dzin pa'am mi g.yo ba med do/ / dbyubam 'a gi gye zag la/ /kha dog dbye ba dgos dbang ngo //315

lag pa'i za sgra zin ma zin/ /gnyis 'dod kun btus dang mthun lang / /'dir bkag 'on kyang gling bu'i sgra/ /zin ba'i mi ston snyan gsungs dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ dbyibs 'dijini/ dbyibasakyi bye brag gzugs kyi skye mched du gyur pa las/ dbyibs spyi 'dren pa min te/ dbyibs la gzugs kyi skye mched ma yin pa reg bya'i skye mched du gyur pa'i ring bo la sogs pa dbyibs brgyad yod de/ rang 'grel las/ dbyibs su yod la/ kha dog tu med pa yang yod de/ ring bo la sogs pa'i phyogs gcig go /zhes dang / gang spel las/ ring bo la sogs pa'i phyogs gcig zhes pa ni/ ring bo dang thung ngu dang lham pa dang skumu po dang mthon po dang dma' ba dang phya le ba dang phya le ba ma yin pa rnams kyi phyogs gcig go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha dog la dbye ba byas pa ni dgos pa'i dbang gi yin te/ 'dir gzugs kyi skye mched nyi shu gsungs pa'i nang du ljang khu dang / chu dang me dang ka ba dang bum pa la sogs pa ma 'dus so zhe na/ de dag ni rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi dang dbyibs brgyad kyi nang du 'du bas skyon med do/ /'o na sprin la sogs pa yang de dag tu 'du bas logs su ci'i phyir drangs zhe na/ de ni dogs pa bzlog pa'i ched yin te/ sprin dang du ba dang rdulu dang khug sna rnams ni 216

'jig rten pas jos su ma grub pas med do snyam pa'i dogs pa bzlog pa dang / grib ma dang snang ba dang mun pa dang nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhi ni 'jig rten pas/ sa gzhi la sogs pa las logs su ma grub bo snyam pa'i log rtog bzlog pa'i dgos pa'i dbang gis logs su dbye ba byas so/ /kha cig zin ma zin gnyis ka'i sgra lag pa'i rdza rnga lta bur 'dod pā/ kun btus dang mthun yang / mdzod kyi skabs 'dir bkag ste/ 'bras bu'i gzugs gcig 'byung ba bzhi tshan gnyis la brten pa mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang rnga dang lag pa gnyis ka las 'byung ba de dag ni/ rkyen tsam yin par 'dod kyi rten ni ma zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po yin no zhes 'dod do/ /'on kyang / mtha' dpyod las/ dang bo grub ste/ skyes bus glu len pa dang skyes bus tshig rtsub smra ba dang / skyes bus gling bu 'bud pa dang /khu tshur gyi sgra bzhi lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gling bu'i sgra de zin pa'i mi ston pa'i snyan pa'i sgra yin par gsungs pa dpyad/gsungs pa ni/ rnga sgra de rnga dang lag pa gnyis ka 'byung ba de rkyen tsam yin gyi/ rten ni ma zin pa'i 'byung ba yin gsungs pa ltar na/ 'dir mchu dang gling bu gnyis rkyen tsam yin gyi rten ma zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po yin pa 'dra ba'i phyir zer na/217

ngo rdung tshi/ lag pa rnga dbyug gnyis ka rkyen tsayoyin la/rnga'i khog pa ni sgra 'byung b.li'abyung ba yin pas gling bu'i sgra 'byung ba'i 'byung ba ni mchu dbugaṣ+kabacas dang / lagapa mdzub modang 'grel ba'i gli nga bu yin pas/ zin pa'i 'byung bar bzhag chog pa e yin snyam mo/ /ston pa rnam rig gsung gartsor dgongs/ /mchims ṭīka phrad pa med gsungasakyang / /bkres skom ma gtogaspolnga char yod/ lngab gis gzhal med so sor dgongs/ / dkar sogaspomatshan nyid ring sogs gnas/ /gzugs khams nyer smrakyagabatus gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/rang 'grel las/ sems can du ston pa ṣ+ka rnam par rig byed kyi sgra'o/ /zhes sems can du ston pa'i sgra ngag gi rnam par rig byed kyi sgrar gsung ba gtso bo la dgongs te/ sems can du ston pa'i sgra yin na/ ngagaka rnam par rig byed yin pas ma khyab ste/ chos bsgrags pa'i lha'i rnga sgra dang / sprul bas chos 'chad pa'i sgratresogs yod par gsungs pa'i phyir/ mchims ṭīka las/ yul tha ma gsum po dag ni dbang bo dang phrad nas 'dzin pas/yul gcig gis rnam shes du ma phyed pa med de/ gang gcig dang 'phrad pa'i yul thogs bcas yin pas / de gzhan gyi dbang bo dang mi 'phrad pa'i phyir dang / ma bod na ni de'i rnam shes mi 218

skye ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes yul gcig gis rnam shes du ma skyed pa med de/ gcig dang 'phrad pa'i yul de gzhan gyi dbang bo dang 'phrad pa med gsungasakyang / bkres skom ma gtogs pa'i reg bya bdun gyi lhag ma 'jam rgyub lci yang grang ba lnga bos rnam shes du ma skyed pa yod de/ dper na/ rtsub pa lta bus bde sdug gnyis skyed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gdags pa las/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi dpag bsam gyi shing gi gos ni srang gi bzhi cha'i bcu drug cha 'jal gyi de yan chad gzugs na spyod pa rnams kyi gos dag nicimi 'jal lo zhes gzugs khams kyi lha'i gos lci yang srang gis gzhal rgyu med par gsungs pa lha so so'i gos gzhal rgyu med pa la dgongs pa yin gyi/ lha so so'i gos mang bo bsags na srang gis 'jal rgyu yod gsungs so/ /kun btus las/ gzugs kyi skye mched nyer lngar bshad de/ mtshan nyid dang / gnas dang / phan gnod dang / byed pa'i rten dang / byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang / rgyan dang drug gi sgo nas dbye ba lta bu yin te/ mtshan nyid las/ dkar bo sogayortsa ba'i kha dog bzhi dang / gnas las/ ring bo dang thung ngu dang lham pa dang thum po dang / rdul phra mo dang rdul rags pa dang phya le ba dang phya le ba ma yin pa dang mthon 219

po dang dma' ba'i bar bcu dang / phan gnod las/ grib ma dang nyi ma dang snang ba dang mun pa dang sprin dang du ba dang rdul dang khug sna'i bar brgyad dang / byed pa'i rten las/ mngon par skabs yod pa dang / byed pa'i mtshan nyid las/rnam par rig byed dang / rgyan las/ nam mkha' kha dog gcig pa bzhag pa'i phyir/ de ltar gzugs khams nyer lnga bo 'di ni kun btus las gsungs so/ /rnam rig min gzugs mtshan nyid par/ /'dod pa bye smra thal 'gyur ba/ /rang kun spong ba'i sems gzhan rig byed min/ /rang gi tha snyad 'jug pa gzugs gzhan la/ /rag las khyad par bzhi ldan chos skye mched/ /gzugs dang byed pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa de/ /rnam rig byed min don no khrad par lnga/ /dus kyi khyad par g.yeng dang sems med kyang / /dzo bo'i khyad par dge dang mi dger nges/ /rgyun gyi khrad par rgyun mchog rjes 'brel te/ /rgyu yi khrad par 'byung bzhi rgyur byas so/ /mig dang rig byed thob pa rim bzhin gcod/ /nges tshig khrad par rnam rig byed min brjod/ /brjod ces rang nyid gzugs su mi 'dod ston/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs te/gzugs mtshan nyid pa yin par 'dod pa/ bye brag smra ba dang /thal 'gyur ba gnyis yod la/ mdo sems rang rgyud pa gsum gyis 22pyi

rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs de gzugs mtshan nyid pa ma yin par 'dod do/ /de'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang kun nas slong ba'i sems gzhan gyis rig byed ma yin pa yang yin/ rang gi tha snyad 'jug pa gzugs gzhan la rag las pa'i khyad par bzhi ldan gyi chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs dang byed pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa de/ rang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par lnga dang ldan te/ khyad par dang bo gnas skabs te dus kyi khyad par ni/ sems g.yeng ba dang sems med pa'i skabs dang der ma zad/ sems ma g.yeng ba mnyam bzhag gi dus su yang gang zag de'i rgyud la 'byung ba'i phyir te/ rtsa bar/ g.yeng dang sems med pa yi yang /zhes byung / khyad par gnyis pa ngo bo'i khyad par ni/ dge ba dang mi dge ba gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar/ dge dang mi dge zhes so/ /khyad par gsum pa rgyun gyi khyad par ni/ rgyun mchog tu gyur pa rjes su 'brel ba ste/ rtag tu rgyun dang ldan pa'o/ /rtsa bar rjes 'byel gang / zhes so/ /khyad par bzhi ba rgyu'i khyad par ni/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi ci rigs kyi skyed rten gnas ston 'phel ba'i rgyur byas pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ 'byung ba che rnams 321

rgyur byas pa/ zhes so/ /khyad par gnyis pha dang gsum pa dang bzhi ba rnams kyis/ mig dang lus kyi rnam par3ga byed dang dge mi dge'i thob pa rim bzhin gcod de/ gnyis pa'i skab sa su/ rgyal sras ma las/ 'a/dis ni mig la sogs pa yang bsal ba ra rigs par bya'o/ / zhes dang / gsum pa'i skabs su rgyal sras ma las/ khyad par gsum pa 'dis lus kyi rnam par rig byed sogs de yin pa gcod de/ zhes dang / bzhi ba'i skabs su/ rang 'grel las/ thob pa'i rgyun yang 'di lta bu yod pas bye brag tu bya ba'i phyir 'byung ba che rnams rgyur byas pa zhis brjod do/ /zhes so/ /khyad par lnga ba nges tshig gi khyad par ni/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs zhes brjod ces pa ste/ rtsa bar/ de ni rnam rig byed min brjod/ /ces brjod gsungs pa'i dgos ba ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen rang nyid kyis/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs de gzugs mtshan nyid snapa yin par mi 'dod par ston to/ /gang gis brjod na slob dpon 'dus bzang gis gzugs yin par brjod/ ces pa'i don no/ /mtshan nyid kyi zur du khyad par bzhi ldan gyi gsungs pa'i khyad par bzhi ni/ khyad par lnga'i dang bo bzhi yin la/ khyad par bzhi ba'i skabs su/ rang gi rgyur 32lha

gyur pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi ci rigs kyis skyed rten gnas rten 'phel ba'i rgyu byed gsungs pa'i/ dang bo/ rang 'bras 'byung 'gyur skyed pa'i rgyu byed/ gnyis pa/ rang 'bras 'byung 'gyur gyi rten pa'i rgyu byed de/ dper na mkhar gzhong la rgya shug bzhin no/ /gsumapa/ rang 'bras 'byung 'gyur gyi gzhi yin te/ dper na/ ri mo'i gzhi rtsigs pa sa byas pa bzhin no/ /bzhi ba/ de rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rgyu yin te/dpe ra na/ mar me'i 'od dang mar me bzhin no/ /lnga ba/rgyu de skyes pas khyod la brten pa'i 'byung 'gyur yang 'phel batshi phyir ro/ /skabs 'azhir skyon drurge 'dus bzang gis/ /dze+ezhi la ma tshang bstan brtsos 'gal/ /nyams dang de min de nyidadzol/ /0nga sgra lhag brjod khrad par du/ /spyub khrad par ma byas so/ /zhe—sa te rig min dang bo ni/ /rgyun min mtshan nyid ma tshang skyon/ /rgyun ni sa su ma grub phyir/ /rig min snas grub bshad bar 'gal/ /g.yeng dang sems med kho na'i na/ /sems bcas skabs kyi rig midz+wanyams/ /rjes 'brel zhes pas ma g.yeng dang / /sems bcas brtsas na rig byed so ges/ /delgen pa lang de ru thal/ /sems bcas g.yeng bas brtsas ba'i phroṃr/ /'grebla ba'i yang sgra gcig lhag go /bstan med thogs mede ces bya ba'i/ /223

khrad par ma sbyar skyon yang 'anug /ces gsungs te/ chos mngon smra ba'i rtog ge'i dbang bo slob dponabyu'adus bzang gis — skabs 'dir skyon drug brjod de/ 'di la ma tshang zhes ba nas/bya ba khyad par ma byas so/ /zhes pa'i bar sho lo ka gcig po de 'dus bzadz+wagi dgag tshig lung drangs pa yin la/ zhes te rig min dang bo ni zhes pa man chad lung de'i don bshad pa yin la/ de'i tshul ni/ skyon dang bo/ rig min skad cig dang bo rgyun ma yin pas/ mtshan nyid ma tshang ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir zer/ de la slob dpon dbyig gnyen rjes 'brang dang bcas pas lan 'debs tshul ni/ rig min skad cig dang bo rgyun ma yin par rtags ma grub ste/ri skad cig dang bo gnyis pa sogs bsags pa rgyun du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na rgyun mi srid par thal lo gsungs/ skyon gnyis pa/ de ltar rgyun yin byas pa la rgyun yin na/ rgyun rdzas su ma grub pa'i phyir/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs rdzas grub tu bshad pa'i bstan bcos dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ zer/ de la lan 'debs tshul ni/ bstan bcos dang mi 'gal te/ skad cig ma mang bo rgyun du 'jog dgos la/ de lta na de'i skad cig re re la rgyun du byed dgos pa'i rdzas yod dang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa 224

min pa mi 'jig pa'i phyir/ gsungs/ skyon gsum pa ni/ g.yeng ba dang sems med pa'i skabs kho na bshad pas/ ma g.yeng ba dang mnyam bzhag sems bcas kyi gnas skabs kyi rnam rig ma yin pa ma bsdus pas nyams par gyur pa'i phyir/ zer/ de la lan 'debs tshul ni/ sems bcas skabs kyi de ma bsdus par rtags ma grub ste/ g.yeng dang sems med pa yi yang / /zhes pa'i yang sgras g.yeng ba dang sems med du ma zad/ ma g.yeng ba'i dang sems bcas kyang sdud pa'i phyir/ gsungs/ skyon bzhi ba ni/ rjes 'brel zhes pas ma g.yeng ba dang sems dang bcas pa bsdus /na/ dge mi dge'i rig byed sogs rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ma yin pa dag kyang / rnam rig min pa'i gzugs su thal lo/ /zer/ de la lan 'debs tshul ni/ g.yeng ma g.yeng gi sems dang sems med du'ang 'jug pa yang sgras bstan pas rnam par rig byed der thal ba'i skyon mi yong ste/ rnam par rig byed ni srems bcas kyi skabs kho nar 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ gsungs/ skyon lnga ba ni/rang 'grel las/ sems g.yeng ba zhes pa ni de las gzhan pa'i sems kyi yang yin pa'o/ /sems med pa'i yang / zhes yod pa'i sems med pa'i yang / zhes pa'i yang sgra 'di lhag par ཿ25

brjod pa yin te/ sems dang bcas pa ni sems g.yeng ba zhes pas bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'grel bar yang sgra gcige lhag pa'i phyir te/ yang sgratshugong ma/ gong gi sems kyi yang yin ba 'o/ /zhes pa'i yang sgra des chog pa'i phyir/ zer/ de la lan 'debs tshul ni/ rtsa bar/ yang sgra gcig las med kyang 'grel ba las yang sgra skabs gnyis kar sbyar dgos par bstan pa'i ched tsam skyi yin pa'i phyir/ gsungs/ skyon drug pa ni/ bstan du med cing thogs pa med pa'i gzugs zhes bya ba'i khyad par ma bstan pa'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bya ba khyad par du ma byas so/ /zer/ de la lan 'debs tshul ni/ de'i khyad par yin tshad thams cad 'dir brjod mi dgos shing thogs pa med pa'i khyad par 'og tu bshad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsungs/ de sbyir rang gi 'dod pa ni/ /byas pa dang lang cha'adra ba'i/ /sems ba'ang sems med pa la gang / /lung bstan thogs pa med ba'i gzugs/ /de ni rnam rig byedasmon 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ slopa dpon 'dus bzang gis/ 'byig gnyen gyi mdzod kyi bstan bcos su rnam rig ma yin pa'i gzugs kyi don bshad pa mi 'thad pa de'i phyir 'dus bzang rang gi 'dod pa ni/ dbyig gnyen gyis byas pa dang mi 'dra bar/ sems 226

dang ldan pa la'ang yod la/ sems med pa la yod pa gang zhigadage mi dge gang rung du lung du bstan pa'i thogs pa med pa'i gzugs de ni/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su 'dod do/ /zhes pa'o/ /ce na skyon dgayod min te / /mtsho bzhin dang po'angasgyu na ldan yin/ /rgyun yang sbyi tsam btags yod yin/ /ma g.yeng sems bcas yang sgras rtsad/ /rig byed bems bcas kho nar 'byung / /gang zag gnyis phyir mang sgra rganyis/ /chos kun 'desabasngod ga la dgos/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dus bzang gis gzhan dgag pa dang / rang lugs de ltar 'dod/ ce na 'dus bzang gis brjod pa'i skyon de dag yod pa min te/ dang bo/ rgyun min pas ma tshang ba'i phyir zerawā mi 'thad de/ mtsho bzhin du rigamin skad ci ga dang bo'ang rgyun yin te skad cig snga phyi bsagasapa rgyun yin pas rgyun ldan yin no/ /gnyitshos pa/ rgyun yin na rgyun rdzas su ma grub pas bstan bcos dang 'gal ba'i skyon med de/ rgyun yang spyi tsam btags yod yin kyang / bye brag rdzas yod yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa/ g.yeng ba dngatshosems med tsam las ma bsdus pas nyams pa'i skyon med de/ ma g.yeng ba'i sems dang bcas pa yang sgrus sdud pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba/ rjes 'grel zhes pas ma 327

g.ying ba dang soms bcas bsdus na rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs sogs rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs rma yin pa ma yin pa dag du kyang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su thal ba'i skyon med de/ rig byed ni sems rbecas kho nar 'byung ba'i phyir/ lnga ba/ sems dang bcas pa g.yengo dang zhes bas bsdus ltabs/'grel ba'i yang sgra gcig lhag pa'i skyon med de/ ma g.yeng ba dang / de min sems bcas kyi gang— —zag gnyis yod phyir yang sgra gnyis brjod pa'i phyir/ drug pa/ bstan med thogs med ces bya ba'i khyad par ma sbyar ba'i skyon med de/ khyad chos kun 'dir brjod ga la dgos te mi dgos so/ /lan rnams dkyus su bkod yod mod 'dir sdom gyi tshig 'bru gnyer ba'i phyir du slar yang bkod pa yin no/ /gabeng— dang sems med pa yi mang /zer bzhin rtsa bar bems med sngon/ /yang sgra med zer 'gal ba ste/ /dang lang kyang 'ang don gcig sbyir/ /zhes gsungs te/bod kyi yig cha rtsom mkhan kha cig gis/ g.yeng dang sems med pa yi yang / /zer bzhin du tshig de la ṭīk+ka mdzad cing / rtsa bar sems med ces pa'i sngon du yang sgra med zer ba nang 'gal ba ste/ dang yang kyang 'ang rnams kyi don gcig yin pa'i phyir/de rnams kyi skad dod la'ang tsa 'byung ba mang ba'i phyir/ khyod kyi 3lha8

ṭīk+ka byed stangs ltar/ g.yeng dang / zhes pa'i dang sgra de yang sgra'i don yin pas/ sems med pa yi zhes pa'i tshig gi sngon du yang sgra yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ / rgya che gtos )che tha gru che/ /sa sogs khams bzhi 'jig rten na/ /'byung gsum kha dog dbyibs la bshad/ /drung ni gsung rab las 'byung bzhin/ /g.yo ba'i khams kyi reg byar bshad/ /sngar bzhin kha dog dbyibs la yang / /zhes gsungs te/ 'byung ba bzhi la/ 'byung ba chen po zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyab che bas rgya che/ rten pas gtos pa che/ gnas pa tha gru che bas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ sa la sogs pa ste/ sa chu me rlung ste/ 'byung bzhi'i khams bzhi ni reg bya yīn la/ 'jig rten gyi grags tshod ltar na/ de dag ni kha dog sogs kyi khyad par la bshad de/ 'byung ba dang bo gsum ni kha dog dang dbyibs tshogs pa la bshad tshul ni/ sa kha dog ser bo dbyibs gru bzhi la sa zhes brjod pa de bzhin du me yangag kha dog dmar bo dbyibs gru gsum dang / chu ni kha dog dkar bo dbyibs rlum po dang / rlung ni gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin du g.yo ba'i khams kyi reg byar bshad de/ 'jig rten na lus la rlung reg go zhes bya bar grags la/ sngar sa la229

sogs par brjod patshude— bzhin du kha dog dang dbyibs la'ang bshad de/ rlung yang kha dog sngon po dbyibs blo gam la 'jog par grags mod/ reg byar gyur pa'i sa chu me rlung gicatshogs bzhi bo la sa sogasakhakyi kha.oṃsa'iṣ+ṭhad du 'jog pa'i phyir/ bye smras tshogs par 'byung bzhi bzhag /daza stonatshus bo naji tshul du 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ bye brag smra bas rdul rdzas rnams tshogs pa go 'byung ba zhes brjod par 'dod la/ bye smra'i sde bco pargyad kyi nang gi dpe ston pas/ dngos po thams cad kyi tshogs par 'byung blo rnams ni sa bon gyi tshul du yod par 'dod do/ /khams ni rgyu mi dodzha yin mab / /'dir khams de de yin pa dgos/ /kun btusakhade la su bzhi bshad/ /ces ga sungs te/ khams kyi —don ni/ rang 'grel las/ de la 'a byungatshoganas dag ni rigs zhes rgyad+kun/ zhes pa ltar rgyu yi don dzin yang / skabs 'dir mig nyid mig gicakhams yin pa dang / sa nyid sa'i khams yin pa bzhin du khamasatrenyid de dang de yidz+wapa dgosate/ skabs 'dir khams don dngos po de yang yin kha/ mas kyang yin papyigacig khams sa'ajog dgos me'i phyir/ kun btusalas/ mig dang —mig gi khams la mu bzhi bshad de/ mig yin la mig gi khams ma yin pa/ dgra bcom pa'i mig tha ma dang / mig gi khams 230

yin lo mig ma yin pa ni sgo nga'i nang 'dug pa dang / nur nur bor gyur pa dang / mer mer bor gyur pa dang / nar nar bor gyur pa dang / mi'i mngal na— gnas pa'i mig ma dod pa rnams 'jog par gsungaske / gnyis ka yin pha rgyun phyi ma yod pa'i mi'i mig 'jog bzhi ba sla/tsho 'a ཿni khadzas sa bon la 'jog pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /tshung lab phyong ba man mi dgos/ /mtshan mar 'dzin lang mtshan 'dzirke mirna/ /de ni bdag 'jirdo yilha pyir jo/ /zhes gsungs te/ kha cigazitshor ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems dang rīsems byungabirnamasakhachos can/ myong ba yin par thal/ rang yul myong ba'i phyir na mjikhyabajiste/ myong yang myong ba yin mi da gos— te/ myong ba yin na tshor ba yin dgos pa'ijiphyir/yang kha cig mig shes su rgyur pa'i 'du shes chos can/ mtshan —'dzin yin phar thal/ rang yul gyi rmatshan ma 'dzin pa'i blo dzin pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyar+pā ste/ mtshan mar 'dzin yang mtshan 'a dzin minate/ mtshan 'dzin ni bdag 'dzin yin rmopa'i phyir/mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan ma lahwa/nga zag gi bdag tshodang rtag gcig lta bu sogs dgos la/ 'a du shes kyi mtshanartsom ni thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos tsam gyis chog pa'i phyir/ sngobe+e gyi skal ldan khyad par can/ /bems gcug las gzhan bems zung sogs/ /med 231

de zid pa 'pho ba'i mdor/ /semasanyad gnyis su snang ba rtse/ /de bzhin chags sogs snang ba 'am/ /dad la sogs par snang bar 'dod/ /nyon mongs dge chos yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngon gyi skal ldan khyad par can na re/ sems sems byung gcige tu 'dod de/ sems gcig pu sems dang sems byung tha dad sogs su tha dad du snang yang / tha dad du ma grub pa'i phyir te/srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo las/ sems nyid gnyis su snang ba ste/ / de bzhin chags sogs snang ba 'am/ /dad la sogs pa snang bar 'dod/ /nyon mongs dge chos yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer mod/ 'di ni ngo bo tha dad med pa'i khungs yin gyi sems gcig las med pa'i don ma yin no/ /btsun pa r+pā dza thas ne/ /sems byung tshor 'du gnyis su 'dod/ /phung bo'i don ma shes pas nongs/ /zhes gsungs te/ btsun pa rā dza shrī na re/ sems byung la tshor ba dang 'du shes gnyis kho nar nges te/ de gnyis phung bo re byas pas sems las tha dad kyang gzhan rnams sems kyi gnas skabs la btags pa yin no zer/ 'di ni tshor 'du phung bo re byas pa'i rgyu mtshan ma shes pas nongs so/ /btsun pa ku mā mā dza ni/ /tshor 'du reg sems bzhi tsam smra/ /de dag mi 'thad bsku ba las/ /lnga nyid 'thad pa 232

— da sbyir dang / /de yi gnas skabs skyon sbyir dang / /byed bye brag med phyir dang / /lung dang 'gal bar 'gyur phyir ro/ /zhes te phung bo lnga bo mi 'thad dang / /byed pa gzhan phyir tha dad thal ba dang / /gcig la gnas skabs gnas skabs can lang 'gal/ /sems dang gcig phyir bems byung dge mi dges/ /yul dbang sogs rgyu 'dra phyir 'bras khyad med/ /chags pas bems nyon mongs byas lung 'gal lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ btsun pa ku mā rā dza na re/ tshor 'du reg pa sems pa bzhi ni sems las tha dad pas/ sems byung ni de bzhi tsam yin zhes smra la/gong gi skal ldan khyad par can gyis sems gcig pu las sems byung med par 'dod pa dang / btsun pa rā dza shrīs sems byung tshor 'du gnyis su 'dod pa dang / 'di gsum mi 'thad de/'phags pa thogs med kyis rnam par gtan la babs pa bsdu ba las/ lnga nyid 'thad pa med phyir dang / /zhes sogs gsungs te/ de'i don ni de ltar na tshor ba la sogs pa sems las gzhan du med na/ phung bo lnga bo mi 'thad par thal ba dang / sems kyi gnas skabs la tshor ba la sogs par btags par 'dod na/sems dang tshor ba la sogs pa la mtshan nyid dang byed pa tha dad yod pas dngos po tha dad du thal ba dang / sems sems byung lha33

gcig yin na/ gnas skabs dang gnasangaskabs can gyi dbye ba mi 'thad pas 'gal ba dang / sems gyung rnams sems dang gcig yin na/ dgomi dge rnams kyi dbang bo dang yid byed sogs byed rgyu 'dra ba ste khyad par med pas 'bras bu la'ang bzang ngan med par la ba dang / sado las/ 'dod chags kyis kun nas nyon mongs par byed do/ /zhes chags pas sems nyon mongs par byas par gsungs pa'i lung dang 'gal lo/ /baspru ba'i lung 'a3sa 'khral nas sems sems byung / /snas tha dad zer gnyis ka' dzis so sor/ /bzung rgyu yod bas snas gzhan mi 'grubaskom/ /bum dang bum gzugs so sor thubage ra ro/ /dzis’macongs re re'i don sbyir 'dir mi gnod/ /ces gsungs te/ kha cig bsdu ba'i lung 'di la 'khrul nas—sems sems byung rdzas tha dad yin zer ro/ /'o na sems sems byung gnyis so sor ngos bzung ba ste 'dzin rgyu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rdzas gzhan yin par mi 'grub ste/ bum pha dang bum pa'i gzugs gnyis so sor grub yod kyang / rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ ci /sems dang sems byung gnyis rdzas mtshungs yin gsungs pa/ rdzas re re ba mtshungs pa'i don yin pas/ rdzas gcig yin pa la mi gnod de/ rdzas mtshungs pa rdzas re re ba 'dra ba'i don yin pa'i lha34

phyir| drug ba'isnyen phyir yid bshad la/ /gosabomar rje bas lhang du bshad/ /snyong ni gzugis med khams su'ang bzhag / ces gsungs te/ drug pa yid shes kyi dngos8) rten ni yid yin pa ra bshad pa la/ bye smra sde ba bco brgyad kyi nang gi gos dmar sde blo4 rnams kyi sa drug pa yid kyi rten ni snying du bshad la /khams gsuyokun na de'i rten snying yod par 'dod pas/ snying ni gzug sa med khams su'ang bzhagasano /mardo las dusapagasum phyinang phra rags dang / /ngan pa gya nom nye ring sogs gsungs don/ /byewās phra rags thogs’bcas thogs med da/nga / /ngan pa nyon mongs can dang bablog pa gzhan/ /nye ring da ltar dang gzhan no btsun misponi/ /phra rags yid dbang yulangan yid mi 'ong / /nye ring snang mi snang ngo chos skyogamin/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdo las/ gzugs gang ci'ang rucing ste/ 'das pa'am/ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byudzoba'aca// nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am/ — phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya nom pa'am/ thag ring bo na yodajib gang yin pa dang / nye ba na yod pa gang yin ba de dag thams cadag cig tu bsdus te/ gzugs kyi phung bo zhes bya ba'i grangs sa 'gro/ zhes pa nas tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed gang ci'ang rung / rnam par shes pa gang 235

ci'ang rung / 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'am/nas/ nye ba na yod pa gang yin pa de— thams cad gcig tu bsdus te rnam par shes pa'i phung bo zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don la/ 'dod tshul gnyis yod de/bye smras/ phra ragase ni/ thogs bcas rags pa dang thogs med phra ba la 'dod pa dang / ngan pa ni nyon mongs can dang de las bzlog pa ste nyon mongs med pa ni ngan pa las gzhan gya nom pa'am bzang bo yin no/ /nye ring ni dus da lta ni nye ba dang dus gzhan gnyis kyi gzugs la ring bar byed pa yin no/ /btsun pa'i 'dod pa ni/ phra rags ni yid kyi gzung bya ni phra ba dang dbang shes kyi gzung bya ni rags pa yin pas de gnyis dngu /ngan pa dang gya nom pa ni/ yid du mi 'ong ba dang / yid du 'ong ba gnyis la 'dod pa dang / nye ring ni rang gi yul du snang ba ni nye ba dang mi snang ba ni ring ba la bshad pa'i phyir/ bye bra ga bshad mdzod nang / btsun pa na re/ zhes rmedod pa bkod pa'i btsun pa zhes pa de gang yin zer na/ skal ldan khyad par can na re/ 'di ni gnas brtan chos skyob yin no zer/ slob dpon rgyal sras na re/ de mi 'thad de bye brag bshad mtsho las/ btsun pa tsam las ming gzhan ma byung la/ btsun pa chos skyob rang ming gis ཿ36

bshad pas/ 'di'i btsun pa ni chos skyob min te/ chos skyob las gzhan pa'i mdo sde ba zhig yin gsungs/ gangagyispel las kyang / rgyal sras ma ltar 'thad par gsungs sta bas chos skyob min no/ / bye smras khamasmo bzhin phung bo snas/ /blob dpon gzugs dzis gzugs phung btags/ /bye brag bshad par tshul gnyis te/ /gzugs nyid phung bo zhes brngod tshe/ / phra rab zul yang phung bor 'gyur/ /gzugs rnams kyi phung zhes brjod tshe/ /phra rab phyogs sam btags pa ra 'argyur/ /phung bo lnga yi 'grel b.ra'ang gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ phung bo dang spungs pa'i don rtsod tshul bzhi yod de/ bye smra rnams kyis skye mched dang khams bzhin du phung bo yang rdzas su 'dod/ slob dpon dang mdo sde bas gzugs tshor re re nas rdzas su yod kyang gzugs phung sogs btags yod du 'dod/ bye brag tu bshad pas gzugs phung la rdzas btags 'jog tshul gnyis bshad de/ gzugs phung nyid phung bo zhes brjod tshe rdul phra rab kyang gzugs kyi phung bor 'gyur te /dper na ras yug gi phyogs gcig tshig pa la ras yug tshig ces brjod pa bzhin no/ /gang spel las/ gal te gzugs nyid phung bo yin pas gzugs phung yin na ni gzugs kyi phung bo rdzas 237

su yod pa yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzugs rnams kyi phudzobo zhes brjod tshe rdul phra rab phyogs sam btags pa bar 'gyur te/ dper na ras yug gi phyogs gcig tshig go zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /gang spel las/ 'on te gzu ga sa kyi phung bo gzugs rnams kyi phung bo yin na ni de'i phyir btag sa pa'i yod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phung bo lnga yi 'grel bar yang 'di ltar gsungs te/ dang bo gsum dus dang / phyi nang rgyud dang / phra rags rnam pa dang / ngan pa gya nom—'gro ba dang / thaka nye ring yul gyis bsdus pa la bshad do/ /sems tsam phung don khur khyer phyir/ /dus gsum re'a'ang phung bo yin/ /'di la mdo n+de ba yis mdor/ /thams cad brtsas naspophung bo zhes/ /gsung bar 'galizer sprung ba'i don/ /med phyir phra jul dus gsum gyis/ /bcis gyir blo mis bsdus pa'i sgoli/ /phung bor bye smras bzhag pa'ang bkag /ces gsungs te / bzhi gsems tsam pa'i 'dodane+epa ni/ phung bo'i don ni khur khyer g.yin pa'i phyir/ dus gsum dang rdu la sarab lta gyaphung bo yin te rab gi bya ba'i khur khyer nus pa'i phyir/ desarin rdu la phra rab lta buwās re re'ang phung bo yin la/ tshogs pa'i ya gyal re re'ang phung bo yin pa 'i phyir zer/ 'di la slob dpon 238

dang camado sde bas/ de mi 'thad par thal/ mdo las/ thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas phung bo/ zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal la/ de ltar na/ spung ba'i don med pa'i phyir te/ de dag re re nas phung bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ des na rdul phra rab dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ blo yis bsdus pa'i sgo nas phung bor 'jog ces bye smra'i 'dod pa de'ang bkag ste/ gal te chos du ma spungs pa phung bo'i don yin na skad cig dang rdulabyuphra mo gcig — —phung bo ma yin par 'gyur te/ de'i mtshan nyid med pa'i phyir/ zheb/ bahā/ga tre| /tshor bas khyim pa 'du shes sam/ /lta bas rab byung rtsod dzir dang / /zhes gsungs te/ sems byung rnams las tshor ba dang 'du shes gnyis logs shig tu phung bor ba'ag pa'i rgyu sa mtshan gsu.oṃyod pa'i dang bo tsod pa'itshortsa bar gyur4pa rna/'dod pa'i yul gzugs sogs la zhen nas tshor ba'i rgyus rgyal bo sogs khyim pa rnams rtsod/ bdag med pa la phadag tu 'du shes pa sogs kyis rab byung rnams rtsod pa'i byir/ phung bo'i rim rgyu'i phyir yang ngo / /de ni rnam bzhi phra rags dang / kakun nyon skye ba'i rim pa dang / /gzugs snod chor zas 'du shes ni/ /bya na 'du byed byan po ste/ /rnam shes za bos 'ardod khams ni/ /239

'dod yon gzugs khams tshor bas gye/ /gsum ni 'aḥ shes rtse 'du byed/ /cesagasungs te/ rgyu mtshan gnyis pa/ 'khor ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin te/ tshar ba zag bcwas la mngon par zhen pas sred pa spel ba dang yul la phyin ci log tu 'du shes pa'i sgo nas lgokhor bar 'khor la/ rgyu mtshan gsum pa ni/ phung bo lnga'i rim pa'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir yang yin te/ de'i tshul rnam pa bzhi yod de/ gzugs tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes rnams rim pa de ltar mtha' gcig tu nges te/ rags pa dang phra ba'i sgo nas dang / kun nyon skye ba'i rim pa dang / dpe zas laspyod pa'i rim pa dang / mthun pa dang / khams gsum na spyod tshul dang mthun pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang bo grub ste/ gzugs thogs pas thams cad las rags/ de nas tshor ba rgyu bas gzhan gsum ste phyi ma gsum las rags/ 'du shes ni mtshan mar 'dzin pas phyi ma gnyis las rags/ 'du byed ni 'du byed pas rnam shes las rags/ rnam par shes pa ni thams cad las phra ba yin no/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ nyon mongs skye ba'i tshe thog mar gzugs la dga'/ bde ba'i tshor bas ro myang bas chags/ de nas 'du shes phyin ci log tu zhen/ de las chags sdang la sogs pa'i 'du byed nyon mongs rnams skyes/ des sems nyon mongs 240

can du byed pa'irgophyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ gzugs ni snod lta bu/ tshor ba zas dang / 'du shes ni bya na ste tshod ma dang /'du byed byan po ste lag bde dang / rnam shes za ba bo lta bur go ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ gzugs kyis snod ltar tsho ra ba'i rtene byed/ zas ltar tshor ba rnam shes kyi myang bya dang / bya na'am tshod mas zas kyi ro so sor 'byed pa ltar 'du shes kyis tshor ba bde sdug gi mtshan ma bzung nas tshor ba so sor gsal bar byed/ byan po'ayolag bdes zas 'dren pa ltar 'du byed kyis tshor ba bde sdug 'grub par byas pa rnam shes la gtod par byed/ skyes bus zas za ba ltar rnam shes kyis bde sdug la longs spyod pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba grub ste/ 'dod khams ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod pas phye ba dang / gzugs khams pa rnams tshor bas phye ste/ bsam gtan dang bo na tshor ba bde ba dang yid bde dang / gnyis pa na tshor ba yid bde dang / gsum pa na tshor ba sems bde dang / bsam gtan bzhi ba na tshor ba btang snyoms yod pas bzhag pa'i phyir/ gozugs med dang bo gsum ni 'du shes kyis phye ba yin te nam mkha' 'di ni mtha' yas so /rnam shes 'di ni rmetha' yas so/ /ci yang med do zhes 'du shes pas/ so/ /srid rtse ni 'du byed kyis phye ba yin te/ 'du byed 241

tsam las mid do/ /rim shos ni de dag la gnas par 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /bye brag don gnyis dgu las gzhan/ /dbang don 'azhir rna shesposgrur dang / /so sortswaskye mched rto gas ra tha/ /gortso bo'i don gsum thogasariphyir dang / /bstan pyiraltajig rterna grags phyir ro/ /zhe sa gsungs te/ gzugs phung gis bsdus pa'i skye mched bcu bo ni gzugs dang skye mched yin pas/ mig gi yul kho na gzugs kyi skye mched du bshad padhedang / phung khams skye mched thams cad chos dang skye mched yin bzhin du yid yul chos kyi skye mched du ji ltar bshad ce na/ de'i dang bo'i lan ston par/ bye brag don dang gtso bo'i phyir/ /gcig ni gzugs kyi skye mched brjod/ /ces gsungs/ de'i don sdom 'diracobasdus tshul yod de/ de'i rgyu mtshan la/ bye brag gi don gnyisu dang gtso bo'i don gsum yod pa'i/ da nga bo bye bra ga gi don ni/yul yul can gyi gzugs can bcu bo so so nas gzugs yin la skye mched kyang yin mod/ 'on kyang gzugs kyi skye mched du mi 'jog par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bye brag gi don gnyis pa ni/ mig sogs gzugs can bcu'i ga zhan dgu'i ming ma btags pa'i dbang bo lnga gang rung gi yul de gzugs kyi skye ma ched du rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir dang / gzugs can 242

bcasgra 'i skye mchid sogs so sor rtogs pa'i chid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gtso bo'i rgyu mtshan gsum gyi dang bo/ gzugs kyi skye mched lag pa sogs—kyis thogs pas reg ba dang / mig shes kyi yuladu bstan du yod pa dang / 'jig rten na yang de la gzugs zhe sa grags pa'i phyir ro/ /chos thamasacad chos dang skye mched yin kyang yid yul gcig phu la chos kyi skye mched du bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshor sogs kyi chos mang bo 'dir 'dus pa dang / chos kyi mchog myang 'das rnams kyang 'dir 'dus la skye mched gzhan du ma 'dus pa'i phyir te/ chos mang ba dang yochog bsdus phyir/ /gcig ni chos zhes bya bar brjod/ /ces so/ /phung bo'i mingathon phungawar brtsas/ /zil gnon la sogs spe mched de/ /bla mar bsten zhi chags bral dang / /mi bsten dbyangs kyis kha rtan byed/ /mi 'don gzhan la rgya cheraston/ /mi ston radzā gis zhib tu dasbod/ /mi daphyod mi sdug sogs bsgoms‘pas/ /chags bral rnam grol skye mched lnga/ zhas gsungs te/ khams mang bo'i mdo las/ khams drug cu rtsa gnyis sam bzhi gsungs pa de dag kyang phung bo lnga dang skye mched bcu gnyis dang khams bco brgyad du 'du ba yin te/ phung bo'i ming canaphung bor bsdus pa ni/ zag med kyi phung bo lngar bshad pa'i dang243

po gzugs phung du 'ardu la lhag ma 'du byed kyi phung bor 'du ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du skye mched du bshad pa rnams kyang skye mched bcu gnyis ci rigs su 'du ba yin te/ zad par gyi skye mched— bcu dang / zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad dang / rnam par grol ba'i skye mched lnga yang der 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam grol gyi skye mched lnga yod de/ bla ma sogs kyis chos bstan nas don so so yang dag rig pa/ dga' ba dang shin sbyangs dang sems bde ba dang mnyam par bzhag pa ste chags pa dang bral ba ni rnam grol gyi skye mched dang bo dang / bla mar ma bsten dge slong sogs kyis ma bstan kyang rang gis ji ltar thos pa dang ci bzung ba ltar dbyangs kyis kha ton byas shing don so so yang dag par rig pa nas/ chags pa dang bral ba ni rnam grol gyi skye mched gnyis pa dang / gzhan gyis ma bstan la/ rang gis thos pa dang shes pa rnams kyang dbyangs kyis kha ton kyang mi byed kyang ji ltar shes pa'i chos gzhan la rgya cher ston cing / ji ltar bstan pa ltar chos de dag so so yang dag par rig pa nas chags pa dang bral ba 'di ni rnam grol gyi skye mched gsum pa dang / gzhan gyis ston pa yang mi byed cing dbyangs kyis kha ton yang mi byed/ gzhan la rgyas par yang mi ston kyang ji ltar thos pa'i don 244

dang shes pa'i don la sems pa dang 'jal ba dang nye bar rtog par byed pa de ltar don so so yang dag par rig pa nas chags pa dang bral ba 'di ni rnam grol gyi skye mched bzhi ba dang / de bzhi ltar mi dpyod kyang rnam par bsngos pa sogs mi sdug pa'i mtshan ma dgu gang rung legs par bzung / legs par yid la byed/legs par sgom/ legs par khong du chud pa de ltar don so so yang dag par rig pa nas/ chags pa dang bral ba 'di rnam grol gyi skye mched lnga ba yin no/ /bco brgyad khams dor lhag ma zhe bzhi lang / /der 'dus so sor bgrang bas re gnyis ni/ /khams ne brtso brgyad sa chu me rlung bzhi/ /nam mkha'i khams dang rnam shes khams te drug /'dod chags gnod sems rnam 'tshe nges 'byung khams/ /gnod med khabaso dang mi 'tshe'i khams te drug /rtsag bsngal bde ba yid mi bde ba'i khams/ /yid bde btang snyoms ma rig khams te drug /tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes bzhi/ /'dod khams gzugs dang gzugs med khams te gsum/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'gog pa'i khams kyang gsum/ /'das dang ma 'ongaspo da ltar khams kyang gsum/ /dman pa gya nom bar ma'i khams gzhan gsum/ /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan khams gsum/ /blob dang mi blob de gnyis min khams gsum/ /zag bcas zag med khams gnyis 'dus ཿ45

byas khams/ /'dus ma byas khams gnyis te ge gnyisa'adod/ /ces gsungs te/ khams drug cu rtsa gnyis po de yang khams bco brgyad ci rigs su 'du ste khames ri gnyis kyistegrangs la bco / brgyad 'dren yang / re gahis las bco ba rgyad dor ba'i lhag ma zhe bzhi bo yang bco brgyad ci rigs su 'du ba'i phyir/ khams mang re gnyis kyi grangs ni/ khams ni bco brgyad sa chu se rlung bzhi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'du sa ma byas khams gnyis te re gnyis 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan la/ bco mirgyad drug tshan gsum dang bzhi tshan gcig /sum tshan drug dang gnyis tshan gnyis bcas pa'i/ /khams mang re gnyisa'ags par bshadawā yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams bco brgyad tshan gcigadzādang /'byung bzhi nam mkha' rnam shes rū khams drug 'dod chags sogs kyi khams drumeg sdug bsngal sogs kyi khams sīg ste drug tshan gsum dang / tshor 'du 'du byed rnam shes kyi khams te bzhi tshan gcig khams gsum ste sum tshan gcig gzugs gzugs med 'gog khams gsum sum tshan gahāg dus gsum gyi khams te sum tshan gcig dman pa sogs gsum gyi khams te sum tshan gnig dge sogs gsum gyi khams te sum tshan gcig346

slobasogs gsum gyi khams te sum tshan ga༈ga ste sum tshan drug yod pa dang / zag bcas zag med kyi khams gnyi’sa dang /'dus byas ma byas kyi khams gasnros te nyis tshan gnyis bcas kyi sgo nas khams mang re gnyis legs par bshad pa yin zhes so/ /brtso brgyad kyis basbrus 'dod khams dang dus gsum/ /lung ma bstan dang spob dang mi blob min/ /dman sogs zag bcas 'dus byas bcu gcig goza /zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa'i lhag ma bcu bzhi'i nang nas khams bco brgyad du 'du ba 'dod khams dang dus gsum dang lung ma bstan dang slob mi slob dang de gnyis ka ma yin pa'i khams dang / dman sogs zag bcas dang 'dus byas te bcu gcig go /chos yin bco brgyad mkha' dang chags sogs drug /sngug bsngal sogs drug tshor 'du 'du byed gsum/ /'gog dang 'dus ma byas so 'gog pa'i khams/ /chags bral spangs dang 'gog khams gsum gyes min/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos khams su 'du ba bco baphywad yod de/ nam 4mkha'i khams dang 'dod chags sogs drug dang / sdug bsngal gyi khams sogs drug dang / tshor 'du 'du byed gsum dang /'gog pa dang 'dus ma byas te bco brgyad yod la/ 'gog pa'i khams ni chags bral dang spangs pa dang 'gog pa'i khams 247

gsum du byas pa min no/ /chos yid rnam sheg gsum du 'du ba ni/ /gzugs med gnyis blob mi blob zag med lnga/ /zhesarī gsungs te/ chos dang yid khams dang rnam shes kyi khams gsum du 'du ba/ gzugs med gnyis slob mi slob kyi khams gnyis zag med kyi khams te lnga'o/ /sna lce'i rnam shes dri ro bzhi bsal ba'i/ /lhag ma bcu bzhir 'dus pa gzugs khams gnyis/ /gzugs sgra yid khams rnam shes khamasacog dang / /chos khams bcur 'du dge dang mi dge gnyis/ /lus dbang dge ba yod na 'di dang 'gal/ /rnam shes khams su 'du ba rnam shes gnyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams bco brgyad kyi nang nas yul can sna lce'i rnam shes gnyis dang yul dri ro gnyis te/ bzhi bsal ba'i lhag ma bcu bzhir 'dus pa gzugs khams lan gnyis dang /gzugs khams sgra'i khams yid khams rnam shes kyi khams drug dang / chos khams bcur 'du ba/ dge ba'i khames dang mi dge ba'i khams yod la/ lus kyi dbang bo yin par gyur pa'i dge ba yod na/ 'di dang 'gal te/ khams bcu bo 'di'i nang du mi 'du bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rnam shes kyi khams su 'du ba drug tshan dang bo'i rnam shes dang bzhi tshan gyi rnam shes te gnyis yod do/ /phyi nang gsungs phyir spong byar gsungs phyir lha 48

dang / /skyis bubam̐ gdags gzhir gsungs r+bhar 'ardus byas mo/ /rang lugs nam mkha' ma byas bu ga sogs/ /nam mkha'i khams ne byas phyir mi mtshungs so/ /'byung bzhi sngar bshad lhag gnyis 'azhir bshad kyi/ /brtso brgyad khams kyi rnam shes 'chad byed min/ /zhes gsungs te/ bye smra na re/ nam mkha'i khams dang nam mkha' mi gcig ste/ nam mkha'i khams la phyi nang gnyis yod par gsungs pa dang / nam mkha'i khams spang bya yin par bshad pa dang / nam mkha'i khams ni sa sogs 'byung ba rnams ltar skyes bu'i gdags gzhir yang bshad pa'i phyir/ des na nam mkha' zag med yin la/ nam mkha'i khams nigyizag pa dang bcas pa'i 'du byas yin no lo/ /lo zhes pa zur za'i tshig yin la/ rtsa bar/ bu ga nam mkha'i khams zhes bya/ /snang dang mun pa dag yin lo/ /zhes pa'i lo zhes pa/ bye smras nam mkha'i khams gzugs su 'dod pa la/ mdo sde ba dang slob dpon ma rangs pa'i tshig yin no/ /slob dpon rang lugs la nam mkha' ni 'dus ma byas yin pas rdzas su me grub la/ bu ga sogs bye smras 'dod pa'i nam mkha'i khams ni 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir mi mtshungs so/ /nam mkha'i khams ni skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gsungs pa ni/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rten la khams su bshad pa'i 249

sa sogs khams drug ni/ nang gi khams zag bcas kyi sa chu mi rlung bzhi dang nam mkha'i khams dang rnam shese kyi khams te drug la 'dod/ de'i nang nas 'byung ba bzhi ni sngar bshad zin la /lhag ma nam mkha'i khems dang rnam shes kyi khams gnyis skabs 'dir bshad pa ni/ khams re gnyis kyi drug tshan gsum gyi dang bo 'chad byed yin gyi khams bco brgyad kyi rnam shes kyi khams 'chad byed ma yin no/ /chu dang skam gnyis nyin mtshan gnyis thogs gzhan/ /mi nya chu grin byis pa gsod dang mi/ /'u ga pa rta dang snyoms 'anug la sogs so/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams kyi rnam pa'i rab — dbye de la mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dang / thogs pa yod med kyi sgo nas dang / dge sogs gsum gyi sgo nas dang / khams gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba bshad pa bzhi las/ dang bo 'chad par/ bstan yod 'dir ni gzugs gcig pu/ /zhes byung / khams bco brgyad kyi nang nas/ gzugs kyi skye mched gcig pu bstan yod kyi gzugs yin la/ lhag ma bcu bdun bstan med yin te/ mig gi yul du bstan du med pa'i phyir/gnyis pa thogs bcas thogs med ni/ thogs dang bcas pa gzugs can bcu/ /zhes byung / khams bco brgyad kyi 250

nang nas khams gzugs can bcu thogs bcas dang lhag ma 6 brgyad thogs med yin no/ /thogs pa del gsum yod de/sgrib pa'icithogs pa dang / yul la thogs pa dang / dmigs pa la thogs pa gsum yod/ dang bo gzugs can bcu dang / gnyis pa dbang bo lnga sogs yul can rnams dang / gsum pa sems sems byung rnams so/ /yul la thogs pa dbang bo gzugs can lnga yod cing / mig gcig pu la'ang du ma yod de/ chu la thogs la skam la mi thogs pa dang / skam la thogs la chu la mi thogs pa dang / gnyis kar thogs pa dang gnyis kar mi thogs pa dang /nyin mor thogs la mtshan mor mi thogs pa dang / de las bzlog pa dang / gnyis kar thogs pa dang / gnyis kar mi thogs pa ste mu brgyad yod pas/ dang bo ni nya dang / gnyas pa ni mi phal cher gyi mig dang / gsu ma pa ni/ chu srin gyis pa gsod dang sbal ba'i mig lta bu dang / bzhi ba ni/ gnyid rilog pa'i dus kyi mig dang mngal du mchi ba'i mig lta bu dang / lnga ba ni/ mi phal cher gyi mig lta bu dang / drug pa ni/ 'ug pa dang pha wang gi mig lta bu dang / bdun pa ni/ gung dang byi ba dang khyi dang rta dang wa'i mig lta bu dang / brgyad pa ni/ gnyid dang snyoms 'jug dus kyi mig lta bu'o/ /yul la thogs dang251

rlub pa'i thogs pa la/ /sku bzhi soms daja yul lnga dbang bo rtag /dmigs bcas yul can nges phyir byu gsum ste/ /yul thogs dmigs par mi thogs dbang bo lnga/ /gnyis thogs sems dang gnyis min nam mkha' sogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ yul la thogs pa dang sgrib pa'i thogs pa don gcig gam zhe na/ yul la thogs pa dang sgrib pa'i thogs pa la mu bzhi yod de/ dang bo yin la phyi ma ma yin pa sems dang sems byung rnams dang / phyi ma yin la dang bo ma yin pa yul lnga lta bu dang / gnyis ka yin pa dbang bo lnga lta bu dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa ni rtag pa rnams so/ /yang yul la thogs pa dang dmigs pa la thogs pa don gcib/ gam zhe na/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni yul can yin stabs dmigs par thogs la yul la mi thogs pa med pas mu gsum tsam las med de/ yul la thogs la dmigs par mi thegs pa dbang bo lnga lta bu dang / gnyis kar thogs pa sems dang sems byung mtha' dag dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa nam mkha' sogs so/ / dbang shes dngos nyid rtog yin kyang / /nges rtog rjes dran rtog med la/ /dgongs nas mdo las rtog bral gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams rnams la rtog dpyod dang bcas ma 252

bcasacobashad pa'i skabs su/ rtog dang dpyod dang bcas pa ni/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams lnga yin/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ bsam gtan dang bo'i dngos gzhi tsam po ba'i khams tha ma gsumapartog dpyod gnyis dang bcas pa dang / bsam gtan dang bo'i dngos gzhi khyad par can gyi khams tha ma gsum ni rtog med dpyod bcas dang / bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad kyitshukhams tha ma gsum dang lhag ma bco lnga ni rtog med dpyod med yin no/ /sgo lnga'i rnam shes rtog bcas dpyod bcas yin par gsungs pa la/ kha cig gis/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes rtog bcas yin pa mi 'thad par thal/ mdo las/ dge slong dag mig gi rnam par shes pas sngon po shes kyi sngon po'o snyam du ni ma yin no/ /zhes rtog med du bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir zer na/bye smra na re/ skyon de mi 'jug par thal/ rtog pa la ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa dang / nges rtog gi rtog pa dang / rjes dran gyi rtoge pa gsum yod par grags pa las dbang shes 'di lnga ngo bo nyid kyi rtog bcas yin kyang / nges rtog dang / rjes dran gyi rtog pa med pa la dgongs nas mdo las rtog bral du gsungs pa'i phyir/ dper na rta rkang ba gcig las med pas rkang ba'i bya ba mi nus pas/ rkang medanezer ba bzhin ngo bo nyed kyi rtog lha53

pa las rtog pa gzhan gnyis med pa la rtog med du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum grags zhes pa bye smra'i 'dod pa las slob dpon rang lugs ma yin pa'i don no/ / snas brgyad zul min bsags zul chung / /khams bzhi sreg byed 'jal byar smra/ /kha cig me dang skyid tsam 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ khams rnams la bsags ma bsags kyi khyad par bshad pa'i skabs/ gzugs can bcu ni bsags pa'o/ /zhes byung / khams bco brgyad la bsags ma baṭ+wāṃ gags kyi cha gnyis yod de/ gzugs can bcu rdul phra rab 'dus pas na bsags pa dang / sems bdun chos khams dang brgyad ma bsags pa yin gsungs/ 'di'i skabs kha cig gis/ rdzas rdul gzugs kyi chung mtha' dang / /bsags rdul de las che ba'i phyir/ /zer na/ de me 'thad de/ rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus zhes pa'i rdzas brgyad po de rdul ma yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de mi 'thad par thal /bsags rdul phra rab de gzugs kyi chung mtha' yin pa'i phyir ro/ /khams bco brgyad las/ gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi ni gcad bya gcod byed kyi khams su bzhag pa bzhin du bsreg bya dang sreg byed/ gzhal bya dang 'jal byed kyang phyi rol gyi /bams de bzhi la 'jog pa'i phyir/ kha cig me kho na sreg byed dang snyi ba 254

kho na 'an+del byed yin par smra'o/ /nang gi lnga ne rgyu mthudzha las/ /skung lang byung ba gzhan gnyis las/ /gzhan du med phyir 'gir ma bshad/ /sgra ni rnam smin ma yin te/ /'dod dgur dbyungabs chog phyir dang / /bcad nas slar yang 'byin rung phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams rnams kyi byung ma byung gi dbye ba la/byung ma byung gi sgo nas dang / phyi nang gi sgo nas dang / rten bcas de mtshungs kyi sgo nas dang / spang bya yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi/ dang bo la byung ba spyir bstan pa/ ma byung ba dmigs kyis bsal la/ dbang bo rnam shes kyi sa mtshungs dang gsum yod pa'i dang bo la/ rnam smin gyi rgyu/ rgyas byung gi rgyu/ rgyu mthun gyi rgyu gsum yod/ dang bo ni/ nang gi dbang bo lnga ni/ rnam smin gyi rgyu las byung ste dge ba zag bcas dang mi dge ba las byung / dbang bo lnga bo de rgyas byung gi rgyu las byung ba yang yin te/ zas dang khrus dang sku mnye sogs leb/sa spyad dang /gnyid dang ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par dag gis khyod rgyas/ des dbang rten khog pa rgyas par byas pa'i phyir/ 'dir bsdus pa'i don ni/ nang gi dbang bo lnga ni rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma las byung bas/ rgyu mthun las byung yang / byung ba gzhan gnyis las gzhan du rgyu mthun las byung ba med stabs/ 'dir rgyu mthun 255

las byung bar ma bshad do/ /sgra ni rgyas byung dang rgyu mthun las byung ba yod kyang / rnam smin las byung ba ni ma yin te/ 'dod dgur sgra byung chog pa'i phyir dang / 'phro bcad nas slar yang sgra 'byin rung ba'i phyir/ thogs med khams brgyad gnyis las byung / /rgyas byung med de mi bsags phyir/ /gang las ma byung rtag dzis chos/ /zhes gsungs te/ thogs med rnam shes bdun dang sems byung dang brgyad de/ thogs med khams brgyad po de ni/ rgyu mthun dang rnam smin gnyis las byung ba yin te/ skal mnyam kun 'gro'i rgyu las byung ba ni rgyu mthun las byung ba dang / rnam smin las skyes pa dag ni rnam smin gyi rgyu las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/khams de brgyad la rgyas byung gi rgyu las byung ba med de/ bsags pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma byung ba dmigs bsal ni/ rgyu gsum gang las kyang ma byung ba ni/ rtag pa'i rdzas dang ldan pa ste chos khams de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /tha ma chos yid rnam shes kyi/ /phyogs gcig mthun las min te/ /zag med skad cig dang bo 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma byung ba dmigs bsal 'di ni/ sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i yid dang chos khams dang rnam shes kyi phyogs gcig gi khams te/ khams tha ma 256

gsum ni/ rgyu mthun las byung ba ma yin te/ khyod zag med gang zhig rang gi zag med kyi khams sngo—na du ma song ba'i phyir te/ khyod zag med skad cig dang bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgom lam yin yang gnyis pa yi/ /dngos gzhi zag med gsar skyes kyang / /gnyis bzhin kun 'byung chos bathod kyang / /zag med snga ma'i rgyun nam dpyad/ /'di ni dmigs bsal ston byedayin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sdug bsngal chos bzod de zag med skad cig dang bo yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgyu mthun las byung ba min pa bzhin du/ sgom lam yin yang bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i zag med gsar skyes de yang rgyu mthun las byung ba min dgos la/ mthong sgom gsar skyes de gnyis bzhin du/ kun 'byung chos bzod kyang zag med kye lam snga ma'i rgyun yin nam min dpyad gsungs la/ de ni zag med snga ma sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi rgyun yin nam snyam mo/ /'di yang /rgyu mthun las byung rnam smin skyes/ thogs pa med brgyad ces pa'i dmigs bsal ston byed yin pas/ rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las/ ma byung ba dmigs kyis bsal ba/ zhes sa bcad byas so/ /mig gsar thob la rnam shes gsar min pa/ /'dod na dbang bo rim gyis thob pa skye/ /rnam shes bar do'i dus nas 357

cithob zin phyir/ /gzugs med gnyis par skyes ma bag pa de/ /mig thob rnam shes gtan ma thob pa yin/ /mig shes gsar thob mig gsar thob min pa/ /gzugs med gnyis skyes mig shes mngon byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ thob tshul gyi khyad par/mig gsar du thob la mig shes gsar thob min pa ni/ 'dod khams na dbang bo rim gyis thob ma thag pa ste/ mig dbang gsar du thob la/ mig shis sngar bar do'i dus nas thob zin pa'i phyir/ gzugs med nas bsam gtan gnyis par skyes ma thag pa de yang mig gsar du thob la mig shes gsar thob min pa yin te/ mig gsar du thob la/ mig shes gtan nas ma thob pa'i phyir/ mig shes gsar du thob la mig gsar thob ma yin pa ni/ gzugs med nas bsam gtan gnyis par skyes nas mig shes mngon du byed pa lta bu/ gnyis ka lhan cig thob pa ni/ gzugs med nas 'dod khams dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i tshe bar do'i dus mig dang mig shes lhan cig thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis ka mino pa/ khams 'og ma nas gzugs med du skyes pa dang /gzugs med nas gzugs med du skyesatrepa lta bu'o/ /dge dang lung ma bstan ni 'dir 'brel med/ /ma sgrib lung ma bstan tsam mngon byed pyir/ /de yis mngon ma byas par thob min te/ /de 358

lha 'das thob bcas par bal phyir lo/ /gzugs med ma zad 'dod dang dang bo las/ /gnyis par skyes kyang 'dra ste der skyes tshe/ /snga ma'i mig shes thob pa btang phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs med nas bsam gtan gnyis par skyes nas mig shes mngon du byas pa'i mig shes de/ dge ba dang lung ma bstan gang yin dpyad pa ni 'dir 'brel med de/ 'dir ma sgrib lung ma bstan tsam gyi mig shes mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa des mngon du ma byas par mig shes de thob pa med de/mngon du ma byas par thob na 'das thob dang bcas par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bye brag smra bas 'dod do lo/ /lo zhes pa bye brag smra bas 'dod pa tsam yin par ston to/ /gzugs med nas bsam gtan gnyis par skyes pa der ma zad 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang bo las/ bsam gtan gnyis par skyes te mig shes mngon du byas pa yang de dang 'dra bar mig shes gsar du thob pa yin te/ der skyes tshe snga ma 'dod pa'i skabs su thob pa'i mig shes sngar btang zin pa'i phyir/ mnyam thob gzugs med nas ni 'dod pa dang / /tshangs pa'i bar dor skyer+sā pa'o / /zhes gsungs te/ mig gi dbang bo dang mig shes gnyis mnyam du thob pa ni/ gzugs med nas 'dod par skyesalha59

pa dang / tshangs pa'i bar dor skyes pa de dag yin no/ / ldan tshul lang / /mig dang ldan la mig shes mi ldan pa/ /de mdzon mi byed bsam gtan zi ma gsum/ /bablog pa daskus long mer bo mig nyams sogs/ /yin te 'dod na mig shes nges ldan phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ mig dang mig shes gnyis ldan tshul la'ang mu bzhi yod de/ mig dang ldan la mig shes dang mi ldan pa ni/ mig shes mngon du mi byed pa'i bsam gtan phyi ma gsum khu skyes pa lta bu dang / bzlog pa mig shes dang ldan la mig dang mi ldan pa ni/ dmus long dang mer mer bo dang mig nyams pa lta bu yin te/ 'dod par skyes pa'i gang zag la mig shes nges par ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig gzugs med 'dod par skyes ma thag /ma sgrib lung ma bstan pa'i mig shes ni/ /nyed min drug dang drug dang gnyis nyed do/ /gsungs zir khrab ste gong nas 'der skyes tshe/ /nyon mongs can gnyis dge ba skyes thob snyed/ /dgra brtsom 'dod pa'i nyon mongs kyis nyams tshe/ /gong ma'i ston mongs gnyis dang blob sems snyed/ /ma sgrib bsnan na bdun du 'byucar phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ kha cig gis/ gzugs med nas 'dod par skyes ma thag pa des/ma sgrib lung ma bstan pa'i mig shes ni rnyed pa mi 'thad de/ ca lha60

ba las/ byeg dang drug dang gnyis rnyed do/ /zhis gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste gong nas 'dod khams 'dir skyes tshe 'dod pa'i nyon mongs can gyi sems gnyis dang dge ba skyes thob dang /'dod pa'i nyon mongs kyis dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu las nyams tshe/ gzugs dang gzugs med kyi nyon mongs can gnyis dang /slob sems te drug rnyed par gsungs la/ ma sgrib lung ma bstan pa'i mig shes bsnan na bdun du 'gyur bas drug dang / zhes pa dang 'gal lo zer ro / chos khams rten bcas rnam zhes skyed pa'i don/ /yin phyir mi 'dra ma mthong 'gag 'gyur dang / /mi skyes dbang bo rnam shes de mtshungs nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ chos khams ni mtha' gcig tu rten bcasayin te/ khyod kyis rnam shes skyed par byed pa'i don gyis rten bcas yin par bshad pa las/'phags pa'am so skye yang rung ste de dag gis yid kyi rnam shes skye ba'i bya ba byed tshul mi 'dra ba ma mthong ba'i phyir/ khams bco brgyad kyi lhag ma rnams la rten bcas dang de mtshungs gnyis re yod de/ rang gi las byed mi byed gnyis re yod pa'i phyir/rang gi las byed pa'i don ni/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum phan tshun brten pa'am 'phrad par byed pa la brten pa de yin la/261

dper na mig gis lta ba rna jes nyan pa lta bu/ mig gi dbang bo'i byed pa ni lta ba yin la mig shes kyi byed pa ni rnam par shes pa lta bu'o/ /mig gang gis gzugs la bltas pa dadz+wa lta ba dang blta bar 'gyur ba ni rten bcas yin pa nas lus kyi bar du 'dra la/ de dang mtshungs pa ste de mtshungs ni/ mig gang gis gzugs ma mthong bar 'gag pa dang / 'gag 'gyur/ mi skye ba'i chos can rnams so/ /gzugs sogs lnga gi rnam shes so so la/ /stos nas rten bcas de mtshungs gnyi ga yin/ /nub phyogs pa yis mi skyes dbang bo la/ /rnam shes ldan dang mi ldan gnyis su bshad/ /sna lces yul mnyam 'dzin gsungs chachung ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs sogs yul lnga la'aparten bcas dang de mtshungs gnyis ka yod par bshad de/ yul de la brten nas yul de 'dzin pa'i rnam shes skyes pa de rten bcas dang / de 'dzin pa'i rnam shes ma skyes pa de/ de mtshungs yin zer/ dper na gzugs sgra gnyis gang zag cig gi rnam shes skyes pa la ltos nas rten bcas dang / gang zag 'ga' zhig gi rnam shes ma skyes pa la ltos nas de mtshungs su bzhag pas gnyis ka yin —no/ /bye smra nub phyogs pas mi skye ba'i chos canatshogyi dbang bo la rnam shes ldan dang mi ldan pa gnyis su bshad de/ 'dod khams 262

dang bsam gtan dang bo'i mi skye ba'i chos can gyi dbang bo la rnam shes ldan pa dang / bsam gtan gnyis pa yan gyi mi skye ba'i chos can gyi dbang bo la rnam shes dang ldan pa min no zer/ snadang lce'i dbang bo gnyis kyi yul mnyam pa 'dzin par gsungs pani/ dbang bo'i rdul gyi che chung dang mnyam pa 'dzin pa'i donano/ /mthong spang mtshan nyid thob pa'ang mthong spang yin/ /dephyir nyon mongs can du ma thes la/ /'azhir 'phros dbang bo'i /sems pa las gang dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i phra rgyas rnams dang mtshungs ldan dang / de dag gi mtshan nyid dang / rjes su mthun pa'i mtshan nyid dang / thob pa'ang mthong spang yin pa'i phyir/ mthong spang ni nyon mongs can yin par ma nges la/ 'di las 'phros nas dbang bo'i sems pa ste/ dbang bo la brten pa'i rnam shes kyi 'khor du gyur pa'i sems pa de las gang yin dpyad par bya ste/ lta ba dang mthong ba mig gi rnam shes kyi byed pa ste las yin kyang mig de'i rten yin pas mig gis kyang mthong bar bzhag pas/ lta ba dang mthong ba de mig gis kyang las sam byed pa yin la/ des na mig shes kyi'akhor du gyur pa'i sems pa sogs kyi 'al sam byed pa yin byas na chog gam snyam mo/ / 263

sgang ma'i lus la 'og ma'o mig mi bten/ /'og ma'o mige gis rgong ma'i gzugs mi mthong / /dzi 'asprul dang gi gzhan brten ma gtogs lo/ /gong ma'i rnam zhes 'og ma'i mig la min/ /shes dang mi 'dra gnyis par 'og mngon byed/ /de pyir dang bo'i mig blos sa kun mthong / /mig shes gong 'og sa gsum mthong ba ltar/ /lus la'ang gong 'og rang sa'i gzugs mthong zhing / /ci rigs par ne gsum ga'i rnam shes brten/ /'di dag lus rna sgra shes bzhir yang jija/ /zhes gsungs te/sa gong ma'i lus la rang sa dang gong sa'i mig brten du rung yang / 'og ma'i mig brten pa ma yin te/ sa 'og ma'i rnam smin gyi rgyus gong sa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin zhing / 'og sar gong sa'i de bskyed pa'i rgyas byung gi rgyu med pa'i phyir/ lus la 'og ma'i mig ma yin zhes so/ /'og ma'i mig gis rang sa dang 'og sa'i gzugs 'dzin kyang / gong sa'i gzugs mi mthong ste/ gong —sa'i gzugs dwangs shing phra bas mi mthong ba'i phyir/ bye smras rdzu 'phrul dang ni/ gzhan gyi mthu la brten pa gtogs so zer lo/ /lo zhes pa ma rangs pa'i tshig yin phyir rang lugs la mi 'dod do/ /sa gong ma'i rnam par shes pa'ang 'og ma'i mig la brten pa ma yin te/ rang gi rten dang lhan cig yul la 'jug 264

dgos pa'i phyor/ rnam par shes pa dang mi 'dra bar bas7 gtan gnyis par sa 'og ma'i mig mngon du byed pa yod de/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bsam gtan dang bo'i mig dang blos sa kun mthong ba'i phyir te/ bsam gtan dang bo'i rten can gyis bzhi ba'i dngos gzhi bsgrubs nas/ de'i sas bsdus kyi mig dbang thob pa'i tshe/ de la brten pa'i rnam shes kyis rang sa dang bo/ 'og sa 'dod pa gong sa bzhi ba'i sas bsdus kyi gzugs sogs gsum mthong ba yod pa'i phyir/ mig shes kyis gong sa 'og sa rang sa gsum gyi gzugs mthong ba ltar/ lus kyi'ang yul gzugs dang rnam shes gnyis rang sa 'og sa gong sa gsum ga yod de/sngar bshad pa las rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ mig la rgyasu par bshad pa ltar rna ba sogs la ci rigs par sbyar bar bya ste/ lus kyi'ang gzugs dang rnam shes gnyis rang sa 'og sa gong sa gsum ga yod tshul sogs lus rna sgra rnam par shes pa bzhir yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /dbang yid gnyis ka'i khyal lnga yid yul gzhan/ /spog tshor dri med dad sogs chos kyi gyed/ /nang khams bcu gnyis dbang bo'o gzhan ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams bco brgyad po las/ yul gang rnam shes gang gi yul yin tshul yod de/ dbang shes dang yid kyi rnam shes gnyis ka'i yul yin lha65

pa ni/ gzugs sogs phyi yi yul lnga dang gzhan te yid yul ni lhag ma bcu gsum mo/ / khams bco brgyad las dbang bo yin pa ni/ srog gi dbang bo dang tshor bde sogs lnga dang / dad sogs dbang bo lnga dang / mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang bo/ kun shes pa'i dbang bo dang / kun shes ldan pa'i dbang bo po/sum gyi cha re ste bcu bzhi dang nang gi khams bcu gnyis te/ de dag dbang bo yin la/ lhag ma phyi'i khams lnga dang /chos khams kyi phyed de gzhan rnams ni dbang bo ma yin no/ /smras pa/ bdag blo shes bya'i gnas la goms phyir dang / /bdag 'dzin tshang nas 'byin phyir 'di 'dra'i las/ /bdag gis bgyis pa gang yin 'di dag gis/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams kun shes gnas thob shog /ces bsnyes don chos mngon rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings kyi tshig 'grel tshig don rab spru/sal zhes bya ba las gnas dang bo'i skabs so/ / khams kyi rang bzhin shin tu rtogs dka'i gnas/ /khams mi bde ba'i ngang la sug las kyis/ / khams kyi rnam grangs ri mor phab pa 'dis/ /khams gsum 'gro bas 'chi med gnas thob shog / ཿ6khyi

gnas gnyis pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'gril ba/ ribyin rlabs nyi ma 'bar ba'i rtsed dga' yis/ /bdag blo pad+mo bzhad pa'i dpal ster ba/ /rgyal kun 'dus zhal zhabs sen nor bu'i 'phreng / /byang chub bar du 'bral med spyi bor 'dzin/ /'dir gnas gnyis pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig cung zad 'grel ba la/ gnyis pa yul can dbang bo'i skabs kyi sdom ni/rang gi don la lhag par dbang byed pa'i/ /cha nas bzhag pa'i 'dus byas dbang bo'i don/ /lnga yis lus mtshes bsrungadang rnam shes skyed/ /thun mong min yul la dmigs rgyu bzhir dbang / /zhes gsungs te/ rang gi don la lhag par dbang byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i 'dus byas te/ dbang bo'i mtshan nyid/ mig sogs dbang bo lnga bo rnams ni don bzhi la dbang byed de/ de lngas lus mdzes pa dang / lus bsrung ba da nga /rang 'bras mtshungs ldan gyi rnam shes skyed pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i yul la dmigs pa'i rgyu byed pa dang bzhi la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis kyis po mor bye brag gyed pa dang / /skad gzengs mtho sogs khrad par gnyis la dbang / /srog gis mtshams spyor srog 'dzin gnyis la dbang / /yid kyis phyi mar spyor lha67

zhing de'i dbang gis/ /lus sogs dger 'gyur mthun par dbangabyed gnyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ pho dbang mo dbang srog dbang yid dbang bzhi re re don gnyis gnyis la dbang byed de/ pho mo'i dbang bo gnyis kyis pho mo so sor bye brag phyed pa dang / skad gzengs mtho ba dang dma' ba sogs kyi khyad par gnyis la dbang ba dang / srog dbang gis rigs 'dra snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba dang srog 'dzin pa gnyis la dbang bar byed/ yid kyis yang srid phyi mar mtshams sbyor zhing / lus ngag gi las dge ba'i las su 'gyur ba sogs la mthun par 'jug pas na dbang bo'i ngo bo dang mthun par dbang byed pa'i phyir/ de dag mi 'thad mdzes byed dbang rten yin/ /rkyang bas mi mthong bsrung la rnam shes gco/ /dbang bo med kyang pho mo'i dbye ba rung / /nyon mongs can min sgrug mtshams rdzor byed min/ /mtshams spyor byed po yid nyid yin phyir yang / /zhes gsungs te/ mdo sde ba sogs na re/ bye smras 'dod pa de dag mi 'thad de/ mdzes byed ni dbang rten khog pa yin la mig rkyang bas mi mthong bas/ lus bsrung ba dang tha snyad thun mong ma yin pa dag dbang bo la brten pa'i rnam shes kyis byed pas rnam shes gtso ba'i phyir/ pho mo'i dbang bo med kyang pho mo'i dbye ba rung ste/ gzugs khams pa'i nyu68

lha dngo bskal ba dang bo'i mi'ang pho yin pa'i phyir/ srog dbangortsinyon mongs can ma yin pas rigs 'dra snga phyi mtshams sbyor byed ma yin no/ /mtshams sbyor byed pa bo ni yid nyid yin par bshad pas kyang mi 'thad do/ / gsum gyis kun shes byed dang kun shes ldan/ /lhag med 'das thob sogs sgras mthong sgom gyi/ /spang bya spong zhing bder gnas la dbang byed/ /mdzod sgyuka gong nas gong dang myang 'das thob/ /sogs pa la gi dbang gyed jir zhes bskur/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang bo dang kun shes kyi dbang bo dang kun shes ldan pa'i dbang bo gsum dbang bor 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gsum gyis rim bzhin du kun shes byed dang kun shes ldan pa'i dbang bo dang lhag med myang 'das kyi bar thob pa la gong nas gong du dbang byed pa dang / rtsa bar/ mya ngan 'das sogs gong nas gong / /thob pa la ni dbang byed phyir/ /zhes pa'i sogs sgras/ der ma zad de gsum gyis rim bzhin du mthong spang spong ba dang sgom spang spong ba dang / mthong chos la rnam grol gyi dga' bder gnas pa gsum la gong nas gong du dbang byed pa'i phyir/ 'di la mdzod ṭīka sogs rje yab sras kyi zin 269

bris dag las/ ging nas gong du myang 'das thob/ /sogs pa la ni dbang byed phyir/ /zhes bsgyur na bde gsungs so/ /las kyi dbang bo lnga sogs mi bgrang ste/ /smra ba slob dgos khas len rkang med 'gro/ /khame kyang gtong phyir(ro)grangs res rgyu mtshan la/ /bye smra bkod kyang rang lugs 'anug pa'i gnas/ /mig sogs drug dang skyes pa po mo gnyis/ /srog gnas tshor lnga nyer spyod bcu bzhi'o/ /de bzhin 'khor ba snog pa'i dbang byas rten/ /dad sogs kun shes byed pa skye ba dang / /kun shes gnas dang ldan pas dga' la spyod/ /ces gsungs te/ de la grangs can pa la sogs pa kha cig na re/ dbang bo nyer gnyis su grangs ma nges te/ las kyi dbang bo lnga yod de/ ngag smra ba sogs la dbang / lag pa len pa la dbyāng / rkang ba 'gro ba la dbang / rkub rtug pa 'dor ba la dbang / 'doms gci ba 'dor ba la dbyāng byed pa'i phyir zer/ de mi 'thad par thal/ngag gis smra ba slob pa la ltos pa'i phyir/ khas kyang len phyir lag pa la mi ltos/ rkang med sbrul dang nya sogs 'gro nus/pha wang gi kha nas kyang mi gtsang ba 'dorartsob sogs kyis las kyi dbang bo lnga mi 'thad pas mi bgrang la/ de mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan bye brag smra bas bkod pa ni/ de ltar na/ kha dang rkub 270

rkang lag gi dbang bo 'chol bar thal/ khas kyang lag pa ltar len pa dang / rtug par byed pa yod la/ lag pas kyang len pa dang 'gro ba yod cing / rkang bas kyang len pa dang 'gro ba yod pa'i phyir/ rgyur gyur pa thams cad rang gi bya ba la dbang bar thal ba'i phyir/ zhes bkag go /dbang bo nyer gnyis su grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan sdom 'dir/ bye smra bkod kyang / zhes gsungs pa'i bye smras bkod pa ni/ bye smra na re/ ngag sogs dbang bo ma yin la/ dbang bo nyer gnyis su grangs nges par thal/ rnam shes kyi rten nam gzhi'am gnas kyi dbang du byas nas mig sogs dbang bo drug dang / sems can gyi bye brag pho mo so sor 'byed pa'i pho mo'i dbang bo gnyis dang / sems can gyi rigs rgyun gnas par dbang byed pas srog dbang dang / kun nas nyon mongs la dbang byed pa'i dbang du byas nas tshor ba'i skedabang bo lnga ste bcu bzhi bzhag pa'i phyir/ rnam byang gi rgyu tshogs pa'i dbang du byas nas dad sogs dbang bo lnga dang / rnam byang gingo bor skyes shing gong nas gong du rnam par byang bar byed pa'i dri med kyi dbang bo gsum dang brgyad yod do/ /'dir/ bye smra bkod kyang rang lugs/ zhes pa'i rang lugs mdo sde ba'i lugasani/ ngag sogs dbang bo ma yin par/ dbang bo nyer gnyis 271

su grangs nges te/ —bye smra ltar ma yin par/ 'khor bar 'jug pa'i gnas sam rten ni/ mig sogs dbang bo drug gis byed pa dang / 'khor bar gsar du skyes pa'i dbang du byas na sa pho mo'i dbang bo gnyis bzhag rigs mthun gnas pa'i dbang du byas nas srog dbang dang / tshor ba lnga ni bde sdug sogs la nye bar longs spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'khor bar 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas bcu bzhi bzhag go /de bzhin du/ 'khor ba las ldog pa'i rten gyi dbang du byas nas dad sogs dbang bo lnga dang / rnam byang dang bor skye ba'i dbang du byas nas mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang bo skye ba dang / rnam byang thob pa mi nyams par gnas par byed pa'i kun shes pa'i dbang bo dang / rnam grol gyi dga' bde la longs spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas kun shes ldan pa'i dbang bo dang brgyad bzhag go /bsam gtan gsum pa las gzhan na/ /lngar gye'i bde ba lus tshoja yin/ /de na nyon mongs can gyi lang / /sems bde yod de chos bcu drug /yul du 'byur tshul bshad pa'i skabs/ /sems bder spang bya ris lngar gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ dbang byed tshul gyi tshor ba la lnga yod de/ dang bo tshor ba sdug bsngal lha7lha

ni/ gdung ba nyams su myong ba'i lus tshor zhig dang / gnyis pa tshor ba bde dbang ni/ sim pa nyams su myong ba'i lus tshor dang bsam gtan gsum pa'i sems kyi tshor ba bde ba gang rung gis bsdus pa dang / gsum pa tshor ba yi da bde ni/ bsam gtan gsum pa las gzhan pa'i sim pa nyams su myong ba'i sems tshor zhig dang / bzhi ba tshor ba yid mi bde ni gdung ba nyams su myong ba'i sems tshor zhig dang / lnga ba tshor ba btang snyoms ni/ sim gdung bar ma nyams su myong ba'i tshor ba zhig go /des na bsam gtan gsum pa na sems kyi tshor ba bde dbang yin la bsam gtan gsum pa las gzhan na/ tshor ba lngar phyes pa'i bde ba'am bde dbang de lus tshor yin dgos/ bsam gtan gsum pa de na/ nyon mongs can gyi sems bde yod de/ chos bcu drug ste/ mi rtag sogs yul du 'gyur tshul bshad pa'i skabs su/ sems bde de la spang bya ris lnga yod par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dad sogs lam ma lhags nas yod/ /kun brtus dang ni bsngu ba las/ /kun shes byed dang kun shes la/ /spyor mthong mthong sgom gnyis gnyis bshad/ /kun shes ldan nam bsrung bar mthun/ /zhes gsungs te/ dad pa brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi dbang bo lnga'i sa mtshams lam ma zhugs nas yod/ dri 273

(mid kyi dbang bo gsum gyi dang bo/ mthong lam yin te/ mthong lam de mi rtag sogs bcu drug sngar mngon sum du mi shes pa kun gsar du shes pa'i skabs kyi zag med kyi lam yin pa'i stabs kyis/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang bo zhes brjod la/ de la dbang bo dad sogs lnga dang / yid dbang dang /tshor ba bde ba dang / yid bde dang / btang snyoms dang dgu yod/ sa mtshams mthong lam kho nar yod/ gnyis pa sgom lam yin te/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa kun mngon sum du shes shing sgom spang spong phyir du sgom pa'i zag med kyi lam yin pa'i stabs kyis/ kun shes pa'i dbang bo zhes brjod la/ dbye na sngar ltar dgu yod/sa mtshams sgom lam kho nar yod/ gsum pa ni/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i mi slob lam yin te/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes 'di la yod pa'am/ de bsrung ba'i ngang tshul can gyi lam bden yin pa'i stabs kyis/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang bo zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ dbye na sngar ltar dgu yod/ sa mtshams mi slob lam kho nar yod do/ /kun btus las/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang bo gang zhe na/ sbyor ba'i lam dang mthong ba'i lam gyi sems kyi skad cig ma bco lnga la gang dbang byedu pa'o/ /zhes dang / rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba 274

las k+shing / byang chub sims dpa' rnams kyis mi shos pa kunalhashes par byed pa'i dbang bo la sogs pa ji ltar rnam par bzhag ce na/ smras pa/ mos pa spyod pa'i sa la ni dang bo rnam par bzhag go /de las gzhan pa lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sa dag la ni gnyis pa kun shes pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la ni dbang bo gsum pa kun shes ldan pa rnam par bzhag par blta bar bya'o/ /zhes kun btus las/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang bo la sbyor lam dang mthong lam gnyis bzhagabasdu ba las/ dang bo/ mos spyod kyi sa la bzhag gnyis pa/lhag bsam dag pa'i sa la bzhag gsum pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la bzhag go / bzo gnas spyod lam sprul sems sogs/ /rnam smin min te 'bad bya'i sbyir/ /skes gsungs te/ 'dir dbang bo nyer gnyis la rnam smin yin khyad par bshad pa'i skabs su/ srog ni rnam smin kho na dang / dad sogs lnga dang dri med kyi dbang bo gsum ste tha ma brgyad dang yid mi bde rnam smin ma yin pa kho na dang / lhag ma dbang bo gzugs can bdun dang tshor lnga'i lhag ma bzhi dang yid dbang dang bcu gnyis la rnam smin yin min gnyis yod/ mig rna ba sna snyi lus pho yo'i dbang bo ste27 5

gizugs can bdun gyi rgyas byung rnams rnam smin min la/ de lnga'i nyon mongs can rnams dang spyod lam pa dang bzo'i gnas dang sprul ba rnams rnam smin min te/ 'bad pas—bskyed dgos pas lung ma bstan yin kyang rnam smin ma yin pa'i phyir/ tshe yi gtong 'arngog tshul la laspre / /rnam smin 'dod tshul gtong 'jog tshul/ /srag tshe'i khyad par gtong 'jog gi /dgos pa bzhi 'o / /zhes gsungs te tshe'i gtong 'jog gi tshul bshad pa la yang / rnam smin gyi 'dod tshul/ gtong 'jog byed tshul/gtong 'jog gi srog dang tshe'i khyad pār/ gtong 'jog gi dgos pa dang bzhi'o/ / dang bor lang / /yo byad phul nas rab mtha' la/ /zhugs las langs te smon tshig gis/ /tshe rgyur bskur phyir tshe 'jog la/ /kha cig/ tshe 'di'i rnam smin zer/ /la la snga ma'i las lhag ma/ /bsgoms mthus drangs phyir snga ma zer/ /dbyangs sgrogs bsam gtan rgyas byung ste/ /'dod pa'i lus la'ang ting 'dzin mthus/ /bsam gtan sas brtsas 'byung ba tsher/ /mthun dang 'gal ba mngon byas nas/ /rim bzhin 'jog dang gtong bar smra/ /spob dpon de tshe rgyas byung dang / /lhag ma'i rnam smin cha gnyis bzhag /srog ne gcig rtu rnam smin du/ /blob dpon mi ba zhed gang spel gsal/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong 276

—du bshad pa de bzhi'i dang bor tshe gtong 'jog gi khyad par yod de/ dgra bcom pa'am dge slong rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa sems la dbang thob pas yo byad phul nas rab mtha'i ting nge 'dzin la —zhugs nas/ de las langs te bdag gi longs spyod kyi rnam smin tshe'i rnam smin du 'gyur na bsam zhing smon tshig brjod pa'i sgo nas tshe'i rgyur bsgyur ba'i phyir tshe 'jog par byed la/ 'di ni kha cig tshe'i 'du byed 'jog pa tshe 'di'i rnam smin yin zerngo /la la na re/ tshe snga ma'i las kyi lhag ma bsgoms stobs kyis drangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshe snga ma'i lhag ma yin zer/ dbyangs sgrogs na re/ bsam gtan gyis rgyas byung yin te/ 'dod khams kyi lus rten la'ang ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus/ bsam gtan sas bsdus kyi 'byung ba tshe dang mthun pa mngon du byas nas tshe 'jog la/ tshe dang 'gal ba ste mi mthun pa mngon du byas nas tshe gtong bar smra'o/ /slob dpon gyis/ dgra bcom pa sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshe ni ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i rgyas byung kho na dang / srog lhag ma las byung ba rnam smin yin pas cha gnyis su bzhag go /srog ni mtha' gcig tu rnam smin du slob dpon gyis mi bzhed pa gang spel du gsal lo/ /btsun pa mtha' las go chas ne/ /tshe yi rnam par smin pa'i las/ /mthong tshos 277

thung bar rigs min te/ /mthong chos dbye ba 'chad 'byur sbyir/ /gnyis pa'ang mi rigaspomathong chos la/ /byung 'a ra la sogs 'chol bar 'thur/ /gzugs kyi 'byung bas gnod med jir/ /gtodzā ba mi 'thad tshe 'apos par/ /thal phyir rjom pa'ang btang 'gyur zer/ /blob dpon sgrag gi lhag ma ne/ /'dod sbyir skyon 'di 'brel brdodaka'/ /zhes gsungs te/ btsun pa mtha' yas go cha na re/ dang bo mi 'thad de/ tshe'i rnam par smin pa'i las mthong chos la myong bar mi rigs te/ mthong chos kyi dbye ba 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'ang mi rigs te/ mthong chos myong 'gyur dang / skyes nas myong 'gyur dang / lan grwangs gzhan la myong/ 'gyur gsum 'chol bar 'gyur te/ tshe snga mar myong 'gyur te/ phyi mar myong ba'i phyir/ gsum pa'ang mi 'thad de/ gzugs kyi sas bsdus kyi 'byung bas/ 'dod pa'i tshe la gnod pa med pa'i phyir/ de'i dbang gis tshe gtong ba mi 'thad la/ bzhi ba slob dpon gyi 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ sngon gyi las zad pas srog sngon med skyes pas tshe 'phos par thal ba'i phyir sdom pa'ang btang bar 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir zer/ slob dpon gyis srog gi lhag ma ni 'dod pas tshe 'phos par thal ba'i skyon 'di 'brel 278

dka' ba ste mi 'brel lo/ /lan la bye smras mthong chos 'azas/ /yin mang skyon med mchod rten sogs/ /gsos pas tshe 'phel mdor gsungs sbyir/ /'azhir lang mi 'gal shugs bstan yin/ /ris mthun gnas phyir bzhi ba'ang nyams/ /zhes gsungs te/'dod pa dang bo la skyon brjod pa tshe'i rnam par smin pa'i las mthong chos la myong ba mi 'thad pa'i skyon brjod pa'i lan/ mthong chos kyi 'bras bu yin kyang skyon med de/ mchod rten sogasagasos pas tshe 'phel ba mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir yang mthong chos yin pa la 'gal ba med de/ mngon pa'i skabs 'dir mdo'i don de shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /'dod pa bzhi ba la skyo na brjod pa/ tshe 'phos par thal ba'i skyon med de/ lhag ma'i tshe'i ris mthun gnas par gsungs phyir/khyod kyis 'dod pa bzhi ba la skyon brjod pa'ang mi 'thad pas nyams so/ /tshe dang longs spyod rnam smin ni/ /smon pas badzir ba gtong 'arjog tshul/ /gling gsum rten la dus mi spyor/ /rnam grol lam pa zhig gis byed/ /ces gsungs te/ tshe dang longs spyod dang rnam smin ni smo na pas bsgyur nas gtong ba dang 'jog pa'i tshul la 'dod tshul bshad zin pa ltar la/ rten gang yin pa ni/ gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med kyi rten la yin la/279

rten gzhan la de byedaskepa'i dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ gang zag gang gis byed pa ni/ bsam gtan bezhi ba sgom pa'i du.oṃdang mi sbyor ba'i rnam grol lam pa ba zhig gise byed pa'i phyir/ ( spog tshe gcug kyang sngon da lta'i/ /'bras dang ris gnas tshe dang ni/ /'tsho ba srog sogs 'dod tshul mang / /zhes gsungs te/ srog dang tshe'i khyad par la 'dod tshul mang ste/kha cig de gnyis la khyad par med par 'dod/ la la na re/ sngon las kyi 'bras bu ni tshe'i 'du byed dang da lta ba'i las kyi 'bras bu srog gi 'du byed du 'dod/ yang gzhan dag gis ris methun gnas par gyur pa tshe'i 'du byed dang / dus gzhan gyi bar du 'tsho ba srog gi 'du byed du 'dod pa sogs 'dod tshul mang bo yod do/ /gtong 'jog dgos pha blob dpon gyis/ /'chi dang tshe la mnga' banyes gsungs/ /bye tsā bdud rgyal shes ched de/ /yangs pa can du 'tsho btang bas/ /phung brtsom byin tsābs 'chi bdag brtsom/ /'chi bdag(mchims)gyad kyi lul bcom 'khyal/ /zhes gsungs te/ gtong 'jog gi dgos pa ni/ mdo sde ba dang slob dpon gyis 'chi ba dang tshe la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir de gtong bar mdzad la/ tshe la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir du sku tshe'i 'du byed zla ba gsum du byin gyis 280
