rlibs par bzhed/ bye smra ltar na ston pa bdud bzhi las rgyal bar shes pa'i ched yin te/ byang chub shing drung du srod la lha'i bu'i bdud btul/ thun gnyis pa la lha'i spyan gyisdo 'jig rten la gzigs/ thun gsum pa la nyon mongs pa'i bdud btul/yangs pa can du sku tshe'i 'du byed zla ba gsum gyi bar du byin gyis rlabs pa dang 'chi bdag gi bdud btul ba gnyis gnas dang dus gcig tu mdzad pa dang / srog gi 'du byed btang ba na phung bo'i bdud btul ba'i phyir/ tshe gtong 'jog gi dgos pa yod de/ gson kyang gzhan la phan mi thogs pa dang / lus la nad sogs kyis gdung bar mthong na gtong la/ yun ring du gnas nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par mthong na sku tshe'i 'du byed 'jog par byed pa'i phyir/ kha cig yangs pa can du sku tshe byin gyis rlabs pas 'chi bdag gi padud las rgyal/ rtsa can du sku tshe btang bas ni phung bo'i bdud las rgyal zer ba ni 'khrule ba yin te/ gnyis ka yangs pa can du mdzad pa gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ / rnam par smin pa bcu gsum las/ /'dod par dang bor lus srog gnyis/ /mer mer lus kyang dbang bo min/ /yid dang btang snyoms sogs de tshe/ /skye srid nyon mongs can du gsungs/ /ri 281

malhams mdzod de'i rma'ang yid sogs la/ /rnam smin nges d+dhad la dgor+pās gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ dbang bo rnyed gtong gi tshul la khams gsum gyis rnyed tshul yod la/ 'dod par skye niganas gsum gyis rnyed tshul so sor yod/ de la 'dir rnam smin du gyur pa'i rnyed tshul gsungs pa yin la/ rnam smin du gyur pa ni/ srogayid/ btang snyoms/ mig sogs lnga/ yid mi bde/ lus dbang /pho dbang / mo dbang ste bcu gsum las/ 'dod par dang —bor skyes tshe/ lus kyi dbang bo dang / srog gi dbang bo gnyis rnyed/ mngal gyi gnas skabs kyi mer mer bo lus yin kyang lus rten gyi dbang bo min la/ yid dang btang snyoms sogs skye ba len pa de'i tshe skye srid nyon mongs can yin par gsungs pas rnam smin min dgos la/ mchims mdzod las/ de'i tshe'ang yid dang btang snyoms la rnam smin yin pa'i nges pa med pa la dgongs gsungs so/ /dzis skyes mtshan med mtshan gcig dang / /mtshan gnyis pas ne drug bdun brgyad/ /phyi ma ngan song kho nar yod/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dod pa'i rdzus skyes la bskal ba dang bo'i mi ltar mtshan ma gnyis ka med pa dang / 'dod lha ltar mtshan gnyis gang rung gcig ldan pa dang / mtshan gnyis pa can rnams kyi rim pa ltar/ mtshan med pas mig sogs lnga 282

deng srog dbang dang drug rnyed/ mtshan gcig pas mtshan gahaṃs gang rung dang mig sogs lnga dang srog dang bdun rnyed/ mtshan gnyis pas mig sogs lnga dang srog dang pho mo'i dbang bo gnyis dang brgyad rnyed/ phyi ma rdzus skyes mtshan gnyis pa ni ngan song kho nar yod pa yin no/ /mig sogs spog yid btang stoms brgyad/ /gzugs gtong 'dod na mtshan sngar bzhin/ /dge bas 'chi la lnga lnga bsnan/ /zhes gsungs te/ dbang bo gtong tshul la/ gzugs khams su/ 'chi tshe mig sogs lnga dang srog yid btang snyoms brgyad cig car gtong / gzugs med du 'chi tshe srog yid btang snyoms gsum cig car 'gag 'dod pa na mtshan gnyis yod med sngar rnyed tshul bshad pa'i skabs bzhin la/ bde 'gror rdzus te skye ba la dbang bo lnga ma tshang bar mi skye ba'i phyir/ 'dod par cig car du 'chi ba na/ mtshan gnyis ldan pa mig sogs lnga srog yid btang snyoms gsum pho mo'i dbang bo gnyis te bcu cig car gtong ba'i phyir/ mtshan gcig pas ni/ dbang bo lnga dang srog yid btang snyoms gsum ste brgyad dang pho mo gang rung gi de dang dgu gtong ba'i phyir/ bskal ba dang bo'i mi lta bu'i mtshan med pas mig sogs lnga srog yid btang snyoms gsum ste brgyad cig car gtong ba'i phyir/ 'dod 283

khams su rim gyis 'chi bas/ lus dang srog yid btang snyoms kyi dbang bo bzhi cig car btang ste/ lus can 'chi ba'i tshe de dag so sor phral nas 'chi ba med pa'i phyir/ dge sems kyis dbang bo gtong tshul yang / khams gsum gyi sngar cig car 'chi bas dbang bo so so'am de dang de'i steng du dad sogs lnga lnga bsnan pa'i phyir/ der thal gzugs med du brgyad dang / gzugs khams su bcu gsum/ 'dod par mtshan gnyis par bco lnga/ mtshan gcig par bcu bzhi/ bskal ba dang bo'i mi lta bu mtshan med pas bcu gsum dang / rim gyis 'chi na dbang bo dgu gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /dbang bo 'phos na tshor gnyis te/ /mothar gyis phyir mi 'ong gi 'azas/ /dbang bo brgyad dang dgu yis 'thob/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di dbang bo dus thob ni gzhung du gsal la/ gnyis ni bdun dang brgyad dang dgus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'bras bu bar ba gnyis bdun dang brgyad dang dgus thob par bshad la/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob tshul ni/ mthong lam thob pa'i rjes su/ zhi rags rnam can gyi lam la brten nas thob na/ dad sogs dbang bo lnga dang yid dbang dang mi lcogs med kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms dang bdun gyis thob pa ni/ de ltar thob pa'i 284

dbang rtul dang dbang rnon phal cher gyi thob tshal spyir bshad pa ༄yin la/ 'on kyang dbang rnone 'ga' zhig gis bathod pa brgyad kyi rjes su zhi rags rnam can gyi bar chad med lam dgu ba zhig mngon du byas pa de dad sogs lnga dang yid dang btang snyoms bdun gyis thob la/ 'dod nyon dgu be spangs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rnam grol lam dgu ba thob tshe dbang bo 'phos nas bsam gtan dang bo'i dngos gzhi'i tshor ba yid bde dang brgyad kyis thob pa gcig yod pa'i phyir/ dbang rtul dang dbang rnon phal cher gyis de ltar mi nus te/ nyer bsdogs kyi tshor ba btang snyoms nas dngos gzhi'i tshor ba yid bder 'pho dka' ba'i phyir/ mtha' dpyod las par 'dir 'di 'dra'i zhib cha mang ngo gsungs/ de'i phyir 'dir/ dbang bo 'phos na tshor gnyis te/ /zhes 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam gyi rnam grol lam gyi skabs dbang bo bsam gtan dang bor 'phos na dad sogagolnga dang yid dbang dang nyer bsdogs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms dang bsam gtan dang bo'i dngos gzhi'i tshor ba yid bde dang brgyad kyis mthar gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob la/ rgyun zhugs ltar chags bral sdon song gis dbang bo dgus thob pa yin no/ / —2skye5

sdes ldan rnams kyang phan tshun du/ /yod par ma nges sems med gnyis/ /gsum ba'i zag med bde thob pa'i/ /gzugs med phyir mi.ā+ong dgra brtsom/ /res ldan gsum dang de bzhir ldan/ /'azhi ni bcu gcig ldan min nam/ — /zhes gsungs te/ dbang bo de dag ldan tshul la/ nges ldan gsum yod de/ btang snyoms kyi dbang bo dang srog dbang dang yid dbang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ nges ldan gsum kyang phan tshun du yod par ma nges te/ sems med snyoms 'jug pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi srog dbang yod kyang / yid dang tshor ba gnyis med pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang de'i rgyud la de dag gi thob yod pas ldan par bzhag go /zag med kyi bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gang zag gis zag med kyi bde da bang thob yod pas/ de 'dra'i gzugs med kyi phyir mi 'ong dang dgra bcom pas nges ldan gsum dang bde dbang de dang bzhi ldan/—phyir 'ong dang dgra bcom 'di ni dbang bo bcu gcig dang ldan pa min nam ste/ yin te/ bde ba dang yid bde dang btang snyoms dang srog dang yid dang dad sogs lnga dang / kun shes pa'i dbang bo dang kun shes ldan pa'i dbang bo gnyis gang rung dang bcu gcig ldan pa'o/ /bsam gtan mtha' dang gzugs med 386

yi/ /so skye ma gtogs dzoms cad la/ /bde ba ldan phyir lus ldan la/ /lnga dang mi ldan gang yin dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ bsam gtan gyi mtha' ste bsam gtan bzhi ba dang gzugs med gnyis kyi so skye ma gtogs 'phags pa thams cad la bde ba'i dbang bo dang ldan pa'i phyir na lus dang yang ldan pa'i phyir/nges ldan gsum dang bde lus gnyis te lnga dang ldan la/ des na/ lus ldan sogs la lnga dang mi ldan pa gang yin dpyad gsungs pa ni/ lus sogs gang rung ldan na nges ldan gsum dang /tshor ba bde sdug gang rung ste lnga dang ldan pas so/ /bzhi tsam dang ldan pa yod de/ gong du/ gzugs med phyir mi 'ong dgra bcom/ /nges ldan gsum dang de bzhir ldan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mig sogs bzhi dang ldan pa ni/ /nges ldan gsum lus rang ste lnga/ /yid bde ldan yang bde ste lnga/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa'i so skye la/ /bde med lus bde dang bos brtsas/ /gsum pa'i sems bde ma thob phyir/ /zhe na ma grub gsum pa yi/ /sems bde ston mongs can ldan phyir/ /'on kyang gsum pa'i sems thob min/ /zhes gsungs te/ mig sogs kyi dbang bo ldan pa la dbang bo bzhi dang ldan pa ni/ nges ldan gsum dang lus dbang dang mig sogs dbang bo lnga rang rang 287

re brtsis pas lnga yod la/ yid bde ldan yang bde ba zhes gcig tu brtsi bas/ nges ldan gsum dang lus dbang dang bde ba ste lnga/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i so skye la bde dab nga med de bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi ma thob pa'i phyir/ lus bde yod kyang de ni phyis su skyes pa'i bsam gtan dang bo'i sas bsdus yin la/ de'i rgyud la gsum pa'i sems bde med par thal/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i sems bde ma thob pa'i phyir zhe na/ rtags ma grub ste/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i semasabade nyon mongs can yod pa'i phyir te/ gsum pa'i nyon mongs yod pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems thob pa min no/ /sngug bsngal ldan la nges ldan gsum/ /chags bral yid mi bde spangs phyir/ /tshor gzhan bzhi dang bdun ldan no/ /po mo yid mi bde gsum yang / /snga ma'i bdun steng rang ste brgyad/ /ces gsungs te/ tshor ba sdug bsngal dang ldan pa la/ nges ldan gsum dang sdug bsngal rang ste bzhi/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong gis yid mi bde spangs pa'i phyir/ tshor ba gzhan bzhi dang nges ldan gsum ste bdun ldan no/ /pho mo'i dbang bo gnyis dang yid mi bde gsum po gang rung dang ldan na/ snga ma nges ldan gsum dang 288

tshor ba bzhi ste bdun gyi steng du rang rang bsnan pa'i brgyad yod do/ /dad sogs nges ldan gsum ste brgyad/ /kun shes la ni de yi nyeng / /bde gnyis rang ste bcu gcig go /kun shes la'ang gzhan bcu 'dra/ /zhes gsungs te/ dad sogs dbang bo lnga dang ldan pa la de lnga'i steng du nges ldan gsum bsnan pa'i brgyad yod pa dang / kun shes pa'i dbang bo dang ldan pa la ni/ gong gi de brgyad kyi steng du bde dbang dang yid bde gnyis dang kun shes pa'i dbang bo rang ste bcu gcig dang ldan/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang bo dang ldan pa la/ kun shes ldan pa las gzhan rnams kun shes pa'i dbang bo'i skabs dang 'dra'o / / zag med bde gnyis gzugs med na'ang / /sa 'phos zag med gtong rgyu min/ /debang tshongs gtong lang rjo thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ zag med kyi yid bde dang bde dbang gnyis gzugs med na yod de/ bsam gtan dang bo'i dngos gzhi thob nas yid bde thob/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi thob nas bde dbang thob/ de dag lam zag med kyi ngo bor gyur tshe/ sa 'phos pas zag bcas gtong yang zag med gtong rgyu min stabs/ gzugs med 'phags rgyud la'ang bde ba lha89

gnyis ka yod la/ 'bras bu thob pa dang dbang bo sbyangs pas/'bras bu thob tshe zhugs pa'i lam gtong ba dang / dbang bo sbyangs nas dbang rnon du gyur tshe rtul bo'i lam gtong ba yin yang / 'bras bu thob pas 'bras gnas su gyur pa dang dbang bo sbyangs pas dbang rnon du gyur pas dbang bo rnon po thob pa yin/ kun shes byed pa 'dod rten phyir/ /tshor bzhi dad sogs spog lus yid/ /'di la pho mo gang rung gi /dbang bo nges ldan zhib cha gnyis/ /bshad spyang 'dod lha bzhi yis gnod/ /ces gsungs te/ kun shes byed pa 'dod pa'i rten la 'thob dgos te/ 'di mthong lam yin pas/ gong na mthong lam med/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la ldan pa tshor ba bzhi dad sogs lnga srog dbang lus dbang yid dbang dang bcu gnyis khyod dang bcu gsum dang ldan pa yin la/ de gsar thob kyi gang zag de 'dod rten can yin phyir/ pho mo'i dbang bo gang rung zhig dgos te/ de dang mi ldan pa dang nyams pa la sdom pa dang 'bras bu thob pa dang 'dod chags dang bral ba mi srid la/ mthong lam thob pa yang mi srid pas/ pho mo'i dbang bo gang rung zhig bsnan te bcu bzhi nges ldan yin zhe na/ de la mchims mdzod du zhib cha gnyis byas yod de/ dang bo ni bcu bzhir mi 'gyur te/290

mthong lam thog mar thob pa'i rten du pho mo'i dbang bo gang rung zhig dgos kyi/ thob zin gnas pa'i rten du mi dgos te/ thog mar mthong lam thob pa'i dus su pho mo gang rung gi 7tshan ma yod kyang phyis ma tshang ba srid pa'i phyir zer/ zhib cha gnyis pa ni/'dir ni gang zag spyi'i dbang du byas nas nges ldan bshad pa spyo yin gyi pho mo gcig kho na'i nges par ldan tshul bshad pa ma yin —pas/ pho la brtsis na mo dbang dang mi ldan/ mo la brtsis na pho dbang dang mi ldan pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas/ de gnyis nges ldan du ma brtsis so zhes zer ba nyid rigs so zhes mchims—gsungs/ de ltar pho mo gang rung gi dbang bo nges par ldan pa'i zhib cha gnyis bshad yod kyang / de gnyi sa la 'dod lha phyi ma bzhis gnod de/ de'i tshul ni/ 'dod lha 'thab bral na gnyis 'khyud pa tsam/ dga' ldan lag bcangs dang 'phrul dga' rgod pa dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bltas pa tsam gyis 'khrig pa'i bde ba myong bar byed la/ 'dod lha de bzhi'i rten la mthong la ma thob pa yod kyang pho mo gang rung gi dbang bo med pa'i phyir/'dir srid ldan gyi skabs yin pas skyon med ces zhib cha byas so/ /dge med 'dod na 'ching ldan phyir/ /byis pa dri med ma gtogs pa'i/ /bcu dgu ldan rnams sdom ldan min/ /mtshan 291

gnyis byung bas gtong phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba med pa'i gang zag de 'dod khams na so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan yin phyir so skye la dri med kyi dbang bo gsum ma gtogs gzhan bcu dgu dang ldan la/ de yang 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang bo rnams tshang zhing mtshan gnyis dang ldan pa rnams yin pas/ sdom ldan min te mtshan gnyis byung bas sdom pa gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /chags bcas 'phags par mtshan gzhan dor/ /dri med gcig ste bcu dgu rung / /de ldan dge spong sogs kyang rung / /phyir mi 'ong la mang na lang / /bco brgyad yid mi bde spangs phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ma bral ba ridag la/ mtshan gcig dor bas dri med gcig ste bcu dgu yin te/ 'phags pa mtshan gnyis pa med pa'i phyir/ de ltar bcu dgu dang ldan pa'i dge slong dang dge slong ma yang rung / phyir mi 'ong 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bas yid mi bde dang mi ldan pa'i phyir mang na yang bco brgyad yin no/ /gzhi lngar skyar ba sgrog pa'i pyir/ /dzis grub lnga bshad grub mtha'i gakhyang / /blob dpon snas brgyad 'dus pa'i sa/ /nus par bzhed phyir snas zul med/ /ces gsungs te/ gzhi lnga la skur ba'am log rtog zlog pa'i phyir du ཿ9lha

gzhi lnga bshed pa yin te/ gzhi lnga ni/ snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi / gtso bo sems kyi gzhi/ 'khor sems byung gi gzhi/ mtshungs pa dang ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi gzhi/ 'dus ma byas kyi gzhi lnga'o/ /gzugs kyi ngo bo sogs la log par rtog pa dang /sems kyang sems byung las gzhan ma yin no snyam pa dang / sems byung yang sems las don gzhan ma yin no snyam du 'dzin pa dang / thob pa sogs rdzas grub med dam snyam pa dang / 'dus ma byas la rdzas grub med dam snyam pa'i log rtog lnga bsal ba'i phyir du gzhi de lngar bshad pa dang / rang gi grub mtha' gsal bar bya ba'i gzhung yin no/ /slob dpon dang mdo sde bas/ rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus pa'i rdzas de 'byung bzhi'i khams kyi ngo bo'am nus pa la bzhed cing / sa chu mtshan nyid pa ma yin par bzhed pas rdzas rdul med par 'dod do/ /bye smras sa jul blo yis kyang / /gzhig med che chung bsags zul 'dra/ /de brgyad 'dus kyang mi che ste/ /bye ma chu dang me lcags bzhin/ /zhes’gsungs te/ bye brag smra bas/ rdzas rdul dang / bsags rdul gnyis 'dod la/ rdzas rdul phra rab gzugs can gzhan gyis bcom pa dang blos gzhig tu med pa'i rdzas yan gar bar 'dod/ bsags rdul phra rab ni/ gzugs can gzhan gyis gzhig tu med 293

pa dang / gzugs kyis churomatha' rdzas rdul dang 'dra yang blos rdzas so sor dbyer yod par 'dod/ bye smras rdzas rdul phra rab de blo yis kyang gzhig tu med la che chung bsags rdul dang 'dra/rdzas rdul de brgyad 'dus pa bsags rdul yin kyang / bsags rdul lhag par mi che ste/ dper na/ tshad long gi bye ma5phor gang dang de tsam gyi chu phor gang phor ba gcig po der shong ba bzhin dang / lcags kyi gong bu ril bo bsags pa'i tshe me rdul dang sa rdul che chung mnyam la gong bu gcig tu gyur pa bzhin no/ /zhes zer ro kun kyang 'byung bzhi gzugs dri ro reg bzhi'i/ /bdag phyir sra gsher mi 'dra med cus rtsod/ /bye smras che chung shas zer mdo zhe bas/ /nus pa tsam phyir rtsod lan gnyi rge bkag /ces gsungs te/'dod khams kyi rdul du grub pa'i gzugs kun kyang 'byung ba bzhi dang gzugs dri ro reg bzhi'i bdag nyid du grub pa'i phyir sra gsher dro ba g.yo ba rnams so sor mi 'dra ba med ces rtsod pa'i lan la/ bye brag smra bas/ 'byung bzhi'i khams la che chung yod pas/ dper na lcags lta bu la tshogs pa na 'byung bzhi yod kyang sa khams shas shin tu che la gzhan gsum shas chung ba'i phyir ze ra/mdo sde ba na re/ dogs pa slong ba dang / de la lan btab pa gnyi 294

gi mi 'thad pa thal/ shing skam lta bu la khams lhag ma gsum gyi nus pa dang khams yod kyang me chu rlung gsum rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas med pa'i phyir te/ khams de bzhi 'gal ba'i phyir/ zhes rtsod lan gnyi ga bkag go /mtshan nyid kyis na dbyibs snas sogs phyir nyung / /skye mched kyis na 'byung bzhi reg bya'i phyir/ /mang zer rang lugs rten dang brten pa yi/ /dbang byas 'byung rbazhi rgyur byas bzhi bzhi yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdo sde ba na re/ bye brag smra ba khyod kyis bsags rdul gyi tshogs pa na rdul rdzas brgyad yod par bshad pa de rdzas rdul so so'i ngo bo'i sgo nas yod pa yin nam/ skye mched kyi sgo nas yod pa yin/ dang bo ltar na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi bsags rdul de la dbyibs dang / 'jam rtsub dang / lci yang gang rung gi rdzas kyang yod pas nyung bar 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ltar na/ 'byung ba bzhi ga yang reg rgya'i skye mched yin pas grangs mang bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ bye smra na re/ nged rang gi lugs ni skabs 'di'i rdzas de la rang mtshan gyi rdzas dang skye mched kyi rdzas gnyis yod cing rten gyi dbang du byas na 'byung bzhi rang mtshan pa'i rdzas bzhi dang /brten pa'i dbang du byas na gzugs dri ro reg bya'i skye mched bzhi'i rdzas yod pa'i phyir/ des na 'byung ba bzhi bo ni ngo bo'i lha95

sgo nas bzhag—ste/ 'a/byung 'gyur gyi rten du gyur pa'i phyir/ 'byung 'gyur bzhi bo skye ma kyi sgo nas bzhag ste/ 'byung ba'i brten par gyur —pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar byas na dbyibs ni gzugs kyi skye mched dang 'jamartsub lci yang sogs reg byar 'du bas grangs mang nyung gi skyon med do zer/ yang mdo sde ba na re/ khyod kyi grangs nges de mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod pa'i bsags rdul gcig la yang kha dog gi rten 'byung ba bzhi dang / dri ro reg gsum gyi rten 'byung ba bzhi rnams rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab ste/ rdzas rigs kyi sgo nas bshad ba yin zhing de bzhi'i rten 'byung ba bzhi bzhi bcu drug yod kyang 'byung ba bzhir rigs gcig pa'i phyir/ des na 'dod pa'i rdul skye ba na rdul rdzas so so ba brgyad du grangs nges te zla dang ma bcas par skye ba mi srid par bzhed pa'i phyir/'dus byas mtshan nyid dang ni kun skye lang / /ma gtogs pa la thob med rgyud gtogs kyang / /khu mchog ltar ldang be'u ltar 'brang bas/ /de min grib ma lta bur lhan cig 'byung / /kho na da nga phyir 'am zhes rnam brtag mthod/ /ces gsungs te/ gtso sems skye ba'i tshe 'khor sems byung dang lhan cig skye la/ sems med par sems byung yang skye ba med de/ na dag lhan cig 'byung ba'i phyir/296

'dus byas thams cad 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid skye 'gag gam/sa pa mi rtag pa bzhi kun dang lhan cig skye yang / rgyud du ma gtogs pa ste rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa la thob pa med la/ rgyud du gtogs kyang / thob pa la khyu mchog ltar ldang ba'i 'das pa'i thob pa dang be'u ltar rjes su 'brang ba'i ma 'ong ba'i thob pa dang de min grib ma lta bu lhan cig 'byung ba'i thob pa dang gsum yod la phyi ma da lta ba kho na'i ldan thob dang rnyed thob 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyud du gtogs ma gtogs gnyis la thob pa yod med kyi bye brag bstan pa'i phyir/ kho na dang don 'dra ba'i phyir 'am sgra smras te rnam par brtag par mdzad do/ /kun btus n+de tshan drug dang nga gcig gsungs/ /'dir ni brjed ngas shes bzhin min dran pa/ /rnam g.yeng ting 'dzin gtici mug med lta blos/ /brtsas byur sa mang lnga dang ma nges pa/ /brgyad de sems byung bzhi bcu rtsa drug gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems byung gi dbye ba la/kun btus las/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ dge ba bcu gcig rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi ste sde tshan drug ste sems byung nga gcig gsungs/ mdzod 'dir brjed ngas dang shes bzhin ma yin pa dran pa'i ldog cha la btags pa dang / rnam g.yeng ting 'dzin gyi ldog cha la btags pa dang /397

gti mug med pa'i dge rtsa dang lta ba ni blo gros te shes rab kyi cha la btags pa'i phyir/ de dag gis bsdus pa'i phyir/ sa mang lnga dang / ma nges pa brgyad de sems byung bzhi bcu rtsa drug gsungs/ sa mang lnga yod de/ sems kyi sa mang / dge ba'i sa mang / nyon mongs pa'i sa mang / mi dge ba'i sa mang / nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba ste sde tshan lnga yod pa'i phyir/ dang bo yod de/ tshor ba/ sems pa/ 'du shes/ 'dun pa/ reg pa/blo gros/ dran pa/ yid byed/ mos pa/ ting 'dzin dang bcu chos can/ sems kyi sa mang bo zhes bya ste/ gtso sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dad pa/ bag yod/ shin sbyangs/ btang snyoms/ ngo tsha shes pa/ khrel yod pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dod chags med pa/ zhe sdang med pa/rnam par mi 'tshe ba/ brtson 'grus dang bcu bo chos can/ dge ba'i sa mang zhes bya ste/ dge ba'i gtso sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rmongs pa/ bag med/ le lo/ ma dad pa/ rmugs pa/ rgod pa dang drug po chos can/nyon mongs chen po'i sa mang zhes bya ste/ dbang shes/ yid shes/ mthong spang / sgom spang du gyur pa'i nyon mongs can gyi gtso sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ bzhi ba ni/ khrel med ཿ98 sgro

dang / ngo tsha med pa gnyis chos can/ mi dge ba'i sa mang zhes bya ste/ gtso sems mi dge ba kun gyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ lnga ba ni/ khro ba/ 'khon 'dzin/ g.yo/ phrag dog 'tshig pa/ 'chab pa/ ser sna/ sgyu/ rgyags pa/ rnam par 'tshe ba bcu bo chos can/ nyon mongs pa chung ngu'i sa mang zhes bya ste/yid shes dang sgom spang kho nar gyur pa'i nyon mongs can gyi gtso sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro bar nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ the tshom bzhi dang / rtog dpyod gnyis/ 'gyod gnyid gnyis te brgyad chos can/ ma nges pa'i sa ba zhes bya ste/ sems byung sde lnga gang rung du ma nges pa'i phyir/ 'di'i sa mang ngam sa ba zhes pa'i go don yod de/ de dang de'i skye ba'i yul lam go skabs can la de'i sa ba zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /kun btus kun 'gro yul lngas rtsa dzhan lnga/ /dge ba bdun te nyer gnyisga dzis yod gzhan/ /mngon par shes bzhin ma yin brjed ngas g.yeng / /tshul min yid byed log mos lnga gsungs zhing / /zhes gsungs te/ kun btus las/ kun 'gro lnga dang / yul nges lnga/ rtsa nyon lnga/ dge ba bdun te nyer gnyis rdzas yod yin par gsungs te/ mchims mdzod la sa/ de dag ni brjod pa sgra dang rgyu mtshan gzhan la ma ltos par blo yul du 299

'gyur bas rdzas yod dang / gzhan lhag ma nyi shu rtsa dgu ni rgyu mtshan de las phazlog pas btags yod yin par gsungs la/ de dag las gti mug med pa dang lta ba dang shes bzhin ma yin pa gsum ni shes rab kho na dang / bag yod dang btang snyoms ni dge rtsa gsum brtson 'grus dang bcas pa dang / rnam par mi 'tshe ba ni zhe sdang med pa dang / khro ba dang 'khon 'dzin dang 'tshig pa dang phrag dog dang rnam 'tshe lnga ni khrong khro dang / ser sna dang rgyags pa dang rgod pa gsum ni 'dod chags dang / 'chab pa dang rmugs pa dang ma dad pa dang le lo bzhi gti mug dang /g.yo dang sgyu gnyis 'dod chags dang gti mug dang / ngo tsha dang khril med dang rnam g.yeng gsum ni dug gsum dang / bag med ni dug gsum le lo dang bcas pa la btags pa'am/ don gsang las 'dod chags dang gti mug gi char gtogs par bshad do/ ṣām 'tshe ni khong khro la btags par bshad/ brjed ngas ni dran pa nyon mongs can yin la/ gnyid dang 'gyod pa nyi nyon gyis bsdus pa nyon mongs can ni gti mug la btags pa dang / dge ba dang ma bsgribs lung ma bstan ni shes rab la btags par don gsang las bshad do/ /rtog dpyod gnyis ni sems pa dang shes rab la btags pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'dod 300

do/ /gzhan6yang chos mngon pa las ni/ shes bzhin ma yin ṭā/ brjed dās/ rnam g.yeng / tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pā/ log mosna lnga gsung zhing / phran tshegs mi dga' glal byed sems zhum dang / /thu ba zas drod mi zin yid mi byed/ /tha dad 'du shes 'khrags sogs nyer bzhi gsungs/ /sdoms kyang don bdun mi 'gyur der 'dus te/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhi phran tshegs las/ mi dga' ba dang / glal byed pa dang /sems zhum pa dang / bya ba dang / zas kyi drod mi zin pa dang /tha dad pa'i 'du shes dang / 'khruka pa dang / sogs sgras bsdus pa/ yid la mi byed pa dang / ci lus kyi gnas ngan len dang / ru gdug dang / 'phya smod dang / gnam pa nyid dang /mi gnam pa nyid dang / rang bzhin du mi 'dug pa nyid dang /'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang / nye du'i rnam par rtog pa dang / yul mi'i rnam par rtog pa dang / mi 'chi ba'i rnarma par rtog pa dang / brnyas pa dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / rigs snyems pa ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / mya ngan dang / sdug bsngal dang / yid mi bde ba dang nyer bzhirtegasungs/ mchims mdzod las/ gzhi phran tshegs las byung ba'i dga' ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nyi 301

shu rtsa bzhi ste/ bdun cu rtsa bdun yod pa las sde tshan lnga dang /ma nges pa brgyad de bzhi bcu rtsa drug dang / gzhi phran tshegs kyi nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste bdun cu rdzas yod dang / lhag ma bdun btags yod yin te/ zhes gsungs/ de dag sdoms kyang bdun cu las don bdun du mi 'gyur te/ bdun po yang gong gi der 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /dang bo lnga ni sems dang nyon mongs pa/ /chen po'i sa ba gnyis yin mongs sogs drug /nyon mongs kho na'i sa ba'i dbang byas bshad/ /sems kyi sa ba kho na tshor sogs lnga/ /sku bzhi'i rtsi tshul dge la yod med dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ dang bo chos mngon pas bshad pa'i/ shes bzhin ma yin pa/ brjed ngas/ rnam g.yeng / tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa/ log mos lnga ni/ sems kyi sa mang dang / nyon mongs chen po'i sa ba gnyis/ ka yin la/ rmongs pa/ bag med/ le lo/ ma dad pa/ rmugs pa/ rgod pa ste drug ni/ nyon mongs snyo na'i dbang du byas par bshad de/ rtag tu nyon mongs can gyi sems thams cad kyi 'khor du 'byung la/ sems ga zhan gyi 'khor du mi 'byung ba'i sems byung yin pa'i phyir/ sems kyi sa ba kho na yin la/ nyon mongs pa'i sa ba ma yin pa ni/ tshor ba/'du shes/ sems pa/ yid byed/ reg pa ste kurge 'gro lnga'o/ /302

'di ltar sems kyi sa mang dang dge ba'i sa mang gnyis la mu bzhi rtsi tshul yod med dpyad ces dpyod pa'i sgo bstan pa'o/ /sa ni go skabs can don khems gsum dang / /sems can kun kyang sa mang bo yi sa/ /log mo sa sogs lta gti skug med/ /'tshe dang mi 'tshe dgu btags yod/ /gsungs so lhag ma lugs 'dir dpyad/ /mchims kyi dzis yod don yang dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ sa mang ngam sa ba zhes pa'i go don ni/ de dang de skye ba'i yul lam go skabs can gyi don yin te/ khams gsum dang sa thams cad kyang sa mang bo zhes pa'i sa yin no/ /log mos sogs lnga ni/ shes bzhin ma yin pa/ brjed ngas/ rnam g.yeng / tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa/ log mos dang lnga/ lta ba dang drug gti mug med pa darobadun/ rnam par 'tshe ba dang brgyad/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba dang dgu ni/ mchims mdzod mchan las kyang btags yod yin par gsungs so/ /de'i lhag ma mchims mdzod las gsungs pa'i btags yod rnams mdzod kyi lugs 'dir 'thad mi 'thad dpyad par bya zhing / /mchims mdzod kyi rdzas yod kyi don gong du drangs yod pa de yang 'grig mi 'grig dpyad par bya gsung ngo / /rnam par mi 'dze ba dang / rnam 'tshe gnyis btags yod yin par gsungs pa mi bye0ne+e

'thad par thal/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba zhe sdang med pa'i dge rtsa dang / rnam 'tshe zhe sdang du mi 'thad de/ dge ba'i sa mang bcu med par thal ba dang / rnam 'tshe zhe sdang gnyis dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems kyi 'khor du zhe sdang dang rnam 'tshe gnyis yod par 'gyur la/ des na rtsa bar/ nyi shu gcig ces pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir gsungs pa dang / rdzas btags kyang / dkyus na phran tshegs kyi nyer bzhi btags yod par gsungs bzhin/ mchan bur btags yod pa dgur byas pa dang nang 'gal bar gsungs so /som nyir shes rab khro la 'dun/ /ma dad la mos shas chung ste/ /ba tshwa'i rgya mtshor chu bzang bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ shes rab kyi byed las ni som nyi zlog pa'i las can yin la/som nyi dang ldan pa'i sems la shes rab yod na som nyi med par 'gyur la/ de med na sems kyi sa mang bo bar 'gyur ro zhe na/som nyi dang ldan pa'i sems la'ang shes rab cung zad yod mod kyi shas chung la som nyi shas che ba dang / de bzhin du khro ba dang ldan pa'i sems la 'dun pa dang / ma dad pa la mos pa dang ldan pa dag ni shas che chung gi sgo nas 'jog ste/ dper na/ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor/ chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu 304

'dres yod pa bzhin no/ /kun btus ma 'dris dran par dpyad/ /don gnyer 'dun pa'o mos pa dga'/ /sems kyi 'anug pa yid byed do/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun btus las/dran pa sngar 'dris pa'i dngos po kho na la dmigs par gsungs pas/ ma 'dris pa'i don la dmigs pa'i dran pa yod med dang / de dge sems thams cad kyi 'khor du 'byung mi 'byung sogs la dpyad par bya gsungs pa/ ma 'dris pa'i ma rig pa yod na/ sngar ma 'dris pa'i dngos po la dmigs dgos mi dgos sogs dpyad par bya'o/ /sems kyi sa mang bcu'i nang gi 'dun pa ni/ yul drug la dmigs nas byed 'dod pa ste dmigs yul don du gnyer ba yin pas/ don du gnyer ba ni 'dun pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/mos pa ni/ dmigs pa la dga' ba yin te/ rang gi dmigs pa la yon tan du bzung nas gces su byed pa'o/ /sems yul la gtod pa'i sems kyi 'jug pa ni/ yid la byed pa yin te/ mdo las/ yid la byed pa thob pa ni ting nge 'dzin thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dmigs pa la sems 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /rang 'grel bcu bo 'azhi dag gi/ /sems kyi skad cig thams cad la/ /tshogs par 'byung ngo zhes grag go /zhes gsungs /zhes gsungs te/ rang 'grel las bcu bo 'di dag ni sems kyi 305

skad cig gcig la thams cad la tshogs par 'byung ngo zhes grag go /zhes gsungs pa la/ grag ces pa ma rangs pa'i tshig yin gsungs te/ grags zhes 'dun sogs ni/ /kurtswal med bar phung bo lngar/ /gsungs byar 'byung tshul mi 'thad cing / /rtsol bcas yid la byed pa dang / /rtsol med 'du byed btang snyoms gnyis/ /gcig la 'gal sbyir bye smra ba'i/ /mtshan nyid la yang ma rangs so/ /zhes gsungs te/ grags zhes gsungs pa ni bye brag smra bas/ sa mang zhes pa'i don ni sems kyi skad cig thams cad dang khams gsum dang sa thams cad la 'byung bar bshad pa mi 'thad de/ 'dun pa la sogs pa sems kyi sa mang de dag las 'dun pa mos pa ting nge 'dzin/ sems thams cad la mi 'byung ba yin te/ phung bo lnga gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'byung tshul de mi 'thad cing / rtsol bcas yid la byed pa dang rtsol med 'du byed btang snyoms mi rtsol ba gnyis sems kyi skad cig gcig la 'gal/ zhes bye brag smra bas mtshan nyid bzhag pa la ma rangs pa'i grags zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan rtsol gzhan la rtsol med lo/ /dmigs pa mi mtshungs thal bar 'gyur/ /rtog dasprud rig par 'dra'o lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ bye brag smra ba na re/ma khyab ste/ de ltar 'gal yang / yid la byed pa rtsol bas 306

dmigs pa/ gzhan gcig la rtsol / rtsol mid 'du byid bstong snyoms kyis kyang dmigs pa gzhan gcig la rtsol med byed pas mi 'gal zer/ 'dir lo zhes pa ma rangs pa'o/ /slob dpon na re/ 'o na mtshungs ldan thams cad dmigs pa mi mtshungs thal/dge sems 'khor gyi de gnyis mtshungs ldan yin kyang dmigs pa mi mtshungs pa de'i phyir gsungs/ bye smra na re/ skyon med par thal/ rtog dpyod sogs kyi rig pa 'dir yang 'dra'o/ /'o/ zhes pa sngar ltar ma rangs pa'o/ /blob dpon rang lang phung bo lngar/ /yid byed kun 'gror gsungs pa'i phyir/ /btang snyoms dang ldan 'dod dgos zer/ /mtshan nyid khrad par yod dam dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen rang gis kyang / phung bo lnga la tshor ba dang yid byed yod pa de/ tshor ba 'du shes sems pa yid byed reg pa ste kun 'gro lnga'i yid byed du gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gtso sems gcig gi 'khor du/rtsol med tshor ba btang snyoms dang / rtsol bcas yid la byed pa gnyis ka yod par thal bar 'gyur zhes 'ga' zhig zer/ sa mang ngam sa ba'i mtshan nyid dam go don la/ bye brag smra ba dang khyad par yod dam dpyad gsungs te/ khyad par yod par mngon te/ rgyal sras ma las/ rang gi lugs ni 'dun pa la sogs 307

pa sims thams cad la mi 'byung ba yin te/ zhes gsungs pas sems kyi skad cig thams cad dang khams gsum dang sa thams cad la gtso cher yod pa/ zhes bshad na e chog gti skug med pa blos brtsas phyir/ /'ga' zla gzhan ston dgag sgra yis/ /gzhan la rtsa ba gnyis zhes bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ skabs 'dir rtsa ba gsum med par thal/ rtsa ba gnyis zhes gsungs pa'i phyir no ma khyab ste/ gti mug med pa shes rab ste blo gros kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'di'i gti mug med ces pa'i dgag sgra med ces pa de 'gal zla gzhan ston pa'i dgag sgra des/gzhan pa rtsa ba gnyis zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ lus kyi zhin jings dbang shes su/ /kun las bangus kyi dar 'ika dang / /mchims sgyuka bshad kyang yig char min/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus shin sbyangs dbang shes yin par kun btus kyi dar ṭīka dang /mchims mdzod las kyang bshad de/ de las/ lus shin tu sbyangs pa— sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi 'khor du byung ba dang zhes bshad kyang / mtha' dpyod las/ min par gsungs la/ rang 'grel las kyang / lus shin sbyangs mtshan nyid pa/ gzugs yin par gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgod pa'i byur dpyad 'tshig pa bajigs/ /nyes sped g.yo dang bzang sku sku/ /ston mongs chung ngu'i sa yin 308

te/ /ma rig tsam dang metshungs ldan phyir/ /mtshungs ldan grogs kyis chung ba dang / /'di dag sgom spang kho na'i phyir/ /spang bya ris kyis chung ba dang / /yid shes kho nar 'byung ba'i sbyir/ /'byung sa rten gyis chung ba'o/ /ma rjes rnams ni de ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgod pa ni 'dod chags kyi char gtogs su gsungs la/ ngo bo ni/ sems ma zhi bar dmigs pa las gzhan du 'phro ba yin pas/ 'dod yon la chags pa dang / zhe sdang gis kyang de'i rgyu byed pa yod pas/ rgod pa'i rgyur dpyad gsungs/'tshig pa ni tshig brlang bos zher 'debs pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan la bsdigs shing gshe ba la mngon par zhen pa'o/ /rang gi nyes pa sbod pa'i thabs byed pa ni g.yo yin la/ rang la yon tan de dang de med kyang yod par bzang rdzu7byed pa ni sgyu'o/ /de dag nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba yin te/ ma rig pa tsam dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i phyir mtshungs ldan grogs kyi dbang gis chung ba dang / sgom spang kho na yin pa'i stabs kyis spang bya ris kyis chung ba dang / yid shes kho na'i 'khor du 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'byung sa rtene gyi sa sgosmonas chung ba ste/ chung ba gsum dang ldan pas/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba zhes smras so/ /ma nges pa'i nyon mongs rnams ni/ khyad par de gsum 309

dang mi ldan pa shes sla bas nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa mang min no/ /rtog daphyod la gsum 'aklod dang bo/ /gnyid la snga gnyis chags sdang la/ /dzi gnyis nga rgyal the tshom la/ / mtshan ba ra ba ma tshang dzir/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma nges pa'i sa mang 'di rnams nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa bar mi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ der 'jog pa la rgyu mtshan gong du bshad pa'i mtshungs ldan grogs kyis chung ba/ spang bya ris kyis chung ba/ 'byung sa rten gyis chung ba gsum tshang dgos la/ 'dir rtog dpyod gnyis la rgyu mtshan de gsum ga ma tshang / 'gyod pa la dang bo ma tshang /gnyid la snga ma gnyis ma tshang / chags sdang gnyis la phyi ma gnyis ma tshang / nga rgyal dang the tshom gnyis la/ rgyu mtshan bar ba ma tshang ba'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ /'dod sems dge la nges can du/ /nyer gnyis mang na nyer bzhi 'byung / /ngan byas 'aklod pa'i ngo bo ste/ /yid la bcag par de btags pa/ /yul gnas rgyu ming gsum btags yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dod pa'i dge sems kyi 'khor du nges can du sems byung nyer gnyis 'byung skye/ sems kyi sa mang bcu/ dge ba'i sa mang bcu/ rtog dpyod gnyis te nyer gnyis nges par 'byung la/ mang na nyer bzhi 'byung ste/310

gnyid dang 'gyod pa res 'ga' 'byung yang ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /ngan par byas pa la dmigs pa'i yid la bcag pa ni 'gyod pa'i ngo bo ste/ yid la bcag pa de la 'gyod pa zhes btags pa yin te/ 'gyod par yul dang gnas dang 'bras bu la rgyu'i btags pa gsum la btags pa yin no/ /lta ba blo las gzhan med bas/ /lta ba gsum ldan ma 'dres 'dra/ /chags sogs bzhi dang khro sogs 'argyad/ /rang rang bsnan pas nyer gcig go /zhes gsungs te/ lta ba ni sems kyi sa mang nang gi shes rab kyi khyad par yin pas de lasu lhag par mi bgrang stabs/ lta ba tha ma gsum dang mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba'i sems kyi 'khor du yang sems byung nyi shu 'byung ba ma 'dres pa'i mi dge ba'i sems la bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dod chags dang khong khro dang nga rgyal dang the tshom ste rtsa ba'i nyon mongs bzhi dang / khro ba la sogs pa nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba rnams dang / 'gyod pa mi dge ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa rnams rang rang bsnan pas nyer gcig re 'byung ste/ sngar ma 'dres pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i sems kyi sa mang bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa mang drug dang mi dge ba'i sa mang gnyis dang rtog dpyod gnyis rnams kyi steng du rang rang bsnan pas nyer gcig yod do/ /lta gnyis la ni 311

bco brgyad de/ /'dod na ma sgrib lung ma bstan/ /sems kyi bachu dang rtog dbyod ldan/ /sgrib la lung ma bstan lang ste / /nyon min ma rig yod phyir lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgrib la lung ma bstan gyi 'jig lta dang mthar lta dang mtshungs ldan gyi 'khor du bco brgyad 'byung ste/ sems kyi sa mang bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa ba drug rtog dpyod gnyis dang bco brgyad yod/ 'dod pa na nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi 'dod sems la 'khor sems byung bcu gnyis 'byung ste/ sa mang bcu dang / rtog dpyod gnyis 'byung ngo / /sgrib la lung ma bstan yang de dang 'dra/ bye smras nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa yod par 'dod/ lo ni ma rangs pa yin pas/ slob dpon dang mdo sde bas mi 'dod do/ /nyi 'og pa yis ma zhu bar/ /cis thos rtsig par cis ma bris/ /snyam 'argyad yid mi bde ba lang / /lung ma bstan zer bablog par dka'/ — /zhes gsungs te/ nyi 'og bye brag tu smra ba dang / sde ba 'ga' zhig gis 'gyod pa'ang dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod pa gnyid dang 'dra/ 'gyod pa lung ma bstan ni/ ngas zas snga ma ma zhu bar ci'i phyir zas phyi ma zos zhes pa'am/ ngas rtsig pa de la ci ste ri mo ma bris snyam pa lta bu/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi yid 312

mi bde ba'ang yid bde ba dang 'dra bar lung ma bstan du 'dod do/ /de la kha che bye brag smra ba rnams kyis/ 'gyod pa lung ma bstan med de/ yid mi bde ba ni dge ba dang mi dge bar nges pa'i byir ro/ /zhes rtsod pa bkod pa bzlog par dka'o/ /daphyod pa yang zhes yang sgra yis/ /gartso 'khor med phyir g.yo sku bkag /mdo sde ba yis ngo'i khrad par/ /brjod pa'i sgra blong rtog dbyod smra/ /zhes gsungs te/ rtsa ba las/ dpyod pa'ang bsam gtan khyad par can/ /de yi gong na dpyod pa yang / /zhes pa'i yang sgras/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad na/ gtso 'khor med pa'i phyir/ g.yo sgyu yang med ces yod pa bkag ste/gang na gtso 'khor yod pa de na gtso bos 'khor rnams bsdu ba'i phyir g.yo sgyu yod de/ bsam gtan dang bo na/ tshangs pas 'khor gyi nang du rta thul la gtam tshung bskur byas pa'i phyir/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyi khyed par/ rtog pa ni rtsing ba dang / dpyod pa ni sems zhib pa'i rnam pa can du grub mtha' bzhi ga 'dod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ yang mdo sde ba na re/ don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par brjod pa'i tshig gnyis kun nas slong ba'i blo gnyis rtog pa dang dpyod par rim par 'jog par smra'o/ /rgyag pa dga' min khams gsum pa mi khyur/ /de la dbye na lnga ste bshes 313

jings las/ /rigs dang gzugs dang thos pa lang tsho dang / /dbang bang che bas rgyag pa dgra bzhin gzigs/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyag pa ni/ rang gi rigs dang gzugs la sogs pa'iñtsachos la chags pa'i sems yongs su gtugs pa yin la/ kha cig rang gi rigs la sogs pa la chags pa las skyes pa'i yid dga' ba yin no zhes 'dod kyang / dga' ba min te/ dga' ba ni bsam gtan gsum pa yan la med la rgyag pa khams gsum na —yod pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na lnga yod de/ bshes springs ltar/rigs kyis rgyag pa/ gzugs kyis rgyag pa/ thos pas rgyag pa/lang tshos rgyag pa/ dbang thang che bas rgyag pa ste lnga'o/ /bye smras dge dang mi dge 'byed ba'i sems/ /don shes yid dang dmigs shes rnam shes lo/ /dge sogs bag chags bsags sems rten gyur phyir/ /yid dang brten par gyur phyir rnam shes so/ /khams dang skye mched kyang de'i dbang byas te/ /ma 'ongs 'das dang da lta'i pyir yang ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ sems dang sems byung gi rnam grangs bshad pa ni/ mdo las/ semasadzhadang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa zhes gsungs pa rnams ni don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ de dag gi nges tshig—bshad tshul la/ bye brag smra ba na re/ dge mi dge 'byed pas na—314

sems dang / gzugs la sogs don shes pas na yid dang /dmigs pa rnam par shes pas na rnam shes so/ /zhes zer/ lo zhes ma rangs pa'o/ /mdo sde ba'i rang lugs ni/ dge sogs bag chags bsags pas na sems dang / rten du gyur pas na yid dang / brten par gyur pas na rnam shes so/ /zhes zer zhing / gzhan yang / khams dang skye mched thams cad de'i —dbang du byas te/ khams bstan par be+ems kyi khams bdun dang / skye mched bstan par yid kyi skye mched dang / phung bo bstan par rnam par shes pa'i phung bo/ zhes khams dang skye mched kyang de gsum gyi dbang du byas par gsungs la/ de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa ni sems dang / 'das pa ni yid dang / da ltar byung ba ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /de'i phyir byed pa gsum dang /dus gsum dang / bstan pa gsum gyi dbang gis so/ /zhes mkhas pa dag 'chad do/ /bems tsam skug po bkod pa' mardor/ /sems ne kun gzhi'i rnam zhes te/ /de la ngar 'dzin yid yin no/ /yul la rnam par rig pa gang / /de ni 'anug pa'o rnam shes 'dod/ /rtses so dbang bor brten phyir dang / /yul 'dzin khrad 'byed mnyam ba' pyir/ /rten dmigs rnam bcas mtshungs ldan gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems tsam 315

pa ba rnams kyis/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ /de la ngar 'dzin yid yin no/ /yul la rnam par rig pa gang / /de ni 'jug pa'i rnam shes 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa la brten nas/ sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang / yid ni nyon yid dang / rnam shes ni 'jug pa'i rnam shes la 'dod do/ /sems dang sems byung dbang bo la brten pa'i phyir rten bcas/ gzugs 'a/ sogs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i phyir dmigs bcas dang / yul 'dzin pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa de nyid la khyad par 'byed pas rnam bcas dang / mnyam rmer ldan pas mtshungs par ldan phyir/rten dmigs pa rnam bcas mtshungs ldan yin pa'i phyir/ sems la sogs pa gsum don gcig pa de bzhin du sems dang sems las byung ba rnams/ rten dang bcas pa dang dmigs pa dang bcas pa dang / rnam pa dang bcas pa dang / mtshungs par ldan pa rnams kyang tha snyad so sor bshad kyang don gcig par gsungs so/ / thob pa rnyed ldan dang bosayang / rmo/sngar med snyed thob chos bathod dang / /nyams las dhed thob mis bsam gzugs/ /ldan thob de yi skad cig gzhan/ /zhes gsungs te/ thob pa 316

ni rang gang dang ldan pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la ldan byed kyi rdzas gcig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ de la rnyed thob dang ldan thob gnyis yo da/ dang bo rnyed thob la yang / sngar med pa'i rnyed thob ni/ mthong lam chos bzod gsar du thob pa lta bu dang / nyams pa las rnyed pa ni mis bsam gzugs gsar du thob pa lta bu'i thob pa yin la/ ldan thob ni thob zin de yi skad cig gzhan te gnyis pa phan chad du ldan pa'i rdzos de ldan thob yin zhes pa'o/ /dhed pas ma thob ldan ma thob/ /dgra brtsom grid nyon ma thob pa/ /sngar med nyed pa'i ma thob dang / /mig long nyams las snyed ma thob/ /de dag skad cig gnyis pa nas/ /ldan pa'i ma thob(bo)yig cha las/ /spyor lam mthong dang mi ldan pa/ /sngar med snyedak+ṣepa'i ma thob gsungs/ /de lha thog ma med pa nas/ /ldan pa'i ma thob ma yin na/ /ldan pa'i de la nam zhig 'gyur/ /zhes gsungasar+shate// ma thob pa de la/ rnyed pas ma thob pa dang ldan pa'i ma thob pa gnyis/ dang bo/ dgra bcom pas srid rtse'i nyon mongs ma thob pa de/ sngar med gsar du rnyed pa'i ma thob pa dang /mig nyams pa las mig ma thob pa de/ nyams pa las rnyed pa'i ma thob pa yin la/ de dag skad cig gnyis pa nas ldan pa'i ma thob par gyur pa yin la/ rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las/ sbyor—317

lam pa mthong lam dang mi ldan pa de/ sngar med rnyed pa'i ma thob pa yin par gsungs mod/ de ni thog ma med pa nas ldan pa'i ma thob pa ma yin na/ de ldan pa'i ma thob bar nam zhig 'gyur/ zhes dpyad par bya gsungs pa bshad tshul gsum yod pa shes ched yin zhes gsungs pa yod do/ /thob nyed ldan gsum don gcig pa/ /bkag pa gsum du phye ba yin/ /thob dang ma thob yod mnyam mo/ /yid kyi ma thob su la yod/ /ces gsungs te/ mtha' dpyod las/ thob pa dang rnyed pa dang ldan pa gsum don gcig zer na/ thob pa dbye gzhi dang gzhan gnyis ya gyal ma yin par thal lo/ /zhes thob rnyed ldan gsum don gcig pa bkag pa ni/ thob pa dang rnyed thob dang ldan thob gsum du phye ba'i de gsum don gcig pa bkag pa yin gyi/ sbyir de gsum don gcig yin te/ rgyal sras ma las/ thob pa dang so sor rnyed pa dang kun tu ldan pa zhes bya ba don gcig ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ thob pa dang ma thob pa yod mnyam yin par gsungs pas/ yid kyi thob pa yod la/ ma thob pa yod dgos pas/ de su la ldan dpyod/ ces pa yin la/ yid dbang ma thob pa'i gang zag yod na de yin dgos/ 'gog snyoms pa ni yid kyi khams yod la yid med pa'i mu la bzhag 'dug pas de 318

bzhag e chog snyam/ bye smras thob pa dzis grub ste/ /mi blob yan lag bcu ldan kun/ /'jig rten pa yi sems mngon byas/ /'phags min thal ba rigs ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ bye brag smra ba na re/ thob pa spos 4 grub ste/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i yang dag pa'i ye shes te chos bcu bo gang zag de'i rgyud la ldan par byed pa'i rdzas su mdo las bshad pa'i phyir/ thob pa rdzas su med na 'phags pas 'jig rten pa'i lam mngon du byas dus so skye dang spangs rtogs khyad med du thal te/ 'das las mngon gyur med cing 'das lam gyi thob pa rdzas grub kyang med pas so skye dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhes rigs pas kyang bsgrubs so/ /blob dpon 'khor skur rin chen ldan/ /mthong spang spangs phyir mi 'dra gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ slob dpon gyis gong gi de'i lan gsungs par rgyud la ldan par byed pa/ thob pas byas pa min te/ 'thob bya'i chos de la dbang thob pa tsam la de dang ldan par btags te/ dper na/ rin chen sna bdun phyi rol gyi don yin pas rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i 'dus byas la thob pa med par khyed rang yang 'dod kyang / 'khor sgyur rin chen sna bdun dang ldan no zhe sa ldan sgra sbyar ba bzhin no/ /'phags pa deng so skye'i—319

sna spangs rtogs kyi khyad par ni/ mthong spang spangs ma spangs kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba yod do/ /zhes pa'o/ / 'gog gnyis rgyud du ma gtogs phyir/ /'argog rnam gnyis zhes dmigs bsal gsungs/ /dus gsum so so'i dus gsum lang / /rang gi snga phyi bar la sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyir thob ma thob gnyis rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa la med cing rang rgyud du gtogs pa'i 'dus byas kyi steng nas 'jog dgos la/ dmigs bsal 'gog pa gnyis rgyud du gtogs pa'i 'dus byas min yang /so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa sems can thams cad la ldan/so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa ni 'phags pa skad cig gnyis pa phan chad thams cad la ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad par/ 'gog gnyis kyis/ zhes dmigs bsal gsungs so/ /'thob bya'i dus gsum so so'i 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum yang rang rang gi snga phyi bar gsum la sbyar dgos te/ 'thob bya'i chos 'dus byas kyi chos 'das pa gcig la yang de'i thob pa 'das pa/ de'i thob pa da ltar ba/ de'i thob pa ma 'ongs pa gsum 'jog la/ de bzhin du 'thob bya'i 'dus byas kyi chos ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar ba gnyis la'ang rigs 'gres sbyar te gsum gsum 'jog pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi snga ma khyu mchog ltar sngon la lding ba'i thob pa 320

dang / gnyis pa be'u ltar rjes su 'brang ba'i thob pa dang /gsum pa/ grib ma ltar mnyam du 'grogs pa'i thob par bshad pa'i phyir/ mchims ṭīka 'das pa'i 'das ba ne/ /rang dang lhan cig 'gag ma thag /da lta'o de nas ma 'ongs gsungs/ /skye ba'i chos can ma 'ongs kyang / /rang dus ma 'ongs da lta bar/ /'phos tshe da ltar de rjes 'dag /zhes gsungs mi skye'i chos cam/ dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ mchims ṭīka mchan las/'thob bya'i chos 'das pa'i thob pa 'das pa ni chos te rang dang dus mnyam pa dang de'i sngar de'i thob pa byung ba thams cad yin no/ /de'i thob pa da ltar ba ni de 'gag ma thag tu de'i thob pa byung ba'o/ /de'i thob pa ma 'ongs pa ni de 'gag pa'i skad cig gnyis pa phan chad du de'i thob pa byung ba rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang de'i mchan de las/ 'thob bya'i chos ma 'ongs pa skye ba'i chos can gyi thob pa ma 'ongs pa ni rang dang dus mnyam pa'i de'i thob pa'o/ /de'i thob pa da ltar ba ni de da ltar bar 'phos pa'i skad cig ma de'i thob pa'o/ /de'i thob pa 'das pa ni de da ltar 'phos pa de'i skad cig gnyis pa phan chad de'i thob pa 'byung ba rnams so zhes gsungs la/ 'di ni ma 'ongs pa skye ba'i chos can gyi thob pa'i dus gsum gsungs pa yin la/ ma 321

'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can gyi thob pa'i dus gsum sbyar tshul yang 'di'i rigs 'gre byas nas sbyar e chog dpyod ces pa yin no/ /ma gtogs rnacha sa kyi rnam bzhi ni/ /brtags min gang zag dbye ba gsum/ /brtartswathob zag bcas gong ma gnyis/ /gzhan dang lam bden gar ma gadzhags/ /spob dang mi blob min thob la'ang / /blob par byed dang mi blob dang / /de gnyis gang yang ma yin gsum/ /brtags 'argog blob dang mi slob kyi/ /thob dang so skyes de thob ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams gsum gyi sa gang du ma gtogs pa 'gog pa gnyis dang lam bden yin la/de'i thob pa khams gsum du gtogs pa gsum dang khams gsum du ma gtogs pa dang bzhi yod pa ni/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa'i rten can gyi gang zag khams gsum gang du gtogs pa'i sar gtogs pa'i dbye ba gsum yod/ so sor brtags 'gog gi thob pa zag bcas khams gong ma gnyis la gtogs pa gnyi sa yod/ gzhan so sor brtags 'gog gi thob pa zag med dang lam bden gyi thob pa khams gang du ma gtogs so/ /slob pa'i chos zag med rnams kyi thob pa de/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag slob pa kho nar byed pa'i chos yin la/ mi slob pa'i chos zag sed rnams kyi thob pa de rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag mi slob pa kho 322

nar byed pa'i chos so/ /slob pa dang mi slob pa gang yang ma yin pa'i chos kyi thob pa la/ slob par byed pa'i chos dang / mi slob par byed pa'i chos dang / de gnyis gang yang ma yin pa'i chos gsum yod/ so sor brtags 'gog de nyid slob pa'i lam gyis thob pa'i thob pa ni slob par byed pa'i chos dang / so sor brtags 'gog de nyid/ mi slob lam gyis thob pa'i thob pa ni mi slob par byed pa'i chos dang / zag bcas thams cad dang 'dus ma 4byas ni slob mi slob gang yang ma yin pa'i chos yin la/ zag bcas rnams dang / so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa dang / so skyes thob pa'i so sor brtags 'gob/ gi thob pa gsum ni slob mi slob gang rung ma yin pa'i chos yin no/ /thal 'byur ba yang spob 'phags par/ /'dis 'grub chogs ra blob min na/ /thob skabs tshogs gnyis ma bsags 'gyur/ /slob bar gang zag dgos min te/ /blob 'bras gnyis ka min gsum du/ /spob pa'i bral 'bras gsungs phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la yang slob pa 'phags pa med zer ba mi 'thad de/ slob pa 'phags pa yod pa 'dir slob par byed pa'i chos pa rigs pas bsgrubs pa 'dis 'grub la/ gzhan yang tshogs lam shaṃ dang / sbyor lam pa slob pa min zer ba mi 'thad de/ de ltar 323

na slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su tshogs gnyis ma bsags par 'gyur te/ tshogs sbyor gnyis ka'i skabs su tshogs bsags pa de slob pa'i skabs su tshogs bsags pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir slob pa lam gyi skabs su tshogs gnyis bsags kyang / slob pa'i skabs su ma bsags zer ba dang / slob pa la gang zag dgos kyang / sdom 'dir/ slob par gang zag dgos min te/ /slob 'bras gnyis ka min gsum du/ /slob pa'i bral 'bras gsungs phyir ro/ /zhes pa dpyod pa'i sgo tsam bstan pa yin zhes ma ti sa ras gsungs so/ /ma sgrib lung bstan min thob lhan cig skyes/ /mig rna'i mngon shes sprul —sems spyode lam bzo/ /cheṅge rgoms spyor bas khrad par stobs ldan phyir/ /dus gsum thob ldan so thar spog gartsod sogs/ /'dod pa'i gzugs dang rgong ma'i sgrib gzugs la'ang / /'das thob med kyang de'i gzugs dge la yod/ /ces gsungs te/ dmigs bsal’ni 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi ma bsgribs la/ lung du bstan pa ma yin pa'i thob pa la dus gsum ga 'jog pa'i nges pa med de/ de dag gi thob pa stobs chung bas rang dang lhan cig skyes pa yin gyi/sngar skyes dang phyis skyes med pa'i phyir/ lung ma bstan gyi thob pa la lhan cig skyes kho nar ma nges te/ de'i thob pa la lha'i mig 324

dang rna ba'i mngon shes dang / sprul sems rnams lung ma bstan yin pa dang / lha'i bi shwa karma dang lha ma yin gyi ma yu'i bzo gnas lta bu dang / ston pa dang rta thul gyi spyod lam rtogs dka' ba rnams sbyor ba ches goms stobs kyis khyad par stobs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ thob pa sngar skyes phyis skyes lhan cig skyes te dus gsum gyi thob pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ so thar sdom pa dang srog gcod sogs 'dod pa'i dge mi dge'i gzugs kyi thob pa ni stobs chung bas sngar skyes med la/ phyis skyes dang da ltar skyes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der ma zad gzugs kyi sas bsdus kyi rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs dang / nyon mongs can gyi sgrib pa lung ma bstan pa'i thob pa ni/ stobs chung bas lhan cig skyes pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi dge ba la dus gsum gyi thob pa yod ces pa'o/ /'das ma skyes gsum da lta'i bar ba med/ /'thob byar dus mnyam thal sbyir ma thob 'gal/ /'das pa'i 'das thob mchims kyis rang dus la/ /sbyar ba 'azhis gnod 'di dang 'dra phyir ro/ /'das pa la yang snga phyi gsungs mod kyi/ /snga mar rang dang lhan cig ma gsungs sam/ /yig char 'das pa'i da lta zhes ba yi/ /da ltar 'das pa'i rang dus la bzhag dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ ma thob pa la dus gsum gang 'jog gi khyad 325

par yod de/ 'thob bya'i chosad+ngha 'das pa'i ma thob pa la 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gsum yod/ 'thob bya'i chos ma 'ongs pa'i ma thob pa la yang de gsum yod/ 'thob bya'i chos da lta ba'i ma thob pa la 'das ma 'ongs gnyis kyang bar ma da lta ba med de/ da ltar ba'i 'thob bya'i ma thob pa da ltar ba yod na 'thob bya dang dus mnyam par thal phyir ma thob par 'gal ba'i phyir/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ 'das pa'i 'das thob mchims mdzod du rang dus la sbyar ba rigs pa 'dis gnod de/ rang dus su 'das zin pa yin na rang dus su de'i thob pa yod pa tre'agal ba rigs pa 'di dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /'das pa la yang snga phyi gsungs med kyi/ snga ma 'das pa rang dang lhan cig ma gsungs so/ /yig char/ nyon mongs sam so thar sdom pa lta bu'i thob pa skyes la 'gag pa ni 'das pa yin la/ de'i sngar skyes pa thob pa 'das pa'i 'das pa dang / de'i phyis skyes pa thob pa 'das pa'i ma 'ongs pa dang / de dang lhan cig skyes pa ni thob pa 'das pa'i da ltar bar 'jog pa bye smra la grags pa'i phyir/ gsungs pas 'das pa'i da lta ba 'das pa'i rang dus la bzhag pa dpyad gsungs te/ yig char ltos sa 'thob bya'i chos snga phyi bar gsum du 'byung tshul la ltos nas thob pa rnam pa gsum du gsungs pa'i 326

phyir/ ma thob rgyud ldan gar gtogs sa yis brtsas/ /zag med ma thob zag bcas bablog pa gzhan/ /'dod khams sa 'apos kyis gtong spangs pas min/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma thob pa 'ango/da pa sogs khams gsum du gtogs pa gsum yod la/ ma thob rgyud ldan gyi rten sa gang du gtogs pa'i sgos ma thob pa yang r+shas der gtogs par 'jog dgos pas/ sa des bsdus pa yin—la/ zag med kyi ma thob pa zag bcas yin/ de las bzlog pa gzhan te/ zag bcas kyi ma thob pa zag med do/ /ma thob pa gtong tshul ni/ rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi ma thob pa ni de rtogs rma 'i rgyus gtong / sa dgu'i ma thob pa ni de dang der 'phos pa'i rgyus gtong ste/ dper na 'dod khams kyi ma thob pa ni 'dod khams su sa 'phos pa ste 'dod khams su skyes pas gtong ba las 'dod khams kyi ma thob pa spang dgos pa min no/ /skal mnyam sems can smos pas 'bya sogs gartsod/ /tha dad min ji'i skal mnyam sems can tsam/ /bye brag tha dad skal mnyam lha mi sogs/ /skal mnyam sbyi gi blo mthun 'jug pa'i rgyur/ /smra phyir gzhan sel mi 'dod 'dra ste dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/rtsa bar/ skal mnyam sems can 'dra ba'o/ /zhes sems can smos pas/ gro nas kyi 'bru sogs phyi'i dngos po dag la skalardzi327

mnyam 'dod pa gcod do/ /tha dad ma yin pa'i spyi'i skal mnyam ni/ sems can tsam du 'dra ba'i rdzas lta bu yin la/— bye brag tha dad pa'i skal mnyam ni/ lha dang mi sogs phan tshun 'dra bar byed pa'i rdzas lta bu'o/ /skal mnyam spyi'i don ni de la blo mthun par 'jug pa'i rgyu yin zhes smra phyir/ rang yul la sel ba'i rnam pa'i 'jug pa'i gzhan sel lugs 'dir mi 'dod pa 'dra ste dpyad gsungs/ rjes 'byung 'dod pa'i stoms 'jug da ltar thob/ /skad cig gnyis par gnyis ldan langs tshe 'das/ /skyes nas byung 'gyur gsungs phyir gnas der med/ /de ne phyi mar 'dod par skye zir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug pa des/ dgos pa ci'i phyir snyoms par 'jug ce na/ 'du shes med pa ba de la nges par 'byung ba ste thar bar 'dod nas de thob pa'i ched du snyoms par 'jug pa yin la/ dang bor dus gcig kho nar thob pa'i da ltar thob pa yin te/ sngon med pa thob pas 'das pa thob pa yang med/ sems med pas ma 'ongs pa yang mi 'thob pa'i phyir/ rnyed tshul dang ldan tshul mi 'dra ste/ rnyed tshul dus gcig kho na yin pa gang zhig ldan tshul skad cig gnyis phan chad snyoms 'jug las ma langs bar du 'ad sa pa dang da ltar ba gnyis ldan yin zhing / snyoms par 328

'jug pa las langs tshe 'das pa kho na dang ldan pa yin no/ /skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las yin par gsungs phyir/ de'i 'bras bu 'du shes med pa ba'i lha de/ snyoms 'jug sgom pa'i gnas der med la/ 'du shes med pa ba de phyi mar 'dod par skye nges yin no/ /'gog pa zhir gnas don du grid rtser brten/ /nub phyogs pa yis byang 'phags ldang ba 'dod/ /rang lugs zad ba mkhyen dang dus mnyam mo/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni/ tshor 'du rags pa nye bar zhi ba'i snyomasa'ajug 'di la tshe 'dir zhi bar gnas pa'i don du srid rtse la brten nas sems sems byung mngon gyur pa bkag pa'o/ /del nub phyogs kyi bye brag smra ba kha cig na re/ byang sems slobapa'i dus su bsam —gtan bzhi ba'i sems la brten nas mthong lam bskyed/ de rjes 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug bskyed/ de las ldang ba'am langs nas bsam gtan bzhi ba'i sems la brten nas zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub bskyed pa yin zhes zer/ kha che ba na re/ dang bo byang chub sems dpa' slob pa'i dus na de bskyed pa ma yin te/ bden pa mngon rtogs bcu drug dang / srid rtse'i gnyen po bar chad med lam dgu dang / rnam grol lam dgu ste skad cig ma sum cu rtsa bzhi bar ma chad par bskyed nas 329

byang chub thob pa'i phyir/ rang lugs de ltar zad pa mkhyen pa thob pa dang dus mnyam du 'gog snyoms thob pa yin no/ /tshe bsod zad 'chi mya bzhi'i gcug bablog dka'/ /khyu gu skyes pas byug dang gnas sogs gsum/ /skye de'i skye sogs bzhi ste brgyad po la/ /skyed pa'i byede pa 'acag cing skye ba'i skyes/ /skye la byed 'jug thob pas thob pa bzhin/ /skye bas brgyad char skyed na yang / /rgyu rkyen tshogs la rtos pa'i phyir/ /ma 'ongs thams cad cig car min/ /zhes gsungs te/ srog ni tshe yin/ zhes srog ni phung bo'i rigs 'dra gnas pa'i tshe la 'edod pa yin la/ de las 'phros te/ tshe zad nas 'chi ba dang / bsod nams zad nas 'chi ba dang / gnyis ka zad nas 'chi ba dang / bar ma dor 'chi ba bzhi gsungs/ de ltar mu bzhi gsungs pa'i nang gi tshe dang bsod nams gnyis ka zad nas 'chi ba gcig po de bzlog par dka' ba ste/ 'phags pa tshe la dbang 'byor ba rnams ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis tshe bsring ba'i thabs med par gsungs/mu dang bo tshe zad pa3ni/ tshe'i rnam smin can gyi las zad pa'o/ /bsod nams zad pa ni/ longs spyod kyi rnam smin can gyi las zad pa'o/ /bar ma dor 'chi ba ni dug la sogs pa'i zas dang / g.yang sa la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / gdon la sogs 330

pas mdangs phrogs pas gnod pas 'chi ba dang / tshe la dbang ske'abyor ba rnams kyis tshe gtong ba dag go /bsod nams zad nas 'chi ba la ni dge sbyor dang sbyin pa la sogs pas tshe bsring du lod par gsungs/ dug dang g.yang sa la sogs pa'i bar ma dor 'chi ba la ni sman dang spyod lam gyis tshe bsring du yod la/gdon la sogs pa 'byung bo'i gnod pa la ni/ rigs sngags 'chang grub pa rnams kyis tshe bsring du yod gsungs so/ /'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ skye rga gnas pa mi rtag pa nyid kyi chos de yin la/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid skye rga gnas pa mi rtag pa bzhi'i rjes mthun dang bcas na brgyad yod de/ rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid bzhi dang / skye ba'i skye ba gnas pa'i gnas /pa rga ba'i rga ba mi rtag pa'i mi rtag pa ste rjes mthun kyi mtshan nyid bzhi dang brgyad yod/ chos de skye ba'i tshe rang ma gtogs pa'i skye sigs brgyad dang rang dang dgu cig car skye ba yin la/ des na myu gu skye bas myu gu dang de'i gnas pa rga ba mi rtag pa sogs gsum dang / skye ba de'i skye ba dang de'i gnas pa'i gnas pa dang / de'i rga ba'i rga ba dang / de'i 'jig pa'i 'jig pa bzhi ste brgyad po skyed la/ de brgyad po la skyed pa'i byed pa 'jug cing myu gu'i skye ba'i skye ba des myu gu'i skye ba kho na skyed pa thob pa'i thob pa 331

bzhin dang / de ltar skye ba gcig pus ma 'ongs pa skye rga gnas pa 'jig pa bzhi dang / skye ba'i skye ba rga ba'i rga ba gnas pa'i gnas pa 'jig pa'i 'jig pa ste brgyad char skyed na yang / rgyu dang rkyen tshogs pa la ltos dgos stabs/ ma 'ongs pa thams—cad cig car skyed pa min no/ /skal mnyam rgyu mthun las byung dang / /sems can ston dang lung bstan min/ /tshogs gsum 'dra la de'i steng du/ /rnam smin las byung khams gsum gtogs/ /mtshan nyid rnams dang thob pa la / /rnam smin rgyu mthun las byung gnyis/ /ma thob snyoms 'jug rnam smin min/ /zhes gsungasar+shate/ skal mnyam ni rgyu mthun las byung ba dang / sems can—du ston pa dang / lung du bstan pa ma yin pa gsum ni/ ming gi tshogs dang / tshig gi tshogs dang / yi ge'i tshogs te tshogs gsum dang 'dra la/ de'i steng du rnam smin las byung ba dang /khams gsum du gtogs pa gnyis bsnan te/ de rnams rnam smin las byung ba yin te dge mi dge gang rung las/ skyes pa'i phyir/khams gsum gyis bsdus pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid skye sogs bzhi dang / gong du bshad pa'i thob pa la/ rnam smin dang rgyu mthunacelas byung ba gnyis yod de/ sems can du mi ston pa'i skye sogs—332

bzhi ni rgyu mthun las skyes pa dang / sems can du ston pa'i de bzhi rnam smin las skyes pa yin la/ rnam smin skyes kyi thob pa rnamasmin dang / thob pa gzhan rnams rgyu mthun las byung ba'i phyir/gong du bshad pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis dang ma thob pa dag ni/rnam smin las byung ba ma yin te/ rgyu mthun kho na las byung ba'i phyir/ mi ldan pa'am ma thob pa ni bsags pa'i gzugs can ma yin pas ma sgrib lung ma bstan yin pa dang snyoms 'jug gnyis ni gcig tu dge ba kho na yin pa 'i phyir/ phan 'dogs rigs gnas rgyu yi don/ /rgyu drug ming tsam gong mas 'dod/ /skyer gegs mi byed byed rgyu ste/ /mi 'tshe rgyal bos bde byas bzhin/ /mchims ṭīka skye rung skun dang snang / /byed ra gsungs so yig char bkag /ces gsungs te/ chos de la phan 'dogs pa'i rigs su gnas pa chos de'i rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ rigs gnas smos pas byed rgyu bsdu ched yin te/ byed rgyu la nus ldan dang nus med gnyis yod pas/ nus med kyis phan mi 'dogs pa'i phyir/rgyu drug gi ming tsam grub mtha' gong mas kyang 'dod de/ kun btus dang rnam 'grel sogs las kyang rgyu drug gi rnam bzhag byung ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang lhan cig 'byung rgyu 'dod kyang phan tshun rgyu 'bras su mi 'dod pa sogs don la khyad —par yod do/ /chos rdzo 333

gang rung skye ba la gegs mi byed cing rang las don gzhan pa'i —chos te/ byed rgyu'i don yin te/ dper na grong ba rnams rgyal bos khral dmag la sogs pas sdug bsngal bar ma byas pa la r+shabadag cag bde bar byas so zer ba lta bu'o/ /mchims ṭīka las snang ba la sogs pa de dag mun pa la sogs pa mi skye ba'i chos can la gegs byed kyi/ skye ba la ni gegs bya bar mi nus pa'i phyir dang / byed rgyu ni skye ba la gegs mi byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang de dag gi byed rgyu yin no zhes bya ba ni bye brag tu smra ba'i grub pa'i mtha' yin no/ /zhes skye rung gi mun pa dang snang ba byed rgyur gsungs so/ /'on kyang yig cha'i mtha' dpyod las/ de la gnod pa chos can/ de'i byed rgyu ma yin te/ de 'jig byed yin pa'i phyir/ dber na mun par snang ba bzhin no/ /zhes bkag go /sems byung rnams ni rgyu mtshan bcus/ /sems rjes 'jug ste skye gnas 'gag /gcig la min yang dus tsam gcig /'azhi yis mi skyes chos can sngud/ /'bras dang rnam smin rgyu mthun gcig /'dir lang zag med ma gtogs so/ /'bras bus byed dang bral 'bras bsngus/ /lhan cig 'byung dang mjugamithog 'byung / /dus gzhan 'byung dang mi skye bzhi/ /334

yod phyir byed 'bras rnam smin dang / / mthun gnyis las logs su bstan/ /dge sogs gsum yang gcig pa ste/ /ma sgrib sogs kyang ma gtogs so/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems kyi rjes 'jug ni/ sems kyi 'khor du gyur pa'i sems byung rnams dang / bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang / zag med kyi sdom pa gnyis dang / sems kyi skye 'jig sogs mtshan nyid rnams de yin la/ sems kyi rjes 'jug de dag ni/ rgyu bcus sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa zhes bya ste/ dus kyi sgo nas bzhi dang / 'bras bu dang rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gsum dang / dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ste bcu bo de dag dang cig car rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir/ dang bo sems dang mtshan nyid skye rga kanas pa 'gag pa bzhi dus gcig pa la dus kyi sgo nas bzhi zer/ sdom 'dir bsdus don ni skye gnas 'gag gsum dus gcig la min yang /dus rags tsam gcig pa yin pas bzhag la/ 'di yis mi skye ba'i chos can bsdu bar gsungs te/ mi skye ba'i chos can la ni dus gcig pa tsam ma gtogs skye gnas 'jig pa gcig pa mi srid do/ /gnyis pa/ 'bras bu zhes pas skyes bu byed 'bras dang bral 'bras gnyis dang / rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang / rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gsum dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'o/ /'dir 335

yang zag med ma gtogs te/ zag med la rnam smin gyi 'bras bu med pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu smos pas ni/ skyes bu byed 'bras dang bral ba'i 'bras bu bsdu'o gsungs/ skyes bu byed 'bras de/ rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu las zur du sto na pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ skyes bu byed 'bras bzhi yod de/ skyes bu byed 'bras lhan cig 'byung ba dang / mjug thogs su 'byung ba dang /dus gzhan du 'byung ba dang / mi skye ba'i bral 'bras dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir byed 'bras de rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gnyis las logs su bstan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sems dang rjes 'jug la dge mi dge lung bltan gsum yod cing / de gang yin par gcig dgos la/ ma sgrib lung ma bstan sogs ma gtogs te/ de la rnam smin gyi 'bras bu mi srid pa'i phyir/ de ltar dus las bzhi dang / 'bras bu las gsum dang / dge la sogs pa gsum ste rgyu bcus sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa'i ma sgrib bems kyisazha/ /sems nga mtshan nyid bcas rilnga bcu/ /rang gi rtsa ba' mtshan nyid bzhi/ /rjes maphun bzhir bcas nga brgyad skyed/ /tshur la lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen/ /nga bzhis byed de rjes mthun bzhis/ /dngos su mi nus nying bran bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i ma sgrib nga 336

lalung ma bstan gyis ni sims byung rang gi mtshan nyid dang bcas lnga bcu yod de/ sems kyi sa mang bcu dang / de dag re re la mtshan nyid bzhi bzhi yod pas bzhi bcu ste lnga bcu yod/ de'i steng du sems rang gi rtsa ba'i mtshananyid bzhi dang / rjes mthun gyi mtshan nyid bzhi bcas brgyad bsnan nas lnga bcu rtsa brgyad skyed par byed/ tshur sems la lhan cig byed rkyen byed pa ni/ de'i nang lnga bcu rtsa bzhis byed de/ rjes mthun gyi mtshan nyid bzhis dngos su lhan cig byed rkyen byed mi nus te/ rgyal bo'i nying bran te nying g.yog gis rgyal bo la dngos su bya ba byed mi nus pa bzhin no/ /sgrib pa'i skal mnyam khrad chos gsum/ /rjo rtul dang ni dus mnyam pa/ /dbang bo rgyu rgyas mnyam pa'o/ /zag med khams su ma gtogs phyir/ /zag bcas rang sa'i mnyam khyad par/ /ma 'ongs go rim med5phyir dang / /kun 'gro skal mnyam rang 'azas las/ /sngar skyes nges phyir dus gnyis pa/ /las gzhan yod kyang ma bshad lo/ /byed rgyu rtag sbyir 'dir ma bshad /ces gsungs te/ sgrib pa'i skal mnyam mam nyon mongs can gyi skal mnyam khyad chos gsum dang ldan te/ rang dang spang bya rigs gcig pa/ sa gcig pa/ 'bras bu'i sngar skyes pa gsum dgos pa'i phyir/ dbang bo rno rtul ni rang dang mtho dman mnyam pa 337 3

dang rang las khyad par can gyi rgyu byed de/ rtul bo dad pa'i rjes 'brang ni rang nyid dang / rang las khyad par can dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang dang / dad mos pa dang / mthong thob pa dang / dus kyis rnam par grol ba dang / dus dang mi—sbyor bar rnam grol rnams kyi yin pa sogs so/ /de yang bsam gtan bzhi ba'i dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / bsam gtan gsum man chad kyi dad pa'i rjes 'brang yang mnyam pa yin te/ gnyis ka'ang dbang bo rtul ba'i phyir/ — de dag pas bsam gtan dang bo'i sa ba'i chos kyi rjes 'brang khyad par can yin te/ de'i phyir sa gong ma'i zag med kyi lam gyis sa 'og ma'i lam gyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed pa ni/ bsam gtan bzhi ba'i sa ba dbang bo rtul bo sbyangs te gsum pa man chad kyi dbang bo rnon po chos kyi rjes 'brang gi lam skyed pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du dad mos la sogs par sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang bo rno rtul gyis skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed pa la lam thob pa'i dus dang rang dang mtho dman mnyam pa dang / dbang bo mnyam pa dang / rgyu'i sgo nas rgyas pa mnyam pa ste khyad par can dgos par gsungs pa las dman pa'i ni ma yin no gsungs/ zag med rnams ni sa de dag—gi sred pas bdag gir ma byas stabs khams su ma gtogs phyir/338

rang gi sa kho nar ma nges so/ /zag bcas rnams rang sa kho nar nges te/ rang sa'i rang dang mnyam pa dang rang gi ris khyad par can kho na la skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed do/ /ma 'ongs pa la snga phyi'irdzigo rim med pa'i phyir skal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu 'bras mi rung bar 'dod/ kun 'gro'i rgyu dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu gnyis rang rang gi 'bras bu las sngar skyes par nges pa'i phyir dang 'das pa dang da lta ba'i dus gnyis pa can yin la/ gzhan ma 'ongs pa yod kyang kun 'gro dang skal mnyam gyi rgyur ma bshad lo/ /zhes bye smras 'dod do/ /byed rgyu la dus gsum yod kyang mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byed rgyu rang nyid dus bral yin pa'i phyir te/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi grub na khyod yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / mdo sde ba dang bye smra gnyis/ /'gog bden bral 'bras byed 'bras dang / /med dgag yin min rtsod tshul mang / /dpe ston ma byas dmigs rkyen min te mdor/ /rnam shes skyed pa'i rgyu gang yin pa dang / /rkyen gang yin de dag kyang mi rtag na/ /gsungs zer bye smras skyed pa' gsungs phyir zer/ / zhesagasungs te/ mdo sde ba dang bye brag smra ba gnyis/ 'gog bden de bral 'bras dang byed 'bras su 'dod mi 'dod dang /339

med dgag yin min gyi rtsod tshul mang ste mtha' dpyod du gsal/dpe ston pa ste mdo sde ba na re/ 'dus ma byas dmigs rkyen yin pa mi 'thad de/ mdo las/ rnam shes skyed pa'i rgyu gang dag yin pa dang / rkyen gang dag yin pa de dag kyang mi rtag pa yin la zhes sogs phung bo lnga ga yang de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir zer/bye smras ma khyab ste/ rgyu gang dag gzugs skyed pa'i rgyu de mi rtag ces gsungs pas 'dus ma byas byed rgyur ma bkag pa'i phyir zer ro/ /skyes bu ba ne lhan mtshungs gnyis/ /de la de las gzhan yang yod/ /lung bstan phyis 'byung rgyas byung gcod/ /rgyu mthun 'bras la cha gnyis te/ /skal mnyam la ne rnam pa 'dra/ /kun 'gro dang ni ris 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ skyes bu byed 'bras chos can/ rgyu gnyis las byung ste/ lhan cig 'byung ba dang /mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gnyis las byung ba'i phyir/ de la de gnyis las gzhan pa'ang yod de/ rnam smin gyi rgyu ma gtogs pa'i rgyu lnga'i rgyu byed tshul yod pa'i phyir/ lung bstan phyis 'byung zhes pas rgyas byung gi 'byung ba rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yin pa gcod de/rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni rang rgyu lung bstan las dus phyis kho na ste/ de ma thag tu ma yin par 'byung dgos pa'i phyir/ des rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yang sel ba'i phyir te/ de lung bstan de ma thag 340

byung ba'i phyir rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la cha gnyis yod de/ skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang / kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis kyi 'bras bu yod pa'i phyir/ skal mnyam gyi rgyu ni rang gi 'bras bu dang rnam pa 'dra ba dang / kun 'gro'i rgyu ni rang gi 'bras bu dang rnam pa mi 'dra yang / rang gi ris te sa gcig pa dang nyon mongs can du 'dra bar nges pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir skal mnyam kun 'gro'i rgyur/ /sku bzhi 'dod chags kun 'gro min/ /'jig lta ris gzhanad+kul mnyam min/ /'jig lta rang ris gnyis ka yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ skal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu yin min gyi mu bzhi yod de/skal mnyam gyi 'dod chags de rang ris nyon mongs pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu yin la kun 'gro min pas kun 'gro'i rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'jig lta sogs kun 'gro yin pas/ ris gzhan gyihonyon mongs pa'i kun 'gro'i rgyu kho na yin la/ ris gzhan gyi nyon mongs can gyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu yin pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ 'jig lta sogs de rang dang ris gcig pa'i nyon mongs can dang ris gcig pa'i skal mnyam rgyu dang / de'i kun 'gro'i rgyu yang yin pa'i phyir/ mu bzhi ba yang yod de/ dge ba sogs kyi mjug tu sems mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba skye na de'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu yang ma yin la/ kun 'gro'i rgyu yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ gang mthus gang 341

skyes byed 'bras gsungs/ /'o na 'gogacho bden 'azhir mi rung / /ma skyes phyir zer gang spel las/ /thob la skyes pa'i sgrar gdags gsungs/ /rgyal sras ma las de yin yang / /rtag phyir 'azhir ne ma bshad gsungs/ /gang spel bshad pa gzhung dang ma thun/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyu gang gi stobs kyis sam/ rgyu gang gi mthu las gang skyes bu'i 'bras bu de skyes bu byed 'bras kyi mtshan nyid du gsungs pas/ 'o na 'gog bden dngos su bshad ces zer mi rung bar thal/ de la skyes pa'i sgra mi thob ste/ ma skyes ba'i phyir na/ gang spel las/ thob pa la yang skyes pa'i sgra gdags rung ba'i phyir te/ dper na nga'i nor skyes zhes pa bzhin no gsungs/ rgyal sras ma las/ so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa yang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu yin pa ni 'dod mod kyi/ rtag pa'i phyir/ 'di rgyu stobs kyis skye ba ni ma yin te/ de'i phyir tshig le'ur byas pa las ma bshad do/ /zhes gsungs/ mtha' dpyod las rtsa ba'i dngos bstan gtso bor sbyar na 'grel bshad gnyis mi 'gal 'ing skyon du ma las grol bar 'gyur te/ so sor brtags 'gog yang dngos bstan yin pas gang spel dang mthun/rgyu gang gi stobs kyis 'bras bu de skye ba'i zhes pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo ma yin pas rtsa ba'i sgras zin du ma bshad ces bshad na 342

'gril bshad gnyis kyi dgongs par 'grig par gsungs/ 'grel bshad gnyis kyi dgongs pa so sor 'dod na/ gang spel kyis bshad pa de legs par snang ste/ lung rigs gnyis kyis bshad la/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /byed ma gtogs lnga yis 'dzin/ /'dzin pa skyed pa 'i nus ldan don/ /yang na 'bras bu yin pa'i don/ /kha cig 'bras bu'i mtshams 'dzin/zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'bras bu 'dzin 'byin gyi skabs rgyu drug las rgyu gang gis dus gang la 'bras bu 'dzin pa yod de/byed rgyu ma gtogs pa'i rgyu lnga bo da ltar ba kho nas 'bras bu 'dzin pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu 'dzin pa'i don ni/ 'bras bu de skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i don yin la yang na 'bras bu 'phen pa'i don yin no/ /yang kha cig gis 'bras bu'i mtshams 'dzin pa'i don yin yang zer ro/ /'bras bu 'byin pa ni skyed pa ste rgyu dang dus ma nyam du 'bras bu sgyed pa zhes bya ba'i don no/ /zhes mchims mdzod las gsungs so/ /lhan mtshungs gnyis kyis da ltar 'byin/ /gnyis kyis 'das dang da ltar te/ /skal mnyam kun 'gro dag sgras bsngus/ /rnam smin 'das pa kho nas 'byin//skal mnyam 'bras bu 'byin 'dzin la/ /dmigs med dge dang mi dge sgrib/ /ma sgrib lung ma bstan bzhi dang / /dmigs 343

bcas sems kyang dge sogs bzhir/ /bzhi bzhi byas pas sde bzhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'bras bu ji ltar 'byin zhe na/— lhan cig 'byung rgyu dang / mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gnyis kyis/ 'bras bu 'dzin 'byin dus mnyam pas 'bras bu da ltar ba 'byin par — byed pa yin no/ /'bras bu 'dzin pa ni 'bras bu skyed pa'i nus pa mthu can yin pas 'bras bu dngos su skyed pa'o/ /da ltar gyi rgyu dang 'das pa'i rgyus 'bras bu 'byin pa ni skal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis yin te/ skad cig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'bras bu skyed na da ltar ba dang / bar chod pa'i 'bras bu skyed na 'das pa 'byin zhing / ma 'ongs pa'i 'bras bu 'byin pa med pa'i phyir/ de ni rtsa bar/ da ltar gyi dang 'das pa dag /ces pa'i dag sgras bsdus pa ste/ gnyis ni da ltar 'das pa dag gis zhes 'don par bya'o/ /rnam smin gyi rgyu gcig pu ni 'das pa kho nas 'bras bu 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /'dir skal mnyam gyi 'bras bu 'dzin 'byin la mu bzhi tshan pa brgyad yod de/dmigs med kyi dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / sgrib lung ma bstan dang / ma sgrib lung ma bstan bzhi dang / dmigs bcas sems sems byung gi dge ba/ mi dge ba/ sgrib lung ma bstan/ma sgrib lung ma bstan bzhi la mu bzhi sbyar ba bzhi dang brgyad/ de 344

ltar brgyad gatram̐s kyi re re la mu bzhi bzhi byas pas drug cu ri bzhi yod do/ /mu rtsi tshul mtha' dpyod sogs su gsal bas sdom 'dir bkod med do/ /nyon mongs can la rnam smin rgyu med cing / /rnam smin skyes la kun 'gro ma gtogs te/ /gzhan rnams kun 'gro rnam smin gnyis char dang / /zag med dang bor de gnyis skal mnyam yang / /de yang sems dang sems byung dbang byas kyi/ /gzugs kyis bsngus pa'i dzhan mongs can sogs bzhir/ /mtshungs ldan ma gtogs lhag ma sngar bzhin sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ mtshungs ldan rgyu du las skyes pa bshad par/bzhi yod de/ nyon mongs can dang / rnam smin skyes dang /zag med dang bo dang / de gsum gyi lhag ma'i 'dus byas dang bzhi yod/ nyon mongs can gyi 'bras bu ni rgyu gzhan lnga las byung yang / rnam smin gyi rgyu las byung ba med de/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni ma sgrib lung ma bstan la bshad pa'i phyir/ rnam smin skyes ni gzhan lnga las byung yang kun 'gro'i rgyu las ma byung ste/ rnam smin skyes ni kun 'gro'i rgyu ma gtogs lhag ma lnga las skyes pa'i phyir/de'i lhag ma rnam smin ma gtogs pa'i lung ma bstan rnams dang zag med dang bo ma yin pa'i dge ba rnams kun ni gzhan bzhi las byung yang / kun 'gro'i rgyu dang rnam smin gyi rgyu gnyis las 345

ma byung ba'i phyir/ zag med skad cig dang bo de/ kun 'gro'i rgyu dang rnam smin gyi rgyu de gnyis dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu gsum ma gtogs pa'i lhag ma byed rgyu lhan mtshungs kyi rgyu gsum las skyes pa'i phyir/ chos bzhi bo de yang 'dus byas su ma zad mtshungayoldan gyi dbang du byas pa'i phyir/ sems dang sems byung las gzhan pa'i sdom min dang / dbang bo nyon mongs can lnga dang /nyon mongs can gyi gzugs dang nyon mongs can gyi ldan min sogs/ byed rgyu lhan cig kun 'gro skal mnyam gyi rgyu bzhi las skyes te/ mtshungs ldan ma gtogs pa lhag ma sngar bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ / rgyu dang rkyen gcig rgyas brtsas phung khams bzhin/ /byed sku ma gtogs lnga bo rgyu rkyen yin/ /de ma thag rkyen 'bras 'dra phyir/ /bar du chod kyang rigs 'dras min/ /brgyud rgyu lang mtshungs de ma bag rkyen lo/ /nyams pa'i ston mongs dngos kyi nyer men 'dra/ /spob dpon gyis bkag / /ces gsungs te/rgyu dang rkyen gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin kyang / so sor bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'bras bu skyed pa'i bya ba byed pa'i cha nas rgyu bstan/ 'bras bu 'grub pa'i bya ba byed pa'i cha nas rkyen bstan pa'i phyir/ gdul bya la ltos nas kyang de gnyis 346

dze rgyas bsdus so sor bshad pa yin te/ dper na gnas dang bor phung khams skye mched bstan pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu rkyen gyi ngo bo yod de/ byed rgyu ma gtogs rgyu lnga bo ci rigs kyi sgo nas rang gi 'bras bu la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i dngos po de yin pa'i phyir/ bye smra na re/ de ma thag rkyen ni/ rang gi 'bras bu dang rigs 'dra ba zhig yin phyir/ rigs mi 'dra bas bar chod kyang skyon med la/ rigs 'dra bas bar ma chod pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ nyon mongs can gyi sems dang dge sems dang nyon mongs can gyi sems gsum rim can du 'byung ba'i tshe/ nyon mongs can snga ma nyon mongs can gyi sems phyi ma'i de ma thag rkyen du 'dod zer bas/ brgyud rgyu yang mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen lo/ /snga ma'i nyon mongs de spangs rtogs las nyams pa'i nyon mongs gyi dngos kyi nyer len yin zer ba 'dra bas/ slob dpon gyis skyon brjod de rang lugs su mi bzhed do/ / de ma thag rkyen dang / /mtshungs pa de ma bag rkyen mya bzhi ste/ /'jug bems ldang blo'i de ma thag rkyen min/ /'jug sems 'gog snyoms dang bo'i mtshungs ne min/ /gnyis yin 'anug sems snyoms 'anug sems dang bo/ /gnyis min 'jug sems stoms 'jug gnyis pa'o/ /sems med phyir na gsum ba gzung bar dka'/ /zhib 347

dzini mtshungs pa de ma thag pa zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ bye brag smra bas de ma thag rkyen dang mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gnyis la mu bzhi yod de/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug sems de ldang blo ste ldang sems kyi mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen yin la de ma thag rkyen ma yin pa dang / snyoms par 'jug sems de snyoms 'jug skad cig dang bo'i skye ba'i de ma thag rkyen yin la de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen ma yin pa dang / gnyis ka yin pa ni/ snyoms par 'jug sems de snyoms 'jug gi sems dang bo lta bu/ gnyis ka ma yin pa snyoms par 'jug sems dang 'gog snyoms skad cig gnyis pa lta bu'o/ /'gog snyoms ni sems med kyi skabs yin phyir/ mu gsum pa 'jug sems dang snyoms 'jug skad cig dang bo lta bu gzung ba'am bzhag par dka' ste snyoms 'jug skad cig dang bo sems med skabs yin pa'i phyir/ de la zhib cha byed tshe 'jug sems dang mtshungs pa de ma thag pa zer yang da dung mtha' chod med do/ /gzhan las lhag pa'i phyir na bdag rkyen no/ /lhan mtshungs 'gag dang da ltar la byed cing / /rnam smin skal mnyam kun 'gro skye la 'o/ /de ma thag dang dmigs rkyen gnyis po la/ /rgyu yis byed tshul gnyis po bablog ste sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ bdag po'i rkyen gyi ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ rang lago 348

r+sha dad pa'i 'dus byas skye ba la mi sgrib pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i dngos por dmigs pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi ni yod de/ byed rgyu zhes bya ba'i rgyu de bdag po'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir/bdag po'i rkyen zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lhag pa yin pas sam rkyen can 'bras bu lhag pa ste mang bo'i rkyen yin pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ rgyu lnga'i 'bras bu dus gsum gang la bya ba byed tshul yod de/ lhan mtshungs gnyis kyis 'bras bu 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa ste da ltar ba la bya ba byed/ rnam smin skal mnyam kun 'gro gsum gyis ni skye la mngon du phyogs pa ma 'ongs pa la bya ba byed/ rgyu rkyen de las gzhan pa'i de ma thag rkyen dang dmigs rkyen dag ni sngar bshad pa de las bzlog ste 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa dang 'bras bu da ltar ba gnyis la bya ba byed/ bdag rkyen ni gnas skabs thams cad du 'bras bu skye ba la mi sgrib pa'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ sems la rkyen bzhi 'gog la dmigs ma gtogs/ /gzhan la rgyu padag gnyis so dbang phyug gartso/ /rtsal dngos dus min rim sogs res sogs phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'bras bu du zhig gis rkyen du zhig bskyed pa'i tshul yod de/ rkyen bzhi yis sems dang sems las byung ba rnams bskyed par byed pa'i phyir/ dmigs rkyen ma gtogs pa'i rkyen 349
