gsum gyis sems med kyi snyoms 'jug gnyis bskyed par byed pa'i phyir/ de dag las gzhan pa'i mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed dang gzugs can rnams ni rkyen gnyis las skye ste/ rgyu rkyen dang bdag rkyen gnyis las skye ba'i phyir/ de la phyi rol ba rnams na re/ dngos po rnams rkyen bzhi ci rigs las skye bar bshad pa mi 'thad de/ dbang phyug rtag pa dang sogs sgras bsdus pa gtso bo rtag pa gcig pu dang / dus dang ngo bo nyid dang rdul phran rtag pa gang rung re las snod bcud thams cad 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir zer/ de 'gog pa la snod bcud snga phyir byung ba 'di rnams dbang phyug rtag pa sogs las byung ba ma yin par thal/ rim gyis skyes pa'i phyir dang / sogs sgras bsdus pa res 'ga' skyes pa'i phyir/ 'byung bas 'byung la lhan cig skal mnyam gnyis/ /'byung 'gyur la ni byed rgyu lnga byed de/ /skye gnas rten ston 'phel ba'i rgyu yin phyir/ /sngar med skyed dang 'phel 'grib rjes 'gro snog /ri mos rtsig gzhi 'dra dang rgyun gnas byed/ /'phel bar byed gyir(ro)delid rang nyid kyi/ /'grel bar skyed phyir rten phyir gnas phyir dang / /ston pa'i phyir dang 'phel byed phyir zhes gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'byung bas 'byung ba gzhan dang 'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen gnyis byed tshul 350

dang / 'argyung 'argyur gyis 'byung 'argyur gzhan dang 'argyung ba'i rkyen gnyis byed tshul gnyis yod pa'i dang bo/ 'byung bas rang 'bras 'byung ba de'i lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu rnam pa gnyis byed de/ rang dang dus mnyam pa'i 'byung ba de'i lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu dang / rang gi rigs 'dra phyi mar gyur pa'i 'byung ba de'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ 'byung bas 'byung ba las gyur pa rnams kyi rgyu rnam pa lnga byed pa yod de/'byung bas 'byung 'gyur gyi skye ba'i rgyu byed/ rten pa'i rgyu yang byed/ gnas pa'i rgyu yang byed/ ston pa'i rgyu yang byed/ 'phel ba'i rgyu yang byed pa'i phyir/ dang bo grub ste/ de las 'byung 'gyur sngar med skyed pa'i phyir dang / gnyis pa grub ste/ 'byung 'gyur de 'byung ba 'phel 'grib kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ 'byung 'gyur de 'byung ba don gzhan la rten pa'i phyir te/ rtsig pa la ri mo bzhin no/ /bzhi ba grub ste/ 'byung bas 'byung 'gyur rgyun mi 'chad par byed pa'i phyir/lnga ba grub ste/ 'byung bas 'byung 'gyur gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du rang 'grel las/ 'phel bar skyed phyir rten phyir gnas phyir dang / ston pa'i phyir dang 'phel byed phyir/ zhos gsungs so/ /'byung 'gyur phan tshun 351

lhan jig skal mnyam dang / /rnam spren gsum mo 'byung la rnam smin gcig /ces gsungs te/ 'byung 'gyur gyis 'byungar+sha'agyur gzhan gyi lhan cig 'byung rgyu dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang rnam smin gyi rgyu rnam pa gsum byed pa yod de/ bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa dang tshogs pa gcig pa rnams phan tshun lhan cig 'byung rgyu byed/ 'byung 'gyur snga mas 'byung 'gyur phyi ma'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed/ tshe 'di'i dge mi dge rnam par rig byed las tshe phyi ma'i rnam smin skyes kyi mig la sogs pa 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa de ma thag rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa la/ bcu gnyis su dbye ba/ nyi shu dbye ba/ bcu gnyis po gang las gsar du rnyed tshul gsum/ dang bo la/ bcu gnyis su dbye ba dang / de ma thag pa'i rkyen dang rkyen can sbyar ba gnyis/ dang bo ni/ sems de la rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na bcu gnyis yod de/ de la 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi yid dge ba dang mi dge ba'i semasadang /sgrib lung du ma bstan pa'i sems dang / ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems bzhi dang gzugs khams dang gzugs med dag na mi dge las gzhan pa'i sems gsum gsum dang / slob pa'i zag med kyi sems dang / mi slob pa'i zag med kyi sems bcu gnyis yod/ gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa'i dbang du byas pa dang /352

gzugs kyi dbang du byas pa dang / gzugs med kyi dbang du tshobyas pa dang / zag med kyi dbang du byas pa dang bzhi/ dang bo la spyi don dang / tshig don gnyis yod pa'i/ dang bo ni/ sems bcu gnyis po de las sems du zhig sems gang gi 'jug thogs su 'byung zhe na/ de ni sdom 'dir bsdus pa/ tshe 'am gnas skabs brgyad de rgyun gyi tshe/ /sa mtshungs tshe dang nying mtshams spyor ba'i tshe/ /stoms par 'jug tshe de las ldang ba'i tshe/ /stoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe/ /sprul la 'jug tshe sprul las ldang tshe'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i tshul ni/ tshe'am gnas skabs brgyad du bsdus pa ni/ rigs rgyun gyi tshe/ sa mtshungs kyi tshe/ nying mtshamasasbyor ba'i tshe/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe/ snyoms 'jug las ldang ba'i tshe/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe/ sprul ba la 'jug pa'i tshe/sprul ba las ldang ba'i tshe dang bcas pa brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ dang bo ni/ rigs 'dra snga ma las rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/rigs mi 'dra yang sa gcig pa'i sems gzhan 'byung ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ khams gsum gyi sems gang yang rung ba las shi ba na skye ba'i sems nyon mongs can kho na 353

'byung ba lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba ni/ 'og ma'i dge sems las gong ma'i zag bcas zag med kyi sems skye ba lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ lnga ba ni/ gong ma'i dge sems las 'og ma'i dge sems zag bcas 'byung ba lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa ni/ gong ma'i sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems las 'og ma'i dge sems skye ba lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ bdun pa ni/ gzugs kyi dge sems kyis de ma thag rkyen byas pa las 'dod pa'i sprul sems 'byung ba lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa ni/ 'dod pa'i sprul sems kyis de ma thag rkyen byas pa las gzugs kyi dge sems 'byung ba lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod sems dge las rgyun sa gnyis kyi bzhi/ /thob zin blob dang mi blob zag med gnyis/ /nying mtshams spyor tshe 'dod dge skyes thob las/ /gong ma' sgrib gnyis 'dod dge spyor byung las/ /gzugs dge spyor byung(ngo)mi lcogs med nyid zer/ /la la khrad par can 'dod dbyangs sgrogs ni/ /thod rgal tshe na gnyis pa'ang 'byung ngo gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dod pa'i dbang du byas pa de la spyi don dang tshig don gnyis byas pa'i tshig don gyi sdom 'dir gsungs pa ni/'ardod pa'i sems las sems dgu byung ba yod de/ de'i mjug thogs su rgyun gyi tshe dang sa mtshungs kyi tshe/ rang sa'i sems bzhi 354

spreṅge jeng ste/ rgyun gyi tshe 'dod pa'i dge sems dang sa mtshungs kyi mi dge ba dang lta ba gang rung dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgrib lung ma bstan dang 'dod pa'i spyod lam pa dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i lung du ma bstan pa dang bzhi 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ thob zin slob dang mi slob kyi zag med gnyis yod de/ 'dod pa'i slob mi slob kyi dge sems sbyor byung gi mjug tu/ slob pa'i sems zag med dang / mi slob pa'i sems zag med gnyis 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge sems skyes thob las khams gong ma'i sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems gnyis 'byung ste/ gzugs su skye na gzugs kyi nyon mongs can dang gzugs med du skye na gzugs med kyi nyon mongs can te sgrib lung ma bstan gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i dge ba sbyor byung las bsam gtan dang bo'i dge sems nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gang rung gi sbyor byung gcig pu de 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'di la 'dod tshul mang ste mi lcogs med pa kho na zer/gzhan dag bsam gtan dang bo'i yang zer/ la la bsam gtan khyad par can du 'dod/ btsun pa dbyangs sgrogs na re/ thod rgal gyi tshe bsam gtan gnyis pa'ang 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs/gzugs med dge min bzhi yis ring phyir te/ /gzugs la 'dod 355

ba'i sprul sems mngon byod kyang / /gzugs med gang lang mi nus rten gyis ring / /'dod la rags b.ra'ang mi ltaram bas ring / / 'dod la mi dmigs phyir na dmigs pas ring / /'dod pa'i gnyen po mi byed gnyen pos ring / /zhes gsungs te/ 'dod pa'i dge sems kyi de ma thag tu gzugs med kyi dge ba 'byung ba med de/ 'dod pa dang gzugs med gnyis rten dang / rnam pa dang / dmigs pa dang / gnyen po bzhis ring ba'i phyir te/ gzugs kyi rten gyis 'dod pa'i sprul sems mngon du byed kyang / gzugasdo/ med kyi rten gyis 'dod par gtogs pa'i chos gang yang mngon du byed mi nus pas rten gyis ring ba dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i sems kyis 'dod pa la rags pa dang gzugs la zhi ba'i rnam par lta ba ltar/ gzugs med pa'i sems kyis de ltar mi lta bas rnam pas ring ba dang / gzugs med kyi sems des 'dod pa la mi dmigs pa'i phyir na dmigs pas ring ba dang / gzugs khams bzhin du gzugs med pa dag gis 'dod pa'i gnyen po mi byed pas gnyen pos ring ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dge de rgyun sa'i bzhi dang stoms 'jug las/ /ldang tshe zag med gnyis dang gzugs kyi dge /spyor byung(ngo)de tshe skyes thob 'jug mi srid/ /ston mongs kyis 356

gzir gzugs kyi sgrib las te/ /de laso mchog phroṃr(ro)de ltar brgyad las byung / /zhes gsungs te/ 'dod pa'i dge sems de sems brgyad las byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi tshe rang sa'i bzhi dang / snyoms 'jug las ldang tshe zag med gnyis dang gzugs kyi dge sems sbyor byung 'byung ngo / /de'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems skyes thob 'byung mi srid pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe gzugs kyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems las te/ gong ma'i nyon mongs can las 'og ma'i dge sems bzang stabs/ de las 'dod pa'i dge sems byung ba mchog yin la/ de ltar sems brgyad las byung ba yod pa'i phyir/gzugs kyi sgrib las 'byung ba'i dge 'dod par/ /ma nges rang rang 'og mas bstan phyir ro/ /'de ni 'og ma dag la ci rigs sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs kyi sgrib pa las byung ba'i dge ba ni/ 'dod pa'i dge ba lasatshobyung bar ma nges te/ sprul sems de gzugs kyi dge ba sbyor byung kho na las 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ rang rang 'og mas bstan phyir te rang rang gis 'og ma 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir 'di ni rang rang gi sa 'og ma dag la ci rigs par sbyar bar bya'o/ /mi dge rgyun sa'i bzhi dang mtshams spyor tshe/ /gong ma'i drug las 'byung ngo rang las bzhi/ /357

thib pa bcu las skyes thing de las bzhi/ /ma sgrib bzhi dang sprul tshe gzugs dge las/ /de las bzhi dang gong skyes nyon mongs gnyis/ /sprul las ldang tshe gzugs dge bdun 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ mi dge ba ni bcu las 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i bzhi dang mtshams spyor ba'i tshe/ gong ma'i drug las 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ mi dge ba rang las bzhi 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i bzhi 'byung ngo / /'dod pa'i sgrib lung ma bstan sems bcu las skyes shing / de las sems bzhi 'byung ba rnams mi dge ba dang 'dra ste/ rtsa bar/ bsgribs de bzhin/ zhes gsungs/ 'dod pa'i ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems de/ sems lnga'i de ma thag tu 'byung ba yod de/ rang sa'i bzhi dang sprul ba la 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems las 'byung ba yod la/ de las sems bdun 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi tshe rang sa'i bzhi dang / khams gong gang rung du skyes pa'i tshe gong gi nyon mongs can gnyis dang / sprul ldang gi tshe gzugs kyi dge sems dang bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/ gzugs dge rgyun sa'i gsum dang ldang ba'i tshe/ /'dod dge sprul la 'jug tshe 'dod ma sgrib/ /mtshams spyor 'dod nyon gnyis dang gong ma'i sgrib/ /stoms 'jug gzugs med dge dang zag med gnyis/ /'byung rngo /358

zhis gsungs te/ gnyis pa gzugs kyi dbang du byas pa ni/gzugs khams na dge sems las sems bcu gcig 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi tshe rang sa'i gsum dang / ldang ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge ba dang / sprul 'jug gi tshe 'dod pa'i ma sgrib pa'i sems dang / nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba'i sems dang / de'i sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems te 'dod nyon gnyis dang / gong ma'i sgrib pa ste gzugs med kyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs med kyi dge sems gcig dang / zag med kyi sems gnyis te bcu gcig 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ / rang gsum 'anug tshe 'dod dge dang / /ldang tshe zag med gnyis dang gachugs med dge /sprul las ldang tshe 'dod pa'i ma glib dang / /sngar bzhin gzir tshe gong ma'i sgrib las 'byung / /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs kyi dge sems de sems dgu'i mjug thogs su byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi rang sa'i gsum dang / snyoms 'jug gi tshe 'dod pa'i dge sems dang / ldang tshe gzugs med kyi dge ba dang zag med gnyis/ sprul ba las ldang tshe 'dod pa'i ma sgrib pa dang / sngan bshad pa bzhin nyon mongs can gyis gzir tshe gong ma ste gzugs med kyi sgrib pa'i mjug thogs su359

'byung ba yod do/ /sgrib pa rgyun sa'o gsum dang motshams spyor tshe/ /gzugs med ga6ma dang 'dode po'i ma sgrib dge /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs kyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems de/sems brgyad las 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi rirang sa'i gsum dang / nying mtshams sbyor tshe gzugs med kyi sems gsum dang / 'dod pa'i ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems dang /'dod pa'i dge sems dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs can la sa gong ma min gsungs phyir/ /de las gsum dang spyor tshe 'dod nyon gnyis/ /gadzir tshe 'og dge 'byung zhing / /zhe sa gsungs te/ nyon mongs can gyi sems las gong ma'i sems 'byung ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems chos can/ khyod las sems drug 'byung ste/ rang dang sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum dang / nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang sgrib pa gnyis dang / nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge ba dang drug 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / ma sgrib las/ /gsum dang spyor tshe gong 'og nyon mongs gsum/ /gachugs med ma sgrib pa yang phyogs 'azhir 'dra/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs kyi ma sgrib pa chos can/ sems gsum las 'byung ste rang sa'i gsum las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos 360

can/ khyod las drug 'byung ste/ sa mtshungs kyi tshe rang sa'i gsum dang / nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang sgrib pa gnyis dang gzugs med kyi sgrib pa ste gong 'og nyon cho/ngas gsum dang drug 'byung ba'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi ma sgrib pa yang phyogs 'di dang 'dra ste/ gzugs rtsa bar gzugs med pa'ang / de yi tshul lo/ /zhes so/ /gzugs med dge la gsum dang ldang ba'i tshe/ /gzugs dge stoms 'jug tshe na zag med gnyis/ /spyor tshe ston mongs gnyis dang gzugs kyi sgrib/ /'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs med kyi dge ba las/sems dgu 'byung ste/ sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/ snyoms 'jug las ldang tshe gzugs kyi dge blo dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe na zag med gnyis/ nying mtshams sbyor tshe gzugs kyi sgrib pa dang 'dod pa'i sgrib pa ste nyon mongs gnyis dang dgu 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / rang gsum 'jug tshe gzugs dge dang / /ldang tshe zag med gnyis so / /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs med kyi dge ba ni/ sems drug gi mjug thogs su 'byung ste/rang sa'i gsum dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge ba dang / ldang ba'i tshe na zag med gnyis las 'byung ba'i phyir/gzugs med kyi/ /sgrab pa thun sa'i gsum dang mtshams spyor 361

tshe/ /'og ma'i dge dang ma sgrib bzhi las 'byung / /nes gsungs te/ gzugs med kyi sgrib pa'i semes de sems bdun gyi mjug thogs su 'byung ste/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyis rang sa'i gsum dang / nying mtshams sbyor tshe 'og ma gnyis kyi dge ba gnyis dang / ma sgrib lung ma bstan gnyis dang bdun las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de las gsum dang spyor tshe 'dod nyon gnyis/ /gzugs kyi sgrib pa'o gzir tshe gzugs dge 'byung / /zhes chogasungs te/ gzugs med kyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems las sems bdun 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum dang / nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod nyon gnyis/ gzugs kyi nyon mongs can gyi sems te gsum dang /nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems gcig ste bdun 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ khams gsum dge dang zag med gnyis te lnga/ /blob dang mi slob gnyis la mthun par jir/ /zhes gsungs te/ slob mi slob kyi sems gnyis las/ sems lnga 'byung ste/ khams gsum gyi dge ba'i sems gsum dang /zag med gnyis te lnga 'byung ba slob mi slob gnyis la sbyar dgos so /bcu gnyis nyi shur phye tshul gathang nyid gsal/ /gzugs 36lha

na bzo med kun rdzogs gos bcas phyir/ /nyi shur r+bha ba'o dgos pa khams gang na/ /thos bsam sgom yod shes dang 'chi sems kyang / /dge bas byed tshe'ang 'chi sems mi gsal pyir/ /skyes thob kho nas byed dang ma sgrib pas/ /byed tshe rnam smin smyod lam gyis byed kyang / /batho dang sprul sems gsal phyir mi byed dang / /'dod las gzhan la skyes thob mi gsal phyir/ /'jug ldang khyur byung kho nas byed rtogs phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ bcu gnyis nyi shur dbye ba ni/ gzhung nyid de rtsa 'grel kun tu gsal ba ni 'di ltar/ sngar bshad pa'i sems bcu gnyis po de sems nyi shur 'gyur ba yod de/ khams gsum du dge ba skyes nas thob pa dang / sbyor byung gi dge ba'i sems rnam pa gnyis su phye nas sems drug dang / 'dod pa na lung du ma bstan pa'i se/mas la rnam smin skyes kyi sems dang / spyod lam pa'i sems dang / bzo ba'i gnas kyi sems dang / sprul ba'i sems dang bcas 'dod pa'i sems bzhi dang / gzugs khams na bzo ma gtogs pa'i rnam smin skyes/ spyod lam pa/ sprul sems te/ ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems gsum dang / khams gsum gyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems gsum dang / 'dod pa'i mi dge ba'i sems dang / gzugs med na ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems rnam smin 363

gcig pu dang / zag med kyi sems gnyis te nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ sems nyi shu las bcu gnyis khyab che ste bcu gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i sems med cing / nyi shur ma 'dus pa'i ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems du ma yod pa'i phyir/ de yin te/ gnyis pa sogs na lus mig dang / zhes sogs dang / smrar 'jug pa ni 'og mas kyang / zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems de de yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs na bzo med de/ kun rdzogs gos dang bcas shing / gzhal med khang yang las kyi dbang gis skye la skyes bu'i bzo mi dgos pa'i phyir/ nyi shur phye ba la dgos pa yod de/ khams gsum na thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gang yod shes pa dang / dge sems kyis 'chi sems byed tshe 'chi sems mi gsal phyir/ skyes thob kho nas byed kyi sbyor byung ma yin phyir/ ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyisa'achi sems byed tshe rnam smin skyes dang spyod lam gyis byed kyang /bzo'i gnas dang sprul sems gnyis gsal ba'i phyir 'chi sems mi byed de/ 'chi sems mi gsal ba'i phyir/ 3dod pa lasagazhan la skyes thob mi gsal ba'i phyir/ snyomayopar 'jug ldadzasbyor byung kho nas byed dgos shing / 'dod pa'i skyes thob kyispokyang byed pa'i phyir/ de dag rtogs pa'i phyir du nyi shur byas so /364

gzugs med gzugs su skyes ze dge nyon gnyis/ /'edod gzugs sprul sems gnyis snyed nyams tshe gnyis/ /gzugs med nyon mongs kyis nyams de dang spob/ /gzugs skyes dge mngodz+wabyur tshe gsum gsar du/ /nyed brad sprul sems gnyis dang rang nyid do/ /slob mngon gyur la bzhi grid rang nyid dang / /sprul sems gnyis dang gzugs med dge ba'o/ /blob pa 'phags pa yin pa 'dir yang bshad/ /lhag ma drug tshe rang rang gcig bu snyed/ /ces gsungs te/ rnyed tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la khams gong ma gnyis nas 'dod par skyes pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i nyon mongs can gyi sems gnyis dang / dge ba skyes thob dang / tre'adod pa'i nyon mongs kyis dgra bcom nyams tshe gzugs gzugs med kyi nyon mongs can gyi sems gnyis dang / slob sems gcig ste drug rnyed/ gzugs med gzugs su skyes tshe gzugs kyi nyon mongs can gyi sems dang / dge ba skyes thob ste dge nyon gnyis dang / 'dod gzugs kyi sprul sems gnyis dang / gzugs kyi nyon mongs pas dgra bcom nyams pa'i tshe gzugs kyi nyon mongs can gyi sems dang / slob pa'i sems te drug gsar du rnyed/ gzugs med kyi nyon mongs can gyis dgra bcom pa 'bras bu las nyams pa'i tshe gzugs med kyi nyon mongs can gyi sems dang / slob 365

pa'i simathe gasnyes gsar du rnyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs su skyes pa'i dge sems mngon du gyur pa dag la sems gsum gsar du rnyed pa yod de/ rang nyid dang 'dod gzugs kyi dge sems gnyis gsar du rnyed do/ /slob pa'i zag med kyi sems mngon du gyur pa la sems bzhi gsar du rnyed pa srid de/ zag med dang bo'i tshe slob pa'i sems dang / zag med kyi lam gyis 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang byal ba'i tshe 'dod gzugs kyi sprul sems gnyis dang / des gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i tshe gzugs med kyi dge sems mi ldan pa las gsar du rnyed yod pa'i phyir/ slob pa 'phags pa yin pa gong du bshad par ma zad 'dir yang bshad pa'i phyir/ de dag gi lhag ma 'dod pa dang gzugs med kyi dge sems gnyis dang / ma skyes pa gnyis dang /gzugs kyi ma sgrib pa dang / mi slob pa'i sems dang drug ni khyod gang rnyed pa'i tshe rang nyid kho na gsar du rnyed de/ de tshe deri mi ldan pa las gsar du thob pa'i phyir/ dper na/ mi slob pa'i sems gsar du rnyed pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnas gnyis pa'i skabs so/ / dbang phyug brgyad ldan nyi ma'i 'od rlabs kyis/ /dbang rnon chu skyes 'dzum zhal lhag lhag rgod/ //366

dbang bo'i rab dbye bzlos pa'i dge mtshan des/ /dbang phyug mchog gi go 'phang myur thob shog / gnas gsum pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad+ma dkar bo yis/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /gcig tu bsdus nas dam chos zil mngar gyis/ /skal ldan lus stobs rgyas mdzad de yis skyongs/ /'dir gnas gsum pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig cung zad 'grel ba la/ dga' dang skyabs med na ra kaḥ/ /mi ldog yid btags pre ta ste/ /dud cing 'gro bas ticha kaḥ/ /dmyal brgyad gling bzhi lha drug ste/ /nyi tha grang dmyal gling phran min/ /'khor phyir nyi tshe nges med phyir/ /ma bgrang ba las grang dmyal brgyad/ /glingaphran brgyad dang bcas so drug /ces gsungs te/ gnyis pa bden bzhi'i de nyid nges par byed pa la/ shes bya sdug bden dang /spang bya kun 'byung dang / 'thob bya 'gog bden dang / thob byedalam bden rnams gtan la dbab pa la gsum/ dang bo la nang 367

bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam bzhag dang / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam bzhag gnyis/ dang bo la/ spyir dbye ba dang / rten 'brel bshad pa dang / skye ba gnas thabs dang / gnas pa 'chi 'pho ba'i sems dang / sems can gyi tshogs gsum du sdud pa dang lnga/ dang bo la/ khams gsum du dbye ba dang / 'gro ba lngar dbye ba dang / skye gnas bzhir dbye ba dang gsum/ dang bo la/ 'dod khams dang / gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams bshad pa dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ dmyal ba sogs de dag gi sgra bshad kyang yod de/ dga' ba'am skyabs med pas na ra kaḥ stegyidamyal ba/ 'di nas shin tu phyir mi ldog par song bas sam/ skom ltogs kyis shin tu yongs su non pas na yid btags pa ste pre ta ste yi dwags dang / dud cing 'gro bas tiyo kaḥ ste dud 'gro dang / yid shas che bas na mi dang / khyim nam mkha' la yod pas sam rtse ba'am rol bas na lha dang / khams dang 'khrig pa'i 'dod pas rab tu phye bas na 'dod khams dang / 'khrig pa'i 'dod pas rab tu phye ba'i lha yin pas na 'dod lha rigs drug dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ des na tsha dmyal brgyad dang /yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i gnas gnyis te/ ngan 'gro'i gnas rigs bcu dang / gling bzhi dang / 'dod lha rigs drug gi 368

gnas dang bcas bcu ste nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ grang dmyal rnams tsha dmyal gyi 'khor dang gling phran rnams gling bzhi'i 'khor dang / nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba la gnas dang tshe nges pa med pas gnas kyi skapas su de rnams ma bgrangs pa'i phyir/ gong gi nyi shu bo de'i steng du grang dmyal brgyad dang / gling phran brgyad bsnan pa'i so drug la 'dod pa so drug zhes bya'o/ /'dod lha rigs drug kyang yod de/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gnas sam dbang phyug yod pas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / legs par byas pa lhan cig tu byas pa dag gis der skyes pas sam nye dbang so gnyis dang dbang bo gcig ste sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pas na sum cu rtsa gsum dang / bsod nams kyis song bas sam 'thab pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bas na 'thab bral dang / dga' ba mang ba dang ldan pas na dga' ldan dang / rang gis byas pa'i longs spyod sprul ba la dga' bas na 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan gyis sprul ba'i longs spyod la dbang bsgyur bas na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ dge chung bde chung sogs su btags/ /bzhi la gzugs can gnas med do/ /grin po ja yab gling gnas mi/ /lha min 'gro ba gsum du bshad/ /ces gsungs te/gnyis pa gzugs khams ni/ 'dod khams kyi gong ma tshangs ris 369

nas 'og min gyi bar bcu bdun gyi snod bcud rnams ni gzugs khams yin te/ gzugs khams su spyi mthun gyi las dang so so'i las kyis 'phangs shing 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral zhing gzugs la chags bral ma byas pa'i sas bsdus pa'i phyir/ gzugs khams der rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan mi 'dra ba so so yi sgo nas 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan de la dbye na bcu bdun yod de/ bsam gtan dang bo gsum la gsum gsum dang / bzhi ba la brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ dang bo grub ste/ bsam gtan dang bo la tshangs ris/ tshangs mdun/ tshangs chen gsum dang /gnyis pa la 'od chung / tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal gsum dang / gsum pa la dge chung / tshad med dge dge rgyas rnams yod pa'i phyir/ 'di la dge chung sogs btags pa ni ku sha la zhes pa bde ba dang dge ba gnyis ka la 'jug pas 'dir dge ba la bsgyur ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi ba la sprin med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che ba ste so skye gnas gsum dang /mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / 'og min te 'phags pa'i gnas gtsang lnga dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gzugs med khams na gzugs can gyi gnas logs su med de/ de gzugs can ma 370

yin pas rten snod dang brten pa sims can lo/ kha dog dang/dbyibs sogs med pa'i phyir/ gzugs med khams pa rnams gang du shi 'phos pa der gnas te ming gzhi'i phung bo tsam blangs nas grub pas bla 'og gi gnas med kyang / gzugs med du skye ba'i rgyu snyoms 'jug mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pa'i bye brag las ni skye ba rnam pa bzhi yod de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yange med/ srid rtse dang bcas pa bzhi yod do/ /kha cig gis/ gling bcu gnyis na mi gnas pa mi 'thad par thal/gling bcu gnyis po gang rung gi rten can gyi rkang gnyis pa la mis ma khyab pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rnga yab gling na srin po'ang yod pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ kha cig na re/ gcig na srinapo gnas so/ /zhes zer ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'dir/ srin po rnga yab gling gnas mi/ /zhes gsungs pa ni / srin po 'ga' zhig gi gasgyunas rnga yab gling na yod kyang / spyir rnga yab gling na mi'i rigs gnas pa yin te/ gling phran brgyad na gnas pa'i mi lus chung ba gnas pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don to/ /mchims mdzod las srin po ni mi'i bye brag yin la/ zhes gsungs/ 'gro ba drug ces mi bshad par/ 'gro ba lnga zhes bshad pa'i dgos pa yod de/ 'phen byed 371

dgi ba'i las kyis 'phangs pa'i lha min rnams lha dang / 'phen byed mi dge ba'i las kyis 'phangs pa'i lha ma yin rnams dud 'gro dang yi dwags su 'dus pas 'gro ba gsum yodabyā do/ — /sprul sems chags bral la yod phyir/ /de la ji ltar rgyas she na/ /gzhan gyis rgyas zhing rang gis kyang / /nyams dran chags skyed des sprul ba'i/ /dri ror skye phyir brgyud nas yin/ /bar min dri za lha'i rol mo/ /gzhan yang ci rigs tshul gyis basprus/ /zhes gsungs te/ dmyal ba nas lha drug gi bar gyi snod dang bcas pa dag ni/ 'dod pa'i khams yin te/ de'i sems can rnams ni kham zas dang 'khrig pa la 'dod chags dang bcas shing 'dod yon lnga'i 'tsho ba'i phyir dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa dang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'dod pa'i sprul sems la'ang 'dod chags rgyas par thal lo zhe na/ sprul sems chags bral la yod pa'i phyir/ de la ji ltar 'dod chags rgyas she na/ de'i sprul ba la gzhan gyis chags pa rgyas shing / rang gis kyang / ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul nyams nas/ sngar gyi rdzu 'phrul dran de de la chags pa skye zhing / sngar kho rang gis sprul ba'i dri dang ro la brgyud nas chags pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir/ bar do ba ma yin pa'i dri za ni/ dri za'i rgyal bo rta 372

mgo can sogs lha'i rol mo mkhan rnams ci rigabye par bsdu bar bya ste/ 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa rnams ni lha'i khongs sabasdu ba dang / mi dge bas 'phangs pa yod med dpyad par bya'o/ /'azhir bstan khams dang 'gro ba la/ /mya bzhi grang dartsal bar do sogs/ /bar do'ang gzugs sogs rten can te/ /bar 'da' gzugs su 'da' phyir jo/ /mngal du mtshams jir gzugs khams mtshar/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i khams dang / 'gro ba la mu bzhi yod de/ 'dir bstan khams yin la/ 'gro ba ma yin/ khams gsum re re'i dge ba zag bcas dang nyon mongs can dang 'og ma gnyis kyi bar srid pa de yin pa'i phyir/ 'asdo ba yin la 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i khams ma yin pa yod de/ grang dmyal brgyad dang / lha ma yin de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis ko yin pa yod de 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i 'gro ba nyi shu bo de yin pa'i phyir/ gang yang ma yin pa sla'o/ /gzugs kyi bar do ba'ang gzugs kyi rten can yin te/ phyir mi 'ongs par 'da' ba de gzugs kyi rten nam gzugs su 'da' ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ba'i gzugs khams pā yod par 'dod pa ni ngo mtshar te/ gzugs khams pa la mngal skyes med pa'i phyir ro/ / 373

sngar skyes tshangs ris lha rnams ne/ /'du shes gcig kyang phyi skyes rnams/ /dzis 'byung 'dod ba'i lha mi ltar/ /gnyis ka tha dad 'od chung sogs/ /nyer bsdogs darngos gzhi'i btade snyoms bdes/ /skyo bas res byed shes tha dad/ /gsum par bde bas skyo med lo/ /dbai ston rgan gzhon me 'jig tshe/ /'jig bcas 'jig med phyir zhes bshad/ /gsum par lus dang 'du shes gcig /ngan song skug bsngal rtse 'gog pa/ /bzhi ba 'du shes med pas 'arjoms/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa dogs dpyod la/sems kyi gnas pa bdun bshad pa/ sems can gyi gnas dgu bshad pa/ sems kyi gnas pa bzhi bshad pa dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ sems kyi gnas pa bdun yod de/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka tha dad pa dang / lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig pa dang / de las ldog pa lus gcig cing 'du shes tha dad pa dang /lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka gcig pa dang / gzugs can trem yin pa'i gnas dang bo gsum ste bdun yod pa'i phyir/ dang bor byung ba ma yin pa'i 'dod pa'i lha mi gnyis dang bsam gtan dang bo'i dang bor byung ba ma yin pa'i lha rnams ni/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka tha dad yin te/ de rnams lus che chung dang kha dog dang dbyibs dang rtags dang cha lugs sogs mi 'dra ba'i 374

sgo nas tha dad cing 'du shes tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum so sor tha dad pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang bor sngar skyes pa ste dang bor skyes ma thag pa rnams ni lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig pa yin te/ lus snga ma dang 'dra ba gang zhig 'du shes tshangs chen gyis byas so snyam par gcig pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir sngar skyes kyi tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ni/ 'du shes gcig kyang phyis te rjes su skyes pa'i tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ni/ 'dod khams kyi lha dang mi ltar gnyis ka tha dad do/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa rnams ni/ lus gcig cing 'du shes tha dad pa yin te/lus 'od lus su gcig pa gang zhig 'du shes bde ba dang btang snyoms gnyis res mos su don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ 'di la bshad tshul gzhan yang yod de/ 'od chung sogs te/ sogs kyis bsdus pa tshad med 'od dang 'od gsal te bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lha rnams ni lus gcig pa lus 'od lus su gcig pa sogs sngar ltar dang / 'du shes mi gcig pa ni/ dngos gzhi'i yid bdes skyo na/ nyer bsdogs kyi btang snyoms mngon du byed la/ nyer bsdogs kyi btang snyoms kyis skyo na/ dngos gzhi'i yid bde mngon du byed pa/ 'du shes tha dad pa'i don du 'jogade lta na/ bsam gtan gsum pa rnams kyang der thal bar 'gyur 375

ro tshe/ na// mi 'gyur te/ yid bde ni sems g.yo bar byed pas ma zhi bas des skyo la/ bde ba ni zhi ba yin pas/ des mi skyo bas/ de'i ñtsa mtshan gyis bsam gtan gsum par yidangabade med la bde bas mi skyo ba ste skyo ba med do zhes zer lo zhes pa ma rangs pa'o/ /dpe ston pa ste mdo sde ba na re/ bsam gtan gnyis par skyes nas ring du lon pa ste rgan pa rnams ni/'jig chags la mkhas pas bskal ba 'jig pa'i tshe na bsam gtan dang bo yan chod me 'bar bas 'jig pa med par shes nas mi 'jigs pa'am mi skrag la/ der skyes nas ring bo ma lon pa'i gzhon pa rnams ni 'jig chags la mi mkhas pas 'jigs skrag dang bcas par mdo las gsungs phyin/ 'du shes tha dad pa'o/ /zhes zer ro/ /bsam gtan gsum pa ba rnams ni/lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka gcig pa yin te/ lus snga ma dang 'dra zhing 'du shes dngos gzhi'i sems bde la 'jug par gcig pa'i phyir/ sems kyi gnas pa bdun gyi lhag ma/ ngan songangagasum ni sems kyi gnas pa ma yin te sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sgo nas de 'joms par byed/ srid rtse 'gog snyoms kyis de 'joms par byed/ bsam gtan bzhi bar 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gis de 'joms par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi ba 376

zid rtser bcas te dgu/ /bdun gyi nang tshan nem thes bzhis ma btsos/ /bzhi ba'i gzugs phung la sogs bdun gyis min/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa sems can gyi gnas dgu bshad pa ni/ gnas bdun po de dang srid rtse dang 'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams te dgu bo de de yin pa'i phyir/ de dag gnas su bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sems can de dag rang dga' bar gnas pas na de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan ngan song gsum ni sems can gyi gnas su gi 'chad pa'i rgyu mchan yod de/ der sems can rnams mi 'dod bzhin du las kyi dbang gis gnas pa ma gtogs dga' bzhin du mi gnas pa'i phyir/gsum pa sems kyi gnas pa bzhi ni/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed kyi gnas pa'am nye bar spyod pa bzhi rnames su yod pa'i phyir/ de yang rnam shes kyi gnas pa bzhi la rang gi sa ba nyid yin pa zhig dgos te/ sa gzhan gyi phung bo la sa gzhan gyi rnam shes dga' ba'i sred pa mi skye ba'i phyir/ bye smra na re/ rnam shes ni/rnam shes skyo gnas par mi rigasacite/ gnas pa‘bo dang gnas pa gnyis mi mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dper na/— rgyal bo nyid rgyal bo'i stan du mi rung ba bzhin zhes zer/ spado sde ba na re/ skabs 377

'di'i gnas dang gnas pha gnyis gru dang mnyan pa lta bu yin pas/ rnam shes gnyis lhan cig tu gnas pa med pa'i phyir zhesarte'adod do/ /rnam shes gnas pās bsdu tshul la mu bzhi yod de/bdun gyis bsdus la bzhis ma bsdus pa dang / bzhis bsdus langabadun gyis ma bsdus pa dang / gnyis kas bsdus pa dang /gnyis kas ma bsdus pa bzhi yod pa'i jir/ mu dang bo yod de/bdun gyi nang tshan gyi rnam shes de bdun gyis bsdus la/ bzhis ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ mu gnyis pa yod de/ ngan song rnams dang bsam gtan bzhi ba dang srid rtse rnams kyi zag bcas kyi phung bo dang bo bzhi bo de bzhis bsdus la bdun gyis ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ mu gsum pa yod de/ gnas bdun gyi gnas skabs kyingazag bcas kyi phung bo dang bo bzhi de de yin pa'i phyir/ mu bzhidzhab ni/ ngan song dang / bsam gtan bzhi ba dang srid rtse ba—dag gi zag bcas kyi rnam par shes pa dang / zag med kyi rnamar+shapar shes pa rnams de de yin pa'i phyir ro/ / mngal du zhe mched dod las gzhan sgong skyes/ /lnga len bu dang ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu/ /mchims ṭīka de'i ma sa ga'i gzhes bshad/ /drod gzher nga las nu dang de'i brla las/ /marjes dang nye mjos gnyis so tshangs byin gyi/ /brang las bu mo thi ba'i 378

'azeng ldan ma/ /ging las liza skyong ma'o mchims sgyuka las/ /mtshes dang nye mtshes phrag skyes bagla las ni/ /mdzes ldan marjes can brang las 'phreng ldan zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ gsum pa skye gnas bzhir dbye ba la/ skye gnas kyi dbye ba/ bar srid kyi rang bzhin/ de skye gnas su 'jug tshul gsum/ dang bo sgo nga las skyes pa/ mngal las skyes pa/ drod gsher las skyes pa/ rdzus te skyes pa dang bzhi yod/ mngal du skye mched rnams dod pa las skyes pa de mngal skyes yin la/ mi dang dud 'gro la skye gnas bzhi yod// mi la sgo nga las skyes pa rgyal bo lnga len gyi bu lnga brgya/ ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu sum cu so gnyis rnams sgong skyes yin zhing / mchims ṭīka las/ ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma sa ga'i bu sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /zhes bshad 'dug gzhan yang rgya mtsho'i naja du gru zhig pa'i tshong ba bya khrung khrung mo dang lhan cig tu rtse ba las sgo nga gnyis byung rdzozhing / de las skyes pa gnas brtan brag dang nye ba'i brag gnyis kyang sgo nga las skyes pa'i mi yin pa'i phyir/ mngal skyes ni da lta'i mi phal cher dang / drod gsher las skyes pa/ rgyal bo gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo nas nga las nu/ nga las nu'i brla g.yas pa las mdzes pa dang / de'i brla g.yon pa nas nye mdzes dang /rgyal bo tshangs byin gyi brang las skyes pa'i bu mo thi ba'i 'phreng ldan 3ha9

spa dang / a pra'i sdong bo las skyes pa'i ske za skyong ma rnams de de yin pa'i phyir/ mchims ṭīka las/ nga las nu'i zag pa g.yas pa las skyes pa mdzes pa dang / g.yon pa las nye mdzes dang /rdzode'i brla g.yas pa las mdzes ldan dang / de'i brla g.yon pa las mdzes can dang / de'i brang las skyes pa/ bu mo thi ba'i 'phreng ba can dang / zhes zer ro/ /de dag gi khungs/ mdo mdzangs blun dang / las brgya ba dang / 'dul ba lung sogs las shes par bya dgos so/ /mi la rdzus skyes yod de/ bskal ba dang bo'i mi rnams yin la/ mchims ṭīka las 'phags pa lha dang / mtsho skyes la sogs pa'o gsungs/ mkha' lding bzhi yi gcig gis klu bzhi za/ /bye smra kha cig yi dwags skus skyes zer/ /zhag rer bu bcu za ba du mar bshad/ /skye gnas mchog dang mang ba rtsas skyes gi/ /min yang dgos pa gsum dzir ston pas dor/ /zhes gsungs te/ klu dang mkha' lding la skye gnas bzhi yod/ mkha' lding skye gnas bzhi ldan des klu skye gnas bzhi ldan za bar bshad pa'i phyir/ rdzus skyes la ro med pas/ za ba mi 'thad do zhe na/ ma shi bar du za ba yin la/ shi ba'i tshe ro mi snang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang klu dang mkha' lding la skye gnas bzhi yod de/ mkha' lding la mtshon na rdzus skyes mchog 380

dang / drod gsher skyes nye mchog dang / mngal skyes bar ma dang / sgong skyes tha ma yin la/ mkha' lding rdzus skyes kyis klu skye gnas bzhi ga za/ drod gsher skyes kyis gsum za/ mngal‘skyes kyis gnyis za/ sgong skyes kyis sgong skyes kho na za ba yin nogasungs/ dmyal ba rnams dang / khams gsum gyi lha rnams dang / srid pa bar ma rnams rdzus skyes kho na yin no/ /las kyi nus pa stobs dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzus skyes la phung bo bzhi ba can yod de/ gzugs med pa rnams so/ /de las gzhanardzopa rnams phung bo lnga ba can yin no/ /bye brag dz+ra ba kha cig gis/yi dwags rdzus skyes yin —zer yang / yi dwags la rdzus skyes yod/mngal skyes kyang yod de/ lung las/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu la yi dwags mo zhig na re/ bdag gis mtshan mo bu lnga dang / /de bzhin du nyin mo bu lnga dag /bskyed nas de dag za mod kyi/ /'on kyang bdag ni tshim pa med/ /ces smras pa ltar/ zhagahorer bu bcu za ba du mar bshad pa'i phyir/ skye gnas bzhi la khyad par yod de/ rdzus skyes de rang gzhan gnyis ka la mi gnod par skye/ drod gsher skyes de gzhan la mi gnod par skye/ mngal skyes de sdug bsngal lhan gcig myong ba'i sgo nas skye/ sgong skyes de sdug bsngal lan gnyis myong ba'i sgo nas skye bas na snga ma snga ma rnams tsho381

bza nga la/ phyi ma —phyi ma rnams ngan pa yin pa'i phyir/ skye gnas mchog dang bzang zhing mang ba ni rdzus skyes yin yang / ston pa shākya thub pas/ gdul bya spro ba bskyed pa dang / nye du shākya rnams chos la 'god pa dang / mu stegs byed dag gis ma 'ongs pa na sgyu ma mkhan gyis 'jig rten— bslu bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i kha zer ba'i log rtog 'gog pa'i ched de/ dgos pa gsum gyi phyir rdzus skyes dor—te/ mngal skyes su skye ba bzhes pa'i phyir/phal chen sa ston bar brad med de mdor/ /bram ze na tshod khyer zin rga ba dang / /na ba man te gagin rje'i drung du dzin/ /bar na khyod kyi gnas kyang yod min zhing / /khyod kyi lam rgyags spyang ni yod ma min/ /zhespodang lus res dmyal skung gsungs phyir lang / /bar grid med zer ga gas na rim 'gro ste/ /'dru bzhin(no)chad nas 'byung ste gzugs brtan zer/ /sha shel 'byung 'gal gzugs gozhan med dzir dbair/ /ma grub grub kyang rgyun min sbyir mi mtshungs/ /masur nas zid pa bdun gsungs mdo yis 'grub/ /ces gsungs te/ gnyis pa bar srid la/ ngo bo bshad pa/ sgrub byed bshad pa/ khyad chos bshad pa dang gsum/ dang bo bar srid kyi ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ 'jig rten 'dir skye ba gang tshe snga ma'i 'chi srid dang phyi ma'i skye ba'i sri da 38snye —

pa gnyis kyi bar —du 'byung ba'i srid par dmigs pa de de yin ba'i phyir/ khyod la 'byung ba zhes brjod kyang / byung ba zhes brjod mi rigs te/ byung ba bgrod pa'i yul du phyin zin pa la byed cing / khyod gang du bgrod pa'i yul skye srid der phyin ma zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgrub byed la/ phal chen sde ba dang /sa ston sde ba na re/ bar do'i srid pa ni med de/ mdo las/bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze rgan po la/ bram ze na tshod khyer zin rga ba dang / /na ba yin te gshin rje'i drung du phyin/ /bar na khyod kyi gnas kyang yod min zhing / /khyod kyi lam rgyags kyang ni yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la bdud sun 'byin ces bya bas/ dge slong mkhas mgu zhes bya ba'i 'gram pa la thal lcag bsnun pa'i sdig pas/bdud de rang gi lus yes bskor nas dmyal ba mnar med du lhung bar bshad pa dang / mtshams med kyi las kyis de ma thagatu dmyal ba dag tu skye'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ de 'gogapa la/ rigs pa dang / lung gnyis/ dang bo ni/ sum cu rtsagasum gyi lha shi 'phos nas 'dod pa'i mir skyes pa'i skye srid de/khyod tshe snga ma'i 'chi srid chad pa kho na las byung ba ma yin te/ khyod rang gi tshe snga ma'i srid pa'i rgyun gyis 'jug pa'i chos yin pa'i rte383

phyir/ dper na 'bru shar gyi grong nas nub kyi grong du khyer ba na rgyun chad pa med par rim gyis sleb pa'i 'bru de 'bru snga ma'i rgyun las byung ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de la phyogs snga ma na re/ ma khyab ste/ 'chi srid rgyun chad pa kho na las skye srid 'byung ba'i dpe rnam dag yod pa'i phyir/ dper na mi long nang gi byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan byad bzhin gyi rgyun yin yang me long dang byad bzhin gnyis bar 'gyangs chen po yod kyang / me long nang du byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan 'byung ba mthong ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir zer/ de mi 'thad par thal/ go sa gcig na byad bzhin gyi sha'i rdul dang me long gi shel gyi rdul gnyis go sa gcig tu 'byung ba 'gal ba'i phyir dang / me long gi byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan de snang ba ltar kha do ga dang dbyibs gnyis la sogs pas khyad par dulabyas pa'i gzugs kyi skye mched du ma grub pa gang zhig gal te grub na yang / byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan de/ byad gzugs kyi—rgyun ma yinapas/ dpe don mi mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ skye srid de 'chi srid kyi rgyun yin la/ byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan de byad bzhin gyi rgyun ma yin pas mi 'dra ba dang / byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan de gtso bo'i rgyu byad bzhin dang me long gnyis tshogs pa las 'byung ba bzhin du/ skye 384

sridarwa de gtso bo'i rgyu ngaganyis las mi 'byung bar 'chi srid gcig pulke las 'byung bar 'dod pa dang mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa lung gi sgrub byed ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mgur nas srid pa bdun gsungs te/ dmyal ba'i srid pa dang / yi dwags kyi srid pa dang / dud 'gro'i srid pa dang / lha'i srid pa dang / mi'i srid pa dang / las kyi srid pa dang / srid pa bar ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mi 'don mngal 'jug dri za nyer gne sa gsungs/ /phung bo zhig r+pā nyer gnas zhes 'don na/ /rta men ba'i mdor de yi rigs dang phyogs/ /gang nas 'ongs dris zhig la ji ltar rung / /mi 'ardon sbyir mi 'ong lngar gsungs mdosardzi 'gyub/ /phal chen bar ma do bya'i lha zhig lo/ /la la tshe mi bar dang tshe phal cher/ /rdzogs nas 'da' ba bar 'da' skyes 'da' mo/ /gzugs med bar 'da' yod par bal byan min/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhan yang bar srid yod par thal/ mdo las gnas gsum mngon du gyur pas ma'i mngal du bu chags par 'gyur te/ ma rung zhing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang / pha ma gnyis chags par 'gyur zhing phrad pa dang / dri za yang nye bar gnas pa na'o/ /zhes pa'i dri za de bar srid pa la byed pa'i phyir/ /kho na re/ de yang dri za zhes mi 'don gyi/ phung bo zhig pa nye 385

bar gonasi b.ratshornar 3yo/ tsogawayi'adonocasto/ /zhes zer/slob dpon na re/ de mi 'thad par la/— dri zacide bar do ba yin pa'i phyir/ rta len gyi bu'i mdo la sa/ rta be+en gyi bu khyod kyis mchis 'brang la dri za nye bar gnas pa gang yin pa 'di rgyal rigs sam zhes pa nos/ 'on de lho dang nub dang byang nas 'ongs pa zhig ces sam zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ phung bo zhig pa la byed na/ rigs dang phyogs kyi brtag pa dang / de ni gang nas 'ongs dris shig ces brjod ji ltar rung ste mi rung ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang / khyod kyis dri za zhes mi 'don to zhe na mi 'thad de/ mdo las/ phyir mi 'ongs lngar gsungs pa'i nang tshan gyi bar 'da' ba de bar do ba yin pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ phyir mi 'ongs ni lnga ste/ bar ma dor yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / zhes sogs kyi mdos 'grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang bar do ba yod par thal/ skyes bu dam pa'i 'gro ba bdu na bstan pa'i mdo las/ zhogs ma'i me stag chung ngu ltar myur bar 'da' ba dang / lcags kyi tsha tsha gnam du yar ma thag pa ltar myur ba ma yin par 'da' ba dang / de sa la ma lhung tsam du 'chi ba ltar dus ring mo zhig nas 'da' ba rdeng bcas gsum yod par gsungs pa la brten nas grub pa'i phyir/ phal chen sde ba na re/386

bang makyi+o zhe'adzin pha'i lhar+shazhig yod zer ba la /rka 'dir ya rangs pa'i lo zhes smras so/ /la la na re/ tshe yi bar du 'da' ba dang / tshe phal cher rdzogs nas 'da' ba dag ni bar 'da' ba dang skye 'da' ba sogs kyi don yin no lo/ /de ltar na/ gzugs med du'ang bar ma dor mya ngan las 'da' ba sar 'gyur — bas mi 'thad do/ / nyid kyi 'grel bang drangasaphaba'arom tshigaskus / /bsam gtan dgagi ba tshan dzagi/ /ga rgas med kyi ni bdun tshan gsum/ /'du zhes kyi rna drug tshan du/ /ma da nas tshoms su mang dag ban+debs/ /zhes te bar 'da' dor zir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ mchims ṭīka las/ khams bar ma dor myur ba la sogs pa ni skyes nas mya ngan las 'da' ba la sogs pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhes/ gong du bshad pa'i 'dod pa de bkod pa la 'dod pa de nyid mi 'thad la/ khyed kyis kyang mi bzhed pa yin pa gsal te/ nyid kyi 'grel bar drangs pa'i sdom tshig las/ /bsam gtan dag gi bcu tshan bzhi/ /zhes pa nas/ mdzad nas tshoms su yang dag bsdebs5 /zhes bsam gtan re re la gnas gzhan gsum gsum dang / sngar bshad pa'i bar ma dor lha ngan las 'da' ba nastagong du 'artso ba'i bar rnam pa lnga dang /387

'chi ba med sgo'i ṇabyings la sem gartodang khu snangar+sha soms rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba bcu bcu dang / ci gzugasaskomad dang bo gsum la bar —ma dor mya ngan las 'da' ba ma gtogs bzhi bzhi dang /gnas gzhan tha dad med pa'i ris gcig dang / 'chi ba med pa'i dbyings la sems gtod pa dang / sems rnam par grolagab bdun bdun dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min la gong du 'pho ma gtogs pa drug gsungs pas kyang grub ste/ 'chi ba med pa ni myo ngan lasa'adas pa dang / sems rnam par grol ba ni zag pa las grol ba'i yesna shes te lhag bcas lhag med kyi myang 'das yin no/ /des na gzugs khams su bar ma dor mya ngan las 'da' ba gsungs la/ gzugs med du ma gsungs pa'i phyir yang bar srid yod par shes so/ /'o na/ phal chen sde bas bar srid med pa'i sgrub byed du drangs pa'i —mdo'i don ji ltar yin zhe na/ mdo snga ma'i don ni/ mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi las kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu myong ba la dgongs la/ phyi ma gnyis ni/ gang zag de shi ma thag skye srid gzhan ma brgyud par dmyal bar skye ba la dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mngal gnas dbyul ba'i brad pas bgreg min te/ /las kyisakham mas bcad sbyir ro 'og min gyi/ /khri dang drug stongacu ldan yang 'dir 'grub rung / /ma 388

snang mong ba'ang de tshe dbang bo nga / /glang na rnam bar lhams zagaspozi lam tsam/ /mnar med bar grid brgyad khri bzhi stong thub/ /tsho'akhor bskur skye grid ston mongasakhyun nam dpyad/ /lnga men bu ne rang rgyal yin yang mongs/ /zhes gsungs te/ bar srid ni/ gang du skye 'gyur gyi sngon dus kyi sridamipa'i sha tshugs can nam dbyibs can du 'byung ba'i phyir/ de la kho na re/ bar do ba de 'byung 'gyur sngon dus kyi srid pa'i rnam pa can yin na/ khyi mo'i mngal du tsha dmyal gyi bar srid 'grub pa'i tshe mngal 'tshig par 'gyur ro zhe na/ bar do'i lus ni shin tu dwangs pa dang / 'al kyis mtshams bcad pa'i phyir mi 'tshig par bshad do/ /gal te gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i sha tshugs can yin na/'dzam bu'i gling nas 'og min du skye ba'i bar srid 'dzam bu'i slogling du grub pa'i skal ba med par 'gyur te/ bar srid ni gang du shi ba der 'grub pa yin pa la 'og min pa'i lus dpag tshad khri drug stong ba yin pa'i phyir dang / 'dzam bu'i gling la ni dpag tshad drug stong dang phyed dang bzhi las med pa'i phyir ro zhe na/nam mkha' yangs shing rten 'od ltar dwangs pas 'gar yang thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ bar do ba de'i lus dpag tshad khri dang drug stong ldan yang 'dzam rbu'i skying 'dir 'grub tu rung ngo / /389

ma ning dang long ba yinawāng de'i bar do'i tshe'am skabs su dbang bo kun tshang ba yin no/6 /de'i phyir kun btus las/ gang du skye bar 'gyur ba de'i byad gzugs so/ /zhes gsungs/ 'o na byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad 'grub pa glang chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan gyi rnam par yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ de ni rmi lam gyi mtshan ma tsam yin gyi/ bar srid la dgongs pa min no/ /bar do mthong tshul ni/ ris mthun dag gis mthongadhe la/ lha'i mig skyon bcu gcig dang bral bas mthong ba'i phyir/ bcu gcig yod de/ the tshom dang /yid la mi byed pa dang / lus kyi gnas ngan len dang / rmugs pa dang / gnyid dahe / rgod pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams drags pa dang / sems yal bo dang / bag tsha ba dang / 'du shes sna tshogs pa dang / smra ba mang ba dang / ha cang sgom drags pa rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ bar srid kyi tshe tshad ni/zhag bdun dang / bdun phrag bdun du'ang bshad/ mnar med bar srid zhag brgyad khri bzhi stong thub pa'ang bshad/ 'khor bsgyur gyi skye srid nyon mongs can yin nam dpyad de/ skye ba'i srid pa nyon mongs can zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bar do ba de skye gnas su 'gro tshul ni/ mngal skyes dang sgong skyes gnyis kyi 390

'jug tshul ni/ ji rang gang du skye ba'i gnas de mthong nas phortswa gang rung la chags nas de dang rtse 'dod kyi blo phyin ci log gis ske mngal du 'jug la/ gzhan drod gsher skyes dang rdzus skyes gnyis kyi dang bo ni/ skye gnas gtsang mi gtsang gi dri4la 'dod pa'i sgo nas 'jug gnyis pa ni/ rang gang du skye ba'i gnas de mthong nas de la 'dod pa skyes nas 'jug te/ dmyal ba ba rnams kyangasnatsha dmyal du skye na grang bas nyen nas dro ba 'dod/ grang dmyal du skye na de las ldog pa don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ 'jug tshul bzhi mdo las gsungs te/ gcig ni shes bzhin du 'jug la/ gnas pa dang 'a byung ba mi shes pa yod/ 'jug par ma zad gnas pa yang shes pa yod/ 'jug gnas 'byung gsum shes pa yod/'jug gnas 'byung gsum thams cad la rmongs pa dang bzhi yod de/ de'i bzhi ba ni/ sgong skyes kyi bar do ni/ rang rgyal yin kyang rmongs pa yin te/ rgyal bo lnga len gyirī btsun mo la sgo nga lnga brgya las khye'u lnga brgya byung ba rang sangs rgyas su byung ba yin kyang rmongs pa yin par gsungs so/ /mi thogs lhags gong nang gi zin 'bus thes/ /the tshom yid mi byed skugs gnyid rgod sogs/ /bcu gcig skyon bral sgom byung mig dag ngaska /rta glang khyi dom dus bzhir 'dod khyud pas/ /gzhan tshe rje bu ba min spyang dre da 391

'byur/ /zhes gsungs te/ bar srid thogs med yin te/ gang la yang thogs pa med de lcagasakyi gong bu gshags pa'i nang du'ang srin 'bu dang de'i ro rnyed pa sogs kyis shes pa'i phyir/ mi'i bar do bas mi'i bar do mthong ste/ ris mthun pa'i phyir/ the tshom yid me byed pa rmugs gnyid rgod pa sogs sngar bayad pa'i skyon bcu gcig dang bral ba'i sgom byung gi lha mig dag pas mthong la/ skyon bcu gcig gsungs yang / brtsis na bcu gnyis yod pas/ the tshom dang yide mi byed pa gcig tu brtsis pa e yin snyam/ yang kha cig mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ khyi'i bar srid grub nas/ der mi skye ba yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ der thal/ de grub nas lce spyang du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gnyis rigs mthun pa'i phyir/ zhes chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gsungs so/ /rta dang glang khyi dnge dom dus bzhir 'dod pa spyod pas/dus gzhan gyi tshe/ de dag gi bar srid bong bu dang ba min dang spyang dang dred mong sogs kyi bar srid du 'gyur ba yod gsungs so/ /mngal gyi lnga dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs lnga/ /nur mer nar bo mkhrang 'byur rkang lag 'byus/ /byis gzhon dar ma dar yol— rgas pa'o/ /tshe dang yan lag rgyud sogs gzhan du blta/ /392

mus /gsungs te/ srid pa'i 'khor lo 'di la thog ma med— de/ mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas na/ skye ba snga mar ma rig pas kun nas blangs te las bsags pa'i dbang gis yang srid phyi ma rdzi'aphangs pa bzhin/ mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga rim bzhin grub pa yin te/ mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga ni/ nur nur bo/ rī mer mer bo/ nar nar bo/ mkhrang 'gyure/ rkang lag 'gyus pa ste4lnga'o/ /btsas pa'i gnas skabs lnga ni/ byis pa/ gzhon nu/dar ma/ dar yol/ gos pa ste lnga'o/ /de ltar gnas skabs bcu rim gyis myong zhi—nga / cher skyes nas tshe deng la ma rig pa'i dbang gis las bsags/ de'i dbang gis 'chi srid dang / de las bar srid dang / de nas yang 'jig rten pha rol dag ste mngal skyes sogs kyi skye srid du 'gro ba'i phyir/ mngal 'jug gi tshe dang yan lag bcu gnyis dang bdun tshan bcu phrag so sor 'byung tshul sogs/ gzhan mtha' dpyod sogs su rgyas pas der blta bar bya'o/ / —bye smras reg tshor lhan ga 'a nga ra 'dod/ /dbai ston khams gsum dge sogs gsum mi blob/ /spob la yod sbyir sa mang bor bshad kyi/ a khrab reg la tshor med rang 'grel gsungs/ /btang stoms —mid sgekau gnyis la'ang 'dra 'am dpyad/ /rmo 393

zu tshogasungase te| snyi zag smra ba na je/ reg tshor gnyis lhan cig 'byung rgyu yin pas dus mnyam du 'byung ste/ mar me las 'od dang myu gu las grib ma ba'in no/ /zhes zer/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde bes/ reg pa'i rjes su tshor ba 'byung ba yin pas dus mnyam pa yin mi rung la/ reg pa dang tshor ba ni/ khams gsum dang / dge sogs gsum dang / mi slob pa'i sa dang /slob pa'i sa dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa'i sa thams cad na yod pa'i phyir sa mang bo bar bshad kyi/ sems thams cad la khyab —pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes 'dod do/ /reg pa la tshor ba med par rang 'grel las gsungs pa'i phyir/ btang snyoms dang yid byed gnyis kyang / reg tshor gnyis dang 'dra 'am dpyad par bya'o/ /dbang tshor nyer med kyang mardo yi don/ /de 'as mid kyi nyer rgyu thab la dgongs/ /gsum pa'i bde ba'ang brtan rgyur nyer min/ /blob dpon rang lugs yul der chags bral bas/ /der dmigs zag bcas tshor ba'ang nyer rgyu min/ / gas ring gnyis dang mtshungs par ldan min phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ yid tshor de la yul la nye bar rgyu ba'i sgo nas bco brgyad yod de/ yul gzugs sogs drug la dmigs pa'i tshor ba yid bde drug dang / yul gzugs sogs drug la dmigs pa'i 394

tshorarib yid mi bde drug dang / yul gzugs sogs drug la dmigs pa'i tshor ba bting snyoms drug dang bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ nye bar rgyu ba'i tshuloji lta bu zhe na/ bye smra na re/ yidal brten nas tshor ba yul la rgyu bar 'dod/ mdo sde ba ni tshoraba'i dbang gis yid yul la nye bar rgyu bar 'dod pa'i phyir/des na lus tshor rtog min ni nye bar rgyu bar mi 'dod la/ yidatshor rtog pa de der 'dod pa'i phyir/ de la kho na re/ nye b.rargyu ba'i dbang bo'i tshor ba lnga yang yod de/ mdo las/ migagis gzugs dag mthong nas/ yid bde ba'i gnas lta bu'igazugs rnams la nye bar rgyu ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir nam khyab ste/ de mig gis gzugs mthong bas yid nye bar rgyuba'i gzhi sgrub pa la dgongs tsam yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/dur khrod du mig gis bltas nas sgom pa'i mi sdug pa bzhin no/ /de'i don sdom 'dir/ dbang tshor nyer rgyu med kyang mdo yi don/ /de yis yid kyi nyer rgyu sgrub la dgongs/ /zhes sdom/bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ba'ang shin tu brtan pa'i phyir nye bar rgyu ba min no/ /slob dpon rang lugasacini/ blo gang zhig yul gang la chags pa dang bral ba ni/ yul de la dmigs pa'i zag bcas kyi tshor ba'ang nye bar rgyu ba min te/ chags sdang 395

gnyis dang mtshungs bar ldan pa ma yinasgro pa'itshuphyir ro/ — /phrab/ dog ser sna khro 'tshig 'argyad ba rtse/ /migalkung thub pa lnga las gzhan pa yi/ /rang sa'ijinyon mongs log lta mis kyang spyor / /skye 'chi lung bstan min nyid gong ma'i lugs/ /mchims byuka 'tshig pa'i tshab rtu 'chab pa bgrang / — /brad ba gzhan gsum la rna dge sogs gsum/ /bar brad ma gtogs gsum po gzugs med na'ang / /zhes gsungs te/ srid pa badziyod de/ bar srid/skye srid/ sngon dus kyi srid pa/ 'chi srid dang bzhi yod/ de dag las skye ba'i srid pa ni nyon mongs can kho na yin pa'i phyir/skye srid de rang sas bsdus pa'i rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa thams cad kyis nyon mongs par byed pa'i phyir/slob dpon rang lugs la/ phrag dog ser sna/ khro ba/ 'tshig pa/ 'gyod pa ste chig rkyang thub pa'i nyon mongs lnga las gzhan pa'i rang sa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis nying mtshams sbyor la/ log ltas kyang mtshams sbyor ro/ /skye ba'i srid pa dang /'chi ba'i srid pa gnyis lung ma bstan yin par 'dod pa nyid ni grub mtha' gong ma'i lugs yin la/ mchims ṭīka las 'tshig pa'i tshab tu 'chab pa bgrang ba ni/ rgyal sras ma la brten paraji snang / skye srid las gzhan pa'i srid pa gsum la dge sogs gsum 396

k+shis mtshams sbyar ba r+yad la/ bar srid ma gtogs pa'i srid pa gsum ni/ gzugs med na'ang yod do/ /kham dang zas la sku bzhe zag med kham/ /reg pa kham zas rtsag bsngal tshor ba'o/ /phyi mas gnod phyir zas su ma bshad kyang / /dbyul ba'i khro chus skom pa bel sbyir zas/ /zhes gsungs te/ skye ba gnas pa'i thabs/ zas la bzhi yod de/ kham kyi zas/reg pa'i zas/ sems pa'i zas/ rnam shes kyi zas dang bzhi yod la/ dang bo kham gyi zas de khyad chos gnyis dang ldan te/khams kyi khyad par 'dod khams khocin dang / ngo bo'i khyad par dri ro reg bya'i skye mched gsum gyi bdag nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir/kham dang zas la mu bzhi yod de/ kham yin la zas ma yin pa/ zag med khams gsungs/ mchims ṭīka las/ kham yin la zas min pa ni tho lum 'bar ba la sogs pa za ba dang 'ju ba'i tshe gnyis ka phan mi 'dogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mtha' dpyod las/ dbang bo dang 'byung ba chen po 'jig par byed pa'i kham chos can gsungs/ kham gyi zas kyi kham la sa mtha' med pas zag med khams gsungs pa dpyad/ zas yin la kham ma yin pa/reg pa'i zas/ gnyis ka yin pu kham gyi zas/ gnyis ka ma yin pa sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba'o/ /dmyarmā ba'i khro chu/ sdug brwa~X 7gyi

tshor ba 'dren byed yin pas/ zas yin pa la phyi ma 'a dis gnod mo/da/ bye brag smra bas/ dmyal ba'i khro chus skom pa sel ba'i phyir/ zas yin zhes 'dod do/ /mchims ṭīka las de bzhinarte du reg pa dang zas la mu bzhi brtsis yod de/ reg pa yin la— zas ma yin pa ni/ reg pa zag med do/ /zas yin la reg pa min pa ni/ sems pa sogs zas gsum mo/ /gnyis ka yin pa ni reg pa zag bcas so/ /gnyis min ni de dag ma gtogs pa ste zas gzhan gsum la yang mu bzhi sbyar ro/ /zhes gsungs/dgra bcom rnam smin spyod lam gnyis kyis 'da'/ /gang spel mi dge spangs ging zag med gsal/ /zag bcas rnam smin bcas phyir 'di'i mdor gsungs/ /kun btus rtsad phyogs mang yang snying gar 'apo/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba len pa gnyis tshor ba btang snyoms kho na labarten—cing gnas pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom pa tha ma'i sems de la gnyis yod de/ spyod lam pa'i sems dang / rnam smin skyes kyi sems gnyis kyis 'da' ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gang spel gyi ṭīka las/ kha cig na re/dgra bcom pas mi dge ba dang nyon mongs can spangs shing zag ngamed gsal bas de las mya ngan las mi 'da' la/ dge ba zag bcas ni rnam smin dang bcas shing / dgra bcom pa ni ma 'ongasang398

pa'i rnam smin la rgyab kyis phyogs pa yin pas dge ba'i sems la mya ngan las 'da' ba med do/ /zhes gsungs zer/ 'chi ba'i tshe lus kyi phyogs gang nas rnam shes 'gag pa'i tshul yod de/ngan song dang / mi dang / lha dang / dgra bcom pa rnams ni/rim bzhin ngan song du 'gro na rkang ba nas 'pho/ mi dang lhar skye na/ lte ba dang / dgra bcom snying kha nas 'chi 'pho bar byed gsungs/ kun btus las/ dge ba byed pa'i lus ni thog ma nyid du smad grang bar 'gyur ro/ /mi dge ba byed pa'i lus ni stod grang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di ltar na drod sdud phyogs ma gtogs pa mthar thams cad kyi snying kha nas kun gzhi 'pho bar 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phal chen yab sras mjal sogs tshul mang bas/ /'di las shazhan pa dus 'khor gcig pu min/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa phyi snod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa/ mdo las kyang gsung tshul du ma yod de/ gdul bya rang rang gi las kyi snang tshul ltar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdulabya'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen nas/ mdo phal chen dang yab sras mdo dang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag dang / mngon pa gong 'og sogs la 'jig rten gyi khams chags tshul mi 'dra ba re snye 399

gsungs pa'i phyir na/ mngon pa 'og ma las bshad pa'i 'jig rten chags tshul dang mi 'dra ba bshad pa dus 'khor gcig pu ma yin te/ mdo phal chen sogs du ma yod pa 'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i rlan gsher phor gang la lha mi yi dwags gsum gyis bltas pa'i tshe na de gsum gyi rgyud la rim bzhin bdud rtsi rnag khrag chu dwangs bsil mthong ba'i mig shes tshad ma gsum so sor yod pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la'ang / phal chen/ dran nye/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo/ mngon pa gong 'og dus 'khor rnams kyi ched du bya ba'i gdulabya so sos bltas pa'i tshe na rang rang so so'i las kyi snang tshul ltar mthong ba'i mig shes tshad ma re hore yod pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi khams gcig po de'i go sar dertedag re re la snang ba'i 'jig rten gyi cha re yod pa'i phyir/ des na deng dus 'jig rten la zhib 'jug byed padag gis 'jig rten rlum por snang ba dang / nyi zla gza' skar sogs 'khor tshukhu gong du bshad pa'i mdo sde gang dang yang mi mthun mod/ de ltar 'dzin pa'i tshad ma yang yang dag pa yin te/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod trelas/ dngos po'i sa/nas tshod la 'jig rten gyi khams gcig la yang tshad dbyibs dpangs kyi cha shas gcig kho nar nges pa med de/ dus 400

d+nghagacig la yang tshad dbyibs mi 'dra ba thum po sogs la longs spyod dgos kyi gdul bya mang bo dang / gru bzhi sogs la longs spyod dgos kyi gdul bya mang bo yod na/ de 'dra'i ri rab skum po dang gru bzhi gnyis kyang cha can ri rab gcig gi go sar cig car grub srid pa gang zhig ri'am gling gcig la yang sems can bsod nams chen po can byung dus che zhing bzang ba dang / sems can sdig pa can byung dus ngan pa dang chung ngur 'gyur ba ni lung dang rigs pa dang sngon byung gi rabs du mas grub pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa dang / da lta mdo phal chen dang / yab sras mjal ba'i mdo dang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag dang / mngon pa gong 'og dang / —dus 'khor las bshad pa'i 'jig lkerten dag thun mong snang ngor mthong mi thub ste/ de dag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya ma yin pa'i phyir/ der ma zad shasta la sogs dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i gnas dag kyang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa dag ma gtogs/ yongs grags thun mong ba'i skye 'gro dag la snang mi thub ste/ ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/ don dam par te dngos po la ni 'jig rten gyi khams gcig la yang tshad dang dpangs kyi cha nas rigs gcig tu nges pa med de/ sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi las rigs 401

mi 'dra ba dang / sdig pa'i las rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis las de dag gi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i bde 'gro dang ngan nga'agro'i 'jig rten gyi tshad dbyibs kyi cha shas mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su 'gyur bas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /da lta chos khas mi len pa dag lta ci/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa yin khul gyi shes rlom 'ga' zhig gis/ da lta tshan rig pa ba dag gis ni mngon sum du grub la/ mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad tshul de dag ni/ rmongs dad kyi bshad pa yin snyam zhing ci yin zhes the tshom gyi tshig smra ba dag ni/nang rigs pa smra ba'i grangs su bsdad pa tsam las mtha' chod pa'i rigs pa'i lam du ma zhugs pa'o/ /drung 'jam ldang tshe chags ba'i mgo rtsom yang / /glung dkyil min te las nas chags sgropa'i phyir/ /'a ba zal ma chags bar du de mi chags/ /chu dkyil mi 'pho las kyis brten pa ste/ /bza' btung ma lu long khar mi lhang bzhin/ /n+de gzhan rlung gi bang bas bskor bar 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ chos mngon pa 'di dag gi lugs ni 'jig rten chags tshul yod de/ dang bo bar snang stong bar yod pa las sems can spyi mthun gyi las dbang gis rlung 'jam po 'jam po langs nas lo du mar rim gyis chags nas 'jig rten chags pa'i mgo rtsom/ de ni 'og gzhi'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor 402

min te/ yas nas chags pa'i mgo rtsom pa yin pas/ bskal4ba snga ma mes 'jig pa yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ snod chags4pa'i thog mar tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang dang / de'i 'og tu tshangs mdun gyi gzhal med khang dang / de'i 'og tshangs ris kyirkekhang ba dang / de'i 'og tu yas rim nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang—byed kyi dang / 'phrul dga'i dang / dga' ldan gyi dang / 'thabahobral gyi khang ba'i bar yas rim dang / 'thab bral gyi snod chagasapa'i rjes su rlung dkyil chu dkyil gser dkyil sogs chags par gsungs phyir/ mthab bral ma chags bar du rlung dkyil mi chags—pas/ thog mar chags pa'i rlung 'a—jam po de 'og gzhi'i rlung dkyil ma yin pa'i phyir/ de nas mas rim nas chags pa yin te/sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis rim gyis rlung langs nas rlung —dkyil chags pa yin te/ rlung dkyilko skum po sngo skya/ reg byartetshan po che'i rdo rjes kyang gzhig par mi nus pa/ rngams su ni dpag tshad sa ya gcig dang drusha 'bum/ rgyar dpag tshad grangs med pa yod/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor chags te/ rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong phrag nyi shu yod rdzipa'i phyir/ rlung dkyil gyi steng gi chu dkyil mtha' nas mi 'pho ba—las kyi dbang gis brten pa yin te/ dper na/ bza' btungadzā 403

dag pho ba'i nang nas ma zhu bar du long khar+shanang du mi lhung ba ste mi 'babs pa las rlung gi dbang gi yin—pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/sa sde ba dang sde ba gzhan 'ga' zhig gis/ rlung gi bang ba lta bu'i ra bas mtha' nas bskor yod pas mi 'pho ba ste mtha' nas mi bzhur bar 'odod do/ /cung la gnas zhes rus zal la sogs 'gog /chu mcho bajoms kyang gser dkyil mi khebs te/ /'bum phrag bcu gnyis brgyad bsku don lnga las/ /med kyang galas g.yon re jer chig stong dang / /nyis brgya brgyad cu rtsa r+bhad brgyad lhag go /la la 'dru phung bzhin du rtse rting zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas so/ /zhes bya bas phyi rol khyab 'jug pa dag gis khyab 'jug gi sprul ba'i rus sbal gyi steng na gnas so zhes 'dod pa dang / dbang byug pa dag gis/dbang phyug gi 'dod pa las byung ba'o/ /zhes sogs kyi 'dod pa de dag 'gog pa yin pas/ log rtog de dag sel lo/ /rlung dkyil gyi steng du chu dkyil chags pas/ de'i rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong phrag nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/chu dkyil de'i steng du 'o ma skol ba'i spris ma ltar gser dkyil chags pa'i phyis su ni chu dkyil gyi rngams su dpag tshad 'butha zag brgyad tsam yod de/ sngar bshad pa'i chu dkyil lhag ma 404

rngams su dpag tshad sum 'bum dang nyi khri dag ni gser gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi rgya tshad dang mtha' skor gyi tshad yod de/ de gnyis kyi thad kar te zheng du dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang stong —phrag gsum dang brgya phrag ni phyed dang lnga rnams kho na yod la khor yug gam mtha' skor du skum po rnams la rang rang gi thad ka'i sum 'gyur yod pa ltar dpag tshad 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug dang stong phrag bcu dang brgya phrag phyed dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/sprudi la dogs pa ni 'di la chu mtsho mtho' zheng dang bcas pa kun rdzibasdoms kyang gser gyi dkyil 'khor mi khebs te/ rgya zheng lasku'abum phrag bcu gnyis dang brgyad brgya don lnga las med kyang /rme g.yas g.yon re rer stong gcig dang nyis brgya brgyad cu rtsa byed dang brgyad lhag par yod do/ /mtha' dpyod las/ dang bo la 'o na/ phyi'i lcags ri phan chad du phyogs g.yas g.yon re re lahoyang dpag tshad stong dang nyis brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa phyed dang brgyad re lhag pa ma gin par thal/ daspobaca' dang bo 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dodatsā nus te/ 'dir tshun chad du ma tshang ba'i —dpag tshad de snyed yod pa'i phyir te/ zhes rgyal sras ma drangs pa'i phyir / yang de las/ yang kho na re lhag tshul de mi 'thadardzo805

par thal/ ri dang mtsho rnams kha gting mnyam pa kho na yin nalhag tshul de ltar rung yang de ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ri gling rnams 'bru'e —phung bo ltar zhabs sbo/ma pasadakyil 'khor dang tshad mnyam pa'i phyir zer te/ zhes ga sungs pa dag 'dir sdoms te/ la la 'bru phung bzhin du rtse rting zer/ zhes gsungs/rlung dkyi la gyi rgyar dpag tshad grangs med yod pa'i steng du/ chu dang gser dkyil zil pa'i thigs pa ltar/ dum bu dum bur bye ba phrag brgyar chags pa'i phyir gsungs so/ /lcags ri gnya' theng 'dzin gyi chu mtshams man/ /sum brgya gyed dang bcu gsum bzhi khri'o/ /klu dbang rol gnas zab mtshungs rang rang ri'/ /chu mtshams lan dang zheng mtshungs galung lugs las/ /bsil dang zhim dang lang ba dang / /'jam dang dwangs be+eng dri nga med/ /'thungs na mgrin dang sto ba la/ /mi gnod man lag brgyad ldan chu/ /zhes so / /zhes gsungs te/ ri rgyal dang / gser gyi ri bdun dang / mtha'i lcags ri ste ri dgu bshad pa la/gser dkyil gyi dbus0su ri rgyal lhun po/ de'i mthar gnya' shing 'dzin/ gshol mda' 'dzin/ seng ldeng can/ lta ba sdugarta rna/ rnam 'dud/ mu khyud 'dzin rnams yod/ de dag gi phyi rol na khor yug gi lcags ri dang dgu yod/ mtsho bdun yo da h+la6 — —

de ri rgyal nas mu khyud 'dzin— ri la thug gi bar gyi mtsho bdun po de yin pa'i phyir/ de bdun ni nang gi mtsho yin la/ gling bzhi gnas pa'i mtsho de la phyi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya zhing / des na lcags ri dang / gnya' shing 'dzin gnyis chu mtshams yan la dpag tshad sum brgya phyed dang bcu gsum dang / khri bzhi yod la/ klu dbang rol ba'i gnas mtsho bdun gyi gting zab tshad mtshungs shing / ri rang rang gi chu mtshams yan gyi tshad dang / chu zheng gi tshad mtshungs gsungs so/ /ri dgu dang mtsho bdun gyi rgya zheng sogs mtha' dpyod du shin tu gsal zhing rgyas pas/ 'dir ma bshad do/ /nang mtsho la rol mtsho zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/klu'i rgyal bo rnams rtse zhing rol ba'i gnas yin pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ klu chen brgyad yod de/ klu'i nang na klu chenapo bskal bar gnas shing sa 'dzin pa/ dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / rta'i gzhi dang / btung bzung dang / gzi brjid can dang / yul 'khor srung dang / nag po chen po dang / e la'i 'dab dang brgyad yod/ nang gi mtsho de ni/yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu yin te/ yan lag brgyad ni/ gzhung lugs rang 'grel las/ bsil ba/ zhim pa/ yang ba/'jam pa/ dwangs pa/ dri nga med/ 'thungs na mgrin 401

pa la mi gnod pa/ 'thungs na yo ba la mi gnod ba'o/ / mi yi bzhin yang rang gling 'dra/ /gi sha cu'i skad smra phyir mi snyan/ /mtha' chus bskor gyir gling zhes sher mdor gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang du gling bzhi gling phran brgyad yod pa dag gi tshad dbyibs la sogs pa mtha' dpyod sogs su gsal bas/ sdom 'dir bsdus med la/ gling so sor gnas pa'i mi rnams kyi bzhin nam gdong yang gling de dang de'i dbyibs dang 'dra bar gsungs/ byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling la/sgra mi snyan zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ gling 'di'i mi rnams kyis bi sha tsi'i skad smra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod do/ /mdzod lugs 'dir gling thams cad kyi mtha' chus bskor yod la/ mtha' chus bskor ba la gling zhes brjod pa sher mdo brgyad stong ba las gsungs so/ /khrad chos lnga ba phal ba'i mi bgrod pa'i/ /gangs dang nye bar mtsho la bdun bskor nas/ /gamyu si bsku si ta 'bab/ /las stobs che sbyir dmyal sogs gling 'de'i 'og /yod do 'dru phung 'dra phyir tshud par smra/ /sa las ma dros mtsho yi 'og tu gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dzam bu gling gi yon tan bye brag tu bsha da pa ni 'phags pa'i yul nas brtsis pa'i byang du ri 408

nag po dgu 'das pa'i phyi rol na/ ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba'i gangs ri yod/ de nas pha rol na spos ngad ldang ba'i ri yod kyang / de'i dpag tshad bcu'i tshu rol te lho phyogs na mtsho ma dros pa zhes bya ba chu zheng dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa'e mtsho yod/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang ba'i mtsho de la khyad chos lnga yod de/dbyibs gru bzhi/ chu zheng gnyis kar dpag tshad lnga bcu re / sgra don ni klu ma dros pa gnas pa/ dbus na dzam bu bṛk+ṣa'i shing yod pa'i khyad chos bzhi dang / khyad chos lnga ba ni/ phal bas bgrod mi thub pa'i gangs ri rin po che dang nye bar/ mtsho ma dros pa de la lan bdun re bskor nas 'gro ba'i chu bo chen po gasgru/sidz+nya/ pak+ṣa/ si ta bzhi 'bab pa'o/ /'dzam gling las kyi sa pa zhes las stobs che ba'i phyir gling 'di'i 'og tu dmyal ba sogs yod la/ 'bru'i phung bo spung ba dang 'dra ba 'og zheng che ba'i phyir 'og tu tshud par bshad la/ sa sde las ma dros pa'i mtsho'i 'og tu dmyal ba sogs gnas par bshad do/ /yi dwagle/sa gartso bo mi dges 'phangs ba ste/ cho/dbyul srung lang ngo de 'bras phyis tsung mang / /las kyis mtshams bcad byir na tshe der min/ /dbe ston 'byung ba'o ra lug ri bzhin zed/ /sems tsam sems su smra ste spyod 'acag mthun/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi dwags kyi 409

gtso bo gshin rje'i rgyal bo zhes pa mi dge ba'i las kyis 'phangs pa zhig yod la/ bye smras dmyal ba'i srung ma yang de bzhin du mi dge ba'i las kyis 'phangs pa'i gang zag tu 'dod/ de dag0gis tshe der las ngan pa byas pa'i 'bras bu phyis su myong dgos pa yin yang / las kyis mtshams bcad pa'i phyir/ tshe de la myong dgos pa min gsungs/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde bas dmyal srung de 'byung ba chen po'i ri ra ba la sogs pa ra lug sogs su snang ba bzhin las kyi 'khrul snang yin zer/ sems tsam pas las dbang gis sems kyi snang ba phyi rol tu shar 'dod de/ de ni spyod 'jug las/ 'di ltar 'jigs pa thams cad dang / /sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yang / /sems las byung ba yin nongazhes/ /yang dag gsung ba nyid kyis bstan/ /sems can dmyal ba'i mtshon cha rnams/ /su zhig gis ni ched du byas/ /lcagasangabasregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ /mo tshogs de dag ci las byung / /de 'dre de dag thams cad kyang / /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /dus 'khor go la'i dbang gis mi 'chol gsungs/ /go lar 'khral nas glung gcig smra mi rung / /nyi ma'i snying bor ja pong byed por bshad/ /shasbya la srol bde mchog bstod 'grel las/ /rab 410

byung rnam byung sogs gsungs rgya nag gi /lo skor bcu gnyis shing me sa lcags chus/ /bye bar gnad gcig 'on kyang mgo mi mnyam/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang bcud kyi sems can gyi snang tshul yang / mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ dus skabs gcig dang gnas gcig tu snang tshul tha dad pa du ma yod de/ mdo las/ snal ma zhes pa'i 'jig rten dang / spyi'u tshugs zhes pa'i 'jig rten dang / snrel zhi zhes pa'i 'jig rten rnams kyang go sa gcig tu yod par gsungs pa dang / 'phagasartsopa thogs med kyis mdo sde sna tshogs las gsungs pa sa sder rdzobakod pa la/ mngon pa gong ma'i lugs dang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis gdags pa la sogs pa'i don bzhin mngon pa mdzod 'dir gsungs pa/ mngon pa 'og ma'i lugs dang / de bzhin du phal chen las gsungs pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs las gsungs pa dang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las gsungs pa de dag thams cad ni mi 'dra ba yin te/ rang rang gi gdul bya'i snang tshul dang / dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa la 'gal ba ci yang med de/ mdo phal bo che las/ ji ltar sa bon khyad par gyis 'bras bu sna tshogs 'byung ba ltar/ de bzhin las kyi khyad 411

par gyis/ sems can rnams dang zhing 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / 'jug pa las/ sems nyid kyis ni sems can 'jig rten dang / /snod kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs shin tu 'god/ / 'gro ba ma lus las las skye bar gsungs/ /sems spangs nas ni las kyang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na/mdzod lugs la cung zad sbyangs pa 'ga' zhig gis/ gzhan gyis mthong tshul dang bshad tshul de min no zer ba dang / dus 'khor lugs la sbyangs pa 'ga' zhig gis/ theg pa 'og ma sogs kyis bshad tshul dang mthong tshul dag min no/ /zhes smra ba dag gis ni rang rang gi las kyi snang tshul de dag ni tshad ma yin pa'i don la rmongs pa'o/ /dus 'khor lugs la gza' skar rnams rgyu tshul ni/ nyi zla gnyis kas go la la g.yon skor dang / sgra gcan gyis g.yas skor byed pa dang / rgyu skar rnams ni go la'i thog phra btab pa bzhin du gnas mod/ go la'i rmyeng shugs kyis 'khor ba yin la/ nyi zla gnyis sogs kyis rang 'gros kyis g.yon skor dang rlung 'gros kyis g.yas skor yin/ sgra gcan rang 'gros dang rlung 'gros gnyis kas g.yas skor yin/ des na dus 'khor lugs la go la'i dbang gis gza' skar gyi 'gros dang / dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma ldog tshul sogs 'chol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes 412

gsungs/ go lar 'khrul nas/ mdzod lugs kyi steng gi thog —mar chags pa'i rlung 'jam po skum po de dang skar khyim gyi go la gnyis rlung gcig yin par smra mi rung ngo / /gnas bskal rtsom pa'i dus tsam na shed bu dang shed las skyes gnyis kyis sa'i zhag zos pas lus kyi 'od nyams te mun pa byung bas de'i tshe nyi zla skar ma rnams 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las byung gsungs/dus tshigs kyi byed pa bo/ mdo nyi ma'i snying bo ltar na/ 'jig rten 'di'i thog mar lo zla tshes grangs kyi go rim byed pa bo ni/rang re'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal bo 'di nyid sku tshe snga ma zhig la drang srong rnga bong du gyur dus lo drug khrir dka' thub bsgrubs pas srib/ pa gsum na mthu che bar gyur te/ tshangs pa sogs lha rnams kyis zhus pa'i ngor rgyu skar gyi go rim mdzad pa yin gsungs/ shasta la'i lo rgan drug cu rtsi tshul ni/ bde mchog bstod 'grel las/rab byung rnam byung dkar bo dang tsho/ /rab myos skye bdag i gi ra/ /dpal gdong dngos po na tshod ldan/ /'dzin byed dbang phyug 'bru mang bo/ /myos ldan dpa' bo khyu mchog dang / /sna tshogs nyi ma nyi sgrol byed/ /sa skyong mi zad thams cad 'du la/ /kun 'dzin 'gal ba rnam 'gyur dang / /bong bu dga' ba rnam rgyal nyid/ /rgyal ba myos byed gdong ngan dang / /gser 413

'phyang rnam 'phyang sgyur byid dadza / /kun ldan 'phar ba dge byed dang / /mdzes byed khro bo sna tshogs dbyig /zil gnon spre'u phur bu dang / /zhi ba thun mong 'gal byed dang / /yongs 'dzin bag yod kun dga' dang / /srin po me dang dmar ser can/ /dus kyi pho nya don grub drag /blo ngan rnga chen khrag skyug pa/ /mig dmar khro bo zad byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgya nag gis/ byi ba glang / stag yos bu/ 'brug sbrul/ rta lug sprel bya/ khyi phag ste lo skor bcu gnyis la/shing me sa lcags chu ste lngar phye ba/ shing pho byi ba/ shing mo glang /me pho stag me mo yos/ sa pho 'brug sa mo sbrul/ lcags pho rta/lcags mo lug de ltar brtsis te/ 'byung ba lnga re re'i steng du lo skor bcu gnyis song ba'i lo drug cu bo de la lo rgan drub/ cu zer ba dang / bstod 'grel gyi rtsi tshul de gnyis gnad gcig tu 'bab ste/ lo drug cu re yod pa mnyam pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang mgo 'dzin tshul mi mnyam ste rgya nag gi lo rgan drug cu'i mgo shi nga byi nas 'dzino pa dang / bstod 'grel lugs kyi lo mgo rab byung de rgya nag 'byung rtsis lugs kyi me yos la khel yod/ me yos te rab byung nas brtsis pa'i lo drug cu skor la rab byung gi lo zer la/ dus 'khor bod du 'gyur lo me yos nas brtsis pa'i drugamicu 414

skor la rab byung dang bo zer/ de nas brtsis pa'i/ da skabs rab gnas te/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i nang du slebs yod/rab byung bcu bdun pa la rab gnas zer don/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun yongs su grags pa des zlas drangs pa yin no/ / kha cig dus kyi dang bo lo yin te/ /zhag ni nyi bla'i bar du med do lo/ /dbugs kyis brtsis pa'o de ne kun tu rung / /dus kyi rnam grangs a spur ko ḍar/ /de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de dag brtso lnga phyogs su grags/ /snga phyi'i phyogs ne dkar nag gnyis/ /de gnyis bsdoms pa 'jal byed do/ /mchu zla la sogs gnyis gnyis la/ /de tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /sto byang bgrod pa gnyis la lo/ /zhes so zhes gsungs te/ kha cig na re/ dus kyi dang bo lo yin la/zhag ma yin pa'i phyir te/ zhag ni/ nyi zla'i bar du med la nyi zla byung rjes zhag byung ba yin zer lo/ /de ni mi 'thad de lo ni/nyi mas khyim bcu gnyis bgrod pa'i yun la bshad pas/ nyi mahomed pa'i sngon du lo rtsi byed kyi gzhi med pa'i phyir/ dbugs kyis rtsi gzhi byas nas brtsi ba ni/ rnam pa kun tu rung ba yin te/skyes bu gcig gi mig 'dzum bco brgyad la mthar gnas gcig415

de sum cu la skad cig gcig dang / de bcu gnyib la yud tsam gcig de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig de bco lnga la phyogs dang /de gnyis la zla ba gcig de gnyis la tshigs gcig de gsum la bgrod pa gcig de gnyis lo gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir te/ a ma ra ko dzi ste/ —'chi med mdzod las/ mig 'dzum bco brgyad mthar gnas la/ /de sum cu la skad cig bgrang / /de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam yin/ /de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de dag bco lnga phyogs su grags/ /snga phyi'i phyogs ni dkar nag gnyis/ /de gnyis bsdoms pa 'jal byed do/ /mchu zla la sog sa gnyis gnyis la/ /de tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /lho rtebyang bgrod pa gnyis la lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ phyogs gnyis la zla ba dang / de gnyis te zla ba gnyis la tshigs gcig zer zhing / tshigs gsum ste zla ba drug la bgrod pa gcig lho byang gi bgrod po gnyis ka tshang ba la lo gcig tu 'jog pa yin no/ / tshes zhag khyim gyi zhag zla lo/ /phyogs re'i brtso lnga'i cha ni tshes zhag ste/ /nam langs nam langs bar ni nyin zhag go /nyi ma ldog nas ldog par brgya brgyad cu'i/ /cha'am lug thang 'khrig pa kaska ṭa/ /de bzhin seng ge bu mo srang jig pa/ /gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya rnams kyi/ /nang nas khyim gabyug rdzogs par sum she16

ca d+nghacu'i cha/ /khyim zhag go de'i sum cu de zla sgogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ zhag la/ tshes zhag dang / nyin zhag dang / khyim zhag gsum yod/ de re re'i dbang du byas pa'i zhag zla lo gsum gyi dbye ba yod la/ phyogs de'i bco lnga'i cha ni/ tshes zhag yin la/nam langs nas nam langs kyi bar ni nyin zhag zer/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ldog nas nyi ldog gi bar zhag brgya dang brgyad cu 'i cha'am/ khyim la sbyar na/ lug glang / 'khrig pa/ kaṅka ṭa/seng ge bu mo/ srang / sdig pa/ gzhu/ chu srin/ bum pa/nya rnams kyi nang nas/ nyi mas khyim gcig bgrod pa'i bar la cha sum cu byas pa'i cha gcig gi yun la khyim zhag dang / de sum cu khyim zla yin no/ /khyim bla'i yun tshad skar khyim gnyis gnyis dang / /skar rkang re res rdzogs jir rags rtsis su/ /tshes zhag so gcis zhib par zhag sum cu/ /chu tshod gcig srang lnga bcu dbugs bzhi dang / /'dod cha brgyad kyis khrim zla gcig rdzogs sbyir/ /khrim lor tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig 'byung / /zhes gsungs te/ khyim zla'i yun tshad ni/ go la'i thog0gi skar ma'i khyim ste/ nyi ma khyim re la gnas pa'i dus su/ skar khyim ste skar khong re la cha bzhi bzhi byas pa'i cha re la rkang ba'i tha snyad btags te/ de lta bu'i rkang ba dgu re —la nyi mas longs spyod pa'i phyir/417
