gsum 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa mi slob pa'i las kyis slob—pa'i chos bskyed na/ bdag 'bras gcig pu dang / mi slopa pasar+shami slob pa bskyed na/ skyes bu byed 'bras/ bdag 'bras/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gsum dang / mi slob pas slob pa yang ma4yin/ mi slob pa'ang ma yin pa'i chos bskyed na/ skyes bu byed 'bras dang / bdag 'bras gnyis byed pa'i phyir/ mi slob pa las nyams pa'i tshe na nyams ma thag tu nyon mongs mngon du gyur pa las/ slob sems mi 'byung ba'i phyir na/ skyes bu byed 'bras kyang mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa slob mi slob gnyis ka ma yin pa'i las kyis 'bras bu slob pa bskyed na/ skyes bu byed 'bras dang / bdag 'bras gnyis yod la/ mi slob pa bskyed na'ang 'bras bu de gnyis 'byung la/ slob mi slob gnyis ka ma yin pa'i 'bras bu bskyed na/ 'bras bu lnga char 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /mthong spang 'azas bu spang bya rnam gnyis la/ /rnam smin zal 'azas gnyis dang zal 'bras dor/ /de 'bras spang bya min pa bdag gcig lu/ /sgom spang 'bras bu spang bya rnam gnyis la/ /skyes bdag gnyis dang zal 'bras ma gtogs bzhi/ /zhi rags lam gyi bral 'bras yod pa'i byir/ /spang bya min ba skyes bdag bral 'bras gsum/ /spang bya min 'ablos bdag dang skyes bdag 487

gnyis/ /spang bya min pa rnam smin ma gtogs bzhi/ /zhes gsungs te/ mthong spang sogs phan tshun 'bras bu du bcas ni/ de la mthong spang sgom spang spang bya ma yin pa'i las gsum las mthong spang 'bras bu/ spung bya mthong sgom gyi spang bya gnyis las/mthong ba'i spang bar bya ba'i las kyi 'bras bu la rnam smin dang bral 'bras gnyis dor ba'i lhag spu gsum/ sgom spang gi las kyi 'bras bu la bral 'bras dor ba'i lhag ma bzhi yod/ mthong spang gi las kyi 'bras bu spang bya ma yin pa la bdag 'bras gcig pu yin la/ sgom spang gi 'bras bu mthong sgom gyi— spang bya rnam gnyi sa las/ mthong spang la skyes bu byed 'bras dang bdag 'bras gnyis /sgom spang la bral 'brasi ma gtogs bzhi yod/ 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam zhi rags lam gyi bral 'bras yod pa'i phyir/ sgom spang gi 'bras bu spang bya ma yin pa la/ skyes bu byed 'bras dang /bdag 'bras dang / bral 'bras dang gsum yod/ spang bya ma yin pa'i las kyi 'bras bu la'ang / mthong spang / sgom spang /spang bya ma yin pa gsum yod pa'i mthong spang la bdag 'bras gcig pu dang / sgom spang la skyes bu byed 'bras dang bdag 'bras gnyis/ spang bya ma yin pa'i las la/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ma gtogs pa'i bzhi yod pa'i phyir ro/ / 488

ston mongaspocan gi rigaspomin rkyed dzirtse/ ltas ga spyod lam nyams pa'ang rigs min lo/ /rang 'grel sems med snyoms 'jug dag gis rkyapha/ /ris mthun ba ni 'phen bar mi byed de/ /las dang lhan cig mi 'byung gyir gsungs bas/ /'alen byed de ma tshogs pa'i jom ba 'am/ /sems rten bzhi ba'i dngos gzhi gang min dbyad/ /stoms 'anug thob par bcas te rdzogs byed yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ bstan bcos las/ rigs pa ma yin pas bskyed pa dang / rigs pas bskyed pa dang / rigs pas bskyed pa yang ma yin/ rigs pa ma yin pas bskyed pa yang ma yin pa'i las/ zhes gsungs pa'i dang bo'i mtshan nyid yod de/ nyon mongs can gyi las de ni rigs pa ma yin pas bskyed pa'i las kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ de tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ma yin pa las byung ba'i las yin pa'i phyir/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pas bskyed pa'i las de/ rigs pa'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ de gnyis las gzhan pa'i las de/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i las kyi mtshan nyid yin la/kha cig der ma zad 'gro bsdad zas gos sogs cho ga ltar ma byas pa'i las kyang rigs min gyi las yin la/ cho ga ma nyams pa'i las de/ rigs pas bskyed pa'i las dang / de dag las gzhan pa'i las de/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i las kyi mtshan nyid 489

yin zhesather lo/ /se masamad 'ju garnam smi na da/nga bcas kya/nga ri sa masaga'aphenashrīd spe siste las nang lhan cig mi 'byung ba'i phyir skewo 'grel las/ ris malobashaphen snar mi byed de/ las dang lha na cig mi 'byung ba'i phyijero/ /tshosagasungasayo/ kau ḍā bshad pa'i 'pheṭ+wāṃ byed ñtsā wo dgagi sdus ṭ+wāṃ na ngodapazhi ༵'am/ mas nabasam gaṭ+wāṃn bzha ba das ga gang na dbya da gsungs/ mchipy-is ka las/ 'du shes medapa'i snyoms 'a jug gi rnam smin lha ring bo dang / 'a gog pa'i snyo mas 'a jug gi rnam smin srid rtse ba yin no /ce/ rje / /bye/ /// /)be //bye/ /jo/sa bya ba'ang gas da dbang du byas pa na / 'an byed ni bsam gtan bzhi ba dang / srid pa'i rtse mo'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyiraro/ /zhes gatrīngs pa'i rigs pa sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dir yang snyoms 'jukā ba parabacasaterdzogasaṭ+wāṃd yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /na mongs shas che ba dang ba 'a sa/ /gcig spangs spa byar snga ma ston༅kha yin/r+sha /dbyenagyi skung ba rtsan no byebyen ldanalgen/ /lha sbyin drang lo mngom shes lha ldan du/ /sa 'khor ston pas sge ba'i rnam smin / /zhes gsurnyis te/ mdo las/ las kyisgribaṭ+wāṃ dang / nyon mongs pasdi 90ba pa dang / rnam par smin pa'i ba pa gsum gsungs /

mtho lha sapaskadastolnga yi 'phan rnamasapalaglo sgrib dang / nyon mongs pa shas chen po ni nyon sgrib dang / ngan 'gro gsum dang 'du shes med pa'i sem sa/ can dang / sgra mi snyan pa rnams rna ma par smin pa'i sgrib pa ste gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi che chung yod de/ nyon mongs shas che ba dang rno bas shin tu ngan cing gcig tu spangs sla phyir/ las sgrib kyi snga ma nyon sgrib ngan la/ de'i 'og las sgrib ngan pa'i phyir/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen de/ nyon mongs can dang mi dge ba ma yin te/ nyon mongs spangs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la yod cing / lung du ma bstan pa'i phyir/ de lung du bstan pas dge ba'ang ma yin te/ dge rtsa chad pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la'ang yod pa'i phyir/ dge—'dun dbyen de gang la ldan na/ dge 'dun dang phye ba'i dge 'dun sde phan tshun gnyis dang ldan la/ byed pa bo la mi ldan pa'i phyir/ dbyen byed pa bo'i rgyud kyi dbyen gyi ltung ba ni/ rdzun gyi ltung ba yin no/ /de dge 'dun dbyen dang ldan pa min no/ /dge 'dun 'khor lo'i dbyen de/ sangs rgyas gzhan la mi 'byung ste/ bdag cag gi ston pas sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su lha sbyin drang srong mngon shes lnga ldan zhig tu skyes pa de'i 'khor phye bas de'i las kyi lhag ma byung ba'i rnam smin lo/ /lo zhes pa bye brag smra bas de 491 /

ltar 'dod pa la ma rangs pa yin te/ ltetheg pa gong mas lung de dgongs pa can du 'dod pa'i phyir/yul gtong ba la bu mon ldang ba bzhin/ /bathod sog sa thob tshe las kyis gin tu 'gog /rjes gnas khrad chos drug dang las gsog pa'i/ /gling sogs khrad chos drug kyang rtsa bar gsal/ /tog dkar mer mer mngon zhes gsum gyis dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ rang gnas pa'i yul de btang nas gzhan du 'gro ba la bu lon ldang ba ste/ bu lon gyi dbang gis gzhan du 'gro ba'i gegs byed pa bzhin du/ yon tan khyad par can thob pa la shin tu gegs byed pa gsum yod de/ bzod pa 'thob par byed pa'i gegs phyi ma ngan song du skye 'gyur gyi las dang / phyir mi 'ong 'thob pa'i gegs 'dod par skye nges pa'i las dang / dgra bcom pa 'thob pa'i gegs khams gong du skye nges kyi las rnams yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams gang nas byang sems nges pa la gnas pa yin zhe na/ gang phan chad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam par smin pa can gyi las la sogs pa byed pa dang / mtshan gyi rnam par smin pa can gyi las chos gzugs la dmigs shing sems pas byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ chos gzugs kyi sku ste sangs rgyas kyi smon lam btab cing sems par byed pa'i byang chub 492

bems dpa' dang / byang chub la nges par gzhol ba'i mi ldog pas na nges gnas sam nges rtogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de'i khyad chos drug/ dang / las gsog pa'i gling sogs kyi khyad chos drug kyang rtsa bar gsal ba ltar mtha' dpyod sogs su rgyas shing gsal bas sdom 'dir bsdus med pas/ de dag tu blta bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar yum sgyu ma lha sadzes ma'i mngal du zhugs pa'i skabs kyi mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga'i mer mer bo sogs kyi gnas skabs kyi khyad chos rnams ni/lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ rna ba'i mngon shes dang / gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes gsum gyis dpyad de shes dgos pa las gzhan pa'i thun mong gi snang ngor grub pa med do/ /tog dkar gyi mer mer bo'i rgyud la tshe rabs dran pa'i mngon shes yod na skyes thob las med pas dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gang yin dpyad gsung ba yin la/ de'i rgyud la tshe rabs dran pa dang gzhan sems shes pa yod kyang / rtog med yin zer dgos gsungs/ bsod nams brgya yi 'dren tshul la bzhi lta/ /dge bcu'i spong sems 'god bsngags yi rang bsngo/ /lnga bcu 'phen rdzogs dbye bas brgyar 'dod dang / /'phen byed dang ne mi g.yo'i las 493

la dpyad/ /las lam babyu la rgyu lngaso dmigs pas bcur/ /dbye tshul dge btsu'i lam dag rdzor ba dag /rtog pas ma smas dran zin rtsang 'das su/ /bsngo ba lnga bcu de ltar smon lnga bcu / / chos gzugs skur dmigs brgya rtse mtshan so gnyis/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad dang bcas lnga bcu la/ /dmigs pa lnga bcu smon pa lnga bcu'o/ /khams gsum grol smon bdag grol smon pa dang / /'dod pa nyi tha gong ma nyi shu dang / /grang dbyul brgyad la dmigs pa'i snying rje rnams/ /snga phyi gnyis gnyis r+bha bas brgyar lang gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' nges pa la gnas pas bsgrub bya'i mtshan so gnyis po de dag gi rnam smin gyi rgyu yod de/ mtshan so gnyis po re re'ang bsod nams brgya las skyes pa'i phyir/ bsod nams brgya'i 'dren tshul la bzhi yod de/ dang bo ni dge ba bcu'i spong sems dang / 'god sems dang / bsngags sems dang / yi rang dang / bsngo ba'i sems pa ste re re la bcu bcu byas pa'i 'phen byed lnga bcu dang rdzogs byed lnga bcu ste brgya yod pa dang / 'phen byed kyi las dang mi g.yo ba'i las kyi khyad par dpyad dgos te/ mi g.yo ba'i las ni khams gong mar 'phen byed kyi las yin pasade la rdzogs byed kyi las med dam snyam/ yang de 'dra'i bsod nams 494

—mi g.yo ba'i las kyang yod pas de mtshan rnam par smin pa'i las su mi 'jog gam dpyad gsungs zer/ gnyis pa ni/ dge ba'i las lam bcu la rgyu lngas dmigs pas bcur dbye tshul ni/dge ba bcu'i las lam yongs su dag pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i las lam dag pa dang / sbyor ba dag pa dang / rnam rtog gis ma smas pa dang / dran pas zin pa dang / myang 'das su bsngo ba lngas phye ba'i sems pa lnga bcu dang / de ltar gyur cig snyam pa'i smon pa lnga bcu dang brgya la 'dod pa dang / gsum pa ni/ chos gzugs kyi sku la dmigs pa brgya ste/ mtshan so gnyis/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang bcas pa lnga bcu la dmigs pa'i sems pa lnga bcu dang / bdag kyang de 'drar gyur cig snyam du smon pa'i sems pa lnga bcu ste brgya la byed pa dang / bzhi ba ni/khams gsum las grol bar smon pa dang / bdag grol bar smon pa gnyis dang 'dod khams nyi shu/ gzugs khams bcu drug gzugs med bzhi dang / grang dmyal brgyad dang zhe brgyad la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i sems zhe brgyad dang lnga bcur snga phyi gnyis gnyis phye bas brgyar yang gsungs/ 'di dag ni/ mdo so sor bshad tshul yin la gcig kho nar 'dod mi rung yang mtshan gzhir rung ngo gsungs so/ / 495

bar du bdun khri lnga drug bdun stong bkur/ /ya gcig 'greng ste zhag bdun bstod pa ne/ /skyes bu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge rgyung gzhan/ /'jig rten gzhan dang lha kul sa la med/ /'jig rten 'ji na yod ba ma yin zhing / /rnam thos bu yi gnas na yod ma yin/ /lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na yang / /yon min phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med/ /ri dang nags su bcas pa'i sa yi steng / /rgyas pa kun tu yul zhig ga la yod/ /sman gzhir bskal ba dgu phrag 'dums par gsungs/ /zhes ga sungs te/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'dis sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su bskal ba grangs med pa gsum du sangs rgyas du ma la bsnyen bkur tshul yod de/ grangs med gsum gyi dang bor shākya thub pa chen po la/ rdza mkhan gyi bu snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/ chu 'jam po dang sku mnye dang zham 'bring la sogs pa byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ji 'dra zhes sogs kyis sems bskyed cing / de nas sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong la bsnyen bkur ba'i mthar de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor can gyi tshe grangs med dang bo'i tshogs rdzogs/ grangs med gnyis par de bzhin gshegs pa bdun khri drug stong la bsnyen bkur ba'i tha mar mar me mdzad kyi tshe grangs med gnyis pa'i 496

tshogs rdzogs/ grangs med gsum par sangs rgyas bdun khri bdun stong la bsnyen bkur ba'i mthar sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi dus su grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs rdzogs kyang tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa ma yin la/ de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor can sogs sangs rgyas nyis 'bum nyis khri brgyad stong la bsnyen bkur bas grangs med gsum gyi tshogs rdzogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir/ bdunari khri lnga drug bdun stong bkur/ /zhes/ dang bo la bdun khri lnga stong dang / gnyis pa la bdun khri drug stong dang / gsum pa la bdun khri bdun stong la bsnyen bkur ba'i don no/ /ston pa bram ze'i khye'u gyur pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas skar rgyal ri'i phug cig na me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa la dad de/ rkang ba ya gcig 'greng ste zhag bdun gyi bar du bstod pa ni/ skyes bu khyu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge sbyong zhes sogs kyis bstod pas brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin rdzogs par gsungs/ 'dul ba lung gi sman gzhi las/ de ltar bstod pas bskal ba dgu phrag 'dums par gsungs so/ /rigs pas bskun pa bris rko snyan ngag dang / /grangs sogs 'dzin pa lus ngag yid kyi las/ /kun byang rnam grangs smos pas mngon pa skud/ /ces gsungs te/ gsum pa/ las kyi rnam grangs 497

gzhun bstan pa'i sgo nas don bsdu ba ni/ rigs pas rab tu bcug pa'i lus ngag gi las kun slong dang bcas pa ni/ de la ka la sogs pa'i yig 'bru'i gzugs 'bri ba dang / lha la sogs pa'i 'bur gyi rgya rko ba ni lus kyi las dang / dngos po'i grangs bgrang ba dang / snyan ngag gi tshig brjod pa ni ngag gi las dang / bcu tshan bcu la brgya'o/ /zhes pa dang / chos thams cad ni yul lo snyam du sdom pa yid kyi las yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na phung bo lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis ba chos kyi rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa'i sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ nyon mongs can gyi chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ nyon mongs pas bkab pas na bsgribs pa dang /'phags pa rnams kyis bor bas na ngan pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang lhan cig 'dug pas na kha na ma tho ba zhes bya ba rnam grangs yin/ 'du shes dge ba'i rnam grangs yod de/ rgyud la bskyed cing brten par bya ba yin pa de de'i rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /las kyi mchog gyur dam chos bdud rtsi yis/ / las nyon ma lus zhi ba'i thar ba mchog /las can kun la sbyin pa'i dpal yon gyis/ / las nyon zad pa'i dga' ston deng 'di spyal/ /gnas bzhi ba'i skabs so/ / 498

gnas lnga ba'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/thabs dang shes rab mchog la dbang 'byor bas/ /phra rgyas ma lus 'joms pa'i dgra thabs kyis/ /thabs shes gnyis med rgyal thabs la gnas te/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i bla ma sa/tsug tu 'dzin/ /gnas lnga ba'i skabs kyi sdom tshig cung zad 'grel ba la/las de'i rtsa ba phra rgyas bye smras gi/ / gas sogs dbe ston sa bon gnas mas thob/ /phra rgyas nyon mongs gzhi gcig tha dad smra/ /'anir yang tha ma'i gas sogs za rgyas min/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun 'byung bden pa la/ las kyi kun 'byung dang / nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis yod pas/ las kyi kun 'byung ni/ gnas bzhi bar gsungs nas/ las kho nas srid pa sna tshogs bskyed pa yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ de'i rtsa ba ni/ nyon mongs pa'am phra rgyas yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /ces sogs gnasalnga ba 'dir nyon mongs pa ste phra rgyas gsungs/ nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ gang byung na rangabyā dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems rgyud rab tu ma 499

zhi bar byed pa'i rigs gnas kyi sems byung de yin pa'i phyir/'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs par/ nyon mongs zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sems nyon mongs pa ste ma zhi ba'am rnal ma dgra bcom pa'i sems ltar mi gnas par blong blong bor byed pa'am byed las bcur byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na nyon mongs pa phra rgyas ni gang yin zhe na/ 'dod tshul sdom 'dir bsdus pa ni gnas bzhi bar bshad pa'i las de'i rtsa ba phra rgyas ni/bye brag smra bas 'dod chags sogs kun nas dkris pa'i nyon mongs su 'dod la/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde bas nyon mongs kyi sa bon la 'dod/ gnas ma bu bas nyon mongs kyi thob pa la 'dod/ phra rgyas ni nyon mongs gzhi gcig la ldog pa tha dad du smra bar 'dod do/ /kha cig rtsa nyon drug po gang rung yin na phra rgyas yin pas khyab zer na/ mi 'thad de/ 'dir yang skad cig tha ma'i 'dod chags sogs phra rgyas ma yin pa'i phyir te/nyon mongs rang nyid rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der thal rgyun 'chad kha ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'jug pa'am byed bcu mchims ṭīka las/ /rtsa ba brtan byed thob pa'i rgyun/ /thud gnas byed pa phra rgyas na/ /zhing ni rang da phra rgyas gzhir/ / mthun skub pa nye ston skyed/ /las kyi brad pa skub par byed/ /300

rang tshogs 'dzin pa tshul bezhin min/ /dmigs pa kun mongs mi shes nyid/ /rnam shes rgyun 'khrid grid par 'phen/ /dge las g.yo ba nyams pa yin/ /'ching ba khams las mi 'da' ba/ /rnam pa bcu ni gnas 'azhir lang / /rab rtu bstan ba yin par 'dod/ /ces gsungs 'dod chags de bzhin zhes 'dod chags/ / rgyas rung de la khro sogs rgyas par bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/nyon mongs pa'i byedari las bcu ni/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba ste/thob pa rgyun mi 'chad par byed pa brtan par byed/ nyon mongs pa'i rgyun brgyud par gnas par byed/ lus rten nyon mongs skye ba dang mthun par byed pas zhing du byed/ 'dod chags kyis—ngo tsha med pa dang / rgod pa dang / ser sna dang / zhe sdang gis khro ba dang / phrag dog dang / gti mug gis rmugs gnyid dang / khrol med lta bu/ rtsa nyon rang rang gi nye nyon skyed par byed pas rgyu mthun pa sgrub par byed/ nyon mongs kyis las— bsags pas las kyi srid pa sgrub par byed/ nyon mongs kyisangargyu tshogs ni tshul bzhin min pa'i rnam rtog skyed pas nyon mongs rang gi tshogs 'dzin pa dang / don gnas mi rtog pa'am de las log par 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa la kun tu rmongs par byed/rnam shes kyi rgyun dmigs pa la'am yang srid du 'khrid pas na 501

rnam shes kyi rgyun 'khrid par byed/ dgi ba'i phyogs las nyams par byed pas na dge ba'i phyogs las g.yo ba dang / khams las mi 'da' bar 'ching ba'i ched du khyab par byed cing mchen par byed pas na 'ching ba'i don du khyab par byed pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs par byed tshul rnam pa bcu bo ni/ gnas 'dir yang rab tu bstan pa yin par 'dod la/ gong 'og kun tu shes dgos/zhes gsungs so/ /'dod chags de bzhin zhes smos pa ni/yul de la chags pa'i brlan par ma byas na/ rtsa nyon gzhan mi chags pa ras gsher ba dang rdul lta bu yin pas/ 'dod chags kyi dbang gis rtsa nyon gzhan dag dmigs pa la rgyas par 'gyur bas/ 'dod chags rgyas rung de la khro sogs rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ / thar blo blog phyir bshad kyang blob dpon gi/ /rdo skyong sred skyal lus ne grid pa nyid/ /yin phyir gsungs te gzugs med khams la dbyad/ /de steridun nam lta bcas phra rgyas bcu/ /so gnyis nyer brgyad nyer brgyad rjom pa mi/ /mthong spang gya brgyad steng du sgom spang bcu/ /kun btus mthong spang brgya rtsa bcu gnyis gsungs/ /brtsa bar bden pa phyi ma gsum gsum la/ /rta ba gnyis gnyis dor bas go bzhir gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ phra rgyas de la/ rtsa ba'i 502

sgo nas dbye na drug yod de/ 'dod chags kyi phra rgyas/ khong khro'i phra rgyas/ nga rgyal gyi phra rgyas/ ma rig pa'i phra rgyas/ lta ba'i phra rgyas/ the tshom gyi phra rgyas dang drug yod/ rtsa bar 'dod chags de bzhin khong khro dang / /zhes pa'i de bzhin zhes pas chags pa'i dbang gis rtsa nyon lnga 'jug dgos par bstan to/ /rtsa nyon drug tu ma zad bdun du yang bshad de/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyi phra rgyas dang / khong khro'i phra rgyas dang / srid pa'i 'dod chags kyi phra rgyas dang / nga rgyal gyi phra rgyas dang / ma rig pa'i phra rgyas dang / lta ba'i phra rgyas dang / the tshom gyi phra rgyas dang bdun yod/ 'dod chags la gnyis phye ba ni/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / khams gong ma gnyis kyi 'dod chags la srid pa'i 'dod chags zhes gcig tu bgrang ba'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'dod pa'i khams na ni 'dod chags phal cher yul la mngon du phyogs pas kha phyir bltas te 'jug la/ khams gong ma de dag gi 'dod chags ni gzhal yas khang la chags pa yod mod phal cher snyoms 'jug la chags pas kha nang du bltas par mtshungs bas gcig tu byas pa'i phyir/ kha cig khams gong ma gnyis la thar ba'i 'du shes bzlog pa'i phyir du srid pa'i 'dod chags zhes logs su bshad par grags kyang / slob 503

dpon dbyig gnyen rang nyid ni/ sems can de dag snyoms par 'jug pa na rten dang bcas pa'i lus kho na srid pa yin de'i ro rtemyong ba de la srid pa'i 'dod chags zhes bshad/ ces gsungasangamod/ gzugs med khams kyi gang zag la lus med de/ gzugasangamed pa'i chags yul gyi lus de gang yin dpyad dgos gsungs te/ gang spel las/ lus nyid kyi rten yin te phung bo lnga'am bzhi'o/ /zhes pa ltar phung bo bzhi'o/ /de ltar phra rgyas la bdun nam/ lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga ste bcu yod la/ 'dod pa'i mthong spang so gnyis/ gzugs gzugs med gnyis la so sor nyer brgyad yod pas bsdoms na mthong spang gya brgyad yod/'dod pa'i mthong spang so gnyis ni/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang la lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga ste bcu dang / kun 'byung dang 'gog pa mthong spang la lta min lnga dang / log lta dang / lta ba mchog 'dzin gnyis dang bdun bdun yod/ lam mthong spang la lta min lnga dang / log lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba gsum dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/'dod khams kyi sgom spang bzhi yod de/ 'dod chags/ khongangakhro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa bzhi yod pas 'dod pa'i mthong sgom gyi spang bya so drug yod la/ gzugs khams kyi phra rgyas so gcig yodadzha 504

de/ khong— khro lnga med pas mthong spang nyer brgyad dang / sgom spang gsum dang so gcig yod/ gzugs med na'ang so gcig yod pa de dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ mthong spang gya4brgyad kyi steng du/ sgom spang bcu bsnan te/ 'dod pa'i sgom spang bzhi dang / khams gong ma gnyis kyi gsum gsum ste drug dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/kun btus las/ mthong spang nyon mongs brgya dang bcu gnyis gsungs te/ 'dod khams na bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i lta ba dang lta min lnga ste bzhi bcu/ khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro ma gtogs pa'i dgucidagu bsdoms pas brgya dang bcu gnyis/ sgom spang nyon mongs bcu drug yod de/ 'dod pa na drug khams gong ma gnyis la lnga lnga ste bcu drug yod par gsungs/ rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ sdug bsngal la bcu dang /bden pa phyi ma gsum la lta ba dang bo gnyis dor bas mthong spang 'dod pa na sum cu rtsa bzhi dang / gong ma gnyis na sum cu sum ste/ mthong spang nyon mongs go bzhi dang / sgom spang 'dod pa'i bzhi dang / gong ma gnyis kyi gsum gsum ste bcu gsungs so /lam dang cig bsngal tshul zhugs khrad par dpyad/ /phyi mas lam mthong spang byar dmigs sam brtag /dngos gzhir mi 505

dmikros spang bya ris gzhan byar/ /zhes gsungs te/ lam bden gyi 'o ga zhugs sam spang bya ni/ lta min lnga dang / lam med par 'dzin pa'i log lta dang lam ngan pa mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba mchogatsho'adzin dang / tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin la gnyis yod pas/ lam dor bya dang tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs kyis dag par 'dzin pa dang gsum yod/ 'jig mthar gnyis sdug bden la dmigs dgos pa'i/ lam bden la log par zhugs pa min gsungs/ sdug bden gyi log zhugs la lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga yod pas/ phyi ma sdug bden gyi log zhugs kyis lam mthong spang la dmigs sam brtag ste/ 'dis zag bcas kyi phung bo lnga la dmigs pa gang zhig lam dman pa mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lam mthong spang du gyur pa'i lta ba mchog 'dzin gyi dmigs pa ni zag bcas thams cad la byed de/ rang 'grel las/ dman pa la mchog tu 'dzin par lta ba ni lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa'o/ /dman pa yang ci zhig ce na/ zag pa dang bcas pa thams cad de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na lam mthong spang gi dmigs yul la sdug bden yod par thal/ zag bcas thams cad yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na lam mthong spang la 'jig mthar gnyis med pa'i rgyu mtshanā med par thal/ 'dod pa'i 506

phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ yig cha las/ 'jig lta mthar lta la sdug bden la dmigs dgos pas 'dir med cing / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'jig mthar gnyis lam bden gyi yang mthong ba'i spang bya'am log zhugs su mi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sdug bden la dmigs pa tsam gyis min te/ nyer len gyi phung bo la dmigs nas bdag gam bdag gir lta ba dang /nyer len gyi phung bo la dmigs nas rtag chad gang rung du lta ba'i rdzoshes rab nyon mongs can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ mtha' dpyod las/ lta ba lnga bo thams cad 'jig pa dang tshogs pa la lta ba ste dmigs pa yin kyang 'jig ltar mi 'gyur te/ bdag gam bdag gir lta ba 'di kho nar nges pa'i phyir dang / lta ba lnga dmigs pas mi 'byed par rnam pas 'byed pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sdug bsngal mthong spang ngam tshul zhugs kyis/ lam mthong spang la dmigs pa yin mod/ dngos gzhir mi dmigs te spang bya ris gzhan yin la/ bdag gir ma byas gnyen po'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/nyer len phung dmigs bdag gam bdag gir dang / /der rdzo dmigs rtag chad lta zhes nyon mongs can/ /'jig mthar lta ba'o lam dmigs bdag 'dzin yang / /yod na zhen yul med par 507

mngon sum du/ /rtogs pas spong dzir rtsag bsngal mthong spang lo/ /srug bsngal mthong spang dmigs dang zag med 'gal/ /de phyir mkha' dmigs log lta bzhag bar dka'/ /zhes gsungs te/lta ba lnga'i 'jig lta'i ngo bo yod de/ nyer len gyi phung bo la dmigs nas bdag gam bdag gir lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can de de yin pa'i phyir/ mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba'i ngo bo yod de/ nyer len gyi phung bo la dmigs nas rtag chad gang rung du lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can de yin pa'i phyir/ lam bden dze+edamigs pa'i bdag 'dzin yang yod na/ bdag 'dzin de'i zhen yul med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam gyis spang dgos phyir/ sdug bsngal mthong spang yin zhes bye brag smra bas 'dod do/ /lo ni zur za'o/ /drug ni zag med spyod yul yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'gog pa mthong spang dang lam mthong ba'i spang bar bya ba'i log lta gnyis dang / the tshom gnyis dang / bzhi bo de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa dang / 'ba' zhig pa ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa dang drug po ni zag med kyi yul can dang / lhag ma rnams zag bcas kyi spyod yul can du grub pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pas/ sdug bsngal mthong spang gi dmigs ba dang zag med 'gal dgos la/ de'i phyir nam mkha' la 508

dmigs pa'i log lta bzhag dka' ste/ nam mkha' zag med yinanepa dang / zag med la dmigs pa ni/ 'gog lam gnyis la dmigs pa drug las gzhan ma bshad pa'i phyir/ dale ston dngos—gzhi thob kyang 'dod nyon yod/ /mngon zhes can gyis log lta'i spol btod phyir/ /bye smra de la jig sems byung ba'i tshe/ /mngon thes nyams te lha sbyin bzhin zhes zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde bas bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob kyang dzi'adod nyon yod par 'dod de/ zhi rags rnam can gyi 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam gyis 'dod pa nas ci yang med par gyi nyon gamongs rags pa mngon gyur pa la chags bral byed nus mod/ phra ba lkog gyur pa la chags bral byed mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob kyang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis 'dod nyon ma spangs na/ 'dod nyon phra mo rgyud laneyod par 'dod do/ /mngon shes can gyis log lta'i srol btod pa yin te/ lta ngan drug cu'i dang bo ni/ gzugs med nas 'dod par skyes pa'i bram ze zhig gis ting 'dzin bsgrubs te/lha'i mig gi mngon shes thob nas skye ba snga ma gang yin bltas pas/ skye ba snga ma gzugs med kyi skye ba de/ ma mthong nas skye ba snga ma med do snyam pa'i log lta skyes pa dang / de bzhin du 509

'dod lha rtse 'jor rol ba las tshe 'phos pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas nas tshe 'phos pas log lta'i srol btod pa sogs lta ngan drug cu re gnyis kyi skabs su gsal/ de dag gis dang bor mngon shes thob kyang / sdig sems byung ba'i tshe mngon shes nyams pa yin te/ dper na lha sbyi na gyis rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs kyang dge 'dun dbye 'dod kyi sdig sems byung ba'i tshe rdzu 'phrul nyams pa bzhin no zhes bye brag smra ba 'dod do/ /dbang phyug rgyur lta rgyu la logalhags phyir/ /kun 'byung mthong spang zhe na rang byung rtag /bdag gi rnam pas 'acag phyir sdug bsngal mo/ /'o na ba lang bskul zhugs la sogs pa/ /mtho ris dang thar ba'i lam lta ba/ /kun 'byung mthong spang mi 'gyur ci zhe na/ /bye smras tshul de rtsag bden yin dzir zer/ /rang 'grel lam gyi de med thal ba 'phang / /zhes gsungs te/ kho na re/ dbang phyug sogs 'gro ba'i rgyu min pa rgyur mngon par zhen pa chos can/sdug bsngal mthong spang ma yin par thal/ kun 'byung mthong spang yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la log par zhugs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ dbang phyug rtag pa dang bdag tu phyin ci log tu mngon par zhen nas de'i stobs kyis log par rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de 'dra de sdug bsngal chos 510

bzodatho kyi mthong bas spang bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bye bragardzotu smra bas zer lo/ /'o gab lang gi ba rtul zhugs la sogs pastoste/ sogs pas bsdus pa ri dwags kyi tshul khrims/ bya gag gi tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te gnas pa de ni des dag par 'gyur/ grol bar 'gyur/ nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal las rnam par 'da' bar 'gyur zhing / bde ba dang sdug bsngal las rnam par 'das pa'ang rjes su thob par ho'agyur ro zhes de ltar lta zhing / de skad du smra ba ni rgyu ma yin pa la rgyur yid ches shing / mtho ris kyi rgyu dang / thar ba'i lam du lta ba rnams/ kun 'byung mthong spang du mi 'gyur ba ci'i phyir zhe na/ bye brag smra bas/ gong gi tshul de dag ni sdug bden yin pa'i phyir zer mod/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ de lta na zag bcas la dmigs pa'i mthong spang dang sgom spang thams cad kyang sdug bsngal mthong spang du 'gyur te/ sdug bsngal la log par zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lam mthong spang yang med par 'gyur/ zhes thal ba 'phangs so rtag bdag phyin ci log pa gnyis tsam mam/ /ma yin gtsang bde rtag bdag bzhi yi pyir/ /de bzhi mabar n+ta'i phyogs gcig lta 511

sachog 'dzin/ /'jig lta gsum skur log dang mthar lta'i phyed/ /sgro 'dogs med byar tshul byugs mtha' gcig tu/ /log min gzhan la nges rtog med byar dor/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyin ci log la/ rtag par lta ba dang / ba dag tu lta ba gnyis tsam nges sam zhe na/ ma yin te/ mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar lta ba dang /sdug bsngal la bde bar lta ba dang / mi rtag pa la rtag par lta ba dang / bdag med pa la bdag tu lta ba'i phyin ci log bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi ni/ mthar lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/'jig lta dang gsum la phyin ci log bzhi 'jog ste/ mthar lta'i phyogs gcig la dang bo rtag 'dzin bzhag lta ba mchog 'dzin la gtsang bsa'i phyin ci log gnyis bzhag 'jig lta la bdag lta phyin ci log bzhag go /phyin ci log ni rgyu mtshan gsum gyis 'jog pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa la gcig tu phyin ci log pa'i phyir dang / nges par rtog pa'i phyir dang / sgro 'dogs pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ mthar lta'i chad lta dang / log ltas sgro mi 'dogs shing / tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin ni dmigs pū la mtha' gcig tu phyin ci log min la/ nyon mongs gzhan dag ni nges par rtog par byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir dor ba yin no/ /'o na sems dang 'du shes phyin ci log /mdor gsungs 512

dngaltagal thes rtog mad dzir zer/ /skyon med de ne lta ba'i dbang phyir ro/ /tshor bar bal bar mi 'byur ma grags phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'o na/ 'du shes phyin ci log pa dang /sems phyin ci log pa dang / zhes mdo las gsungs pa dang 'gal te/ sems dang 'du shes la nges rtog med pa'i phyir zer na/ mdo dang 'gal ba'i skyon med de/ sems dang 'du shes phyin ci log gnyis lta ba'i dbang gis phyin ci log tu bshad pa'i phyir/ 'o na tshor ba yang phyin ci log la sogs par yang thal bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ de skad du 'jig rten na ma grags pa'i phyir ma bshad de snga ma gnyis ni grags pa'i phyir ro/ /khengs lhag nga rgyal nga mngon cung zad log /lhag dang nga rgyal cung zad gsum las dgu/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshig rkang dang bo'i skabs su nga rgyal bdun bstan pa yin te/ khengs zhes pa'i skabs su rigs sogs kyis mnyam mo snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang bo bstan/ lhag ces pa'i skabs su/ rigs sogs kyis bdag 'phags so snyam pa'i lhag pa'i nga rgyal te/ nga rgyal gnyis pa bstan/ nga rgyal zhes pas khyad par 'phags pas kyang bdag khyad par 'phags so snyam pa'i nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal te/ nga rgyal gsum pa bstan/nga zhes pas nye bar len pa'i phung bo la bdag gam bdag gir lte513

sems pa'i nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal te/ nga rgyal bzhi ba bstan/mngon zhes pas khyad par ma thob bar thob bo snyam pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal te/ nga rgyal lnga ba bstan/ cung zad ces pas khyad 'phags las cung zad dman snyam pa'i cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal te/ nga rgyal drug pa bstan/ log ces pas/ yon tan ma yin pa la yon tan du rlom pa'i log pa'i nga rgyal te/ nga rgyal bdun pa bstan pa'i phyir/ tshig rkang gnyis pas/ nga rgyal da gu sdud byed kyi nga rgyal gsum bstan pa yin te/ lhag ces pas lhag pa'i nga rgyal dang / nga rgyal ces pas nga rgyal dang / cung zad ces pas cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal te/ de gsum las nga rgyal dgu gyes par ba shad pa yin no/ /nga rgyal dgu yod de/ bdag mchog yin no snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi rnam pa dang / bdag dang 'dra'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi rnam pa dang / bdag dman no snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi rnam pa dang / bdag pas mchog yod do/ /bdag dang mnyam pa yod do/ /bdag pas dman pa yod do/ /bdag pas mchog med do/ /bdag dang mnyam pa med do/ /bdag pas dman pa med do snyam pa'i nga rgyal dgu bstan bcos las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /ma spangs mi spyod skye gred 'jig sred gnyis/ /spangs kyang spyod pa gnyid dang mig la sogs/ /zhes — 514

gsungs te/ 'phags pa slob pas ma spangs kyang mi spyod cing mngon du mi 'gyur ba yod de/ gsod pa sogs lus ngag gi mi dge ba rnams dang / de dag gi kun slong kun dkris dag dang /bdag yun ring du gnas pas ci zhig bya/ myur du zhi na snyam pa'i 'jig pa la yid smon pa'i 'jig —sred dang / sngar bshad pa'i nga rgyal bdun dang / bdag lus ngan po'i bud mede du skyes na ci ma rung snyam pa'i skye ba la yid smon pa'i skye sred dang / nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal rnams 'phags pa la mngon gyur du mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ de rnams nyon mongs lta bas rgyas par 'gyur dgos pa la/ 'phags pas nyon mongs lta ba spang ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ nga rgyal gyi rnam pa rnams dang / nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal rnams 'jig ltas dang gsod sogs kun dkris ni log ltas dang / 'jig sred ni chad ltas dang / skye ba'i sred pa'i phyogs rtag ltas rgyas par byas pa yin la lta ngan de dag spangs pa'i phyir dang / mi dge ba'i 'gyod pa'ang 'phags pas ma spangs kyang mngon gyur du mi 'byung ste/ de the tshom gyis rgyas par 'gyur la 'phags pa sa the tshom spangs pa'i phyir/ spangs kyang spyod pa gnyid dang mig sogs gsungs te/ mchims mdzod las/kha cig spangs kyang 'phags pa rnams kun tu spyod pa'ang yod de/515

'jig rten pa'i dad pa dang gnyid dang sdug bsngal gyi dbang bo dang mig la sogs pa rnams 'dod par skyes pa'i 'phags pa rnams la mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro zhes slob dpon gang spel 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs shing / gong du/ mchan las dad sogs zag bcas dang gnyid dang mig sogs dbang bo dang sdug bsngal gyi dbang bo rnams ma spangs kyang spyod la/ zhes gsungs 'dug go / skal mnyam khams kun 'gro ba rtsag kun gyi/ /lta bdun the chom gnyis dang ma rig gnyis/ /ma 'dres pa ste chags can kun 'gro min/ /'dod khams ma lus dmigs tshul med na lang / /ris lnga'i rang snog tsam la cig car dmigs/ /zhes gsungs te/ skal ba dang mnyam pa'i khams kun tu 'gro ba ni/ sdug bsngal mthong spang gi lta ba lnga dang / kun 'byung mthong spang gi log lta dang lta ba mchog 'dzin gnyis te lta ba bdun dang /de bzhin du sdug kun mthong spang gi the tshom gnyis dang the tshom gang yin pa de dag dang lhan cig ste/ mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma rig pa dang / rtsa nyon gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa gnyis te/ khams gsum na bcu gcig re yod pa'i phyir/ khams gsum na bcu gcig re yod pas khyon bsdoms sum cu rtsa gsum yod pas/ de dag ni skal mnyam kun 'gro yin te/ khams rang 516

rang gi sa ba'i skal ba spang bya ris lnga kun la dmigs pa'i sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar bden pa dang bo gnyis kyi lta ba dang the tshom dang mtshungs par ldan pa dang / ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa kho na kun 'gro yin gyi/ 'dod chags la sogs pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma reg pa ni/ kun tu 'gro ba ma yin no/ /chags can kun 'gro min/ zhes pa de'i don no/ /phra rgyas bcu gcig po dag gis rang gi khams mtha' dag la dmigs pa yin/ bye smras/ rang gi khams mtha' dag la dmigs tshul yod de/ mtha' dag cig car dmigs pa min kyang sdug bsngal mthong spang nas sgom spang bar rnam pa lnga bo thams cad kyang cig car dmigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod khams ma lus pa cig car dmigs tshul med na yang / ris lnga'i rang ldog tsam la cig car dmigs pa yin par 'dod do/ /'jig mthar ma gtogs dgu ni skal mi mnyam/ /kun 'gro 'dod pa'i tshangs pa rtag lta ba/ /log shes tsam ste lta ba lngas ma brtsas/ /bsam gtan mtha' dang srid rtser sa skal mnyam/ /ma gtogs med de 'og mar mi dmigs zhing / /rang sar skal mnyam khams kyi ming med de/ /gzhan du sa bzhin khams dgur bal phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/skal ba mi mnyam pa'i kun 'gro ni sngar gyi bcu gcig po de dag 517

las skal ba mi mnyam pa'i khams gong du dmigs pa dgu yod/ phra rgyas bcu'i 'jig lta dang mthar lta gnyis po ma gtogs pa khams gong du spang bya ris lnga la dmigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i lta ba dang bo gnyis rang sa'i phung bo kho na la dmigs pa'i phyir/'dod pa'i tshangs pa sems can du lta ba ni/ tshangs pa la bdag dang bdag gir mi 'dzin pas 'jig lta ma yin la/ tshangs pa rtag par lta ba'ang mthar 'dzin par lta ba ma yin te/ chos mngon pa rnams kyis tshangs pa la dmigs pa ni/ log pa'i shes pa yin gyi lta ba lngar ni mi bgrang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa ltar log shes tsam ste lta ba lngas ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan mtha' ste bsam gtan bzhi ba dang srid rtse na sa skal mnyam pa yod pa ma gtogs khams dang sa la dmigs pa gzhan med de/sa 'og mar mi dmigs shing / rang sar skal mnyam khams kyi ming med de/ de yod na khams gsum sa dgu zhes sa dgu 'dren pa bzhin du/ khams dgu zhes 'dren rgyu yod par thal ba'i phyir gsungs kyang / sdom tshig gi de ni mchims ṭīka mchan bu'i de bkod pa yin la/ de dang gang spel gnyis tshig zin mi mthun pas gang spel ltar bya'o/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /mchims sgyuka 'dod pa dang ldan gzugs gzugs med/ /dang ldan la 518

dmigs phra rgyas gang dag rtses/ /'byung myir gsungs kyang ma na bur gnyis bsdoms la/ /dmigs brad gsum brjoms pa la nus med gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ mchims ṭīka tu/ bstan bcos kyi lung drangs pa las/ res 'ga' ni skal ba mi mnyam pa'i khams gcig la dmigs so/ /res 'ga' ni gnyis lardzidamigs te/ 'dod pa ldan pa gzugs dang ldan pa la dmigs pa rnams dang / 'dod pa dang ldan pa/ gzugs med pa dang ldan pa la dmigs pa rnams dang 'dod pa dang ldan pa gzugs dang gzugs med pa dang ldan pa la dmigs pa'i phra rgyas gang dag yin pa/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs kyang /de'i 'og gi mchan bur 'dir skal ba mi mnyam pa'i khams gcig gam gnyis bsdoms pa la dmigs pa srid kyi gsum bsdoms pa la dmigs nus ni med do/ /zhes gsungs/ des na gong gi de/bstan bcos kyi lung drangs pa yin la/ 'og tu mchan bur gsungs pa ni/ gong gi bstan bcos kyi gsung tshul la zhib cha byar+sā/ pa yin nam snyam/ zhes pa de ni khams dgur mi 'thad pas na/ khams skal ba mi mnyam pa'i kun 'gro la rang dang skal ba mi mnyam pa'i khams gsum la dmigs pa mi srid kyang / rang dang skal ba mi mnyam pa'i sa gsum 4 dmigs pa yod ces pa'i 51mi

non yin par gsungs so/ / tsho phra rgyas kun tu 'gro dang rgyu kun 'gror/ /byu bzhi ma 'ongs phra rgyas kun 'gro dang / /da lta'i de yi 'dus byas mtshan nyid bzhi/ /'on kyang 'bras bu gzhan skyir thob ma gartogs/ /gnyis yin da lta'i phra rgyas kun 'gro'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ phra rgyas kun 'gro dang rgyu kun 'gro la mu bzhi yod de/ dang bo phra rgyas kun 'gro yin la/ rgyu kun 'gro ma yin pa ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i phra rgyas kun 'gro rnams dang / gnyis pa/ rgyu kun 'gro yin la phra rgyas kun 'gro ma yin pa ni/ 'das pa dang da ltar gyi phra rgyas kun 'gro dang lhan cig tu 'byung ba'i 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid bzhi sogs 'jog la/ 'on kyang dmigs bsal thob pa ni phra rgyas de dag dang rnam smen dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu mi gcig pa'i phyir/kun 'gror ma gtogs so/ /gsum pa/ gnyis ka yin pa ni/'das pa dang da ltar gyi phra rgyas kun 'gro rnams so/ /bzhi ba/gang yang ma yin pa ni/ de dag tu ma gtogs pa ma 'ongs pa'i lhan cig 'byung ba dang / thob pa la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar go brgyad las ni kun 'gro ba/ /kho na nyer bdun bablog pa re lnga ste/zhes gsungs te/ phra rgyas dgu bcu rtsa brgyad po de las/ kun 'gro kho na nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / bablog pa ste/ kun 'gro ma yin 520

pa drug cu rtsa lnga yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsag kun ma rig drug la cha gnyis so/ /'gog lam cal can log lta the tshom smongs/ /'gog dmigs gsutsho po rang sa kho nar dmigs/ /sa drug chos zhes kun kyang 'dod log lta'i/ /yul yin de bzhin sa dgu'i rjes shes kyang / /gzugs dang gzugs med kun gyi log lta'i yul/ /zhes gsungs te/ bden pa dang bo gnyis kyi spang bya ma rig pa drug la cha gnyis yod de/ dngos bye log zhugs dang / log zhugs la log zhugs gnyis yod/ dang bo ni kun— 'gro rnams bden pa dang bo gnyis kyi mtshan nyid dang 'gal bar zhugs pas/ dngos su log zhugs yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ kun 'gro ma yin pa rnams dngos po la dmigs kyang mtshan nyid dang mi 'gal bas dngos su log zhugs min kyang / log zhugs la log zhugs yin no/ /phra rgyas de dag las/ zag med 'gog lam la dmigs pa drug yod de/ 'gog pa mthong spang dang / lam mthong spang gi log lta gnyis dang / the tshom gnyis dang / bzhi bo de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa dang / 'ba' zhig pa ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa ste drug po ni/ zag med la dmigs pa yin la/ phra rgyas lhag ma rnams ni zag bcas la dmigs pa yin no/ /'gog pa la dmigs pa'i log lta/ the tshom/ ma rig pa 521

gsum po rang sa'i 'gog pa kho na la dmigasakyi sa gzhan gyi 'gog pa la dmigs pa min te/ 'dod pa na spyod pas log lta sogs kyis/ 'gog pa la sas bsdus med —kyang 'dod pa'i spang bya spangs pa'i sa de'i 'gog pa kho na la dmigs pa nas/ srid rtse'i bar du rang sa'i 'gog pa kho na la dmigs pa'i phyir/bsam gtan sa drug gis bsdus pa'i chos shes kyang 'dod pa'i log lta'i dmigs yul yin la de bzhin du zag med sa dgu'i rjes shes kyang gzugs dang gzugs med kun gyi log lta'i yul yin te/ lam la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa na spyod pa'i log lta sogs drug gi dmigs pa ni/ bsam gtan sa drug gi chos shes pa'i phyogs dang —mthun pa'i khams gsum gyi gnyen po'i lam thams cad yin te/ sa drug gi lam ni phan tshun gyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar lam ni phan tshun rgyu yin pas/ /zhes gsungs/mtha' dpyod las/ 'di bye smra'i grub mtha' tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lam la chos shes khams gsum gnyen gsungs kyang / /gong ma'i log lta'i dmigs yul ma yin te/ /gong ma'i mthong spang gnyen po mi byed phyir/ /lhag ma phra rgyas brgyad cus zag bcas dmigs/ /zhes gsungs te/ lam chos shes de khams gsum gyi log lta sogs kyi gnyen po yin gsungs kyang / 522—

lami chos shes gong ma'i log lta'i dmigs yul ma yin te/ sdug kun gyi chos shes pa de nyid/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi mthong spang gi gnyen po ma yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar khams gsum gyi phra rgyas bco brgyad zag med la dmigs par bshad pas/ lhag ma phra rgyas brgyad cu ni zag bcas la dmigs par bstan par 'gyur ro /lung bstan min rtsa'i zhes rab rnam smin sogs/ /the tshom rtse gnyis nga rgyal mthor 'anug pa/ /rtsa ba brtan cing gting na gnas gyir min/ /zhes gsungs te/ dang bo/ mi dase/ ba'i rtsa ba gsum ni/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ lung ma bstan ma yin pa'i ma rig pa dang gsum po de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/lung ma bstan gyi rtsa ba gsum yod de/ sred pa dang / ma rig pa dang / blo shes rab rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan the tshom dang nga rgyal gnyis rtsa ba min te/ the tshom ni yul rnam pa gnyis su 'jug nga rgyal ni mthon por 'jug pa'i phyir dang /rtsa ba ni brtan cing gting na gnas pa dgos stabs/ de gnyis rtsa ba dang chos mi mthun pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba min no/ /zhes kha che bye brag tu smra ba 'dod do/ /kha sdo'i sul sogs mthar gnas nyi 'og pa/ /sred lta nga rgyal spyad pa'i bsam gtan pa/ /gsum 523

po ma rig dbang gis 'anug pyir bzhi/ /zhes gsungs te/ kha che'i yul lam rgya gar yul gyi mthar gnas pa'i bye brag smra ba la/ bye brag smra ba nyi 'og pa zhes bya la/ de 'dra'i nyi 'og pa dag na re/lung ma bstan gyi rtsa ba bzhi yod de/ lung ma bstan de dag kyang yin pa'i sred pa dang / lta ba dang / nga rgyal dang / rmongs pa dag yin pa'i phyir te/ sred pa dang / lta ba dang / nga rgyal shas che ba'i bsam gtan pa gsum dag kyang ma rig pa'i dbang gis der 'gyurardziba'i phyir/ dus kun mi skye yul yang khyad par phyir/ /khong khro chags rgyal ston mongs rang mtshan pa/ /lta dang ma rig the tshom sbyi ba 'o/ /'das dang da lta'i khro chags nga rgyal gyi/ /dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ldan byed rgyud ldan min/ /zhes gsungs te/ nyon mongs la rang gi mtshan nyid pa'i nyon mongs dang / nyon mongs spyi ba zhes bya ba gnyis las/ 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal gsum ni rang gi mtshan nyid pa'i nyon mongs zhes bya ste/ yul sdug pa dang mi sdug pa mthong ba la dmigs nas 'dod chags dang khong khro nga rgyal gsugaso sor yin gyi/ yul thams cad la dmigs nas skye ba min zhing / dus thams cad du'ang skye ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa dang / the tshom dang / nyon mongs can gyi lta ba ni/ nyon 524

mongs spyi ba zhes bya ba yin te/ zag bcas kyi phung bo thams cad la dmigs nas dus thams cad du skye ba'i phyir/ 'das pa dang da lta bar nye bar gnas pa'i 'dod chags dang / khong khro dang / nga rgyal dag gis ni/ khyod ma spangs pa'i gang zag la/dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ldan par byed pa yin gyi/ yul gyi thob pa dang ldan pa ma yin te/ 'gog pa gnyis ma gtogs pa/ rgyud du ma gtogs pa la 7thob pa dang ldan pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /ma 'ongs yid kun dbang bos da lta ba/ /'on kyang mi skye dbang blos kun ldan byed/ /lhag ma lta sogs gsum gyis kun dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs te/ yid shes 'khor gyi dug gsum po de dag ma 'ongs pa'i dug gsum kun dang ldan te/ yid ni dus gsum gyi yul can yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan dbang shes 'khor gyi nyon mongs de dag rang dus da lta ba dang ldan te/ de dag dbang shes da lta ba'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang / dbang shes mi skye ba'i chos can rnams kyis dus gsum po thams cad dang ldan par byed de/ de yul dus gsum la dmigs pa srid pa'i phyir/lhag ma lta ba dang / the tshom/ ma rig pa kun gyi yul dus gsum po kun dang ldan te/ de gsum yul dus gsum ga la dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /525

dus kun snas yod rtag 'thur yod min na/ /ldan par 'gal zhes rtsod la bye zas lan/ /mardo las 'das gzugs yod par ma gyur na/ /zhes dang rnam shes gnyis rten rkye gsungs phyir/ /rigs pas 'grub ste dran pa'i cal yod dzir/ /'das pa'i las kyis 'bras bu skyed pa'i pyir/ /zhes gsunges te/ kho na re/dus gsum rdzas su yod dam med/ yod na rtag tu yod pas 'du byed rtag pa'i rdzas su 'gyur/ med na de dang ldan pa'am/des ldan pa 'gal lo/ /zhe na/ bye smras lan btab pa ni/dus gsum rdzas yod du grub ste/ — de la lung gi sgrub byed dang /rigs pa'i sgrub byed gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ dus gsum po ni rnam pa kun tu rdzas su yod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gal te 'das pa'i gzugs shig yod par ma gyur na 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'das pa'i gzugs la mi lta bar mi 'gyur ba zhig na/ gang gi phyir 'das pa'i gzugs yod pa de'i phyir/ 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'das pa'i gzugs la mi lta ba yin no/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa la'ang sbyar nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang lung las/ rnam par shes pa ni gnyis la brten nas skye'o zhes gsungs pa'i gnyis gang zhe na/ mig dang gzugs rnams 526

nas/ yid dang chos kyi bar yen te/ 'das ma 'ongs pa'i gzugs rdzas su med na/ de gnyis la dmigs pa'i rnam par shes pa dag gnyis la brten par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ rigs pa'i sgrub byed yod de/ 'das ma 'ongs rdzas su yod de/ de gnyis la dmigs pa'i rnam shes kyi yul yod pa'i phyir/ las 'gags nas yun ring du lon pa las 'bras bu 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ thams cad yod par smra bas yod ji ba/ /'bras bu 'das dang ma phyin da ltar yod/ /'azas phyin 'das dang ma 'ongs dzis med par/ /smra ba rnam par sge ste smra ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ des na bye brag smra bas 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar ba thams cad rdzas su yod par smra ba de dag ni/ thams cad yod par smra ba yin la/ gang da ltar ba dang 'bras bu ma skyes pa'i las 'das pa gang yin rdzas gub dang / ma 'ongs pa dang 'bras bu bskyed zin 'das pa gang yin rdzas su med par phye nas smra ba'i gang zag rnam par phye ste smra ba yin no/ /de yang yod smra'i grangs yin dul ba lhas/ /gzhi kun pa dang 'od srung sde/ /sa srung sde dang chos srung sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phyi ste smra ba'i sde/ /thams cad mod par smra ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong gi 527

rnam par phye ste smra ba de yang yod par smra ba'i grangs yin/ yod par smra ba'i grangs sdom dul ba lhas mdzad pa las/ gzhi kun pa dang / zhes pa nas/ rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde/ /thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs yod smra la yang lugs bzhi ste/ /chos skyob darngos 'gyur gser snod bzhin zhes zer/ /dbyangs sgrogs mtshan nyid shas che chagos bzhin zer/ /dbyig bshes gnas skabs rtsis kyi ge'u bzhin 'gyur/ /ma bu gzhan gzhan 'gyur ba sangs rgyas lha/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba de lu yang / bzhi yod de/ dang bo/ btsun pa chos skyob na re/ myu gu lta bu ma 'ongs pa nas da ltar ba dang / da ltar ba nas 'das par 'jug pa'i tshe rdzas gzhan du mi 'gyur yang dngos po gzhan du 'gyur bar khas len pa'i phyir/ dper na gser snod bcos nas rgyan byas tshe/ mdog mi 'gyur yang dbyibs gzhan du 'gyur ba dang /'o ma zhor gyur tshe ro nus 'gyur yang kha dog gzhan du mi 'gyur bangabazhin zhes 'dod do/ /gnyis pa/ btsun pa dbyangs sgrogs na re/ myu gu de ltar 'jug pa'i tshe/ myu gu de dus gsum char ldan yang mtshan nyid gang shas che ba'i sgos 'jog pas mtshan nyid gzhan du 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na/ mi de bud med cig la 528

chags tshe bud med gzhan la chags bral ma yin kyang bud med de la chags zhes pa bzhin no zer/ gsum pa/ btsun pa dbyig bshes na re/ de ltar 'jug pa'i tshe/ bya ba ma skyes pa ma 'ongs pa dang / bya ba skyes shing ma 'gags pa da ltar ba dang / bya ba zhig pa la 'das par 'jog pas/ gnas skabs gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na/ rtsis kyi rde'u gcig gcig dang brgya dang stong la sogs pa'i gnas so sor bzhag na gcig dang brgya ba sogs su khas len pa bzhin zhes 'dod pa'i phyir/bzhi ba/ btsun pa sangs rgyas lha na re/ des de ltar 'jug tshe/ snga phyi bar gsum la ltos te rim pas 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ba zhes 'jog pas gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur bar 'dod snapa'i phyir/ dber na/ bud med cig rang gi ma la ltos nas bu mo dang rang gi bu mor ltos nas mar 'jog pa bzhin zhes 'dod do/ /dang bo mi 'bad grangs can lugs phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mi 'thad mtshan nyid 'chol phyir ro/ /bzhi ba mi 'thad gsum gar thal phyir ro/ /gsum pas bya ba byas dang ma byas kyis/ /bzhag phyir cung bzang / /zhes gsungs te/ 'dod pa dang bo mi 'thad de/ grangs can gyi 'gyur ba de 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa gnyis pa yang mi 'thad de/ mtshan nyid 'chol 529

ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyiwa/ 'dod pa bzhi ba yang mi 'thad de/de ltar na dus re re yang dus gsum char du thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa gsum pa btsun pa dbyig bshes kyi lugs de cung zad bzang ste/ bya ba mi byed pa na ma 'ongs pa dang /byed pa da ltar ba dang / byas nas 'gags pa 'das pa dang gsum po de yis dus gsum po rnams rnam par bzhag pa'i phyir/ de la rtsod pa ne/ /de mtshungs mig gis gzugs la mi lta phyir/ /da ltar mi 'gyur(jo)zhe na bye smras ni/ /skyon med 'bras bu 'byin 'dzin byed phyir lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ gsum pa de cung zad bzang yang / de la'ang skyon yod de/tsho de la rtsod pa ni/ da ltar ba'i mig dbang de mtshungs chos can/ da ltar ba ma yin par thal/ 'bras bu bskyed pa'i bya ba mi byed pa'i phyir te/ gzugs la mi lta ba'i phyir/ des na da ltar bar mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ bye smra na re skyon med de 'bras bu 'byin 'dzin gyi bya ba byed pa'i phyir da ltar bar 'jog go zhes zer lo/ /rnam smin skal mnyam kun 'gro 'das pas kyang / /'byin phyir da ltar thal lo de dag la/ /'dzin pa ma tshang zhe na 'ji'i cha nas/ /'das dang 'byin pa'i cha nas da lta bar/ /'gyur dzir 'chol ba'am yang na sged kar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'o na/ 'das pa'i skal mnyam 530

dang kun 'gro dang rnam smin gyi rgyu de dag chos can/ da ltar par thal/ da ltar 'bras bu 'byin pa'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ ma khyab ste/ de dag la 'bras bu 'dzin pa ma tshang ba'i phyir zhe na/ 'dzin pa ma tshang ba 'di'i cha nas 'das pa dang / 'bras bu 'byin pa'i cha nas da ltar bar 'gyur la/ de ltar na 'chol —bar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na phyed ka 'das pa dang phyed ka da ltar bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bya ba res byed res mi byed/ /mi rung rtag tu yod phyir gegs byed su/ /zhes gsungasad+nghate/ gzhan yang / dus gsum chos can/ da ltar bya ba res 'ga' byed la res 'ga' mi byed pa ni mi rung ste/ rtag tu ngo bo nyid kyi yod—par khas blangs yod stabs/ gegs byed pa su zhig yod de su yang med pa'i phyir/ de yang ji ltar bya bas 'jog ces pa'i/ / bya ba 'das pa las ji gzhan min te/ /dus kyis ma brtsas phyir na rtag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang ji ltar bya ba'i sgo nas 'jog ces pa'i bya ba 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba zhes bya ba yang gzhan zhig yod ba ma yin te/ bya ba mi byed pa'i tshe na/ dus gsum gyis ma bsdus pa'i phyir na/ 'dus ma byas rtag par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bya ba 'das dang gcig na da ltar lang / /yod sbyir —de 'gag cha nas 'das dus su/ /mi 53 1

rung da ltar bzhin du dus gnyis kyang / /yod na ci phyir ma skyes zhig rtses bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ kho na re/ gal te chos las bya ba gzhan yin na skyon de ltar 'gyur yang skyon de ltar mi 'gyur bar thal/ bya ba de ni chos de las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na bya ba de 'das pa dang gcig yin na/ da ltar ba la yang bya ba yod pas bya ba dang gcig yin dgos la da ltar ba de 'gag pa'i cha nas 'das pa'i dus su mi rung zhing / da ltar ba bzhin du 'das ma 'ongs gnyis la'ang ma skyes pa dang zhig pa gnyis kyang yod na/ ci'i phyir ma skyes pa zhig ma 'ongs pa yin zhes smra bar byed/ ces pa'o/ /bye smra na re/ mdo sde ba'i rtsod pa de rnams kho bo cag la mi 'jug ste/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes pa dang 'das pa zhig pa sogs 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad kyi chos nyid de ngo bo nyid dag ni zab pa dang phra ba'i rtogs dka' ba yin pas rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir zer te/ chos nyid dag ni zab pa yin/ zhes so/ /ngo bo spangs kyang skug bsngal mthong spang dang / /'dod ston brgyad sogs dmigs bas ldan tshul gnyis/ /khams gsum spang bya brtso lnga zag med bcas/ /'og ma 'og ma'i mthong spang kun 'gro'i yul/ /'og ma gong ma'i nyon mongs yul min pas/ /532

sgom spang yul 'gyur snyoms 'jug dag pa'i ste/ /bsam gtan dge yul yod dgu yin gsungs phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/spang bya de dang bral na spangs pas khyab kyang spangs na bral bas ma khyab ste/ spang bya de'i ngo bo spangs kyang dmigs pa'i sgo nas ldan pa yod de/ sdug bsngal mthong spang kun spangs kyang kun 'gro lhag ma kun 'byung mthong spang ma spangs pa'i tshe na/ kun 'byung mthong spang rnams kyi dmigs pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal mthong spang de dag dang ldan pa yin la/ de bzhin du mthong spangaskun la rigs 'dra ste/ 'dod pa'i lam mthong spang gi—'dod nyon brgyad sogs ma spangs par ldan tshul dang dmigs —pa'i ldan tshul gnyis yod de/ rang 'grel las/ re zhig—gang dang bral na des ngo bo de spangs pa ni yin no/ /spangs lardzide dang ma bral ba yang yod de/ zhes so/ /chos bcu drug las gang zhig gang gi yul yin pa dpyad pa la/ spyir chos de la bcu drug yod de/ khams gsum so so na sdug bsngal mthong spang sogs mthong spang bzhi dang sgom spang ste spang bya ris lnga lnga yod pas bco lnga dang zag med bcas bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/de dag gi yul la dmigs pa'i sems bcu drug yod de/ khams gsum gyi bden bzhi'i mthong spang bzhi dang sgom spang dang bcas 533

spang bya ris lnga la dmigs pa'i sems bco lnga dang / zag med kyi sems gcig ste bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod khams kyi spang bya ris lnga ni/ rnam shes lnga'i spyod yul yin te/ 'dod pa rang gi sas bsdus kyi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung mthong spang gnyis dang 'dod pa'i sgom spang ste rang sa'i gsum dang /gzugs su gtogs pa'i sgom spang gcig dang / dri med chos shes phyogs kyi rnam shes rnams kyi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir/ khacha/sa 'og ma'i spang bya ris lnga rnams 'og ma rang gi mthong spang kun 'bro'i yul yin gyi/ 'og ma gong ma'i nyon mongs kyi yul min pas/ 'dod pa'i spang bya la dmigs pa'i gzugs su gtogs pa'i sgom spang gcig po ni/ 'dod pa'i sgom spang gi yul du 'gyur ba'i snyoms 'jug dag pa ba yin pa ste/ bsam gtan dge yul yod dgu yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsab/ bsngal mthong spang lam mthong spang bya'i yul/ /min te lam la kun 'gro med phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ sdug bsngal mthong spang rnams ni/ lam mthong spang gi spang bya'i yul min te/ lam mthong spang la kun tu 'gro ba'i nyon mongs med pas/ kun 'gro ma yin pa dag gis sdug bsngal mthong spang la mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsag kun mthong dang sgom spang gsum/ /'dod 534tre

bskusacelnga chul gzhan brgyad bcu/ /zhes gsungs te/ sdug kun mthong spang dang sgom spang ste gsum po 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa rnams mi sems lnga'i yul du gyur pa gong du bshad pa ltar la/gzhan gzugs khams las skyes pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang dang kun 'byung mthong spang dang sgom spang gsum po rnams ni sems brgyad kyi dmigs pa yin te/ rang sa'i sdug kun mthong spang gi sems gnyis dang / sgom spang gi sems gcig ste sems gsum dang / 'og ma'i skal ba mi mnyam pa'i kun 'gro dang / de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems zhes gcig dang / de la dmigs pa'i sgom spang gi sems dge ba thos bsam gyi 'dun pa dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa ste 'og ma'isems gsum dang / gong ma gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs kyis bsdus pa'i sgom spang gcig dang / dri med kyi sems gcig dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med na spyod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang dang / kun 'byung mthong spang dang / sgom spang dang rigs gsum ni rnam shes bcu'i spyod yul te/ 'dod pa sogs khams gsum du gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung mthong spang gnyis dang / sgom spang ste gsum re yod pas dgu dang / zag med rjes shes phyogs kyi sems gcig dang bcu'i spyo da yul yin pa'i 535

phyir/ khams gsum 'gog lam mthong spang ne/ /rang bsnan drug dgu bcu gcig yul/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams gsum gyi 'gog pa dang / lam mthong bas spang bar bya ba gnyis ni/'dod par rnam shes drug dang / gzugs khams su dgu dang / gzugs med du bcu gcig gi spyod yul yin te/ 'dod par sngar bshad pa'i sems lnga'i steng du 'gog lam rang gi sems glags pa ste bsnan pas rnam shes drug dang / gzugs khams su sngar bshad pa'i sems brgyad kyi steng du 'gog lam rang rang gi sems glags pa'am bsnan pas dgu dang / gzugs med du sngar gyi bcu'i steng du 'gog lam mthong spang rang rang gi sems glags pa ste bsnan pas sems bcu gcig gi spyod yul yin te/rtsa bar/ 'gog dang lam mthong spang bya kun/ /rang gi glags pa'i spyod yul lo/ /zhes so/ /chags sogs snon gyi zag med pa/ /kho na'i yul can la sogs min/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang sa'i 'gog lam mthong spang snon pa ni/ 'dod chags sogs zag bcas kyi yul du gyur pa dag sdon gyi/ zag med kho na'i yul can la sogs pa snon pa min gsungs so/ /zag med khams gsum spang bya ris/ /tha ma gsum gsum zag med bcu'i/ /lul lo 'dod pā'i sgom spang dbyad/ /ces gsungs te/ zag 5 36

med ni rnam shes bcu'i spyod yul yin te/ khams gsum gyi spang bya rigs lnga'i tha ma 'gog pa dang lam mthong spang gnyis dang /sgom spang ste gsum gsum dang / zag med kyi sems dang bcus dmigs pa'am spyod yul yin zhes 'dod de/ sgom spang gi spyod yul la zag med 'jog pa dpyad dgos te/ sgom spang skor dgu'i dmigs yul la zag bcas las zag med yong tshul med dam snyam mo/ / phra rgyas bcas la rgyas pas khrab bam na/ /nyon mongs can la bcas ging rgyas pa dang / /bcas kyang mi rgyas pa ce byu gnyis yod/ /spangs dang ma spangs phra rgyas rim bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te/phra rgyas dang bcas pa'i sems yin na/ de la phra rgyas de rgyas par 'gyur bas khyab bam zhe na/ sems nyon mongs can de la phra rgyas dang bcas shing rgyas pa dang / bcas kyang mi rgyas pa ste mu gnyis yod de/ ma spangs pa'i nyon mongs can de la bcas shing rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / spangs pa'i nyon mongs can de la bcas shing mi rgyas pa yin no/ /sems nyon mongs can gyi phra rgyas la gnyis yod de/ mtshungs ldan sgo nas dang / mtshungs ldan ma yin kyang dmigs pa'i sgos rgyas par 'gyur ba gnyis yod/ nyon mongs ma spangs pa dang mtshungs ldan rnams dmigs pa dang /537

mtshungs ldan gnyis ka'i sgos rgyas par 'gyur la/ 'phags pa 'ga' zhig la nyon mongs spangs kyang dmigs pa'i ma spangs pas rgyas par 'gyurab dang de dang bcas par 'jog pa yin no/ /ston mongs can min la ni sbya ma med/ /yig char nyon mongs bcas la mi rgyas yod/ /dgra brtsom rnams la 'das sems nyon mongs can/ /nyon mongs pa dang lhan cig gnas rnams dang / /ma 'ongs mi skye'i chos can bems nyon mongs/ /dang bcas lta bu yin pa'i phyir gsungs dbyad/ /ces gsungs te/ sems nyon mongs can ma yin pa la phyi ma bcas shing mi rgyas pa med de/ nyon mongs spangs zin pa ni rgyas par mi 'gyur bas/ phra rgyas dang bcas pa med de/ de dang lhan cig spyang med la dmigs ba'i sgos kyang spangs zin pa'i phyir/ yig cha mtha' dbyod las/sems nyon mongs dang bcas la mi rgyas pa yod de/ dgra bcom rnams la 'das pa'i sems nyon mongs can dang lhan cig gnas pa rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa mi skye ba'i chos can gyi sems nyon mongs dang bcas pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa la dpyad dgos gsungs pa/ mchims mdzod las/ mi rgyas kyang phra rgyas dang bcas par 'jog pa ni sngar ma spangs pa'i dus na rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bye brag smra ba zerme te/ 'di ni dus 538

gsum spos su grub paṭ+wāṃ grub mtha' 'khrul ba la 'khrul ba 'jus pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /nyon mongs rnams skye ba'i go rim ni/ rtsa ba las/ rmongs las the tshom de nas ni/ /log lta de nas 'jig tshogs lta/ /de nas mthar 'dzin de nas ni/ /tshul khrims mchog 'dzin de nas lta/ /rang gi lta la nga rgyal chags/ /gzhan la zhe sdang de ltar rim/ /zhes pa ltar nyonatshumongs phra rgyas rnams skye ba'i go rim phal che ba dang srid tshad kyi rim pa rnams kyi 'grel tshul mtha' dpyod du shin tu gsal ba dag sdom 'dir bsdus med la/ nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu ni/ rtsa ba las/ dze rgyas spangs pa ma yin dang / /yu'/ ni nye bar gnas pa dang / /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las/ /nyon mongs rgyu ni tshang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu dang yul dang sbyor ba gsum las skye ste/ phra rgyas ma spangs pa rgyu'i stobs dang /nyon mongs skye ba'i yul nye bar gnas pa yul gyi stobs dang /tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa sbyor ba'i stobs te gsum tshogs pa las skye ba'i phyir/ res 'ga' yul gyi stobs kho nas skye yi rgyu'i stobs kyis ni min te/ dper na dgra bcom pa yongs su nyams pa'i chos can lta bye'o/ /zhes bye smras zer ro/ /'dod na ris lngazhi gti skug lnga ma gtogs/ /khro chags nga rgyal 539

gsum la lnga lnga dang / /rta ba bcu gnyis tshom bzhi kun dkris/ /bcu ste zhe gcig 'ardod pa'i zag pa dang / /zhes gsungs te/rnam grangs bshad pa la/ mdo las gsungs pa'i rnam grangs dang / bstan bcos las gsungs pa'i rnams grangs gnyis las/ dang bo la/ zag pa/ chu sbyor/ nyer len/ de dag gi nges pa bzhi/ dang bo zag pa la/ 'dod pa'i zag pa dang /srid pa'i zag pa dang / ma rig pa'i zag pa gsum yod/ dang bo/ 'dod pa na spang bya ris lnga'i gti mug ma gtogs pa'i khong khro/ 'dod chags/ nga rgyal gsum la spang bya ris lnga'i lnga lnga dang / lta ba bcu gnyis/ the tshom bzhi/ ngo tsha khrel med sogs kun dkris bcu ste zhe gcig po de dag ni 'dod pa'i zag pa yin no/ /kun dkris nyi tha khong khro bcu bsal ba'i/ /gong mar spyod pa nga gnyis zid pa'i zag 7/chugs rgod kun dkros gong mar yod mod kyang / /ma bshad rang dbang can gi min phyir lo/ /'dod pa' zugs rgod sogs la thal bar 'byur/ /zhes gsungs te/gnyis pa srid pa'i zag pa ni/ kun dkris nyi shu dang khong khro bcu bsal ba'i shul na/ khams gong mar spyod pa lnga bcu rtsa gnyis yod de/ lta ba bcu gnyis/ the tshom bzhi/ 'dod chags dang nga rgyal lnga lnga ste phra rgyas nyi shu rtsa drug yod pa/ gzugs 540

gzugs med gnyis ka bsdoms na lnga bcu rtsa gnyis po de ni/srid pa'i zag pa yin no/ /gong ma gnyis la srid pa'i zag pa zhes gcig tu byas pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de gnyis ka sgrib la lung ma bstan du 'dra ba dang / kha nang du bltas par 'dra ba dang /mnyam bzhag gi sa bar 'dra ba'i phyir/ de gnyis srid pa'i zag pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khaṭas gong ma gnyis po de srid pa yin gyi/ thar ba ma yin pas de don du gnyer ba yang srid pa don gnyer yin gyi/ thar ba don gnyer ma yin pa shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar/ thar ba'i 'du shes bzlog phyir bshad ces gsungs/ lnga bcu rtsa gnyis tsam zag pa yin pa mi 'thad de/ rmugs rgod kyi kun dkris khams gong ma gnyis lardzoyod de/ rab tu byed pa las/ srid pa'i zag pa gang zhe na/ma rige pa rnams ma gtogs pa de las gzhan pa gzugs dang gzugs med pa dang ldan pa'i kun tu sbyor ba/ 'ching ba dang /phra rgyas dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / kun nas dkris pa gang dag yin pa'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ kha che ba rnams na re/ khams gong ma'i rmugs rgod gnyis 'dod chags la sogs pa dang mtshungs par ldan pas rang dbang can ma yin pa'i phyir ma bshad do/ /zhes zer ro/ /gal te de lta na 541

'dod pa'i ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pa dang rmugs rgod rnams kyang 'dod pa'i zag pa ma yin par 'gyur te/ 'dod chags la sogs pa dang mtshungs par ldan pas rang dbang can ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir rang gi 'jug pa shas chung bas rang dbang can ma yin par 'dod kyi chags sogs dang mtshungs par ldan pas rang dbang can ma yin pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes bye smras 'dod do gsungs/ khams gsum ma rig bco lnga logs su bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma rig pa'i zag pa yod de/ khams gsum gyi ma rig pa lnga lnga ste/ bco lnga bo thams cad ma rig pa'i zag pa yin la/ ma rig pa'i zag pa logs shig tu zag par bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ma rig pa zag pa gzhan thams cad kyi yang rtsa ba yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bstan nas spong ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/chu spyor phal cher de dang 'dra na yang / /lta rnams rnam glegasal phyir logs su bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ chu sbyor phal cher gong du bshad pa'i zag pa de dag dang 'dra na'ang lta ba rnams lta ba'i chu bo zhes logs shig tu bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ lta ba rnams dmigs rnam gsal bas de ltar logs su bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes ston par/ rtsa ba las/ chu bo sbyor ba'ang de 542

bzhin du/ /lta rnams gsal phyir logs shig bstan/ /zagartsopar ma yin grogs med rnams/ /'jog pa'i rjes su mi mthunaholo/ /zhes lta ba rnams lta ba'i chu bo zhes logs su bstan pa dang / lta ba rnams zag par ma bstan pa ni/ de rnams ma rig pa'i grogs med par 'khor bar 'jog pa'i rjes su mi mthun pa'i phyir gsungs/ lo sgra'i don/ slob dpon mi 'dod cing / de ltar na ma rig pa yang bstan pa dang / mi gsal ba chu bo dang sbyor bar logs shig tu mi ston par 'gyur zhes gang spel las bshad do/ /de sbyir 'dod pa'i chu spyor nyer dgu re/ /zid spyor nyer brgyad lta ba'i sum cu drugo /ma rig brtso lnga'o zag bar lta ba rnams/ /zurasna gin rkyang bas 'khor bar 'arjog min lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar lta ba'i chu bo logs su bshad pa de'i phyir na/ chu bo labazhi yod de/ 'dod pa'i chu bo dang / srid pa'i chu bo dang / lta ba'i chu bo dang / ma rig pa'i chu bo dang bzhi yod/ sbyor ba la'ang bzhi yod de/ 'dod pa'i sbyor ba dang /srid pa'i sbyor ba dang / lta ba'i sbyor ba dang / ma rig pa'i sbyor ba dang bzhi yod/ 'dod pa'i chu bo dang sbyor ba nyer dgu re yod/ srid pa'i chu sbyor nyer brgyad/ lta ba'i chu sbyor sum cu rtsa drug re dang/ ma rig pa'i chu sbyocha bco lnga yod la/543

lta ba rnams zur du zag par mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan/ lta ba rkyang bas 'khor bar 'jog pa'i rjes su mi mthun no zhes zer lo/dang bo 'dod pa'i chu bo dang sbyor ba nyer dgu yod de/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal bco lnga dang / the tshom bzhi dang / kun dkris bcu yod pa'i phyir/ srid pa'i chu sbyor nyer brgyad yod de/ gzugs gzugs med kyi 'dod chags dang nga rgyal bcu bcu ste nyi shu dang / the tshom bzhi bzhi ste nyer brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ lta ba'i chu sbyor sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ khams gsum na lta ba bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa'i chu sbyor bco lnga yod de khams gsum po re re la lnga lnga yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod rgyu ra ma rig lnga bcas 'dod nyer len/ /srid spyor ma rig bcu bcas bdag nyer len/ /lta ba sum cu brtul khyags nyeng len drug /rab byung khyim pa bslu phyir so sor bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ nyer len la bzhi yod de/ 'dod pa'i sbyor ba nyer dgu ma rig pa lnga dang bcas pa sum cu rtsa bzhi kho na 'dod pa nyer len dang / srid pa'i sbyor ba nyer brgyad ma rig pa ba/ cu dang bcas pa sum cu rtsa brgyad bdag tu lta ba nyer bar len pa dang / lta ba'i sbyor ba so drug las tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin drug phyung ba'i lhag ma sum cu lta ba nyer len dang /544

tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin drug tshul khrims brtul zhugs nyer len yin pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gnyis lta ba nyer len las zur du phyung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ grangs can gyi rnal 'byor shes pa dang me lnga brten pa sogs phyi rol ba'i lam tsam gyis thar ba thob par 'dzin pas lam gyi dgra'am gegs yin pa'i phyir/ 'asdes zas mi za ba dang me dang chur 'jug pa dang mi smra ba dang dpa' bo rtebyed pas khyim pa rnams 'di phyir phung bas bslus/ yul yid du 'ongs pa dang dga' ba spong zhing / sa la nyal ba dri ma dang 'dam rdzab sbrel ba sogs kyis dag par yid ches pas rab byung ba rnams dgos don la bslu ba'i phyir/ de'i phyir 'di gnyis lta ba las so sor bshad do/ /ma rig rkyang bas mi 'dzin phyir bgres lo/ /rang lugs gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang byas yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma rig pa 'dod pa nyer len dang bdag tu smra ba nyer len gnyis su bsres nas ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bye smras/ma rig pa rkyang bas rang dbang du mi 'dzin zhing / de 'ba' zhig gis srid pa nye bar len par mi byed pas/ de gnyis/ su bsres/lo zhes pa ma rangs pa'i tshig ste/ slob dpon rang lugs ni/'dun pa'i 'dod chags kho na nyer len yin pas/ 'dod chags 545

kyis dngos su4ldokhor ra sbyorad+ku dngartadzibaralenapa'i phyir /gdul byas de ltar shes dgoshasastabs gdu 'jibya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis gsungs parobazhedazudo/ / rtsa nyon drug gi kun spyor drugasha sa/ /mchog 'dzin gnyis po mchog 'dzin kun rdzorajo/ /n+ta ba snga gsum bden bzhitshomathong spang rdzas/ /brtso brgyad 'a3ra lang brtso brgyad phyir gye lo/ 'di gnyis khor mchog 'dzin zir sge'o/ /zhes gsungs te/kun sbyor dgu yod de/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ lta ba/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ the tshom/ phrag dogaser sna ste dgu yod/ kun sbyor dgu so sor dbye na kun sbyor rigs bzhi yod de/ rtsa nyon gyi kun sbyor/ lta ba'i kun sbyor/mchog 'dzin gyi kun sbyor/ kun dkris kyi kun sbyor dang bzhi yod/ 'dir rtsa nyon drug gi kun sbyor drug las logs su mchog 'dzin gnyis po la/ mchog 'dzin kun sbyor zhes sbyor ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan lta ba snga ma gsum ste 'jig lta mthar lta log lta gsum yang khams gsum na drug drug ste rdzas bco brgyad yod de/bden bzhi'i mthong spang gi rdzas la sbyar na 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang gi lta ba dang bo gnyis dang / de bzhin khams gong ma gnyis kyi yang sdug bsngal mthong spang gi lta ba dang bo gnyis 546

gnyis yod pas drug dngabyu/ khamasagasulogyi bdertswabazhichamathong spang gi log lta bzhi bzhi stetrebazhi gsugabacu gnyis pod pa'i khar gong gi drug bzhag pas rdzas bco brgyad la/ de bzhin du 'dir mchog 'dzin ga nyis la'ang khams gsum na rdzas drug drug yod pas rdzos bco brgyad par mnyam pas phyir logs su phye ba yin zhes bye smras zer/ lo zhes pa ni slob dpon gyi 'dod pa logs su yod par ston te/ slob dpon gyis ltab phyi ma gnyis ni rim pa ltar lta ngan la mchog tu sgro 'dogs pa dang / lta ngan dang 'brel ba'i brtul zhugs la 'dag grol nges 'byin du lta bas na dang bo gsum yul dang / phyi ma gnyis yul can yin pa'i don gyis kun sbyor gnyis su bgrang bar bzhed do/ /bstan bcos las bshad pa'i rnam grangs dag ni mtha' dpyod du gsal lo/ /kun dkris nang nas phrag dog ser sna gnyis/ /mi dge rang dbang can phyir kun spyor byas/ /kun dkris bcur smras kun spyor bcu gcig 'byur/ /spyor dgus gang la bsgribasapa dbus mthar gsal/ /zhes gsungs te/ ngo tsha med pa dang /khrel med pa dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna dang / rgod pa dang / 'gyod pa dang / rmugs pa dang / gnyid de kun dkris brgyad kyi nang nas phrag dog dang ser sna gnyis logs shig tu 547

kun sbyor gnyis su bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gnyis ka mtha' gcig tu mi dge ba yin pa dang nye nyon rang dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ kun dkris gzhan pa dag ni de lta ma yin te/ ngo tsha med pa dang khril med pa gnyis gcig tu mi dge ba yin kyang chags sogs dang mtshu ngas ldan yin pas rang dbang can min pa dang / 'gyod pa rang dbang can yin kyang gcig tu mi dge ba ma yin te/ de la dge ba yod pa'i phyir/ rmugs rgod gnyis dang gnyid ni gcig tu mi dge ba ma yin zhing / rang dbang can yang ma yin no/ /zhes bye smra kha cig zer/ gzhan dag na re/ bye brag smra bas/ kun dkris brgyad kyi steng du khro ba dang 'chab pa gnyis bsnan pas kun dkris bcure 'dod la/ de ltar na khro ba dang 'chab pa gnyis kyang mi dge ba rang dbang can yin pas kun tu sbyor bar 'chad par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer/ de la khro 'chab gnyis de ltar yin kyang / 'di kun dkris brgyad kyi skabs yin pa'i phyir te/ bcomaldan 'das kyis kyang ko'u shi ka lha dang mi rnams ni phrag dog dang ser sna'i kun tu sbyor ba can yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /bye brag smra bas kun dkris brgyad kyi steng du khro 'chab gnyis bsnan te bcur byed pa ltar na/ kun sbyor dgu'i steng du'ang de gnyis bsnan te 548

kun sbyor bcu gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /kun sbyor dgus gang la bsgribs pa ni dbus mthar gsal ba yin te/ dbus mtha' las/ skyo ba dang ni btang snyoms dang / /de kho na ni mthong ba dang / /'jig tshogs lta dang de'i gzhi dang / /'gog dang lam dang dkon mchog dang / /rnyed pa dang ni bkur bsti dang / /yo byad bsnyungs pa yongs shes la/ /sgrib pa yin no/ /zhes nga/sungs te/ khams gsum la chags na skyo ba mi 'byung bas 'dod chags kun sbyor gyis skyo ba la sgrib pa dang / khong khro'i kun sbyor gyis btang snyoms lu sgrib pa dang / nga rgyal kun sbyor gyis 'jig lta yongs su shes pa la sgrib pa dang / ma rig pa'i kun sbyor gyis 'jig lta'i gzhi phung bo yongs su shes pa la sgrib pa dang / lta ba'i kun sbyor gyis 'gog pa yongs su shes pa la sgrib pa dang / mchog 'dzin kun sbyor gyis lam bden yongs su shes pa la sgrib pa dang / the tshom kun sbyor gyis dkon sachog gsum yongs su shes pa la sgrib pa dang / phrag dog kun sbyor gyis rnyed pa dang bkur bsnyi yongs su shes pa la sgrib pa dang / ser sna'i kun sbyor gyis yo byad bsnyungs pa yongs su shes pa la sgrib pa ste/ nyon mongs 'di dag yod na sdug bsngal gyi khyad par du ma dang kun tu sbyor bar byed pas na kun sbyor ro/ /549

dang bo gnyis3 de kho na nyid mthong ba'i sbyor ba la sgrib pa yin la/ lhag ma bdun mide khon nyid mthong ba la sgrib pa yin no//gnyis kyis sems can ba ma so skye dang / /gsum gyis khams mtha' 'dod las mi 'da' 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ tha ma'i cha mthun lnga ni/ 'jig lta dang / tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lnga ba dang / the tshom nyon mongs can dang /'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems dang lnga yod pa'i/'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems gnyis kyis sems can tha ma so skye las mi 'da' bar byed la/ gzhan gsum gyis khams tha ma 'dod pa las mi 'da' bar byed ces pa'o/ /'dod 'dun dang / gnod sems ni/ rang gi lta grub la chags pa dang / gzhan gyi lta grub la sdang ba shas che bas/ mthong spang shas che stabs byed las ni so skye las mi 'da' bar byed ces gsungs sam snyam la/ mtha' dpyod las/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod se mas gnyis kyis 'dod pa'i khams las mi 'da' la/ 'jig lta dang mchog lta dang the tshom nyon mongs can gsum gyis khams gong mar lan gcig skyes kyang slar 'dod par phyir zlog par byed pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rtar yang de ltar gsungs so/ /mchims 550

mdzod labe/ dang bo gsum gyis ni semaspocan gyi tha ma so ṣ+kadang / phyi ma gnyis kyis khams kyi tha dad pa'i khams las mirdzi'ada' la zhes gsungs pas dpyad par bya'o/ /yang na sdom gyis/ mchims mdzod kyi tshig don 'di dag bsdus pa yin kyang /gsum gyis sems can tha ma so skye dang / gnyis kyis khams mtha' 'dod las mi 'da' 'o/ /zhes yi ge cung zad nor ram gang yin dpyad par bya'o/ /'jig lta skug bsngal mthong spang sgo gcig la/ /tshul lugs sgo gnyis the tshom sgo bzhi ste/ /de de spangs pas gzhan spang rtogs phyir lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'o na rgyun zhugs kyis lta ba lnga the tshom dang drug spangs na/ ci'i phyir kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ste bstan zhe na/ de la bye smra'i lan ni/ de lta yin mod kyi gsum po 'dis ni mthong spang rnams kyi sgo bsdus pa'i phyir te/ 'jig lta ni spang bya'i sgo gcig pa ste sdug bsngal mthong spang yin la de spangs par ribastan pas/mthar lta spangs pa'ang shugs la go ste sgo gcig par 'dra ba'i phyir/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin ni sgo gnyis pa ste/ sdug bsngal mthong spang dang lam mthong spang yin pas sgo gnyis yin la/ the tshom ni sgo bzhi ba yin te/ bden bzhi'i mthong spang bzhi ba yin pas sgo bzhi ba yin la/ de spangs par 55ram̐

lastan pas log lta dang lta ba mchog 'dzin yang spangs par shugs la go ste/ sgo bzhi ba yin pa'i rnam pa 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /sgo de dang de dag spangs par bstan pas mthong spang gzhan dag spangs par rtogs thub pa'i phyir/ zhes 'ga' zhig zer/ lo sgra'i non rang lugs min pa'o/ /gzhan yang rim bzhin mthar lta lta mchog 'dzin/ /log lta'i rtsa ba yin phyir 'di gsum bshad / /ces gsungs te/ gzhan yang / der ma zad rtsa ba bsdus pa'i phyir te/ rim bzhin/ mthar lta ni 'jig lta'i rtsa ba can dang /lta ba mchog 'dzin ni/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi rtsa ba can dang / 'o ga lta ni the tshom gyi rtsa ba can yin pa'i phyir/ 'jig lta/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba/ the tshom 'di gsum bshad pa yin/ zhes bye brag smra ba zer ro/ /slob dpon gyi lan ni/ kun sbyor gsum spangs pa'i cha nas rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'jig rten na lam la 'gro mi 'dod pa dang / lam nor ba dang / lam la the tshom za ba gsum gyis lam de la 'gro ba'i gegs byed pa bzhin du/ 'jig ltas thar ba la skrag nas 'gro mi 'dod/ mchog lta gnyis kyis lam nor bar byed/ the tshom gyis thar lam la the tshom zos nas gegs byed pa'i phyir/ 'di slob 55phri

da porna deng mdo sde ba'i 'dod pa yin no/ /gong ma'i cho mthune lnga ni/ gzugs gzugs med kyi 'dod chags dang / rgod pa dang / nga rgyal dang / ma rig pa lnga'o/ /kyan btus 'ching gsum rtsag bsngal gsum la sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'ching ba gsum ni/ tshor ba bde ba las 'dod chags rgyas/ sdug bsngal las zhe sdang rgyas/ btang snyoms las gti mug rgyas la/ dug gsum thams cad 'ching ba yin pa'i phyir/ kun btus las/dug gsum gyis rim pa ltar 'gyur ba dang sdug bsngal dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum la 'ching bas na 'ching ba zhes bshad de/ sdug bsngal gsum la sbyar ro/ / nyon mongs las gzhan smos pa'i dgos ba ni/ /nyon mongs bra rgyas sam rtsa ston thams cad dang / /nye bar nyon mongs byed pas nye ston phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ nye nyon ni/ rtsa bar/ nyon mongs las gzhan nyon mongs can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyon mongs las gzhan smos pa'i dgos pa ni/ nyon mongs phra rgyas sam rtsa nyon thams cad dang nye bar nyon mongs par byed pas na nye ba'i nyon mongs zhes bshad pa'i phyir te/ rgyal sras ma las/ 'di dgal nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i dngos tre'am nyon mongs pa nye bar 'dug pa yod pas nye ba'i nyon mongs pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/553

kun dashritshobargyad nga lani khro 'chagabasnan/ /'acab pa chabs mongs gang las skye ba rtsod/ji /kun dkris brgyad dam bcu las lnga la gi/ /gnyisalco lhag dade dri ma sgo spang nyid/ /'aklod pa sgom spang ma rig nyid ldan par/ / gsungs chung ngu'i sa bar 'gyur ram dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel sed pa/ phrag dog ser sna/ rgod pa/ 'gyod pa/ rmugs pa/ gnyid de kun dkris brgyad kyi steng du la la ste bye smras/ khro ba dang 'chab pa gnyis bsnan te kun dkris bcu 'dod pa'i phyir/'chab pa ni 'dod chags dang rmongs pa ste gti mug gang las skye ba rtsod par byed do/ /la las ni ga/nyis ka las skye bar 'dod de/ nyes pa byung ba shes pa rnams kyi 'dod chags dang / byung bar ma shes pa rnams kyi gti mug las skyes so/ /zhes zer/dri ma drug yod de/ sgyu dang / g.yo dang / rgyags pa dang /'tshig pa dang / 'khon 'dzin dang / rnam 'tshe rnams yod/kun dkris ba4da dam bcu las lnga la ni mthong sgom gyi spang bya gnyis yod de/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa/ mugs pa/gnyid/ rgod pa dang lnga la mthong spang dang sgom spang gnyis yod/de lnga'i lhag ma/ phrag dog ser sna/ 'gyod pa/ khro ba/'chab pa lnga ni sgom spung nyid yin no/ /'gyod pa sgom spang yin 554

ma ri gaspu nyid dab mtshungs par ldan pa yin zhes/ mchi mas 4 mdzod las gsungs te/ de las/ 4 lnga bo de dag las gzhan pa nye nyon kun dkris kyis bsdus pa phrag dog dang ser sna dang 'gyod pa dang khro ba dang 'chab pa ni bden pa la dngos dang brgyud nas log par mi 'jug pas sgom pasagyispang bar bya ba kho na dang / rang dbang can yang yin te/ sgom spang gi ma rig pa tsam dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsunges pas/des na nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa bar 'gyur dgos te/ ma rig pa tsam dang mtshungs par lhan pa'i sgogaspang yin pasne phyir/ zhes dpyad par 'tshal/ zhes pa'o/ gong gi rgyu mtsha na 'thod pa thi'i byur min/ /dkris lnga dri mar bcas te rang dbang can/ /mtshamasasku ra rang dbang can lnga las gzhan na/ /'di dag 'byung dgos rang dbang can gyir 'gal/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong gi 'gyod pa sogs rang dbang can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'gyod pa spyi la sbyar phyir min te/ rgyu mtshan ni bden pa la dngos dang brgyud nas log par mi 'a jug cing yul la 'jug pas/ zhes pa 'di yin la/ 'dod bsdus 'gyod pa mi dge ba bden pa la brgyud nas log par 'jug pa yod dam snyam/ kun dkris lnga dri ma drug dang bcas te rang dbang can yin par gsungs pa'i 555
