mtshams sbyor stabaso rang dbang can lnga las gzhan yod na/ 'di dag gi skabs su 'byung dgos te/ ma byung na rang dbang can yin pa 'gal lo/ / kun dkris bcu yi bdun dang dri ma drug /'dod na mi dge'o spags gnyid rgod rnam gnyis/ /gong skyes bzhi'o sgrib la lung ma bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun dkris bcu'i nang nas rmugasaganyid rgod gsum las gzhan bdun dang dri ma drug 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa rnams ni mi dge ba kho na dang / 'dod pa'i nyon mongs can gyi rmugs gnyid rgod gsum la mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi cha rnam ba gnyis yod/ khams gong na skyes pa ste yod pa rmugs gnyid rgod rgyags pa bzhi'o de bzhi ni sgrib la lung ma bstan yin no/ /kun dkris gnyis bzhi dri drug chung ca'i sa/ /mthong spang la sogs yid shes kho nar 'gyur/ /chugs rgod the tshom gong mar yod mod kyi/ /'dir bstan bsam gtan sgrib phyir 'dod kho na/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun dkris gnyis pa bzhi ba dri ma drug dang bcas pa nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba yin/ mthong spang la sogs pa ste sgom spang gnyid dang nga rgyal dang bcas pa yid shes kho na'i sa bar 'gyur te/ mi gsal zhing kun tu rtogs bcas yin pa'i phyir/ — ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med gnyis mi 556

dge ba'i sa mang bo dang rmugs rgod gnyis nyon mongs pa'i sa mang bo dang / gnyid ni yid kyi sa ba 'dod pa na spyod pa thams cad dang mthun par bstan pa'i phyir/ rmugs rgod the tshom gsum gong mar yod mod kyi 'dir bstan gyi de gsum bsam gtan la sgrib pa'i dbang du byas pa'i phyir 'dod khams kho nas sas bsdus pa'o/ /skugs gnyid gnyen po zas dang bya ba gcig /rgod 'thod de bzhin(no)lngar lngas rgyu mtshan ni/ /gnyis gnyis rim bzhin bslab gsum phung bor gnod/ /zhes rab med na bden la the tshom 'byur/ /zhes zer / /zhes gsungs te/'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems dang / gnyid dang rmugs pa dang / rgod pa dang 'gyod pa dang / the tshom ste lnga ni mdo las gsungs pa'i sgrib pa lnga yin la/ 'dir nyon mongs tha dad pa bdun yod kyang / rmugs gnyid gnyis gcig byas/ rgod 'gyod gnyis gcig byas nas lngar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rmugs gnyid gnyis kyi gnyen po gcig zas gcig bya ba yang gcig pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi gnyen po ni/snang ba'i 'du shes yin pa gcig zas lnga yang gcig bya ba sems zhum par byed pa gcig pa'i phyir/ zas lnga ni/ rmya ba dang / mi dga' ba dang / bya myang dang / kha zas kyi drod mi 557

zin pa dang / sems zhurma pasnyedang lngahūṃ/ /rgod 'gyod gnyis kyang de bzhin yin te/ de gnyis kyi gnyen po zhi gnas yin pa gcig zas bzhi yang gcig bya ba sems ma zhi bar byed pa gcig pa'i phyir/ zas bzhi yod de/ nye du' rnam par rtog pa dang / yul gyi rnam par rtog pa dang / mi 'chi ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang / sngon bgad pa rtses pa dga' mgur yongs su spyad pa rnams rjes su dran pa dang bzhi'o/ /lngar nges pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'dod 'dun gnod sems gnyis kyis tshul khrims kyi phung bor gnod par byed/ rmugs gnyid gnyis kyis shes rab gyi phung bor gnod par byed/ rgod 'gyod gnyis kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phung bor gnod par byed/ shes rab med na bden pa bzhi la the tshom za bar 'gyur bas lngar bshad do/ /zhes bye brag smra ba zer ro/ / blob dpon rang lugs ting 'dzin gyi/ /rdzor dngos rjes la sgrib pa'i dbang byas so/ /zhes gsungs te/slob dpon rang lugs la/ de lngas ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum la sgrib pas na sgrib pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te/bsod snyoms la rgyu ba'i tshe gzugs sdug mi sdug gi mtshan ma bzung bas 'dod 'udun dang gnod sems kyis ting nge 'dzin sbyor ba'i dus na bar chad byed/ dngos gzhi'i dus na thabs ma 558

yin pas zhi gnas la rmugs gnyid dang / lhag mthong la rgod 'gyod kyis bar chad byed la/ the tshom gyis zhi lhag gnyis ka la bar chad byed cing / rjes su langs pa'i chos la nges par rtogs tshe'ang the tshom gyis bar chad byed pa'i phyir/dmigs pa shes pas spong ba 'dod pa yi/ /rtsag kun mi mnyam kun 'gro min pa brgyad/ /gong ma'i rtsag kun mthong spang sum cu rtse/ /mi mnyam pa lang cig car spong phyir ro/ /'gog lam yul na log lta the tshom gnyis/ /khams dbye'i bcu gnyis dang bcas lnga bcu'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ phra rgyas spong tshul yod de/ dmigs pa yongs su shes pas spong ba dang / kun 'gro de la dmigs par byed pa yang dag par zad pas spong ba dang / dmigs par bya ba spangs rīpas spong ba dang / gnyen po skyes pa'i spangs pa bzhi yod/ dang bo dmigs pa shes pas spong ba ni/ 'dod pa'i sdug kun gnyis kyi skal ba mi mnyam zhing kun 'gro min pa dang brgyad yod de/'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang rang sa la dmigs pa'i skal ba mnyam pa'i khams kun 'gro lta ba dang bo gnyis dang / kun 'gro sa yin pa 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal gsum dang / kun 'byung mthong spang gi kun 'gro ma yin pa 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal gsum ste brgyad yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro ma gtogs 559

pa sdug bsngal mthong spang dgu dgu dang / kun 'byung mthong spang drug drug ste sum cu dang bcas skal ba mi mnyam pa yang cig car du spong ba'i phyir/ khams gsum gyi 'gog lam mthong spang gi ma rig pa drug ma gtogs pa zag med la dmigs pa log lta dang the tshom gnyis khams kyi dbye bas/ khams re la bzhi re yod pas bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang bcas pa khyon bsdoms lnga bcu bo thams cad dmigs pa yongs su shes pas spong ba yin no//rang la dmigs pa zad pas spong ba ni/ /'dod pa'i skal ba mi mnyam kun 'gro dgu/ /rang gi dmigs pa spangs pa'i spong ba ni/ /log par log zhegs rnams te khams gsum na/ /'gog lam mthong spang zag bcas la dmigs ba/ /dgu dang ba dun bdun brdzoms pas nyer gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa/ mthong spang de la dmigs pa'i yul can gyi nyon mongs yang dag par zad pas spong ba ni/ 'dod pa'i skal ba mi mnyam pa'i kun 'gro dgu bo rnams ni/ de dag la dmigs pa'i yul can 'dod pa'i skal ba mnyam pa'i kun 'gro bcu gcig po de spangs pas spangs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa dmigs par bya ba spangs pas spong ba ni/ khams gsum gyi 'gog lam mthong spang zag bcas ni log pa yin pas log pa la dmigs pa'i log 560

zhugs 'dod pa na 'gog pa mthong spang bzhi dang / lam mthong spang lnga ste dgu dang / khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro ma gtogs pas 'gog pa mthong spang gsum dang / lam mthong spang bzhi ste bdun bdun yod pas de dag bsdoms na nyer gsum yod pa de dag ni de dag gi dmigs pa'i yul spangs pas yul can de dag spangs par 'gyur ro/ /'gog lam mthong ba'i spang bya ma rig drug /spong tshul gsum du ma brtsas rgyu mtshan tshol/ /mi 'gal gsum po dmigs shes spong bas brtsas/ /gong sa tsam dmigs kun 'gro yod dam dpyad/ /mtshungs ldan las min dbye mi nus byar ro/ /dmigs las spong ste gong 'og gcung kun mthun/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'gog pa dang lam mthong spang gi spang bya ma rig pa drug ni/ spong tshul dang bo gsum du ma bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan tshol/ zhes pa'i lan du/ dang bo gsum po gang rung du bsdu ba'i tshig ma byung yang mi 'gal te/ spong tshul dang bo gsum po de dmigs pa yongs su shes pa'i spong bas bsdus pa yin te/der ma zad spong tshul bzhi ga la dmigs pa yongs su shes pa'i stobs kyis spangs pas khyab ste/ bzhir bzhag pa ni/ yul spangs pa dang yul can spangs pa'i spong tshul dang snga phyi mi 'dra tsam shes pa'i ched du phye ba tsam yin pali phyir te/ rgyal sras ma 561

las/ gang dag gnyen po skyes pas sprongo bar brjod pa sgom pas spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa de dag spyang dmigs pa sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la sogs pa yongs su shes pa kho nas spong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /de la dmigs pa spangs pa la sogs pas kyang nyon mongs pa rnams spangs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par bzhag pa tsam du zad do/ /zhes bya ba yin par mngon/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gong sa tsam la dmigs pa'i kun 'gro yod dam dpyad par bya'o/ /nyon mongs spong tshe mtshungs ldan las spong ngam dmigs pa las spong zhe na/ mtshungs ldan las spong ba min te/ mtshungs ldan ni phan tshun med na mi 'byung ba'i ngo bor skyes pas phan tshun dbye mi nus pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa las nyon mongs pa ni spang bar bya bar 'dod de/ 'di dag skye na dmigs pa la dmigs nas skye ba'i phyir/ 'di la grub mtha' gong 'og kun te/ rnam 'grel/ bzhi brgya ba/ dbu ma 'jug pa rnams kyi yang dgongs pa yin no/ /me shes yongs shes yongs shes dacos yin la/ /spangs pa yong shes rgyu ming 'bras btags so/ /'on kyang 'dir bstan spangs pa'o de la lang / /mthong drug sgom spang spangs pa'i yongasashes 562

gsum/ /drug kyang shes pa'i 'bras bu yin mod kyi/ /bajod thes 'bras bu gcig phyir der bshad la/ /lhag ma gsum gi shes pa khordzin ste/ /thod rgal bcu drug pa yi gnyis kyang ngo / /zhes gsungs te/yongs shes la sgras brjod kyi gnyis yod de/ ye shes yongs su shes pa dang / spangs pa'i yongs su shes pa gnyis yod kyang / ye shes yongs su shes pa ni yongs shes dngos yin la/ spangs pa yongs shes ni btags pa ba yin te/ rgyu ming 'bras la btags pa yin tshul ni/ spangs pa yongs shes ni spungs pa kho na yin la/ de'i thob byed kyi rgyu ye shes kyi ming 'bras bu spangs pa la btags pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i spangs pa'i yongs shes dgu yod de/ 'dod pa na sdug kun mthong spang rnam gnyis zad ba la yongs shes gcigayang 'dod pa'i 'gog pa mthong spang zad pa'i spangs pa yongs —shes gcig 'dod pa'i lam mthong spang zad pa'i spangs pa yongasar+shashes gcig ste 'dod pa'i bden bzhi'i mthong spang la yongs shes gsum dang / khams gong ma gnyis kyi sdug kun mthong spang zad pa'i yongs shes gcig 'gog lam mthong spang gnyis zad pa'i—yongs shes gnyis te khams gong ma'i gsum/ tha ma'i cha mthun lnga zad pa'i yongs shes dang / gzugs kyi nyon mongs zad pa'i yongs shes dang / zag pa kun rmed pa'i yongs shes te sgom spang 563

spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ spangs pa yongs shes te/ yongs shes btags pa ba yin mod/ 'on kyang 'dir bstan yongs shes rnams kyang spangs pa yongs shes yin te/ de la mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug dang /sgom spab spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum ste dgu yod pa gong du drangs pa ltar ro/ /mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug ni/rang thob byed kyi mthong lam bzod pa'i 'a—bras bu zhes bya ba yin— te/ de'i bral 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ drug bzod 'bras/ /zhes gsungs la/ de drug kyang shes pa'i 'bras bu yin mod kyi/ bzod shes gnyis 'bras bu gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis drug bzod 'bras zhes bzod pa de thob byed kyi gtso bo yin pas bshad la/ shes pa 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ lhag ma sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum ni/ chos shes pa'i 'bras bu kho na yin zhing / thod rgal ba'i bcu drug pa lam rjes shes kyi bral 'bras la yang mthong sgom gyi spangs pa yongs shes gnyis kyang yod do/ /dngos gzhi'i mthong mtha' gsum dang sgom mtha' gnyis/ /dbyangs sgrogs tha ma'i cha mthun min brgyad de/ /'dod gsum bral thob zag med nyed phyir ro/ /tha ma'i cha spangs rog pa snyed mod kyi/ /lam mthong spang ba'i zhar 'an phyir ma 564sna

ba grang / /zhes gsungs te/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi khyad par cam/ la sogs pa lnga bo rnams kyi 'bras bu bral 'bras yongs —shes lnga lnga yod de/ mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes mtha' ma gsum ste khams gong ma gnyis kyi mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum dang / sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes mtha' ma gnyis te/ gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa'i yongs shes dang / zag pa kun zad kyi yongs shes gnyis te lnga yod do/ /btsun pa—dbyangs sgrogs na re/ bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i 'bras bu ni tha ma'i cha mthun ma gtogs pa'i yongs shes brgyad yin te/'dod pa la chags bral sngar nas thob kyang 'dod pa'i mthong spang—spangs pa'i thob pa zag med mthong lam dus su gsar du rnyed 4pa'i/ 'dod pa'i mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum4dang / sngar gong du bshad pa'i lnga dang bcas brgyad yod par—'dod pa'i phyir/ tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pa'i yongs shes kyi—ldog pa ste de'i rang ldog mthong spang spangs pa'i skabs su rnyed mod/ bsam gtan gyi 'bras bu'i yongs shes kyi skabs su ma bgrang ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de'i bral thob ni lam mthong spang spangs pa'i zhar la thob pa'am lam mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes dang gcig tu 'dus pas so/ /zhes zer ro/ /nam mkha'i 565

nyer bsdogs 'bras bu gzugs zag da/ /gzugs med dajas gzhi gsum la'ang kun zad nyid/ /zhi rags lam gyi 'azas bu bduspe brgyad gnyis/ /rjes kyi gnyis so lam la chos shes ni/ /khams gsum gnyen po yin phyir de 'bras gsum/ /phyogs mthun chos brngod dang bajoms chos shes 'bras/ /gsum steng 'dod pa'i mthong spang spangs pa'i gsum/ /rjes shes phyogs mthun bzid bcas 'bras bu ni/ /gong ma'i mthong spang gsum dang sgom spang gnyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs med nam mkha' mtha' yas nyer bsdogs kyi bral 'bras gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa'i yongs shes de yin/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi dang bo gsum gyi bral 'bras yang zag pa kun zad kyi yongs shes nyid yin no/ /zhi rags rnam can gyi 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam gyi bral 'bras gnyis yod de/ yongs shes dgu'i bdun pa tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pa'i yongs shes dang / brgyad pa gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa'i yongs shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rjes shes kyi 'bras bu yongs shes gnyis yod de/ sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes tha ma gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ lam chos shes ni khams gsum gyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ de'i bral 'bras la sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum yod/ sgom lam chos shes de'i phyogs 566

mthun chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang bsdoms pa chos shes rnams kyi 'bras bu yongs shes drug yod de/ chos shes kyi bral 'bras sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum gyi steng du 'dod pa'i mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ rjes shes phyogs dang mthun pa rjes bzod rjes shes bcas kyi bral 'bras yongs shes la lnga yod de/ gong ma'i mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gsum dang / sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes tha ma gnyis te lnga yod pa'i phyir/ yongs shes 'jog byed bral thob zag med nyed/ /brad rtse' phyogs cha cig bsngal mthong spang da/ /rang sa'i kun 'gro gnyis brtsom gsum tshang bas drug bzhag mtha' gsum khams la 'das basporkyang / /zhes gsungs te/ so skye la yongs shes mi 'jog cing / yongs shes dgu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bral ba'i —thob pa zag med gsar du rnyed pa dang / srid rtse'i nyon mongs phyogs cha sdug bsngal mthong spang zad pa dang / rang sa'i sdug kun mthong spang gi kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis bcom pa ste/ rgyu gsum tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug bzhag rgyu gsum po de dang rgyu bzhi ba khams gsum so so las 'das pa ste 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rgyu ste rgyu bzhi tshang bas/ yongs shes 567

mtha' ma gsum bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /ldan tshul gcig min gang na so skye 'o/ /kun 'byung chos brngod man gyi 'phags pa yang / /mthong lam gzhan la gcig nas lnga'i bar ldan/ /sgom la rgyun zhugs gsar thob drug dang ldan/ /chags bral 'bras thob tshe na bsdoms gsungs par/ /gnyis char 'doms na yin phyir 'anir mi 'gal/ /de tshe spang bsdoms yongs shes bsdoms pa min/ /dgra bcom 'dod nyon gyis nyams la yang drug tachags bral bcu drug pa la gcig ldan te/ /mthong lnga btang nas sgom gcig thob phyir ro/ /gong ma'i lam mthong spangs pa'i yongs shes mtha'i/ /cha mthun spang bar brtsas kyi med min te/ /de la dngos gzhi'i 'bras bu bshad byir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ gcig ni yongs shes dang ldan pa min te/ gcig gang zhe na so skye'o/ /kun 'byung chos bzod man chad la gnas pa'i 'phags—pa yang yongs shes dang mi ldan no/ /mthong lam gzhan la gnas pa dag ni yongs shes gcig nas lnga'i bar ldan pa yod de/kun 'byung chos shes kyi tshe gcig rjes shes kyi tshe gnyis/ 'gog pa chos shes kyi tshe gsum/ rjes shes kyi tshe bzhi/ lam chos shes kyi tshe lnga yod pa'i phyir/ sgom lam la gnas pa rgyun zhugs gsarardzidu thob pa'i tshe yongs shes drug dang ldan la/ gal te lam la 568

rjes shes thob pa na yongs shes drug dang ldan par mi 'gyur te/ rā'abras bu bzhir rnams bzhag pa ni/ /rgyu lnga dag ni srid phyir ro/ /'bras la sngon lam btang ba dang / /gzhan thob pa dang zad bsdoms dang / /shes pa brgyad tshan thob pa dang / /rnam pa bcu drug thob pa'o/ /zhes spangs pa bsdoms par bshad pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de'i tshe spangs pa bsdoms pa yin gyi yongs shes bsdoms pa ni ma yin pas 'gal ba med do zhes ṭīka byed dag 'chad do/ /zhes mchims mdzod gsungs/ 'di ni/ rtsa bar/ khams las 'dod chags bral ba dang / /'bras bu thob phyir de dag bsdoms/ /zhes pa'i do na gsungs pa yin la/mtha' dpyod las/ sngon nam phyis 'dod pa tshwa chags bral thob pa'i bcu drug pa lam rjes shes pa ni tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i longs shes gcig pu dang / dgra bcom pa thob pa ni kun tu sbyor ba thams cad spangs pa'i yongs shes gcig pu dang ldan pa'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong dang dgra bcom pa gnyis yongs shes gcig pu re dang ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'dod pa'i khams las 'dod chags dang bral/ gzugs kyi de dang ma bral bar 'bras bu gsar du thob pa de'i tshe de'i rgyud kyi yongs shes rnams bsdoms nas tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pa'i yongs shes gcig dzu byas 569

shing / khams gsum las 'das shing 'bras bu gsar du thob pa /nyis kyis/ dgra bcom pa thob pa'i tshe de'i rgyud kyi yongs shes rnams bsdoms nas kun tu sbyor ba thams cad zad pa'i yongs shes gcig byas pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ bsdoms 'dir/ chags bral 'bras thob tshe na bsdoms gsungs par/ /gnyis char 'doms na yin phyir 'dir mi 'gal/ /de tshe spangardzibasdoms yongs shes bsdoms pa min/ /zhes chags bral ste dgra bcom tshe na de'i rgyud kyi yongs shes rnams bsdoms nas kun tu sbyor ba thams cad zad pa'i yongs shes gcig byas gsungs pa/tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i yongs shes dang / kun sbyor thams cad zad pa'i yongs shes gnyisachar yongs shes thams cad gcig tu 'doms pa ste bsdoms par byas pa yin stabs/ yongs shes gcig byas pa la 'dir 'gal ba med la/ spangs pa bsdoms pa yin gyi yongs shes bsdoms pa ni ma yin zhes ṭīka byed dag 'chad do zhes pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa'i tshe zag pa kun zad kyi yongs shes bsdoms pa la rgyu mtshan yod de khams gong ma las 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu gsar du thob pa na spangs pa de dag bsdoms nas bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /dgra bcom pa 'dod nyon gyis nyams pa la yang drug dang 570

ldan te/ khams gsum gyi mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug 'thob la/ chags bral sngon song gi bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa de yongs shes gcig dang ldan te/ mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes lnga btang nas/ sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes gcig 'thob pa yin te/ tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i yongs shes thob pa'i phyir/ gong ma 'i lam mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes de/ mtha' ma'i cha mthun spang bar bsdus pa yin gyi med pa min te/ gong ma'i lam mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes de la/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i 'bras bu yod de/ bsam gtan rnams kyi lnga'am brgyad/ ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gzugs zangs bcu drug ba la bdun brgyad gnyis/ /dgra brtsom thob tshe btang nas dgu ba 'thob/ /nyams tshe dgu ba btang nas snga gnyis 'thob/ /lnga bshad zinalta mabar gyis phrir mi 'ong / /mthong drugs gadzhang ngo nyams tshe drug ka 'thob/ /ces gsungs te/ gzugs kyi nyon mongs chags bral gyis spangs pa'i bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa des/ tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i yongs shes te yongs shes bdun pa dang / brgyad pa gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa'i yongs shes gnyis 'thob/ dgra bcom thob pa'i tshe yongs shes de —gnyis btang nas/ dgu ba zag pa kun zad kyi yongs shes 'thob/ 571

dgra bcom pa gzugs med kyi nyon mongs spangs pa las nyams na/ dgu ba zag zad kyi de btang nas snga ma yongs shes bdun pa dang brgyad pa gnyis 'thob/ lnga btang ba ni/ chags bral bcu drug pas lnga btang ba bshad zin la/ 'phags pa mthar gyis pa 'dod pha las 'dod chags dang bral ba na bdun 'thob la snga ma drug gtong ngo / /de chags bral las nyams tshe snga ma drug ka 'thob bo/ /phra rags 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyer byed pa'i/ /phra rgyas ba mo skems byed nyi zer gyis/ /phra zhib blang dor gnas rnams gsal ba na/ /phra rags 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yongs su skems/ / gnas lnga ba'i skabs so/ / ri gnas drug pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/lam mchog goms pa'i thabs shes rmephrul 'degs kyis/ /ye shes yongs shes mchog la sbyor mdzad pa/ /rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan kun/ /gcig bskyes 'gro 'dren mchog la slar yang 'dud/ /'dir gnas drug pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig cung zad 'grel ba la/ 572

momathong dang sgom pas spong zhes sngar bshad pa'i/ /lam dang mthong bya'i bden pa 'azhir bshad do/ /mchims ṭīka mthong lam zag med mtshan du/ /mthong spang skor dgu mnyam spong 'jig rten pas/ /de mi nus gsungs phyir na des spong tshe/ /'jig lta skor dgur byas nas spong ngam dbyad/ /ces gsungs te/ bden pa mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i lam dang mthong zin rgyud ldan du sgom par byed pa'i sgom lam gnyis bsgom par byas pas nyon mongs pa spong bar byed ces sngar gnas lnga ba'i skabs su bshad pa'i bden pa mthong byed kyi lam dang / de'i mthong bya'i bden pa bzhi dang / bden pa gnyis sogs gnas drug pa 'dir bshad do/ /mchims mdzod las/ mthongangaba'i lam zhes bya ba ni gcig tu zag pa med pa yin te/ khams gsum pa'i mthong spang gi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir dang / mthong spang chen po la sogs pa rnam pa dgu cig car spong ba'i phyir dang / zhes mthong lam zag med—yin pa'i rgyu mtshan du/mthong spang skor dgu mnyam spong yin pa bkod pa'i phyir dang /'jig rten pa la ni de 'dra ba'i mthu med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'jig rten pa'i lam zag bcas kyis/ de ltar mthong spang skor dgu mnyam du cig car du spong mi nus par gsungs pa'i phyitwe7/3

des na/ mthong lam zag med des mthong spang 'jig lta skor dgu ste 'jig lta chen po'i chen po sogs skor dgur byas nas spong ba yin nam dpyad gsungs te/ 'jig lta che 'bring chung gsum re re la che 'bring chung ste skor dgu yod la/ zag thed mthong lam gyis rang gi spang bya'i nyon mongs skor dgu bo cig car spong la/ de bzhin du khams gsum gyi mthong spang 'jig lta rnams spyang skor dgu dgu byas nas skor dgu bo cig car spong zhing / zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis dgu bo rim can du spong ba las cig car du spong mi nus te/ zhi rags su lta ba'i lam rim gyis sgom pa las chags bral byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'ji bas zag bcas bams cad rtsag kun gnyis/ /dbe ston kun 'byung sred pa kho nar 'dod/ /rtsag bsngal gyir brtsos min ba' bde bra zhig /'dir lang med kyang rtsag bsngal 'gag tsam la/ /bde zhes btags pa 'jog mtshams ma 'tshal bas /'phags pa lha bkag bden pa gnyis las nyams/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ba ste bye brag smra bas/ mdo las/ 'phags pas bde bar gang gsungs pa/ /de ni gzhan gyis sdug bsngal rig /gzhan gyis bde bar gang smras pa/ /de ni 'phags pas sdug bsngal rig /zhes gsungs pa ltar zag bcas thams cad sdug bden 574

dang kun 'byung bden pa yin no zhes 'dod la/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde bas/ bye brag smra bas kun 'byung gi bden pa gang yin pa de nyid sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'ang yin no/ /zhes smras pa ni mdo dang 'gal te/ mdo las ni kun 'byung gi bden pa gang zhe na/ gang 'di dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang lhan cig pa'i sred pa ste de dang de la mngon par dga' ba can yin no zhes sred pa kho na kun 'byung du gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes kun 'byung sred pa kho nar 'dod do/ /bye brag smra bas/ lung de'i don ni gtso che ba la dgongs so zer ro/ /bye smras/ sdug bden yin na sdug bsngal yin pas ma khyab ste/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba de/ bde ba yin pa'i phyir zer/ mdo las/ bde ba'i tshor ba ni sdug bsngal du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa la bde ba'o zhes 'khrul ba las gzhan sdug bsngal phyir bcos min pa'i bde ba zhig bye smra'i lugs 'dirayang med par 'dod dgos te/ rtsa bar/ sdug bsngal nyidagasum ldan pa'i phyir/ /ci rigs ma lus sdug bsngal lo/ /zhesaso/ /sdug bsngal che rim nas 'gag pa'i cha tsam la bde ba zhes btags pa yin zhes khas len dgos pa la/ de lta bu'i khas len 'jog mtshams ma 'tshal ba'am ma shes pa'i dbang gis 'phags rdzo575

pa lha yang bkag pa yin te/ rang 'grel las/ re zhig bde ba la skur ba 'debs pa de la/ zhes zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba de sdug bsngal yin par 'dod pa'i ār+ya de ba bkag pa yin par bzhi brgya ba'i 'grel bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ / bum chu dbyibs dang tshogs pa'i kun rdzob bo/ /lus sems 'du 'dzi rnam rtog gnyis las bsrings/ /thar bar bgrod pa'i gzhegs shul marngon rtogs de/ /thar lam don no smin grol gnyis su bsdus/ /zhes gsungs te/ bden pa gnyis yod de/kun rdzob bden pa dang / don dam bden pa gnyis yod/ dang bo kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa dang bum pa'i nang gi chu lta bu/ bum pa kun rdzob tu yod de/ bcom pa na rang 'dzin pa'i blo 'jig pa'i phyir/ bum chu kun rdzob tu yod de/ kha dog dri ro reg so sor bsal ba na/ chur 'dzin gyi blo 'dor ba'i phyir/des na bum pa dbyibs la ltos nas kun rdzob tu bzhag la/ bum chu tshogs pa la ltos nas kun rdzob tu bzhag go /lam sgom pa'i gang zag gis/ ji ltar byas na lam sgom pa rdzogs pa'i thabs gnyis yod de/ gcig pur gnas pa'i lus kyi 'du 'dzi thag bsrings pa dang / sems kyi rnam rtog thag bsrings pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ thar lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang 576

'bras thar bar bgrod pa'i go rme bas gshegs shul du gyur pa'i momangon rtogs de yin la/ de la rnam smin lam dang grol lam gnyis yod/ lam thams cad de gnyis su bsdus so/ /mdog dbyibs reg pa bsnyen bkur chags gnas bzhi'i/ /gnyen po ra 'du shes dgu bsngags tha ma yi/ /gnyen por zhi ro g.yo ba med pa bsgom/ /mi rtsag sgom tshul gsum po bye smra'i lugs/ /dang bos mi skug rjogs zhes grags pa 'thad/ /ces gsungs te/ de ltar bsrings pa gnyis dang ldan pa de yang 'dod chung chog shes can la yin pas/ chog mi shes pa dang 'dod pa che ba ni 'dod pa'i mi dgi ba yin la/ 'dod chung chog shes dge ba yin zhing / ma chags pa ni 'phags pa'i rigs yin te/ 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi ni/ chos gos la ma chagase pa dang / bsod stoms la ma chags pa dang / mal cha dang stan la ma chags pa dang / spong ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba'o/ /zhi gnas sgrub par byed pa la 'dod chags kyi gnyen po mi sdug pa bsgom dgos pas/ de sgom tshul ni/ mdog ste kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / reg pa dang / bsnyen bkur la chags pa bzhi'i gnyen por 'du shes dgu bsngags pa yin te/ kha dog la chags pa'i gnyen por rnam par bsngos pa dang / rnam par rnags pa 577

dang / rnamaripar dmar ba sgom ba'i 'du shes gsum dang /dbyibs la chags pa'i gnyen por rnam par zos pa dang / rnam par 'thor ba sgom pa'i 'du shes gnyis dang / reg bya la chags pa'i gnyen por rnam par 'bus gzhig pa dang rgyus pa sbreng ba'i keng rus la dmigs pa'i 'du shesauganyis dang / bsnyen bkur la chags pa'i gnyen por shi ba'i ro g.yo ba med par sgom pa'i mi sdug pa'i 'du shes dang / kha dog dgyibs sogs la chags pa thams cad la keng rus bcud med pa'i rus rnying sgom pa ste mi sdug pa'i 'du shes dgu sgom par bsngags so/ /mi sdug sgom tshul gsum ni/ las dang bo ba dang / yongs su sbyangs par byas pa dang / yid la byed pa rdzogs pa gsum yod gsungs pa de ni bye smra'i lugs yin la/ de gsum gyi dang bo mi sdug sgom tshul de ji bzhin bsgom thub na mi sdug sgom tshul yongs su rdzogs zhes grags pa 'thad do/ /'dod sems nyer bsdogs bzhi dang dngosasnyegazhi lnga/ /dmigs pa 'dod pa'i dbyibs dang kha dog dkar/ /dang po gling gsum mis skyed phyis lha yang / /zhes gsungs te/ mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sems rten ni/ 'dod sems dang / bsam gtan bzhi'i nyer bsdogs bzhi —dang / bsam gtan bzhi'i dngos gzhi dang / bsam gtan 578

stid par can te dngos gzhi lnga yod pas/ sa bcu la brten pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa kha phyir bltas kyi 'dod pa'i snang ba dbyibs dang kha dog dkar bo la dmigs pa'i phyir/ lus rten ni/ dang bor gling gsum gyi mi'i lus rten la skyed cing phyis su lha'i lus rten la yang mardon du byed pa yod par gsungs so/ /'byung jub shes rab 'jug byed dran pas btags/ /'dod shang dang bo gsum gyi nyer brjogs dang / /khyad par can no btang rilhams tsod dang mtshungs/ / nga rna rnam na min te chad nas spyor/ /lus stobs 'apel bas 'grib byur rgyas byung min/ /zhes gsungs te/ dbugs 'byung jub dran pa sgom pa la/ dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rang bzhin ni shes rab yin kyang / dran pa'i stobs kyis 'jug par byed pas dran pa zhes btags nas brjod pa'i phyir/ sems rten ni/ 'dod sems dang / bsam gtan dang bo gsum gyi nyer bsdogs gsum dang / bsam gtan khyad par can de sa lnga na yod pa'i phyir/ de lngar yod pa'i rgyu mtshan bde sdug ni rnam rtog dang mthun la/ 'dir rnam rtog gi gnyen po yin pas btang snyoms yang rnam rtog sdud pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sbyir/ rlung de ni rnam smin ma yin te/ bar skabs su chad nas yang stor ba yod pa'i phyir/ rgyas sgobyung ma yin te/ lus stobs rgyas 579

pa'i dbang gis mi rgyas par ma —zu da4/ lha lus stobs 'phel ba na rlung 'grib pa yod pa'i phyir te/ bam̐ ri rlung nad zhi phyir lus stobs bskyed pa'i sman dpyad byed pa yod do/ /des na dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rlung ni/ dbang bos ma zin pa dang / rgyu mthun las byung ba dang / sngar ma 'dris pas sbyor byung dang 'dris pa'i chags bral gyis thob pa'i phyir ro/ /chos rnams thams cad dmigs pa dran nye rtse/ /rang gzhan dbyesgrubs bzhi char phyi nang gsum/ /tshogs lam klu dang gong mar mchims gsungs dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ lhag mthong sgom dus kyi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ni/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag r+shasems dran pa nyer bzhag chos dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ nyer bsdogs sogs la brten nas rang gi dmigs pa lus sogs bzhi gang rung la rang spyi'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i mngon rtogs de dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid/dbye na lus tshor sems chos bzhi la dmigs pa'i de bzhi yod/ chos rnams thams cad la dmigs pa dran pa nyer bzhag yin la/de re re la rang gi rgyud la dmigs pa/ gzhan gyi rgyud la dmigs pa/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i rgyud la dmigs pa gsum gsum yod/ mchims mdzod las/ klu la sogs pa la'ang skyabs su 580

'gro ba yod par bshad la/ 'dod gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams la'ang tshogs lam skye ba la 'gal ba med pa'i phyir de dag kyang rten du rung ngo / /zhes tshogs lam klu dang khams gong mar skye ba yod par gsungs pa la dpyad par bya dgos te/ lha dang —dud 'gro la dge slong yod pa 'dul ba'i sde snod las bkagasapa'i phyir ro/ /dang bor chos la dmigs pa rnam gtod don/ /dzi nas gzhan gsum bsgom pas 'apel bar byed/ /bathod pa chung 'bring gtod byed drod rtse 'dra/ /'phel byed chos te rjom rdzom dmigs phyir jo/ /zhes gsungs te/ drod dang rtse mo la dang bor chos la dmigs pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag gis dmigs pa'am rnam pa gtod pa'am 'god par byed/ de'i don la phyi nas dran pa nyer bzhag gsum bsgoms pas 'phel bar ram byang zhing chub par byed pa'i phyir/ bzod pa chung 'bring gnyis sgom tshul gyi dmigs rnam gtod byed drod rtse dang 'dra la/ 'phel byed yod de/ chos dran pa nyer bzhag kho nas 'phel bar byed de/ des 'dod par gtogs pa'i bden bagli'i rnam pa dang gong gi bden bzhi'i rnam pa dag bsdoms pa dang yang gong ma gnyis kyi rnam pa dag bsdoms nas dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rnam pa gtod pa ni thog mar sgom pa yin la/ 'phel ba ni sgom pa de goms shing 581

byang bar byed pa yin te dper na bzod pa 'bring dmigs rnam phri nas yang yang sgom pa lta bu'o/ /gong 'og bgeja bzhi' khrad sa so gnyis las/ /gong ma'i lam bor so ga ga rigaspobor bas/ /susacu la sogs rnam pa je lde nas/ /dor bas bathoga' nga bzhi brgya go bdun zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ sbyor lam bzod pa 'bring gi skabs bsdoms nas sgom tshul ni/ gong 'og ste gong ma gathugs gzugs med kyi khams gnyis/ 'og ma 'dod khams te khams gsum gyi bden bzhi'i khyad chos so gnyis yod de 'dod khams kyi bcu drug dang /khams gong gi bcu drug ste so gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de so gnyis sgom par bya zhing / de nas khams gong ma'i lam bden gyi khyad chos lam rigs pa sgrub pa nges 'byin bzhi'i nang gi lam bor te lhag ma so gcig sgom pa dang / de nas de bzhi'i nang gi rigs pa bor te sum cu sgom pa sogs re re nas dor ba ni/ de nas sgrub pa bor te lhag ma nyer dgu sgom pa dang / de nas nges 'byin bor te lhag ma nyer brgyad sgom pa dang / de bzhin durtekhams gong ma'i 'gog bden dang kun 'byung bden pa dang sdug bden rnams kyi rnam pa dang dmigs pa rnams rim gyis re re dor nas lhag ma sgom pa dang / de nas 'dod pa'i lam bden 582

dang 'gog bden dang kun 'byung dang sdug bden bar gyi rnam bar+sharnams kyang re re nas dor nas sgom pa dang / mthar 'og nas—'byung ba'i sred spyad gnyis dang / lta spyad gnyis te gang zag de—bzhi'i gnyen po'i dbang gis sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi las gang4yang rung ba zhig lan gnyis su sgom pa'i bar rnams bzod pa 'bring yin pas de ni skad cig ma bzhi brgya dang go bdun yin — no/ /zhes zer ro/ /ma bor so gnyis bsgom pa brngod chung yin/ /dmigs pa ma bor rnam ba mi 'bor bas/ /gong ma'i lam bzhi dor ba'i nyer brgyad nas/ /'og ma'i lam bor nyer bzhi la sogs te/ /gong ma'i rtsag bden bor nas 'og ma'i bzhi/ /ga ga gnyis dor nas gsum gnyis tha mar ni/ /gred spyad gnyis te nga rgyal me lo can/ /sta spyad gnyis te bdag gi bdag lta bas/ /rim bzhin gcug la lan gnyis goms byed do/ /de phyir ga ga gnyis dor bya skabs dang jir/ /rnam ba de gi chos brngod bar du 'acag /ces gsungs te/ gong 'og gi bden bzhi'i khyad chos so gnyis las gcig kyang ma bor bar so gnyis bsgom pa ni bzod pa chung ngu'i skabs yin la/ dmigs yul bden pa ma bor bar rnam pa 'bor ba mi 'thad pas/ thog—mar dmigs pa 'dor ba slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi dgongs 583

pa yin par gsungs te/ khams gong ma gnyis bsdoms pa'i gnyen po lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi dor ba'i lhag ma nyer brgyad sgogli pa dang / de nas 'dod pa 'i gnyen po lam bden rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa bor te lhag ma nyer bzhi sgom pa dang / de nas gong ma gnyis kyi 'gog bden rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa bor te lhag ma nyi shu sgom pa dang / de nas 'dod pa'i 'gog bden rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa bor nas lhag ma bcu drug sgom pa dang / de nas khams gong ma gnyis kyi kun 'byung gi bden pa rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa bor te lhag ma bcu gnyis sgom pa dang / de nas 'dod pa'i kun 'byung gi bden pa rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa bor nas lhag ma brgyad sgom pa dang /lke de nas khams gong ma gnyis kyi sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa bor nas lhag ma 'dod pa'i sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi sgom pa dang / de dag ni 'dir/ 'og ma'i lam bor la sogs te/zhes sogs kyis bsdus pa'i don no/ /de nas 'dod pa'i sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas gcig dang gnyis dor nas gsum pa dang yang na gnyis pa dang tha ma sgom par gsungs pa ni/ sgom pa bo de la ni/ dbang bo rtul bo sred pa spyad pa gnyis te/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal shas che ba dang le lo shas che ba gnyis 584

dang / dbang bo rnon po lta ba spyad pa la yang gnyisate/ bdag tu lta ba spyad pa dang padage gir lta ba spyad pa gnyis yod pas/rim pa bzhin de lta bu'i gang zag la 'dod pa'i sdug bden khyad chos gcig la lan gnyis su goms par byed dgos pas/ de'i phyir rnam pa gcig dang gnyis dor bya skabs dang sbyar nas sgom gsungs/ skabs dang sbyar tshul ni/ lta ba spyad pa yin na/ 'dod pa'i sdug bden gyi rnam pa dang bo gnyis gang rung zhig dor nas lhag ma gsum sgom pa dang / de rjes snga ma gnyis dor nas phyi ma gnyis sgom pa dang / de yang bdag tu lta ba spyad ba yin na de'i gnyen po bdag med pa'i rnam pa lan gnyis su sgom la/ bdag gir lta ba spyad pa yin na de'i gnyen po stong ba'i rnam pa lan gnyis su sgom mo/ /sred pa spyad pa yin na 'dod pa'i sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi las phyi ma gnyis gang rung zhig dor nas lhag ma dang bo gsum sgom pa dang / de nas rnam pa phyi ma gnyis dor nas dang bo gnyis sgom par byed do/ /de yang nga rgyal shas che ba yin na de'i gnyen po mi rtag pa'i rnam pa lan gnyis su sgom la/ le lo shas che ba yin na de'i gnyen po sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa lan gnyis su sgom par byed do/ /de lta bu'i sgom tshul de ni chos bzod kyi bar du 'jug par byed do/ / 585

drod rtse la dod 'ang dbyangasatshosagaspobashad kyang gzhan/ /dzha 'phagabadzingasaganyabasapar che'i tshe dngabasgo'i spyo ra/ /gadzhang gi chags bralatsam dang ṣ+kabs min/ /'phags min 'chi bas gastong bya nyer bsdog go /zhes gsungs te/ nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi char yang mnyam bzhag min pas/ bsam gtan sa drug la brten pa yin la/ drod rtse gnyis 'dod pa la'ang brten pa yin zhes btsun pa dbyangs sgrogs kyis bshad kyang de ni 'dod tshul gzhan yin te/ de ltar na drod rtse gnyis sa bdun la brten par 'gyur bas mi 'thad do/ /bral thob kyi khyad par ni/ 'phags pa rnams gang la brten pa'i sa de 'phos pas gtong bar 'dod de/ 'phags pa bsam gtan dang bo la brten pa'i sbyor lam ni/ bsam gtan gnyis par skyes tshe dang bor brten pa'i sbyor lam gtong girmegs bral tsam dang shi ba tsam gyis gtong ba ma yin pa'i phyir/'chi bas gtong ba dang mi 'dra ste/ shi tsam nas bar do'i gong nas mi gtong ba'i phyir/ 'phags min te so skye yis ni 'chi ba kho nas gtong ste 'chi srid la gnas tshe dor nas bar srid skabs nor zin pa'i phyir/ so skye yis gtong bya'isbyor lam ni nyer bsdogs la brten pa yin te/ dngos gzhi la brten nas skyed pa yin na de'i tshe de nyid la bden pa mthong bar 'gyur te/ yid 586

'byung ba shasroche ba'i phyir/ drod rtse gnyis ṣ+ka'og ltalta bus yongs su nyams pas kyang gtong ngo / /yongs nyams 'gal rkyen stobs kyis nyams yin la/ /rnam nyams zhugs lam 'bras kyis btang ba lang / /'gro gsum sbyi'o brngod chen skye gnas gnyis/ /'du shes med dang tshangs chen sgra mi snyan/ /za ma grid brgyad mthong spang nyon mongs te/ /'gro ba skye gnas skye ba lus brad pa/ /nyon mongs drug la mi skye'i brngod thob gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ nyams pa gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ yongs nyams ni 'gal rkyen log lta lta bu'i stobs kyis dge rtsa nyams pa lta bu yin la/ rnam nyams ni/ zhugs lam ni 'bras bu thob pas btang ba lta bu'o/ /sbyor lam rnams kyi phan yon ni/ drod thob pas nyams kyang myang 'das nges par thob par 'gyur ba dang / rtse mo thob pa ngan song du skye ba yod kyang dge rtsa chad pa med pa dang /'gro gsum ste ngan 'gro gsum du mi skye ba ni sbyor lam bzod pa thob pa spyi'i yon tan yin te/ de thob nas/ der 'gro ba'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs spangs pa'i phyir/ bzod pa chen yo thob tshe/sgo nga dang drod gsher las skye ba'i skye gnas gnyis su mi skye ba dang / 'du shes med pa'i sems can dang / tshangs chen dang / sgra mi snyan rnams su mi skye ba dang / za ma dang ma ning 587

dang mtshan gnyis pa'i lus gami skye ba'i chos thob cing / bzod pa chen po thob tshene+e srid pa brgyad la sogs pa dang / mthong spang nyon mongs rnams te 'gro ba'i sgrib pa dang / skye gnas kyi sgrib pa dang / lus kyi sgrib pa dang / srid pa dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnams las ci rigs par mi skye ba'i bzod pa thob par gsungs so/ /thar cha thos bsam las byung gser 'phreng las/ /sgom gsung lus ngag yid kyi las gsum mo/ /bar cha zhes pa'i cha ni thob pa 'o/ /thes rab mngon rtogs gsum mo mtshungs ldan gnyis/ /mtshan nyid bzhi sogs bya ba gcig bu'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshogs lam mam thar ba cha mthun bshad pa la/thar ba cha mthun gyi ngo bo ni thos bsam las byung ba yin te/ thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i shes rab de/ de'i ngo bo yin gyi sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gseng 'phreng las sgom byung yod par gsungs kyang / gtso bo min te/ rtsa bar/ thos bsam las byung / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de las gsum gyis bsdus kyang yid las gtso che ste/ byang chub thob 'dod pa'i smon lam gyis zin pa'i dbang gis lus ngag gi las la thar ba cha mthun bzhag pa'i phyir/ byang chub thob 'dod kyis zin na de'i 588

sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang thos bsam nyung zad kyisakyang thar ba'i cha mthun skyed la/ des ma zin na sbyin sogs shin tu mang bo dag gis snyekyang thar ba cha mthun mi 'phen par gsungs pa'i phyir/ thar cha zhes pa'i cha ni de'i thob pa —yin la de la phan 'dogs pa dang skyed pas na de ltar brjod pa'o/ /gzhan yang /thar ba mya ngan las 'das pa yin zhing de'i cha ni de 'thob byed kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun yin la de la phan pas na de skad ces bya'o/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dbye na thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i theg pa gsum gyi mngon rtogs gsum mo/ /shes rab de dang sems sems byung gi mtshungs par ldan pa gnyis dang / de'i mtshan nyid skye sogs bzhi'i bya ba ni gcig pu'o/ /rten ni gling gsum gyi mi kho na'i nang du skyed do/ / chos srung n+de ba stong chen rab 'joms las/ /lta ba 'di la tshor ma thag cu ni/ /'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul lhags dang / /the chom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba/ /gsungs phyir bden pa mngon rtogs gabyug tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/bden pa mngon rtogs kyi skad cig ma'i grangs sde ba so so'i 'dod 589

tshul yod de/ dang bo chos srung sde ba sogs na re/ stong chen rab 'joms las/ lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ rajigatshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang / /the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bden pa mngon par rtogs pa gcig tu 'dod do/ /mang dag ldan pa'i mdo las khang ba'i rim/ /'og ma bzhag ste gong mar min bzhin gsungs/ /de phyir gzhan ne rim 'dod de la lang / /bzhi brgyad 'jig rten pa yi shes bzhir bcas/ /bcu gnyis skad cug par du ldang bar smra/ /kha che bcu drug(go)gcig bar zhugs 'bras 'gal/ / zhes gsungs te/ thams cad yod par smra ba sogs na re/bden pa mngon par rtogs pa skad cig ma gcig tu 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo las/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa mngon par ma rtogs par kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa mngon par rtogs par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de ni gnas med cing go skabs med do/ /zhes dang / dpe ni khang ba rtsegs ma'am khang ba rtsegs pa chen po'i rmang dang rtsig pa dang phyam so dang g.yogs ma rnams snga ma snga ma la rkang ba ma bzhag par phyi ma phyi ma la rkang ba bzhag par bya ba'i gnas med cing go 590

skabs med pa dang / zhes khang ba'i rim pa 'og ma bzhag ste gong mar rkang ba 'jog pa min pa bzhin yin par gsungs/ de'i cir gzhan ni rim par skye bar 'dod pa de la yang / bden pa mngon rtogs skad cig ma bzhir 'dod pa dang / brgyad 'dod pa dang / bcu gnyis 'dod pa dang / bcu drug 'dod pa rnams yod la/ dang bo/ bzhi ni/ bden pa la khams gong 'og gnyis mi byed par bden bzhi la shes pa'i skad cig ma bzhira'adod/ gnyis pa brgyad ni/ khams gong 'og gi bden pa bzhi bzhi byas nas chos shes bzhi dang rjes shes bzhi ste/ shes pa brgyad 'dod la bzod pa zur du mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa/ bcu gnyis ni/ khams 'og ma dang gong ma'i chos shes rjes shes brgyad dang de'i steng du gzhan 'jig rten pa'i shes pa bzhi dang bcu gnyis 'dod/ bzhi ba/ bcu drug ni/ kha che bye brag smra bas shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug 'dod do/ /chos srung sde sogs kyis skad cig ma gcig par 'dod pa ni/ zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas rnams thob tshul dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ — /stong chen bya ba'i mngon rtogs dbang byas te/ /chos brngod kyis spyang kun 'byung spong 'gog thob/ /la sogs phyi mar byed pa 'jug phyir lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'o na stong chen rab 'joms las/591

bden pa cig car mngon par rtogs par gsungs pa ci zhe na/de ni bya ba'i mngon par rtogs pa gcig pa'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa yin te/ sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis kyang kun 'byung spong zhing 'gog pa mngon du byed pa ste thob par byed pa la sogs pa phyi ma dag la snga ma'i byed pa 'jug pa'i phyir/ lo ni zer sgros de ltar yin zhes pa'i don no/ / — khyags gsum 'bras bu bzhi ste snas bdun po/ /thod rgal la 'khrul de la snas bzhi'o/ /dbai ston thes pa'i de la lha mi gnyis/ /brjoms kyang zid ba brgyad ba 'gal zhes zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'phags pa snga ma gsum gyi zhugs pa gsum dang / rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu sogs 'bras bu bzhi rdzas tha dad cing / phyir mi 'ong khyad par can nyid ni dgra bcom zhugs pa'ang yin pas rdzas bdun du 'gyur ro/ /zhes mchims ṭīka las gsungs pa de ni/ dgra bcom zhugs pa phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can yin pas rdzas logs su med snyam pa ni/ thod rgal ba'i phyir 'ong zhugs pa sdug bsngal rjes bzod la gnas pa lta bu snyam du 'khrul ba ste/ 'og tu/ chags bral sngon 'gro la phyir mi 'ong khyad par can nyid dgra bcom la zhugs pa'ang yin la zhugs pa snga ma gsum dang 'bras gnas 592

bzhi ste bdun du 'gyur ro/ /ming gis brgyad du rnam par bzhag pa'ang mthar gyis thob pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ 'dod chags dang bral ba sngon du 'gro ba la ni ma yin te/ phal cher dang 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba bden pa mngon rtogs skad cig bco lnga dang bcu drug pa thob pa ni rim pa ltar phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong la zhugs gnas kho na yin gyi rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong zhugs gnas ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas shes so/ /zhugs pa de la yang rdzas bzhi yod do/ /bye brag smra ba rnams na re/ rgyun zhugs srid pa lan bdun pa la/lha'i srid pa bdun dang /sna mi'i srid pa bdun dang bar do'i srid pa bdun‘tshan gnyis te srid pa nyer brgyad len pa yod kyang bdun tshan du 'dra ba'i phyir srid pa lan bdun zhes bya ste/ shing lo ma bdun pa bzhin no/ /zhes zer/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde ba na re/ lha mi gnyis bsdoms kyang / mdo las/ srid pa brgyad mngon par 'grub pa gang yin pa de ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de 'di ni gnas med do/ /zhes pa'i mdo dang 'gal te/ srid pa brgyad yod par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /tshe yongs 'gyur nges brgya byin 'og min du/ /smon pa ma bkag dga' phyir bye smra 'dod/ /der skye mi dgos gsungs 593

na ches dga' mod/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dod par tshe yongs 'gyur gyi 'phags pa ni/ shi 'phos nas slar yang tshe gnyis par 'dod par skyes te phyir mi 'ong thob par byas nas dgra bcom pa thob par byed de/ de ni khams gzhan du 'gro ba min gsungs pa la/ 'o na brgya byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ brgya byin gyis/bdag ni tha mar nyams na lha gang 'og min zhes pa der ni skye bar 'gyur bar shog bcom ldan bdag ni rgyun zhugs bde gshegs rgyun zhugs te/ zhes rang nyid rgyun zhugs yin par yang bshad cing / de nas mir skyes nas mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur cigader myang 'das ma thob na gzugs khams su skye bar gyur cig rdzices/ de nas gzugs khams su skye bar smon lam btab la/ ston pas kyang / legs so brgya byin bag yod par ni gnas par gyis/ zhes gsungs nas dgag pa ma mdzad pa'i phyir de dang 'gal te/ brgya byin ni mir skyes na 'dod par tshe yongs 'gyur gyi 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de ni brgya byin gyis chos mngon pa ma shes pa'i sbyor yin la/ ston pas ma bkag pa ni brgya byin dga' bar bya ba'i phyir yin no zhes bye brag smra ba 'dod la/ dga' bar bya ba'i phyir yin na/ 'dod khams der skye mi dgos gsungs na ches cher dga' bar 'gyur mod/ de ltar ma 594

gsungs pa ci yin zhes bye brag smra ba la 'phangs so sbyir mi 'ong lngar spangs pa rigs dbang bos/ /khri dang nyis stong dgu brgya drug cur dbye/ /rdor ting dmigs pa'i skug kun zid rtses te/ /khrad chos brgyad las ci rigs yin phyir brgyad/ /ces gsungs te/ phyir mi 'ong lnga la spang bya spong tshul dang rigs dang dbang bo'i sgo nas dbye ba byas na khri gcig dang nyis stong dgu brgya drug cu yod de/ phyir mi 'ong bar 'da' ba sogs—rigs lnga re re la nyis stong lnga brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis re yod pa'i phyir/ ji ltar yod na tshangs ris lta bu'i gnas gcig na phyir mirna'ong rigs kyi drug dang rigs re re la'ang gzugs kyi 'ching ba —mtha' dag dang ldan pa nas brgyad pa spangs pa'i bar dgu dgu ste/ dgu drug lnga bcu nga bzhi dang gnas kyis phye na lngabacu dang bzhi ba phrag bcu drug ni brgyad brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi yin no/ / de la dbang bo gsum gyis phye na sum 'gyur nyis stong dang lnga brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnas bcu drug ni/tshangs chen ma gtogs pa'i gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu drug4dang / rigs ni nyams pa'i rtsos can la sogs pa drug spang byas phye na 'ching ba kun ldan dang rang sa'i nyon mongs brgyad pa spangs pa'i bar dgu dang / dbang bos phye na dbang bo rno 'bring 595

rtul gsum mo/ /rten gyis phye na gling gsum gyi mi dang 'dod lha rigs drug ste dgu'o/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin de yang sa'i sgo nas dbye na dgu ste/ bsam gtan sa drug dang / gzugs med dang bo sa/sum la brten pa'o/ /dmigs pa'i sgo ma/sa dbye ba bzhi ste/ bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye na bcu drug ste/ bden bzhi'i khyad chos mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam par byed pa'i phyir/ mi lcogs med la brten pa'i rdorje lta bu'i de nyid 'og sa'i zag bcas la mi dmigs kyi/ srid rtse kho na'i sdug kun gnyis la dmigs te/ khyad chos brgyad las ci rigs la dmigs pa yin phyir rjes shes phyogs kyi rnam pa brgyagal dmigs pa yin no/ /sa dgu'i 'gog la rnam pa so drug ste/ /'dod pa'i lam bzhi gong lam sbyir dmigs pa'i/ /bzhi ste nyer bsdogs brten pa nga gnyis so/ /bsam gtan lnga la'ang nga gnyis nga gnyis so/ /nam mkhar brte na na 'dod pa'i 'gog lam brgyad/ /gzugs 'gog bcu drug bor bas nyer brgyad steng / /rnam shes la ni nam mkha'i 'gog bzhi bor/ /ci yang med la de'i bzhi bor ba yin/ /gzugs kyi sum brgya bcu gnyis lhag don gnyis/ /bsdoms pas rdor ting sum brgya gya bzhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams gsum sa dgu'i 'gog pa'i bden pa la 596

dmigs pa'i rnam pa so drug yod de/ 'dod pa'i 'gog pa la dmigs pa'i chos shes bzhi dang / sa gong ma gzugs kyi bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi ste brgyad kyi 'gig pa la dmigs pa'i rjes shes bzhi re yod pas dgu bzhi so drug yod do/ /'dod pa'i lam bden la dmigs pa'i chos shes bzhi dang / gong ma'i lam bden spyi la dmigs pa'i rjes shes bzhi ste/ nyer bsdogs la brten pa nga gnyis yod de/ sdug kun la dmib/sa pa'ingarjes shes phyogs kyi brgyad dang /tho 'gog bden la dmigs pa so drug dang /lam bden la dmigs pa brgyad de/ de dag bsdoms pas nga gnyis yod la/ de bzhin du bsam gtan bzhi dang bsam gtan—khyad par can te lnga la'ang re re la nga gnyis nga gnyis re yod/nam mkha' mtha' yas la brten na/ gong gi nga gnyis las/'dod pa'i 'gog lam la dmigs pa brgya da dang / gzugs kyi bsam gtan bzhi'i 'gog pa la dmigs pa bcu drug ste nyer bzhi bor bas lhag ma nyer brgyad yod pa dang / rnam shes mtha' yas la brten na/ gong gi nyer brgyad las/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi bzhi bor bas lhag ma nyer bzhi yod pa dang / ci yang med la brten na gong gi nyer bzhi las rnam shes mtha' yas kyi bzhi bor bas lhag ma nyi shu yod do/ /de ltar gzugs kyi bsam gtan 597

sa drug gis bsdus pa la sum brgya dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i/gzugs med dang bo gsum gyi bdun cu don gnyis yod pa'i/lhag pa de bsnan na/ mnyam du bsdoms na rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni sum brgya dang gya bzhi yod do/ /sde ba kha cig 'jig rten 'das kyi mang / /bral thob zag bcas yod de dbang 'apos pas/ /zag med btang yang nyon mongs mi ldan phyir/ /khrod la 'dra ste zid gnyen zag bcas med/ /'on spyang de zud spangs pa dbang 'apos tshe/ / bral thob btang lang gyed mi ldan byar dang / /byis pa gnyis bar skye yang 'dod pa la/ /chags bral thob btang chags dang mi ldan bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sde ba kha cig na re/'jig rten las 'dasapa'i bral thob la zag bcas yod de/ de med na sdon 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la brten nas/ ci phang med pa'i skye mched las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir mi 'ong dbang rtul zhig bsam gtan gyi sems la brten nas dbang bo rnon por 'pho ba na lam snga ma btang ba'i phyir dang / 'jig rten pa'i bral thob kyang med na nam mkha' mtha' yas la sogs pa'i gong ma'i nyon mongs dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de dag gis bral thob zag med btang la zag bcas med pa'i phyir/ des na 598

de 'dra'i 'phags pa des 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bral thob btang mod gong ma'i nyon mongs mi ldan pas/ 'jig rten pa'i bral thob zag bcas yod do/ /zhes zer/ mdo sde ba sogs kyi lan gdab pa ni/ de ni khyod rang la'ang 'dra ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis srid rtse'i nyon mongs phyed de brgyad pa man chad ci rigs las grol ba'i 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong dbang rtul bsam gtan la brten nas dbang bo 'phos pa'i tshe 'jig rten pa'i bral thob med la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bral thob dbang bo 'phos pas btang bas bral thob gnyis ka med kyang / srid rtse'i nyon mongs mi ldan pa khyed rang gis kyang khas len pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dper na bsam gtan dang bo nas bsam gtan gnyis par skyes pa'i byis pa ste so skye la'ang 'dod pa'i nyon mongs spangs pa'i bral thob gnyis ka med kyang 'dod pa'i nyon mongs mi ldan pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gong gi 'phags pa sa 'phos pa la gong ma'i nyon mongs mi ldan pa ni sa bon spangs pas yin la/ gong gi so skye sa 'phos pa la 'og ma'i nyon mongs mi ldan pa ni rkyen ma tshang bas yin gyi bral ba'i thob pa yod pas ni ma yin no/ /zhes mdo sde ba sogs 'dod do/ /599

bye mdos bablas pa rnam grangs 'dod tshul gnyis/ /nes gsungs te/ bye smra'i lugs la/ chos 'khor ni 'khor lnga we bzang bo la/ bden bzhi lan gsum dang bzlas pa bcu gnyis su bzlas pa'i tshe/ lnga sde de dag gi rgyud la mthong lam skyes shing / de lta bu'i mthong lam de ni chos 'khor yin par 'dod pas/ chos 'khor la rtogs pa'i chos 'khor dang de yang mthong lam kho nas khyad par 'dod do/ /mthong lam ni/ shes bzod skad cig ma bco lnga ni mthong lam yin la/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes ni sgom lam du 'dod do/ /bden bzhi lan gsum du bzlas shing rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor tshul ni/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /de yongs su shes par bya'o/ /de yongs su shes so/ /zhes pa ni bezlas pa gsum dang / bzlas pa de re re la mig skyes so/ /shes pa skyes so/ /rig pa skyes so/ /blo skyes so/ /zhes pa ni rnam pa bcu gnyis te/ bden pa gzhan rnams la yang 'dra'o/ /so sor phye na bzlas pa bcu gnyis dang rnam grangs zhe brgyad 'byung yang / gsum tshan dang—bcu gnyis su chos mthun pa'i phyir bzlas pa gsum dang rnam grangs bcu gnyis su bshad de/ gnas bdun la mkhas pa'i dge slong bzhin no/ /zhes zer rgo /mdo sde ba'i lugs la/ 600

'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes sogs bzhi ni ngo bo la bzlas pa dang / shes par bya/ spang bar bya/ mngon du bya/ bsgom par bya/ zhes pa bya ba la bzlas pa dang / shes so/ /spangs so/ /mngon du byas so/ /bsgoms so/ /zhes pa byed pa la bzlas pa ste rnam grangs bcu gnyis kyang de yin no/ /'di ni mdo sde ba yan chad phal cher 'dra'o/ /kun btus la sogs 'pho ba lngas 'dod par/ /gong mar gnas las mi spyod mi g.yo gnyis/ /rtog pa'i 'os can mi g.yor 'apo ba la/ /brel ngan byang bzhin goms phyir lam bco brgyad/ /ces gsungs te/ kun btus la sogs te bye mdo gnyis kas dbang bo 'pho ba nges par 'dod pa'i mi rnams kyi nang kho nar 'phel bar 'dod de/ khams gong dang 'dod lha na de nyams pa med pa'i phyir/ spyir dgra bcom drug khams gsum na yod rung nyams nges dang dbang bo 'pho nges byas na/'dod pa'i khams kyi mi na drug dang / gong na gnas pa las mi spyod pa dang mi g.yo chos can gnyis yod/ rtog pa'i 'os can te rtog pa'i skal ba can mi g.yo bar dbang bo 'pho na zag med lam bco brgyad la brten dgos te/ dper na brel ba ngan pa ste rnam g.yeng la byang zhing goms pa bzhin du/ dbang 601

bo rtul bo'i rigs yun ring du goms par byas pa 'bad pa chung ngus bzlog mi nus pa'i phyir bar chad med lam dgu dang rnam grol lam dgu ste dgu gnyis bco brgyad dgos nga/'i phyir ro/ /mi blob zag med(sa dgu)blob la gzugs med dor/ /de tshe rtul bos khrad par can btang nas/ /rjon pos tsam po thob cing 'bras gnyis kyi/ /tsam po gzugs med brtsas pa med phyir rdza /zhes gsungs te/ mi slob pa gang la brten nas dbang bo 'pho rbo yod de/ zag med kyi mi lcogs med pa nas gzugs med dang bo gsum tshun chad kyi zag med sa dgu gang rung la brten pa'i r+shaphyir/ slob pa phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong da da mos gnyis ni dbang bo 'pho ba la gzugs med kyi sa dor te bsam gtan sa rdzi drug gang rung la brten pa'o/ /de dag gi dbang bo 'pho ba de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de dag gi dbang bo 'phel zhing 'pho ba ni/ dbang rtul gyi lam 'bras dang 'bras bu khyad par can btang nas/ dbang rnon gyi phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu tsam po thob cing phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong gnyis kyi 'bras bu tsam po la sogs pa gzugs med kyi sas bsdus pa med pa'i phyir/ gzugs med dor te bsam gtan sa drug la brten pa yin no/ /nyan thos bdun dang sangs rgyas gnyis te dgur/ /602

dbang bo skor dgu'o 'phags tshogs gang zag bdun/ /la brtsas sbyor bas dad dang chos rjes 'brang / /dbang bo'i sgo nas dad mos mthong thob gnyis/ /stoms par 'jug pa'i sgo nas lus mngon byed/ /rnam grol las ni shes rab kyis rmam grol/ /snyoms 'jug rnam grol gnyi ga'i rgyan bcas pa/ /dzis su drug ste mthong la rjes 'brang gnyis/ /sgom la dad mos mthong thob mi slob la/ /dus sbyo ra mi spyor rnam grol rnam gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs te/dgra bcom dgur dbye ba ni/ nyan thos bdun dang sangs rgyas gnyis te dgu yod/ sangs rgyas gnyis ni/ rang sangs rgyas dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis so/ /nyan thos bdun ni/dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / chos kyi rjes 'brang dang / dad mos pa dang / mthong thob pa dang / lus mngon byed dang /shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba dang / gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba ste bdun no/ /dgu bo de la dbang bo'i sgo nas skor dgu re yod/ dbang bo rno 'bring rtul gsum dang / de re re la che 'bring chung gsum byas pa'i skor dgu re yod do/ / dhegang zag bdun po de ni/ sbyor ba dang / dbang bo dang /snyoms 'jug dang / rnam grol dang / gnyis ka'i cha las grol ba lngas so sor 'jog pa yin te/ 'phags pa'i tshogs gang zag—603

bdun la bsdus nas sbyor bas dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis 'jog la/ dbang bo'i sgo nas dad mos pa dang mthong thob pa gnyis 'jog pa dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgo nas lus mngon byed dang / nyon mongs las rnam par grol ba'i sgo nas shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba 'joganyon mongs las rnam grol dang 'gog snyoms thob pa'i sgo nas gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba 'jog pa de yin pa'i phyir/ming gi bdun po de rdzas su drug tu 'du ste mthong lam la dad dang chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis/ sgom lam la dad mos pa dang mthong thob pa gnyis/ mi slob lam la dus kyi rnam par grol ba dang dus dang mi sbyor ba'i rnam par grol ba dang gnyis te drug 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ / lam bzhi'i spyor lam 'azhi la sgom yang ste/ /mjug tu spebar chad med skye kun phyir ro/ /bsam gtan dngos gzhi sla la khrad can dang / /nyer bsdogs lhag mthong gzugs med zhi ches pas/ /dka' 'o rjon pos dka' sla gang brten kyang / / mngon shes byur la skul bos gang yang bul/ /dka' sla rten dang myur bul dbang bo'i phyir/ /nyer bsdogs la brten mngon shes 'di'i mdos 'grub/ /ces gsungs te/ lam gyi dbye 604

ba spyir bstan pa la/ mdor bsdu na lam rnam pa bzhi ste/ sbyor ba'i lam dang / bar chad med lam dang / rnam grol lam dang / khyade par gyi lam bzhir 'du la/ 'di'i sbyor ba'i lam zhes pa sta gon gyi ming yin pas nges 'byed cha mthun te lam lnga'i nang gi sbyor lam du go bar mi bya gsungs/ skabs 'di'i lam bzhi'i nang gi sbyor lam 'di la bar chad med lam gyi rgyu zer la/bar chad med lam la sgom pa'i lam yang zer te/ rang gi mjug thog tu bar chad med lam skye ba'i lam kun skabs 'di'i sbyor ba'i lam yin no/ /des na dang bo sbyor ba'i lam ni bar chad med lam gyi rgyu yin la/ gnyis pa bar chad med lam ni sgrib pa 'a/ dngos su gnod byed yin/ gsum pa rnam grol lam ni/ sgrib pa las grol ba dang bor skyes pa'o/ /bzhi ba khyad par gyi lam ni—de yan chad kyi lam yin te/ rgyu bsags pa'i sgo nas snga ma las ches khyad par du 'gro ba'i phyir/ yang lam de la dka' sla dang myur bul bzhi yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi yan lag gis zin pa dang zhi lhag cha mnyam pas na lam gsal la skebartan pa 'bad mi dgos par ngang gis 'byung bas lam bskyed pa sogs sla la/ gzhan bsam gtan dang bo'i dngos gzhi khyad par can dang / nyer bsdogs brgyad ni lhag mthong shas che bas la mas605

gsal yang mi brtan pa'i dka' ba dang / gzugs med dngos gzhi bzhi zhi ches pa ste zhi gnas shas che la yan lag gis ma zin pas brtan yang mi gsal bas lam bskyed pa dka' 'o/ /dbang bo rnon pos lam dka' sla gang brten kyang mngon shes myur la/dbang bo rtul bos lam dka' 'am sla yang rung mngon shes bul ba yin no/ /dka' sla sems rten gyi dbang gis yin la/ myur bul dbang bo rno rtul gyi dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ nyer bsdogs la brten pa'i mngon shes yod pa 'di'i mdos 'grub gsungs so// /mdo ni/ dge slong dag lam ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ mngon par shes pa bul la dka' ba'i lam dang / mngon par shes pa myur la dka' ba'i lam dang / mngon par shes pa myur la sla ba'i lam mo/ /zhes gsungs/ bul la dka' ba'i mngon shes dang /myur la dka' ba'i mngon shes ni/ bsam gtan khyad par can dang / mi lcogs med dang / gzugs med la brten pa dag las gzhan bsam gtan dag gi lam rnams la brten pa ni sla ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub kyi phyogs sum cu rtsa bdun ni/ theg pa gsum gyi rang rang gi zad pa dang mi skye ba'i ye shes de rang rang gi byang chub yin la/ de dag dang phyogs mthun pa'i lam yin pas/ byang 606

phyogs so bdun zhes brjod/ de sum cu ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba bzhi/ dbang so lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad de ming gi sgo nas sde tshan bdun yod/ /rdzas su bcur 'du ste/ dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang /dran pa dang / shes rab dang / ting nge 'dzin deng / btang snyoms dang / dga' ba dang / rtog pa dang / tshul khrims dang / shin sbyangs dang bcur 'du'o/ /de dag gi skabs kyi dka' gnad rnams sdom 'dir bsdus pa ni/ grub mtha' gong mas sku 'asprul sprul bskur dang / /skung ba ting 'dzin 'dun sogs de rgyur bshad/ /bye smras sku 'phul ting 'dzin 'dun sogs skung / /'dun bems dbyod bcas bcu gsum dzis su thal/ /zhes gsungs te/ grub mtha' gong ma theg chen grub mtha' smra bas/ rdzu 'phrul ni med pa 'phrul ba dang yod pa bsgyur ba ste/ sprul ba dang bsgyur ba la 'dod cing / rkang ba ni ting nge 'dzin yin te/ yon tan thams cad 'byor ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rten yin pa dang / 'dun pa dang brtson 'grus sogs ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba'i rgyu yin par bshad do/ /bye brag smra bas/ rdzu 'phrul ni ting nge 'dzin kho na yin la/ rkang ba ni 'dun pa dang sems 607

dang brtson 'grus dang dpyod pa bzhi yin no / /zer la/ de ltar na byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'ang rdzas bcu gsum du 'gyur te/ 'dun pa dang sems kyang byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /khyab ste/ 'dun sems dpyod bcas zhes de gsum ga rkang ba yin par 'dra bar khyod kyis bshad pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims lus ngag dbye bas snas bcu gcig /bsdu bar lnga yis so bdun ma bsngus gsungs/ /byang lag 'phagos lam go rim grangs phyir lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ bye brag smra ba ltar na/ tshul khrims ni gzugs can du 'dod pas lus ngag gi las rdzas tha dad cing rigs mi mthun pa'i phyir rdzas bcu gcig yin no/ /grub mtha' smra ba gzhan dag ni tshul khrims spong ba'i sems phar 'dod la de gcig yin pa'i phyir rdzas gcig tu 'dod do/ /rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ dad sogs lnga dang byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu bo dag phan tshun bsdus sam zhe na/ sum cu rtsa bdun gyis lnga bsdus kyi/ lngas ni sum cu rtsa bdun ma bsdus so/ /gang ma bsdus she na/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang / las kyi mtha' dang / 'tsho ba dang /dga' ba dang / shin sbyangs dang / btang snyoms te drug po rnams so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bye smra na re/ sde tshan bdun 608

po de ni so rim las ni dang bo dag dang nges 'byed cha mthun rnams dang sgom lam dang mthong lam brgyad lda rim pa bzhin bzhag ste/ dran nye dag tshogs lam nas/ yang dag spong ba drod nas/ rdzu 'phrul rkang ba rtse mo nas/ dbang bo lnga bzod pa nas/ stobs lnga chos mchog nas/ byang chub yan lag sgom lam nas/ 'phags lam yan lag mthong lam nas bzhag ste/ byang chub yan lag dang 'phags lam yan lag sgom lam dang mthong lam la bzhag pa ni/ sde tshan bdun gyi go rim gyi grangs yin pa'i phyir/ lo zhes zur za ste/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang theg chen lugs la nyer bzhag tshogs lam chung ngu nas/ yang dag spong ba 'bring nas/ rdzu 'phrul rkang ba chen po nas/ dbang bo drod nas/ stobs bzod pa nas/ byang chub yan lag mthong lam nas/ 'phags lam yan lag sgom lam dang sbyar ro/ /nam mkha'i nyer bajogs dran nye zag bcas kyis/ /bzhi ba'i zag bcas gzugs dmigs gzugs med pa/ /gsum gyi dngos gzhi zag bcas zag med kyis/ /sa drug zag med sdom dmigs brad rtse yi/ /zag bcas kyis kyang zag med sdom la dmigs/ /de byir gzugs med na lang lus dran nye/ /yod de sde tshan mtha' gnyis ma gtogs phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs med rang 609

sa na gzugs med kyang nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi nyer bsdogs la brten pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag dge ba zag bcas kyis/ bsam gtan bzhi ba'i gzugs zag bcas la dmigs pa'i phyir dang /'og ma la dmigs pur bshad pa ni dngos gzhi'i dge bas zag bcas la dmigs pa yin la/ gzugs med dang bo gsum gyi dngos gzhi dge ba zag bcas zag med kyis bsam gtan sa drug la brten pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa la dmigs pa'i phyir dang /srid rtse'i shes rab dge ba zag bcas kyis/ bsam gtan la brten pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir gzugs med na lus dran pa nyer bzhag yod de/ sde tshan bdun gyi mtha' ma gnyis ma gtogs pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dad dang tshul khrims 'dir gsungs gnas drug pa/ /mngon rtogs bdun gyis brtsas nas 'chad 'dod phyir/ /blob la lta stog ngag sogs yan lag brgyad/ /mi blob la ni de rtseng rnam grol dang / /mi slob yang dag shes pa bsnan pa'i bcu/ /mos pa rnam grol zhes bya dga' lhaje ba/ /byang chub nyid du sngar bshad zad mi skye/ /shes de skabs 'gi'i yang dag ye shes so/ /zhes gsungs te/shes nas dad pa thob tshul ni/ bden pa dang bo gsum mngon sum du mthong na tshul khrims dang chos la shes nas dad pa thob pa 610

yin te/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam gyi bden pa mngon par rtogs pa na sangs rgyas dang de'i dge 'dun la shes nas dad pa 'thob ste/ de la mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ dmigs yul gyi chos de la du ma yod de/ bden pa dang bo gsum dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de yang rdzas su na gnyis su 'du ste/ dad pa dang tshul khrims dri med zag med gnyis su 'du ba yin zhes dad pa dang tshul khrims gnyis 'dir gsungs nas/ gnas drug pa 'dir/ lam rnams mngon rtogs bdun gyis bsdus nas 'chad 'dod pa'i phyir/ tshogs sbyor mthong sgom slob lam lnga bshad zin nas/ 'dir mi slob lam gnyis 'chad pa ni/ mdo las/ mi slob pa ni mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba nas ting nge 'dzin gyi brgyad dang / mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i rnam par grol ba dang / mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa ste yan lag bcu dang ldan no/ /zhes gsungs/slob pa la yang dag pa'i rnam grol dang yang dag pa'i shes pa ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ slob pa ni nyon mongs/ pas bcings pa'i phyir/ slob pa la yang dag pa'i lta ba dang yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang yang dag pa'i ngag sogs yan lag brgyad dang ldan la/ ye 611

mi slob pa la'ang yang dag pa'i lta ba nas ting nge 'dzin gyi bar 4brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng / mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i rnam grol dang / mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa gnyis bsnan pa'i yan lag bcu dang ldan no/ /rnam grol de la gnyis yod de/ nyon mongs bcom pa 'dus ma byas kyi rnam grol 'gog bden dang /rnam grol der nges pa mos pa rnam grol 'dus byas kyi rnam grol —lam dang gnyis yod/ mos pa rnam grol zhes bya ba ni/ rnam par grol ba'i phung bo de thob pa la nges pa rnyed nas sems dga' lhang lhang ba de nyid yin no/ /'dus byas rnam grol lam la gnyis yod de/ sems rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rnam parar+shagrol ba gnyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ shes rab rnam par grol ba la/ sems gang rnam par grol ba dang / lam gang gi stobs kyis rnam par grol ba gnyis/ dang bo ni/ byang chub nyid du sngar ji skad bshad pa'i zad mi skye shes pa de skabs 'di'i yang dag pa'i ye shes yin te/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung bo yin pa'i phyir/ 'gag 'gyur blob pa'i lam gyis sgrib spangs nas/ /skye 'gyur mi blob sems ni grol bar 'gyur/ /ma byas rnam grol la ni chags bral sogs/ /khams gsum shes bya chags bral yid 'byung mu/ /thod rgal la brtsi 61 2

ma thar gyis la lang rung / /zhes gsungs te/ mi slob pa'i sems ni skye 'gyur ma 'ong ba'i sgrib pa las rnam par grol ba yin la/'o na sgrib pa de gang gis spangs pa yin zhe na/ 'gag 'gyur 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i slob pa'i lam gyis sgrib pa spa ngas nas/ skye 'gyur mi slob pa'i sems ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /'o na dngos po de gang gis yid 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dngos po des 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ram zhe na/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung la dmigs pa'i bzod pa dang shes pa rnams kyis bden pa de gnyis la yid 'byung bar 'gyur te/ zag bcas dman pa skyon du blta bar 'gyur/ des na 'dus ma byas rnam grol la ni chags bral la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ khams gsum gyi sdug kun sogs shes bya la chags bral byed pa dang / yid 'byung ba la mu bzhi brtsi ste/ dang bo/ yid 'byung bar 'gyur la chags bral du mi 'gyur ba ni/ sdug kun la dmigs pa'i sgom lam sbyor lam rnam grol lam dang / chags bral sngon song gi bden pa dang bo gnyis la dmigs pa'i chos bzod dang chos shes lta bu/ gnyis pa/ chags bral byed la/ yid 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba ni/chags bral sngon song gi 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i bar chad med lam lta bu/ gsum pa/ gnyis ka yin pa chags bral hūṃn du ma 613

rtso/nga ba'i bden pa dang bo gnyis la dmigs pa'i bar chad med tā ma lta bu/ bzhi ba/ gnyis ka ma yin pa ni/ 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i sbyor ba dang rnam grol lam dang khyad par gyi lam dang / chags bral sngon song gi 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i bar chad med lam lta bu'o/ /de ltar du thod rgal la brtsi yang mthar gyis la yang rung ste/ mtha' dpyod las/ sdug kun la dmigs pa'i sbyor lam dang shes pa dang / khyad par gyi lam mi slob lam rnams yid 'byung yin la/ nyon mongs dang bral byed min pardzidang / 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i bar chad med lam ni nyon mongs spong byed yin la yid 'byung min/ sdug kun la dmigs pa 'i bar chad med lam ni gnyis ka yin/ 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i sbyor lam dang rnam grol lam yid 'byung dang chags pa dang bral byed gnyis ka ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar yang rung kyang mdzod kyi dgongs pa chags bral sngon songagi mngon rtogs sems bcu drug dang sbyar nas chags pa dang bral ma bral bshad rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so/ / mngon rtogs zad mi skye ba'i ye shes mchog /mngon par rnyed pa'i kun mkhyen gyis gsungs pa'i/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi rim pa 'di dag ni/ / 614

mngon par mkhyen pa 'i bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod/ /gnas drug pa'i skabs so/ /gnas bdun pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/chos bcu rig pa'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /chos kyi dpal stsol bka' drin gzhal dka' ba'i/ /chos rje gtsug gi rgyan du legs bsten nas/ /chos ldan gtam gyis dal 'byor don yod bya/ /'dir gnas bdun pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig cung zad 'grel ba la/ chos bathod bathod shes gnyis kyi shes pa min/ /skyal der the tshom spangs nas res min sbyir/ /zad shes tshol ba' rang bzhin can min phyir/ /lta min 'phags blo gzhan ni gnyis ka ste/ /zhes gsungs te/ dri med bzod pa brgyad kyi shes rab rnams ni/ bzod shes gnyis kyi shes pa ma yin te/ de yul de la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa'am 'dod pa'i ngo bor skyes kyang yul the tshom spangs pa'i nges pa'i ngo bor ma skyes pa'i phyir/'dir bzod shes gnyis kyi shes pa'i dbang du byas so/ /bzod pa brgyad kyi shes rab de/ lta ba4 yin te/ bzod pa dang lta ba 615

yin la skabs 'di'i shes pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i blo ni/ nye bar rtog pa med cing yongs su tshol ba'i rang bzhin can ma yin pa'i phyir lta ba min te/ lta ba zhes pa byed tshig yin pas lta rtog dang tshol ba'i rang bzhin yin dgos pa'i phyir/ bzod pa dang zad mi skye shes pa dag las gzhan 'phags pa'i blo sdug bsngal chos shes sogs brgyad kyi shes rab ni/ bzod shes kyi shes pa dang lta ba gnyis ka yin te/ rang gi yul de la the tshom spangs pas nges pa'i ngo bo dang / nye bar rtog pa'i ngo bo yin padza phyir ro/ /chags sogs blo yang lta min kun rdzob shes/ /de phyir gzhan shes zhes gsungs de'i dmigs bsal/ /lta ba drug ni lta dang kun rdzob shes/ /zhes gsungs te/ zag med las gzhan pa'i 'jig rten pa'i shes n+d+rab rnam shes tshogs drug dang / chags sogs dang mtshungs ldan mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi shes rab rnams ni lta ba min te/ lta ba dang shes pa gnyis kyi nang nas shes pa yin te/ kun rdzob shes pa yin pa'i phyir/de'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ gzhan shes zhes gsungs pa spyir btang yin la/ de'i dmigs bsal sbyar ba ni/ ston mongs can gyi lta ba lnga dang 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang drug ni/ kun rdzob shes pa yin par ma zad lta ba'ang yin te/ rtog cing tshol 616

ba'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/chos shes rjes shes kun rdzob shes gsum sbyi/ /sems shes bden bzhi zad dang mi skye shes/ /gong 'ogariden bzhi'i chos shes rjes thes brgyad/ /bcu gnyis 'byed tshul lta min chos shes bzhi/ /rjes shes bzhi la zad dang mi skye brgyad/ /gsungs pa'i chos shes mi blob yin min dang / /de la brgya da du mi 'byed rgyu mtshan dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dir bstan pa'i shes pa la bcu yod de/ chos shes pa/ rjes su shes pa/ kun rdzob shes pa/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa/ sdug bsngal shes pa/ kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ lam shes pa/ zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa ste bcu yod/ de bsdu na zag bcas dang zag med gnyis su 'du ste/ kun rdzob shes pa mtha' dag zag bcas dang / pha rol sems shes la zag bcas zag med gnyis ka yod/ lhag ma rnams zag med kho nar nges so/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ rgyas bshad la/ chos shes dang / rjes shes dang / kun rdzob shes pa gsum ni spyi'i sdud byed yin te/ zag bcas dang zag med gnyis su shes pa bcu bo de 'du bas/ kun rdzob shes pa ni zag bcas yin la/ zag med shes pa la chos shes dang rjes shes gnyis yod do/ /rgyas 617

bshad la pha rol sems shes bshad pa/ bden bzhi'i shes pa bshad pa/ zad pa dang mi skye shes pa bshad pa'o/ /chos shes rjes shes la brgyad dang bcu gnyis su dbye ba gnyis yod de/ khams 'og ma 'dod pa'i bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i chos shes bzhi dang / gong ma'i bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i rjes shes bzhi ste brgyad do/ /bcu gnyis su dbye tshul ni lta ba'i rang bzhin ma yin pa'i chos shes bzhi dang / rjes shes bzhi la rgyun chags pa'i dbang du byas nas zad pa shes pa bzhi dang / mi skye ba shes pa bzhi ste bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar gsungs pa'i chos shes de mi slob lam yin min dang / de la chos shes bzhi dang rjes shes bzhi zhes brgyad du mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan dpyad gsungs te/ dpyad tshul ni/ gnyis las brgyad du dbye ba de ni/ gong 'og gi bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i slob lam gyi dbye ba yin la/bzhi las bcu gnyis su dbye ba ni/ mi slob lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbye ba yin ma/ma snyam ste/ zad dang mi skye ba 'dren lugs kyis shes so snyam mo/ /dang bo'i zad dang mi skye(rtse'i) rtsag kun la/ /dmigs pa dug mda' 'chi tshe rtsad pa bzhin/ /chos rjes lam dang kun rdzob bzhi las sems/ /sa 'das gong sa dbang 'das rjon po'i lam/ /gang zag 'das pa 'bras gnas gong 618

ma'i lam/ /mi shes zhig dang ma skyes gnyis kyang ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ dang bo'i zad pa dang mi skye shes pa de gnyis kyis ni/ srid rtse'i sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung la dmigs pa yin te/srid rtse'i sgom spang dgu ba la dmigs nas rdo rje lta bu'i rjes su dang bo zad shes sdug bsngal shes so sogs dang / de nas mi skye shes pa sdug bsngal shes te slar shes par bya ba med do sogs skye ba 'i phyir te/ dper na/ dug mda' phog ste shi ba yan lag thams cad la khyab nas shi ba'i tshe rma'i phyogs kho nar gnas pa ltar/ rnal 'byor ba 'di'i shes pa srid rtse'i phung bo'i mtshan nyid kho na la gnas pa'i phyir/ pha rol sems shes de/ chos shes/ rjes shes/ lam shes/ kun rdzob shes pa ste bzhi las sems shes skye ba yin te/ pha rol sems shes la zag bcas zag med la dmigs pa gnyis yod pa'i zag bcas la dmigs pa gang yin kun rdzob shes pa dang / zag med la dmigs pa ni lam shes kyis khyab cing / de la chos shes rjes shes gnyis yod pas gsum dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ pha rol sems shes kyi yul nges pa can yin te/ sa 'og ma'i sems shes kyis sa 'das pa gong ma'i sems mi rig dbang rtul dad mos lta bu'i sems shes kyis dbang bo 'das pa dbang rnon mthong thob pa'i sems mi rig gang zag 619

gli'adas pa 'bras gnas gong ma'i lam mi shes te/ phyir mi 'ong gi sems shes kyis dgra bcom pa'i sems mi rig pa'i phyir/ de da lta ba kho na'i yul can yin te/ des pha rol gyi sems zhig pa 'das pa dang / ma skyes pa ma 'ongs pa mi rig pa'i phyir ro/ /chos zhes rjes zhes la dmigs gnyis po yang / /phan tshun mi rig mthong lam la bltas tshe/ /nyan thos smyor ba skad cig bcu bzhi yis/ /mi 'grub dang bo gnyis rig lhag mi rig /rang rgyal skad cig lnga la spyor byed phyir/ /dang bo gnyis rig brgyad pa rjes shes rig /gnyis pa khams gzhan phyir 'dor lhag ma la/ /slar yang bskyar na rdzor ba rdzogs mi nus/ /dgu ba rig na bas ba rig nus sam/ /'dod na rang rgyal mthong lam bzhi rig 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos shes phyogs dang rjes shes phyogs gnyis phan tshun mi rig ste/ chos shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i pha rol sems shes kyis rjes shes phyogs mthun dang bcas pa mi rig rjes shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i pha rol sems shes kyis chos shes phyogs mthun dang bcas pa mi rig pa'i phyir/ nyan thos rgyud kyi pha rol sems shes kyis mthong lam chos bzod dang chos shes te skad cig ma dang bo gnyis rig la/ gzhan mi rig ste /skad cig ma rnams dmigs rnam mi mthun pas/ de shes ched du 620

—sbyor ba byas na skad cig ma bcu bzhi yi yun la sbyor ba mi 'grub pa'i de'i bar la skad cig ma bcu bzhi bo 'gag 'gro la 'gag pa yul du mi byed pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir dang bo gnyis rig la lhag ma mi rig go /bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi pha rol sems shes kyis skad cig ma dang bo gnyis dang brgyad pa gsum rig ste/ nyan thos ni sbyor ba chen pos bsgrub dgos la 'di ni sbyor ba la rtsol ba chung bas/ dang bo gnyis shes nas yang skad cig ma lnga'i bar la mngon shes 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /des kyang skad cig ma dgu ba sogs mi rig ste/ skad cig ma dang bo gnyis shes nas/ gnyis pa gzhan shes pa'i phyir khams gzhan te gong ma'i rjes bzod sogs kyi phyir du sbyor ba slar yang bskyar na dgu ba rig nus so zer na/ skad cig ma bdun la'ang sbyo ra ba rdzogs mi nus pa'i phyir/ dgu ba rig nus na bcu ba yang rig nus sam/ de ltar 'dod na rang rgyal gyis mthong lam skad cig ma bzhi rig par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyis sbyor ba la mi ltos par mthong lam skad cig kun rig pa yin te/ bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pas thugs kyi dbang phyug thob pa'i phyir/ zad pa dang mi skye shes pa'i blo gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ sdug rbesngal yongs su shes so/ /kun 'byung spangs 621

so/ /'gog pa mngon du byas so/ /lam bsgoms so/ /zhes she//sa pa de zad pa shes pa dang / sdug bsngal yongs su shes te ya nga yongs su shes par byar med do/ /kun 'byung spangs so ya nga spang bar byar med do/ /'gog pa mngon du byas te yang r+yā ngon du byar med do/ /lam bsgoms te yang bsgom du med do/ /zhes shes pa de mi skye ba'i blor 'dod do/ /she.a bcu nang tshan bsngu ba mchims sgyuka las/ /kun rdzob shes pa rang dang ji/ /sems shes cha 'o chos shes ni/ /rang dang bden pa bzhi shespo dang / /zad dang mi skye sems shes brgyad/ /rjes shes kyang yin bden gsum shes/ /rang dang zad dade mi skye shes/ /chos shes rjes su shes pa dang / /lnga yin zad dang mi skye shes/ /rang dang bden pa bzhi shes dang / /chos shes rjes su shes dang bdun/ / sems shes chos shes rjes shes dang / /lam shes kun rdzob zhes pa dang / /rang dang lnga yin lam shes ni/ /rang dang chos shes rjes shes dang / /sems shes zad dang mi skye shes/ /rnam pa drug tu yang dag brjod/ /ces mchims ṭīka gi lung drangs pa dang /zag bcas rang bzhin las ni kun rdzob shes/ /gong 'og gnyen po las ni chos rjes gnyis/ /dmigs mtshungs rnam pa las ni sngugo kun gnyis/ /lugs 'der rtsag kun gcig pa 'gis kyang 622

shes/ /dmigs rnam gnyis char las ne 'gog lam gnyis/ /sems byung shes kyang khyur las sems shes bajod/ /lang na rdzor ba so sor dgos phyir bzhag /zad shes bya ba byas la dang bor tshe /skal mnyam rgyu rgyas pa las mi skye shes/ /yig char zad shes skal mnyam la min gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ mchims ṭīka las/ shes pa dag ni sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa ni/ kun rdzob chos dang rjes su shes/ /gsum yin de dag bcur bshad de/ /kun rdzob shes pa rang dang ni/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa drug tu yang dag brjod/ /ces pa'i bar 'dir drangs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa khyad chos la/ shes pa bcur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/gnyen po'i khyad par/ rnam pa'i khyad par dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ shes pa de dag bsdus na gsum yin kyang bcur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ zag bcas rang bzhin las kun rdzob shes pa bzhag gong 'og gi gnyen po las chos shes dang rjes shes gnyis/dmigs pa mtshungs kyang rnam pa tha dad pa las sdug bsngal shes pa dang kun 'byung shes pa gnyis bzhag bye smra'i lugs 'dir sdug bden dang kun 'byung bden pa gcig pa 'jog tshul 'dis kyang shes so/ /dmigs pa dang rnam pa gnyis ka tha dad pa las 'gog pa shes pa dang lam shes pa gnyis/ sbyor ba las ni pha rol 623

gyi sems shes 'jog ste/ des sems kyang shes mod kyi gzhan gyi sems shes par bya'o zhes sbyor ba la zhugs pa las pha rol sems shes brjod/ yang na sems byunge shes par bya snyam du sbyor ba la brtson pa dang sems shes par bya'o snyam du stor ba la brtson pa gnyis so sor dgos pa'i phyir pha rol sems shes bzhag nyon mongs spong ba'i bya ba byas pa'i cha nas zad pa shes pa ste/ bya ba byas pa'i rgyud la dang bor skye ba'i phyir/ skal mnyam gyi rgyu rgyas pa'i cha nas mi skye ba shes pa bzhag yig char zad shes skal mnyam las skyes pa min gsungs te/ mtha' dpyod las/ bdun pa grub ste/ zag med kyi shes pa snga ma thams cad kyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu byas pas rgyu rgyas pa las de byung la zad shes zag med kyi skal mnyam las ma byung ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ gong du za'i rjes 'jug nor ro/ /chos rjes gong 'og gnyen por ma rjes te/ /'gog lam chos shes dmigs pa mi dman pas/ /sngar 'dris chos shes kyis kyang gong ma spong / /rjes shes 'dod gnyen min te rgyal zin phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos shes 'dod pa'i gnyen po dang / rjes shes gong ma'i gnyen po yin na/ de kho nar nges sam zhe na/ de mthong lam la nges kyang sgom lam la ma nges 624
