te/ sgom lam la 'gog pa chos shes dang lam chos shes gnyis kyis gong ma'i 'gog lam las mi dman pa'i 'dod pa'i 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i phyir te/ 'gog lam la sas bsdus med pas 'dod pa'i 'gog lam de gong ma'i 'gog lam las mi dman pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir 'dod pa'i rten can gyi 'phags pas 'dod pa'i sgom spang dgu chos shes kyis rim pas spangs nas gong ma'i sgocha/ spang rnams kyang sngar 'dris pa'i lam de nyid bskyed nas spong ba srid pa'i phyir/ rjes shes kyis 'dod khams kyi gnyen po byed pa min te/ chos shes ma skyes par rjes shes mi skye/ rjes shes/ skyes pa'i tshe chos shes kyis 'dod pa las rgyal zin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyis bsdus pa'i rjes shes kyis 'dod khams kyi gnyen po byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mthong lam gyis brtsas rjes shes 'dod gnyen min/ /bden dmigs gzhan sbyir(ro)chos shes de dang 'dra/ /mthong lam rjes shes kyi rgyun rgyun khyags la/ /yod de sgom lam rjes shes yin nam dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/ mthong lam gyis bsdus pa'i rjes shes de/ 'dod pa'i mthong spang gi gnyen po min te/ de'i bden pa'i dmigs pa 'dod gnyen gyi dmigs pa las gzhan yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mthong lam chos shes spyang de dang 'dra ste/ gong ma'i mthong spang gi gnyen po mi byed de 625

dmigs yul gyi bden pa gong ma'i bden pa las gzhan 'dod pa'i bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam rjes shes kyi rdzas rgyun rgyun zhugs kyi rgyud la yod de/ de sgom lam rjes shes yin nam dpyad gsungs kyang / yin nam gsungs pas yin par zhal gyis bzhes te/ mthong lam gyis mthong zin goms par byed pa'i lam ni sgom lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kun rdzob shes pa rgyur lam la sogs la/ /stos shes rjes shes bzhin du rnam bcu drug /gzhan du'ang rang sbyi'i mtshan nyid mtha' yas so/ /bden bzhi shes par rnam pa bzhi bzhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ gsum pa la shes pa so so'i rnam pa'i khyad par/ rnam pa'i grangs nges/ de4dag gi khyad par chos gzhan bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang bo ni/chos shes dang rjes shes la/ rnam pa bcu drug yod de/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can yin no/ /kun rdzob shes pa'i rnam pa yod de/ sbyor lam drod rtse bzod pa'i skabase su chos shes rjes shes bzhin du rnam pa bcu drug dang / de las gzhan du'ang chos thams cad kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa mtha' d+mayas pa yod de/ tshogs lam sogs su mi sdug pa dang byams pa dang dbugs 'byung rngub dang / bum pa dang snam bu dang zo zhig thungs shig song zhig sdod cig sogs rang spyi'i mtshan nyid las dzha626

gzhan pa'i rnam pa can yang yod do gsungs so/ /bden bzhi shes pa ste/ sdug bsngal shes pa/ kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ lam shes pa bzhi ni rnam pa bzhi ba can yin te/sdug bsngal shes pas mi rtag pa sogs bzhi 'dzin pa nas lam gyis lam rig sgrub nges bzhi 'dzin pas rang rang gi dmigs yul bden pa'i rnam pa la 'jug pa bzhi bzhi— yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dri med sems shes lam bzhin rnam pa bzhi/ /dri bcas sems kyi ngo bo rags pa mthong / /gnyis kas sems dang sems byung snas re re/ /tsam mthong skabs 'dir 'dod chags bcas gsungs don/ /chags can sems ni 'dres pa'i 'dod chags bcas/ /mtshungs ldan min lang thob par ldan rnams dang / /rgyas 'gyur dmigs pa ldan pa'i 'dod chags bcas/ /zhes grags blob dpon chagos bcas mtshungs ldan dang / /mtshungs par mi ldan chags bral la sbyar ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ pha rol sems shes dri med dam zag med kyang lam shes bzhin du lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi dang ldan la/ pha rol sems shes dri ma dang bcas pas ni sems kyi ngo bo rags pa mthong ngo / — /gnyis kas sems dgasems byung rdzas re re ba tsam mthong zhing / skabs 'dir mdo las/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems la yang 'dod chags 627

dang bcas pa'i sems so zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems la yang 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems so zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/'dod chags dang bcas pa'i zhes bya ba ni/ 'dod chags dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems ni 'dres pa'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa dang / 'dod chags dang mtshungs par mi ldan yang /'dod chags kyi yang thob pa dang ldan pa rnams dang / 'dod chags rgyas 'gyur gyi dmigs pa dang ldan pas 'udod chags dang bcas pa yin zhes bye smra rnams la grags mod/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis ni/ chags bcas 'dod chags dang mtshungs ldan rnams dang / 'dod chags dang mtshungs par mi ldan pa ni/chags bral la sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang kun tu brtsas dang rnam gameng dang / /zhum rab bzung zhes sogs la rtsod tshul mang / /chags par zhes kyang chags yul mi shes te/ /gzugs la dmigs na sems shes min par 'gyur/ /sems tsam lugs kyi sems shes dpyad gzhi che/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun tu bsdus pa dang rnam g.yeng sogs ni/ bye brag smra ba na re/ rim pa ltar rnam g.yeng 628

dang mtshungs ldan yin min gyi bye brag gis/ sems kun tu bsdus pa ni da/ge ba dang g.yeng ba ni nyon mongs can yin no zer/nub phyogs pa na re/ bsdus pa ni gnyid nyon mongs can dar /g.yeng ba ni/ gnyi da las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs dang mtshungs ldan yin pas gnyis ka nyon mongs can yin zer/ kha che ba rnams na re/ de mi rigs te/ de lta na sems te nyon mongs can gyi gnyid dang mtshungs ldan yin pa'i phyir bsdus pa'ang yin la/ nyon mongs can yin pa'i phyir rnam g.yeng yang yin par 'gyur ro zer ba dang / zhum pa ni le lo dang mtshungs ldan yin pas nyon mongs can dang / rab tu bzung ba ni brtson 'grus dang mtshungs ldan yin pas dge ba yin zer ba sogs rtsod tshul mang ste mchims mdzod du gsal/ pha rol sems shes zag bcas zag med gnyis ka rdzas re re ba zhig gi spyod yul can yin te/sems so snyam du 'dzin pa'i tshe sems byung mi 'dzin/ sems byung ngo snyam du 'dzin pa'i tshe sems mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ dper na gos so snyam du 'dzin tshe dri ma mi 'dzin/ dri ma'o snyam du 'dzin che gos mi 'dzin pa bzhin no/ /des na pha rol sems shes kyis chags par shes kyang chags yul mi shes te/ chags yul gyi gzugs la dmigs na de shes pas sems shes ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /sems 629

tsam pa'i lugs la sems shes la dpyad gzhi che ste/ dngos po thams cad rang 'dzin shes pa dang rdzas gcig yin dgos la/ pha rol sems shes kyi yul du gyur pa'i gang zag pha rol bo'i sems de/sems shes de dang rdzas gcig yin na/ gang zag pha rol bo'i sems rgyud kyi bag chags smin pa las byung ba ma yin par 'gyur ba sogs dpyad gzhi che'o/ /zad dang mi skye zhes pa tshol min phyir/ /sems shes las bkol bar chad med kyang bkol/ /lhag ma zad dang mi skye rnam bcu bzhi/ /rjes thob bya pha byas zhes dran pa la/ /mnyam gzhag stong dang bdag med mi mthun lo/ /zhes gsungs te/zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis ni nye bar rtog pa med kyang yongs su tshol ba'i rang bzhin can ma yin phyir/ pha rol sems shes las logs su bkol ba dang bar chad med lam las kyang bkol dgos te lta ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ chos shes nas pha rol sems shes kyi bar khyad par bshad zin pa'i lhag ma zad pa shes pa dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis rnam pa bcu bzhi can yin te/bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug giltang dang bdag med gnyis ma gtogs pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ rjes thob tu bdag gis/ bya ba byas so/ /skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so/ /630

zhes sogs dran pa la/ mnyam bzhag tu stong ba dang bdag med sgom tshul dang mi mthun pas rnam pa de gnyis ma gtogs so/ /zhes bye smras 'dod do/ nyi 'og rnam shes gas las gsungs pa'i phyir/ /zag med rnam par gzhi yod gnas yod bsnan/ /gzhi ne dang gnas ni mtshan nyid lo/ /gzhan ne bden mthong gzhi yodasnyeganas yod zer/ /zhes gsungs te/ dri med lam la rnam pa bcu drug las gzhan rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa yod dam zhe na/ kha che bye smra na re/ med de rnam pa bcu drug las ma gtogs pa zag pa med pa'i rnam pa med zer/ nyi 'og pa na re/ gzhan yod de/ rnam shes kyi tshogs las/ mi ldan pa'i sems kyis 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i chos rnams shes par 'gyur ba yod dam zhe na/ shes par 'gyur te zhes sogs gsungs te/ zag med kyi rnam par gzhi yod dang gnas yod gnyis bsnan/gzhi yod ces pas rgyu yod pa bstan/ gnas yod ces pas mtshan nyid yod pa bstan/ zhes zer/ kha che ba sogs gzhan gyis ni/ bden pa mthong ba'i phyir gzhi yod la gnas kyang yod do zer ro/ /dpe ston rnam pa bcu drug sa bdun te/ /rtsag bsngal bzhi 'o lhag ma rnam grangs byir/ /shes rab mtshungs ldan lul gsum rnam pa dang / /'dzin byed gzung bya gsum las 631

gsum gnyis gcig /kun rdzob shes la rnam gsum lhag ma dge /zhes gsungs te/ rnam pa bcu drug po 'di ming gi sgo nas sam rdzas su bcu drug yin nam zhe na/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde ba na re/ rdzas su bdun yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang / lhag ma/ kun 'byung / 'gog pa/ lam gsum gyi re re ste rnam grangs kyi sgo nas gsum yod pas bdun no zer/ skabs 'di'i shes pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo gang yin zhe na/bye smra na re/ shes pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo yod de/ yul 'dzin pa'i rnam pa shes rab yin pa'i phyir/ shes rab kho nas 'dzin par byed dam zhe na/ shes rab dang bcas pa'i sems dang sems byung yul rnam pa dang bcas pas 'dzin par byed pas 'dzin byed yin la/ de ltar na shes rab ni rnam pa dang 'dzin pa dang gzung bya gsum ga yin la/ shes rab las gzhan pa'i dmigs bcas thams cad ni 'dzin pa dang gzung bya gnyis yin pa dang / dmigs pa med pa dag ni gzung bya gcig pu yin pas/ 'dzin byed gzung bya gsum las gsum gnyis gcig /ces gsungs pa yin no/ —/kun rdzob shes pa la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod la/ lhag ma rnams dge ba kho na'o/ /zhes bye smra 'dod do/ /mamims sgyuka mchan bur sems shes sgom byung 632

cibaspung / /'og rtu gsum bshad skyes thob pyir mi 'gal/ /de ne mngon zhes min par yig char rgu/sungs/ /zhes gsungs te/mchims mdzod kyi mchan bur/ 'dir sems shes zag bcas kyang sgom byung bzung la lhag ma ni lam bden gyis bsdus so zhes gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'og tu/ gzhan gyi yid shes pa ni bsam gtam gyi dngos gzhi bzhi kho na yod kyi gzhan na med do/ /zhes dang / de'i mchan bur/ 'di mngon shes kyis bsdus la/rnam gnas ni gzugs la rtsom pas nyer bsdogs dang gzugs med na med do/ /zhes sogs lan gsum du sgom byung gi phyogs gsungs pas/ skyes thob kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes ni sgom byung yin pa mi 'gal la/ de ni mngon shes min par yig char gsungs te/ mtha' dpyod las/ rtog dang rig sngags kyis byas pa'ang / zhes pa'i sems shes gsum ni kun rdzob shes pa min gyi mngon shes yang ma yin pas 'di'i pha rol sems shes ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sems rten kun rdzob shes pa sa kun te/ /chos shes sa drug rjes shes sa dgu ste/ /sems shes ma gtogs drug kyang de bzhin dgu /zhes gsungs te/ sems rten dang lus rten gnyis las/ sems rten ni/ shes pa bcu'i nang nas/ dang 633

bo kun rdzob shes pa ni sa kun te thams cad na yod/ chos shes ni bsam gtan sa drug na yod/ rjes shes ni sa drug po de dang gzugs med dang bo gsum te sa dgu na yod/ sems shes ma gtogs pa'i bden pa bzhi shes dang zad pa shes pa dang mi skye ba shes pa ste drug kyang zag med sa dgu na yod do/ /pha rol sems shes ni bsam gtan bzhi na yod do/ /sems shesace'adod gzugs chos 'dod lhag khams gsum/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa lus rten ni/ pha rol sems shes de ni 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi rten can yin te/ /de khams 'og ma gnyis su mngon du byed kyi/ gzugs med kyi rten la mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir/ chos shes ni 'dod pa'i rten can kho na yin la/lhag ma gzhan brgyad ni khams gsum ga'i rten can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'gog blo chos dran sems shes lus ma gtogs/ /lhag ma bzhi 'o lam yang rdzom dmigs grid/ /zhes gsungs te/gsum pa dran pa nyer bzhag gi khyad par ni/ 'gog pa shes pa ni chos dran pa nyer bzhag gcig pu dang ldan la/ pha rol sems shes ni lus dran nye ma gtogs pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag gsum dang ldan/ lhag ma'i shes pa brgyad ni dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang ldan zhing / lam shes pas kyang lus tshor 634

sems chos bzhi bsdoms te dmigs pa srid pa'i phyir ro/ /chos shes bal la rjes shes ma gtogs dgu /rjes shes yul la chos zhesardzim gtogs dgu /lam shes yul la kun rdzob ma gtogs dgu /sbug kun zhes yul kun rdzob gzhan sems gnyis/ /kun rdzob sems shes zad mi skye bzhir bcu/ /'gog ba shes pa'i dmigs par shes pa med/ /ces gsungs te/ bzhi ba dmigs pa'i khyad par la/ shes pa nang phan tshun yul du 'gyur tshul/ chos bcu dang shes pa yul yul can du sbyar ba/ chos gang rig pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ chos shes kyi blo'i dmigs pa rjes shes ma gtogs pa shes pa gzhan dgu yod/ rjes shes kyi dmigs pa chos shes ma gtogs pa shes pa gzhan dgu yod/ lam shes pa'i dmigs pa kun rdzob shes pa ma gtogs pa shes pa gzhan dgu bo yod/ sdug bsngal shes pa dang kun 'byung shes pa gnyis kyi dmigs pa la shes pa gnyis yod de/ kun rdzob shes pa dang pha rol gyi sems shes pa gnyis yod/ kun rdzob shes pa/ pha rol sems shes/ zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa bzhi'i yul la shes pa bcu ga yod/ 'gog pa shes pa gcig po de'i dmigs pa ni 'gog pa kho na yin gyi shes pa la dmigs par mi byed pa'i liphyir ro/ / —635

'dod gzugs gachugs med gtogs dang zag med la/ /mtshungs ldan yin min dbye bas 'dus byas brgyad/ /'dus ma byas la dge lung ma bstan gnyis/ /de ltar chos bcu thams cad kun rdzob skul/ /chos cal 'dod gtogs gnyis dang zag med gnyis/ /ma byas dge dang lnga'o rjes shes yul/ /gong bzhi zag med ma byas dge dang bdun/ /sems yul gzugs mede dor bas mtshungs ldan gsum/ /'gog yul dge ba gcig sogs skabs dang jir/ /zhes gsungs te/ shes pa bcu dang chos bcu sbyor ba'i chos bcu yod de/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med dang / dri med 'dus byas bzhi la mtshungs ldan yin min gyi dbye bas 'dus byas brgyad dang / 'dus ma byas la dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis byas pas bcur byed pa yin la/ de ltar chos bcu bo thams cad kun rdzob shes pa'i yul du yod do/ /chos shes kyi yul la 'dod pa'i mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis dang / zag med lam la dmigs pa'i mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis/ 'dus ma byas dge ba 'gog bden la dmigs pa gcig dang lnga'o/ /rjes shes kyi dmigs yul khams gong ma gzugs gzugs med gnyis kyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis re ste bzhi dang / zag med kyi mtshungs ldan yin min 636

gnyis dang / 'dus ma byas dge ba dang bdun yod/ pha rol lkesems shes kyi dmigs yul la gzugs med dor bas 'dod gzugs gnyis dang zag med gsum gyi mtshungs ldan gsum yod/'gog pa shes pa'i dmigs yul 'dus ma byas dge ba gcig po ste de sogs skabs dang sbyar bar bya gsungs pa'i sogs sgras bsdus pa/ sdug bsngal shes pa dang kun 'byung shes pa gnyis kyi dmigs par khams gsum ga'i sas bsdus kyi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung re re mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis te drug re yod/lam shes pa'i dmigs par zag med mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis yod/ zad pa dang mi skye ba—shes pa'i dmigs par 'dus ma byas lung ma bstan ma gtogs dgu yod par rang 'grel las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bya byed gcig tu thal phyir rang tshogs las/ / gzhan tsam rig gsungs bye brag pa la dgongs/ /zhes gsungs te/ gsum pa chos gang gis rig pa'i tshul ni/ kun rdzob shes pas rang gi ngo bo dang lhan cig pa'i tshor 'du sogs ni ha cang nye bas mi 'dzin te/ bzung na bya byed gcig tu thal bar 'gyur te/ rang nyid rang la byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ rang gi tshogs pa las gzhan tsam rig par gsungs pa ni bye brag pa la dgongs pa yin te/ shes pa gcig gis gzhan thams cad rig 637

pa med par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ / gas can gzugs med so skye kun rdzob shes/ /bsamasmogatan casas 'asug can la sems shes kyang / /chags can zag med dang bor kun rdzob nyid/ /de nas shes pa re re 'phel gyur nas/ /chags bcas bcu drugo pa la bdun dang ldan/ /'og ma thob tshulayin zhing dmigs bsal yod/ /dgra bcom rgyan bcas shes pa bcu dang ldan/ /mchims ba/sungs 'azhi la mi g.yos khrab bam dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/gnyis pa ldan tshul ni/ chags bcas kyi gzugs med so skye ni kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu dang ldan/ bsam gtan snyoms 'jug can la pha rol sems shes dang yang ldan no/ /'phags pa ni chags can te 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang ma bral ba zhig yin na zag med skad cig dang bo sdug bsngal chosabazod dang ldan pa la ni/ dri med bzod rnams shes pa min/ /zhes 'byung bas bzod pa ni shes pa ma yin la/ shes pa gzhan mi ldan pas/kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu dang ldan no/ /de nas skad cig ma phyi ma rnams la re re 'phel bar gyur nas chags bcas bcu drug pa lam rjes shes pa la bdun dang ldan la/ chags bral yin na brgyad dang ldan no/ /'og ma'i sa bcad skabs su thob tshul bshad pa yin zhing / mthong lam bzod pa brgyad dang shes pa 638

dzebadun ji ltar skyes pa rnams thob par gsungs la/ 'dir chags bcas bcu drug pa la bdun dang / chags bral bcu drug pa la—brgyad byas pa ni ldan tshul gyi dmigs bsal yin no/ /dgra bcom rgyan bcas pa la shes pa bcu dang ldan par/ mchims mdzod las gsungs te/ de las mi slob pa'i lam la gnas pa ni shes rab kyis rnam grol la pha rol sems shes ma gtogs dgu dang / gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol la bcu dang ldan no/ /zhes gsungs/ dgra bcom rgyan bcas 'di la/ dgra bcom mi g.yoskebs khyab bam dpyad gsungs te/ shes pa bcu ldan tshul la dpag na mi g.yo bas khyab bo/ /shes brngod gang skyes de dang dmigs lul bden/ /mtshungs thob de mi rnam pa bzhi char rung / /sgom la dmigs pa mi mtshungs sna tshogs 'thob/ /rjes shes dang bo gsum mthar kun rdzob zhes/ /mngon par rtogs ba mtha' las byung zhes bya/ /chos shes la med lam rjes shes la med/ /bden pa de de rdzogs mthong min phyir dang / /kun kyang 'gog pa gcig gis mngonañtsa byed kyang / /gnyen po lam kun gcig gis mi bsgom pas/ / lam la mtha' med phyir na maba'i de med༈ /ces gsungs te/gsum pa thob tshul ni/ mthong lam du du thob ni/ mthongaske639

ba'i lam la bzod pa brgyad dang shes pa bdun gang skyes pa de dang de nyid ma 'ongs pa 'thob cing ma 'ongs pa mngon gyur mi 'thob la/ dmigs yul bden pa yang de dang mtshungs par 'thob la/ de yi rnam pa bzhi char yang 'thob par rung ste/ dper na/ sdug bsngal chos bzod skyes pa na/ de 'dra ma 'ongs pa kho na 'thob la/ de'i rnam pa bzhi ste mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med kyi rnam pa bzhi yang 'thob/ zhes bshad kyang rung ngo / /sgom lam la dmigs pa rigs mi mtshungs pa dang de dgasgrugi rnam pa'ang sna tshogs pa 'thob/ rjes shes dang bo gsum ste sdug bsngal rjes shes/ kun 'byung rjes shes/ 'gog pa rjes shes gsum gyi mthar kun rdzob shes pa re re 'thob ste/ de gsum la mngon par rtogs pa'i mtha' las byung ba zhes bya la/ chos shes skabs su gong ma'i bden pa de ma rtogs pas/ bden pa de rdzogs par ma rtogs/ rjes shes skabs su rdzogs par rtogs pa'i phyir/ bden pa rdzogs par rtogs pa kun kyang 'gog pa rjes shes gcig gis mngon du byed nus kyang / gnyene po lam la mtha' med pas phyir/ de dag gang zag gcig gis dus gcig tu sgom pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ des na lam la mtha' med pa'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa mtha' las byung ba zhes pa'i mtha'i don de med do/ /de ne mi skye mthong 640

lam de'i sa 'am/ /'og rten 'gog las byung de dran nye'i mtha'/ /chos so gzhan pa gnyis la bzhi ga yod/ /gangartsagi mthar byung de dang dmigs rnam mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ rjes shes gsum gyi mthar byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa de ni/ nam yang mngon gyur du mi 'byung ste/ ma 'ongs pa mi skyegyu ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rjes shes kyi kun rdzob shes pa de sa gang la brten nas thob pa yod de/mthong lam gang la brten pa'i rang sa'am 'og sa la brten nas thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob shes pa de gsum gyi dran pa nyer bzhag gi khyad par yod de/ 'gog mtha' las byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa de/ dran nye'i mtha' chos dran pa nyer bzhag yin la/ gzhan pa gnyis la dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ga yod/ kun rdzob shes pa gsum ga gang gi mtha' las byung ba'i shes pa de da nga —dmigs rnam mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ / bcu drug pa la bden bzhi chosmo sa drug /kun rdzob mi 'thob sngar nyed zin phyir dang / /lam mtha'i kun rdzob med cing gzhan 'brel med/ /thob bya'i chos shes sgom yin gzhan btang phyir/ /chags zaladzibacu drug pa la bems shes 'thob/ /chags bcas ba yi bcu drug ba'i gong —dang / /chags bral man gyi bar der snga ma yi/ /drug ltang kun rdzob shes pa bsnan pa'i 641

bdun/ /zhos gsungs te/ sgom lam du du thob ni/chags bcas bcu drug pa lam rjes shes pas bden pa bzhi'i shes pa bzhi dang / chos shes dang / rjes shes te drug thob/ kun rdzob shes pa mi 'thob ste sngar rnyed zin pa'i phyir dang / 'dir mngon par rtogs pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa med cing gzhan dang 'brel ba'i de med pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi skabs su kun rdzob shes pa thob kyang 'dir thob pa'i chos shes de sgom lam yin la/ gzhan mthong lam gyi skabs su thob pa rnams btang zin pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba'i 'phags pas de'i tshe bdun 'thob ste/ dang bosdo/ chos rjes bden bzhi shes pa bzhi dang drug gi steng du pha rol sems shes dang bdun 'thob bo/ /chags bcas bcu drug pa lam rjes shes pa de'i gong ma 'dod pa la chags bcas kyi sgom lam la ni ji srid chags bral ma thob bar de srid du sbyor ba dang bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam khyad par gyi lam thams cad du chos shes rjes shes dang bden pa bzhi'i shes pa ste drug gi steng du kun rdzob shes pa bsnan pa'i bdun 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /sa dgu'i bar ba bdun las rgyal zud dang / /blob pa'i mngon shes lnga bo 'thob byed la/ /bdun thob blob phyir zad dang mi skye min/ /bar chad med phyir sems shes 642

der mi 'thob/ /:brad rtse'i gnyen po kun rdzob— shes med phyir/ /brad rtse'i rnam grol brgyad la sems shes bsnan/ /mi g.yor 'pho byed drug ste zad shes bsnan/ /spel sgom bar cha da med la kun —rdzob bsnan/ /spel chos ga med de nyid yin nam dpyad/ / ces gsungs te/ sa dgu'i bar ba bdun te bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med dang bo gsum ste bdun gyi nyon mongs las rgyal ba de dag gi 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i sgom lam bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i 'phags pa dang / slob pa'i mngon shes lnga 'thob par byed pa'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa gnyis kyis kyang sngar ltar bdun 'thob la/ slob pa yin pa'i phyir zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis thob pa min la/ bar chad med lam yin phyir sems shes kyang der mi 'thob bo/ /srid rtse'i nyon mongs kyi gnyen po la kun rdzob shes pa med pa'i phyir/ srid rtse las grol ba'i rnam grol lam dang bo brgyad la drug gi steng sems shes bsnan pas bdun 'thob/ rtogs par 'os pa'i skal ba can mi g.yo ba'i chos can 'thob par byed pa'i bar chad med lam la chos rjes shes dang bden bzhi shes drug gi steng zad shes bsnan te byādun 'thob/bsam gtan ni spel mar sgom pa'i bar chad med lam la gnas pas snga ma drug gi steng du kun rdzob shes pa bsnan pas bdun 643

'thob gsungs/ spel chos bsam gtan ni zag med de nyid yin nam dpyad gsungs te/ mtha' dpyod las/ 'di la zag bcas dang zag med gnyis gsungs nas/ zag bcaspol kunatrerdzob shes pa snon pa dang / zag med la zad pa shes pa snon par gsungs la/ mchims mdzod las kyang zag bcas zag med gnyis so sor—gsungs so/ /bden bzhi chos rjes kun la gzhir bzhag go /blob ba'i spyong byed la drug mthong dang 'dra/ /'dra ste rjonartswas 'bras gsum thob byed sbyir/ /des drangs rnam grol lam la chags bcas drug /gzhan la bdun dzha 'am zhes gnyis ka la/ /kyan rdzob shes pa ston pa'i lugs gzhan bstan/ /brad pa'i rtse las rgyal byed la yang drug /zad pa shes la mi skye ma gtogs dgu /lhag ma 'og sa brgyad las rnam grol dang / /mngon shes spel sgom sogs kyi rnam grol lam/ /mi g.yor 'apo byed rnam grol brgyad la mang / /blob pas mtha' gnyis dor bas brgyad brgyad 'thob/ /ces gsungs te/ bden pa bzhi'i shes pa bzhi dang / chos shes/rjes shes drug ni kun la gzhir bzhag nas/ de'i steng du bsnan rgyu yod pa dag la bsnan par bya'o/ /slob pa chags bcas dbang bo sbyong ba'i rnam grol lam la drug thob pa ni mthong lam dang 'dra ste/ ji ltar 'dra na mthong lam gyis 'bras bu dang bo gsum gang 644

rung zhig 'a thob pa ltar/ 'dis kyang bar chad med lam gyis slob pa dbang bo sbyong ba na 'bras bu dang bo dbang bo rnon pos bsdus pa 'dus byas gang rung zhig 'thob par byed pa'i phyir/ sbyong byed des drangs pa'i rnam grol lam chags bcas la drug gzhan la ste chags bral bas sems shes dang bdun 'thob la/ rtsa bar/ shes pa drug dang bdun 'thob 'am/ /zhes pa'i 'am gyi sgras gnyis ka la kun rdzob shes pa thob pa'i lugs ston/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs las rgyal byed bar chad med lam la gnas pa la yang drugasrid rtse'i rnam grol lam dgu ba zad pa shes pa la mi skye shes ma gtogs dgu 'thob/ sngar bshad pa'i lhag ma 'og sa brgyad ni 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam grol lam dgu dang / mngon shes dang / spel sgom dang / mi g.yo rtogs par byed pa gsum gyi rnam grol lam dang bo brgyad dang / phyir mi 'ong sbyor ba dang / khyad par can gyi lam la gnas pa mums kyi ni shes pa brgyad brgyad 'thob/ slob pas mtha' gnyis dor ba ste/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis ma gtogs brgyad brgyad 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis par chags bral gsum pa'i zag med tshe/ /dang bo gnyis pa yis spyang zag med 'thob/ /zad shes 'thob tshe mi sngug la sogs pa/ /zag bcas zag med bcu gcig sa kun gyis/ /645

basbus 'thob rgyal brad thob skyes 'bul bzhin/ /gsar thob lam dang lang lang mngon byas lam/ /jom dang re zhig chags bral thob ba bzhi/ /nyi 'og jom thob rnam 'jig thob gnyis bsnan/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa gang du shes pa du thob thad/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la ni/ sa bsam gtan gnyis pa la chags bral byas nas bsam gtan gsum pa'i sas bsdus kyi zag med kyi lam thob tshe/ bsam gtan dang bo dang bsam gtan gnyis pa yis kyang dngos gzhi zag med 'thob ste/ gnyen po'i rigs rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /zad pa shes pa la rgyal srid dbang bskur ba ltar zag bcas zag med kyi yon tan du ma thob ste/ de la zag med du ma zad zag bcas kyi yon tan ni/de thob tshe mi sdug pa bsgom pa dang / dbugs rngub 'byung dang /dran pa nyer bzhag sogs dang / bsam gtan sa drug gzugs med pa ste zag bcas zag med sa bcu gcig po kun gyisagyubasdus pa 'thob pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis nyon mongs pa'i thob pa bcom nas chos kyi rgyal srid rin po che thob pa yin pas dge ba rnaspras skyes 'butshwab bzhin du 'byungaste ba'i phyir/gsum pa thob pa'i dbye ba la/ rnyed thob dang / rī brten thob dang / gnyen thob dang / thag bsring ba'i thob pa dang bzhi 646

yod/ dang bo rnyed pa'i thob pa ni/ lam gsar du rnyed pa'i tshe lam de ma 'ongs pa thob pa lta bu/ brten pa'i thob pa ni/ thob zin de yang yang mngon du byed pa lta bu/ gnyen po'i thob pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum ma dul ba'i gnyen po de gsum dul bar bsgoms te sdom pa lta bu/ thag bsring ba'i thob pa ni/ nyon mongs chags bral gyi thob pa lta bu de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyi 'og pa rnams kyis ni/ sdom pa 'thob pa dang / rnam par 'jig pa 'thob pa gnyis bsnan nas drug tu 'dod de/ dang bo ni mdo las/ dbang bo drug po 'di dag shin tu dul ba dang shin tu bsgoms pa zhes gsungs pa mig sogs dbang bo drug gi sgosdom pa dran shes bzhin gyi bdag nyid yin la/ gnyis pa ni lus la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs pa thag bsring ba stephyi nang gi lus dran pa nyer bzhag 'thob pa yin no/ /kha che ba ni de dag kyang rim pa ltar phyi ma gnyis kyi nang du 'dus so zhos zeroro/ /yang na gnyas ka'ang gnyis ka'i khongs su 'duse so zhes byas kyang 'gal ba med do zhes rgyal bo'i sras 'chad do/ / las la 'gog lam bzhi la 'gog shes dor/ /kun 'gro'i lam la rang gi rngo bos dgu /'bras bur bcas na 'gog shes bsnan pas bcu/ /rjes dran skye 'chi shes pa kun rdzob bo/ /647

zad shes ngo bo mkhyen pa'i dbang byas na/ /chos rjes 'gog dang kun rdzob da mi skye/ /thad la yod pa'i dbang byas shes bcu lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi dang bo stobs bcu'i dang bo drug shes pa bcus bsdus tshul yod de/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni shes bcus bsdus/ 'di nas sdom gyi tshig ris ltar/las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs la 'gog lam gyi shes pa gnyis dor ba'i lhag ma brgyad kyis bsdus te/ 'dir las la 'gog lam/ zhes so/ /bsam gzugs brgyad rnam thar brgyad/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ snyoms 'jug gnyis mthar gnas dgu mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / dbang bo mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / khams sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i stobs te stobs bzhi ni 'gog pa shes pa dor ba'i lhag ma dgus bsdus pa yin te/'dir/ bzhi la 'gog shes dor/ zhes so/ /thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs/ lam rang gi ngo bor byas na 'gog shes ma gtogs dgu/ 'am sgra'i don dang lam 'bras bu dang bcas na shes pa bcu yod de/ kun 'gro'i lam la rang gi ngo bos dgu /'bras bur bcas na 'gog shes bsnan pas bcu/ /648

zhes so/ /sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs gnyis ni kun rdzob shes pas bsdus te/ rjes dran skye 'chi shes pa kun rdzob bo/ /zhes so/ /zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobase ni 'am sgras 'gog pa kho na shes na chos shes rjes shes 'gog shes zad she sa mi skye shes kun rdzob shes pa drug gis bsdus/ zag pa zad pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i mkhyen par 'dod na/ shes pa bcus bsdus zer ro/ /'dir/ zad shes ngo bo mkhyen pa'i dbang byas na/ /chos rjes 'gog dang kun rdzob zad mi skye/ /rgyud la yod pa'i dbang byas shes bcu lo/ /zhes so/ /stobs brgyad rten la'ang nyer bsdogs bdun ma gtogs/ /btsun pa thugs bzhin sku'i stobs maba' med gsungs/ /glang chen phal ba spos glang tshan po che/ /rab gnon lan lag mchog dang stobs mchog dang / /sred med bu rnams snga ma bcu 'gyur ro/ /zhar byung sangs rgyas rang rgyal 'khor bskur tshegs/ /klu mdud lu gu rgyud dang gzer btage'adra/ /zhes gsungs te/ stobs bcu bo de sa gang na yod kyi khyad par yod de/ sngon gnas mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / 'chi 'pho— skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs gnyis bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi na yod/stobs lhag ma brgyad ni sems rten la' nga nyer bsdogs phyi ma 649

bdun ma gtogs sa kun na yod/ gnas brtan btsun pa na re/thugs kyi stobs mtha' yas pa bzhin du sku'i stobs kyang mtha' be+ed gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la sred med kyi bu'i stobs mnga' bar gsungs na/ de'i stobs kyi tshad gang yin zhe na/ glang chen phal ba/ spos kyi glang bo che/ tshan po che chen po/ rab gnon/yan lag mchog stobs mchog sred med kyi bu rnams snga ma snga ma las bcu 'gyur gyis stobs che'o/ /zhar byung du rus tshigs kyi khyad par bshad pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang rang rgyal dang 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi rus tshigs ni rim pa ltar/ klu'i mdud pa dang / lu gu rgyud dang / gzer bus btab pa ltar sra ba yin no/ /stogs par mi 'jigs gnas mkhyen bzhin shes bcu/ / spangs pa mi 'jigs zad bzhin drug gam bcu/ /gsum pa las kyi rnam byun mkhyen bzhin brgyad/ / ('di la dpar mar/ — bzhin gyi rjes 'jug na chad pa 'dra/ ) lam la mi 'jigs lam bzhin dgu 'am bcu/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi yod de/ rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ rang don spangs pa phun tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ gzhan don bar chad kyi chos su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ gzhan don nges 'byung gi lam du dam bcas 650 rme

pa la mi 'jigs pa dang bzhi'o/ /mi 'jigs bzhi'i dang bo rtogs pa phun tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ stobs dang bo gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i stobs bzhin du shes pa bcu dang sa thams cad kyis bsdus/ mi 'jigs pa gnyis pa spangs pa phun tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni stobs bcu ba/ zag zad mkhyen pa'i stobs bzhin du shes pa drug gam bcu dang sa bcu gcig gis bsdus/ mi 'jigs pa gsum pa bar chad kyi chos su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni stobs gnyis pa las 'bras mkhyen pa'i stobs bzhin du shes pa brgyad dang sa thams cad kyis bsdus/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi ba nges 'byung gi lam du dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni stobs bdun pa kun tu 'gro ba mkhyen pa'i stobs bzhin du shes pa dgu'am bcu dang sa thams cad kyis bsdus so/ /dran nye chos mnyan la sbyar bag chags bshad/ /thugs rje'i tād chos drug go rtsa bar gsal/ /thugs rje che dang sgring rje'i khrad bar brgyad/ /ngo be+e gti myag med dang zhe sdang med/ /rnam pa sngug bsngal gsum dang rtsag bsngal dngos/ /dmigs pa khams gsum pa dang 'dod khams tsam/ /bzhi ba nyid dang mi spyogs zad sogs rten/ /sangs rgyas la yod nyan rang so skyer yod/ /651

srid la chags bral 'dod chags zal las thob/ /'khor ba'idzi'ajigs las yongs su skyob dang gzhan/ /sems can kyan dang sngug bsngal can la skye/ /rgyu dang ye shes spangs pa mthu dang sku/ /phan 'dogs rna mas la phun tshogs bzhi thozhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ dran pa nyer bzhage gsum yod de/ chos gus par nyan pa la mi chags pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag chos mi gus par nyan pa la mi khro ba'i dran pa nyer bzhag gus ma gus gnyis kas nyan pa la chags sdang med par btang snyoms su gnas pa'i dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi rang bzhin can gyi dran pa nyer bzhag gsum yod/'o na nyan thos dgra bcom la'ang gus ma gus gnyis ka la chags sdang mi 'byung ba yod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos su mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ nyan thos dgra bcom dag gis chags sdang giñtsabag chags ma spangs la sangs rgyas kyis spangs pa'i phyir/ zhes bag chags spangs ma spangs la bshad/ thugs rje chen po la khyad chos drug yod pa rtsa bar gsal te/ thugs rje chen po kun rdzob blo/ /tshogs dang rnam pa spyod yul dang / /mnyam pa'i phyir dang ches che'i phyir/ /tha dad bya ba rnam pa brgyad/ /ces gsungs/ tha dad bya ba rnam pa brgyad ces pa/ thugs rje chen po dang snying rje—chen po gnyis la khyad par brgyad yod par bshad de/ ngo bo'i4652

khyad par thugs rje chen po ni gti mug med pa'i shes rab la 'jog snying rje chen po ni zhe sdang med pa la 'jog rnam pa'i khyad par ni/ thugs rje chen pos sdug bsngal gsum dang bral bar 'dod/ snying rje chen pos sdug bsngal gcig pu dang bral bar 'dod pa yin/ dmigs pa'i khyad par/ thugs rje chen pos khams gsum ga'i sems can la dmigs la/ snying rje chen pos 'dod pa'i sems can la dmigs/ sems rten gyi khyad par/thugs rje chen po bsam gtan bzhi ga kho na la brten/ snying rje po bsam gtan bzhi ga mi lcogs med bcas la brten/ lus rten gyi khyad par/ thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la yod/ snying rje chen po nyan rang gi rgyud na'ang yod/ thob tshul gyi khyad par/ thugs rje chen po srid rtse la 'dod chags dang bral bas 'thob/ snying rje chen po 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bas 'thob bo/ /nus pa'i khyad par/ thugs rje chen pos 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyob par byed/ snying rje chen pos 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal tsam las skyob par byed/ byed las kyi khyad par yod de/ thugs rje chen po khams gsum sems can kun la 'jug snying rje chen po 'dod pa khams pa'i sems can sdug bsngal can la 'jug go /sangs rgyas la gus pa bskyed pa'i 653

thabs yod de/ mnyam pa nyid gsum ni/ rtsa bar/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni/ /chos sku 'gro ba'i don sbyod pas/ /mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang / /rigs dang sku bong tshod kyis min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams la mkhas pa dga' ba dang gus pa chen po bskyed pa'i thabs yod de/mnyam pa gsum gyi mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu phan 'dogs pa phun sum tshogs pa gsum po yid la yang yang byed pa de yin la/ rgyu phun tshogs bzhi yod de/ tshogasasaganyis po thams cad kyi pha rol phyin pa la goms pa dang / bskalasachen grangs med gsum po sogs yun ring bo nas goms pa dang /bskal chen de snyed du bar chad med par goms pa dang / de thams cad la gus par byas te goms pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/'bras bu phun tshogs bzhi yod de/ 'bad pa med par rnam pa thams cad mkhyenapa'i ye shes phun tshogs dang / nyon mongs pa gtan du bag chags dang bcas pa dang snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa spangs pas spangs pa phun tshogs dang / phyi'i yul sprul ba dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / byin gyis rlobs pa'i mnga' ba phun—sum tshogs pa dang / sprul bsgyur la dbang ba'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa zhes kyang bya ste/ sgrib pa dang / mkha' dang shin tu 654

ring bar gshegs pa'i mthu phun tshogs dang / mtshan dpe'i sku'i stobs/ sku rdo rje ltar sra bas sku phun tshogs bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir/ phan 'dogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bzhi yod de/ ngan song gsum las sgrol bar mdzod pa dang / 'khor ba las sgrol bar mdzad pa dang / theg pa gsum la 'argod par mdzad pa dang /bde 'gro la 'god par mdzad pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ nang gses kyis dbye na/ ye shes phun tshogs la bzhi/ spangs pa phun tshogs la bzhi/ mthu phun tshogs la bzhi/ gzugs kyi phun tshogs la bzhi yod pa rang 'grel las bshad pas/ 'dir yang / rgyu dang ye shes spangs pa mthu dang sku/ /phan 'dogs rnams la phun tshogs bzhi bzhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dbye ba mtha' yas shing rmad du byung ba rin po che'i 'byung gnas yin no/ /de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas dang de'i chos dang dge 'dun la dad pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad zil gyis mnan nas lam gyi rten mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang brgyud nas mthar mchog myang 'das thob par 'gyur te/lung smad kyi gzhi las/ gang dag rgyal ba rnam 'dren la/ /bya ba chung ngu byed 'gyur ba'ang / /de dag mtho risacesna tshogs dag // bgrod nas bdud rtsi go 'phang thob/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir 655

ro / / spob ma dang ni thun mong zhes bya yi/ /blob dang min de dgra brtsom mi blob phyir/ /smon nas(sam)gtad nas shes phyir smon nas shes/ /bzhi ba yin pyir gzugs med mi shes zer/ /de yi gzugs med skye bar lung bstan ci/ /snga phyi'i skye ba'i smyor las dpogs so lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa thun mong gi yon tan ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pa dang cha 'dra ba'am ris 'dra ba nyon mongs med pa dang smon nas shes pa nas zad par gyi skye mched bar sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang slob pa'i thun mong ba de yin gsungs/ sdom 'dir/ slob ma dang thun mong ba yin zhes brjod par bya yi/— slob pa dang thun mong ba zhes bshad na 'grig pa min te/ 'di'i thun mong ba la dgra bcom pa yod pas de mi slob pa yin pa'i phyir/ smon pa btang nas sam 'di shesardzipar bya'o snyam du sems gtad nas shes pa'i phyir smon nas shes zhes brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/ bye smra na re/ 'di bsam gtan bzhi ba yin phyir/ gzugs med mi shes zhes zer/ 'o na lus dngadhesems dman zhing zhi ba'i rgyu mthun las gzugs med nas skyes so chazhes dang / snyoms 'jug gi khyad par las gzugs med du skyes so zhes dang / gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin thob la/ ma nyams—656

pa dang ldan pas gzugs med du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa ci yin zhe na/ snga phyi'i skye ba'i sbyor ba las dpogs pa yin te/ dper na/ zhing ba rnams kyis 'bru las zhing dpogs pa dang zhing las 'bru dpogs pa bzhin no/ /zhes zer ro /lo ni gong bzhin no/ — /so rig rgyud rten nyon mongs med dang 'dra/ /chos kyang mig ce skub pa'i chos sogs min/ /bzhi ba'i rtsang 'das la sogs thab byed kyi/ /rigs ba'am gtan tshigs thogs med mngon par brjod/ /spobs pa so rig ngag dang lam dmigs gnyis/ /bsdoms na 'gog shes ma gtogs zhes pa dgu /ngag sogs kun 'byung yin pa 'azhis spyang shes/ /ngag lam ci rigs shes byar sa bcu gcig /don ni shes byar byas na shespo pa bcu/ /byung 'das byas na zad shes drug dang 'dra/ /lhag ma'i ngo bo sa sogs rtsa bar gsal/ /thun mong chos drug rab mthar brten dgos spyang / /lngas tshig dang sa 'gal phyir de'i rten min/ /zhes gsungs te/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni rgyud rten gnyis ka nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang 'dra ste/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la yod pa dang / mi'i rten can yin pa'i phyir/ chos kyang chos rnams kyi ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs rig pa ste sgrub pa'i chos 'phags lam yan lag brgyad 657

ririsogs kyi chos min la/ kun rdzob shes pa'o/ /so rig bzhi ba'i don ni myang 'das la sogs sgrub byed kyi rigs pa'am gtan spre tshigs thogs pa med par brjod pa'i chos de yin la/ spobs pa so rig de la ngag dang lam la dmigs pa gnyis yod/ de gnyis bsdoms na 'gog pa shes pa ma gtogs shes pa dgu yod/ ngag la sogs pa kun 'byung yin pa 'dis kyang 'grub ste/ ngag de nyid zag bcas yin pa'i phyir sdug bsngal yin la/ sdug bsngal phyi ma bskyed pa'i phyir kun 'byung yang yin no/ /spobs pa so rig de ni ngag lam ci rigs shes pa'i phyir sa bcu gcig na yod r+shal/ don so sor yang dag rig pa ni/ don chos thams cad rig pa'i dbang du byas na shes pa bcu dngagyi/ don gyi gtso bo—myang 'das shes pa yin na/ 'gog pa shes pa/ chos shes pa/rjes su shes pa/ kun rdzob shes pa/ zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa drug gis bsdus pa'i phyir/ lhag ma'i ngo bo sa sogs rtsa bar gsal te/ yang dag don rig bcu 'am drug /de ni sa kun na/ zhes so/ /chos dang nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa gnyis ni kun rdzob shes pa'o/ /chos so so yang dag rig pa niske'adod pa dang bsam gtan bzhi na yod/ nges pa'i tshig so so—yang dag rig pa ni 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang bo gnyis na —658

yod/ thob tshul ni/ de bzhi gang rung zhig thob na bzhi ga thob dgos shing / gang rung zhig ma tshang bar de thob pa med pa'i phyir/ting nge 'dzin gnyis te nyon mongs med pa dang smon nas shes pa gnyis dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ste/ thun mong chos drug ni bsam gtan bzhi ba'i rab mtha' la brten dgos gsungs kyang / nges tshig so so yang dag par rig pa ni rtog dpyod kyis kun nas slong ba'i phyir 'dod pa dang / bsam gtan dang bo'i sa ba yin pas/ bsam gtan bzhi ba'i rab mtha' dang 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi ba'i rab mtha' de nges tshig so so yang dag par rig pa'i rten min no/ /'o na/drug po de dag rab mtha' bas/ /zhes khyad par med par bshad pa ci zhe na/ de ni rab mtha' ba'i bsam gtan gyi stobs kyis 'thob pa'i phyir de skad bshad kyi bsam gtan bzhi ba'i sa ba ni min no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la rnam drug gsangs pa nyon mongs med/ /smon gnas mkhyen dang so rig gsum gyi rtseng / /de lnga gang gi ngo bor ma skyed pa'i/ /rab mtha' tsam po dang bcas drug yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ lnga ba zhar byung rab mtha' ni/ bsam gtan bzhi ba'i rab mtha' de la rnam pa drug gi bdag nyid can du gsungs pa ni/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting 659

nge 'dzin dang / smon gnas mkhyen pa dang / so rig bzhi'i nges tshig ma gtogs pa gsum gyi steng du de lnga gang gi ngo bor ma skyed pa'i rab mtha' tsam po dang bcas pa drug yin no/ /'dod rnas grid rtse'i bar du song 'ong gnyis/ /blar lang 'dod nas bzhi ba'i bar 'gro ba/ /mthun byas 'on kyang rab mtha' so sor bshad/ /grub mtha' gong mas rab dang mtha' yi don/ /gcig byas rab mthar bsam gtan bzhi ga yod/ /ces gsungs te/rab mtha' de la 'phel ba gsum gyi mchog gam rab kyi mthar phyin pa zhig dgos te/ 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar du song ste lugs mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa dang / de nas yarnga yas rim nas 'dod pa'i sems kyi bar du lugs bzlog tu 'ong ste snyoms par 'jug pa dang / slar yang 'dod pa nas bsam gtan bzhi ba'i bar du 'gro ba ste snyoms par 'jug pa ni/ sa kun gyis mthun par byas dziyin la/ rab dang mtha'i don so sor bshad de/'phel ba'i mchog ni rab yin no/ /zhe—sa dang / 'dir mtha' ni 'phel ba'am rnam pa yin te/ zhes so/ /grub mtha' gong ma'i lugs la rab dang mtha'i don so sor med par gcig byas nas/rab mtha' la bsam sa/tan bzhi ga yod par gsungs te/ 'phel ba gsum gyi mthar byung ba'i bsam gzugs rnams rab mtha'i 660

snyoms 'jug yin par 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'phel ba gsum ni/khams gsum sa dgu la lugs ca/thun lugs bzlog tu snyoms par 'jug pa 'phel ba chung ngu/ yang lugs mthun du re re bar du rgal ba'i thod rgal 'phel ba 'bring / lugs bzlog tu thod rgal zhugs pa 'phel ba rab yin zhes gsungs so/ /sgom byung mngon zhes skabs 'asko'i rnam grol gyis/ /khyab byar nem grol dbang shes mi 'gal lo/ /skabs 'azhis mchims kyang rgyan bcas mi g.yoragasungs/ /sems lnga'o zad shes zad stobs bzhen zhe na/ /sa lang kun byar srid rtses brtsas pa'i de / /mngon sum yin na zag med thal bar 'argyur/ /lugs 'der mngon shes mngon sum min nam dazad/ /'dod dang brad rtse'i mngon shes yod dam dpyad/ /sems tsam mngon shes 'di bas spyor bar byas/ /sngar rtadris 'ardod la chags bral tsam gyis thob/ /rtsog byung kho na'o bska la mtha'i lha la dpyad/ /ces gsungs te/gnyis pa so skye dang thun mong ba'i yon ston bshad pa la/ mngon shes drug yod de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yul shes pa mngon du bya ba'i mngon shes dang / lha'i rna ba'imo mngon thes dang / sems can gyi rnam grangs shes pa'i dang / sdon gyi gnas rjes sudran pa'i dang / 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa'i dang / zag pa zad 661

pa'i mngon shes dang drug yod/ mngon shes drug po dper na dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu 'dus byas rnam grol lam gyi rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ rnam par grol ba'i lam gyi blo shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin la/ sgom byung mngon shes kyi skabs 'dir/mngon shes kyi sgom byung la rnam grol gyi lam gyis khyab pas/ rnam grol lam dang dbang shes mi 'gal te/ lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni dbang shes yin kyang skabs 'di'i mngon shes kyi rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir mchims mdzod mchan las/ gal te bar chad med lam gyis bsdus na dgra bcom gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol la mngon shes med par 'gyur te bar chad med lam btang nas med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gnyis ka'i cha las grol ba'i dgra bcom rgyan bcas pa de mi g.yo bar gsungs te/ de mngon shes dang ldan pa'i dgra bcom par gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems la shes pa lnga yin no/ /zad pa'i mngon shes stobs bzhin no/ /zhe na/ zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs shes pa drug gam bcu'i rang bzhin dang sa yang kun te bcu gcig gis bsdus pa'i phyir/ srid rtses kyang bsdus par 'dod dgos pas de mngon sum yin na zag med du thal bar 'gyur te/ srid rtser zag bcas kyi mngon shes sgrub tshul med pa'i phyir/ des na 662

lugs 'di ste bye smra'i lugs la mngon shes mngon sum yin nam dpyad gsungs/ yin nam zhes yin pa 'thad phyogs su gsungs te/ rnam grol blo zhes rnam grol lam yin par gsungs pa dang /mdo las/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yul mngon du bya ba'i zhes dang / lha'i rna ba'i shes pa mngon du bya ba'i zhes dang / sems kyi rnam grangs mngon du bya ba'i/ zhes sogs mngon du zhes pa'i tshig du ma 'byung ba'i tshig gi nus pa la brten pa gsal/ 'dod par gtob/sa pa yang yod par 'dod dam snyam ste/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i sprul ba ni/ phyi yi skye mched bzhi zhes sogs dang /srid rtse'i mngon shes yod pa gong du zad shes zag zad kyi stobs bzhin gsungs pas 'grub par bzhed do/ /sems tsam pa rnams kyis bsam gtan la brten nas gzugs 'di 'dra bas na semyo/sa 'di 'dra bar 'gyur te zhes dang / lus 'di la sems kyi rnam pa ci 'dra zhig ces pha rol la sems gtad pa las shes pa lta bu pha rol sems shes yin par 'dod la/ 'di ba bye smras de sbyor ba yin par 'a dod de/ de ltar byas pas gang gi tshe gzugs la ma lhos par pha rol gyi sems shes pa de'i tshe sems shes grub pa yin/zhes 'dod do/ /skye ba sngar 'dris pa'i bag chags yod pa dag gis 'dod pa la chags bral byas pa tsam gyis mngon shes thob/663

sbyor byung kho na'o zer na bskal ba mtha'i lha la dpyad par bya ste /chos nyid kyi dngos gzhi thob pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon shes bzhi dang dran nye smyor tshul gsal/ /sngon gnas 'chi 'pho gnyis la dran nye bzhi/ /bye smras mig ne'i mngon shes dbang shes smra/ /bsam gtan bzhi la yod gsungs dang mi 'gal/ /de'i rten dbang bo'am 'dren byed bar chad med/ /bsam gtan de des brtsas la dgongs so lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ mngon shes bzhi dang dran pa nyer bzhag sbyor tshul rtsa 'grel kun tu gsal te/ mngon shes gsum pa sems can gyi rnam grangs shes pa'i mngon shes ni/ sems dang chos dang tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag gsum gyi rang bzhin dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang rna ba'i mngon shes dang mig gi mngon shes gsum ni lus dran pa nyer bzhag yin pa'i phyir/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes dang 'chi 'pho skye ba dran pa'i mngon shes gnyis ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ga yin pa'i phyir/ bye smras/ mig gi mngon shes dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni/ dbang shes yin smra ba la/ 'o na mngon shes 'di dag bas ma gtan bzhi ba'i sa bar mi 'thad de/ dbang shes ni rtog dpyod dang bcas pa'i phyir zhe na/ bye smra na re/ rten gyi dbang bo sa gang yin pa'i dbang du byas nas sam yang na mngon shes lam grol lam 664

yin pas de 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam bsam ga/tano de dang des bsdus pa la dgongs/ zer lo/ rjes dran 'chi 'apo zag zad gsum kho na/ /dus gsum mongs sel rig pa'o de las kyang / /gnyis ne mi blob rgyud la skyes pa'i pyir/ /mi slob rig par bat+tad kyang mi blob min/ /tha mar mi blob mi jagos grid rtse'i phyir/ /mngon shes de dag blob la yod mod kyang / /smongs bcas phyir na rig pa'i sgras ma bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi slob pa'i rig pa gsum yod de/ de'i rgyud kyi sngon gnas shes pa dang / 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa dang / zag pa zad pa shes pa gsum po kho na mi slob pa'i rig pa 'jog la/ de gsum mi slob pa'i rig par 'jog la gzhan rnams mi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gsum ni rim pa bzhin du sngon gyi mthu' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang /bar du rmongs pa sel ba'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ de gsum las spyang / mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni mi slob pa yin la/ sngon gnas rjes dran dang 'chi 'pho dang skyewā shes pa gnyis ni ngon dam pa'i mi slob pa ma yin kyang / mi slob pa de'i rgyud la skyes pa'i phyir mi slob pa'i rig par bshad pa tsam —las mi slob nga/ min no/ /de gsum gyi tha ma zag zad mngon shes la yang mi slob pa kho na mi dgos te/ mngon shes dang bo lnga 665

gzugs med na med kyang / tha ma zag zad kyi mngon shes srid rtser yang yod pa'i phyir/ mngon shes de dag las sngon gnas rjes dran dang 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa'i mngon shes gnyis slob pa la'ang yod par 'dod mod/ 'on kyang slob pa'i rig par ma bshad de/ rmongs pa ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i phyir na slob pa'i rig pa'i sgras ma bstan to/ /rtsa 'asprul sems shes zag zad mngon shes gsum/ /sku 'phrul kun brjod rjes bstan cho 'chul te/ /dzhan snya ri ba'i sngags kyi spu 'phul dang / /rtog byed rtses sngags kun brjod 'phul byed la/ /rjes bstan de 'dras mi nus 'khrul med de/ /babs ston phan 'dogs 'bras bu mchog la spyor/ /zhes gsungs te/ rdzu 'phrul ni/ dang bo rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang / gsum pa sems can gyi rnam grangs shes pa'i mngon shes dang / drug pa zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes gsum yin la/ de gsum ni rim pa bzhin du/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gsum yod/ cho 'phrul dang bo gnyis ni ghan dha risazhes bya ba'i rig sngags kyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul dang rtog byed ces bya ba'i rig sngags kyis pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang / sman dang mi ma yin gyi nus pas kyang / kun 666

brjod kyi rdzu 'phrul byed la/ rjes bstan de 'dra mi nus par phacharol gyi sems gtod pa tsam yin/ rdzu 'phrul 'khrul ba med pa de mchog tu gyur pa ni rjes bstan gyi rdzu 'phrul yin la/ des thabs ston pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs shing sdug bsngal med pa'i yid du 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mchog la sbyor bar byed do/ /'gro dang sprul ba'i dbye ba rtsa bar gsal/ /mngon shes kho nas sprul min sprul sems kyis/ /sprul phyir de yang dang bor rang 'og gnyis/ /nas bzung bzhi bar lnga ste bcu bzhi 'o/ /'dod pa'i sprul sems logs su ma bshad de/ /bsam gtan so so 'bras bu bshad yin la/ /de lang bzhi bo gang rung 'azas phyir ro/ /dang bo'i 'azas bus 'dod pa'i sprul bems kyis/ /(gnyis pa) mi bgrod phyir na 'dod pa'i sprul sems bzhi/ /sbyi ma phyi ma 'groce ba'i khrad par 'phags/ /gnyis pa'i 'bras bu dang bo'i sprul sems ni/ /yod kyang 'og 'bras gong ma'i sprul sems med/ / ces gsungs te/ 'gro ba/ myur bar 'gro ba sogs sprul ba'i dbye ba rtsa bar gsal ba ltar mtha' dpyod sogs su rgyas pas sdom 'dir ma bsdus la/ sprul ba ni mngon shes kho nas sprul bar byed pa ma yin te/ mngon shes kyi 'bras bu sprul sems dag gis sprul ba sprul bar byed pa'i phyir/ de yang dang bor—667

rang sa dang 'og sa gnyis nas bzung bzhi bar lnga ste bcu bzhi yod de/ bsam gtan dang bo'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i sprul sems la 'dod pa dang rang sas bsdus pa'i sprul sems gnyis/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la 'og sa gnyis dang rang sas bsdus pa'i sprul sems gsum/ bsam gtan gsum pa la 'og sa gsum dang rang sas bsdus pa'i sprul sems gcig ste bzhi/ bsam gtan bzhi ba la 'og sa bzhi dang rang sas bsdus pa'i sprul sems gcig ste lnga yod pa'i bar rim bzhin sbyor ba'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i sprul sems logs su ma bshad de/ 'dod pa'i sprul sems mi/ bsam gtan so so'i 'bras bur bshad pa yin te/ 'dod pa'i sprul sems ni bsam gtan bzhi bo kho nas 'bras bu yin la/de yang bsam gtan bzhi bo gang rung gi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/bsam gtan dang bo'i 'bras bu'i 'dod pa'i sprul sems kyis/sprul ba'i 'dod pa'i sprul ba des bsam gtan dang bo'i sa ba'i bar du bgrod nus kyi gnyis pa la sogs par 'gro mi nus la/de bzhin du bsam gtan bzhi'i 'bras bu 'dod pa'i sprul sems bzhi/ phyi ma phyi ma la 'gro thub pa'i khyad par 'phags/bsam gtan gnyis pa'i 'bras bu bsam gtan dang bo'i sprul sems yod kyang / 'og sa'i 'bras bu sa gong ma'i sprul sems 668

med do/ /dngos gzhi bzhin du 'og sar bral las rnyed/ / gnyis las skye zhing de las de gnyis 'byung / /rang sa'i sprul byed dmigs bsal gnyis ba lan/ /rtog dbyod med pyir(ro)'og mas smra ru 'jug /de ni smra sems tsam las sprul sems min/ /dzi la sems dang ne lhan cig 'gal zhe na/ /sngar sprul zin nas ring gnas byin rlabs phyir/ /de tshe sprul bems mi dgos lung ring bor/ /ji skad cig gis smra bar byed pa na/ /sprul ba thams cad smra bar byed gsungs pa/ /ston min dbang byas zhi shar byin rlabs med/ /rus par yod lo n+de gzhan 'od srungs rus/ /gnas gtsang lha mthu'o byin rlabs yod min zer/ /byang dang ma byang sprul tshul rtsa bar gsal/ /zhes gsungs te/sprul sems rnyed tshul yod de/ de dag bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhin du 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral ba las rnyed pa'i phyir/ sprul ba'i sems kho na las ldang bar 'gyur ba med de/sprul sems de ni dang bor sprul bar 'jug tshe bsam gtan dag pa ba dang / rgyun gyi tshe rang nyid dang gnyis las skye zhing de las de gnyis las 'byung la/ ldang ba'i tshe na yang bsam gtan dag pa ba dang / sprul sems gnyis las ldang ba'i phyir/sa gzhan gyi sprul sems kyis gzhan gyi sprul ba mi byed de/ rang 669

gi sa ba'i sprul sems kyis sprul bar byed la/ dmigs bsal bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad kyis ngag smra bar 'jug pa'i tshe/rtog dpyod med phyir sa 'og ma bsam gtan dang bo'i sems kyis smra bar 'jug la/ de ni smra sems tsam las sprul sems min no/ /rgyud gcig la smra sems dang sprul sems gnyis cig car 'byung ba 'gal ba'i phyir zer na/ skyon med de/ dang bor sprul ba bos sprul sems kyis sprul zin nas yun ring du gnas par gyur cig snyam du mos nas byin gyis brlabs te/ de'i 'og tu sems gzhan dag gi kun slong rtog dpyod dang bcas pa de dag 'di lta ra smra bar gyur cig snyam du mos nas smra ba la 'jug pa'i phyir/de'i tshe sprul sems mi dgos te/ lung ring bo las/ ji skad du/ gcig gis smra bar byed pa na/ /sprul ba thams cad smra bar byed/ /gcig mi smra bar gyur pa dang / /de dag thams cad smra mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa de ston pa ma yin pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ kha che ba dag shi ba la byin rlabs med de mi brtan pa sha khrag dang pags pa la sogs pa la med cing / brtan ba rus pa la byin rlabs yod zer lo/ sde ba gzhan dag na re/'od srungs kyi keng rus gnas pa ni/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyi mthus gnas pa yin no/ /zhes 'dod de/ byin rlabs med 670

zer/ sprul ba ji ltar sprul tshul yod de/ byang ba dang ma byang bas sprul tshul rtsa bar gsal te/ dang bo du mas gcig yin te/ / byang bar gyur nas bzlog pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /rmo sprul sems skyes thob la ne dge sogs gsum/ /sgom byung skyes thob bsnan pas spu 'asprul lnga/ /byang sems 'khor ba ra khrim bdag rin chen star/ /lha yi mig dang 'dra bas btags pa 'am / /dngos yin zhe na mig rna'i ban kor du/ /bsam gtan 'byung ba rgyur byas gzugs dwangs pa/ /sha rus sogs dang ma 'azel lha'i mig rna/ /dngos 'byung / /zhes gsungs te/ skyes thob kyi sprul sems de la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod/ rdzu 'phrul gyi dbye ba la/ rtsa ba'i tshig zin la thon pa'i gas/nga sngags dang / sman dang / las las skyes pa gsum gyi steng du/ sgom byung dang skyes thob gnyis bsnan pas rdzu 'phrul lnga yod/ lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes kyi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mig dbang dang rna dbang gnyis ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'khor 'o sa bsgyur ba dang khyim bdag rin po che gsum gyi mig lta bu'i lha'i mig dang 'dra bas btags pa ba'am/ dngos gnas gang yin zhe na/ lha'i mig dang rna ba dngos gnas ra yin te/bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs pas mig gi yul du snang ba dang 671

mig dang rna ba'i than kor ram nye 'khor du bsam gtan gyi sa'i 'byung ba rnams rgyur byas pa'i gzugs can dwangs pa'i rang bzhin sha rus sogs dang ma 'brel ba'i lha'i mig dbang dang rna dbang dngos 'byung ba yin no/ / sku 'asbul bzhin du rna sogs bzhi/ /skyes thob yod kyang mngon shes ming mi 'thob/ /skyes thob mig gis bar grid mi mthong la/ /skyes thob sems shes la ne dge sogs gsum/ /mtshan ma las dpog rtog ge'i sems shes dang / /sngags kyi sems shes la yang gsum gsum mo/ /dmyal bar skyes ma thag la sems zhes dang / /rjes dran ldan no mi la sems shes ni/ /skyes thob med kyang tshe rabs dran pa yod/ /ces gsungs te/ rdzu 'phrul la skyes thob yod pa de bzhin du rna ba sogs bzhi ste/ lha'i mig dang rna ba dang sngon gnas rjes dran dang pha rol sems shes bzhi la yang skyes pas thob pa yod kyi/ 'on kyang skyes thob kyis ni cung zad kyang mngon shes kyi ming mi 'thob bo/ /skyes thob kyi mig gang yin pa des srid pa bar ma mi mthong ste/ bar srid de ni skyon bcu gcig dang bral ba mngon par shes pa'i lha'i mig rnam par dag pa kho na'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ skyes thob kyi sems shes la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod do/ /gang yang rtog ge ba rnams kyis mtshan ma las dpog pa'i sems 672

shes dang / rig sngags kyis byas pa'i sems shes gnyis la yang dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gsum yod la/ sgom byung ni dge ba kho na'o/ /dmyal ba bas ni dang bor skyes ma thag gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang / sngon gnas rjes dran gyi sems shes dngaholdan mod phyis ni min te/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar bas mi shes so/ /mi la skyes thob kyi sems shes med kyang tshe rabs dran pa yod do/ /phyin drug mngon shes lnga yi zer brgya yis/ /rab bskyangs lung rtogs pad dkar ge sar gyi/ /bcud bzang myong ba'i theg gsum bh+ra ma ras/ / dam chos dbyangs kyis rmongs pa kun 'joms shog /gnas bdun pa'i skabs so/ /gnas brgyad pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba/byams dang snying rje'i sa gzhi brtan po la/ /bdag med la dmigs ting 'dzin 'bum phrag gis/ /phung 'dre ma rig rtsad nas bcom byas te/ /zung 'jug rgyal thabs zin pa de yis skyongs/ /'dir gnas brgyad pa'i skabs kyi sdom tshig cung zad 673

'grel ba la/ bsam gtan sa ne gsum pa yin zhes sogs/ /gsum par der skyes pa dag rab tu bshad/ /'di yis sems par byed sbyir bsam gtan no/ /bsam gtan sas brtsas cha bzhag sems rtse gcig /snyoms 'jug don no nyer brjogs dngos sazhi gnyis/ /'on kyang sems rtse gcig pa ting 'dzin yin/ / zhes gsungs te/ gnyis pa snyoms 'jug gi yon tan gtan la dbab pa la/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug dang / gzugs rdid kyi snyoms 'jug gnyis yod pas/ bsam gtan la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi de dang / 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan gnyas yod/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi'i rgyu snyoms 'jug chung 'bring che gsum gyi 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan bzhi la gnas gsum gsum dang / bzhi ba la de'i steng du spel sgom lnga'i 'bras bu gnas gtsang lnga daje brgyad yod pa'i phyir te/ gnas gsum pa'i rtsa bar/ der so so yi/ bsam gtan sa ni gsum pa yin/ /bzhi ba sa ni brgyad pa yin/ /zhes sogs kyis/ bsam gtan dang bo gsum gyi gnas gsum gsum dgu dang / bsam gtan bzhi ba'i gnas brgyad de/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu 674

bdun yod par gsungs pa sogs/ gnas gsum pa der 'bras bu skye ba'i gnas dag rab tu rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir/ dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin de dag la bsam gtan zhes brjod pa'i sgra don yod de/ 'dis sems par byed pas na bsam gtan zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan sas bsdus kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i sems rtse gcig pa de/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gi don nam mtshan nyid yin no/ /de la dbye na bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dang / nyer bsdogs gnyis yod/ sems rtse gcig pa'i don yod de sems kyi rtse dmigs pa yin pas de gcig la gtod pa de yin la/ 'on kyang / sems rtse gcig pa ni ting nge 'dzin yin mod/ ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs ldan thams cad dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu dmigs bzhin du/ sems kho na la dmigs pa rtse gcig pa zhes brjod pa3 gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /skye ba'i bsam gtan snod bcud sna tshogs shing / /nam 'tsho'i bar du gnas par mchims ṭīka gsungs/ /stoms 'anug ston mongs can ni snyoms 'jug min/ /yig char gzugs med sdom yod ldan la dgongs/ /phal chen chung la gzugs med btags zhes smra/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan la snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can sna tshogs 675

shig yod la/ de dag longs su spyod pa'i sems can dag ji srid nam 'tsho'i bar du gnas par mchims ṭīka las gsungs te/de'i mchan las de'i 'bras bu gong ma'i phung bo snod dang bcas pa ni 'bras bu'o/ /zhes dang / tshe ji srid bar rgyun chags pa ni 'bras bu'o/ /zhes gsungs/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can dzisnyoms 'jug ma yin te/ dge ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ snyoms 'jug yin na dge ba yin pas khyab ste/ rtsa bar/ snyoms 'jug dge ba rtse gcig pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dag pa ba'i rdzas ro myong gi sred pa sogs gang rung dang bcas pa'i phyir/ snyoms 'jug dang dge bar mi rung ngo / /yig char/ byas pa la kho na re/ gzugs med khams kyi gzugs yod par thal/ gzugs med khams pa'i rten can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la zag med kyi sdom pa yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab cing / rtags grub ste/ de zag med kyi snyoms 'jug gi tshogs pa na yod cing / rten gzugs med na —yod kyang gzugs med kyi sas bsdus ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gzugs med na zag med rdo+om pa yod par gsungs pa/ zag med sdom pa ldan pa yod pa la dgongs pa yin te/ gzugs med 676

na gzugs med pa gong 'og kun mthun pa'i phyir/ de la phal chen sde ba sogs na re/ gzugs med na gzugs yod kyang /gzugs med par bshad pa ni/ sdong tshod chung zhing dwangs pa la gzugs med ces btags pa tsam yin no zhes smra bar byed/ bye smra na re/ de re re nas mi 'thad de/ 'o na chu'i nang gi skye bo rdul phra rab lta bu'i 'bu yang gzugs med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / bar do ba dang gzugs khams pa yang der 'gyur la gang las ches dwangs pa med pas gzugs med zer na/ srid rtse kho na gle/zugs med du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ /gzugs med dmigs pa nam mkha' sogs sam dpyad/ /der brten zab med gsum gyi 'byed byed dbyad/ /srid rtser snyoms 'jug zag med yod pa'i phyir/ /snas gsum 'gyur ro zag mad snyoms 'jug kyang / /snyoms 'jug zag med min de'i dbang byas lo/ /snas gnyis nang gi dgu ba ba ru thal/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni nam mkha' la sogs pa yin te/ dmigs pa'i sgos 'og sa las 'da' ba'i rigs gnas kyi dge sems rtse gcig pa de/ gzugs med snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs med la yang rgyu'i snyoms 'jug gi gzugs med dang 'bras bu skye ba'i snyoms 'jug gi 677

gzugs med dngos gzhi gnyis yod/ nam mkha' sogs la dmigs pa'i sgo nas nam mkha' mtha' yas sogs brjod de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam pa dang / rnam shes mtha' yas so snyam pa dang / ci yang med do zhes bya ba yid la byed pa dang / sbyor ba'i dus su 'di ltar yid la byas te snyoms 'jug bsgrubs pa yin la/ gzugs med dang bo de gsum gyi dmigs pa la nam mkha' sogs gsum kho nas ma khyab ste/ gzugs med dngos gzhi dang bo gsum gyi ngo bor gyur pa so so la 'das lam zag med yod pa'i phyir/ der brten gzugs med dang bo gsum gyi dngos gzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'das lam zag med gsum gyi khyad par 'byed byed dpyad dgos te/ 'di ltar dpyad par bya ste/ rtsa ba las/rnam shes mtha' yas mkha' mtha' yas/ /ci yang med ces bya de ltar/ /sbyor phyir dman phyir 'du shes med/ /'du shes med nga 'ang ma yin no/ /zhes sbyor phyir gsungs pa ltar/sbyor ba'i dus su nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam pa sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba 'byed dgos snyam mo/ /snyoms 'jug dngos gzhi'i rdzas rnam pa brgyad yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i bzhi dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ srid rtse ma gtogs pa'i dang bo bdun la rdzas gsum re yod de/ ro myang 678

ldan dang / dag pa dang / zag med gsum re yod pa'i phyir /brgyad pa srid rtse la ro myang ldan dang dag pa gnyis yod la zag med med de/ de 'du shes kyi rgyu ba mi gsal bas/ dmigs rnam shin tu gsal ba'i 'das lam gyi ngo bor mi rung ba'i phyir/mngon pa gong 'og kun gyis de ltar 'dod la/ rang rgyud pa sogs gzhan dag gis/ srid rtser snyoms 'jug zag med yod par 'dod pa'i phyir/ de ltar na srid rtser yang ro myang ldan dang /dag pa dang / zag med kyi rdzas te rdzas gsum yod par 'gyur ro/ /bye smras med de/ zag med snyoms 'jug kyang dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug zag med min te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa'i dngos gzhi'i rdzas de ma yin pa'i phyir/ zer lo/de ltar srid rtse'i zag med snyoms 'jug logs su bkol na/ de ltar snyoms 'jug dngos gzhi'i rdzas/ rnam pa brgyad dang bdun zhes pa'i rdzas gnyis kyi nang gi brgyad kyi 'og gi dgu ba ba ru thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bye smra dang bo gnyis kyi dga' ba ni/ /tshor ba yin phyir bde ba zhin tshong ngo / /dbe ston bde ba gsum ga lus tshor 'dod/ /lus tshor phyir bltas yin byar g.yeng bar 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin las skyes lus bde der mthun lo/ /'ardod pa'i lus kyis gong ma'i reg 679

phyong 'byur/ /shan tu sbyangs phyir tsung lang skyon med lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ gsum pa'i bde ba dang bo gnyis kyi bde ba rdzas gzhan ji ltar yin zhe na/ bye smra na re/ bsam gtan dang bo gnyis kyi dga' ba ni tshor ba yin la/ bde ba shin sbyangs yin pa'i phyir rdzas mtshungs mi nyams shing / yan lag gi grangs dang yang mthun no zer/ dpe ston pa ste mdo sde ba na re/ bde ba gsum ga lus tshor yin te/ bsam gtan ston pa'i mdo las/ bde ba lus kyis myong la zhes gsungs pas/ lus bde kho na yan lag yin no/ /zhes zer/ 'o na sgo lnga'i shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis g.yeng ba'i phyir kha phyir bltas kyi lus tshor gyis g.yeng bar 'gyur ro/ /zhe na/ skyon de med de/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i lus shes mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de nyid lus kyi nang du 'byung bas phyi rol du g.yengs par mi 'gyur te/ de ting nge 'dzin dang mthun pa'i phyir/ zer ro/ /gzhan yang / 'dod pa'i rten can bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag pa'i bsam gtan sa ba'i reg bya dang lus shes gzugs kyi sa ba yin pas 'dod pa'i lus dbang gis gzugs na spyod pa'i reg bya 'dzin pa'i lus shes skyed mi nus pa'i phyir zer na/ nyes pa med de/ 'dod pa'i lus shes kyis gong ma 'i reg bya myong nus par 'gyur te/ shin tu sbyangs pas reg bya zhes bya ba 680

myong yang skyon med/ zer lo/ bar chad med lam yan lag su laphad/ /rim phyir yan lag lnga ldan med par 'gyur/ /rtog dbyod gnyis spyang rim byar mtshungs so lo/ /gin sbyangs bden bzhi bar ba de 'phel 'gyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsam gtan dang bo'i dngos gzhis sems rten byas pa'i nyan thos kyi mthong lag bar chad med lam du gyur pa'i rtog dpyod gnyis re re nas yod par gsungs pas/ de mthong lam bar chad med lam yin pas bar chad med lam pa de'i rgyud la yod dgos so/ /de 'dra'i bar chad med d+kulam yod de/ bsam gzugs mtha' dpyod las/rtags grub ste/ de yod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'on kyang / de gnyis gang rung yod pa la dgongs kyi cig car gasnyas ka yod pa min te/ rang 'grel las/ skad cig las ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang / 'grel bshad las/ bsam gtan dang bo'i sa res 'ga' ni rtog pa dang ldan la/ res 'ga' ni dbyod pa dang ldan no/ /zhes dang / skad cig ma'i dbang du mdzad pa ni ma yin pas nyes pa med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar na yan lag lnga ga cig car du ldan pa med par 'gyur mod/ bye smras de ltar mi 'dod de/ des na sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud na rtog dpyod gnyis cig car med par thal 681

lo/ /des na rtsing zhib kyi khyad par bshad pa ni/ gtso che ba dgongs na rung ngo / /zhes bsam gzugs mtha' da pyod las gsungs so/ /slob dpon rgyal sras pa sogs sems tsam pa kha cig na re/ yid kyi brjod pa kun tu tshol ba rtog pa dang so sor nges pa dpyod pa yin pas rim gyis skye ba bzhin yan lag lnga rim gyis skye ba mtshungs so/ /zhes zer/ de la bye smra sogs na re/mdo las yan lag lnga bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ sems gcig la de gnyis cig car mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ zer/ sems tsam pa sogs na re/ rtog dpyod dang bcas pa ni sas bsdus la yin gyi sems gcig la de gnyis ldan pa'i don ma yin pa'i phyir te/bsam gtan dang bo'i snyoms 'jug res rtog pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa res dpyod pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa'i rgyun gyi dbang du byas nas de ltar bshad kyi sems kyi skad cig ma'i dbang du ma byas pa'i phyir zer ro/ /shin sbyangs ni/ yid dga' na lus shin tu sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yid la tshor ba'i dga' ba khyad par can skyes pa'i lus shin sbyangs lhag par 'phel la/ de 'dra'i dga' ba de zag bcas kyi dga' ba yin pas/ kun 'byung bden pa yin no/ /des na shin sbyangs de nyid bden pa bzhi'i bar ba kun 'byung bden pa'i bye brag las 'phel bar 682

'gyur ro/ /grub mtha' gong mas dga' bde tshor gcug kyang / /lus sems phan 'dogs ldog pas bye gsungs ging / /rab dwangs gnyis par stog dablod bral ba'i phyir/ /gnyen po dran dang shes bzhin bajoms la gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ grub mtha' gong ma ste/ mngon pa gong mas yid tshor sems pa de/ dga' bde gnyis ka yin par 'dod la/ 'o na dga' bde gnyis kyi khyad par med par 'gyur ro zhe na/ lus la phan 'dogs pa'i sgo nas bde ba zhes brjod la/ sems la phan 'dogs pa'i sgo nas dga' ba zhes brjod de/ de ltar phan 'dogs pa'i ldog cha'i sgo nas so sor phye'o/ /zhes gsungs/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i yan lag rab dwangs ni/ bsam gtan dang bor rtog dpyod yod la gnyis par rtog dpyod dang bral phyir gnyen po'i yan lag yin te/ bsam gtan dang bo'i rtog dpyod la skyon du bltas nas spong ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i mi mthun phyogs rnam pa lnga spong ba'i gnyen po/ dran pa shes bzhin btang snyo mas gsum yin yang / dran pa dang shes bzhin gnyis rang ming gis ma bstan par rab dwangs dang bsdoms la rab dwangs kyi ming shis bstan te gsungs so/ /sde ba kha byug gsum pa'i bde ba 683

yang / /yid bde yin la dga' ba des spangs phyir/ /de gnyis gzhan du smra yang bsam gtan gyi/ /yan lag ston mdor yid bde yid mi bde/ /nub gsungs rnam par brgyar ba'i mdo las spyang / /yid bde'i dbang bo skyes pa ma lus pa/ /bkag par 'gyur ro gsungs sbyir yid bde dga'/ /bye smras ting nge 'dzin ni bsam gtan dang / /bsam gtan lan lag gnyis yin gzhan min zer// zhes gsungs te/ sde ba kha cig na re/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ba yid bde yin la dga' ba ni yid bde las tshor ba gzhan zhig yin la/ bsam gtan gsum pa bas de la skyon du bltas nas spangs pa'i phyir/ zhes yid bde dang dga' bde gnyis gzhan te mi 'dra ba yin zhes smra ba mi 'thad de/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag ston pa'i mdo las/ bde ba spangs te/ snga nas sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang yid mi bde ba yang nub pas/ zhes dang / rnam par bsgyur ba'i mdo las kyang / bsam gtan gsum pa bka' stsal nas/ 'dir 'di'i yid bde ba'i dbang bo skyes pa ma lus par 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na yid bde ni dga' ba yin pa'i phyir/ bye smra na re/ ting nge 'dzin ni bsam gtan yin la/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag yang yin te/ bsam gtanañtsa684

bzhi'i dmigs bzhin du yan lag lnga'i bsam gtan yang 'dra bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ yan lag gzhan rnams ni bsam gtan min te yan lag kho na yin nga/'i phyir zer ro/ /nyon mongs can la med ga sung de dag la/ /yig char gsungs bzhin ngag pa spyor dbos te/ /dran pa sems kyi sa mang yin phyir ro/ /dge ba'i sa phyir btang stoms zhin sbyangs bkol/ /sa bzhi'i bsam gtan tshor ba rtsa bar gsal/ /daspre ston gnyis par mig shes 'dod gsungs mchims/ /zhes gsungs te/ nyon mongs can la yan lag de dag med gsung ba ni/ rtsa bar/ nyon mongs can la —4dga' bde dang / /rab dang shes bzhin dran pa dang / /btang snyoms dran pa dag pa med/ /kha cig shin tu sbyangs btang snyoms/ /nyon mongs can la de dag med gsungs pas/mtha' dpyod las/ nyon mongs can dang dag pa med/ /ces kun la sbyar/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ yan lag kun la dag pa sbyor dgos te/ nyon mongs kyis ma dag na/ nyon mongs pas rnyogs par byas pa sogs kyi skyon yod pa'i phyir/ dag pa ma sbyar na/ dran pa sems kyi sa mang yin pa'i phyir nyon mongs can yang yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ nyon mongs can gyi bsam gtan dang bo gnyis na shin tu sbyangs pa med la/ nyon mongs can gyi 685

gong ma gnyis na btang snyoms med de/ de gnyis dge ba'i sa mang bo ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes logs su bkol te/ bsam gtan gyi sa bzhi'i tshor ba rtsa bar gsal te/ rtsa bar/ skye ba'i bsam gtan dag na ni/ /yid bde bde dang btang snyoms dang / /sogs rtsa 'grel kun tu gsal lo/ /mchims mdzod las/ gnyis pa la sogs par skyes pa rnams la mig shes la sogs pa de dag med pa'ang ma yin la rang gi sa ba'ang ma yin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/ mdo sde bas bsam gtan gnyis par mig shes sogs yod par 'dod gsungs so/ /'og spangs gong nas lhung bas dag pa 'thob/ /zag med dngos gzhi gsar thob chags bral dang / /ldan pa dbang 'phos sogs ni smyor bas 'thob/ /dang bo'i nyon mongs can ne dang bo la/ /chags bral nyams dang gong der skyes pas 'thob/ /ces gsungs te/ gnyis pa de dag gi khyad chos 'thob tshul ni /dag pa ba ni 'og ma spangs pa ste 'og ma la 'dod chags dang bral bas 'thob pa dang / gong sa nas lhung ba ste 'og mar skyes pa 'a sa kyang 'thob pa gang zhig zag med ni dngos gzhi gsar thob tshe chags bral gyis 'thob la/ de dang ldan pa ni dbang po 'phos pa sogs kyis sbyor bas 'thob/ bsam gtan dang bo'i snyoms 686

'jug nyon mongs can rna/ bsam gtan dang bo la chags bral las nyams pa dang / gong ma nas bsam gtan dang bo der skyes pas 'thob bo/ /dang bo'i 'og dang ci yang med pa'i gong / /spag med med la gzhan pa phal cher la/ /rang nas gong du bgrang ba gsum 'og bgrang / /gsum gyi dag ba zag med gnyis gnyis rna/ /rang gi sa ba'i zag med mjug tu skye/ /dag par de steng rang sa'i nyon mongs bsnan/ /gong 'og nyon mongs mi snon mtshan ne/ /mchims 'ika snyoms par 'jug dus dbang byas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsam gtan dang bo'i 'og dang / ci yang med pa'i gong du zag med snyoms 'jug med la/de min sa gzhan phal cher la/ rang sa nas gong du bgrang ba'i gsum dang / rang sa nas 'og tu bgrang ba'i gsum gyi dag pa dang zag med gnyis gnyis ni/ rang gi sa ba'i zag med kyi mjug tu skye ba'i phyir/ dper na zag med kyi bsam gtan dang bo'i 'og tu zag med med la/ rang sa dang gong sa'i gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i dag pa re dang zag med re ste/ de'i mjug thogs su drug skye/ ci yang med kyi skye mched kyi gong du zag med med la rang sa'i zag med kyi mjug thogs su rang sa dang 'og sa'i rnam shes mtha' yas dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi dag pa dang 687

zag med gnyis gnyis dang srid rtse'i dag pa gcig dang bdun skye/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i zag med mjug thogs su rang sa dang gong sa'i gsum pa dang bzhi ba dang 'og sa bsam gtan dang bo'i dag pa dang zag med gnyis gnyis te brgyad skye/ rnam shes mtha' yas kyi zag med mjug thogs su rang sa dang gong sa'i ci yang med dang 'og sa'i nam mkha' mtha' yas dang bsam gtan bzhi ba'i dag pa dang zag med gnyis gnyis te brgyad dang srid rtse'i dag pa gcig dang dgu skye/ nam mkha' mtha' yas la rang nas gong du gsum bgrang rgyu yod pa'i rang sa dang rnam shes mtha' yas ci yang med de gsum/ 'og tu rang sa dang gsum bgrang rgyu yod pas rang dang bsam gtan bzhi ba/ gsum pa rnams te lnga yod pas re re la dag pa dang zag med gnyis gnyis yod pas rang sa'i zag med kyi mjug thogs su bcu 'byung ba yod/ bsam gtan gsum par rang sa nas gong du gsum bgrang rgyu yod de rang sa dang bsam gtan bzhi ba dang nam mkha' mtha' yas dang 'og tu rang sa dang bsam gtan gnyis pa dang bsam gtan dang bo ste rang sa nas bgrangs pa'i gsum yod la/des na gong 'og gnyis la gnyis gnyis te bzhi dang rang dang lnga la dag pa dang zag med gnyis re yod pas rang sa'i zag med kyi 688

mjug thogs su bcu skye ba'i phyir/ gong 'og gi bzhi ba phan chad ni skye mi srid de shin tu ring ba'i phyir/ theg dman nyan thos kyi dbang du byas gsungs/ 'on kyang khyad par 'di yod de/ dag pa ba las sngar bshad pa de dag gi steng du snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can bsnan te/ nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe rang rang gi sa ba'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can 'byung la/ zag med kyi mjug thogs su 'byung ba med do/ /dag pa ba'i mjug tu rang sa'i nyon mongs can 'byung ba ste snon la/ sa gzhan gong 'og gi nyon mongs can mi snon pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mchims mdzod las/ de yang snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus kyi dbang du byas nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'chi 'pho'i dus kyi de ni zur gsungs snyir/ /nyams gnas khyad par nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi/ /rim bzhin rang sa'i nyon mongs rang sa'i dag /gong dag zag med skye dang rjes mthun phyir/ /nyams las nyams gnas gnas las nyams gnas khrad/ /khrad las nyams pa ma gtogs mtha' las mtha'/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'chi 'pho'i dus kyi dga' ba dang snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyi 'chi sems byas pa gnyis kyi mjug thogs su skye tshul rtsa bar zur du gsungs te/'chi 'pho dag las nyon mongs kun/ /zhes dang / nyon 689

mongs can la gong ma min/ /zhes so/ /'chi 'pho'i skyesaṣethob dag pa ba'i mjug tu rang sa dang gong 'og gi nyon mongs can kun skye ba dang / 'og ma'i nyon mongs dang bcas bzhin dudzhagong mar mi skye bar gsungs/ dag pa ba'i dbye ba ni/ nyams pa cha mthun dang / gnas pa cha mthun dang / khyad par cha mthun dang / nges 'byed cha mthun dang bzhi/ de bzhi'i ngo bo yod de/ rim bzhin rang gi mjug thogs sam de ma thag tu rang sa'i nyon mongs skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa de dang bo dang / rang gi mjug de ma thag tu rang sa'i dag pa skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa de gnyis pa dang / rang gi mjug de ma thag tu gong sa'i dag pa skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa de gsum pa dang / rang gi mjug de ma thag tu zag med skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i snyoms 'jug dge ba de snyoms 'jug dag pa nges 'byed cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ —nyams pa cha mthun sogs bzhi bo cha mthun bzhi'i gang gis mjug thogs su 'byung zhe na/ nyams pa cha mthun gyi mjug thogs su nyams pa cha mthun dang gnas pa cha mthun gnyis 'byung ste/nyams las nyams gnas/ zhes so/ /gnas pa cha mthun gyi mjug thogs su nyams pa cha mthun dang gnas pa cha mthun dang —khyad par cha mthun gsum 'byung ste/ gnas las nyams gnas 690

khyad/ ces so/ /khyad par cha mthun gyi mjug thogs su nyams pa cha mthun ma gtogs gsum 'byung ste/ khyad las nyams pa ma gtogs zhes so/ /cha mthun bzhi'i mtha' nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mjug thogs su cha mthun bzhi'i mtha' ma nges 'byed cha mthun gcig pu 'byung ste/ mtha' las mtha'/ zhes so/ /brgyad ribadun zag bcas zag med rnam gnyis la/ /'brel te rim bzhin 'gro 'ong ring spyor te/ /zag bcas dang bos zag bcas gsum pa sogs/ /bar nas gcig brgal 'gro 'ong nye spyor ro/ /zag bcas dang bos zag med gsum pa ru/ /'pho lugs 'di yis thod rgal dngos gzhi yin/ /stoms 'jug so so yul sogs rtsa bar gsal/ /zhes gsungs te/ zhar byung thod rgal la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rten bzhi/ dang bo sbyor ba la/ ring skyor dang / nye sbyor gnyis yod/ dang bo ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyi sa brgyad la lugs mthun du zag bcas brgyad la yar song zhing / lugs mi mthun du zag bcas brgyad la mar 'ong ba zag bcas ring sbyor dang / de bzhin du zag med srid rtse ma gtogs pa'i sa bdun la lugs mthun du yar song ba dang lugs mi mthun du mar 'ong ba zag med ring sbyor yin te/ brgyad bdun zag bcas zag med rnam gnyis la/ /'brel te rim bzhin rī ju 691

'gro 'ong ring sbyor te/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /nye sbyor ni/ ring sbyor la byang ba na/ bsam gtan dang bo'i zag bcas la snyoms par zhugs nas bsam gtan gnyis pa gcig pu brgal te/ zag bcas kyi bsam gtan gsum pa la 'jug de nas bsam gtan bzhi ba gcig pu brgal te nam mkha' mtha' yas la 'jug de nas rnam shes mtha' yas gcig pu brgal nas/zag bcas kyi ci yang med la 'jug cing / de bzhin du lugs mi mthun par 'jug pa zag bcas nye sbyor dang / zag med kyi bsam gtan dang bo nas gcig brgal te/ zag med bsam gtan gsum par 'jug de nas gcig brgal te zag med nam mkha' mtha' yas ting nge 'dzin dang / de nas gcig brgal te zag med ci yang med kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug cing / lugs mi mthun par yang de ltar 'jug pa zag med nye sbyor yin te/ zag bcas dang bos zag bcas gsum pa sogs/ /bar nas gcig brgal 'gro 'ong nye sbyor ro/ /zhes pa'i don de'o/ /dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug ni/ nye ring gi sbyor ba gnyis kyi rjes su/ zag bcas bsam gtan dang bo nas zag bcas dang ris mi mthun pa'i zag med bsam gtan gsum pa la 'jug de nas zag med dang ris mi mthun pa'i zag bcas nam mkha' mtha' yas la 'jug de nas 692

zag bcas dang ris mi mthun pa'i zag med ci yang med kyi skye mched la snyoms par 'jug cing / de bzhin du lugs mi mthun par yang zag bcas zag med ris mi mthun par spel nas 'ong ba de'i tshe thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin 'grub pa yin gsungs/ zag bcas dang bos zag med gsum pa ru/ /'pho lugs 'di yis thod rgal dngos gzhi yin/ /zhes pa'i don de'o/ /sgra bshad ni/ bar du re re brgal nas snyems par 'jug pa'i phyir/ de dang bo mngon du byed pa'i rten ni/ gling gsum gang rung gi rten dang dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can kho nas mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ snyoms 'jug so so'i yul sogs rtsa bar gsal te/sred bcas rang gi srid la dmigs/ /bsam gtan dge yul yod dgu yin/ /gzugs med dngos gzhi dge rnams kyi/ /spyod yul zag bcas 'og ma min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /nyer bajogs 'bad pas drangs par bya phyir dang / /'og las ma rgyal phyir na bde med lo/ /grub mtha' gong mas drug spangs bde ldan 'dod/ /dang bor dag par ma zad dmigs bsal gsuphas/ /kha cig mi lcogs med la ro rtsang bsnan/ /de yi rgyu mtshan dngos gzhir 'gran phyir lo/ /khyad par can dang nyer bsdogs rnas grangs kyis/ /gsungs phyir gabyug gam zhe na de'i khyad par/ /693

phyi ma la ni snas gsum la sogs gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/nyer bsdogs la bde ba med de/ — 'bad rtsol gyis drangs par bya ba yin pa'i phyir dang / sa 'og ma las ma rgyal ba'i phyir/sa 'og ma'i yid 'byung can yin pas tshor ba btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zer lo/ grub mtha' gong mas rtog dpyod sogs drug spangs pas bde ba dang ldan par 'dod/ bsam gtan dang bor nyer bsdogs dag pa ba yin par ma zad 'phags pa ste zag med 'das lam yang yod pa'i phyir zhes dmigs bsal dang bcas pa gsungs/ kha cig slob dpon 'dun bzang na re/mi lcogs med na ro myang bsnan te de'i rgyu mtshan/ dngos gzhi la 'gran bzod pas na dag pa ro myang zag med gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir zer/ 'o na nyer bsdogs zhes kyang 'byung / bsam gtan khyad par can zhes kyang 'byung bas/ des na bsam gtan khyad par can dang nyer bsdogs gnyis rnam grangs kyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ gcig gam zhe na/ tha dad de/ de'i khyad par ni/phyi ma bsam gtan khyad par can ni dag pa dang zag med dang ro myang ste rdzas gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ / yul lnga po mo skye rga mi rtag ste/ /mtshan ma bcu bral(lo)skye 'phags dbye ba yis/ /ting 'dzin gsum la dag pa zag med 694
