gnyis/ /de las dri med rnams ni rnam thar sgo/ /yig char rnam bar sgo la dri med dag /gnyis gye dri med phyi ma thar bar dzir/ /sa ni zag med lam bden bzhin du dgu /zhes gsungs te/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtshan med rnam thar gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges 'byung ste bzhi bo de dag rtos/sapa'i shes rab dang mtshungs ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin yin la/ de la mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/myang 'das la gzugs sogs yul lnga pho mo skye rga mi rtag ste/ mtshan ma de bcu dang bral ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ de la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ so skye la yod pa dang 'phags pa la yod pa'i dbye ba yis/ ting nge 'dzin de gsum la dag pa ba dang zag med gnyis phye ste/ dag pa ba ni 'jig rten pa sbyor lam gyis bsdus pas sa bcu gcis/ na yod/ de las dri med rnams ni rnam par thar ba'i sgo yin no/ /yig cha mtha' dpyod du rnam thar gyi sgo la dri med dang dag pa ba gnyis phye ba'i phyi ma dri med ni thar ba ste 'phags lam la sbyar nas/ sa ni zag med lam bden bzhin du sa dgu na yod par gsungs te/ mtha' dpyod las/ dri ma med pa zag med ni mthong lam sogs kyis bsdus pa srid rtse ma gtogs pa'i 'das 695

lam gang na yod pa'i sa dgu na yod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so/ /stong nyid stong ba nyid kyis mi blob pa'i/ /stong nyid ting 'a 'dzin la stong bar blta/ /lhag med smyor phyir blob la skabs bab min/ /dmigs pa bdag gi ba phyir bdag med min/ /de bzhin smon med smon med rang bzhin gyis/ /mi blob smon med mi rtag kho nar blta/ /mchims sgyuka 'di dag rgyu mtshan gzhan lang bshad/ /mtshan med mtshan med dmigs pa mtshan med las/ /langs tshe mtshan ma med pa'i rgyun 'byung ba/ /zag bcas zag med shes gzhan gyis bkag chas/ /ma brtags pa ste brtags min 'gog pa'o/ /dgag bya zag med phyir na brtags 'gog min/ /gsum po zag bcas bcu gcig sas bsrus phyir/ /grid rtse bden ba'i rnam can 'des kyang 'grub/ /ces gsungs te/ ting nge 'dzin gzhan gsum yang yod de/ stong nyid stong nyid ces pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smon pa med pa smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum yod pas dang bo ni/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi stong ba nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la stong ba'i rnam par blta ba yin la/ slob pa ni bya ba lhag ma dang bcas pas 'phags lam la mi sdang la/ 'anir bya ba lhag ma med pa dgos pa'i phyir slob pa dag ni 'di'i ting 696

'dzin sgom pa skabs su bab pa min no/ /'di'i dmigs pa ni stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ltar stong bdag med gnyis kar mi dmigs par stong nyid kyi rnam pa stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la dmigs pas/ dmigs pa bdag gi ba yin phyir bdag med ma yin no/ /de bzhin du smon med smon med de ni smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin gyi mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi smon med de mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin kho nar blta bar byed la/ mchims mdzod las 'di dag gi rgyu mtshan gzhan yang bshad de/ de las/ de ltar gsum po de dag las dang bo gnyis ni rim pa ltar stong ba dang smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la dmigs nas de gnyis la bdag 'dzin dang sred pa'am dga' ba dgag pa'i phyir mi slob pa'i stong ba nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di ni bdag gi ma yin rno/ zhes stong ba'i rnam pa dang / mi slob pa'i smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ni mi rtag pa'o zhes mi rtag pa'i rnam pa yid la byed pa yin no/ /'o na stong nyid stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin de stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ltar stong bdag med gnyis kar mi dmigs par stong nyid kyi rnam pa kho nar dmigs she na/ stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin stong bdag med kyi rnam pa gnyis pa can yin yang / stong nyid stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di stong nyid kyi rnam par zhugs 697 mo

pa'i stong nyid kyi rjes kho na la bskyed pa'i phyir dang / lam du zhugs pa grogs dang bral ba na mgron po ngo mi shes pa mthong bas kyang dga' la/ gcig pu ni grogs kyis stong bas mi dga' ba ltar/ srid pa la bdag med mthong yang stong bar ma mthong na dga' bar 'gyur gyi/ stong bar mthong na mi dga' zhing skyo bar 'gyur bas des na skyo ba dang mthun pa'i stong ba'i rnam pa kho nar dmigs kyi bdag med pa'i rnam par ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin gnyis po de dag bden pa dang bo'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa dang kun 'byung dang 'gog lam gyi nam pa bcu gnyis su'ang dmigs pa ma yin te/ go rim bzhin du dmigs yul ting nge 'dzin de dag zag med yin pas zag bcas 'phags pa dang mi—mthun pa'i sdug bsngal dang / sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin pa'i phyir dang / 'gog bden ma yin pa'i phyir dang / lam bden yin pas sun dbyung bya yin la sun dbyung bya de nyid sun 'byin byed du mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa ni/ mi slob pa'i mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las langs pa'i tshe mtshan ma med pa'i rgyun 'byung ba—yin la/ mtshan ma med pa las langs pa'i rjes la zag bcas zag 698

med kyi shes pa gzhan skyes na mtshan med 'byung ba'i rkyen ma tshang bas 'gag par 'gyur la/ de lta bu'i shes pa gzhan gyis bkag pa'i chas/ ma brtags pa ste brtags min gyi 'gog pa de la—dmigs nas zhi ba'i rnam par 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir/ dgag bya ni mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi mtshan med yin la de rgyun mthud nas 'byung ba bkag pa yin la/ de ni lam zag med yin pa'i phyir na zag bcas gnyen pos bral ba'i so sor brtags 'gog min no/ /gsum po 'di ni zag bcas yin te/ ting nge 'dzin snga ma gsumar+shal rgyab kyis phyogs pas 'phags pa'i lam la sdang bas dor bya yin pa'i phyir/ rten mi'i nang dang / gang zag mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi mngon du byed/ sa bcu gcig gis bsdus te/ nyer bsdogs thardzim bdun ma gtogs pas bsdus pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ nyer bsdogs bdun ni ma gtogs so/ /zhes 'byung bas/ srid rtser bden4pa'i rnam pa can yod pa 'dis kyang 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gong mas rnam snang mngon byang las/ /sems ni rang dngos med sbyir dang / /'bras bu rnams spang phyir dang / /zhes gsung rgyu 'bras ngo bor sbyar/ /brtsa bar mtshan nyid gsum la jir/ /de lang thos bsam sgom la jir/ /zhes gsungs te/sems sogs kyi rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum la sbyar nas/ rnam thar sgo 699

gsum gsungs te/ ngo bo bden par med pa stong nyid rnam thar dang / rgyu bden par med pa mtshan med/ 'bras rū bden par med pa smon med du gsungs pa dang / sems don dam par rgyu las ma skyes pa mtshan med dang / don dam par 'bras bu mi skyed pa smon med dang / ngo bo bden par ma grub pa stong nyid rnam thar te/ bden par zhen pa'i tshe rgyu las skyes pa'i cha nas bden par lta ba dang / 'bras bu skyed pa'i cha nas bden par lta ba sogs 'byung bas de 'gog ched du rnam thar sgo gsum gyi dbye ba mdzad pa'i phyir/ bsdu ba las mtshan nyid gsum la sbyar te/bsdu ba las/ kun btags pa'i ngo bo nyid la brten nas ni rnam par thar ba'i sgo stong ba nyid rnam par bzhag go /gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid la brten nas ni rnam par thar ba'i sgo smon pa med pa rnam par bzhag go /yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid la brten nas ni rnam par thar ba'i sgo mtshan ma med pa rnam par bzhag go /zhes gsungs/ de yang thos bsam sgom gsum la sbyar te/ bsdu ba las/ gang du stong ba nyid dang / smon pa med pa dang / mtshan ma med pa bye brag med par gsungs pa der ni de dag thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa las byung ba stid yin par blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhib par 700

rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rnam bzhag las shes par bya'o/ /mthong chos bsam gta/na bzhi bo kun/ /shes pa mthong 'gyur mig gi mngon shes so/ /spyor byung blo dbye'am blo rgyas 'gyur byed do/ /mdo las 'azhir bstan rdor ting bzhi ba rtse/ /ging drung bsam gtan skyed cing bdud btul rjes/ /(lha'i spyan gyis) 'gror gzigs gung la spyor byung du ma dang / /tho rangs rdor ting bskyed rim bzhin byas lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ yang mdo las/ mthong ba'i chos la bde 'gyur gyi dang / shes pa mthong 'gyur gyi dang /rab tu blo dbye bar 'gyur ba'i dang / zag pa zad 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin dang bzhi gsungs/ dang bo mthong ba'i chos la bde bar 'gyur ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi bo kun mthong chos la bde bar 'gyur ba yin mod/ rtsa bar dge ba'i bsam gtan dang bo ni/ /bde 'gyur ting 'dzin sgom pa yin/ /zhes bsam gtan dang bo gcig pu gsungs pa ni/ 'dod pa las 'das pa'i dang bo yin pas de ltar gsungs kyi/ bsam gtan gzhan rnams kyang mthong chos bder gnas yin no/ /shes pa mthong 'gyur ni lha'i mig gi mngon shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes rab bo/ /sbyor byung gi zag bcas zag med kun ni rab tu blo dbye bar 'gyur ba'am blo shes rab tu rgyas par 'gyur byed do/ /zag pa kun zad 'gyur 701

gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ mdo las 'dir bstan rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan bzhi ba la brten pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rang nyid kyi thugs rgyud la ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul dang mthun par gsungs pa yin te/ las kyi mtha' la gzigs pa'i don du zhing grong du byon nas/ shing 'dzam bu'i drung du bsam gtan dang bo bskyed/ de nas byang chub shing drung du thun dang bo la lha'i bu'i bdud btul ba'i rjes la/ lha'i spyan gyis 'gro ba rnams la gzigs shing 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba nyam nga bar gzigs nas/de dag skyob pa'i phyir gung thun la sbyor byung du ma ste/ bsam gtan dang rnam par thar ba dang snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bskyed cing / de'i rjes su tho rangs kyi dus su bsam gtan bzhi ba la brten te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed nas des kun sbyor thams cad spangs pa rnams ni rim— pa ba'i/na/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la sogs pa byas zhes bye brag tu smra ba zer lo/ /'di bzhi ngo bo shes rab yin mod ting nge 'dzin zhes brjod pa ni rgyu ting nge 'dzin gyi ming 'bras bu shes rab la btags pas/ rgyu ming 'bras la btags pa yin gsungs so/ /tshad med sgra don sogs sla bye smras ni/ /mi rtsag btang 702

snyoms rim bzhin kha dog dang / /'khrig chags gnyen por sbyar ro spob dpon ni/ /'khrig dang nye du'i 'dod chags gnyen por gsungs/ /kha cig lnga gsungs bsam gtan dngos gzhi lnga/ /'dod dang nyer bsdogs bsnan pas bcur yang grags/ /gsum ni phan tshun nges ldan dga' ma rjes/ /'dod dang dang bo'i kha dog chags pa'i gnyen/ /dang bo gnyis pa'o gnyis par kha dog la/ /chags med mig shes med don de yin byar/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshad med bzhi yod de/ dmigs yul sems can tshad med pa dmigs pa dang / bsod nams tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i byams pa tshad med dang / snying rje tshad med dang /dga' ba tshad med dang / btang snyoms tshad med dang bzhi yod/bzhir grangs nges te/ gnod sems dang / rnam 'tshe dang / gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi dga' ba dang / gnod sems dang chags pa mang ba'i gnyen por bzhir nges so/ /de ltar tshad med kyi sgra don sogs sla la/ mi sdug pa dang btang snyoms kyis chags pa'i gnyen po byed tshul la/ bye smra na re/mi sdug pa kha dog la chags pa'i gnyen po dang / btang snyoms 'khrig pa la chags pa'i gnyen por sbyar ro/ /slob dpon na re/ mi sdug pa 'khrig pa dang / btang snyoms nye du la chags 703

pa'i gnyenapo yin gsungs/ kha cig de dag bsam gtan dngos gzhi khyad par can dang dngos gzhi lnga na yod par 'dod/ gzhan dag sbyor dngos thams cad bsdus nas 'dod pa dang bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs bzhi dang dngos gzhi lnga ste sa bcu na yang yod par grags pa'i phyir/ ldan tshul ni/ byams snying rje btang snyoms gsum ni/ phan tshun nges ldan yin te/ de gsum gang rung re re dang ldan na gsum ga dang ldan dgos la/ dga' ba ni ma nges te/ bsam gtan gsum pa dang bzhi ba la mi ldan pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i kha dog dang / bsam gtan dang bo'i kha dog la chags pa'i gnyen por/ tshad med dang bo byams pa dang gnyis pa snying rje tshad med gnyis yin la/ bsam gtan gnyis par kha dog la chags pa med par gsungs pas bsam gtan gnyis par mig shes med pa'i don de yin pa'i phyir/ byams pa yid la byed tshul ni/ bdag nyid kyi bde ba nyams myong la yod pa'am/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems dang dgra bcom ngaklo'i bde ba thob pa de lta bu kye ma sems can thams cad de ltar bde bar gyur cig ces sems can thams cad la bde bar mos par byed pa de yin pa'i phyir/ gal te nyon mongs shas che bas skye dka' na/ thog mar mdza' bo'i phyogs la dung sems che ba ma 704

dang / 'bring pha dang / dung sems chung ngu gzhan gsum du phye nas snga ma la skyes pa dang / gnyis pa la sgom pa sogs kyis mdza' bo che 'bring chung gsum la bskyed/ de dag la byams pa skyes pa na/ de nas dgra gnyen gang yang min pa'i bar ma la byams pa bsgom/ de'i 'og tu dgra bo'i phyogs la gnod pa chung 'bring chen po gsum la rim pas sgom pa de yin pa'i phyir/ snying rje la yang de dang 'dra bar sgom par byed gsungs/ btang snyoms la tha mal ba sngon la sgom pa sogs yin gsungs so/ /'gog pa'i 'jug sems ldang sems rtsa bar gsal/ /bar chad med lam rnam bar ma yin te/ /'og mar dmigs phyir gsungs spyang rang gong 'og /rjes shes phyogs kyi lam kun dmigs gsung dpyad/ /bden pa gzhan gsum gong dang rang kho na/ /gzugs med rnam thar mtshan med mtshan meda'ang yod/ /ces gsungs te/rnam thar brgyad yod de/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi dang / 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang brgyad yod/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar gyi 'jug sems dang ldang sems rtsa bar gsal te/ rtsa bar/ phra ba phra ba'i mjug thogs su/ /zhes 'jug sems dang / rang gi dag dang 'og ma yi/ / 705

'phags pa'i sems kyis de las ldang / /zhes ldang sems gsung la/sems phra ba srid rtse'i sems las kyang phra bar 'ju ga pa dang / srid rtse'i sa ba'i dag pa dang / de'i 'og gi ci yang med kyi sa ba'i 'phags pa zag med kyis 'gog snyoms las ldang bar byed pa'i phyir/ mtha' dpyod las/ gzugs med rnam thar yod de/gzugs med kyi mnyam bzhag dge ba ste/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms tsho'ajug dag pa ba dang zag med rnams dang nyer bsdogs rnam grol lam mnyam par bzhag pa rmams gzugs med kyi rnam thar yin gyi// mnyam par ma bzhag pa dang / 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi bar chad med lam rnams gzugs med kyi rnam thar ma yin te/ rnam thar gyi don rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i don yin shāpa'i phyir te/ zhes bar chad med lam rnam thar ma yin te/ sa 'og mar dmigs pa'i phyir gsungs kyang / mchims mdzod las/ gang dag gzugs can min pa'i rnam thar bzhi bo de dag gi spyod yul te/ dmigs pa ni sa gong ma dang rang gi sa ba'i sdug bsngal dang sogs pas bsdus pa kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang / rjes su shes pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam gyi bden pa sa gong ma dang 'og ma dang rang gi sa ba'i thams cad dang / zhes rjes res phyogs kyi lam gyi rang dang gong 'og gi sa kun la dmigs 706

lapar gsung ba dpyad par bya ste/ bden pa gzhan sdug bden sdukun 'byung bden pa 'gog bden gsum la dmigs pa dag gis gong dang rang sa kho na la dmigs pa'i phyir gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir/ rtsa bar/ gang dag gzugs can min de dag / spyod yul gong dang rang gi sa'i/ /sdug bsngal sogs dang rjes shes phyogs/ /zhes gong sa dang rang gi sa gsung ba las/ 'og gi sa zhes med la/ chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las kyang / gang dag gzugs can min pa'i rnam thar ni chos can/spyod yul yod de/ gong sa dang rang gi sa ba'i sdug bsngal dang /sogs pas kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang rjes shes phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam thams cad la dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa rtsa ba ltar las/ 'og gi sa zhes ma gsungs la/ mtha' dbyod —las/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i rnam thar bzhi'i de dag gi spyod ngayul gong dang rang gi sa'i sdug bsngal dang sogs pa'i kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang rjes shes phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam thams cad yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gong ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na sachims ṭīka gi 'bru snon de ni rang lugs min nam snyam mo/ /shazugs med rnam thar la mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa'i n+t+rang nge 'dzin yang yod de mi slogepa'i mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 707

'dzin yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zil gnon phar pyin 'dra 'o rnam bar 'azas/ /rnam thar zil gnon zad par gsum po las/ /'gog ba ma gtogs nyer lnga sngar 'dris kyis/ /chags bral tsam dang ma 'dris spyor bas thob/ /gzugs med rnam thar bzhi dang zad par gnyis/ / khams gsum rten can(no)lhag ma mis skyed pa'/ /dzir na zad par brgyad yul 'dod par gtogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ zil gnon phar phyin dang 'dra ste/ phar phyin mtha' dasnyod sogs su gsungs pa'i zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad yod/dbyibs zil gnon bzhi dang / kha dog zil gnon bzhi yod/zil gnon dang bo gnyis kyi ngo bo ni rnam thar dang bo gnyis bzhin yin la/ rnam thar de'i 'bras bu'ang yin pa'i phyir/de'i 'og ma gnyis ni/ ngo bo rnam thar gnyis pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ lhag ma rnams ni/ sdug pa'i rnam thar bzhin yin no/ /rnam thar de gsum dang zil gnon rnams khyad par bzhir 'dra yang khyad par yod de/ rnam thar ni dmigs pa de zil gyis mi non kyang de la rgyab kyis phyogs pa tsam yin la/ zil gnon ni rgyab kyis phyogs par ma zad ji ltar 'dod par dbang ngabasgyur ba dang de la nyon mongs mi skye ba gnyis tshang ba'i phyir/ 708

zad par bcu yod de/ zad par sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / sngon po dang / ser bo dang / dmar bo dang / dkar bo dang / nam mkha' dang / mo zad par rnam par shes pa'i skye mched kyi ting nge 'dzin dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/de'i don yod de/ zad par zhes pa rnam pa dang steng dang 'og dang thad kar zhes phyogs dang / gang du yid zad par 'jug pa'i yuldodang gnyis su med pa ni bar mtshams med par khyab pa dang tshad med pa ni mtha' yas par mos te/ steng 'og thad ka ra bar mtshams med par sa mtha' yas so snyam du mos par byed pa de/ zad par sa'i skye mched yin pa de bzhin du/ rnam shes kyi skye mched par 'dra ba'i phyir/ sdom 'dir bsdus pa/ rnam thar brgyad dang / zil gnon brgya/da dang zad par bcu ste gsum po bsdoms pa las 'gog pa ma gtogs lhag ma nyer lnga ni/ sngar 'dris kyis chags bral tsam gyis 'thob la/ sngar ma 'dris pa rnams kyis sbyor bas 'thob bo/ /rten gyi khyad par ni/ gzugs med rnam thar bzhi dang / zad par gnyis te drug ni/ khams gsum ga'i rten can no/ /lhag ma bcu dgu lung la brten nas tshoskye dgos pas/ mis bskyed pa'i phyir na zad par brgyad yul 'dod par gtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /lung la ched du brten phyir lha 709

la med/ /'o na gong sar bsam gtan gzugs med kyang / /med 'gyur nges par lung la brten phyir na/ /ma grub gong mar gzugs med skal mnyam gyi/ /tsu dang lan grangs gzhan khyung las kyis skye/ /gzugs su bsam gtan skye ba de gnyis dang / khos nyid kyis skye chos nyid bag chags so/ /bye smra bag chags med phyir mkha mnyam lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ kho na re/ lung la brten nas skye dgos phyir lha la med na/ 'o na khams gong ma'i sar bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi skye ste/ der lung med la lung la nges par brten dgos pa'i phyir zer na/ rtags ma grub ste/ gong mar gzugs gzugs med dag tu sdon goms pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang / gzugs med du skye 'gyur gyi lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las kyi stobs kyis skye ba'i phyir/ gzugs khams su bsam gtan rnams sdon goms pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las kyis skye ba de gnyis dang / chos nyid kyis kyang skye la/ chos nyid kyis skye zhes pa'i chos nyid de bag chags la go dgos so/ /bye smras bag chags med par 'dod pa'i phyir skal mnyam gyi rgyu la 'dod zer lo/ /'bras bu skub pa lung gi le 'u la/ /dgra brtsom sbyir mi 'ong dang rgyun zhugs gsum/ /baspab gsum sde smyod gsum mo 710

rtags tsam bcas/ /ston pa 'das lo'i dbyar de ma skyes dgras/ /bkur nas 'od srungs la sogs lnga brgyas bskus/ /zhes gsungs te/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad la le'u bcu yod de/ 'bras bu'i le'u gsum/ sgrub pa'i le'u gsum/ lung gi le'u gsum/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u bcas yod pas/ dang bo 'bras bu'i le'u gsum ni/ dgra bcom pa'i le'u/ phyir mi 'ong gi le'u/ rgyun zhugs kyi le'u gsum mo/ /sgrub pa'i le'u gsum yod de/ shes rab kyi bslab pa'i le'u/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bsgab pa'i le'u/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i le'u ste gsum mo/ /lung gi le'u gsum yod de/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi le'u/mdo sde'i sde snod kyi le'u/ 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi le'u gsum mo/ /rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ ston pa 'das tshul bstan rjes su bka' bsdu rim pa gsum byung ba'i dang bo ni/ ston pa 'das pa'i dbyar de la/ rgyal bo ma skyes dgras sbyin bdag byas shing bsnyen bkur byas nas/ 'od srungs la sogs pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas sde snod gsum bsdus so/ /ston pa 'das nas lo brgya bcu 'das tshe/ /bams cad 'dod dang grags pa sgar skyog sogs/ /kun dga' po yi mkhan bu dgra brtsom pa/ /bdun brgyas rung min bcu bsal gnyis pa 'o/ /711

zhes gsungs te/snye ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu 'das pa'i tshe/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyi dge slong de kho na nyid ma mthong ba rnams kyis hu lu hu lu ka'i chog la sogs pa rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi bcu bcas nas bstan pa dkrugs pa na/ gnas brtan kun dga' bo'i mkhan bu gnas brtan thams cad 'dod dang grags pa sgur skyog sogs kun dga' bo'i mkhan bu dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi bcu bsal te yangs pa can du bka' bsdu gnyis pa mdzad pa'o/ /brtsa ba gsum pa rtog ge 'bar ba dang / /dul lha'i n+de ba ba dad klag 'khor dang / /pad 'byung dge tshul lo dri la sogs pa/ /lugs mang(ngo)de yang patra li bu trar/ /bzang bo kun gyi mi mthun phyogs bya ba/ /bdud rigs dgra bcom gzugs 'chang dzi 'phrul gyis/ /po grangs drug cur 'acug go gnas ma'i bus/ /ston 'das lo brgya so bdun tshe na basbus/ /sbyin bdag dga' bo pad ma chen po gnyis/ /yang na ston 'das lo brgya drug cu na/ /skad bzhi'i klag pa'i sde ba bco brgyad gyes/ /ston 'das sum brgya 'das tshe kri kri yi/ /zi lam mthong nas dza lan dha rar brtsas/ /de phyir bag dang ldan pas thos pa mdzod/ /shu lha/ nes gsungs te/bsdu ba gsum pa la/ rtog ge 'bar ba dang / dul ba lha'i sde 712

ba tha dad klag pa'i 'khor lo dang / pad ma 'byung gnas kyi dge tshul gyi lo dri la sogs pa lugs tha dad pa mang bo zhig snang ngo / /de yang grong khyer pa tra li pu tror bzang bo kun gyi mi mthun phyogs bya ba'i bdud sdig can gyi rigs kyis dge slong dgra bcom pa'i gzugs 'chang zhing rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan te dge 'dun rnams phye nas/ bstan pa dkrugs te lo grangs drug cur 'khrug go /de'i tshe gnas brtan gnas ma'i bu zhes bya bas ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang so bdun gyi tshe na sbyin bdag dga' bo dang pad ma chen po gnyis kyis byas te bstan pa bsdus so zer/yang na/ lugs gcig la ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang drug cu na/ grong khyer me rtog gis rgyas pa zhes bya ba na rgyal bo mya ngan med byung ba'i tshe/ dgra bcom pa rnams/ legs sbyar dang / yul mi rang bzhin pa'i dang / zur chag pa dang / sha za'i skad de skad rigs chen po bzhis gsung rab klag pa'i rtsa ba'i sde bzhi dang / de dag nang gses kyi dbye ba so sor gyes pa sde ba bco brgyad du gyes te/ de dag sangs rgyasanyikyi bstan pa 'di kho na yin gyi/ gzhan bcu bdun po ma yin no/ /zhes rtsod pa la/nam zhig kri kri'i rmi ltas lung bstan pa'i mdo rnyed nas bltas pas/ ras yug dkar bo gcig mi bco brgyad kyis so sor 'then 713

kyang ras yug de mi 'dral ba zhig rmis pa de/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs la zhus pas/ rgyal bo chen po/ rmi lam de khyod la dge bar yang mi 'gyur mi dge bar mi 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa gyes pa bco brgyad du gyur kyang / rnam par grol ba'i ras yug nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i snga ltas yin gsungs pa mthong nas/ ston pa 'das nas lo grangs sum brgya 'das pa na yul dza lan snya rar bco brgyad po thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bsdus pa la bsdu ba gsum pa zhes bya ste/ sbyin bdag rgyal bo a sho ka ste mya ngan med kyis byas so/ /bstan pa la yang 'phel 'grib yod pa de'i phyir sgo gsum bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas lung sde snod gsum la thos pa mdzod ces dang shugs la bsam sgom yang mdzod cig ces rang cag rjes 'jug rnams la bskul ma mdzad pa'o/ /shu r+bha ni/ dge'o dge legs dang /bkra shis pa la'ang 'jug go / / / 714

naspyog byud /smras pa/ rab dkon nyi ma 'bar ba'i rtse dga' yis/ / cirab mchog blo gros pad mo rgyas mdzad pa/ /rab mang 'gro la brtse ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /rab dkar nges legs 'grub mdzad gtsug tu bsten/ /sde snod rin chen do shal rab 'phyang ba'i/ /bshes gnyen rin chen lhun po rim byon la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i thal mo nyer zum ste/ /byang chub bar du sgo gsum phyag bgyid do/ /rnam mang mkhas pa'i legs gsung bka' drin la/ /bsam tshe dga' dad yid kyi rgya mtsho 'phel/ /tshe rabs pad mo'i 'phreng bar de dag bzhin/ /sde snod bslab pa gsum la slob par smon/ /skyes sbyangs rnam dpyod nor gyis dbul na yang / /yongs 'dzin zhal lung lhug par bstsal ba yi/ /gzhal dka'i bka' drin cha tsam skong ba'i phyir/ /rab dkar las la brtson pa 'di bgyis so/ /deng dus rgyal bstan nyi ma nub rir slebs/ /rmongs chen smag gis 'jig rten khyab dus ci 715

'dir/ /smag la glog gis rtse dga' ston pa bzhin/ /'di 'dra'i las kyang e ma ngo mtshar snyam/ /bslab gsum nyams len ral gri rnon po yis/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdong rgan rtsa ba nas/ /yongs su gcod pa'i nus pa ma mchis kyang / /rnam dkar sa bon cung zhig thebs snyam dga'/ /grangs med ma rgan dag la phan sems kyis/ /cung zad bgyis pa'i rnam dkar 'di'i 'bras bu/ /byang chen klong du sim pa'i dpal yon la/ /bsam tshe dga' ba'i rgya mtsho rab tu 'phyur/ /'dis mtshon rang gzhan rnam dkar cha kun gyis/ /mtha' med 'gro ba'i duḥkha drung 'byin pa/ /thub bstan nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od chen gyis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag khyab gyur cig /ces bsdus don chos mngon rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings kyi tshig 'grel tshig don rab gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snga sor lung rigs smra ba bstan pa dang 'phrin las gnyis kyis mdzod kyi tshogs gleng skabs dngos skyes dang lha dar srid du ring ba bcas bskul zhing / rjes sor smra ba'i dbang phyug dam pa gso rig gzhan phan gling gi khri ba 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos kyang bskul ba dang / de rjes shing bza' sprul ba'i sku rin po che skal bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis shog lor sum brgya sogs dngos skyes du ma bcas 716

snga byir yang yang bskul ba dang / pu rad bka' 'gyur ba chen pos kyang lha reg dri med bcas bskul ba dang / gzhan yang bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba sogs kyi chos ldan gyi bka' ma bcag par rtsom rgyu khas blangs/ spyir bstan bcos rtsom pa la rgyu gsum dgos te/ slob dpon snga ma'i man ngag dang ldan pa/ rig gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ yi dam lhas gnang ba thob pa gsum gang rung res chog par gsungs la/ phyi ma med kyang snga ma gnyis yod khul gyis spobs pa bskyed de/ rab gnas lcags rta lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i zla mjug tu mgo bzung ste lcags lug zla ba gnyis par gnas lnga baḍa yan bris kyang / de nas tshogs 'du dang nad bcos sogs kyi rkyen las zla shas la 'bri ma thub/ hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes nas 'chad spel dang sgom sgrub ltar snang res brel tshub kyi zhor la bris pa sdom dang dkyus gcig tu yod na lta bde bar bsams nas dkyus gcig tu bkod/ spyir bdag rnam g.yeng gi khol bor gyur pas/ gang thos thams cad brjed ngas kyi rkun pos bcom pas nor 'khrul gang mchis bcos par zhu/ de ltar rtsom pa bo bdag rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen po dngos su phebs pa'i gyibla kho rdo rje 'chang rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo las mdo sngags dbang lung man ngag du ma'i bka' drin 717

gzhal dka' ba thob cing / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos su byon pa lta ba'i yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sigs las mdo sngagajig kyi chos ༄ bka' du ma dang / bka' pod chen po lnga sogs kyi bka' drin thob pa'i rtog ge rgan po bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas/ rje dngos slob snga tshal bzhi'i ya gyal mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa'i gdan sa/ dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon gyi rang gshag bslab gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod nas/ rab gnas lcags lug lo'i hor zla bcu ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i nyin mjug rdzogs par rdzibris pa dza yasgru/ / / / 718

rdzokhri 7 ci/sdi zug / / munishās rnornyu zlo n+ma nā ma ma hā la pha4sna dzor lasi pha'itsu/ lhagasmyo5snyeyo༈5snye /klosnyeluzhesnyesnyo/ko/ / / / ( / /mamabyubyur+sād+mamyu ma yano.u t+ta ra ta n+ma shā skyu wāsnyo /lhasnye snyemūsasnyesnyesnyosnyesnyo/༈gasnye dze+echakhyube+er+sākhyu7smoñtsā k+ka ha ra ta sma/ /tswa'igisprasnyesnyosnyesnyo /5so/

t+yā ṭi5ṅgā d+kur+sha t+pā snye ko 5lhad+ku rtswatsha rmādzo snye weskeske5 la5 kātso ke snyernya'8'e snyeri r+yāgerkoge r+ṣa 4ri/8d+ku 0sprasgoske weridū snyeri gyibhebe+e ma 5 ra ma ma ma0 tshohūṃhūṃhūṃhūṃhūṃhūṃ༈3hūṃ3༈hūṃlha hūṃ3hūṃhūṃ3 the/ rdzosmo dzo/be+echotsātsushurnyekarmargyuḍārnyornerodhātwosasmoḥ//༅/atsordzo ba smosangasastodab//wo thashād dam dang //ma ma ma tsa sma ma ralū1333hūṃ3hūṃlharam̐33333hūṃ hūṃhūṃhūṃsum̐ k+shi kai baimotsāsnalharjargyoshriṣ+yosaṃghat+yāri ci 'imadza snyi// rnam grol brdzugewaṃgyotsornyane tsote/r+ṣaspo r+sā /

de gsum kun 'dus yid bzhin nor mchog che/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma nyi ma 'od po che'i/ /byin rlabs 'od chen 'bar bas 'gro kun gyi/ /rmongs pa'i mun chen myur du sel bar mdzod/ /byams dang snying rje'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /byang chub sems kyi sa bon yongs brtas pas/ /byang chub spyod pa'i kho lag rab rgyas te/ /lam 'bras sku gsum brnyes pa de la 'dud/ /de yi legs gsung las nyon nad sel ba'i/ /zab rgyas bdud rtsi gling 'dir 'dren mkhas pa/ /thogs med ces grags shing rta chen po de'i/ /bka' drin bskal ba'i bar du gzhal bar /dka'/ /gzhan yang 'phags yul zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod/ /'dzin cing spel mkhas paṇa grub tshogs rnams dang / /gangs can mkhas dbang rnams kyi rnam thar la/ /yi rang dad pas dus kum/ phyag bgyid do/ /khyad par rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba bzhin/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs rmang nas gso mdzad ba'i/ /blo bzang grags pa yab sras brgyud par bcas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la nyi ma gnyis pa bzhin/ /'jig rten nor 721

mchog sde lnga'i gzhung mchog 'di/ /bsgyur dang 'chad spel 'grel bshad mkhan dag gis/ /bstan la ri mor bgyis pa'i ngo mtshar la/ /snying nas dad pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir byams chos sde lngar grags pa'i gzhung lnga'i ya gyal theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i tshigajidon rang gi blo nus dang bstun te cung zad 'grel ba la/ mtshan don dang 'gyur phyag dang / gzhung don dang / mjug gi don to/ /

zhesnyo dad bro/de buzhin gasdegs dazhi snyed0brozhi skunaska bugad bu/ dang bo mtshan don la/ rgya gar la skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa'i nang gi saṃskṛta'i skad du ma sgyu la na uca ra tachu shāskya/ bod gangs can gyi skad du/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos/zhes pa'o/ /de ma hā ni chen po/ ya na ni theg pa/ ut+ta ra ni bla ma/ tan+t+ra ni rgyud dang / shāsnra ni bstan bcos so/ /gnyis pa 'gyur phyag ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don du ma 'grub pa'i ched du lots+tsha bas rdzibakod pa'o/ / gsum pa gzhung don la/ bshad pa nye bar bkod pa dang /bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i yan lag go /dang bo bshad pa nye bar bkod pa la/ lus rnam bzhag dang / yan lag rgyas 723

par bshad pa'o/ /dang bo lus rnam bzhag la/ lus kyi rang bzhin dang / mdo las ji ltar bstan pa dang / go rim nges pa'o /dang bo la rdo rje gnas bdun gyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/sangs rgyas chos chogs khams dang byang chub dang / /yon tan sangs rgyas 'azin las tha ma rtse/ /bsnanasmyobacos kun gyi lus ni mdor bsku na/ /rdo rje yi gi gnas bdun 'di dag go /zhes gsungs te/ rdo rje'i gnas bdun ni/ sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun dang / khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo dang / spangs dang rtogs pas bsdus pa'i byang chub dang / bral 'bras dang rnam smin gyi yon tan dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las te bdun no/ /rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos 'di'i lus rgyas par bshad pa kun mdor bsdu na rdo rje gnas bdun po 'di dag yin no/ /rang bzo'i nyes pa —spang ba ni/ 'azhi dag rang mtshan nyid kyi rjes 'brel ba/ /go rim ji bzhin gzungs kyi rgyal bo'i mdor/ /gleng gzhi las ne gnas gsum rig bya ste/ /bzhi ni blo ldan rgyal chos dbye ba las/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnas bdun po 'di dag rang rang gi mtshan nyid bstan pa dang / bar ma chad par rje sa 724

su 'brel ba dang / go rim ji lta ba bzhin 'phags pa gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal bos zhus pa'i mdor gleng gzhi'i le'u las gnas dang bo gsum bstan par rig par bya la/ gnas lhag ma bzhi ni blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' dang rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dbye ba bstan pa las bstan to/ /'di dag gi 'brel gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas las chos chos las 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /chogs las snying bo be shes khams thob mthar/ /ye shes de thob byang chub mchog thob sogs/ /sems can kun don byed chos rnams dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas sangs rgyas las chos 'byung la/ chos 'khor las 'phags pa'i tshogs dge 'dun dkon mchog 'phags pa'i tshogs las de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i khams 'byung la/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi khams thob pa'i mthar te sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thob nas byang chub mchog thob pa sogs kyi skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo zhes mi bya'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan kun mnga' bas sems gān kun gyi don byed pa'i byed chos 'phrin las rnams dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /dkaun mchog gsum gyi dang bo sangs rgyas kyi dbang du byas 725

te gsungs pa/ gang zhig thog ma dbus mtha' med ces sangs rgyas nyid rang rnam sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nas ni ma rtogs rtogs phyir 'jigs med rtag pa'i lam ston pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i ral gri rdo rje mchog bsnams rtsag bsngal byu gu gartsod maphad cing / /sna tshogs lta thibs kyis bskor be tshom rtsig pa 'jig madz+rad de la 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos sku rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha ni/ skye 'jig gnas gsum gyis bsdus pa'i thog ma dang dbus dang mtha' med pa'i rang bzhin yin phyir/ sbos pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir lhun gyis grub pas/ rang byung gi ye shes rtogs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas de slob dpon med par rang byung gi rnam par sangs rgyas so/ /sangs rgyas nas ni ma rtogs pa dmus long du gyur pa gzhan dag gis rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ 'jigs pa med pa'i lam phyir mi ldog pa'i rtag pa'i lam ston par mdzad de slar mi ldog pa'i don yin gyi rtag dngos su 'dod pa bab col lo/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang thugs rje nyid kyi ral gri rnon po rdo rje mchog bsnams nas/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa'i myu gu gcod par mdzad cing / sna tshogs pa'i lta ba ngan pa dang the tshom gyi nags 'thibs pos bskor ba'i the tshom rtsig pa dang 'dra 726

rba 'jig par mdzad pa'i ye shes dang thugs rje de la 'dud pa ste phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ / gzhan yang tshigs bcad 'dis yon tan brgyad bstan pa ni/ 'dus ma byas thing skun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ tshigs bcad 'dis/yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid brjod pa yin la/brgyad gang zhe na/ 'dus ma byas pa nyid dang / lhun gyis grub pa dang / gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa ma yin pa dang / mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / brtse ba thugs rje chen po dang / nus pa dang / rang don dang gzhan don te don gnyis phun sum tshogs par ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid do zhes pa'o/ / yon tan brgyad kyi thog ma drug gi don bshad pa ni/ thog ma dbus maba' med pha yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /zhes 'dus byas la skye 'jig gnas gsum yod pas 'dus byas zhes brjod la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos sku la de med pas thog ma dbus mtha' med pa'i rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas yin no zhes pa'o/ /zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir/ /lhan gyis grub ces bya ba brjod/ /ces spros pa dang rnam rtog pa dang 'bad rtsol zhi ba'i chos 727

kyi sku can yin pa'i phyir lhun gyis grub pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /so so rang gis rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rto gas min pa/ /zhes mnyam bzhag so so rang gisartogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gzhan sgra rtog gi rkyen gyis rtogs par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /de ltar rnam gsum rtogs phyir mkhyen/ /zhes de ltar rang bzhin rnam dag dang / glo bur rnam dag dang / ji lta ba 9mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsum rtogs pa'i phyir mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /lam ston phyir na thugs brtse ba/ /zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yulardzodedag ma rtogs pa rnams la rtogs pa'i lam ston par mdzad pa'i phyir na thugs brtse ba mnga' ba'o zhes so/ /nus ba ye shes thugs rje yis/ /rtsag bsngal nyon mongaspospong phyir ro/ /zhes nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes dang thugs rje yis gzhan gyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang rgyu nyon mongs spong bar mdzad pa ni nus pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhes pa'o/ /dang bo gsum gyis rang don te/ /sbyi ma gsum gyis gzhan don yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa de dag drug gi dang bo gsum gyis rang don phun sum tshogs ba bstan la/ phyi ma gsum gyis gzhan don phun sum tshogs par bstan pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog de las chos dkon mchog 'byung 728

ba'i phroṃme de'i rjes thogs su de'i dbang rdu byas nas rdzigs su bzud pa gsung ba ni/ ’gang zhig med min yod min yod med ma yin yod med las gzhan du'ang / /brtag par mi nus rjes tshig dang bral so so rang gis rig zhi ba/ /dri med ye shes 'od rjer snang ldan dmigs pa kun la chags pa dang / /sdang dang rab rib rnam par 'joms mabhād dam chos nyi ma de la 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ chos gang yang med pa dang yod pa dang yod med gnyi ga dang / de las gzhan du yod med gnyi ga ma yin pa dang rang bzhin gyis grub par brtag par mi nus pas spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'o/ /'di 'grel ba'i 'gyur ltar bshad pa yin gsungs so/ /des na tshigs bcad 'di'i don ni/'gog pa'i bden pa de nyid mtha' bzhi gang du yang brtag par mi nus pa ste busam du med pa dang rjod byed kyi sgra dang / yul so so'i skad dang / 'di'i don ni 'di'o zhes nges tshig la brte na nas rtogs tshul rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa bral bas/'phags pa rnams kyi mnyam bzhag so so rang gis rig pas gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis rig par bya ba dang / nyon mongs kun btags dang / lhan skyes kyi sa bon ci rigs pa gnyen pos 729

bcom pas zhi ba'o/ /shis rab kyis sgrib pa'i sa bon ci rigs pa spangs pas dri ma med pa dang / — de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogasungapa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyi snang ba dang ldan pa yin la gzugs sogs yul la dmigs pa'i chags pa dang / yid du mi 'ong ba la sdang ba dang rmongs pa'i rab rib 'joms par mdzad pa'i dam chos nyi ma de la 'dud do/ /zhes pa'o/ /tshigs bcad 'dis mdor bsdus na yon tan brgyad bstan pa yin te/ yon tan brgyad ni/ rtsa bar/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig gang gis chags zal ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de tshos/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dis ni yon tan brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i chos dkon mchog brjod de/ yon tan brgyad ni/bsam du med pa/ gnyis su med pa/ rnam par rtog pa med pa/ dri mas dag pa/ mngon par gsal ba/ gnyen po'i phyogs/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu ste brgyad do/ /de lta bu'i yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i 'gog bden dang lam bden gnyis kyi mtshan nyid can ni chos dkon mchog yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /730

de brgyad ni 'gog bden dang lam bden gnyis kyis bsdus tshul ston par/ chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang / /lam gyi bden pa dag gis brtsas/ /go rim ji bzhin de dag krang / /yon tan gsum gsum gyis rig bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ dang bo gsum ni bsam du med pa dang / las nyon gnyis su med pa dang / bden 'dzin gyis rnam parathurtog pa med pa ste yon tan dang bo gsum gyis 'gog bden bstan la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba ni de gsum gyis bsdus pa'o/ /dri mas dag pa dang /de kho na nyid mngon par gsal ba dang / gnyen po'i phyogs te yon tan tha ma gsum gyis lam bden bstan la/ de gsum gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rgyu bsdus pa yin la/ go rim ji bzhin de dag kyang / /yon tan gsum gsum gyis rig bya/ /zhes pa'i don to/ / 'gog bden de bsam du med par ston pa ni/ brtag min phyir dang brjod min phyir/ /'phags pas mkhyen phyir bsam med nyid/ /zhi nyid gnyis med rtog med de/ /dag sogs gsum ni nyi bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'gog pa'i bden pa ni rgyu gsum gyis bsam du med pa rig par bya ste/ mtha' bzhir brtag par bya ba min pa dang / sgra rtog gis rdzogs /par brjod par bya ba min pa 731

dang / 'dzigs pos rmanyam rbazheg so so rang rig gis mkhyin pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu de gsum gyis bsam med nyid yin par bstan to/ /las nyon gnyis zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba nyid dang /gnyis su ste las dang nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa rgyu tshul gyis yid la byed pa med pa dang bden 'dzin rtog pa med pa dang / dag pa dang gsal ba dang gnyen po'i phyogs gsum ni nyi ma bzhin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /rang bzhin rnam dag gi ngo bo nyid sku ston par/ sems de rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs pas/ /lang dag 'gro kun bdag med mtha' zhi yang dag rtogs nas thams cad la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes khyags gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa'i blo mnga' ba/ /sems can rnam dag mtha' las yul can ye shes gzigs mnga' de la 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ sems de rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na sems rang bzhin gyis stong bar rtogs pa'i phyir dang / nyon mongs rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i ngo bo med par gzigs pas/ yang dag 'gro ba ste snod ldan gyi 'gro ba kun la bdag med mtha' bzhi dang bral ba ste zhi ba yang dag pa rtogs su bcug nas thams cad la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rjes zhugs pa gzigs pa la sgrib pa med pa'i 732

blo mnga' ba/ sems can rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i yul can la ye shes kyis gzigs pa mnga' ba/ rang bzhin gyis stong ba mtha' yas pa'i sems can la yod par gzigs pa'i yul can ye shes kyi gzigs pa mnga' ba de la 'dud/ ces pa'o bden gnyis gzigs par ston pa ni/ ji star ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan phyir mi ldog pakhu chogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa gnyis gzigs pa'i nang gi so so rang rig gi ye shes kyi gzigs pa dag pa'i blo ldan te byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs ni/ bla na med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /ji lta ba rig pa'i ngo bo ston par/ 'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /stogs sbyir ji lta nyid de yang / /rang bzhin gyis ne yongs dag sbyir/ /nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'gro ba gang zag dang chos phung khams skye mched rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i bdag med pa'i zhi ba chos nyid ni ji lta ba yin la/ de nyid ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa las ji lta ba khong du chud par rig par bya'o/ /ji lta ba de yang rang bzhin gyis 733

yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pas thog ma nas rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i nyon mongos rang bzhin la zhugs pa zad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /ji snyed pa rig pa'i ngo bo ston par/ shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can thams da la yod par/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ shes bya mthar thug ji lta ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blos/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid de sangs rgyas kyi khams rang bzhin gnas rigs/ sems can thams cad la yod par mthong ba'i phyir/ ji snyed yod pa gzigs pa nyid lnga / / /so so rang rig pa dang / chags thogs kyi sgrib pa las grol tshul bshad pa gnyis ston par/ de ltar rtogs pa gang yin de/ /so sor rang shes mthong ba nyid/ /dri med dbyings la chags med dang / /thogs med phyir te dag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/de ltar 'phags pas shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mngon sum du rtogs pa gang yin pa de/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis mthong ba nyid do/ /rang bzhin gyis dri ma med pa'i dbyings la bden par zhen pa'i chags pa med pa dang / shes bya thams cad 734

la thogs pa mid pa'i phyir/ chags thogs kyi sgrib pa las grol te dag pa yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ / cibyang sems 'phags pa dman sgrib las grol ba'i lus can7 kun gyi skyabs yin par ston pa ni/ ye shes gzigs pa dag pas na/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med phyir/ /'phags dziphyir mi rdzog pha ni/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ ji lta ji snyed kyi nang gi ye— shes kyi gzigs pa dag pas na/tsho sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bla na med pa dang nye bar gyur pas/ byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa ni lus can kun gyi skyabs yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ / dkon mchog gsum bstan tshul ni/ ston pa' bstan pa bslab don gyis/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rkang ba dang bo'i dgos pa dang /rkang ba phyi ma gsum gyis ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ston to/ /zhes gsungs/ tshig don ni/ ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rang rgyud la 'thob byar byed pa theg pa chen po'i rigs can dang / bstan pa chos dkon mchog rten 'brel zab mo'i don rtogs pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zad pa rang rgyud la 'thob byar byed pa'i rang 735

sangs rgyas kyi rigs can dadzi / nyan thos dgra btsom pa'i 'ablosacibu rang rgyud la 'thob byar byed pa'i nyan 'thos kyi rigs can te theg pa gsum gyi gang zag gi dbang du byas nas 'bras skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin la/ gzhan yang / ston pa dang /bstan pa theg pa gsum gyis 'phags pas thob zin pa'am grub zin gyi mchog gsum rgyu'i skyabs su byed pa'i don gyis dang / lam ma zhugs kyang dkon mchog gsum la mchod ba la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa gsum la mos pa rnams kyi dbang du byas nas/ rgyu'i skyabs gsum kyang rnam par bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas nyag gcig don dam pa'i skyabs su bsgrub pa ni/spang sbyir bsru ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin te/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi lung gi chos ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs chos can/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu don dam pa'i skyabs ma yin te/ rang nyid kyis 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe gzings ltar spang bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ rang nyid kyi 'bras skyabs ma yin pa'i don yin gyi/ sangus rgyas thob nas gsung gi tshogs dgos pa med pa'i don min te/ gzhan don du dgos pa'i phyir/ byang chub 736

sems dpa'i 'phags rgyud kyi bden stong mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes chos can/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu don dam pa'i skyabs ma yin te/ rang nyid dri ma'i bslad pa mtha' dag dang bral ba med kyang / dri ma'i bslad pa med par snang ba'i bslu ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir te rang nyid dri ma dang bral ba med pa'i phyir/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa chos can/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu don dam pa'i skyabs ma yin te/ shes sgrib kyi 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ de ltar lung rtogs kyi chos rnam gnyis dang / sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i 'phags pa'i tshogs/ gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ / sangs rgyas nyag gcig skyabs mthar thug yin par ston pa ni/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ /thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /chogs kyang de yi mabar thug phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba rnams kyi don dam pa'i skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin te/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jigs pa thams cad zad pa'i chos kyi sku brnyes pa can yin pa'i phyir/ rgyun mtha' ba man chad kyi theg pa gsum po'i 'phags pa'i tshogs kyang chos sku de'i mthar thug pa can du 'gro bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir/737

zhes pa'o/ / dkon mchog gi ming don bshad pa ni/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir/ /mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan thar phyir dang mchog nyid pyir/ /'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ ran zhes pa rin po che dang / yi ge bsnan pa'i nges tshig gis dkon mchog la yang 'jug pas/ chos mthun rnam pa drug gis chos mthun te/ rin po che ltar 'byung ba dkon pa'i phyir dkon pa dang / rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyi dri ma med ba dang / nus mthu chen po dang ldan pa dang / 'jig rten gyi rgyan du gyur pa dang / yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i phyir mchog tu gyur pa yin phyir thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan can dang / 'bras bu 'byin pa 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir dkon mchog nyid snaces brjod par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /sngar gyi yig rnying dag la dkon cog ces bris pa yin cing / deng skabs dkon mchog ces mchog gi sgra sbyar ba ni/ gzhung tshig 'di la brten par gsungs so/ / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par dag pa skye ba'i gnas ni dkon mchog gsum yin la/ de skye ba'i rgyu rkyen gyi dbang du byas nas gsung ba ni/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri 738

ma med/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzod/ /gang las dkon mchog dge ba gsum 'byung ba/ /donabom gzigs pa rnams kyi yul nyid do/ /zhes gsungs te/ nyer len dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang / lhan cig byed rkyen dri med byang chub dang /dri med sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ste rgyu rkyen bzhi bo de las dge ba dkon mchog gsum 'byung ba yin la/de dag yongs su rdzogs pha ni don dam gzigs pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul yin no/ /zhes —pa'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab cing sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi yul yin par ston pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum po 'azhi yi rigs/ /thams cad gzigs pa rnams kyi yul/ /de yang rnam bzhi go rim bzhin/ / bzhi yis ni bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs te/ dkon mchog gsum po'i rigs dang rgyu rkyen ni/ thams cad gzigs pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon sum gyi yul yin la/ de yang rnam pa bzhi go rim bzhin rgyu mtshan bzhi yis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi mngon sum gyi spyod yul yin/zhes pa'o/ /tshigs bcad snga mas rgyu rkyen bzhi ngos bzung nas gang gi yul du 'gyur ba bstan la/ 'dis de'i yul du 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan bstan to/ /739

bzhi bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ston par/dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag byir/ /rnam par dbye ba megachos sprur/ /lhan grupa skom par mi rtog phyir/ /zhes gtsangs te/ sems rang bzhin gyi sa rnam par dag pa dang / de nyon mongs dang ldan pa'i phyir de gnyis gzhi mthun du 'dus pa rtogs dka' bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa tredang / sems kyi rang bzhin la sngar nas kun nas nyon mongs med pa la/ glo bur gyi dri mas dag pa'i phyir rtogs dka 'a bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sems kyi rang bzhin dri ma med pa'i yon tan ni dri ma med pa yang yin la/ gcig tu kun nas nyon mongs pa so so skye bo'i rgyud la yang chos nyid ngo bo'i sgo nas rnam par dbye ba/ med pa'i chos nyid yin phyir rtogs dka' bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ni/lhun gyis grub pa dang / mdzad pa mdzad pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir rtogs dka' bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /rgyu rkyen so sor rnam— par bzhag pa ni/ rtogs bya rtogs pa de yi ne/ /yan lag rtogs par byed phyir te/ /go rim ji bzhin gnas gcig de/ /dag rgyu gsum ne rkyen yi na no/ /zhes gsungs te/ rtogs par byas pa'i khams kyi gnas gcig po de 740

rnam tswaparapyidag pa'i rgyu banyags pajiba'o/ /rtogs bya de nyid mngon sulodu rtogs pa mthar thug pa byang chub dang / byang chub de'i yastolag sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang / yon tan des gdul bya rigs can gsum gyis de bzhin nyid rtogs par byed pa'i 'phrin las de/ go rim ji bzhin du gnas gsum ste de gsum ni dri ma dag byed rkyen yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ / yan lag gi don ni/ rdzogs sangs sku ne 'akro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying bo can/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus can te sems can kun de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo'i mdo las/ rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi snying bo can no zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos sku'i 'phrin las ni sems can thams cad la 'phro ba'i phyir sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las 'jug rung du gnas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang sems can gnyi ga'i de bzhin nyid dbyer med pa'i phyir/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid sems can thams cad la yod pa la dgongs nas sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo can dang / sems can thams cad chos skur gnas 'gyur rung gi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs tshu 74 1

dang / gzugs skur gnas 'argyur rung gi yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i rigs snying bor yod pa'i phyir na de la dgongs nas kyang sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo can du gsungs so/ /zhes pa'o/ / — sdom gyis mdor bstan pa ni/ dza bo 'bras las ldan 'acag pa dang / /gnas skabs de bzhin kun cu 'gro ba'i don/ / rtag tu mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med ni/ /don dam dbyings kyi dgongs don yin zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ rigs kyi ngo bo ni rigs can gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo gsum mo/ /rgyu ni de gsum rnam par dag byed kyi rgyu dang / de bzhin nyid rnam tha/ra dag byed kyi rgyu dang / rigs rnam par sbyong byed kyi rgyu'o/ /ldan pa nirkamos pa dang shes rab la sogs pa'i rgyu'i yon tan ldan pa dang / 'bras bu'i yon tan dang yang ldan pa'o/ /'jug pa ni ma dag pa'i gnas skabs kun tu 'gro zhing 'jug pa'o/ /de ltar gnas skabs kun tu 'gro yang / ngo bo rtag tu mi 'gyur ba dang / gnas skabs tha dad pa tsam las/ rang gi ngo bo tha dad ma yin par yon tan dbyer med par 'jug pa'o/ /de dag ni don dam chos dbyings kyi mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo zhes pa'i dgongs don 742

yin zhis bya'o/ /mdor bsdus na don rnam pa shaṃcu la dgongs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams rnam par bzhag par rig par bya'o/ /don rnam pa bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ngo bo'i don dang / rgyu'i don dang / 'bras bu'i don dang / las kyi don dang / ldan pa'i don dang / 'jug pa'i don dang / gnas skabs kyi rab tu dbye ba'i don dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i don dang / mi 'gyur ba'i don dang / dasder med pa'i don to/ /dang bo ngo bo dang / gnyis pa rgyu'i don las brtsams pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ rin chen nam mkha' chu dag bzhin/ /rtag tu rang bzhin nyon mongs med/ /chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab dang / /ting 'dzin snying rje las byung ba/ /zhes gsungs te/rdon ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang /de bzhin nyid nam mkha' dang / rigs snying rjes brlan pa'i chu dag pa dang chos mthun pa yin la/ spyi'i mtshan nyid rtag tu rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang / nyon mongs rang bzhin gyis med pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i don bshad pa ni/ chos mos lhag pa' shes rab dang / /ting 'dzin snying brtse las byung ba/ /zhes gsungs te/ sa bon dang chos mthun pa theg pa chen po'i chos 743

la lhag par—mos pa dang / mjidang chos mthun pa lhag pa'i shes rab dang / mngal dang chos mthun pa ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa dang / ma ma dang chos mthun pa snying rje —chen po las rigs dri ma mtha' dag dang bralanas/ rigs yongs su sbyangs pas chos sku byung ba'o/ / gong gi tshigs su bcad pa de'i don bshad pa/ mthu dang gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /brlan ba'i ngo bo rang bzhin phyir/ — /'di dag nor bu rin chen mkha'/ /chu yi yon tan chos mthun nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ chos sku don 'grub pa'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ chos sku 'phrin las 'jug rung gi sems can yang de thob pa'i mthu dang ldan pa dang / dri bcas de bzhin nyid kyang rang bzhin gyis stong ba las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang / rgyas 'gyur gyo rigs kyi sa bon 'jog pa'i tshe sems can la snying brtse bas brlan pa'i phyir gsum po dzadi/ nor bu dang nom mkha' dang / chu'i yon tan dang chos mthun pa yin no/ /sgrib bcas kyi gang zag sgrib pa dang bcas par bshad pa ni/chos la khong khro bdag lta dang / /'khor ba' srug bsngal gyis 'jigs dang / /sems can don la ltos med nyid/ /'dod chen mya rtsegs nyan thos dang / /rang byung rnams kyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /744

dag rgyu lhag par sgromos pa la/ /sogs ba'i chos gi rnamasnyebazhi nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ theg chen gyi chos la khong khro zhing zhe sdang ba 'dod chen pa dang / gang zag gi bdag lta can mu stegs pa dang /rang gcige pu'i ched du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas sems can 'dor 'dod pa nyan thos dang / sems can sdug bsngal dang bral ba bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i sems can gyi don la ltos pa med pa nyid de rang byung ste rang rgyal gyi sgrib pa rnams ni/ thams cad mkhyen thob pa la sgrib pa rnam ba bzhi yin no/ /'di dag ni theg chen gyi lam du bgrod pa kun gyis spang dgos so/ /khams kyi dri ma dag byed kyi rgyu theg chen gyi chos la lhag par mos pa la sogs pa'i rgyu'i chos ni bzhi nyid du shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ / dag byed kyi rgyu bzhi ston par/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos bskyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /zhes gsungs te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ theg chen lda mos pa sgom pa ni 'dod chen pa theg chen chos la sdang ba'i gnyen po dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sgom pa ni mu stegs byed kyi bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen po dang / 745

byang chub sims dpa' rnamasakyis nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan sgom pa ni/ sems can gyi don la rgyab kyis phyogs shing semase can gyi don la mi ltos pa'i gnyen po yin no/ /bde ba'i mngal dang chos mthun pa'i ting nge 'edzin la gnas nas/ snying rje ma ma dang mthun pa yod pa can dganeni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su chos kyi rgyal bo'i sras su 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ / sgrib pa'i gnyen po rgyu'i rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa la/gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid kyi/ /yonatan pha rol phyin pa 'bras/ /rtsag bsngal yid 'ebyung zhi thob par/ /'dun dang smon pa'i las can no/ /zhes gsungs te/ gtsang ba dang / bdag dam pa dang / bde ba dang / rtag pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa mthar thug pa ni/ 'bras bu'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brnag mi bzod pa khong du chud nas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis yid 'byung zhing zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa 'dun pa dang / thob par gyur cig snyam du smon pa'i las can no/ /zhes pa'o/ shes rab ni theg pa gsum ga'i thun mong ba'i rgyu yin pas ma lta bu dang / thabs ni thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pas pha lta bu bzhag go / 746

de dag gi 'bras bu bshad pa ni/ 'di dag 'bras rna mdor brtsa na/ /chos kyi sku la sbyin ci log /rnam ba bzhi las bablog pa yi/ /gnyen po'i rab tu r+bha ba nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mos pa la sogs pa'i 'bras bu mdor bsdu na/ chos kyi sku la phyin ci log rnam pa bzhi spangs pas gnyen po'i rab tu phye ba nyid 'bras —bu'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /phyin ci log bzhi ni/ gtsang / bdagabade dang / rtag pa bzhi yin la/ de bzhi ni chos sku'i dbang du byas te 'dir phyin ci log tu 'dod do/ /phung bo ni mi rtag sogs 'dzin pa'i blo sogs bzhi ni de dag gi gnyen po'o/ /'bras bu bzhi'i mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa ni/ de rna rang ba⑫/na dag phyir dang / /bag chags spangs phyir gtsang ba yin/ /bdag dang bdag med spros pa dag /nye bar zhi ba dam pa'i bdag/yid kyi rang bzhin phung bo dang / /de rgyu log phyir bde ba nyid/ /'khor ba dang ni rtsa ngan 'das/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir rtag/ces gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku chos can/ gtsang ba'i pha rol du phyin pa yin te/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i phyir dang / nyon mongs pa'i bag chags zad par spangs pa'i phyir/ dam pa'i bdag gi pha rol du phyin pa yin te/mu stegs pas btags pa'i gang zag gi bdag dang bdag med 747

bden par grub pa'i spros pa dag med par mngon sum du rtogs shing bdag med la ltos te gnyis snang gi spros pa yang slar mi 'byung ba'i tshul du nye bar zhi bas khyab pa'i phyir/ bde ba'i pha rol du phyin pa yin te/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa dang las kyis bskyed pa'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phung bo dang / de'i rgyu ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sa dang / las zad par spangs pa'i tshul gyis log pa'i phyir/ rtag pa'i pha rol du phyin pa yin te/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan las 'das r+pā rang bzhin gyis stong bar mnyam par nyid du rtogs pas srid zhi'i mtha' dang bral ba mthar thug pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ / byang sems kyi rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje gnyis chos sku'i rtsa bar bstan pa ni/ bdag gred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad de/ /sems can gred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min/ /de ltar blo brtse byang chub thabs brten nas/ /'phags pa 'khor ba mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ byang sems 'phags pas bdag la sred pa'i chags pa ma lus pa mi rtag pa sogs dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i sges rab kyis bcad de 'khor ba'i mtha' mi gnas la/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi sred pa dang ldan pa'i 748 —

jir/ brtse ldan byang chub sims dpa' zhi mtha' thob pa minajino/ /de ltar blo ste shes rab dang brtse ba ste snying rje chen po gnyis kyis bsdus pa byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs la brten nas/ byang sems 'phags pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' gnyis su lhung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /de sgrub byed la sgrub byed 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur dang / rjes su 'gro ldog gi sgo nas de bsgrub pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ gal te sangs rgyas khams med na/ /rtsag la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing / /byu ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang / /don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ gal te sangs rgyas kyi khams zag med kyi sa bon med na/ sdug bsngal gyi nyes dmigs mthong na'ang skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing / myang 'das la 'dod pa dang don gnyer dang smon pa'ang med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /des 'phangs pa'i sgrub byed ni/ sems can la sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod de/ 'khor bas yid 'byung bas spong 'dod dang / myang 'das thob 'dod mthong ba'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ /rjes su 'gro ldog gi sgo nas de bsgrub pa ni/ brad dang thu ngan 'das la de'i/ /sngug bde'i skyon yon mthong ba 'di/ /rigs yod las ne gang phyir de/ /rigs med dag la med phyir ro/ /749

zhisacigasungs rto/ srid po dang mya ngan las 'das pa la/ de'i sdug bsngal gyi skyon dang bde ba'i yon tan ma thong ba 'di/ rigs yod pa las yin te/ gang gi phyir na srid zhi'i skyon yon mthong ba de rigs med pa dag la med pā'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa yin la/ rkang ba snga ma gnyis dang phyed kyis rjes 'gro bstanacel/ phyi ma rkang ba phyed dang gcig gis ldog pa bstan te/ rjes su 'gro ldog gi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'o/ / rigs kyi rgyu'i yon tan bstan pa ni/ rgya mtsho che bzhin dpag med pa'i/ /yon tan rin chen mi zad gnas/ /dbyer med yon tan dang ldan pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid byur mar me bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du rigs yod pa'i cha nas yon tan dpag tu med pa'i/ yon tan rin chen mi zad pa'i gnas yin te/ rgya mtsho ni rin po che la sogs pa'i snod dang rin po che dang / chu sna rnams tshogs pa yin pa bzhin du/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi khams kyang rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du yon tan bzhi'i gnas yin te/ mos pa ni snod lta bu dang / shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin rin po che lta bu dang / snying rje ni chu lta bu'o/ /'bras bu'i yon tan ni/ dbyer med par yon tan dang ldan pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi phyir/ mar me bzhin du rdzu 'phrul dang / lha'i 750

rdo— ba dang / gzhan gyi sems pa dang / sdon gyi gnas dang /'chi 'pho dang skye ba dran pa'i mngon shes te mngon shes lnga dang /zag zad kyi mngon shes dang / zag pa zad pa ste 'bras bu'i yon tan bdun dang ldan pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /rgyu'i yon tan ldan par bshad pa/ chos sku rgyal ba'i ye shes dang / /thugs rje'i khams ne brtsas pa'i phyir/ /snod dang rin chen chu yi ni/ /rgya mtsho dang zhi mtshungs par bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos sku dag byed theg chen la mos pa snod dang / theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zhi lhag gnyis rgyal ba'i ye shes thob byed yin pa'i tūr rin po che lta bu dang / byang sems kyi snying rje chen po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje 'jug pa'i rgyu yin phyir chu dang chos mtshungs pa yin/ de bzhin khams ni rgyu'i yon tan dang ldan par bsdus pa'i phyir/ dpe gsum po 'dis rgya mtsho dang mtshungs par bstan to/ / 'bras bu'i yon tan dang ldan par bshad pa ni/ dri med gnas la mngon shes dang / /ye shese dri med de nyid dang / /rnam dbyer med phyir mar me yi/ /snang dang dro mdog chos mtshungs can/ /zhes gsungs te/ dri ma med pa'i gnas khams la 'bras bu'i yon tan mngon shes lnga dang / zag zad kyi ye shes dri med 751

dang dri med spangs pa de nyid dang ngo bo'i sgo nas rnam par dbyer med pa'i phyir mar me'i snang ba dang / dro ba dang mdog dang chos mtshungs pa can no/ /zhes pa'o / / 'jug pa'i rab dbye bshad pa ni/ so so skye 'phags jogs sangs kyi/ /de bzhin nyid dbye'i 'jug pa las/ /de nyid gzigs pas semes can la/ /rgyal ba'i snying bo 'di bstan to/ /zhes gsungs te/ so so skye bo dang 'phags pa gzhan dang /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rten de gsum la gnas pa rten gyi rka 'jug pa dang / de bzhin nyid dri mas ma dag pa dang /phyogs gcig dang bral ba ste dag pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad zad pa'i dbye ba gsum du gnas pas rab tu dbye ba'i 'jugapa las/ de nyid gzigs pas sems can la rgyal ba'i snying bo dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid bstan to/ /zhes pa'o/ /tshigs bcad des bstan pa'i don ni/ so so skye po sbyin byu log /bden pa mthong ba snog pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ji lta bzhin/ /phyin ci ma log spros med nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ so so skye bo'i rgyud kyi de bzhin nyid sgrib pa'i sa bon cung zad kyang ma spangs shing dri ma'i sa bon dang bcas pas phyin ci log dang bcas pa dang / sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i bden 752

ba mngon sum du mthong ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi de bzhin nyid —de lasaldog pa ste dri ma zad par ma spangs shing dri ma'i sa bon ci rigs spangs pas phyin ci ma log pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ji lta ba bzhin gzigs pa mthar thug pa'i rgyud kyi de bzhin nyid phyin ci ma log pa spros pa med pa nyid kyi rab tu dbye bas gnas pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /gtso bo byang chub sems dpa' rnams yin mod kyi/ 'phags pa gzhan yang rim pa gnyis kyitshonang du bsdu bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ rang bzhin gcig pu gnas skabs kun tu 'gro bar bsgrub pa ni/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /zhin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhino gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgrub pa'i sa bon cung zad tsam yang ma dag pa dang / sgrib pa mtha' dag ma dag cing kun btags kyi sa bon sogs ci rigs pa dag pa dang shin tu rnam dag gi de bzhin nyid gsum la go rim bzhin du/ so so skye bo'i sems can gyi khams de bzhin nyid dang /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi khams dang / shin tu rnam dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid do zhes brjod do/ /zhes pa'o/ / 753

dzigs bcad 'di'i don ston pa ni/ 'o po nyid la sogs pa'i don/ /'dicog gis ne brtsas pa yi/ /khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu/ /ming gsum gyis ne bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngar bshad pa'i ngo bo nyid la sogs sa'i don ni/ gong du bshad pa'i don drug ste/ phyin ci log ma log spros med gsum dang / ma dag dag pa shin tu rnam dag gsum ste 'di drug gis bsdus pa yi ste/ de dag gis bshad pa'i don yang mdor bsdus na/ gnas skabs gsum du ming gsum gyis btags nas bstan pa yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /sems kyi chos nyid kun tu 'gro ba ni/ ji ltar rtog med bdag nyid can/ /nam mkha' kun tu rjes song ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med dbyings/ /de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba nyid/ byu/ces gsungs te/ ji ltar snod stong ba kun tu khyab par bya'o snyam pa'i rtog pa med pa'i bdag nyid can/ nam mkha' thogs reg dang bral ba stong ba kun tu rjes su song ba ltar/ sems kyi rang bzhin dri ma med pa'i dbyings rang bzhin gyis stong ba de nyid de bzhin du chos can kun tu 'gro ba nyid shes par bya'o1 /zhes pa'o/ / spyi'i mtshan nyid ston par/ de spyi'i mtshan nyid nyes pa 754

ding / /'on tan mthar brag khrab pa ste/ /gachugs rkye rnam pa dman pa dang / /bar ma mchog la nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ /bams de spyi'i mtshan nyid de bzhin nyid de nyid ma lus pa dang bcas pa dang / spang bya'i sa bon ci rigs pa spangs pa'i yon tan dang / yon tan mthar thug pa kun la khyab pa ste/ gzugs kyi rnam pa sa dang / zangs dang / gser gyi snod rim pa bzhin du dman pa dang / bar ma dang / mchog la nam mkha' khyab pa bzhin du 'gro ba nyid do/ /zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin/ nyid mi 'gyur ba'i don las brtsams te/ tshigs su bcad pa bcu bzhi yod pa la/ de dag gi don bsdus te ston pa mdor bstan lta bu ni/ nyes pa blo bur dang ldan dang / /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'byur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes gsungs te/ de bzhin nyid de ni/ ma dag pa'i gnas skabs dang / ma dag pa dang dag pa'i gnas skabs na nyon mongs pa dang nyes pa'i nyon mongs pa glo bur ba dang ldan la/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas skabs na yon tan thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang ldan pa yin mod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams nam mkha' bzhin snga ma dang phyi ma'i skabs gtan 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid yin 755

rno/ /zhis pa'o/ / rta rgyas par bshad pa la/ ma dag pa'i gnas skabs na mi 'gyur bar ba shad pa dang / ma dag pa dang dag pa'i gnas skabs na mi 'gyu ra bar ba shad pa dang / shin tu rnalodag gi gnas skabs na mi 'gyur ba'i do na bshad pa 'o/ / — — phung sogs skyed byed las nyon sogs kyis mi 'gyur bar bshad pa la/ kun nas nyokomongs kyi chos kyis ma gos par ston pa ni/ ji ltar nam mkha' kun song ba/ /za byar nye bar gos pa med/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /gnas 'dir nye bar gos pa med/ /ces gsungs te/ ji ltar nam mkha' snod kyi 'jig rten kun tu khyab par song ba yin yang / byu thogs pa'i reg bya bcad tsam yin pas 'dus ma byas shing dbang bo'i mngon sum gyi yul du ma gyur sge 'i phra ba'i phyir/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi nyes pas rdul sogs kyis nye bar gos pa med pa de bzhin du/ sems can thams cad la khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa zag pa med pa'i gnas 'di khyab par yod kyang las nyon gyi rnam pa gzhan du bsgyur pa'i tshul gyis nye bar gos par med do/ /zhes pa'o/ /skye 'jig gis ma gos pa ni/ ji ltar 'jig rten thams 756

cad du/ /nam mkha' la ni skye zhing 'jig /de bzhin 'dus ma byas dbyings la/ /dbang bo rnams rna skye zhing 'jig /ces gsungs te/ ji ltar snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad du/nam mkha' la gnas pa'i snod bcud thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings skye zhing 'jig pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'dus ma byas nam mkha'i dbyings la dbang bo rnams ni skye zhing 'jig kyang / khams de bzhin nyid ni skye 'jig gi chos kyi rnam pa gzhan du — zi bsgyur mi nus so/ /zhes pa'o/ / 'jig pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa ni/ ji ltar nam mkha' me rnams kyis/ /rdzon chad nam yang tshirtswapa med/ /de bzhin 'di ni 'chi ba dang / /na dang rga ba'i mes mi 'tshigaspe /ces gsungs te/ ji ltar nam mkha' me rnams kyis sngon chad nam yang tshig pa med pa de bzhin du/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid 'di ni 'chi ba dang na ba dang rga ba'i mes mi 'tshig mi zhig go /zhes pa'o/ /rnams ni mang tshig yin pas me ni gsum mo/ / dpe dang don ston pa ni/ sa dzene chu la chu chung la/ /cang ne mkha' la rab tu gnas/ /mkha' gi chung dang chu dag dang / /sa yi khams la gnas ma yin/ /zhes ge sungs te/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ni chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas la/ chu rlung la gnas rlung 757

nam mkha' la rab tu gnas kyang 'dus ma byas pa'i nam mkha' ni/ rlung dang chu dag dang sa'i khams la gnas par ma yin par shes par bya'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / dpe don so sor sbyar ba ni/ de bzhin phung bo khams dbang rnams/ /las dang ston mongs dag la gnas/ /laspodang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min/ /yid la —byed la rtag tu gnas/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ne/ /thams cad la yang gnas pa med/ /ces gsungs te/ gong gi dpe de bzhin rnam smin gyi phung bo dang / khams dang mig dbang sogs skye mched rnams rang rgyu las dang nyon mongs dag la gnas shing / las dang nyon mongs gang zag dang phung bo bden par 'dzin pa'i tshul bzhin min pa'i yid la byed pa la rtag tu gnas la/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed ni/ sems kyi gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis dag pa la rab tu gnas kyang / — sems kyi rang bzhin don dam pa'i bden pa ni gnas lugs mthar thug pa'i tshul gyis las ston la sogs pa'i chos thams cad la gnas pa med do/ /zhes pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyi khams de nyid tshul min yid byed kyi dbang gis gnas pa ma yin pa ni/ sa dang 'dra ba phung bo dang / /758

skye mched khams rnams shes par bya/ /chu khams dang 'a dra lus can gyi/ /las dang nyon mongs shes byalte/ /tshul bzhin ma yin mid byed ne/ /drung gi khams dang 'dra bar lta/ /rang bzhin nam mkha'i khams bzhin du/ /de gzhi can min gnas pa med/ /ces gsungs te/ rnam smin gyi phung bo skye mched khams rnams ni sa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra bar shes par bya ste/ las dang nyon mongs kyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir dang / sa'i gling bzhi ri rab sogs kyi rten byed pa ltar ma 'ong ba na rnam smin 'byin pa'i las nyon gyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ gzhi mi brtan pa rlung la gnas pa'i chu khams dang —'dra bar lus kyi las dang nyon mongs shes par bya ste/ zag bcas kyi phung bo'i rten byed pa'i phyir dang / gzhi mi brtan pa tshul min yid byed la brten pa'i phyir/ tshularmo bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed ni rlung gi khams dang 'dra bar lta bar bya ste/sems kyi rang bzhin don dam pa'i bden pa nam mkha'i khams bzhin du/ de tshul min yid byed kyi 'dzin stangs dang mthun pa'i gzhi can min zhing / tshul min yid byed sogs la gnas pa med do/ /zhes pa'o/ /tshul min yid byed kyi khyad par ni / tshul bzhin ma yin mid byed ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin la gnas te/ /tshul bzhin 7bya 9

ma yin yid byed kyis/ /las dang nyon mongs rab rtu gye/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin bden stong spros bral la rab tu gnas la/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed kyis las dang nyon mongs skye ba'i go skabs rab tu phye bas/ phyed snga mas bden stong la gnas pa dang / phyed phyi mas las nyon gyi rten byed par bstan to/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di dag gis kyang las dang nyon mongs pa gzhi med rtsa bral du pasgrub pa yin no/ /las dang nyon mongs kyi khyad par ni/ las dang nyon mongs chu las ni/ /phung bo skye mched khams rnams 'byung / /de 'jig pa dang chags pa ltar/ /skye dang 'jigapar 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ las dang nyon mongs chu'i dkyil 'khor lta bu las ni nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas rnam smin gyi phung bo dang skye mched dang khams rnams 'byung la/ chu'i dkyil 'khor 'jig pa dang chags pa ltar rnam smin gyi phung bo sogs kyang las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba dang 'jig par 'gyur ro sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar skye 'jig dang bral bar ston pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' yi/ /khams 760

ltar zed skyen med ne/ /tshogs pa med cing skye ba dang / /'jig dang gnas pa'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ nam mkha' skye 'jig dang bral ba ltar/ sems kyi rang bzhin don dam pa'i bden pa yang nam mkha'i khams ltar skyed pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu med cing lhan cig byed rkyen med de/ de skyed pa'i rgyu rkyen tshogs pa med cing skye ba —dang mthar 'jig pa dang / rgyu yi dbang gis gnas pa yang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /sems kyi rang bzhin las nyon gyis gzhan du mi 'gyur bar ston pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa/ /de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de/ /lang dag min rtog las byung 'dod chags sogs/ /blo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa gang yin pa de ni/ snod kyi bye brag gis gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i nam mkha' bzhin du nyon mongs kyis ngo nga bo gzhan du 'gyur ba med de/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i rtog pa bden 'dzin las byung ba'i 'dod chags sogs/ gro bur gyi dri mas de nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /sems kyi rang bzhin skye 'jig gis gzhan du mi 'gyur ba 761

ston pa sde/ las dang rtonasnyetshangs chu sogs kyis/ /'de ne mngon par 'grub min te/ /'ami dang na dang rga ba'i me/ /mi bzad pas kyang 'tshig mi 'byur/ /zhes gsungs te/ las dang nyon mongs pa chu'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra ba sogs kyi — tshogs kyis dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid 'di ni mngon par 'grub pa min te skye ba'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i phyir te/ 'chi ba dang na ba dang / rga ba'i sdug bsngal drag po bskyed pa'i mi bzad pas kyang 'tshig par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ 'jig pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /rga na 'chi ba gsum me gsum dang sbyar ba ni/ dus maba' dartsal ba tha mal ba'i/ /me gsum 'chi dang na ba dang / /rga ba'i me gsum rim bzhin du/ /de dag 'dra bar shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'chi ba dang na ba dang rga ba'i me gsum rim pa bzhin du snod kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag sreg par byed pa dang /dmyal ba ba'i lus sreg par byed pa dang / bud shing sreg par byed pa'i dus mtha'i me dang / dmyal ba'i me dang / tha mal ba'i me gsum po de dang 'dra bar shes par bya ste/ lus gtan 'joms pa dang / nad med pa 'joms pa dang / dar la bab pa 'joms pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /'chi ba dang na ba dang rga ba 762

rnams rno go rim bzhin du rgyu mtshan gsum dang 'dra bar rig par bya ste/ skye mched drug bdag gi ba gtan med par byed pa/las nyon gyi 'bras bu 'du byed yongs su smin par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gis ni 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams te yid 'byung bar byas nas/ thar ba la don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa'i thabs bstan par shes par bya'o/ / byang sems snying rje'i dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba ston pa ni/ skye 'chi na dang rga ba las grol ba/ /'di yi rang bzhin ji bzhin nyid rtogs te/ /skye sogs phongs dang bral yang de yi thas/ /blo ldan 'gro la snying rje bskyed phyir bsten/ /zhes gsungs te/ blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa las nyon gyi dbang gis 'chi ba dang na ba dang rga ba las grol ba yin te/ spyod pa rgya chen pos khyad par du byas nas khams 'di'i rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ las nyon gyi dbang gis skye sogs phongs pa dang bral yang 'gro ba la dmigs nas snying rje skye ba'i phyir du 'khor ba bsten pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khams kyi rang bzhin mngon sum du rtogs pa de'i rgyus dang snying rje chen po'i rgyus so/ /zhes pa'o/ /dag pa'i khyad par byang 'phags kyis skye 'chi spangs par 763

ston pa ni/ 'phags pas 'ji dang na ba dang / /rga ba'i hrug bsngal rtsad nas spangs/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye/ /de la de med phyir de med/ /ces gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pas las nyon gyi dbang gis 'chi ba dang na ba dang rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs nas de la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de med de/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis skye ba de med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ /theg pa dman pa'i 'phags pa slob pa rnams stong nyid kyi don mngon sum du rtogs kyang / thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pas las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba len pa yod la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams ni de ltar skye ba ma yin no/ /zhes dar ṭīka las gsungs so /ma dag pa'i skye ba bzhes tshul ni/ ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang / /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang / /'chi dang rga dang na bar ston/ /zhes gsungs te/ thabs rgya chen pos khyad par du byas nas khams ji lta ba bzhin yang dag pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir/las nyon gyi dbang gis skye sogs rnams las 'das par gyur kyang / snying rje'i bdag nyid kyis skye ba dang / 'chi ba dang rga 764

ba dang / na bar ston par mdzad do/ /zhes pa'o/ /rang don gyi yon tan ni/ rgyal sras 'gyur med chos nyid 'di/ /rtogs nas ma rig ldongs rnams kyis/ /skye ba la sogs dag rtu ni/ /mthong ba gang yin de rmad do/ /zhes gsungs te/rgyal sras 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems dang bo bskyed pa'i sa dang bo ba de 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid 'di mngon sum du rtogs nas 'khor ba'i rgud pa las nyon gyi dbang gis skye 'chi las grol yang nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pas ldongs pa rnams kyi skye ba'i tshul ltar snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa dag ni ma rig pas ldongs pa rnams kyis kyang mngon sum du mthong ba gang yin pa de rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes pa'o/ / gzhan don gyi yon tan ni/ 'phags pa'i spyod yul thob pa gang / /byis pa'i spyod yul du ston te/ /de nyid phyir na 'gro ba yi/ /gnyen gyi thabs dang snying rje mchog /ces gsungs te/'phags pa'i spyod yul skye 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs pa thob pas/ sa dang bo gang yin pa des snying rjes kun nas bslangs nas/ byis pa'i spyod yul du skye ba len pa sogs ston par mdzad pa ste/ de nyid kyi phyir na 'gro ba yi gnyen gyi thabs 765

dang snying rje mchog tu gyur pa mnga' ba yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /'jig rten na gnas kyang de'i dri mas ma gos par ston pa ni/ de ni 'jig rten thams cad las/ /'das kyang 'jig rten las ma goyos/ /'jig rten don du 'jig rten na/ /'jig rten dri mas ma gos rdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi byang chub sems dpa' de ni/ so so skye bo nyan thos —dang rang sangs rgyas kyi 'jig rten thams cad las 'das kyang 'jig rten pa'i skye ba len pa la sogs pa'i tshul las ma g.yos par gnas la/ de ltar gnas kyang 'jig rten pa'i don du 'jig rten na ston mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa dang / sdug kun gyi rgud pas zil gyis non nas gzhan don sgrub mi nus pa sogs 'jig rten gyi dri mas ma gos par spyod cing gnas so/ /zhes pa'o / dpe don sbyar te bshad pa ni/ ji ltar pad ma chu nang du/ /skyes pa chu yis gos pa med/ /de bzhin 'di ni 'jig rten du/ /skyes kyang 'jig rten chos mi gos/ /zhes gsungs te/ ji ltar pad ma chu nang du skyes pa chu yis gos pa med pa de bzhin du/spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni 'jig rten du skyes kyang 'jig rten pa'i chos kyis mi gos te/ las nyon gyi 766

skye 'chi las grol zhing skye ba len pa ri bzhed dzi la mnga' bsgyur ba'i phyir ro/ / byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i yon tan ni/ bya ba dzib la rtag tu blo/ /me bzhin du ni 'bar ba dang / /zhi ba'i bsam gtan snyoms 'jug la/ /rtag tu stoms par lugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam pa thams cad du phyir mi ldog pa sa brgyad pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ sems can don bya ba bsgrub pa la rtag tu blo me bzhin du 'bar ba dang zhes pas gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa dang / nyon mongs zad par spangs pas sdug bsngal dang 'bad rtsol nye bar zhi ba'i bsam gtan dang snyoms 'jug la rtag tu snyoms par zhugs pa yin te/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dbang bsgyur thob pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ /khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i myang 'das mngon du byed nus kyang / rang don 'ba' zhig tu thar ba don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa skye ba'i go skabs legs par bcom pas/ rnam pa thams cad du phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa yin la/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi rnal 'byor thob pas rjes thob kyi shes bya 'char tshul ni sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ /zhi ba'i bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs pa ni/ mnyam bzhag rigs 'dra bar ma chad du 'byung 767
